name: Ožujsko Pub Zaobilaznica
description:
A must-visit for beer lovers, Ožujsko Pub Zaobilaznica is a vibrant spot dedicated to Croatia’s most famous brew. While details are limited, expect:
Fresh Ožujsko beer on tap (including limited editions)
Bar snacks like štrukle (cheese rolls) or grilled meats
Sports screenings and a casual, social vibe

name: Pub Gajba
description: The Pub Gajba offers you over 60 types of domestic and foreign beers that you can taste in a pleasant rock atmosphere.

name: Rent a Scooter & Motorcycle Modena
description:
Rent a Scooter Modena is a small family-owned business focused on providing excellent experiences to all our clients.
What Makes Us Stand Out?

- Most Affordable Rates: Our packages are convincingly the most affordable, providing you with top-notch service without emptying your wallet.

- Free Trial Hour: We offer you the opportunity to try our scooters for the first hour absolutely FREE. We’re confident that you will feel the difference.

- 100% Money-Back Guarantee: If you manage to find a better deal or service elsewhere, we will refund you 100% of your money, no questions asked.

name: Brabel Scooter Motorbike & Car Rental
description:
At Brabel Rental Agency, we believe that every journey should be simple, smooth, and full of unforgettable moments. Whether you’re cruising the coast or winding through the historic streets of Dubrovnik, our mission is to make your trip effortless and enjoyable — one ride at a time.

With our local expertise, passion for travel, and commitment to quality service, we help you explore at your own pace. From scenic views to hidden gems, let Brabel be your trusted companion in discovering the beauty and charm of southern Croatia.

At Brabel, the road isn’t just a way to get somewhere — it’s part of the adventure. Let’s make every moment count.

name: Scooter Rental Split
description: We provide a wide selection of motorcycles at affordable costs, ranging from sports bikes to adventure bikes. Our skilled team can assist you in selecting the ideal motorcycle for your requirements. In order to let you discover Croatia on two wheels, we also provide discounts for long-term rentals. You may enjoy the independence of the open road and see the stunning Croatian countryside with the help of our motorcycle rental service. Therefore, reserve your motorcycle rental immediately and relish the journey!

name: Moto Andro Rent
description:
Moto Andro is a company that rents motorcycles/scooters and riding equipment located in the city of Split, Croatia. We combine hobby and work and dedicate our life to motorcycles and travel. In our offer you can find an interesting assortment of the latest Honda motorcycles/scooters and choose something to your liking.
We give great importance to safety, which is why we regularly change tires and check the condition of motorcycles while servicing them at an authorized Honda dealership so that our clients can relax and focus on driving.
We are located near the city center, so you can easily find us and pick up your motorcycle. Our professional staff will welcome you with a smile and help you with every choice. We will be happy to advise you on some motorcycle routes according to your preferences and prepare you for the trip.
We will also show you some very beautiful places including national parks, beaches, sights, various cultural and historical heritage and our traditional Croatian restaurants. Rent your motorcycle / scooter and contact us with confidence.

name: MotoGS Rental
description:
Welcome to MOTOGS Rental, your reliable, family-run motorcycle rental company.
Based in Germany with a Meet&Greet office in Trogir, Croatia, we bring German precision, organization, and reliability to every rental experience.
Located directly on the stunning Adriatic coast, just 10 minutes from Split Airport, we make it easy for you to begin your motorcycle adventure.

name: Rent a scooter Duće Omiš
description: Rent a Scooter Duće Brale – scooter rental in the Croatian town of Duće with affordable prices from 20€/day, offers reliable models for trips along the coast and to the canyon of the Cetina River.

name: Rocker Moto
description: We are ROCKER Motorcycle Rental company from Croatia, Zagreb – motorcycle enthusiasts who have the best job in the world, RIDE WHILE WORKING to meet great people from all over the world and travel to amazing places.

name: ZELRENT
description:
Why choose Zelrent?
- Top level of service: Suitable for tourists and businessmen
- Best rental prices: Daily and long-term leases at an affordable prices
- Secure and comfortable vehicles: All vehicles are less than one year old
- See the sights of Trogir and Ciovo: Escape traffic jams driving Zelrent scooters
- Free delivery within 10 km of Trogir: We arange delivery of vehicles to the desired location

name: Bikers Beer Factory
description: Providing another great reason to visit the nether regions of Savsk cesta, Bikers is by no means a niche bar for a niche public. Bikers Beer Factory provides the design theme and indeed there’s a motorbike repair shop at the same address, but the general atmosphere is one of easygoing alternative lifestyles plus rock’n’roll. The exposed brick interior contains a few post-industrial touches; there’s a large inner-courtyard beer garden; live rock/blues a couple of times a week. As far as the drink is concerned; there’s Erdinger on tap, a good choice of bottled beers, and Perković rakijas on the spirits menu.

name: Legend Riders
description: Zagreb’s cult neighbourhood boozers don’t get more cultish than this: a blues-and-beer bar crammed full of musical mementoes, including a sign reading “Clapton is God”, and a clutch of Fender Stratocasters hanging authoritatively from the wall. It’s another of the places that started stocking bottled beers from around the world long before the craft brewers came along, and is still a great place to pick up Czech and German brands you’ve been planning to try for ages. Well-kept Nova Runda ales are available on tap. The background music revolves around blues, rock and roll and vintage soul; while the narrow, 7-table lay-out contributes to a cosy convivial vibe.

name: Biker Bar Kofein
description: Biker bar Kofein offers you relaxation, socializing, and entertainment with a wide selection of drinks. We are characterized by a pleasant ambiance.

name: Bonk
description: Zagreb’s ultimate craft beer sanctuary, Bonk is where hopheads and rock lovers unite. This industrial-chic pub boasts 24+ rotating taps of Croatian and international microbrews, paired with juicy burgers and live music.

name: Macedonian Pub DZE
description: Welcome to Macedonian Pub DZE, a cozy and atmospheric pub in downtown Skopje, where great beer, live music, and relaxed vibes come together. The interior features wooden tables, soft seating, and a welcoming bar counter. Regular live performances showcase local and guest musicians, adding to the vibrant feel. The perfect spot for evening gatherings, meeting friends, or exploring Macedonian pub culture.

name: Bar Konak
description: Welcome to Bar Konak, a stylish pub located at Borka Talevski 53 in Skopje. The interior blends warm, rock-inspired décor with wooden tables, exposed brick, a cozy bar, and ambient lighting for a relaxed vibe. Guests can enjoy a wide selection of craft and imported beers, laid-back rock music, and friendly service from welcoming staff. An ideal spot for catching up with friends over great drinks in a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Bar Café Racer
description: Bar Café Racer is a compact, rider-friendly spot on Pirinska Makedonija in Kumanovo with a casual, no-frills vibe. By day it’s an easy stop for a straight espresso or a soft drink; after dark expect ice-cold beers and simple mixed drinks. The soundtrack leans rock/indie at a talk-friendly volume—an easy meet-up before or after a ride. Quick, easygoing service and a low-key atmosphere make it a solid place to cool down, swap road stories, and sketch the next route.

name: Drunken Monkeys
description:
Drunken Monkeys is a casual, rider-friendly bar in central Skopje with an easygoing, social vibe.
Expect straightforward drinks - cold beers and classic cocktails - plus simple bar snacks to keep the chat rolling.
The playlist leans upbeat without drowning conversation, making it a good meet-up spot before or after a ride.
Staff are quick and welcoming; it’s the kind of place where you can cool down, trade road stories, and sketch the next route.

name: Crash Bar
address: Blvd. Saint Clement of Ohrid br.18, 1000
description:
Crash Bar is a laid-back bar-grill in central Skopje, just off the government quarter, with a warm, no-frills vibe.
The menu leans comfort: juicy burgers, wings, club sandwiches, and shareable snacks, paired with a solid lineup of beers and classic cocktails.
Daytime feels relaxed for lunch or coffee, while evenings ramp up with a lively crowd and occasional live-music or themed nights.
Service is friendly and quick, there’s a small outdoor area, and take-away is available—an easy pick when you want a straightforward, good-value meal and a cold drink in the heart of the city.

name: Rock Bar Old School
description:
Rock Bar Old School is a compact, rider-friendly rock bar in Skopje with a worn-in, no-frills vibe.
Inside, dim lighting and walls of band posters set the tone while the playlist leans on classic rock, hard rock, and Balkan rock staples.
Drinks are straightforward-cold beer and honest pours-served by a quick, friendly team.
It’s the kind of meet-up spot where you can cool off, trade road stories, and map out the next route before rolling back into the city night.

name: BKW Hybrid Bar
description: BKW Hybrid Bar is a unique venue where classic meets innovation. Here, you can enjoy signature cocktails and dishes crafted with cutting-edge techniques. The atmosphere blends cozy comfort with stylish design, perfect for relaxing and socializing with friends.

name: Bar Makka
description: Makka Bar is a laid-back urban spot blending daytime café culture with vibrant nightlife. Known for its creative cocktails and cozy, eclectic decor (think colorful lights, comfy sofas, and greenery), it attracts a mixed crowd of locals and travelers.

name: Van Gogh Bar
description: Van Gogh Bar is a vibrant, art-inspired spot in the heart of North Macedonia. The interior pays tribute to Van Gogh’s genius, while the menu blends local flavors with European flair. With live music, signature cocktails, and a warm welcome, it’s a perfect place to unwind in the evening.

name: Bar Kafe Alex
description: Nestled in the mountainous town of Leskovik, Bar Kafe Alex is a beloved grill bar and café known for its warm hospitality and authentic Albanian flavors. With a 5/5 Google rating, it’s a favorite among locals and travelers exploring the Korçë region

name: HandleBar
description:
HandleBar is a small, rider-friendly bar in Tetovo with a relaxed, no-fuss vibe.
By day it’s an easy stop for a well-pulled espresso; after dark, expect a straightforward lineup of cold beers and classic cocktails.
The playlist leans rock/indie at a talk-friendly volume, making it a solid meet-up point before or after a ride.
Service is quick and easygoing—it’s the kind of place where you can cool down, swap road stories, and sketch the next twisty route.

name: Arli Rent a car, motorcycle, bike, scooter, electric bike(scooter & motorcycle)
description:
We're always working on something. Most of the time, we're focused on getting results for our clients. But every so often we get the chance to experiment with new concepts and ideas.
Because we're experienced, reliable, and focused on results, we've had the privilege of working with many fantastic clients.

name: Rent Moto Albania
description:
- Many Types of Bikes:
We can fit you with the perfect bike because we carry all sizes and
of bikes.

- Best Bikes in Town:
Comfort. Safety. Our equipment is guaranteed to make your biking experience 100% stree-free.

- Longest Opening Hours:
Have all the time in the world? Rent for an entire day and explore Tirana at your leisure.

- Rent Fully Insured:
A simple bodily injury claim from a customer riding your bike can derail your business.

name: Moto Rent Vlore - Moto Fun
description: Moto Fun is your one-stop shop for all your rental needs. We offer a wide range of vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, and bicycles, to suit any adventure. Whether you're exploring the city, cruising along scenic routes, or hitting the trails, our well-maintained fleet ensures a smooth and enjoyable ride. Conveniently located in the heart of downtown, Moto Fun provides flexible rental options and competitive pricing to meet all your transportation needs. Discover your next adventure with us today.

name: Zeleni Gaj
description: Zeleni Gaj, a 4-star restaurant, is located on the very shore of Slovenska Beach in Budva. Long-standing family tradition and dedication to quality make it the perfect place for lovers of good food and an unforgettable atmosphere. We offer a combination of authentic Montenegrin cuisine and international specialties, prepared with the highest quality ingredients. Our spacious terrace offers a spectacular view of the sea, the island of St. Nikola and the Old Town, perfect for romantic dinners, family gatherings or relaxing with the sounds of the waves and live music. Visit us and feel the magic of tradition, taste and natural beauty

name: Forsage Gastro Lounge
description: A vibrant fusion of high-energy nightlife and elevated dining, where Mediterranean flavors meet modern mixology. By day, savor creative brunch plates and specialty coffees in our sunlit lounge. As night falls, the space transforms into a chic destination for crafted cocktails, DJ beats, and shareable gourmet bites

name: Eatzy - Grill & Casual Food Restaurant
description: At Eatzy, we bring together the best of grilled cuisine and casual dining in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere. Perfect for meat lovers, friends, and families, our menu features juicy burgers, tender steaks, smoky BBQ ribs, and fresh local ingredients—all cooked to perfection on our grill.

name: Rivijera Restaurant
description: Step into Rivijera Restaurant and experience Montenegro’s coastal soul through every bite. Nestled by the water’s edge, we serve authentic Mediterranean cuisine with a focus on fresh seafood, locally sourced ingredients, and generations-old recipes—all with a breathtaking view.

name: Friends Lounge Bar
description: The “Friends Lounge Bar” restaurant-lounge is located in Vladimir, within the Ulcinj municipality in Montenegro, near the Lukoil petrol station. The menu includes a wide selection of drinks, ice creams, fruit salads, pizzas, pastas, burgers and grilled dishes at affordable prices. Guests appreciate the friendly staff, English-speaking service and relaxed, comfortable atmosphere. Friends Lounge Bar has been recognized for several years for its business quality and excellent service. It’s an ideal spot to unwind after a drive or to enjoy a pleasant gathering with friends, offering convenient parking and a cozy ambiance.

name: Restaurant Green
description: Green restaurant in Budva’s Old Town offers a charming, family-run vibe with lush greenery and a cozy courtyard . The menu features fresh seafood, hearty Montenegrin specialties, and Mediterranean-inspired pasta and risotto, all praised for quality and service.

name: Giardino Restaurant
description:
Welcome to our oasis of peace, the Giardino restaurant! Here you will simply enjoy your senses!

A beautiful corner is located halfway between Petrovac and Sveti Stefan, more precisely in Rezevici, from which the most stunning view of the Adriatic Sea and the natural beauty of the Budva Riviera opens. Inspired by the view and magic of nature, more than 35 years ago, we built a family restaurant of national cuisine in this place.

We invite you to visit our restaurant, where we are happy to prepare and serve you dishes and drinks of unique taste and aroma. Traditional recipes and many years of experience in preparing specialties will not go unnoticed. Although our main pride is meat prepared from under the sac (let's not forget the grilled and fish specialties), we also offer a vegetarian type of food.

name: Fast food Good Grill
description: Fast food Good Grill in Budva (3 Kanjoša Macedonovica) is a convenient stop for bikers looking for a quick meal and a short rest on the road. The place offers grill specialties, hearty food, and drinks with fast service. There’s nearby parking where you can easily leave your motorcycle. A perfect spot for a quick break while riding through Montenegro.

name: Meat & burger
description: Welcome to Meat & Burger, your new favorite place in Rafailovići. A combination of modern ambiance, beautiful sea views and a diverse menu that includes top-notch burgers, juicy kebabs, the highest quality meats, pastas, risottos and sweet treats. Visit us and experience a unique gastronomic experience.

name: Stara Hercegovina
description: Stara Hercegovina is more than just a restaurant — it’s a full “restaurant + lodging” complex, perfect for travelers and bikers alike. With traditional cuisine, comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, and parking, it’s a great all-in-one stop on your journey through Herzegovina.

name: Restoran Etno selo Dodig
description:
The rooms have central heating. There is a shower. The care of guests is evident in little things like beauty products and a set of towels. Family rooms and non-smoking rooms are available upon request.
Luggage storage, a safe deposit box and currency exchange facilities are available. The gastronomic facilities - restaurant, café and bar - offer deliciously prepared meals and various drinks. You can have a great time in the hotel park or walking with children on the playground. Guest parking is available (free of charge).

name: Čarda Na jami
description: The restaurant is known for its fish dishes, such as fish paprikash and fresh fish, as well as grilled specialties. There is an outdoor terrace with a view of the river, where you can enjoy your meal and the nature around. The service is fast, and the portions are generous. There is parking available nearby for motorcycles. It is recommended to make a reservation in advance, especially on weekends.

name: Restoran Groš
description: Ethno log cabin Groš Leskovac as an A La Carte restaurant in an ethno ambiance with recognizable Leskovac, Serbian and international cuisine.

name: Restoran i ribnjak "Lovac - Beli"
description: The restaurant is known for its home-caught fish and grilled dishes, along with hearty snacks and drinks for the road. There’s an outdoor terrace and spacious parking convenient for motorcycles. The calm and cozy atmosphere makes it a perfect spot for a short rest before continuing your route through Serbia.

name: Restaurant "Great Serbia"
description: Our restaurant is woven from the finest Skadarlija charm, which is adorned with our national and international cuisine, old wine, homely service and warm atmosphere, as well as a rich assortment of drinks.

name: Restoran Bakrač
description:
Authentic Serbian specialties.
Why come?
✔ Rustic atmosphere – Wooden tables, copper details, warm homely vibe
✔ Large portions – Like at grandma's in the country
✔ Live music – Folk orchestras often play

name: Bikers bar ''Kod Vukoja''
description: Bikers Bar "Kod Vukoja", located in Serbia near the Bosnia and Montenegro borders, is a legendary stop for motorcycle travelers. Known for its rustic charm, cold beers, and biker-friendly spirit, it’s a must-visit on any Balkan road trip. The bar features unique decor, friendly locals, and often hosts live music or biker meetups.

name: Bike Bar White Land
description: Bike Bar "White Land", nestled in the scenic countryside of Serbia, is a haven for motorcycle enthusiasts seeking a blend of open-air freedom and rustic charm. The bar offers cold drinks, hearty local snacks, and a relaxed, biker-friendly atmosphere surrounded by rolling green landscapes. With its laid-back, welcoming vibe and occasional live music gatherings, it's the perfect rest stop on any two-wheeled journey. Whether you're passing through or planning a group ride, White Land promises memorable camaraderie and scenic views.

name: Moto Platz
description: Moto Platz is a modern motorcycle service known for its high-quality work. We offer repairs, diagnostics, and trip-ready preparation for your bike. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, card payment, and a friendly team. Reliability, comfort, and attention to detail - everything your bike needs on the road!

name: Cafe Racer Serbia
description: Cafe Racer Serbia is a cozy café and biker hub in Belgrade, offering a unique blend of freedom, motorcycle culture, and great coffee. Guests can enjoy craft beer, and a warm, laid-back atmosphere. Vintage motorcycles and themed decor add to the charm, making it a must-visit for motorbike enthusiasts. It's the perfect spot to relax and connect with the local biker scene.

name: BLACK GEORGE
description: BLACK GEORGE is a popular biker bar in Serbia known for its vibrant atmosphere and welcoming community. Located in a lively area, it offers a great selection of drinks, hearty food, and regular live music events. This bar is a favorite gathering spot for motorcyclists looking to relax and share stories after a long ride. With its friendly staff and energetic vibe, BLACK GEORGE guarantees a memorable experience for every visitor.

name: Street Pub
description: Welcome to Custom Pub — a legendary rock pub in the heart of Skopje at Boulevard VMRO 7. The vibe is inclusive and relaxed: biker club stickers adorn the windows, and the staff chat with guests like old friends. Expect a great selection of craft and imported beers, live rock and blues music, and an energetic yet laid-back atmosphere. Perfect for bikers, music lovers, and anyone who enjoys good vibes and storytelling.

name: House of Mijaks Ethno Restaurant
description: Among the peaceful silence and picturesque nature, on the corner of the road leading to the Bigorski Monastery, along the Radika River - is the first ethno-museum restaurant of the Macedonian Mijak culture "House of Mijak".

name: Gostilnica Neim
description: Tucked away in Ohrid’s old town, Gostilnica Neim is a beloved family-run eatery celebrated for its warm hospitality and traditional Macedonian dishes. The owner, known for his friendly demeanor, often engages guests in conversation, adding a personal touch to the dining experience.

name: Mavrovski Merak
description: Nestled in the scenic Mavrovo region, Mavrovski Merak is a cozy eatery known for its hearty portions and stunning lakeside ambiance. Ideal for travelers exploring the area, it offers a mix of grilled specialties and local comfort food.

name: Restaurant Bratski Merak
description: A staple in Skopje’s dining scene, Bratski Merak specializes in robust Balkan cuisine with a focus on grilled meats and communal dining. Known for its lively atmosphere and courteous service, this restaurant is a favorite among locals and visitors alike.

name: Bar Brick
description:
Welcome to our new brick in the wall, our new casual restaurant Brick Eat.
At Brick Eat Restaurant and Bar you can have your breakfast, explore fine dining and have fun with your friends, family or colleagues.
This place is absolutely amazing, offering a variety of options for all tastes and interests.
Nothing at Brick Eat can be defined as ordinary.
Not even the breakfast, served in an exquisite authentic avant-garde atmosphere in the scope of carefully selected details, making it a one of a kind experience.

The garden itself, accompanied by the delicious cuisine, the selection of good wines and highly enjoyable drinks and cocktails, will inspire your day and night to feel the ambiance as a motivation to create.
Brick Eat restaurant & bar along with the gardens, on both sides, dispose with more than 1000 square meters which gives you the chance to organize all sorts of events.
Let’s not forget the weekend parties and the night atmosphere that will help you relax, have fun and feel at your best.

name: Bike Cafe Fanis
description: Bike Cafe Fanis is a motorcycle-friendly roadside café nestled in Albania’s rugged southern mountains. Known for its biker community vibe, it offers fuel, repairs, and hearty meals for riders tackling the thrilling Llongo Pass routes.

name: Brutal Steakhouse Durres
description: An upscale steakhouse in Golem, Brutal Steakhouse Durres combines prime cuts with Mediterranean flair. Set near the beach, it features a poolside terrace with live music and Adriatic views, making it ideal for romantic dinners or celebrations

name: Restorant Bardhi
description:
A place with experience in production, cuisine and hospitality.
Built in 1994, in a traditional style combined with modern; this restaurant is a stop that will leave you with an extraordinary taste and will make you feel at home.
Positioned in the south-west of the castle, just a few steps away from the National Museum Gj. K. Skënderbeu Krujë, with a spectacular view, at an altitude of 607m above sea level offers freshness, pleasure and relaxation. The fresh air and tranquility will create ideal conditions for you to spend an unforgettable day.

name: ODA E HASAN BEUT TIRANE
description: Oda e Hasan Beut Mullet, A place full of fun and relaxation in one of the most charming places on the outskirts of the city of Tirana. Where you can enjoy Traditional Albanian cuisine with Organic food cooked to the highest level and flair. Quality lies in the composition of the organic products that we offer.

name: Polako Motors
description: Polako Motors is located in Podgorica and offers car and motorcycle rentals, guided tours and airport transfers. The company focuses on mobility services and emphasizes high customer care and service quality. Their fleet includes both standard vehicles and motorcycles - a convenient option for exploring Montenegro. Clients appreciate the flexibility of rental terms, allowing bookings for both short and longer durations. Its central location in the city makes Polako Motors a convenient choice for picking up transport and starting your journey.

name: Magnus Moto Centar Boka
description: At the end of 2006, Magnus Moto Ltd. was founded in the desire to combine the love for motorcycles and a new business vision to create a company that would be the carrier of the offer of this segment in the country. A different business approach, in which the customer and his needs come first, slowly brought popularity to the company and created a larger base of satisfied clients. By constantly improving the offer and service, Magnus Moto grew, so that today we can proudly say that we are one of the leading companies in this business in our country. This is evidenced by the extraordinary offer, complete with all the content and services that a motorcyclist could ask for.

name: Moto Edo
description: Moto Edo motorcycle dealership is a true paradise for bikers, located in a picturesque area with convenient access for motorcyclists. The showroom boasts an extensive range of motorcycles from leading manufacturers, while professional consultants are on hand to help you find the perfect bike to suit your needs. The shop also offers high-quality gear and accessories, and skilled mechanics provide any repair and maintenance services. The convenient location and spacious parking area ensure a comfortable visit. Regular customers appreciate Moto Edo for its excellent service and competitive prices on spare parts.

name: Acimic Speedshop - SYM Store
description: SYM Scooters and Motorcycles Montenegro — Acimić Speed Shop is a professional motorcycle dealership specializing in SYM brand vehicles. The store offers a wide selection of scooters, motorcycles, and ATVs that meet the highest quality standards. Qualified specialists assist in choosing the right model and provide expert technical advice. The shop provides full vehicle diagnostics, professional maintenance, and repair services. Customers can purchase original spare parts and high-quality gear at competitive prices.

name: Moto Shop 7 - Ovlašteni Yamaha distributer i serviser za BiH.
Moto Shop Extreme | Dijelovi i Oprema za Motocikle i Servis za Motocikle
Kacige.ba - Kacige i moto oprema Sarajevo
CFMOTO / Prodaja ATV SSV i MOTOCIKALA
Barel Motoshop
description:
Barel doo imports and distributes the world's leading motorcycle equipment brands: Shark helmets, Bering, MT helmets, Momo Design, Gianni Falco, Acerbis, Oxford, Seventy Degrees, Held, IXS.

In addition, in our shop you can find products for your two-wheeler: Brembo, Yamalube, Ipone, HifloFiltro, Yamaha oem parts, Dunlop.

We try to constantly monitor the needs of the market and therefore create an offer that will suit everyone's pocket and needs.

On over 500 m2 in our stores in Belgrade and Niš in a very pleasant atmosphere, you can see all the items we offer in person, so we are sure that with our professional help you will always make the right choice!

name: DD Moto
description: No matter your riding style, you can find the perfect balance between safety and style in our collection of motorcycle clothing and footwear. Whether you are a man or a woman, you will find top-quality equipment that will provide you with a comfortable and safe ride, with the addition of elegance and attractive design. Choose from our diverse offer and embark on an adventure on two wheels with reliable and modern motorcycle equipment that will make you stand out as a real rider.

name: Moto land
description:
Motoland is the leading specialized retail chain in Serbia dedicated to motorcycles, equipment and lifestyle on two wheels. With more than 15 years of experience, we offer:

Wide range - From motorcycles and scooters to equipment, parts and fashion accessories
Service and support - Authorized service for top brands

With its motorcycle-themed decor and regular events, the bar is a perfect stop for riders exploring the region. Whether you're traveling solo or with a group, "Moto Klub" promises good company and authentic Serbian hospitality.

This is not a public bar but a clubhouse for members and invited guests. It offers a strong biker vibe but isn’t intended for casual visitors.

It's a perfect stop for moto- and road travelers who enjoy great coffee, refreshing cocktails, and a welcoming vibe. Located near the coast, the bar offers panoramic views and easy parking. Frequent biker meetups, live DJs, and parties make this place full of energy and character.

description: Melbourne Bar is a stylish venue with an Aussie spirit right in the heart of Albania. It’s the perfect stop for those seeking cozy vibes, great music, and well-crafted cocktails. The interior is filled with Elvis posters and vintage décor, creating a nostalgic and fun atmosphere. A perfect stop for those who love music, freedom, and good company.

Popular among motorcyclists and travelers, it offers more than just drinks — it delivers an experience. The stunning sea view makes it a perfect sunset stop.

Featuring local brews, signature cocktails, and tasty snacks, it’s the perfect place to unwind after a long day. The vibe is friendly, with a modern interior touched by rock culture. A top choice for travelers, bikers, and anyone seeking a relaxed evening in Tirana.

Inspired by Ernest Hemingway for a simple life lived among friends, art, culture, literature and the sounds of jazz, this Non-Public Bar is located across the Lane and under the mimosas.

name: Enduro Adventure Serbia
description: Motorcycle rental Serbia vrši iznajmljivanje motora sa ili bez vodiča gde je uz cenu uključena oprema za vozače. Lokacija na kojima se realizuju ture su Svrljiške planine, Stara Planina, Rtanj, Pleš i okolina. Cena izdavanja motora se kreće od 99 eura na dan, vodič 20 eura, kompletan paket sa smeštajem je 140 eura. Ukoliko imate sopstveni motor cena je 30 eura po osobi. Posedujemo sopstveno etno selo sa smeštajem i hranom. Polupansion sa cenom od 16 eura i pun pansion sa cenom od 22 eura. Očekujte da ćete bit provođeni srcem, prilagođavamo se Vašim veštinama, a naši vodiči će vam ponuditi najbolje usluge i rute prilagođene svakom nivou. Iznajmljivanje motora / Rentiranje Enduro motora sa i bez vodiča - Nezaboravna avantura uz Hard Enduro Adventure Serbia.

We are ROCKER Motorcycle Rental company from Croatia, Zagreb – motorcycle enthusiasts who have the best job in the world, RIDE WHILE WORKING to meet great people from all over the world and travel to amazing places.

name: Ride Enduro AL
description: Ride Enduro AL in Tirana offers motorcycle rental and off-road riding training with professional instructors for adrenaline and adventure lovers.

name: Kotor Serpentine viewpoint
description: Perched high on the winding Kotor Serpentine road, this viewpoint offers some of the most breathtaking vistas over the Bay of Kotor, framed by rugged mountains and the historic town below. Ideal for photographers and road-trippers alike, it’s best experienced during sunrise or sunset when golden light enhances the dramatic scenery. The views unfold gradually as you ascend the 25+ hairpin bends—each a scenic moment in itself

name: Scenic View Point & Kotor Webcam
description: Perched above Kotor and overlooking the UNESCO-listed Bay of Kotor, this breathtaking viewpoint offers sweeping panoramas of the bay, old town rooftops, and rugged mountains. Ideal for landscape photography and catching peaceful moments, the best times to visit are at sunrise or sunset when the light transforms the view into a magical scene. A webcam nearby allows you to preview real-time weather and bay conditions before your visit.

name: Vidikovac Kanjon Tare / Viewpoint Tara Canyon
description: Perched above the Tara River Canyon—the deepest in Europe—this viewpoint offers jaw-dropping panoramas over dramatic limestone cliffs, lush forests, and the river winding far below. An ideal spot for hikers and nature lovers, it's especially magical at sunrise or sunset, when light paints the landscape in golden hues

name: Meandri Ćehotine viewpoint
description: Perched high above the winding Ćehotina River, this serene viewpoint offers a stunning natural spectacle of vivid blue water carving dramatic meanders through lush green hills. It’s incredibly peaceful—perfect for contemplative rides and nature photography

name: Mala Crna Gora view point
description: Abu el Jooj Viewpoint (Mala Crna Gora, Montenegro) sits above a remote mountain village in the Žabljak region, offering a serene lookout over the dramatic Dinaric landscapes. Expect sweeping vistas of rugged hills, dense forests, and mist-filled valleys — a peaceful place for reflection and photography.

name: View point on mountains and Crno Jezero
description: Crno Jezero Viewpoint offers one of the most dramatic mountain-lake panoramas in the Balkans. Perched above the glacial Black Lake (1,416 m elevation) and framed by rugged peaks like Medjed, Savin Kuk, and Šljeme, this spot showcases the lake’s "figure 8" shape, dense pine forests, and sparkling alpine water

name: Panoramic View Borićje
description: Panoramic View Borić is perched at about 1,428 m above sea level within Sutjeska National Park. From this vantage, bikers and nature enthusiasts can soak in sweeping views across deep canyons, the peaks of Vučevo, Maglić, Volujak, the ancient forest of Perućica, Dragoš Saddle, Prijevor, Tjentište Valley, and even remnants of age-old cities like Vratar and Vrata

name: Planinska osmatračnica Sedlo
description: Planinska osmatračnica Sedlo — a mountain viewpoint along the P14 route descending from Durmitor National Park toward the Piva Canyon. Perched at an elevation near 1,900 m, this spot features a unique wooden frame that artistically frames the wild mountainous landscape of Montenegrin highlands.

name: Viewpoint Zahum - Ramsko Jezero
description: Viewpoint Zahum – Ramsko Jezero (RFHF+98) is a must-see stop for motorcyclists exploring the Prozor-Rama region of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Located in the mountain village of Zahum, this viewpoint offers panoramic views of Ramsko Lake, surrounded by rugged terrain and lush greenery.

name: View of Sarajevo
description: Located in the village of Lukavac, approximately 5 kilometers from the M7 highway, this viewpoint offers a panoramic vista of Sarajevo. To reach it, head east from Bjelasnica Mountain on the M18 road towards Sarajevo.

name: Panorama Viewpoint Vrilo
description: Located in the village of Vrilo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Panorama Viewpoint offers breathtaking vistas of the surrounding landscapes. Visitors are greeted with expansive views of rolling hills, lush greenery, and serene waters, making it an ideal spot for nature enthusiasts and photographers.

name: Lukomir viewpoint
description: Perched at 1,495 meters above sea level, Lukomir is Bosnia and Herzegovina's highest and most isolated village. The viewpoint offers breathtaking panoramas of the Rakitnica Canyon, traditional stone houses, and the surrounding rugged mountains. It's a haven for nature lovers, hikers, and those seeking an authentic glimpse into highland life.

name: Vidikovac 'Perunica'
description: The Vidikovac 'Perunica' viewpoint, located near the village of Selenac in Montenegro, offers a stunning panoramic view of the surrounding landscapes. Situated at coordinates 87CW+9H, this spot provides a serene environment for visitors to enjoy the natural beauty of the area.

name: Vidikovac na Zlataru
description: Vidikovac na Zlataru is a scenic viewpoint located near the tourist center of Zlatar Mountain in Serbia. Situated just a few hundred meters from the main tourist area, it offers visitors a tranquil spot to relax and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding nature. The viewpoint is accessible via a 300-meter trail that begins at the parking area in front of the Panorama Hotel. The path winds through a forest of coniferous trees, with natural steps formed by intertwined roots, creating a unique and pleasant walking experience .

name: Drlije Viewpoint
description: The Drlije Viewpoint, located near the village of Jagoštica in Montenegro, offers breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding landscapes. Situated at coordinates X7MV+JQ, this spot provides a serene environment for visitors to enjoy the natural beauty of the area.

name: Biljeska stena
description: Bilješka stena viewpoint is located about 6 km north of Predov Krst. From NP Tara administration office at Predov Krst educational trail follows the forest road and takes you to this site. Viewpoint is a habitat to the Serbian spruce, one of the most important species of the park, also there are centuries-old pines, mixed forests of deciduous and conifer trees and characteristic canyon vegetation. From this point you can see the high limestone slopes of the beautiful Drina River canyon, chamois on the rocks and eagles in flight. Across the river Drina, you can see Klotijevac, the medieval fortress in Bosnia or even older Sase mine.

name: Janjač viewpoint
description: Janjač viewpoint, located on Tara Mountain in Serbia, offers stunning views of the surrounding area, including the village of Zaovine and parts of the Tara massif. It is one of the highest peaks in the area, reaching 1,473 meters above sea level. The viewpoint is close to the village of Zaovine and the border with Bosnia and Herzegovina.

name: Viewpoint Tometino Polye
description: Tometino Polje is a picturesque plateau located in the northern part of the municipality of Požega, Serbia. Situated at an altitude of approximately 750 meters, this undulating terrain offers breathtaking views of the surrounding landscapes. The viewpoint marked by coordinates 3XPX+Q7 provides an excellent vantage point to appreciate the natural beauty of the area.

name: Vidikovac Zaovinsko jezero
description:
The viewpoints on Tara are considered some of the most beautiful in Serbia, ideal for all nature lovers, mountaineering and photography. The most famous is the Banjska stena viewpoint, which offers an unforgettable view of the Drina canyon and Lake Perućac. In addition to this viewpoint, Zelenika, Crnjeskovo, Osluša, Sokolarica, Sjenič and Bilješka stena are also unmissable - each with its own unique views and ambience.

Tara is ideal for those who want to hike with panoramic views, peace and quiet of untouched nature. The viewpoints are easy to reach - on well-maintained trails, by bike or car, and most are also suitable for family outings. If you are looking for a place to rest or get inspired - the viewpoints on Mount Tara are the right choice.

name: Lake Kozjak Viewpoint & Picnic Spot (Pamja Kozhaku - Vend per piknik)
description: Perched above the emerald waters of Lake Kozjak, this scenic viewpoint offers one of the most breathtaking panoramas in western North Macedonia. A favorite stop for road trippers and nature lovers

name: Viewpoint Lake Mavrovo
description: Perched above Lake Mavrovo, this viewpoint offers one of the most breathtaking vistas in Mavrovo National Park. The artificial lake, framed by the Bistra, Korab, and Šar mountain ranges, is renowned for its emerald waters and the hauntingly beautiful submerged St. Nicholas Church, which emerges during low water levels

name: Rebel Pub
description: Rebel Pub is a cozy rock bar located in the heart of Novi Sad at Freedom Square. Almost every evening, you can catch live rock and blues performances, creating a relaxed and social atmosphere for locals and travelers alike . The menu features both classic drinks and a selection of local craft beers . It’s the perfect spot for winding down after exploring the city—intimate, soulful, and full of character.

name: Konoba Feral
description: Located in the heart of Herceg Novi's Old Town, Konoba Feral offers an authentic taste of Montenegrin cuisine in a charming, rustic setting. Fresh seafood, grilled meats, and local wines are served with warm hospitality and a cozy atmosphere. Enjoy a relaxing meal just steps from the Adriatic coast.

name: Joy Restaurant
description: Joy Restaurant in Herceg Novi invites you to enjoy a modern Mediterranean dining experience with a stunning sea view. The menu features fresh seafood, international favorites, and carefully crafted cocktails. With its stylish interior and relaxed atmosphere, it's the perfect spot for both casual lunches and romantic dinners.

name: Harley Bar Tuzla
description: Harley Bar Tuzla in Bosnia is a legendary stop for bikers and rock music fans alike. Located in the heart of Tuzla, it offers a rugged interior, cold beer, and a welcoming vibe for travelers on two wheels. With regular live music events and motorcycle-themed decor, it’s more than just a bar — it’s a biker community hub. A must-visit for anyone exploring northern Bosnia with a passion for freedom and engines.

name: Muzička kuća Metropolis
description: Muzička kuća Metropolis is a modern music venue in Belgrade, Serbia, known for its live concerts and support of local artists. It hosts performances in rock, jazz, blues, and alternative music genres. It's a great place to experience the Serbian music scene in a relaxed and lively setting.

name: Hotel Maksim
description: «Try it to feel it!» This simple slogan encapsulates our approach. To ensure your visit to Montenegro is truly unforgettable, we've curated a diverse tourist program. Every day promises a new adventure, leaving lasting impressions. From boat trips to individual and group excursions, fishing in the open sea, hiking and cycling, to indulging in a sauna infused with the aromas of local herbs — Montenegro offers surprises at every turn!

name: Hotel Podgorica
description:
Situated on the bank of Morača River, Podgorica Hotel was built in 1967 and is known as a unique architectural work of a renowned architect Svetlana Kana Radevic, for which she won a national award for architecture with a special accent on fitting into a current natural ambient. The greatest uniqueness is that the river stone is carved into the exterior walls of the hotel.
Location, architecture, service, all three makes this hotel, which has the name of the capital town, unique. One of the oldest city hotels, it has an excellent location being in the centre of the city, but still surrounded by the sports and recreational zone of the river. Hotel’s exterior and modern interior design meets the high standards of hospitality. Hotel has had the pleasure of hosting princes and princesses, ambassadors, politicians, sports teams, actors, actresses, singers and others.

name: Hotel Krušo
description: One writer called Herceg Novi a city with a soul because its residents were hospitable and cheerful, saying that "every city is built twice: the first time of stone and brick, the second time of words and spirit." For over twenty years, "Kruso Group" has been striving to not only enhance quality but also to bring this warm spirit of Herceg Novi into all of its properties. In the recently built "Kruso" hotel in Herceg Novi, we want to offer you not only the most luxurious accommodation but also to give you a unique taste of the "city of stairs," which will become and forever remain a part of you.

name: Hotel Belani Zelenika
description: Hotel Belani Zelenika is centrally located in Španjola, just steps from the beachfront, cafés, shops and pharmacy. Warm hospitality and a 24‑hour reception ensure a welcoming and hassle‑free stay. The hotel features twelve bright and modern units—six facing the sea, seven with balconies—all equipped with air conditioning, free Wi‑Fi and flat‑screen TVs . The on‑site restaurant offers Mediterranean cuisine and a well‑curated wine list for guests to enjoy.

name: Wellness & Spa Hotel ACD
description: Wellness & Spa Hotel ACD is beautifully situated in Meljine, a peaceful waterfront neighborhood just minutes from the sea and promenade of Herceg Novi. The property offers 34 comfortable rooms and 11 modern apartments with sea‑ or garden‑views, all featuring air conditioning, balconies, minibars, safes and complimentary Wi‑Fi . Guests enjoy free access to the rooftop seasonal pool, gym, a variety of saunas, Turkish bath, salt and ice rooms for total wellness relaxation. The rooftop Sky Bar a la carte restaurant provides stunning views over the Bay of Kotor, while the on‑site restaurant serves both local and international cuisine.

name: Hotel & Restoran Play
description: Welcome to Hotel & Restoran Play — the perfect place for relaxation and fine dining. Cozy rooms, modern design, and attentive staff create a warm and comfortable atmosphere. Our restaurant offers delicious European and local cuisine, prepared with care. Enjoy your stay surrounded by nature or in the heart of the city — everything is within reach!

name: Aria
description: Guest House Aria in Herceg Novi is just about a 2‑minute walk from the beach, making it ideal for seaside getaways. Bright, modern rooms feature balconies or terraces with sea views, creating a relaxing ambiance. Enjoy freshly prepared European and Mediterranean cuisine at Restaurant Fontana, included in the daily breakfast offering. Warm hospitality, clean rooms, and the genuine personal touch make Aria a welcoming choice for travelers.

name: Hotel & Restaurant Montenegrino
description: Welcome to Hotel & Restaurant Montenegrino — a charming hotel in the heart of Tivat. Enjoy comfortable rooms, exquisite Mediterranean cuisine, and genuine Montenegrin hospitality. Just steps away from the sea, Porto Montenegro marina, and the city’s main attractions.

name: Boscovich Boutique Hotel
description:
Boscovich Boutique Hotel is set in the heart of Podgorica, steps from major government offices, embassies, museums, sports venues and ‘green oases’ of city parks.

Guests of the Boutique Hotel Boscovich can relax in 30 luxury accommodation units. Explore the various amenities and choose the space that’s right for you.

In addition to luxurious accommodation units is also characteristic for its restaurant and bar, located at the entrance to the hotel, with the unique ability to enjoy delicacies from Boscovich’s cuisine.

name: Hotel Hemera
description:
Hotel Hemera
Hemera is the ancient goddess of light, after which the hotel was named, so allow her to embrace you.
Hemera Rooms
The dominant characteristic, rustic industrial design combined with elements of hi-tech technologies is a recognizable feature of the visual identity of the hotel Hemera.
Hemera Restaurant
Rich menu of international dishes with an emphasis on Mediterranean cuisine, a wide selection of fish, salads and an amazing selection of desserts and pastries.

name: Hotel Marienplatz Podgorica
description:
Hotel Marienplatz Podgorica

We present to You the newly opened hotel located in the city centre – CRIB & BEER Marienplatz hotel. In our hotel which is designed in the spirit of Munich, you will feel the magic of modern and simple and at the same time, notably different combination of architecture and design.
Hotel is located in the heart of Podgorica where everything is within reach. Visit us and experience something different.
There is also a beerhouse within the hotel, offering the best Austrian sausages, as well as a wide range of beers with different texture.

name: Hilton Podgorica Crna Gora
description:
Business hotel in the heart of Podgorica
Between city parks, we’re streets from the Montenegrin National Theatre and the Natural History Museum of Montenegro. The Doclea ruins and Šipčanik Wine Cellar are within 15 minutes, and we’re a half-hour from Skadar Lake National Park. Our hotel has a rooftop bar, indoor pool, and the city’s largest spa — complete with saunas and experience showers.

name: Hotel Kerber
description:
Hotel Kerber
Accommodation in the heart of Podgorica
Hotel Kerber is located in the heart of the capital of Montenegro in a quiet and pleasant neighborhood. It is only twenty meters away from the main street, which is closed to traffic every day from 5 pm and opens for the promenade and nightlife.

Professional staff
Our hotel staff is ready to make your stay special, so that you will always want to come back to us again.
There are many other reasons for this - comfort, warmth and a sense of welcome, rich homemade breakfast, room service, internet access, satellite TV, elevator, aperitif bar.

name: Agape Rose
description: Welcome to Agape Rose — a stylish Montenegrin villa where comfort meets elegance. Spacious apartments offer panoramic views of the sea and mountains, modern interiors, and peaceful surroundings — perfect for your dream holiday. Ideal for families, couples, and anyone seeking inspiration on the Adriatic coast.

name: 7 Hills Rooms
description:
7 Hills Rooms is a stylish and welcoming haven in the heart of Podgorica, blending modern design with a homely atmosphere. Bright, airy rooms with city views and thoughtful touches ensure a relaxing stay.

Perfectly located, the hotel puts the city’s main attractions, vibrant cafes, and restaurants right at your doorstep. After a day of exploring, unwind in the cozy lounge or enjoy a freshly brewed coffee in the shared guest area.

Guests love it for the warm hospitality, spotless comfort, and the feeling of a home away from home.

name: Hotel Lazaro
description:
Brand new hotel ''Lazaro'' is the first hotel from our company, constructed with a strong belief in making and realizing new future successful cooperation with individulas and group visitors.

Hotel ''Lazaro'' will attract all kinds of travelers, wishing they would always come back to us.

name: Hotel Casa Del Mare Vizura
description: Discover serenity and luxury at Hotel Casa del Mare – Vizura, perched above the Bay of Kotor with breathtaking views. Elegant rooms, a panoramic pool, a gourmet restaurant, and a tranquil spa make it a perfect escape. Just a 5-minute drive from Kotor Old Town, yet surrounded by peaceful nature. Ideal for romantic getaways and discerning travelers.

name: Kings Park Hotel
description:
Located just 300m from Podgorica's iconic Clock Tower, Kings Park Hotel epitomizes Montenegrin elegance. This 4-star gem blends modern luxury with local charm, offering 73 sophisticated rooms, a gourmet restaurant, and premium conference facilities.

Ideal for both business and leisure, the hotel places you steps from Parliament, Millennium Bridge, and top museums. With its spa, gym, and personalized service, it redefines urban hospitality in Montenegro.

name: Hotel Porto In
description: Stay at Hotel Porto In — a cozy four-star hotel just steps from Kotor’s Old Town. Stylish rooms, delicious breakfasts, and attentive staff make it ideal for both leisure and business travel. Enjoy scenic views of the Bay of Kotor and the historic city walls from your window.

name: SIGNUM Hotel
description:
Enjoy the stay in a peaceful part of Podgorica, with spectacular views of the city.

SIGNUM Hotel provides comfort and tranquillity after a hectic business day and relaxation after exploring the coastal and mountain attractions of Montenegro.
All rooms and apartments are located on high floors, isolated from city noise, with balconies and a view of the city. Modern design, equipment and other details necessary for a relaxing stay and peaceful sleep have been carefully selected with the aim of providing a complete atmosphere.

name: Avala Resort & Villas
description: Welcome to Avala Resort & Villas — a stylish five-star resort at the edge of Budva’s Old Town, with direct access to the sea. Enjoy elegant rooms and private villas, two panoramic pools, and a refined SPA center. Start your day with a rich breakfast overlooking the Adriatic, and end it with a cocktail on the terrace to the sound of the waves. A perfect escape for those who seek comfort, atmosphere, and inspiration.

name: Bungalow Holiday
description: In accordance with your wishes, we have designed various arrangements that include rafting on the Tara River, numerous hiking and mountaineering tours in the Durmitor and Sutjeska National Parks, cruising on Lake Piva, camping, horseback riding, fishing, canyoning, visits to ethno villages, etc. We offer you arrangements with accommodation in Plužine.

name: Fontana Hotel & Gastronomy
description:
Fontana Hotel & Gastronomy **** is an ideal choice for your stay in Budva, whether you are on your summer vacation, here for a good time or to do business.

The hotel is open all-year round, offering guests a pleasant, homely atmosphere in new surroundings in an exceptional location – in the very heart of the city.

We are family friendly Hotel with 32 rooms. All rooms are non-smoking and have most beautiful views: mountains, city, Old Town and st. Nicolas Island.

name: Guesthouse Zvono
description: Pluzine is worth a stop. The guesthouse ZVONO is located here, on the shore of Lake Piva, modestly nestled among greenery, quiet and reliable, hospitable, and has been around for over twenty years. It is famous for its homemade mead, wonderful art exhibitions, rock and jazz concerts on summer evenings. Zvono is a place for all generations, and a starting point for nature lovers. There are several options: one-day trips with a combination of boat trips, swimming, hiking, fishing. Or two-day trips. Camping in a deep-sea canyon, lunch in a cave, villages and shepherd's huts, springs... Homemade food and drinks. Every detail has been thought of here. You will remind yourself how good it is to slow down from time to time. To see what life without haste looks like. Without noise, without excess. Life is simple and pleasant, like trout in Lake Piva, healthy and sweet, like honey drink.

name: Hotel Pirate Old Town
description: The amenities in the rooms will make your stay as comfortable as possible. Room facilities include WiFi (free of charge). Accommodation in family rooms and non-smoking rooms is available on request. A restaurant, bar and room service are available. WiFi in public areas allows guests to use the Internet freely. Walks through the hotel park will lift your spirits. Guest parking is available.

name: AM Palace
description: The AM Palace Hotel in Ulcinj, Montenegro, offers luxurious comfort with stylish rooms, a spa, pools and direct beach access. Enjoy first-class service, exclusive amenities and a breathtaking location on the Adriatic coast.

name: WOW hotel
description: Welcome to WOW Hotel - a modern boutique hotel designed for stylish comfort and relaxation. Spacious designer rooms, attentive service, and a perfect location near the sea turn your stay into something truly special. Here, bold interiors meet cozy elegance to make every moment a true “wow” experience.

name: Hotel Palata Venezia
description:
As a luxury heritage hotel-museum in the heart of Ulcinj's Old Town, Palata Venezia blends historic charm with modern comfort.

The hotel offers 31 units, including double, twin, and multi-bedroom suites.

Guests enjoy premium amenities: a conference room, the Miguel de Cervantes restaurant with a spacious terrace and Adriatic Sea views, a small fitness and wellness center, an outdoor pool, and a car and boat rental service. Our AI Concierge Dulcinea assists in 30+ languages, 24/7.

Explore the in-house Maritime Museum of Ulcinj's corsairs, the Bay's House, and monuments honoring Shabbatai Zevi and Miguel de Cervantes, both historically linked to Ulcinj.

name: Sea Star Hotel
description: Welcome to Sea Star Hotel — the perfect seaside retreat offering comfort, serenity, and a warm atmosphere. Enjoy modern, well-appointed rooms, attentive service, and stunning views of the Adriatic coast. Here, you’ll relax under the sun and experience true Montenegrin hospitality.

name: Hotel & Resort Gacka
description: Welcome to Imanje Rakočević – A place where nature meets luxuryLocated at 1100 meters above sea level, on the slopes of Sinjajevina, Imanje Rakočević is an oasis of peace and luxury in the heart of untouched nature. Spread over 50,000 m², it offers luxurious accommodation, a spa center, restaurant, wine cellar, amphitheater and a wide range of activities. Whether you come for relaxation, adventure or a business event, you will find the perfect balance between luxury and nature here.Location: Sinjajevina Mountain, Montenegro. Book now and get exclusive benefits!

name: Mountain Maison
description:
Welcome to the Mountain Maison Hotel & Restaurant, a family-owned retreat in picturesque Mojkovac, Montenegro. After returning home from abroad with three young children, our family saw the potential to open a hotel and tourism business in this stunning region.

Driven by a passion for hospitality and the outdoors, we created the Mountain Maison to showcase the natural beauty of Mojkovac. Set near the Biogradska Gora National Park and Tara River Canyon, our resort blends luxury with the tranquility of the surrounding landscapes.

name: Tara Place - Camp Rabrenovic
description:
Kamp Rabrenovic
is located in the central, northern, mountainous part of Montenegro at 820m above sea level, just 4km from the small historic town of Mojkovac (where you can find a bank, supermarkets, gas stations...). Near the camp is the Tara river at a distance of 800m and Bistrica 10m away. The camp is surrounded by three mountains: Bjelasica, Sinjajevina and Proscenska mountains, as well as two national parks: Biogradska gora 13km and Durmitor 18km. It is 30 km from Zabojsko Lake, 20 km from Tara Canyon, 30 km from Morača Canyon. Nearby is the Ckara mountain lodge 6 km and the Gušterov do viewpoint up to 7 km.
The camp was opened for guests in 2018 on an area of ​​40,000 m2. The property is located in a rural part of Montenegro, therefore the environment is like that. What is characteristic is the peaceful atmosphere, friendly local population and preserved nature. The days are sunny and warm and the nights are cool, which makes the stay pleasant. The camp is a family business where 5 members of the Rabrenović family work and live. The entire space is covered by wi-fi signal. In our camp you can rest, use the sauna, jacuzzi, eat, ride a jeep, motorbike, bicycle, quad, go rafting, canyoning, speleology, paragliding, skiing, snowshoeing, hiking, swimming in a river or lake.
You can use the camp as a base camp because it is located in the middle of Montenegro. From here you can visit all tourist destinations and everything is close from here. You can reach us by bus (distance 5km) and train (distance 6km), and we organize and wait for our guests at the station. We also organize transportation and wait for our guests from Podgorica airport, which is 93 km away.

name: Dream House Hotel & Spa
description:
Dream House Hotel has 32 accommodation units divided into double rooms, triple rooms and apartments. The rooms are designed in a modern style, equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. A mini-bar and tea and coffee making facilities are also available in the rooms. The bathroom is equipped with a shower, a hairdryer and free toiletries.

Free wireless internet is available throughout the property, and guests can also use free parking in front of the hotel.

Ski equipment and laundry services are available to all hotel guests. At the request of guests, the hotel can organize hiking, horseback riding and fishing in various areas of Kolašin.

name: Bianca Resort & Spa
description:
Hotel Bianca Resort & Spa is an exclusive resort, providing all the sophistication and comforts of a world-class hotel,

combined with a chalet ambiance and elegance.

It is surrounded by magnificent pine forests and enjoys breathtaking views of the Bjelasica Mountain.

The Resort’s architecture is based on the idea of a hunting lodge in the mountains, and it dominates Kolasin with this unique exterior.

Masterpieces of Montenegrin paintings, which are decorating the public lounge spaces, will delight all art lovers, as well as all others who enjoy a wonderful and relaxing ambiance.

name: Swissôtel Resort Kolasin
description:
Dear Guest,

Welcome to Swissôtel Resort Kolašin, where nature, tradition, and heartfelt hospitality come together to create unforgettable moments.

Nestled high on the slopes of Bjelasica Mountain, our resort invites you to slow down, breathe in the crisp alpine air, and reconnect with the simple pleasures of life—whether you're carving the slopes, hiking through ancient forests, or simply admiring the beauty from your balcony.

Our team is here to make you feel at home. With genuine warmth and a deep passion for this beautiful place, we are dedicated to ensuring your stay is seamless, inspiring, and truly memorable.

Thank you for choosing to share your journey with us.
‍
We wish you a wonderful stay.

name: Hotel Čile
description:
Hotel Čile is a 3 star hotel in Kolašin, Montenegro, a town in the northern part of the country. The hotel is family-run with staff on the site and it stands in a small, quiet alley, centrally located, just two minutes walk from the main town square.

The cosy mountain accommodation in Kolašin offered by Čile Hotel is suitable for holidaymakers wanting to enjoy a relaxing time away from the city’s buzz in a location surrounded by beautiful nature. The town is at 960 meters above sea level, 8 km from the ski resort Kolašin 1450. The 17 km of ski slopes available are suitable both for expert skiers and beginners of any age. Kolašin is also close, just a 10 minute drive, to the famous Biogradska Gora National Park and its untouched forest. Lake Biograd in the national park is one of 5 magnificent glacier lakes, definitely worth a visit.

Wireless Internet connection is available for free throughout the hotel.

name: Hotel Zlatni bor
description:
Comfort and warmth for an unforgettable mountain stay
Hotel Zlatni bor offers free WiFi throughout the property and views of the garden in Žabljak. The property is 4.2 km from Crno Jezero, 11 km from Tara Canyon Lookout and 21 km from Đurđevića Tara Bridge. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant serving local cuisine. Free private parking is available on site.

name: Camping Maslina
description: Maslina Camping is a peaceful seaside retreat surrounded by ancient olive trees. It offers cozy spaces for tents and campers, clean facilities, and the quiet charm of nature under the stars. Just steps away lie the beach, mountains, and hiking trails. A perfect place for travelers seeking a simple, soulful escape close to the earth.

name: Hotel Rezident
description:
Built for comfort.
Based on superior craftsmanship.
We believe that true luxury lies in the details, in the way a space feels from the moment you step in. With only nine rooms, Hotel Rezident was never meant to be large. It was meant to be personal. Every element, from the carefully crafted wooden details to the soothing atmosphere, is designed to provide a quiet retreat that simultaneously exudes elegance and provides a deep sense of comfort.

Hotel Rezident is not a place of luxury, but a place of refinement. A peaceful, contemporary retreat created for those seeking authenticity, quality and a sense of connection with nature, local culture and themselves.

name: Pansion Nobel - restoran i apartmani
description: Welcome to Pansion Nobel — a cozy, family-run guesthouse with apartments and a traditional restaurant, nestled on the scenic Budva Riviera. Enjoy spacious rooms, a warm and friendly atmosphere, and authentic Montenegrin cuisine. It’s the perfect spot for a relaxing holiday near the beach and local attractions. Genuine hospitality and comfort await you here.

name: MB Hotel & Restaurant
description:
The city of Žabljak is located in the northwest of Montenegro, in the center of Durmitor. With its 1456 meters above sea level, the city is the highest urban settlement in Southeast Europe. It is located at the foot of Durmitor and is surrounded by 23 mountain peaks over 2200 meters, 18 mountain lakes and the Tara River Canyon, the deepest in Europe.

The Đurđević Tara Bridge, which elegantly straddles the deep Tara River Canyon, captivates with its appearance and position. It was built back in 1938 before World War II, and its designer, whose name is immortalized on the plaque next to the bridge, had a refined sense of aesthetics. The beautiful nature that carved the imposing canyon, has been tamed gently and safely by human hands.

"MB Turist" has been operating in Montenegro since 1991. MB Turist's main activities are catering and tourism. MB Turist operates the following facilities: "MB Hotel" Žabljak and "Motel Tara MB" on Đurđević Tara.

name: Hotel Polar Star
description:
Welcome to Žabljak, the most beautiful mountain resort on the most beautiful Montenegrin mountain Durmitor!

Recently renovated (July 2015), the Polar Star hotel is located in the Borje settlement, 4 km from the center of Žabljak, on the way to the famous bridge over the Tara River.

Designed in a traditional mountain style, which exudes a homely atmosphere, surrounded by untouched nature, meadows and mountain ranges, it is the right place for relaxation, socializing and business events.

The possibility of numerous activities - skiing, hiking, rafting on Tara, various excursions ... and other options for active and passive vacation, are reasons why to come to Žabljak.

Comfortable rooms and apartments, a tavern, a bar, a mini Wellness & Spa center, a seminar room, a children's corner ... are enough reasons to choose the Polar Star hotel.

We can also boast of the award for the best continental hotel in Montenegro in 2010 according to the Tourist Organization of Montenegro -

Winner of Montenegro Wild Beauty Award 2010

Gold medal at the 44th Novi Sad Tourism Fair in 2011

Diploma with a gold plaque for the quality of hotel services at the 45th International Tourism Fair Novi Sad 2012

Explore our offer and come and see for yourself the beauties of Žabljak and Durmitor!

name: Hotel SOA
description:
Tucked away and surrounded by conifers, with a magnificent view of the mountain range.
Respecting the values of nature and the environment, Hotel SOA was built in Žabljak, in the very heart of the Durmitor National Park. A contemporary interpretation of traditional Durimitor architecture characterizes the style of this four-star hotel. It is located on the first kilometer of the road to the Black Lake, the most visited natural treasure in Žabljak.
For a complete atmosphere, we also offer you different types of excursions and activities organized by the SOA Experience agency.
‍
SOA Experience fulfills your dreams and desires for an active vacation in nature and offers the opportunity to experience truly incredible and unforgettable adventures in the beautiful Durmitor National Park, a world heritage site under the protection of UNESCO.

name: Hotel Porto Tara
description: Hotel Porto Tara is located at the spectacular rafting spot Radovan Luka, right where the Tara River Canyon reaches 1,330 meters deep. As the only hotel within Durmitor National Park, one of the most beautiful natural pearls under UNESCO protection, it is the perfect destination for lovers of adventure, privacy and untouched nature. The hotel is only an hour’s drive from Žabljak.

name: Hotel Divan
description:
Divan Hotel blends contemporary luxury with Turkish charm in the upscale Şişli district. Its prime location puts Istanbul’s key attractions, including Taksim Square and shopping hubs, within easy reach.

Guests enjoy elegantly designed rooms with modern amenities, from minibars to high-speed Wi-Fi. The hotel features a gourmet restaurant serving Turkish and international cuisine, a chic bar, and a spa with a sauna and massage services.

Perfect for both business and leisure, Divan offers impeccable service and a serene urban escape

name: Stara Čaršija Hotel & SPA
description: Modern and luxuriously equipped apartments where care was taken with every detail and the traditional-rustic appearance of the hotel is a combination that will leave you with the most beautiful memories of Stari Bar. The beauty of the hotel is only surpassed by the view of the Old Town and the beautiful shores of the Adriatic Sea and Lake Skadar.

name: Hotel Princess
description:
Excellent service and comfort, as well as guest satisfaction are confirmation of quality and the reason why guests choose our hotel again and again.
Hotel Princess is located on the seashore in the immediate vicinity of the city center and sports fields.
Whether you are on vacation, alone, with your partner, family or on sports training or on a business trip, the hotel can meet all your requirements.

name: Hotel Sato Conference & SPA Resort
description: Hotel Sato Conference & SPA Resort is a modern 4-star hotel located right on the beach in Sutomore. Spacious rooms with balconies, a panoramic rooftop pool, a cozy SPA center, and fully equipped conference facilities make it ideal for both leisure and business stays. Guests enjoy a sea-view restaurant, fitness center, and direct access to the beach. Comfort and elegance meet warm Montenegrin hospitality here.

name: Hotel R
address: Petovica zabio, bb Ulica Sulja Kalezića
description: Located in the charming village of Kunje, known as Hladna uvala, our boutique hotel offers the perfect combination of elegance and affordability, and the ideal combination of nature and comfort. Immerse yourself in the comfort of our rooms and suites, which are characterized by modern design and an unforgettable view of the sea ​​expanse and the island of Stari Ulcinj.

name: Gradska Cetinje
description: Welcome to Hotel Gradska Cetinje, a five-star boutique hotel located on Dvorski Trg in the historic Old Royal Capital of Montenegro. Its elegant rooms blend modern amenities—air conditioning, coffee machine, safe, and refined bathrooms—with tasteful design and comfort. The on-site restaurant and café serve Montenegrin and international cuisine in a charming setting that echoes the city’s royal legacy. As Montenegro’s first EU Ecolabel eco-friendly hotel, it offers a refined stay rooted in heritage and sustainability.

name: Hotel Monte Rosa
description: Welcome to Hotel Monte Rosa, nestled at 1240 m above sea level in the stunning Lovćen National Park. This cozy high-category mountain hotel offers an authentic blend of traditional design with modern comfort: wooden-furnished rooms and suites, minibar, Wi‑Fi, and breathtaking mountain views. Guests can relax in the indoor pool, spa area and enjoy regional cuisine made from organic Njeguši products at the on-site restaurant with terrace. Ideal for nature lovers—hiking trails start at the doorstep and the nearby Kotor–Lovćen cable car offers panoramic vistas.

name: Hotel Agape
description:
HOTEL “AGAPE” **** opened its doors in mid-October 2021, for all those who are driven by a sense of universal love, unconditional trust and good will.
The hotel is located in the centre of Bar and is the perfect choice for all those who want to be a few steps from the business and shopping area.
From the very entrance to the glamorously lit space, you will be greeted by friendly and smiling staff. Paved with marble from the ancient city of Carrara, with which Michelangelo created his monumental sculptures, it will provide a unique experience to every guest.

name: Hotel Ravnjak
description: Welcome to Hotel Ravnjak, a charming three-star hotel nestled in the picturesque Tara River Valley in Dobrilovina, near Durmitor National Park. Guests enjoy cozy and newly renovated rooms with mountain or forest views, equipped with TV, minibar, and modern bathrooms. The on-site restaurant's terrace offers delightful traditional Montenegrin dishes—like trout and grilled local delicacies—overlooking a serene stream. With its spotless rooms, friendly staff, and nature-based activities, it's an ideal retreat for travelers seeking comfort in nature.

name: Restoran Niagara
description: Welcome to Restoran Niagara — a charming riverside restaurant beside the Cijevna River and its stunning waterfall, just a short drive from Podgorica. Taste traditional Montenegrin specialties like kačamak, cicvara, sač-roasted meat, homemade pies, and fish—made with authentic home-style recipes. The spacious wooden tables on the terrace sit right by the water, offering a serene natural setting. Perfect for those seeking local cuisine, excellent wine, and peaceful moments by the falls.

name: Pic Nic
description: Welcome to Restoran Pic Nic - a cozy and friendly eatery in Herceg Novi, beloved for generous portions, hearty menu, and warm service. The interior blends modern design with café-style charm: wooden tables, soft lighting, and comfortable seating for a relaxed dining experience. Popular dishes include freshly made pizzas, pastas, sandwiches, and homemade desserts at great value. A perfect spot for breakfast, lunch, or dinner in a laid-back seaside setting.

name: Beautiful Balkans Adventure
description:
Date: 22 Aug - 5 Sep 2025
Duration: 15 days
Place: Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro (international expedition)

Exhilarating routes will be taken to all the special areas these three countries have to offer. The route is all on good asphalt starting on wide gentle roads throughout Bosnia's inland and finishing with superb coastal riding up the azure Adriatic coast in Croatia.

Both Montenegro and Bosnia and Herzegovina are surely two of the last undiscovered tourist destinations in Europe. Witnessing the transition and rediscovering a region of forgotten beauty, culture and history will reward and surprise even the most jaded traveler. Make sure you come for a visit before these natural beauties get overrun by tourists!

name: Dinaric Rally 2025
description:
Date: August 23–29, 2025
🌍 Route: Croatia → Bosnia and Herzegovina → Montenegro → Serbia

The Dinaric Rally is a multi-day cross-country rally raid through the stunning landscapes of the Dinaric Alps. Designed for experienced riders, it features off-road navigation stages, endurance segments, and technical tracks across four Balkan countries. Riders will face both natural obstacles and GPS-based challenges, with a bivouac camp set up in Knin, Croatia, serving as the central logistics hub. Entry fees start from approximately €1215 (M-class), including navigation support, technical assistance, meals, and safety coordination.

name: Biker Fest Skopje
description:
Date: September 13, 2025, 15:00–22:00 CEST.
Location: Avtokomanda Square, Скопье
One-day biker festival in Skopje's central Avtokomanda Square featuring open-air concerts, bike showcases, and community vibes. A great occasion to meet local clubs and riders.

name: Croatia Bike Week Pula
description:
Date: tentatively August 28 – September 2, 2025
Location: Pula, Croatia
Croatia’s biggest biker event featuring city-wide motorcycle parade, live rock concerts, and camping by the Adriatic. Hosted in stunning historic Pula — ideal for touring riders and festival-goers.

name: Beer Garden
description: Welcome to Beer Garden — one of Skopje’s top beer pubs located at Zhivko Chingo 5 in the lively Debar Maalo district. Featuring over 160 beers from around the world, it's paired with delicious grilled and pub-style dishes. The spacious interior includes wooden communal tables, ambient lighting, and a bar that often hosts live music performances. Perfect for an evening out with friends, offering great drinks, music, and a warm, convivial vibe.

name: Grahovac 1858
description:
Welcome to Grahovac_1858 — a place where history, traditions, and quality intertwine; a place for pleasure, soul, and unique experiences. A place where you can go hiking, try extreme activities (off-road jeep tours, shooting ranges, enduro motorcycles, and bicycles) and enjoy the best dishes of traditional Montenegrin cuisine.A quiet place, surrounded by mountains, hills, and untouched nature.

The complex features the famous national restaurant (Grahovac_1858), offering delicious traditional dishes. The Grahovac_1858 aparthotel in Nikšić offers guests rooms, a garden, a terrace, and a bar with a mountain view.

name: Pub (City Beerhouse Pub)
description: City Beerhouse Pub is a cozy urban pub offering a wide selection of local and imported beers. Located in the heart of the city, it attracts both locals and tourists. With live music, a warm atmosphere, and delicious snacks, it’s a perfect stop for travelers on the go.

name: Irish Pub Five
description: Irish Pub Five is a little piece of Ireland in North Macedonia. With dark wood interiors, live music, and legendary Irish beer, it offers an authentic pub atmosphere. Popular among both travelers and locals, especially during sports events and themed nights.

name: Rock&Beer Club Alcatraz
description: Rock&Beer Club Alcatraz is a legendary spot for rock lovers, live music fans, and craft beer enthusiasts. The atmosphere echoes classic rock bars, with powerful sound, bold decor, and a strong community vibe. Frequent concerts, biker meetups, and theme nights make it a highlight of the local nightlife. A great drink selection and welcoming crowd seal the deal.

name: Caffe bar BMB
description: Caffe bar BMB is a cozy spot in the heart of Omiš, just by the bridge and the Cetina River. Refreshing drinks, great coffee, and a relaxed atmosphere await you here. Bikers and motorcycle travelers are especially welcome — with a 10% discount just for them. A perfect stop along the scenic Adriatic coastal route.

name: Bikers Cafe
description: Bikers Cafe in Dubrovnik is a cozy spot with the true biker club vibe and a stunning view of the Old Town. They serve great coffee, cold drinks, and light snacks. Free Wi-Fi and motorcycle-themed decor make it the perfect place to relax after a long ride. A great meeting point for motorcyclists and enthusiasts to connect.

name: Illyrian Saloon
