description: Illyrian Saloon is a biker-friendly bar with Albanian spirit and a wild west twist. It offers signature drinks, live music, and a rustic interior full of vintage charm. Welcoming all travelers - especially those on two wheels - this is a great stop to rest, share stories, and feel the essence of freedom.

name: Two Riders Bar
description: Two Riders Bar is a popular biker spot combining coziness and excitement. Guests enjoy a great selection of drinks and hearty snacks, along with themed biker events. The bar is famous for its friendly and free-spirited atmosphere, attracting locals and tourists alike.

name: Beerhouse Bass Maribor
description: Beerhouse Bass is a craft beer paradise with a cozy vibe and nearby motorcycle parking. Expect live music and fun events — perfect for a biker break.

name: Snack Bar 1964
description: For more than 50 years, the snack bar has been a popular gathering place for locals and guests who are taken to the Slovenian sea. Many loves and online solid friendships were born at the Snack Bar. A snack bar is not just a bar, it is a kind of institution of rock'n'roll, good vibes and joyful moments that fill life. Almost everyone who takes it to the Snack Bar in Žusterna will return to it again and again.

name: X Rock Bar Celje
description: X Rock Bar in Celje is where the energy of live music meets the spirit of biker freedom. Expect rock and blues concerts, a wide range of drinks, and a friendly crowd. The interior is styled like a rock club, with guitars on the walls and an atmosphere that makes you lose track of time. A perfect evening stop during a motorcycle tour through Slovenia.

name: Beer Pub
description: Beer Pub is a cozy spot for beer lovers in the heart of Slovenia. It offers a wide selection of local and imported brews, paired with delicious snacks. The atmosphere is friendly and laid-back, with a warm interior inspired by beer culture. A perfect place to take a break on the road and mingle with locals and fellow travelers.

name: Cutty Sark Pub
description:
Cutty has a wild and picturesque history because of its famous parties and live music events.
It is a classic English pub where you can have a variety of cold local and imported beers together with snacks.

You and your friends are kindly invited to visit us and experience our hospitality.

name: Corner pub
description: Corner Pub is a cozy, long-standing pub in central Ljubljana. With over 40 beer varieties and quality snacks served by certified baristas, it's a haven for beer lovers. Friendly staff and a British-style atmosphere make it a great spot to mingle with locals and travelers alike. The inviting interior and lively ambiance make it the perfect place to unwind after a day exploring the city.

name: Lord Byron Pub
description: Lord Byron Pub, located in a historic 500+-year-old building in the heart of Koper, delivers authentic English pub charm. With exposed brick walls, plush red curtains, and ambient lighting, it offers a cozy and atmospheric setting. The pub offers an extensive beer list from around Europe, signature cocktails, coffee, lemonades, and light bites such as nachos and margarita pizza. Friendly English-speaking staff provide table service, cards are accepted, and guests can relax indoors or in the outdoor seating area.

name: Tirana City Viewpoint
description: Tirana City Viewpoint offers a stunning panoramic view of the Albanian capital. A great spot to rest and take photos after a mountain ride.

name: Rent a Scooter by Picnic
description: Rent a Scooter by Picnic provides high-quality scooters in central Skopje, perfect for day trips and city rides. Includes helmets, phone holder, and unlimited mileage.

name: Ohrid Rent A Car & Scooters-Escape
description: Ohrid Rent A Car & Scooters-Escape offers modern scooters and motorbikes for exploring the scenic roads around Lake Ohrid. Their fleet includes Piaggio Beverly 300cc and 125cc models—ideal for solo riders or two-up touring. Helmets and insurance are included, with flexible pickup options and 24/7 support via WhatsApp.

name: GSG Motors
description: GSG Motors is a family‑owned dealer and service center in Bitola, North Macedonia, specializing in scooters, motorcycles, ATVs, electric bikes, and e‑vehicles. Their scooter lineup includes popular models like YADEA E8S Pro (up to 150 km range) and RKS Easy Pro 50cc, with rentals or purchases available along with free delivery and nationwide support.

name: Tony viewpoint
description: Tony Viewpoint—located near the monastery of the Holy Mother of God in Dolna Matka Canyon, North Macedonia—offers a stunning vantage over the gorge and reservoirs. A scenic mountain trail from the monastery leads hungry bikers straight here.

name: Matka Canyon Trail
description: Matka Canyon Trail (X75W+859, Skopje 1000, North Macedonia) is an easy‑to‑moderate riverside path that follows the Treska River through steep canyon walls and past lake viewpoints. Perfect for bikers seeking a peaceful nature ride, it’s often paired with boat tours or riverside cafes

name: Observation deck on lake Kozjak
description: Observation deck at Lake Kozjak offers panoramic views of North Macedonia’s largest artificial lake and surrounding hills. A peaceful nature spot reached via a scenic ~13 km paved route from Skopje—ideal as a rest stop for bikers seeking tranquility and sweeping vistas.

name: Viewpoint Kozjak - Gurgurnica
description: Viewpoint Kozjak – Gurgurnica (V35V+JG, Gurgurnitsa, North Macedonia) is a remote observation deck atop Mount Jasen, offering sweeping panoramic views over the expansive Kozjak reservoir and surrounding forested hills. A scenic destination reached via a narrow mountain road, it’s ideal for bikers seeking breathtaking vistas away from crowds

name: Viewpoint Of Dubrovnik
description: Viewpoint of Dubrovnik is a panoramic overlook just outside Ploče Gate (“Iza Grada”) offering sweeping vistas of Dubrovnik’s Old Town, medieval walls, and the Adriatic Sea dotted with islands like Lokrum. A short downhill road ride from the city center makes it an ideal rest or photo stop for bikers exploring the Croatian coast.

name: Vidikovac Lozica
description: Vidikovac Lozica is a scenic viewpoint located along the D8 coastal road in Lozica, Croatia. Perched above Rijeka Dubrovačka, it offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea, the Elafiti Islands, and the Bay of Dubrovnik. This spot is particularly popular among photographers and travelers seeking a tranquil setting to enjoy the natural beauty of the region. It's an ideal location for capturing stunning photographs, especially during sunrise or sunset when the lighting enhances the picturesque landscape.

name: Viewpoint Ukotići
description: Viewpoint Ukotići is a serene vantage point located along the Unnamed Road in Kašćerga, Croatia. Approximately 3 to 5 kilometers from the town center, this viewpoint offers panoramic views of the surrounding Istrian countryside. The area is known for its lush greenery and tranquil atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for relaxation and nature walks. Visitors can enjoy the peaceful surroundings, ideal for photography, birdwatching, and leisurely strolls. The viewpoint is accessible year-round, providing a scenic escape into nature.

name: Viewpoint Casanova
description: Observation deck on a hilltop, with views over a yacht harbor, Vrsar old town & the Adriatic Sea.

name: Baška viewpoint
description: Baška Viewpoint is a scenic overlook situated in Baška, Croatia, offering panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. Located along the Unnamed Road in the 51523 postal code area, this viewpoint provides a tranquil setting for visitors to enjoy the natural beauty of the region. The area is known for its lush greenery and serene atmosphere, making it an ideal spot for relaxation and photography. Whether you're a local resident or a traveler exploring the area, Baška Viewpoint offers a peaceful retreat to appreciate the scenic vistas.

name: Lake view Point
description: Lake View Point is a serene vantage point situated in the Grand Park of Tirana, offering panoramic views of the artificial lake and the surrounding lush greenery. Located at coordinates 8R6C+GC2, this spot is a favorite among locals and visitors alike for leisurely walks, photography, and enjoying the tranquil atmosphere. The area features well-maintained paths, benches for relaxation, and is easily accessible from the city center. Whether you're seeking a peaceful retreat or a scenic spot to capture the beauty of Tirana, Lake View Point provides a perfect setting.

name: Osumi Canyon viewing point
description: Osumi Canyon Viewing Point is a breathtaking natural overlook located along an unnamed road in Çerenisht, Albania. Situated at coordinates F6HX+VWR, this viewpoint offers panoramic vistas of the Osumi Canyon, a 26-kilometer-long river gorge renowned for its dramatic limestone cliffs and the crystal-clear waters of the Osum River below. Visitors can witness the vibrant greenery surrounding the canyon, making it a picturesque spot for photography enthusiasts and nature lovers alike. The area is accessible year-round, providing a tranquil setting to immerse oneself in the beauty of Albania's landscapes.

name: Panoramic Viewpoint of Sarandë
description: Panoramic Viewpoint of Sarandë is a stunning overlook situated on an unnamed road (V28G+F34) in Sarandë, Albania. Perched above the city, it offers breathtaking panoramic views of Sarandë's charming architecture, the azure Ionian Sea, and, on clear days, the distant Greek island of Corfu. This spot is ideal for photography, leisurely walks, and enjoying the tranquil atmosphere. Accessible year-round, it's a must-visit for those seeking to capture the beauty of Albania's southern coast.

name: View point to the city
description: Gjirokastër Obelisk Viewpoint (approx. 34CP+MVV, along Rruga Astrit Karagjozi) is a peaceful overlook offering sweeping views across Gjirokastër’s historic stone houses, the Drino River valley, and surrounding mountain ridges. Perfectly positioned for bikers exploring the UNESCO-listed “City of Stone,” this scenic spot shines at sunrise or sunset.

name: View point SH8
description: View Point SH8 is one of the many panoramic overlooks along the legendary SH8 coastal route in southern Albania. Positioned near the famous Llogara Pass and winding highway, it offers expansive views of the Adriatic/Ionian Sea, rugged mountains, switchback roads, and deep blue coves. A perfect rest spot for bikers riding through the Albanian Riviera.

name: Viewpoint Springs
description: Ljubaništa is a village along the shore of the Lake Ohrid in North Macedonia. The village is located near the Monastery of St. Naum and the border with Albania

name: Two lakes view point
address: WRRF+4H4 Lipova - Vrv Magaro Starting point, P504
description: Two Lakes View Point offers a breathtaking high‑land vantage where you can see both Lake Ohrid and Lake Prespa framed by Galicica’s rugged peaks. Accessible via a scenic (but twisty) road followed by a moderately steep ~1 km marked trail, it’s a rewarding stop for bikers seeking panoramic views and nature immersion.

name: Koritski Rid
description: Koritski Rid Viewpoint is a scenic ridge viewpoint along the road between Trpejça and Oteshevo in Galičica National Park. At an elevation of about 1,405 m, it offers sweeping panoramas across turquoise Lake Ohrid, the village of Trpejça, the surrounding hill ranges and distant valleys—perfect for bikers seeking a tranquil, photo‑worthy stop

name: View Point
description: View Point is perched on the lakeside edge of Lin village, offering panoramic views over Lake Ohrid, the peninsula with its mosaic‑topped ruins and sunset‑kissed coastal lanes. An easily accessible, peaceful spot for bikers to pause, enjoy the sparkling lake, and explore Lin’s historic charm.

name: Scenic view
description: Scenic View – Primošten is a panoramic overlook located on the hills above the coastal town of Primošten. From this vantage, you can see the charming Old Town peninsula, the sparkling Adriatic waters dotted with small islets, and the terraced vineyards known locally as “stone lace.” Easily reachable via the D8 coastal road, it's an ideal rest stop and photo opportunity for riders exploring Croatia’s Dalmatian coast.

name: Ambasador Hotel
description:
Hotel Ambasador is located in the heart of Niš, on King Milan Square. It's the only 5-star hotel in southern Serbia and one of the tallest buildings in the city, easily recognizable by its distinctive design.
The hotel offers a restaurant, lobby bar, spa and fitness center. The front desk is open 24/7, and services include room service and currency exchange. Rooms are modern, luxurious, and thoughtfully designed, offering comfort and stunning views of the city. A rich continental breakfast is available.
Nearby attractions include Niš Fortress, the Monument to the Liberators of Niš, and the National Theater. The closest airport, Constantine the Great, is just 3 km away.

name: New City Hotel & Restaurant Niš
description:
The hotel currently has 85 rooms and suites in several accommodation categories. The hotel's modern "A la carte" restaurant offers local and international cuisine, as well as delicacies for all gourmets. Three modernly equipped, multifunctional conference rooms are available to guests from the country and abroad, for organizing meetings, conferences, seminars, presentations, interviews.
The large Banquet Hall "Grand", on the ground floor of the hotel is an ideal place for organizing various celebrations: weddings, parties, birthdays, celebrations and anniversaries.

name: Hotel Crystal Light
description:
Welcome to the hotel where every guest has their special place.
Hotel Crystal Light in Niš offers more than just accommodation — it's a space where memories are made, business partnerships are built, and guests feel at home, even when far from it.
The hotel features 34 modern and well-equipped rooms and suites, offering a perfect balance of comfort and functionality.
For business events, the hotel provides conference halls suitable for everything from intimate meetings of 20 people to large events with up to 150 participants. The spaces offer modern interiors, natural lighting, and full technical equipment, making them ideal for presentations, seminars, workshops, and conferences.
The hotel restaurant combines flavor, elegance, and comfort. Whether you're a hotel guest, a visitor seeking a quality meal, or a business partner looking for the perfect meeting spot, the restaurant offers a refined atmosphere for any occasion.
Every detail at Hotel Crystal Light is thoughtfully designed to make guests feel special.

name: Garni Hotel Niš City View
description:
Whether you're visiting Niš for business or leisure, Hotel Niš City View is the right choice for you.
We offer the highest level of comfort and service at the most affordable prices.
Enjoy your stay in one of our over 40 spacious rooms and apartments, just 1.2 km from the city center, with free private parking available in front of the hotel.
Start your day with a coffee or unwind in the evening with a glass of wine on our large terraces, offering unforgettable panoramic views.
Located in a quiet part of the city, our hotel ensures a peaceful and restful stay.

name: Bed and Breakfast Ponte Bianco
description:
Welcome to Ponte Bianco
Located in the center of Vranje, yet isolated from city noise, Ponte Bianco offers comfortable accommodation close to administrative, cultural, religious, and entertainment venues.
The hotel features:
Luxurious rooms with elegant interiors
On-site café-pizzeria and restaurant
Additional restaurant with garden terrace across the street
Conference room
Free underground garage and outdoor parking with video surveillance
Whether visiting for business or leisure, Ponte Bianco is the perfect base for exploring Vranje and its surroundings.

name: Harmony
description:
Harmony Guesthouse offers accommodation in 8 modern rooms with a cozy atmosphere enhanced by stylish photo wallpapers. A free breakfast is included.
Ideal for both business travelers and tourists, Harmony is located in the heart of the city, close to the promenade where you can experience the vibrant nightlife of Vranje.
Guests have access to private parking with video surveillance, free of charge.
Our friendly staff is ready to assist with your needs, ensuring a comfortable stay.
We hope Harmony will be your choice and promise not to disappoint.

name: Hotel Royal Putnik
description:
Hotel Royal Putnik opened in 2020 and is located in a fantastic location near the highway and very close to the city center.
Designed as a hotel with luxury accommodation, it will provide each guest with maximum comfort and convenience necessary for a quality vacation. This is supported by the numerous facilities that the Royal Putnik hotel has. In addition to modern and luxuriously equipped rooms and apartments, the hotel has a bar and restaurant, a SPA&WELLNESS center, a gym and rooms for celebrations and conference meetings.
The hotel has parking and a WI FI zone, which are completely free for all guests.
Hotel Royal Putnik is categorized as a 4* star hotel and has an accommodation capacity of 45 rooms and 95 beds.

name: Restoran, zoo vrt i prenoćište Mišić - VRANJE
description:
Hotel Mišić offers an exceptional experience for guests seeking relaxation, fine dining, wildlife encounters, and special event management. Set in a peaceful location, this hotel has everything you need for a comfortable and memorable stay.

The hotel offers spacious and elegantly decorated rooms and suites, equipped with comfortable beds and all the necessary amenities to make you feel at home.

name: Vila Kristina
description:
When the time specified in Negotin to meet natural beauty and mystery of Eastern Serbia the right place for your pleasant stay in the Negotin Villa Kristina.
Villa has 7 double rooms and one apartment. All rooms and apartments are furnished with beautiful and specific interior, modern design, and odišu warmth, comfort and color. Each room has a double bed or a double bed, extra bed, dressing table with large mirror, mini-bar, television with satellite channels and the ability to access the Internet. Bathrooms in Willy Kristina are fully equipped with the latest Italian equipment and provide a pleasant stay.

In skolopu Villas and enclosed parking for your vehicle.

name: Brick Apartment
description:
Location
Our apartments are just a 5-minute walk from the center of Bajina Bašta, located near the bus station and NIS gas station. The famous Drina River House is only 1 km away, while Mount Tara (Kaluđerske Bare) and Lake Perućac are both 15 km from the property. Location is available on Google Maps.

Outdoor Area
Enjoy a spacious yard with a swimming pool, sun loungers, a covered terrace with a corner sofa, espresso machine, and barbecue.
The pool is saltwater and maintained at a constant temperature of 25–30°C. It uses electrolysis for disinfection and features automatic pH control.
Right next to the pool is a summer kitchen with a shower cabin for your convenience.

Apartment 1 (44 m²)
Features a living room with a kitchen, a bathroom, and a bedroom with one double bed and one single bed. An extra bed can be added upon request.
There are TVs in both the living room and bedroom, and Wi-Fi is available throughout the apartment, yard, and pool area.

Apartment 2 – Studio (37 m²)
Includes a kitchen, bathroom, one double bed, and a sofa bed.

Capacity
The entire complex accommodates up to 7 guests.

Extras
Guests have access to three brand-new mountain bikes and one private parking spot in the yard.

name: Zepter Hotel Bajina Bašta
description: Zepter Hotel Drina, located in the center of Bajina Bašta and only 500 m from the sports and recreation center "Braća Milutinović", is your right choice for holding sports preparations. Guests can use the sports hall with a volleyball, handball, and five-a-side football field. The hotel offers excellent conditions for accommodation and food for athletes. The sports fields, together with the hotel, represent a functional and complete whole. In addition to the field in Bajina Bašta, athletes also have access to the football field in Perućac.

name: Enigma | Studio apartments & Event Hall
description:
Welcome, dear friends!
We are waiting for you on the banks of the Drina River, in the nature that exudes beautiful greenery that surrounds our facility. We are located three kilometers from the center of Bajina Bašta, but we are far enough out of town that you can completely enjoy the beauty of our region. The Tara Mountain, the Drina River and Lake Perućac are also a wonderful part of our district. With a good mood and a view of the river, we are sure that your vacation will be like a dream. See the location on Google Maps.
Within our facility, we offer you fully equipped, elegant apartments for rent. Our accommodation offers you a completely new level of comfort and luxury during your stay in the city.
We offer three studio apartments, one two-bedroom apartment and four rooms. Each accommodation unit includes air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, private parking and cable TV.
Within our offer, there is the possibility of organizing excursions to the Tara Mountain, Lake Perućac, as well as a boat ride from Perućac to Višegrad.
Visit Bajina Bašta and discover the beauties that this beautiful municipality has to offer!
For more pictures, follow us on Instagram @apartmani_enigma. Reserve your spot today!

name: Gorski Hotel & Spa
description:
There are places whose magic you feel immediately. Which bring us closer to nature and everything that is deep within us. Hotel Gorski & Spa Kopaonik is such a place.

Here the dream of freedom becomes a reality, and enjoying the small and big joys of life - the only obligation. Here the day flows at a pace that suits you.

The pressure of everyday life disappears, already at the first glance through the window of your warm apartment at the silent winter landscape and snow-covered forests.

Everything that is less important is left behind.Everything you dream about all year round is here at your fingertips...

From walking along the blossoming trails in spring, to the excitement of skiing on snowy peaks. From enjoying a warm pool overlooking the ski slope, to an unforgettable experience of warmth and understated luxury in every detail of the nature-inspired interior.

Get closer to nature and yourself.

name: Viceroy Kopaonik Serbia
description: Viceroy Kapaonik is a timeless mountain adventure where our refined lens on hospitality takes a Serbian icon to new heights. As the only five-star resort on Kopaonik Mountain, our 119-room ski-in, ski-out retreat offers modern luxury amidst breathtaking natural beauty, providing adventure and unforgettable experiences. Begin your journey with a day on the slopes, unwind at The Spa at Viceroy, featuring a beauty lab, indoor vitality pool, and hammam scrub room, or relax at our après ski lounge with stunning scenic views and enjoy inspired, local fare.

name: Grey Hotel Kopaonik
description: Grey Hotel is a place that offers you the opportunity to discover new heights of pleasure and relaxation. Designed to keep everything at your fingertips, Grey Hotel offers impeccable, personalized service and superior accommodations, which are here to fulfill your desires and expectations. Comfortable and spacious rooms are equipped with top-quality designed Italian furniture and ceramics, wi-fi network with excellent flow, as well as cable television.

name: Aparthotel & SPA Woodside by Anaya, Kopaonik
description: Our mountain spa hotel is a place where peace meets magnificent nature. Nestled among breathtaking pine peaks, it is a haven that offers an escape for those seeking relaxation and an active holiday. Relax in the heart of one of the most beautiful mountains, where every moment in the fresh air is an opportunity to reconnect with your inner peace.

name: Belvedere Hills Luxury Apartments and Spa Kopaonik
description: Belvedere Hills Apartments are luxurious and functional apartments designed to meet all your needs during a multi-day stay on Kopaonik. They are intended for rent. The facility has 17 accommodation units arranged on 5 levels, ranging in size from 27 m2 to 62 m2.

name: Hotel Junior
description: Junior Hotel is located in the tourist center of Brzeće in Kopaonik, on the ideal altitude of 1100 meters. Traditional hospitality, environment and services make our hotel a central facility of Brzeće tourist offer. Our hotel is an ideal place for organization of business, sport, recreational activities and also for relaxing and enjoying in the peace and authenticity of nature.

name: Enduro Touren Bosnien Grip
description: Enduro Touren Bosnien Grip is the perfect choice for fans of enduro and two-wheeled adventures. The company offers guided tours through Bosnia’s stunning landscapes, including mountain trails, forest paths, and authentic villages. Experienced guides ensure safety and tailor the routes to each rider’s skill level. It’s a unique way to discover Bosnia’s wild beauty from the saddle of a motorcycle.

name: Camp Kljajevića Luka
description: Camp Kljajevića Luka is a cozy campsite located in a scenic valley near the Tara River and at the foot of Durmitor National Park. It’s a perfect stop for bikers and nature lovers, offering fresh air, tranquility, firepit areas, and a welcoming atmosphere. Guests can stay with tents or campers and enjoy amenities like showers, Wi-Fi, and parking. It’s a great place to recharge and soak in the stunning natural surroundings.

name: GNIJEZDO
description: GNIJEZDO is a boutique guesthouse with soul, perfect for travelers seeking comfort, style, and peace. Located in a scenic part of Montenegro, it offers modern rooms with a warm ambiance, comfy beds, and all essential amenities. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi, parking, and a breakfast made from local delicacies. Expect a heartfelt welcome and a true sense of comfort — like visiting old friends.

name: MOTO-NAUTIKA, d.o.o.
description: Moto‑Nautika is the largest and most renowned moto-mart in Slovenia, near Maribor. It offers a vast selection of riding gear, helmets, luggage, and apparel (sizes up to 12XL), with the opportunity to test-ride Yamaha motorcycles. The showroom encourages relaxed browsing and expert advice. A perfect stop to outfit yourself fully before hitting the road.

name: TC Motoshop
description: TC Motoshop is the largest motorcycle store in Ljubljana, offering an impressive range of brands like Yamaha, Kawasaki, Triumph, Suzuki, Honda, Vespa, and Dainese. You can find bikes, gear, accessories, genuine parts, and official service support. Known for exceptional customer care and technical expertise.

name: Motomaxx
description: Motomaxx is the official distributor of Piaggio, Vespa, KTM, Yamaha, and Honda in southwestern Slovenia (Izola). They offer new and used motorcycles sales, full-service workshop, and test rides. Staff fluent in English, German and Italian — ideal for international visitors.

name: KMC MOTOSHOP
description: KMC MOTOSHOP is Slovenia’s leading motorcycle store and gear center located in Ljubljana. They offer everything a biker needs: premium riding gear (brands like IXS, REV’IT!, Alpinestars), technical accessories, and parts. The shop hosts regular test rides, and their staff provides expert advice on gear, bikes, and regional riding routes.

name: Harley-Davidson Ljubljana (US MOTO d.o.o.)
description: Harley‑Davidson Ljubljana is Slovenia’s first official Harley‑Davidson dealership, located in the Rudnik district of Ljubljana. See iconic American choppers and find branded apparel, accessories, and full service support. The venue exudes the spirit of freedom and adventure tied to Harley culture. A biker’s haven for fans of American motorcycle heritage.

name: Borderless Motocyclism (75th Anniversary Race)
description:
30–31 August 2025
This event commemorates the 75th anniversary of international motorcycle races in Nova Gorica and Gorizia. Highlights include vintage bike parades, exhibitions, and reenactment of historic race routes. Perfect for classic bike lovers and history buffs.

name: 8th International Biker Rally in Herceg Novi
description:
August 30 – September 1, 2025
On the Igalo Riviera, near Ušće Beach, bikers from across the Balkans will gather for the 8th International Biker Rally. The event features live rock music from bands across Montenegro, Bosnia, and Serbia, a seafront camping area, and the iconic biker parade on August 31. Hosted by MC Cruiser, the oldest and largest motorcycle club in Montenegro, this rally has become a true tradition in the Adriatic biker scene.

name: Balkan Rally
description:
07–14 September 2025
The Balkan Rally is a multi-country adventure from Budapest through Slovenia, Croatia, and Bosnia, ending in Dubrovnik. Riders face navigation challenges, cultural stops, and a grand finale parade. A continental event that brings bikers together.

name: MotoDays Festival 2025
description:
23-24 August 2025
MotoDays Festival is a two‑day motorsport event featuring EnduroCross and MotoCross races, a motorcycle parade through Râciu, and an outdoor party with bonfire and music. Open to both competitors and spectators.

name: Caffe bar MX
description: Caffe bar MX is a cozy spot for bikers and travelers to relax and meet in Croatia. Here you can enjoy delicious coffee, refreshing drinks, and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a perfect stop along your route to share experiences and make new friends. Caffe bar MX welcomes everyone who loves freedom and the open road!

name: Motostatus mehanika Boštjan Štravs s.p.
description:
MotoStatus is a professional motorcycle service in Slovenia, located at Gorenje Zabukovje 4 in Trebelno. The workshop offers specialized diagnostics using TEXA systems and services for motorcycles, scooters, and ATVs of various brands including BMW, Suzuki, Honda, and more.They perform extensive repairs—from fork and engine restorations to ultrasonic carburetor cleaning and power limiters installation .
The owner is a master auto mechanic with long-standing experience, and the service even provides motorcycle transport and a replacement vehicle when needed.

name: SMK - Iztok Mihelič s.p.
description: Motostatus mehanika SMK (Iztok Mihelič s.p.) is an authorized motorcycle service center in Ljubljana, located at Letališka cesta 29, specializing in Yamaha, Suzuki, Honda, and Kawasaki bikes. Customers appreciate the high professionalism, attentive service, and detail oriented care .

name: Čarman Motosport
description: Čarman Motosport is a leading motorcycle workshop located in Medvode, Slovenia, at Sora 5b. They specialize in suspension servicing, race bike preparation, repairs, tuning, and on-track support. The shop offers top brands of parts and tires, as well as tuning accessories to help perfect your bike. The workshop features Slovenia’s only dyno test bench for measuring rear-wheel power and torque, essential for evaluating tuning results.

name: DVTrade d.o.o. | Popravilo in obnova motorjev Maribor
description: DV Trade is a Slovenian service specializing in the sale and maintenance of motorcycles, including both used and new models. It offers a wide range of parts, accessories, and professional technical support for bikers. The service focuses on quality and reliability, making it a convenient stop for mototourists traveling through Slovenia. Additionally, visitors can receive expert advice on purchasing or repairing motorcycles.

name: MOTO SERVIS TOMI TOMAŽ STUBELJ S.P.
description: Moto Servis Tomi is a small but highly professional workshop located in Nova Gorica. Specialist Tomaz Stubelj (Tomi) handles BMW motorcycle repairs with meticulous precision, carefully inspecting bearings, chains, and bolts.

name: Isa Begov Hamam i Hotel
description:
Here at Isa Begov Hamam Hotel we offer you 500 years of history and the sweetest experience of turkish bath and massages. Throught the history the main building has seen many changes but the culture stood same.

Hotel Isa Begov Hamam offers accommodation in Sarajevo, with free use of saunas and hot tubs. The hotel has furniture with hand-carved Osman motifs, handmade carpets and wooden floors. Turkish breakfast is included in the price of accommodation. Free tea and coffee are available in the hotel lobby.
All rooms are air conditioned and come with a flat-screen satellite TV. Other rooms have a seating area, and some overlook mountains, a garden or a city. All rooms have a private bathroom equipped with a bath or shower, bathrobes, slippers and free beauty accessories.

Hammam use is free of charge while massage treatments can be booked at an extra charge. The hotel’s front desk is open 24 hours a day.
Hotel Isa Begov Hamam is located 100 metres from the Latin Cave and 1,000 feet from Bascarsia. Sarajevo Airport is 5.6 miles from the property. Airport shuttle can be arranged with prior request and compensation.
This is our guests’ favorite part of Sarajevo, based on our guests reviews.
Couples particularly liked the location – they rated it 9.7 for their stay.

We speak your language!

name: Hotel Boutique 36
description:
Hotel Boutique 36 is located in the center of the most historically inspiring part of Sarajevo - Baščaršija. With a modernist interior and a charming and intimate atmosphere, it provides its guests with complete comfort.

Hotel Boutique 36 consists of single and double rooms and studios with 3 and 4 beds. All rooms have a bathroom, cable TV, wireless internet and air conditioning.
The interior of the rooms follows modern design trends, and the rooms themselves are equipped with LCD TVs and books that make your stay in our hotel more meaningful.

name: Villa Basamak - Luxury aparthotel
description: Villa Basamak is a luxurious 4-star apart-hotel offering an unforgettable experience. A recently renovated aparthotel in Sarajevo and within 700 metres of Sebilj Fountain, VILLA BASAMAK has a garden, comfortable allergy-free rooms and free WiFi. The property features garden and city views, and is 700 metres from Bascarsija Street. Boasting family rooms, this property also provides guests with a sun terrace. All units at the aparthotel come with air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, a hair dryer and free toiletries. Guests can have fruits and chocolates or cookies delivered to their room. The units will provide guests with a desk and a kettle. Popular points of interest near the aparthotel include Latin bridge, Gazi Husrev-beg Mosque in Sarajevo and Eternal Flame in Sarajevo. The nearest airport is Sarajevo International, 10 km from VILLA BASAMAK, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

name: Hotel Aziza
description:
Feel at home in Hotel Aziza
At the heart of the oldest residential area of Sarajevo is located a cosy lodge where the guests can rest as if they were at their own home. Our Hotel Aziza is warmth, hospitality and family; which is what we want to give to our guests.

We want to be a home when you are far away from your loved ones, we want you to come as a stranger and leave as a friend.

name: Hotel Sahat
description: Located in the old town of Sarajevo, Hotel SAHAT really takes one back in time. Once you step out of the door of SAHAT, you can travel through time from the Otoman Period, followed by the Austrian Hungarian empire time, and end your journey with a Sarajevo of 21st century. The design is impeccably connecting modern art with traditional Bosnian craft ship. What is putting SAHAT forward on the hospitality scene in Sarajevo, is its BOLDNESS to shake up things and BE DIFFERENET.

name: Hotel Festival
description:
Hotel “Festival” is a blend of modern and traditional. Located near the old city center, on the left bank of the Miljacka River, between two historic bridges, “Čobanija” and “Principovo”.

The hotel is the work of architects who, with their many years of experience, creativity and knowledge, managed to incorporate it into the surrounding environment without changing its authenticity, while at the same time enriching the space with something new.

Twenty single, double and triple rooms are luxuriously furnished and designed in a combination of retro and minimalist style.

name: Hotel Sokak
description: A classic boutique hotel in the historic center of Sarajevo offers comfortable rooms and great rates. It is ideal for online reservation booking of weekend deals, business travel, holidays in Sarajevo, or last-minute accommodation in Sarajevo. Hotel Sokak is located in the historic center of Sarajevo, close to the Center. It offers rooms with flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms, and free Wi-Fi internet access.

name: ibis Styles Sarajevo
description:
ibis Styles Sarajevo is ideally located close to Sarajevo's Airport and the city centre. Stylish hotel with 181 rooms, spacious conference venues for up to 800 guests and a restaurant serving organic dishes, and non-alcoholic beverages carefully composed to energize you healthily. The unique decor emphasizes winter sports and Sarajevo with a harmonic mixture of modern and traditional elements, helping you to feel the vibrant pulse of the city.

ibis Styles Sarajevo does make the contrasts play ! Same way that Sarajevo does, a Balkan city where the East meets the West, chic young culture meshes the tradition. A city of scenic mountains and Winter Olympics. It's all there! Whatever the secret of Sarajevo's charm may be, it will capture you, and so will the ibis Styles Sarajevo! Come on, wouldn't you like to discover the secret?
Hotel is located close to Sarajevo's Airport (10 minutes drive) and the city center.

ibis Styles Sarajevo is a passage to Sarajevo through a vibrant mixture of designs. Experience the unique melting pot of designs combined with the simplicity that will make you feel relaxed. Welcome!

name: Koncept Residence Hotel
description: Hotel Koncept Residence offers you a pleasant stay in our modern rooms or apartments. Enjoy a rich, complimentary breakfast, prepared by our friendly and professional kitchen staff. For your business or private accommodation needs, our professional and, above all, experienced staff is at your disposal.

name: Hotel Ideja
description: Hotel “Ideja” is located in the center of Banja Luka in the old part of the city, popularly called “Hanište”. This, once a craftsman’s part of the city, still preserves the spirit of the past. The hotel is ideally located for those who want to explore Banja Luka or complete their business obligations as quickly and easily as possible. The hotel was opened in 2004 and since then has been a favorite address for many guests who came to Banja Luka from all over the world.

name: Hotel Integra Banja Luka
description:
Hotel Integra 4 is located in the immediate vicinity of the city center in the most beautiful alley of Banja Luka. Its position allows easy access to all significant locations and attractions in the city.

We offer our guests a pleasant, quiet and comfortable environment. We have 67 modernly equipped rooms that guarantee a high level of comfort.

Depending on the requests and needs of our guests, we offer 16 Standard double rooms, 25 Premium double rooms, 8 Superior double rooms, 4 Deluxe double rooms, as well as 14 rooms for 3 people.

All rooms in the hotel provide a unique atmosphere, a view of our beautiful garden and the city itself, which is characterized by a lot of greenery. The interior of the rooms is decorated with soothing - neutral tones in a luxurious atmosphere. We care about all our guests, so we have provided unhindered access to the hotel and restaurants for people with disabilities, while we have provided pet-friendly rooms for pet lovers.

name: Hotel Bohemian Garni
description: Hotel Bohemian Garni is an elegant hotel located in the center of Belgrade, perfect for both tourists and business travelers. Its modern, comfortable rooms, stylish interior, and top-notch service create an atmosphere of comfort and tranquility. The hotel offers all the essential amenities for a pleasant stay, including a restaurant with a diverse menu. It is an ideal place for those looking for a combination of quality and comfort in the heart of the city.

name: Hyatt Regency Belgrade
description: Hyatt Regency Belgrade is a luxurious hotel located in a scenic area on the banks of the Sava River. With modern rooms, excellent service, and numerous amenities including a spa center and restaurants, it provides a comfortable stay for every traveler. Ideal for both business meetings and family vacations, the hotel offers unique conditions for an unforgettable stay in Belgrade. Major city attractions are within walking distance.

name: MotoCamp Serbia
description: MotoCamp Serbia is a unique campsite located in the picturesque village of Martinci in Vojvodina, specifically designed for motorcyclists. It offers secure garages, camping, bungalows, and self-contained apartments, as well as basic kitchens, drinks, and food. A great place to relax and socialize among like-minded individuals.

name: Hotel "Metropol Palace"
description: Metropol Palace in Belgrade is a luxurious five-star hotel that combines historical charm with modern comfort. Its prime location in the city center offers easy access to major attractions like the Saint Sava Temple and the National Theatre. The hotel features first-class amenities, including a spa, fitness center, restaurant, and a panoramic rooftop bar. It's the perfect place for those who value luxury and exceptional service.

name: Balkan Soul Hostel
description: Balkan Soul Hostel is a cozy and friendly hostel located in the historic district of Kosančićev Venac in the heart of Belgrade. Guests are offered modern rooms with comfortable beds, spacious lockers, and individual reading lights. Special attention is given to the social atmosphere: the "Soul Room" hosts parties, cooking workshops, and movie screenings, fostering interaction and meeting other travelers. The hostel is perfect for those seeking a comfortable and affordable place to get to know Belgrade.

name: Hotel Amsterdam
description: Hotel Amsterdam Garni is a cozy city hotel with modern rooms and a warm, welcoming vibe. Start your day with a delicious breakfast before heading out to nearby streets and landmarks. Fast Wi-Fi, attentive staff, and a convenient location make it a smart choice for weekend breaks and short stays. Great for couples and solo travelers alike.

name: Feel Belgrade Apartments
description: Feel Belgrade Apartments are stylish serviced apartments in the heart of Belgrade, perfect for both short breaks and longer stays. Spacious studios and apartments feature fully equipped kitchens, comfortable living areas, and fast Wi-Fi. Step outside to find major sights, charming cafés, and vibrant nightlife within easy reach. Friendly staff and thoughtful amenities ensure a smooth, comfortable stay.

name: Side One Design Hotel Garni
description: Side One Design Hotel Garni is a modern riverside hotel set on the Danube Promenade in Belgrade’s Zemun district. Contemporary rooms, daily breakfast, and complimentary Wi-Fi make it ideal for both city breaks and business stays. The location offers easy access to the city center and Zemun’s charming waterfront. Friendly staff and comfortable common areas complete a relaxed, design-forward stay.

name: Hotel Vozarev
description: Hotel Vozarev is a cozy garni hotel with modern rooms and a calm, welcoming vibe. Comfortable beds, practical workspaces, and fast Wi-Fi make it a smart choice for both leisure and business stays. A tasty breakfast sets you up for the day, and the convenient location offers easy access to key sights and business areas. Friendly staff are happy to share local tips and help with arrangements.

name: Hotel M Belgrade
description: Hotel M Belgrade is a modern hotel in a quiet part of the city, ideal for both leisure and business stays. Bright rooms with comfy beds, workspaces, and fast Wi-Fi keep you relaxed and productive. A generous breakfast, on-site parking, and warm service add to the ease of your visit. Quick access to the city center and the airport makes it a practical base for weekends and business trips.

name: Hilton Belgrade
description: Hilton Belgrade is a contemporary city-center hotel, steps from major sights and lively avenues. Spacious rooms, thoughtful amenities, and polished service ensure a relaxing stay for both leisure and business travelers. Guests can enjoy generous breakfasts, stylish bars and a restaurant, plus a wellness area with a gym. Flexible meeting spaces and easy city connections make it a smart, convenient base.

name: Maccani Luxury Suites
description: Maccani Luxury Suites offers elegant boutique-style apartments in the very heart of Belgrade. Spacious suites with thoughtful amenities, stylish interiors, and fast Wi-Fi provide a private, comfortable stay. Major streets, museums, and charming cafés are all within easy reach. The friendly team is happy to share local tips and help with travel arrangements.

name: Hotel Capital
description: Hotel Capital is an elegant boutique hotel set in the very heart of Belgrade. Bright, well-appointed rooms with comfy beds and fast Wi-Fi ensure a relaxing stay. Enjoy a tasty breakfast, then step outside to shops, cafés, and major city sights. A smart choice for both romantic getaways and business travel.

name: Dominic Smart Luxury Suites - Terazije
description: Dominic Smart Luxury Suites – Terazije is a boutique stay set right in Belgrade’s center, on the iconic Terazije square. Stylish, well-appointed suites with modern amenities and fast Wi-Fi work equally well for short breaks or longer stays. Knez Mihailova Street and Republic Square are an easy walk away, with cafés, theaters, and shops all around. Friendly staff and a calm, elegant setting make it a convenient base for exploring the city.

name: Hotel Garden
description: Hotel Garden is a cozy city hotel in Serbia with a calm atmosphere and modern rooms. A satisfying breakfast and fast Wi-Fi set you up for the day. Its convenient location puts key sights and cafés within easy reach. The friendly team is ready with local tips and helpful arrangements.

name: Hostel Novi Sad
description: Hostel Novi Sad is a friendly, budget-wise base within easy reach of the Old Town. Guests can choose clean dorms or private rooms, with secure lockers and reliable Wi-Fi. A shared kitchen and a cozy lounge make it easy to meet fellow travelers. Handy access to the train and bus stations, the Danube riverfront, and Petrovaradin Fortress.

name: HOTEL DASH
description: HOTEL DASH is a modern 4-star garni hotel located near Novi Sad’s city center. Expect bright rooms with free Wi-Fi and parking, plus a wellness area featuring an indoor pool and sauna. The property is pet-friendly and works equally well for city breaks and business stays.

name: Hotel ELEMENT Novi Sad
description: Hotel ELEMENT Novi Sad is a contemporary base with a convenient location for both sightseeing and business. Bright, well-designed rooms with comfy beds and fast Wi-Fi keep you relaxed and productive. Start the day with a tasty breakfast, and count on the friendly team for local tips and trip assistance. A smart choice for weekend breaks, events, and business travel.

name: Garni Hotel AMI
description: Garni Hotel AMI is a modern city hotel with cozy rooms and a calm, welcoming vibe. Daily breakfast, fast Wi-Fi, and attentive staff make for an easy, comfortable stay—whether you’re here for a weekend or on business. Its convenient location puts major sights and business areas within easy reach. A smart choice for travelers who value comfort and practicality.

name: CORSO ROOMS
description: CORSO ROOMS is a stylish city base within easy reach of major sights and lively streets. Contemporary, comfortable rooms with reliable Wi-Fi work well for both short stays and longer visits. Cafés, shops, and public transport are close by. Friendly staff are on hand with local tips to help you make the most of your time.

name: Hotel Arhiv
description: Hotel Arhiv is a boutique stay in the very heart of Novi Sad, just a short walk from Danube Park and the Museum of Vojvodina. Comfortable rooms and free Wi-Fi keep you at ease, while breakfast is served in the on-site restaurant. Its central location makes it a perfect base for exploring the city’s pedestrian streets and riverfront.

name: Hostel Klara
description: Hostel Klara is a friendly, budget-wise hostel with a warm, welcoming vibe. Choose from clean dorms or private rooms, with personal lockers and reliable Wi-Fi. A shared kitchen and a cozy lounge make it easy to meet fellow travelers. Its convenient location puts cafés, public transport, and the city center within easy reach.

name: Tourist resort Ribarsko ostrvo
description: Tourist Resort Ribarsko Ostrvo is a leafy riverside retreat on the Danube in Novi Sad, just a short drive from the city center. Guests stay in cozy Dunavske kolibe bungalows and modern rooms. On-site dining includes Alaska barka, Alaska terasa, and Ribarac—perfect for meals with river views. Free Wi-Fi and the tranquil promenade make it an easygoing base for a relaxing stay.

name: Hotel Cider&Squash
description: Hotel Cider&Squash is a cozy countryside stay in Prnjavor (Batočina), right in the heart of Serbia. Guests enjoy an indoor pool, sauna, spa, and a fitness area, plus a squash court and table tennis for active fun. There’s an on-site restaurant and complimentary bicycles for exploring nearby lanes. A great pick for families and for convenient stopovers.

name: F Apartmani Kragujevac - Luxuary Business Suites
description: F Apartmani Kragujevac – Luxuary Business Suites offers contemporary apartments designed for both business and leisure stays in Kragujevac. Spacious studios and suites with dedicated work areas and high-speed Wi-Fi suit short visits and extended stays alike. Each unit includes a kitchenette and all the essentials for a comfortable stay. Its convenient location keeps you close to the city’s key business venues and cultural highlights.

name: Hotel Industrial
description: Hotel Industrial is a stylish, industrial-inspired hotel that blends modern design with comfort and functionality. Bright, well-planned rooms suit both business and leisure stays. Its convenient location and attentive service make travel feel effortless. A smart choice for travelers who appreciate contemporary design and a calm ambiance.

name: Filips Sleep
description: Filips Sleep offers comfortable, modern apartments with a calm, restful vibe. Quality beds and fast Wi-Fi set you up for a great night’s sleep and a productive day. Its convenient location puts you close to key sights and business areas. A smart choice for both short city breaks and extended stays.

name: Rubicon Hotel
description: Rubicon Hotel is a modern city hotel with a warm, welcoming vibe. Bright, well-designed rooms and comfortable beds ensure a restful stay. A daily breakfast and fast Wi-Fi set you up for a productive day. Its convenient location keeps you close to key sights and business venues.

name: Harizma apartmani - Astera
description: Harizma Apartmani – Astera offers modern apartments with a warm, home-like feel. Clean lines, comfortable beds, and thoughtful touches make it ideal for both work and leisure. Each unit features the essentials for short or extended stays, including a kitchenette and reliable Wi-Fi. Its convenient location keeps you close to the city’s main attractions and business spots.

name: Hotel Beograd
description: Hotel Beograd is a classic city hotel in Serbia that blends traditional hospitality with modern comfort. Bright, comfortable rooms and reliable high-speed Wi-Fi make it easy to relax or get work done. Its convenient location keeps you close to major sights and business districts. A smart choice for both short stays and extended visits.

name: PRESIDENT APARTMENTS
description: PRESIDENT APARTMENTS offers elegant, private-feel suites with confident, modern style. Thoughtfully designed spaces work for both short city breaks and extended stays. Its convenient location puts cafés, museums, and business spots within easy reach. A refined base for travelers who appreciate quiet elegance and warm hospitality.

name: Centrum Sobe Rooms Čačak
description: Centrum is a welcoming stay right in the city’s heart. Museums, parks, and charming cafés are just a short stroll away, making each day easy to plan. Inside, a calm aesthetic meets genuine Serbian hospitality. The perfect base for walks, meet-ups, and memorable discoveries.

name: Hotel Crni Vrh
description: Hotel Crni Vrh is a mountain retreat where fresh air and an easy pace make every season special. Start your mornings on scenic trails, enjoy nearby slopes in winter, and spend your days hiking, cycling, and tasting local flavors. Evenings settle into a warm, laid-back vibe amid pine-scented calm. The perfect base for both romantic getaways and active adventures.

name: Maglian Campus co-living co-working
description: Maglian Campus is a modern co-living & co-working hub that makes blending work and life effortless. Bright shared spaces, a green courtyard, and regular community events help you plug in fast. Thoughtful amenities—from quiet work nooks to a lecture space and communal kitchens—create a true home-away-from-home. A perfect base for digital nomads, startup teams, and anyone who values real connection.

name: Hotel Royal Mountain
description: Hotel Royal Mountain is a serene mountain retreat for nature lovers. Mornings bring ridge-line views and trail walks; in winter, snowy adventures are close at hand. Days are for exploring the surroundings at your own pace. Evenings settle into a cozy ambiance and regional flavors—perfect for romantic getaways and family breaks.

name: Hotel Heba
description: Hotel Heba is a cozy retreat in the heart of the Divčibare mountains, surrounded by pine forests and snowy slopes. Warm hospitality, a welcoming atmosphere, and delicious home-style meals come with views you’ll never forget. Hiking trails and ski slopes are just moments away. The perfect choice for family holidays, romantic weekends, and nature-filled escapes.

name: Etno selo Gostoljublje selo Mionica Kosjerić
description: Etno-village Gostoljublje is set on the scenic slopes of Mt. Maljen in the village of Mionica, at an elevation of around 600 m, blending traditional architecture with natural serenity. Guests praise the warm hospitality, cozy wooden cottages, and delicious homemade cuisine — everything here feels like home. Facilities include a swimming pool, an authentic restaurant, and a variety of activities, from hiking and cycling to winter skiing. A perfect choice for those seeking to escape city life and immerse themselves in tradition and comfort.

name: Zlatiborski Pastuv
description: Zlatiborski Pastuv is a cozy guest house and restaurant located in the Farma settlement, near Zlatibor’s tourist center but nestled in a peaceful, natural setting.Guests can savor traditional Serbian dishes—such as veal under sač, “svadbarski kupus”, kajmak, proja, and the famous Zlatibor “komplet lepinja”—cooked over an open fire and served in a rustic interior of wood and stone with a spacious terrace.The guest house offers comfortable accommodation amenities including cozy rooms, a restaurant, bar, free Wi‑Fi, and free parking.Nature lovers and active travelers will appreciate the on-site mini zoo and stable, where they can enjoy horseback riding and stroll through the ranch .

name: Grand&Sky Hotel Tornik
description:
Grand & Sky Hotel Tornik is a new five-star hotel in the Zlatibor resort area, nestled in a peaceful hillside setting at around 1010 m above sea level.
It offers a variety of rooms and suites, a luxurious spa center featuring two indoor pools, saunas, hammam, massage rooms, and a rotating restaurant with panoramic mountain views. Conveniently located just 600–900 m from Zlatibor center and adjacent to the base station of the world’s longest panoramic gondola, it's an ideal base for both relaxation and outdoor adventures.

name: Queen of Zlatibor apart hotel & SPA
description:
Queen of Zlatibor Aparthotel & SPA is a contemporary and elegant aparthotel nestled at the foot of Zlatibor in a tranquil mountain setting, just 700–900 m from the town center. It features 152 diverse apartments—King, duplex, superior and classic—each equipped with a kitchenette, comfortable sleeping spaces, and scenic mountain views. Guests can unwind in the spa facilities, including a Turkish bath/hammam, sauna, fitness centre, indoor pool, and children’s pool, plus enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast.
Reviewers consistently praise the friendly service, superb breakfast, and exceptional comfort throughout their stay.

name: Hotel Olimp Zlatibor
description:
Hotel Olimp is a four-star hotel located at the entrance to Zlatibor resort, just a short walk from the town center and the scenic lake.
It offers spacious, comfortable rooms, restaurants serving both Serbian and international cuisine, and a terrace bar. Guests can enjoy the outdoor pool, modern fitness center, spa area, and conference facilities.
The hotel is an ideal choice for both leisure travelers and business events.

name: Mona Plaza Zlatibor
description:
Mona Plaza Zlatibor is a luxury, family-friendly hotel located centrally in Zlatibor, just steps from the lake and Gold Gondola.
Guests can enjoy amenities such as an indoor pool, children’s pool, sauna, full-service spa, and a kids’ playroom — perfect for families. The hotel features two restaurants and three cafés serving both international and Serbian cuisine, and a rooftop terrace offering scenic views.

name: Zlatiborske Terase
description:
Zlatiborske Terase Spa & Wellness is a modern aparthotel situated about 1 km from central Zlatibor, nestled amid serene natural surroundings.
It offers 125 stylish apartments with fully equipped kitchens, terraces or balconies, a living area, and private bathrooms.
Guests can enjoy an on-site spa center featuring a sauna, steam room, hot tub, and indoor pool, perfect for ultimate relaxation.

name: 21st Century Zlatibor Residence, Spa & Wellness by Adora
description:
21st Century Zlatibor Residence, Spa & Wellness by Adora is a modern aparthotel located in the heart of Zlatibor, nestled in a pine forest just minutes from the main attractions .
The complex features 107 apartments sized from 34 to 105 m², including stylish penthouses with terraces, kitchenettes, and boutique amenities—combining apartment living with hotel services . Enjoy exceptional facilities including a spa center with sauna, hammam, hot tub, fitness room, and an indoor pool, alongside an on-site restaurant, bar, kids' playroom, 24-hour reception, concierge, and parking garage .

name: Agape Zlatibor
description: Hotel Agape is a cozy, family-friendly hotel located at the entrance of Zlatibor, just a short walk from the town center and its scenic surroundings. Guests can enjoy the on-site spa center with indoor pool and sauna, while children have fun in the playroom — making it an excellent pick for family stays. Amenities include a restaurant, bar, terrace, and well-appointed, clean rooms complemented by warm and attentive service.

name: Mövenpick resort Fruske Terme
description: Mövenpick Resort & Spa Fruske Terme is a stylish family-friendly spa resort nestled on the sunny slopes of Fruška Gora National Park, located about an hour from Belgrade and close to Novi Sad. The resort features an impressive spa complex — 11 thermal pools filled with healing mineral water (both indoor and outdoor), along with a rich selection of saunas and steam rooms — the largest spa center in Serbia. Guests enjoy 201 spacious rooms and suites with private balconies, plus on-site dining, bars, fitness facilities, and extensive meeting and conference spaces.

name: Hotel Norcev
description: Hotel Norcev is a charming three-star hotel nestled in the heart of Fruška Gora, surrounded by nature—perfect for hiking and relaxation. Guests enjoy the on-site spa with sauna and indoor pool, a fitness center, restaurant, bar, and complimentary private parking. Rooms are air-conditioned and comfortable, including family rooms and apartments, with warm and attentive service.

name: Etno selo Vrdnička kula
description:
Etno Selo Vrdnička Kula is an ethno-complex nestled in a secluded natural area, right at the border of Fruška Gora National Park.
Guests stay in charming ethno-bungalows and apartments, crafted from natural materials and blending seamlessly into the forest environment, offering peace and sensory relaxation. The on-site restaurant serves traditional Serbian cuisine and features a wine cellar, allowing visitors to enjoy authentic local flavors while dining on the terrace overlooking scenic surroundings. The complex includes amenities such as indoor and outdoor pools, spa services, children’s playgrounds, and game rooms — making it perfect for family retreats or cultural immersion alike.

name: Vila Slap
description:
Vila Slap is a contemporary aparthotel located in the heart of Vrdnik, nestled at the base of Fruška Gora — perfect for romantic getaways or outdoor adventures.
Spacious studios and rooms are well‑appointed with modern furnishings, air conditioning, private bathrooms, kitchenettes, terraces or balconies, along with complimentary Wi‑Fi and parking.Additional amenities include an on‑site bar and café, free bicycles, and assistance with exploring local hiking and cycling routes.

name: KAMP-US Fruška gora
description: KAMP-US Fruška Gora is a small, atmospheric campsite located in a natural area near Vrdnik, in the heart of Fruška Gora. Guests can rent cozy Viking-style tents for two, complete with mattresses, pillows, and bed linen, or bring and set up their own tents. The campsite features barbecue areas, cooking pots, and outdoor tables and benches, making it ideal for both short stays and longer getaways. A unique highlight is the open-air cinema under the stars, with weekend film screenings chosen by the site’s Instagram followers.

name: Park Hotel
description:
Garni Hotel Park is a charming turn-of-the-century hotel located in a park setting by Lake Palic, offering a tranquil natural getaway.
The rooms are clean and cozy, well-equipped with air conditioning, flat-screen TV, and private bathrooms — providing a comfortable stay.
The hotel includes free Wi‑Fi, on-site parking, two restaurants, a bar, and convenient room delivery service for food and beverages.

name: Camping Palić
description: Camping Palić is a charming campsite located by the scenic Lake Palić, surrounded by nature and close to regional cultural attractions. The site offers spaces for tents and campers, equipped barbecue and picnic areas, as well as expansive green lawns for quiet relaxation in fresh air. Guests have access to facilities such as showers, toilets, and electrical hookups, ensuring a comfortable and convenient stay for both families and solo travelers. It's an ideal base for nature lovers, fishing enthusiasts, and cyclists, offering a perfect blend of lakeside tranquility and outdoor activities.

name: Hotel Palić Resort
description: Garni Hotel Palić Resort is a cozy hotel nestled within a century-old park in the heart of Palić, just steps from the lake and zoo. Modern and comfortable rooms are equipped with LCD TVs, mini-bars, air conditioning, and private balconies, offering privacy and comfort. Guests have access to an indoor swimming pool, fitness center, free Wi‑Fi, secure video-monitored parking, and spa amenities including sauna, Turkish bath, jacuzzi, and fitness facilities.

name: Camp Kalinovac
description:
Camp Kalinovac is a charming small campsite opened in 2018, situated right on the shores of Silver Lake and the Danube, along the EuroVelo 6 and 13 routes.
The campsite features spotless showers and toilets, a fully equipped communal kitchen, outdoor seating, and reliable Wi‑Fi — everything needed for a comfortable camping experience.
Hosts are exceptionally welcoming, often greeting guests with homemade liqueur and a friendly chat, making the place feel like a cozy retreat.
It's an excellent stopover for cyclists and nature lovers seeking tranquility with scenic views of the lake and Carpathians, right at the water's edge.

name: Danubia Park Hotel
description:
Danubia Park Hotel is a modern 3-star hotel situated right on the shores of Silver Lake, just a few minutes’ walk from the Danube and the heart of the resort area.
Guests can enjoy excellent wellness facilities including an indoor pool, sauna, fitness center, and spa with hydromassage and relaxation areas — ideal for both leisure and wellness breaks.

name: Hotel Park Vrnjačka Banja
description:
Hotel Park is a luxurious five-star hotel situated on the main promenade in the heart of Vrnjačka Banja, showcasing elegant architecture with a rustic charm.
It offers modern, spacious rooms equipped with air conditioning, mini-bars, and free Wi-Fi, along with 24-hour reception, an on-site restaurant, and room service.
Located just a 4–5-minute walk from the famed Bridge of Love and surrounded by healing spa parks, the hotel features a wellness area with an indoor pool, sauna, fitness center, and spa treatments.

name: Vila Emilia
description:
Vila Emilia is an elegant 4-star villa located on the main pedestrian promenade of Vrnjačka Banja, just steps from the iconic “Bridge of Love.”
It offers modern, spacious rooms equipped with air conditioning, mini-bars, free Wi-Fi, and private parking. The property features a cozy spa center with a jacuzzi, sauna, and hammam, as well as a pool and the on-site “Bistro Luka” restaurant serving local and international cuisine.

name: Villa Splendor
description:
Villa Splendor is a modern aparthotel ideally situated near the central park, the iconic Bridge of Love, and the Fons Romanus wellness center.
The property offers a variety of accommodations: studios, classic, and lux apartments, most of which have separate bedrooms; some include a balcony or terrace.
Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi, video-monitored private parking, and spa amenities such as two saunas (Finnish and infrared), a salt room, aroma showers, and a dedicated massage studio.

name: Winery and Pools Grabak
description:
Winery & Pools Grabak is a distinctive wine-and-leisure complex perched on the sunny hills of Vrnjačka Banja—just 700 m from the town center—nestled within hornbeam forest and green surroundings. The venue offers premium wine tastings, charming log cabins, a tennis court, beach volleyball court, and three swimming pools, including one designed especially for children.
Guests can enjoy refreshing swims under natural shade, wine on a terrace, and peaceful relaxation within a countryside retreat. With attentive service, scenic beauty, and top-notch amenities, it's an ideal destination for rest, romantic getaways, or outdoor celebrations.

name: Hotel Bela Jela
description: Hotel Bela Jela is a modern four-star spa hotel located at an altitude of around 680 meters in the picturesque Lukovska Banja, Serbia’s highest spa resort. The hotel offers 85 comfortable rooms, 8 apartments, and 2 luxury suites. Facilities include a medical center providing therapeutic treatments, both indoor and outdoor thermal pools, and a spacious spa area with a Finnish sauna, bio-sauna, steam room, salt room, and tepidarium. For active guests, there is a fitness center, sports courts, a tennis court, and a forest walking trail, while leisure options include a restaurant, wellness bar, lobby bar, children’s playroom, and an evening entertainment hall.

name: Hotel Jelak
description: Hotel Jelak is a cozy 3-star hotel in Lukovska Banja, nestled at an elevation of about 680 m in central Serbia amid forests and thermal springs. It offers 64 comfortable rooms and apartments with mountain or river views, equipped with minibars, Wi-Fi, TVs, and balconies. . Visitors consistently praise the high level of service, excellent location, cleanliness, and the well-rounded blend of relaxation, sport, and wellness.

name: Etno Kuca Stanojevic
description: Etno Kuća Stanojević is a charming ethno-house complex located in the pastoral surroundings of Boljevac, overlooking the majestic Rtanj Mountain. The property consists of traditional-style cottages and apartments encircled by a garden, an outdoor swimming pool, and an open-air museum of historic tools and artifacts. Each unit offers cozy accommodations—complete with kitchenette, bathroom, and scenic views—alongside facilities such as outdoor seating areas, a barbecue space, and children’s playground.

name: Eco ethno village Vranesa
description: Etno Eco Village Vranesa is an eco-conscious ethno-complex nestled in a secluded pine forest by Lake Uvac at approximately 943 m elevation, surrounded by the pristine nature of Zlatar. The four-story central building houses a restaurant, reception, ethno-shop, and a spacious 400 m² banquet hall. The third and fourth floors offer eight exclusive apartments and a glass duplex suite with a jacuzzi and lake views. Around the complex are five comfortable 40 m² bungalows featuring two bedrooms and fireplaces. Guests also enjoy an ethno-wellness area that includes a swimming pool, and the on-site restaurant serves traditional specialties such as veal under sač, regional cheeses, and kaymak. This is an ideal destination for peaceful retreats, family or romantic getaways—a harmonious blend of nature, comfort, and cultural ambiance.

name: European Bike Week 2025 #BackToTheRoads
description:
September 2–7, 2025, Lake Faak, Austria. European Bike Week is Europe’s largest motorcycle rally.
Thousands of fans will gather to experience the latest Harley-Davidson models, enjoy demo rides, a custom bike show, live music, and the legendary parade. With free admission, it’s a thrilling celebration of moto-culture set against the stunning backdrop of the Alps.

name: Hotel EMERALD - Mostar
description: Hotel Emerald Mostar is a modern 4-star hotel ideally located in the Bišće Polje area, just minutes from Mostar’s Old Town and the iconic Old Bridge. The property features 14 elegantly appointed rooms equipped with air conditioning, soundproofing, minibars, safes, work desks, free Wi-Fi, and blackout curtains. Guests enjoy on-site amenities such as a restaurant, café-bar, buffet breakfast, 24-hour front desk, a mini-market, and secure private parking with video surveillance and garage access. Additional services include concierge, car rental, and airport shuttle. Guests consistently praise the hotel for its cleanliness, attentive staff, and exceptional comfort.

name: HOTEL OASIS
description: Hotel Oasis is a cozy 3-star hotel situated in the Bišće Polje area of Mostar, just a 5-minute drive from the Old Town and the iconic Old Bridge. The hotel features 23 bright rooms equipped with air conditioning, private bathrooms, TVs, and comfortable seating areas; some rooms have pitched ceilings, and all offer free Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a hearty breakfast with local specialties and rich Turkish coffee in the restaurant, followed by a beverage on the terrace overlooking the city and surrounding hills. The hotel also provides free parking, airport shuttle service, concierge assistance, and car rental, adding to its convenience.

name: Hotel Carpe Diem Mostar
description: Hotel Carpe Diem Mostar is a modern 4-star urban hotel situated in the Bišće Polje district, just a short distance from the iconic Old Bridge. The property offers 18 stylish rooms equipped with air conditioning, minibar, safe, flat-screen TV, desk, and private bathrooms — perfect for couples, families, and travelers. Mornings begin with a delicious buffet breakfast featuring local specialties, followed by relaxation in the café-bar or on the cozy terrace. Guests enjoy complimentary secure parking, free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception, laundry service, and convenient airport shuttle.

name: HA Hotel
description: Welcome to HA Hotel Mostar — a modern 4-star hotel ideally located in the southern part of the city, just a 3-minute drive from the airport and a short 5-10 minute ride from the Old Bridge. We offer 37 tastefully designed rooms and suites featuring air-conditioning, workspaces, minibars, soundproofing, and heated floors. Stay connected with reliable Wi-Fi, unwind in our indoor pool with sun loungers, and stay active in the on-site fitness center. Enjoy conveniences such as secure free parking, 24-hour reception, laundry services, a conference room, and concierge assistance. Begin your day with a sumptuous buffet breakfast offering international and Bosnian dishes, and later visit our restaurant and bar to relax with a drink. Visit us for attentive service, comfort, and the perfect blend of relaxation and accessibility.

name: Muslibegovic House
description: Welcome to Muslibegović House, a unique hotel-museum located in the heart of historic Mostar, just a few minutes' walk from the Old Bridge. This exquisite example of 18th-century Ottoman architecture was once the noble residence of the Muslibegović family and now offers twelve elegantly appointed rooms where antique furnishings, ornate ceilings, and museum-quality pieces blend seamlessly with modern comforts — including air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and en-suite bathrooms. Mornings begin with a continental breakfast served in the charming courtyard adorned with roses and palm trees. Guests can also enjoy the on-site café-bar and are treated to a complimentary guided tour of the house-museum, offering insights into the family’s legacy and architectural details.

name: Hostel Dada
description: Welcome to Hostel Dada Mostar — the perfect choice for motorcyclists and bike-friendly travelers. Located just an 8-minute walk from the Old Bridge and Bus/Train Station in historic Mostar, we offer secure garage storage for motorcycles and bicycles, free Wi-Fi throughout the property, bike rental services, and curated walking tours. Guests can enjoy warm hospitality, a home-cooked breakfast, a shared garden lounge, and outdoor barbecue facilities.

name: Hotel Bristol
description: Welcome to Hotel Bristol Mostar — a perfect haven for travelers on motorcycles. Nestled on the right bank of the Neretva River, in the heart of Mostar, it's just a 15–20 minute leisurely walk to the Old Bridge and key landmarks. We offer spacious, spotless rooms equipped with air conditioning, minibar, Wi‑Fi, and river views. For guest convenience, free parking is provided, and motorcyclists will be especially pleased to know that motorcycles can be parked free of charge right at the hotel. Begin your day with a delicious buffet breakfast on the terrace overlooking the river, and unwind in the evening at our restaurant or café‑bar. Excellent location, attentive staff, and thoughtful facilities make us a favorite among both tourists and motorcyclists alike.

name: Hostel Miran Mostar
description: Welcome to Hostel Miran Mostar, a true haven for motorcyclists and two-wheel travelers. Located centrally—just minutes from the Old Bridge and the train/bus station—our hostel provides easy access to all of Mostar’s key sites. Secure parking is available on-site for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. Amenities include free Wi‑Fi, a friendly outdoor lounge, shared kitchen, laundry facilities, hot showers, and 24-hour security.

name: EDEN Hotel & Spa
description: Welcome to Hotel Eden & Spa Mostar — your oasis of comfort and relaxation in the heart of Mostar. We offer a convenient location near the Old Town, cozy rooms with air-conditioning, free Wi‑Fi, and scenic views. For motorcyclists, we provide secure free parking, including valet services with on-site surveillance. After a day on the road, unwind in our updated spa area featuring an indoor pool, saunas, and massage treatments, or dine in our elegant restaurant offering a variety of buffet and à‑la‑carte options. We accept cashless payments (Visa, Maestro, MasterCard), and can assist with airport transfers, car rentals, and curated biker routes. Above all, we offer a warm, stylish environment and a service that truly understands the traveler’s pace.

name: Villa Anri
description: Welcome to Villa Anri Mostar, a charming guesthouse nestled in the heart of Mostar—making it an excellent choice for motorcyclists. We provide free secure parking under video surveillance for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles right at the doorstep. All rooms come equipped with air conditioning, Wi‑Fi, and TVs; many feature balconies or terraces offering views of the Old Bridge and the Neretva River. Your mornings start with an exceptional breakfast—including homemade Bosnian coffee—served in our cozy garden or terrace.

name: OLIVE Hotel & Spa
description: Welcome to Hotel Olive & Spa Mostar, a modern 4-star spa hotel located just a 15-minute walk from the iconic Old Bridge. We've made life easier for bikers by offering free private parking, including EV charging facilities right on-site. Guests enjoy elegant, air-conditioned rooms equipped with free Wi‑Fi and a serene atmosphere. Start your day with a hearty buffet breakfast, then unwind in our central spa facilities — featuring an indoor pool, sauna, jacuzzi, and wellness treatments. Additional amenities include a restaurant, bar, terrace, and airport transfer services. Comfort, tranquility, and security — precisely what every rider deserves after a long ride.

name: Hotel Mepas
description: Hotel Mepas is your urban spa retreat and an excellent choice for motorcyclists. Located atop the Mepas Mall and just a ten-minute walk from the Old Town, it offers secure, free underground garage parking with direct hotel access — perfect for unloading gear with ease. Our spacious, modern rooms feature air conditioning, minibars, free Wi-Fi, and a welcome drink upon arrival. After a long ride, unwind in our spa with an indoor pool, sauna, fitness center, and massage services — all under one roof. With our prime location, attentive staff, and biker-friendly facilities, Hotel Mepas delivers the comfort, safety, and convenience you seek.

name: City Hotel Mostar
description: Welcome to City Hotel Mostar — the perfect base for motorcyclists in the heart of the city. We offer free private parking, including a secure, video-monitored garage with dedicated motorcycle parking, ensuring your ride is safely housed. Our modern, cozy rooms come with air-conditioning and complimentary Wi‑Fi, all within walking distance of the iconic Old Bridge. Start your day with a hearty buffet breakfast, and our friendly team is always ready to suggest scenic rides and local routes. Convenience, comfort, and security — everything you need after a long day on the road.

name: Motel Monte Rosa
description: Welcome to Motel Monte Rosa, the perfect stopover for bikers, located just steps from the iconic Old Bridge. We offer free secure parking, including a covered, video-monitored area to ensure your motorcycle stays safe. Our rooms feature air conditioning, minibars, workspaces, and complimentary Wi‑Fi— everything you need after a long ride. Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and relax later at our restaurant and bar on the terrace with scenic views. With high ratings for service, location, and comfort, Motel Monte Rosa is a trusted choice for two-wheeled travelers.

name: Herceg Etno Selo Medugorje
description: Herceg Etno Selo Međugorje is a charming ethno-complex set in scenic surroundings, just 3 km from the center of Medjugorje.
