Riders will appreciate the free on-site parking right at the property, ideal for safely storing their bikes. After the ride, unwind by the seasonal outdoor pool, enjoy authentic meals in the traditional restaurant, catch an outdoor show in the amphitheater, or wander along eco-trails. The cozy, ethnically-styled rooms feature air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and mostly mountain-view vistas. With its convenient location, rich infrastructure, and authentic ambiance, it’s the perfect base for motorcyclists exploring the region.

name: Hotel Grande Casa
description: Hotel Grande Casa is a modern 4-star hotel in Medjugorje, perfectly suited for motorcyclists. We offer free private parking, including secure coverage for motorcycles, ensuring your bike stays safe. After a long ride, unwind in our tranquil garden, on the terrace, or at the seasonal outdoor pool — plus, enjoy our gym and bar amenities for added relaxation. Rooms feature air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and minibars, and each morning you'll be welcomed with a varied buffet breakfast. With a prime location, attentive service, and biker-friendly infrastructure, we’re a dependable choice for riders and active travelers alike.

name: Hotel Leone
description: Welcome to Hotel Leone Medjugorje — a perfect choice for bikers, located just steps away from the Shrine and all main attractions. We offer free private parking, including a secure garage-style area right next to the building for safe storage of your motorcycle. Cozy rooms with air conditioning and complimentary Wi‑Fi ensure comfort after a long ride. Start your day with a hearty buffet breakfast, and unwind in the evening on the terrace with a drink from the bar. Excellent location, attentive staff, and dependable amenities for bikers make Hotel Leone a favorite among motorcycle travelers.

name: Villa Ruža
description: Welcome to Villa Ruža, beautifully situated at the foot of Apparition Hill in Medjugorje — a comfortable and secure haven for bikers. We offer free private parking, including a monitored area to keep your motorcycle safe. Upon arrival, you’ll enjoy a warm, homely ambiance, a delicious breakfast, and insider tips on the best biking routes and local excursions. With thoughtful location, cozy accommodations, and attentive service, Villa Ruža is an excellent choice for riders seeking tranquility and simplicity.

name: Hotel Park
description: Welcome to Hotel Park Široki Brijeg. We offer free private parking, including a secure garage adjacent to the hotel, ensuring your bike is safe. Our bright rooms are equipped with air conditioning, minibars, free Wi‑Fi, and work desks — all essentials after a long day on the road. Enjoy a hearty breakfast in the restaurant or relax with a cold drink on our terrace before continuing your journey.

name: Hotel Luna Bihać
description: Welcome to Hotel Luna Bihać, a convenient and peaceful stopover for bikers passing through Bihać. We offer free private secure parking right on the premises, ensuring your motorcycle stays safe. Rooms come with air conditioning, free Wi‑Fi, and a cozy ambiance—including balconies with scenic river views—and breakfast is served on the terrace. It’s the perfect place for riders seeking comfort, reliability, and a great start to their next day's journey.

name: Hotel Gold Jet Bihać
description: Welcome to Hotel Gold Jet Bihać — a modern 4-star hotel ideally located in the heart of Bihać. We provide free private parking, ensuring your motorcycle is safely stored during your stay. Our cozy rooms come equipped with air conditioning, free Wi‑Fi, and all the comforts you need after a long ride. Start your day with a delicious buffet breakfast, and relax in the restaurant or on the terrace — perfect for bikers seeking comfort, convenience, and safety.

name: Kamp Orljani
description: Welcome to Kamp Orljani, a cozy campsite surrounded by nature just 5 km from Bihać — a perfect stopover for motorcyclists. We offer on-pitch or camper parking, with a secure spot for your motorcycle available for a small fee (~5 €), all shaded by the surrounding trees. Facilities include a restaurant, shop, Wi‑Fi, showers, and tranquil access to the banks of the Una River — ideal for a peaceful outdoor retreat. After a long ride, guests can unwind by the water or enjoy sports facilities on-site.

name: Motel Kamenica
description: Welcome to Motel Kamenica — a convenient stopover for bikers en route to Plitvice Lakes. We offer free private parking, complete with surveillance and valet options to keep your motorcycle secure. Spacious, clean rooms with air conditioning and Wi‑Fi provide a comfortable place to rest after a long ride. On-site restaurant and bar let you refuel and unwind before hitting the road again.

name: HOTEL LOBBY
description: Welcome to Hotel Lobby Bihać — the perfect stretch for motorcyclists en route to Una National Park and scenic routes. We offer free private parking, including spaces for motorcycles with 24-hour surveillance. Unwind after your journey in our modern rooms featuring air conditioning and free Wi-Fi, and enjoy breakfast or drinks at our on-site restaurant and bar with mountain views. Comfort, security, and top-notch service make us a go-to choice for riders.

name: Hotel Swiss Plus Bihać
description: Welcome to Hotel Swiss Plus Bihać — a convenient stopover for motorcyclists, located steps from the Una River and city center. We offer free private parking, including secure space for your bike. Rooms are equipped with air conditioning, Wi‑Fi, smart TVs, and kitchenettes — everything you need to relax after a long ride. Whether you want a breakfast with ease or local route tips, our 24-hour reception is always here to assist.

name: Auto Camp Drina & Rafting Tara
description: Welcome to Auto Camp Drina, the perfect stop for motorcyclists seeking adventure amidst stunning riverside landscapes along the Drina. We offer dedicated motorcycle parking and the option to stay in your tent, cabin, van, or vehicle right on-site — ideal for bikers. After a ride, unwind in our spotless shower facilities, enjoy a hearty meal at our restaurant, or relax with a drink by the seasonal pool. With great location, friendly hosts, and biker-friendly amenities, it's a top pick for self-sufficient travelers.

name: Hotel Kompas
description: Welcome to Hotel Kompas Bihać, a biker-friendly choice made perfect by its free private parking, offering safe and secure spots for motorcycles. Refresh in modern rooms equipped with Wi‑Fi, air conditioning, and comfortable showers after a long ride. Unwind at the hotel’s restaurant or bar, where service and comfort come first. Great location and thoughtful amenities for two-wheeled travelers make this hotel a dependable stopover.

name: Hotel Plivsko Jezero
description: Welcome to Hotel Plivsko Jezero, an ideal spot for motorcyclists traveling through Bosnia. We offer free private parking, where your bike can be securely stored, and stunning Pliva Lake nearby with scenic views and walking trails. The cozy rooms are equipped with air conditioning and Wi‑Fi — everything you need to recharge after a ride. In the morning, enjoy breakfast in the restaurant or relax on the terrace overlooking the lake — a perfect pause before hitting the road again.

name: Hotel Premium Jajce
description: Welcome to Hotel Premium Jajce — an excellent choice for motorcyclists. We offer free private parking right behind the hotel, ensuring your bike stays secure under surveillance. Our rooms are modern and spotless, featuring air conditioning, Wi‑Fi, and scenic views of the river or the mountains — the perfect retreat after a ride. Start your day with a continental breakfast on our terrace and enjoy being just steps away from the town center — everything a biker needs for a comfortable stopover.

name: Jajce Youth Hostel
description: Welcome to Jajce Youth Hostel — a great choice for motorcyclists, located right beside the Pliva River in the heart of the town. We offer free gated parking for bikes and motorbikes, along with Wi‑Fi and a shared kitchen for planning your next ride. Rooms are cozy and include complimentary linens and towels, and our friendly team is ready to assist with route tips and local insights. It’s a welcoming and dependable stopover on the road.

name: Hotel Turist 98
description: Welcome to Hotel Turist 98 Jajce — an ideal stop for motorcyclists, situated right in the heart of town. We offer free private parking directly at the entrance, where your bike will be safe and secure, including night security. Comfortable rooms with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi await you after the ride. Start your day with a buffet breakfast at the on-site restaurant, then effortlessly explore the city on foot thanks to our prime location.

name: CAMP MARS JEZERO
description: Welcome to Auto Camp Drina & Rafting Tara — the perfect stop for motorcyclists seeking both convenience and scenery along the Drina River. We offer secure motorcycle parking right within the campsite, along with clean shower facilities and hot water. After your ride, enjoy a meal at our on-site restaurant or unwind with a drink at the outdoor bar while soaking in the riverside views. It's an ideal base for refreshing, recharging, and continuing your journey through beautiful Montenegro.

name: Hotel IUT
description: Welcome to Hotel IUT Travnik — a modern hotel that makes an ideal base for bikers exploring the region. We offer free private parking, ensuring your motorcycle is securely accommodated. After your ride, relax in air-conditioned comfort, stay connected with fast Wi‑Fi, and enjoy a drink at our bar or unwind on the terrace. With convenient location, welcoming hospitality, and biker-friendly amenities, it’s a smart choice for motorcycle travelers.

name: Hotel Lipa Travnik
description: Welcome to Hotel Lipa Travnik — an excellent choice for bikers, offering a central location in town and free private parking, ideal for safely securing your motorcycle. Relax in comfortable, air-conditioned rooms featuring free Wi‑Fi and a workspace for planning your next leg of the journey. Start your day with a hearty breakfast, plus enjoy the on-site café for a relaxing pause. With its convenience, modern amenities, and attentive hospitality, Hotel Lipa is a top pick for two-wheeled travelers.

name: Hotel Vezir Palace
description: Welcome to Hotel Vezir Palace Travnik — an elegant four-star retreat where motorcycle travelers will feel right at home. We offer free private parking, including covered spaces that riders especially appreciate. After a long ride, relax in stylish air-conditioned rooms with Wi-Fi, enjoy the restaurant and bar, or unwind in the spa center with a sauna, jacuzzi, and massage services. Start your day with a rich buffet breakfast on the terrace before exploring the city’s historic fortress just a short walk away.

name: Hotel Residence
description: Welcome to Hotel Residence Travnik — a fantastic stop for motorcyclists, with free private parking to securely store your bike. After your ride, relax in modern, air-conditioned rooms with complimentary Wi‑Fi and enjoy a fresh continental breakfast every morning. The hotel also offers laundry services, a 24-hour reception, and pleasant garden and terrace spaces to unwind. With its convenient location and attentive service, it’s a trustworthy choice for two-wheeled travelers.

name: Hotel Jelena Banja Luka
description:
Hotel "Jelena" is a place where business people, tourists, recreationalists and all those who want the best hotel service meet. With 54 rooms, a room adapted for people with special needs, 3 superbly equipped apartments, two halls for presentations, banquets and conferences, a wellness center, a restaurant and a cafe bar with a summer garden, Hotel "Jelena" is the right place for you.

Located just a few minutes' walk from the center of Banja Luka, Hotel "Jelena" offers all the comforts for guest accommodation, a variety of business facilities, a top-notch offer of domest3ic and international dishes, an extensive wine list... The hotel has its own parking lot, which is free for all our guests, and is provided with video surveillance.

It is located within the "Emporium" shopping center, where you can find various products and facilities on over 12,000 m2.

name: Stara Ada
description:
This luxury complex offers the possibility of a perfect vacation. A special impression on visitors is left by the perfect harmony of the interior with the natural resources that surround us, which represents a kind of oasis of peace, relaxation and unwinding.

All our apartments are luxuriously equipped for your pleasant vacation, hidden from the city bustle, and close to the city center guarantee complete privacy, comfort and convenience whether you come for business, for a romantic weekend or even a family vacation.

Each apartment is equipped with a rich mini-bar, air conditioning, cable television and the possibility of using a free internet connection will make you available 24 hours a day.

name: Wellness Spa Hotel Zeleni Raj
description:
Operation as a Family Business we are providing You with the great service allowing You to experience the very best parts of our Spa & Lunch Bar. Stay at our hotel and enjoy special packages at great prices.
We bring our expertise and attention to detail to our guests in a way that is natural and warm.

name: Fortuna
description: Hotel and Wellness Center Fortuna is located in Petrićevac, within the ŽUTE ZGRADE settlement, 2 km from the center of Banja Luka. The concept of the Hotel and Wellness Center meets all the needs of modern man for a comfortable stay. It is designed and built according to high standards and represents a new dimension in the hospitality industry.

name: Hotel Central Park
description:
The hotel is located in a building with a very interesting history and tradition. It was built in 1894, shortly after the arrival of the Austro-Hungarian monarchy in these areas, in the architectural style that dominated the second half of the 19th century.

The same style is found in all major European capitals such as Vienna and Prague. The authentic appearance of the building was preserved during its restoration.

Its original purpose was administrative and managerial, until the First World War. Then, due to its size and position, it was used as an elementary and secondary school, and then as a student dormitory.

name: Hotel Nar
description: Hotel Nar is a representative hotel whose beauty captivates you at first sight. It is only 800 meters from the center of Trebinje. We are located only 30 km from Dubrovnik, the pearl of the Adriatic (Croatia) and 40 km from Herceg Novi (Montenegro). The hotel is located away from the hustle and bustle of the city, allowing for a pleasant rest for the eyes and soul.

name: Hotel APIS
description:
We have prepared for you Comfort, Family rooms as well as Deluxe and Superior rooms.
All the rooms have carefully arranged interiors, integrating harmoniously high-quality textiles, soft carpets and modern design.

name: Apartmani Aleksandar
description: Welcome to Apartmani Aleksandar Pale — cozy apartments that are perfect for motorcyclists, offering free private parking to secure your bike with peace of mind. After your ride, relax in spacious accommodations equipped with Wi‑Fi, a kitchen, and a terrace with mountain views. In the morning, enjoy making your own breakfast and savor it outdoors in the garden. It’s a reliable stopover with comforts and a homely vibe—ideal for two-wheeled travelers.

name: SL Industry Hotel
description: Designed to provide you with the ultimate in comfort, relaxation and fun, the City of the Sun will delight you at first sight. The City of the Sun is home to the largest aqua park in the Balkans, "Sunčana vrela", the luxurious hotel "SL Panorama", the sports and recreational facility "SL Olimp" (with an indoor swimming pool, gym, multifunctional hall, outdoor and indoor football, basketball, volleyball and tennis courts), the wellness and spa center "Galija", the ethno village and Varoš čaršija, the children's park "Dino Park", the apartment complex "Bijeli grad", a camping site and a coliseum. Welcome!

name: Ethno Village Čardaci
description: Welcome to Ethno Village Čardaci — a scenic ethno-complex surrounded by nature, offering everything bikers need for a comfortable stop. We provide free on-site parking, convenient for motorcycles — secure and hassle-free. After your ride, unwind with traditional Bosnian cuisine at our restaurant, complimentary Wi‑Fi, and a water park to relax and recharge. Here, you’ll experience authentic Bosnian ambiance, warm hospitality, and the comfort you deserve after a long journey.

name: Hotel Via
description: Welcome to Hotel Via Jajce — a convenient stop for motorcyclists right in the heart of town. We offer free private parking for your bike, ensuring peace of mind. After your ride, enjoy comfortable rooms equipped with air conditioning and Wi‑Fi, plus an on-site restaurant to relax and refuel. With its central location and biker-friendly service, it's an ideal choice for travelers on two wheels.

name: ALMY MOTEL
description: Welcome to Motel Almy — a practical and cozy stopover for motorcyclists, ideally located just outside the center of Zenica. We offer free private parking right at the property, ensuring your motorcycle stays secure. After your ride, unwind in our clean, air-conditioned rooms with complimentary Wi‑Fi, and refuel at the on-site restaurant and bar. With friendly staff and excellent value, it's a fantastic choice for travelers on two wheels.

name: City Code Hotel
description: Welcome to City Code Hotel — a modern stopover perfectly located for bikers, just 5 minutes from the city center. We offer free secure parking with motorcycle-friendly access, so you can relax knowing your bike is safe. After the ride, enjoy stylish air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi and start your day with a continental breakfast. An ideal choice for those who value safety, comfort, and a quick return to the road.

name: Moto-Bike BiH (Banja Luka)
description: Moto-Bike BiH in Banja Luka offers spare parts and accessories for motorcycles and scooters. The inventory includes everything from consumables to small accessories, making it a lifesaver for emergency needs on the road. Customers appreciate the convenient opening hours and the stock availability. A solid spot when you need something urgent or need a quick fix while traveling.

name: Moto Shop Adventure
description: Welcome to Moto Shop Adventure — a biker’s haven in Banja Luka where you’ll find everything from basic repair services to gear and accessories. The convenient location at Krajiških brigada 23 makes it an ideal pit stop for resupply or emergency fixes. True professionals are on hand to help you get your bike road-ready for the next leg of your journey. A top choice for riders who value quality and quick solutions on the road.

name: Moto Shop 7
description: Welcome to Moto Shop 7 in Banja Luka — the perfect stop for bikers to quickly gear up with motorcycle apparel and accessories. They carry high-quality brands like Yamaha, Dainese, IXS, Modeka, Cardo, and Oxford, and the staff are ready to assist with advice or swift purchases. Conveniently located in the city center, it’s an excellent waypoint before continuing your ride. If you need something urgently, this is a trusted place to gear up and get back on the road.

name: Jazina Hotel
description: Jazina is a complex located on the banks of the mountain river Sušica. Your place for relaxation and unforgettable moments consists of a restaurant, hotel and swimming pool. Visit us and experience the combination of natural beauty and top-notch service. Your Jazina.

name: Herceg Vila (Herzeg Villa)
description: An elegant Villa, cafe and spa. serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, fresh juices, and Lavazza coffee. Our rooms offer contemporary facilities highlighting the beauties of Herzegovina. Located beside Trebinje's city basin, this is an ideal location to stay for the week or weekend, close to the heart of the city, with a spectacular view and easy access to Trebinje's outdoor delights

name: Villa Marija
description: Vila Marija is a modern tourist facility, located in the very center of the city in the quiet neighborhood of Bregovi. Vila Marija has 15 studio apartments, with a total capacity of 51 beds. All units are spacious, well-lit by nature, with excellent sound and thermal insulation. With a modern interior, the entire facility is equipped with optical internet. The Old Town of Trebinje and the recognizable “Platani” garden are less than 100 meters from the facility. This facility is located 100 meters from the local bus station and 30 meters from the bank. Vila Marija Apartments are located 21 km from Dubrovnik and 40 km from Herceg Novi, while the marina and Dubrovnik Airport are 30 km away.

name: Mellain
address: Aleja Alije Izetbegovića br. 3, Aleja Alije Izetbegovića 3, 75000
description:
Hotel Mellain is located in the center of Tuzla, in one of the most attractive locations that connects the most important economic, educational and cultural institutions. The proximity to the airport, university and clinical centers, the Pannonian Lakes complex contributes to the attraction of this modern hotel.

The proximity to the airport, the faculty and the clinical center, and the Pannonian Lakes complex contribute to this modern hotel.
The hotel has 128 rooms, 16 suites, one presidential suite and one suite for the disabled.

Guests of Hotel Mellain have the opportunity to enjoy the hotel's swimming pool, sauna and gym, which are located on our 19th floor. Whether you are looking for a little privacy, a relaxed environment, discretion and luxury, Hotel Mellain is the perfect place.

If you are not a hotel guest, but want to use the services of the swimming pool, gym and sauna, it is now very simple, because within the Hotel Mellain complex there is a Sports-Recreational & Spa Center that offers you all these opportunities.

In addition to the conference hall, which is proud of its size and capabilities, you can also organize smaller events or seminars in smaller halls in our complex. The VIP hall exudes importance and natural light with a capacity of up to 40 people. It is attractive because of the equipment it possesses and the beauty it radiates. On our 17th floor, there are work offices, which can be used to organize video calls, job interviews, and small seminars. It offers you privacy, a nice environment and good conditions for calm and quality work.

Tuzla, Mellain Hotel and Spa Aqua Bristol managed to preserve the centuries-old tradition of salt water treatment and enabled everyone to feel the charms of this unique "spa" within the complex.

name: Hotel Vertigos
description:
Hotel "Vertigos" is in the category of four-star hotels. It is located in the very center of the city, only 100m away from the most important tourist destinations (Lake Pannonia, Soni Trg, Trg Slobode...) Due to its convenient location, it belongs to commercial (city) hotels. The Vertigos hotel offers 17 accommodation units, 10 double rooms and 7 single rooms.
We also offer our guests parking services with 24-hour video surveillance. Hotel "Vertigos" keeps pace with innovations, and we hereby inform all our potential guests that the hotel also has a charging station for electric cars that will be available to all guests. With prior agreement, we can offer guests of the Vertigos Hotel two amphitheatres, air-conditioned and equipped with projectors. The amphitheatres have 130 and 90 seats. Seminars, conferences, promotions, presentations and meetings can be organized in the mentioned premises.

The style, modern interior, professionalism and kindness of our staff will inspire you to come back again.

name: Hotel Heartland City
description: It will be a pleasure to welcome you to our newly opened City Hotel located in center of Tuzla, at Kazanmahala number 10. Our hotel is a restaurant and cafe pizzeria in one, which makes Heartland one of the leading hotels in the region. It is located in the city center, 300 meters from the spa Aqua Bristol, which offers a traditional salt water healing. Hotel is located 200 meters from the Pannonian lake with healing salt water, which contains three lakes of various sizes and depths, salt waterfalls and sports fields at its complex. The hotel offers luxury rooms (french bed, double and triple bed rooms). Hotel guests have hotel parking at disposal. Hotel offers a restaurant with a capacity of 120 seats to guests and business partners , a wide range of food and drink as well as a collection of prestigious high quality wines. To comply with all the requirements of our guests, we offer you quality accommodation in air-conditioned rooms, which are equipped with cable TV (160 channels) and free wireless internet access.

name: University hotel Dorrah
description:
University Hotel Dorrah is located in the western part of the city of Tuzla, across from Bingo City Center. It takes 10 to 15 minutes to walk to Univerzitetska Street, and if you are in a hurry, there is a bus stop in front of the hotel, so you can take a three-minute bus ride to Univerzitetska Street. The Emergency Service and the Health Center are just ten minutes from the hotel, and the city center and the Pannonian Lakes are only about a 20-minute walk away. Our building is truly enchanting and captivating with its warmth, but don't judge it by its appearance alone, because we proudly say that behind this imposing building lies a much more beautiful treasure trove of precious pearls. It stands out not only with its size and appearance, but also with its significance, importance and reputation. We have 40 modernly furnished student rooms with private bathrooms and kitchenettes, 12 hotel rooms, a 24/7 reception, a restaurant, a library, a laundry room, a kitchen and a lounge.
The users of our services come from all over Bosnia and Herzegovina and from the region. We have had the opportunity and honor to be home to students from other countries such as Russia, Turkey and Australia.
A large number of them attend the faculties of the University of Tuzla, while a few attend private Tuzla faculties. All together we form one large
community, which abounds in diversity but is focused on the same goals.

name: Hotel „So i sol“
description: Perfectly located in the center of Tuzla, So i Sol boutique hotel Tuzla is a 4-minute walk from the Pannonian Lakes. All museums, mosques, churches and monuments in the center of Tuzla are in the immediate vicinity of the hotel and can be reached on foot. So i Sol hotel Tuzla is ideal for business people, a short break or a romantic weekend for two. You will be delighted by the comfort of the rooms and apartments, friendly staff and quality service, excellent free Wi-Fi and comfortable beds. Free large parking, which is very easily accessible from the main road, greatly facilitates arrival and planning day trips in Tuzla or the surrounding area. Van parking is also possible. We offer our dear guests 9 spacious accommodation facilities, seven rooms, five of which have a terrace and two modernly equipped apartments for complete rest and relaxation.

name: Hotel Golden Star
description: Are you traveling for business or vacation? Are you in town for just one night or for several days? Do you want accommodation in the most urban part of Tuzla, close to the Korzo and city squares? You've come to the right place. Golden Star Hotel is the closest starting point for all locations in the city of Tuzla. If it is important for you to reach any institution and facility quickly and without the risk of traffic jams, you will do it most efficiently from this place. Golden Star Hotel, in addition to comfortable accommodation in single and double rooms, offers a buffet breakfast and a stay in the lobby bar. Free WiFi signal is provided for all guests in all rooms. And for organizing seminars, round tables, press conferences and other similar events, we rent a congress hall on the ground floor of the Hotel. We have provided parking in our own garages.

name: Hotel Vila Ana
description:
Welcome to Vila Ana, a unique setting that combines excellent traditional cuisine and comfortable accommodation on the enchanting slopes of Majevica Mountain.

Vila Ana goes beyond the concept of an ordinary hospitality facility, presenting a place where tradition and natural beauty dominate, allowing our guests to fully enjoy every moment.
Hotel Vila Ana is a newly built 3-star hotel, located on the slopes of the Majevica mountain, Kalesija municipality, 18 km from the center of Tuzla and the Tuzla airport.

The hotel has:

10 rooms with a double bed
1 room with two separate beds
4 apartments

name: Bunski Biser
description:
Villa Bunski biser features a restaurant, bar, a shared lounge and garden in Blagaj. Featuring family rooms, this property also provides guests with a terrace. The accommodation offers a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, room service and free WiFi.

At the hotel, every room includes a wardrobe. At Villa Bunski biser all rooms are fitted with a desk, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom.

The accommodation offers a continental or à la carte breakfast.

At our hotel we have 5 double rooms and 5 triple rooms.

Each of our 10 rooms is fitted with a desk, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom.

name: Luxury Villa Vie
description:
Four spacious master bedrooms with double king beds and private bathroom. All rooms are equipped with adjustable air conditioning and flatscreen TV. All rooms are perfect for enjoying precious moments of relaxation.
Spacious outdoor area with all possible facilities. With over 500m2 of space surrounded by mountains, this garden offers an oasis of calmness and peace. The outdoor area is equipped with a professional 40m2 pool, outdoor kitchen with barbeque, outdoor bathroom and lounge. Villa Vie offers outdoors activities as well, like a basketball court.

name: Hotel Blagaj
description:
Hotel Blagaj is located in the center of Blagaj, a tourist center near Mostar. The total accommodation capacity is 60 beds with extra beds. This includes 27 classic rooms and 3 deluxe rooms with a hall. All accommodation units in this newly built facility are equipped with wi-fi, air conditioning, cable TV, etc. We have secured parking for all guests. The hotel also has a modernly equipped restaurant with approximately 60 seats where our guests can enjoy local and international specialties.
Hotel Blagaj offers comfortable accommodation in its thirty rooms in total. Of these, we offer twenty-seven classic rooms and three luxury rooms with anterooms. The furniture is very comfortable and all rooms are air-conditioned. The rooms can be easily reached from the reception using the elevator.

name: Riverside Guesthouse
description:
Located in Počitelj, 18 km from Kravica Waterfall, Riverside Guesthouse provides accommodation with a shared lounge, free private parking, a garden and 	Free! WiFi is available in all areas and is free of charge.
Tea/Coffee maker
Entire unit wheelchair accessible

name: Hotel Oaza
description:
Hotel "Oaza" Konjic is located in the very center of Konjic, about a hundred meters from the old Konjic bridge, the most famous building in the city of Konjic. It has 4 double rooms, 4 triple rooms, 4 rooms with a double bed and a Presidential Suite.

All rooms are air-conditioned with cable TV, free wireless internet access, safe, minibar, spacious bathroom, hairdryer... Guests also have access to a free room with a kitchenette, washing machine and other supporting elements. The hotel also has a VIP lounge.

Garages are provided for all types of passenger vehicles as well as car rental services.

The hotel also has a café-pastry shop with a 63-year tradition, a buregdžinica and a pizzeria.

name: Garden City Konjic
description: Our hotel offers a wide range of comfortable and modernly furnished accommodation units to ensure you fully enjoy your stay. Whether you are looking for a single room, double room or apartment, we have everything you need.

name: Hotel Novalić Konjic
description:
Well-appointed rooms guarantee a quality stay at the hotel. Central heating in all rooms
Easy access to the upper floors by lift or stairs. A restaurant and a bar are just a few of the amenities in this apartment complex. Internet access in public areas will allow you to stay up to date. The hotel offers a range of services and amenities for people with disabilities. Walks in the hotel park will lift your spirits. Guest parking is available (free of charge).

name: Hotel Han Jelica
description:
Welcome to Hotel Han Jelica. Our charming hotel offers a variety of accommodations to suit your needs, including elegantly appointed Double Rooms, Twin Rooms, and Triple Rooms, each boasting breathtaking mountain views.
We offer Double Rooms, Twin Rooms, and Triple Rooms, each boasting mountain views.
Hotel Han Jelica boasts a Restaurant and caffé set in a charming mountain ambiance.

name: Hotel Novitas Livno
description:
We are pleased to present the hotel “Novitas”, a company that has a long tradition of dedicated work, responsibility and business approach.

A family company that has hired a lot of young people so far expanded its activities to hotel industry and tourism and provided employment opportunities for many citizens of Livno and its surroundings.

Hotel “Novitas” is a domestic company, with no foreign investments, conceived on an effort and work, fair and honest relation to the satisfaction of all employees.

Hotel is open since 03.06.2017.

name: Motel Vujeva
description: Free internet and a comfortable bed. Motel Vujeva in Livno with a total capacity of 10 rooms can accommodate up to 20 people.

name: Hotel Nomad
description:
Clean mountain air, views of the fairytale slopes of Bjelašnica, endless walks along them, skiing, delicious food, socializing… Sounds good, right?!
All of this, and much more, is offered by Nomad, a new wellness & spa hotel located right next to the ski slope of this mountain. The facility has 51 designed hotel rooms.

name: Hotel Han Bjelašnica
description:
Elegant and modernly furnished rooms provide complete comfort and warmth where you can feel at home.

Hotel Han Bjelašnica offers 51 rooms with amenities that guarantee a high level of comfort and stay. Guests have access to internet access, LCD TV, telephone and safety deposit box, as well as a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower.

Hotel Han offers two types of rooms and a modern family apartment that will certainly make your stay on Bjelašnica pleasant. The rooms contain two or three beds, double or twin beds, according to your wishes.

name: Brunarica Kosobrin
description: A rustic alpine log cabin serving hearty Slovenian comfort food like spoon dishes and homemade cheeses, with a sunny garden, playground, and warm après-ski vibe near Kranjska Gora’s slopes

name: Julija
description: Julija Restaurant offers a cozy yet refined atmosphere, blending Slovenian and international flavors in its menu. Expect seafood, pasta, grilled meats, and inventive starters like beef carpaccio with truffles or grilled mushrooms with prawns. Desserts are highlights too — lava cake, almond cake, fresh fruit. The setting is warm, a bit romantic, with attentive service and attention to detail — perfect for those who want to enjoy a quality meal and a relaxed evening.

name: Dežela Okusov - Top quality 100% gluten-free cuisine
description: Dežela Okusov offers a completely gluten-free menu where everyone can find something they love: from delicate soups and risottos to hearty steaks and smoky ribs. Highlights include rack of lamb, dry-aged Florentine steak, and satisfying meat-free options like salads and vegetarian mains. Service is friendly, portions generous and full of flavor; the atmosphere is calm and carefully designed — a great place to enjoy dinner and take a break in a cozy setting.

name: GOSTILNA VIDA
description: Gostilna Vida feels like a green oasis in the heart of the city — perfect for those who want something fresh, tasty, and light. The menu features seasonal dishes, lots of greens, creative combinations: smoothie bowls, salads, fresh soups, breakfasts, with European and Asian influences. There are vegetarian and plant-based options, and the presentation is vibrant and appetizing. The vibe is relaxed and stylish, and you can tell meals are made with care and detail — a solid place to pause for healthy food on the road.

name: Restavracija Most
description:
At Most, we believe great food starts with great ingredients and an even greater experience.
Our menu is inspired by tradition, crafted with care, and always served with heart. Here, hospitality isn’t just a word—it’s a way of life.
From seasonal dishes to timeless flavors, every plate reflects our passion for quality and connection.
A place where meals turn into memories, conversations flow as effortlessly as wine, and every visit feels like coming home.

name: Restavracija Breg
description: An elegant fine-dining establishment on the Ljubljanica riverbank, where contemporary Slovenian gastronomy meets artistic plating and an exceptional wine pairing experience.

name: Brunarica Restaurant
description: A charming retreat with a cozy wooden interior and sunlit terrace, specializing in hearty mountain cuisine like slow-cooked stews, homemade dumplings, and locally sourced game meats.

name: Restaurant Majerca
description: A Michelin Bib Gourmand-awarded alpine retreat where chef Timi Rožič reimagines Julian Alps' flavors through seasonal tasting menus (3-5 courses), paired with 65+ Slovenian wines, all served in a contemporary space with mountain views or on a sunlit terrace

name: Slovenska Hiša - Figovec
description: A historic inn-turned-restaurant (since 1879) where cart drivers once stopped, now serving hearty Slovenian classics like štruklji, bograč, and Prekmurje ham in a rustic-modern space with a tree-shaded terrace, all paired with 200+ local wines

name: Europe Moto Rent & Tours
description:
Motorcycle rent is easy with us and everything is prepared and planned for ahead of motorcycle rent, to ensure you make the most of your time on the motorcycle and not off it. Our rental motorcycles go through a detailed check before each rental. If the rental motorcycle is not in 100% working order, it won't be rented.
Riding a motorcycle through the traffic free roads of Slovenia and surrounding countries is a fantastic experience. We offer best motorcycle rent rates to suit a range of budgets and travel needs. Whether you want to rent a motorcycle for a day, a week or even on a monthly basis, we can find a motorcycle rent contract to suit you.
Rent your favorite motorcycle to take you where you want to go by browsing our motorcycle collection.

name: Čevabdžinica Sarajevo '84 - Ljubljana
description: Sarajevo ’84 is where Balkan cuisine shows its full heart: juicy cevapcici, meat rolls, and homemade Bosnian pies. They serve dishes that evoke that “home journey” feeling: soup, sarma, prebranac, a variety of meat specialties and fresh flatbreads. The vibe is warm and authentic — calm, with a touch of nostalgia and heartfelt service. Perfect for getting a solid meal in before riding on, or just unwinding with good food among friends.

name: Hertz Ride Motorcycle Rentals Ljubljana
description: Premium motorcycle rental service offering the latest BMW, Harley-Davidson and Ducati models for exploring Slovenia's alpine roads, with flexible rental periods and optional GPS navigation

name: E-Moto Tours Bovec
description: An adrenaline-packed e-motorcycle rental and guided tour service specializing in off-road adventures through the Julian Alps, with powerful Sur-Ron electric dirt bikes perfect for exploring mountain trails and river valleys.

name: Ljubljana Rent-a-Scooter
description: Convenient urban scooter rental in the heart of Ljubljana, offering modern 50cc-125cc scooters for effortless city exploration, with flexible hourly/daily rates and helmet included.

name: Vodnikov Lookout Point
description: A breathtaking panoramic viewpoint at 1,017m altitude, named after Slovenian poet Valentin Vodnik, offering textbook-perfect views of Lake Bohinj, the U-shaped glacial valley, and the Julian Alps—best visited at sunrise or above morning valley fog

name: Boka Waterfall High Viewpoint
description: The most dramatic panoramic viewpoint of Slovenia’s mightiest waterfall, reached via a steep 45-minute climb from the base trail, offering a jaw-dropping perspective of Boka’s 144-meter cascade and the Soča Valley below

name: Vogar viewpoint - Lake Bohinji
description: A iconic panoramic perch at 1,054m altitude, offering Slovenia’s most photographed vista of Lake Bohinj’s turquoise waters, framed by the Julian Alps, with paragliders often soaring from its grassy launch site and a rustic mountain hut serving hearty local dishe

name: Razgledni stolp Boč
description: A 20-meter-high observation tower perched atop Mount Boč (978m), dubbed the "Triglav of Styria," offering 360° panoramas of eastern Slovenia’s rolling hills, vineyards, and distant Alpine peaks, especially magical during spring when rare pasque flowers bloom

name: Maistrov Stolp
description: A 17-meter-high metal observation tower in the Slovene Hills, built in 1982 to honor General Rudolf Maister, offering panoramic views of the Pesnica River valley, vineyards, and the Austrian border, with a memorial plaque and ties to Slovenia’s military history

name: Mala Osojnica
description: Hilltop viewpoint, reached by a steep, challenging hike, offering iconic panoramas of Lake Bled.

name: Bled Panoramic Viewpoint
description: A breathtaking elevated perch offering iconic 360° views of Lake Bled’s emerald waters, the medieval Bled Castle perched on a cliff, and the Julian Alps—best visited at sunrise for misty reflections or sunset when the castle is illuminated

name: Straza hill above Lake Bled
description: Hilly park with lake & mountain views, plus adventure trails, zip lines & summer toboggan runs.

name: bar Bled
description: In the Lake Bled and Bohinj region, there are bars and cafes popular among motorcyclists, especially those riding through the Wurzenpass and Kranjska Gora route. The tourist area offers paid parking for cars and motorcycles near the lake and other attractions. For instance, central parking lots by Lake Bled include dedicated motorcycle spaces. This provides convenient access to a bar after a scenic ride, blending comfort with a sense of adventure.

name: Sunset View Point SAHA
description: A serene sunset spot by West Lake, offering breathtaking views of the historic silhouetted against vibrant skies, with a peaceful atmosphere enhanced by lotus ponds and swaying palms

name: Devil's Cafe & Bar
description: Devil’s Cafe & Bar is a popular spot in central Bled, located right by the lake with views of the castle and a cozy terrace—perfect for unwinding after a long ride. They offer a wide selection of drinks, from craft beers and cocktails to Slovenian wines and coffee, plus light snacks, pizza, and the famous cream cake (kremšnita). The interior blends modern design with a welcoming vibe, and in the evenings, club music sets the mood—ideal for bikers craving that energetic, social atmosphere. It’s a great place to relax, enjoy scenic lake views, and refuel (both physically and socially) before heading out on your next ride or evening adventure.

name: Tony's
description: A bar with a biker-themed name in the city of Ploiești that clearly positions itself as appealing to motorcycle enthusiasts. Information about it is limited, but its name and social media branding create the impression of a fitting spot for a biker group meetup. It could be a convenient option for regional rides and social gatherings.

name: The Fable
description: The Fable is a cozy wine bar located in the heart of Ploiești that offers bikers a relaxed vibe with a distinctive, inviting style. Its interior, featuring warm lighting and wooden accents, provides a perfect setting for unwinding after a long ride. The bar serves a variety of cocktails, wines, and craft beers, paired with light bites that are ideal for fueling up before hitting the road again. They also host themed nights and tastings, creating a lively and social environment—great for biker groups looking to connect over good drinks and good company.

name: Panoramic View of Lake Bicaz
description: A jaw-dropping vantage point overlooking Lake Bicaz, Romania’s largest artificial lake, where emerald waters meet the rugged Ceahlău Massif—best visited at sunrise for misty reflections or golden hour for dramatic alpine silhouettes

name: Radulescu View point
description: A scenic overlook in the Borsec resort area, offering sweeping views of the Carpathian Mountains and the Borsec Depression, named after a local historical or cultural figure

name: Zânelor Meadow
description: A magical alpine meadow dotted with mineral springs and traditional wooden baths, where visitors can soak in healing waters while surrounded by Carpathian wildflowers and the sounds of mountain streams. Named after the "zâne" (fairies) of local folklore, this family-friendly spot blends nature with Székely cultural heritage

name: Duruitoarea Waterfall
description: Waterfall with 2 tiers, known for its thunderous sound & reached by a long trail through forest.

name: MotoRentals.ro Bucharest - Motorcycle Rentals in Romania
description:
We are a motorcycle tours and rentals company located in Bucharest, Romania. We offer a range of latest models of motorcycles from BMW. Our motorcycles are always maintained by official dealer services and are very well looked after. We also offer a fine selection of extras and services along with the motorcycle tours and rentals.

For online payment method is required to complete a form with information about your card in payment processor’s secure page (www.euplatesc.ro).

Payments with credit/debit cards issued under the Visa and MasterCard logo (Visa/MasterCard/Visa Electron and Maestro) is made through the “3-D Secure” system prepared by organisations that provide on-line transactions at the same level of safety as those made from ATMs or in the physical environment, at the merchant. The “3-D Secure” system ensures first of all that any of the information related to your card is transferred or stored at any moment of time, the merchant’s servers or on the servers with the processor of payments, this data is directly introduced into the Visa and MasterCard systems.

Important to know! – There are no extra fees for payments by credit card!

name: Moto Rent and Ride
description:
Our names are Ligia and Mihai, and we are the founders of Moto Rent&Ride. In 2023, fueled by the passion for motorcycling and the constant thirst for adventure, we started to picture the dream of MRR (Moto Rent&Ride). With the thought of us enjoying riding on two wheels for years, we wanted to share with other passionate motorcyclists the incomparable feelings offered by this activity.
We strongly believe that we can offer forward a part of the wonderful sensations experienced by us all these years. So, you, the one reading these lines, enjoy life at its fullest from the saddle of the motorcycle!
We offer you a selection of the most attractive and high-quality motorcycles on the market, chosen so that you (alone, together with your loved one or with your friends) can explore and taste, literally and figuratively, the goodies offered by Romania and by its people.
Become the main character in your adventure, we are waiting for you!

name: bike2rent - Motorcycle Rentals and Guided Tours
description: Bike2Rent offers premium motorcycle rentals and guided tours in Bucharest, featuring BMW, Harley-Davidson, and KTM models for exploring Romania's epic roads.

name: Transilvania Moto Rent
description:
Transilvania Moto Rent is the starting point of adventure for any motorcycle lover. Whether you’re a local or just visiting Transylvania, here you’ll find a motorcycle that will take you with a smile on your face wherever you want to go.

Whether you’re planning an asphalt road trip, an off-road excursion or just need to get around town quickly, we have motorcycles and scooters to cover all these needs.

The bikes are carefully prepared and checked before each departure, so you can fully enjoy your trip and relax.

In addition to the seriousness that characterizes us, all of us from Transilvania Moto Rent team are also motorcyclists.

Some of us prefer long trips, others off-road adventures, some of us only use the scooter in the city, others are drawn to the circuit. Whichever one of us you’re talking to, we’re eager to help you with tips, suggestions, beautiful trails, sights not to be missed.

name: AttisWay Moto Rent & Tours
description: Discover more about Attisway Motocycle Rental and Tours Brasov! We are ready for you to experience breathtaking landscapes and unforgettable journeys. Join us for a unique adventure that combines freedom and excitement.

name: DKM RENT & TOURS, dajanje motorjev v najem, Darko Klešnik s.p.
description: Motorcycle rental service in Slovenia offering Yamaha and Suzuki models for touring, with unlimited mileage and free Ljubljana delivery.

name: Roata
description: Restaurant Roata is a warm place featuring authentic Romanian cuisine, serving traditional dishes like mititei, sarmale, mamaliga, and various heartfelt meat and vegetable recipes. The interior blends wooden decor and cozy rooms, giving a home-like feel. The menu offers generous portions, friendly service, and a relaxed atmosphere — perfect for enjoying a meal with friends or taking a break during the ride.

name: Nor Sky Casual Restaurant
description:
Bucharest with a View
NOR is becoming a reference point for Bucharest because it is the highest place where you can dine! You start with the feeling of a bright hotel reception and the city panorama opens up before your eyes, seen from 136 meters high.

name: Vatra
description:
The Vatra Restaurant opened up December 2001 and ever since it has been the place where the Romanian cuisine is pleasantly supplemented by the authenticity of the Transylvanian sets.
Both the delicious dishes made with passion by our chefs and the hospitality that our staff welcomes you, will complete our purpose:
Your satisfaction!
We are inviting you to discover the Romanian traditional cuisine at VATRA Restaurant!

name: Brunch House
description:
We believe that a pleasant day begins with a tasty and healthy breakfast. It is no coincidence that breakfast is also called the most important meal of the day.
After a long journey spent in famous restaurants in Europe, we return with a baggage of knowledge and unique experiences, which we have always wanted to capitalize on.
Thus, Brunch House was born, from a passion for cooking, the pleasure of a brunch with friends and quality food in general.
Brunch House is the place where the day begins with a tasty coffee and a delicious breakfast, we are waiting for you at the newest Restaurant Breakfast & Brunch Brașov

name: Sergiana
description:
Inaugurated in 2003, then relocated in 2009, Sergiana Restaurant was and remains a firm statement that expressing local identity in the hospitality industry is a winning card. We are Romanian, we are Transylvanian and we belong to the Land of Bârsa, this is the succinct expression of the Sergiana Concept.

The tradition and color of the place greets and charms you from the moment you cross its threshold, and the menu will launch an invitation that is impossible to resist. Here you eat trilingually: Saxon, Hungarian and Romanian, but whatever you choose, you will also receive a large portion of pampering on your plate. That's how the word of the place spread, that Sergiana is a good host, and the menu is worthy of the Capital of Transylvanian Cuisine!

name: Restaurant HOME
description:
In the heart of Bucharest, as you leave the Patria Cinema towards the Icon Garden, leave the Carturesti Bookstore on your left and continue until you come across the Anglican Church.

Here you stop for a moment to admire the beautiful red brick building and the recently built monument in front. Every corner, every stone, every building here has its own history, some known, others buried in the past, perhaps forever. When you get tired of the ‘journey’ to the past and want to quench your thirst and hunger, we are waiting for you at the Home restaurant.
Because we set out with the idea of creating a place where you will FEEL AT HOME, in this space, not very large, but warm and chic, we offer you the most refined and well-known strong drinks, the best local wines, the most famous beers and soft drinks, the tastiest fruit shakes, delicious combinations based on coffee and tea, a hearty frappe with milk and ice cream and cocktails that delight the eye and the taste.

name: Crama Sibiul Vechi
description: Many legends have been told about this restaurant. Now it's up to you to find out why! On a small alley which bind the two city towers to the Large Square, in the cellar of an old building of the 15th century, lies a Transylvanian restaurant. We do not have much space, but the food is delicious and does not ask for praise. Just to be tasted. We will be honoured by your visit!

name: Country Cheese & Wine
description: Country Cheese & Wine is a cozy place with the feel of a European wine lounge, serving cheese boards, French and Swiss dishes, and a fine selection of wines. The menu includes light snacks and full dinner options—good both for a relaxed stop and a quick bite. The interior is warm and stylish, with plenty of space, so even after a long ride you’ll feel comfortable.

name: La Ceaun - Michael Weiss
description:
La Ceaun - Weiss is a popular choice for many travelers seeking authentic Romanian cuisine. The restaurant is noted for its generous portions and reasonable prices, especially given its central location. The cozy and rustic atmosphere, enhanced by Romanian music, adds to its charm.

Dishes like Bulz and goulash earn rave reviews, though some mention occasional inconsistencies. Service is frequently praised for being friendly and knowledgeable, with staff offering helpful recommendations and accommodating attention.

name: Kombinat Gastro-Brewery
description:
A Kombinat of neo-Romanian flavorsThe menu changes with the season.
The quality of the dishes is a constant.
You know what to expect.
The best and most delicious!

name: Restaurant Mestecăniș
description: Mestecanis Restaurant was born from the desire to offer locals and tourists alike a place where they can admire the beauty of the Bucovina Mountains along with a tasty dish and a comfortable ambiance.

name: Schnitzel Wirt
description: Schnitzel Wirt is a cult spot for schnitzel lovers, offering around 15 varieties, including options with mushrooms, cheese, and spices. Portions are generous, making it a hearty stop for bikers on the road. The traditional interior creates a cozy atmosphere, and the affordable prices make it popular with both locals and tourists.

name: Zur eisernen Zeit
description:
As early as the 18th century, a farmers' market existed on the banks of the Wien River, where primarily dairy products were traded. The name Naschmarkt likely derives from this original use of the area as a milk market. The ashwood vessel used to transport milk was traditionally called "Asch."

In 1916, the Naschmarkt was relocated from Karlsplatz to its current location. To also feed the construction workers who erected the market stalls, the first and thus oldest inn on the Naschmarkt opened on the site where gold was once exchanged for iron to finance the imperial treasury. The "Eiserne" inn, as it is affectionately called by guests and employees, soon became known throughout the city for its traditional Viennese goulash, which remains its trademark to this day. The combination of friendly service, a rustic ambiance, and excellent traditional Viennese home cooking attracts young and old alike. Whether you are a celebrity, an artist, a student, or simply “just” passing through, everyone feels at home in the “Eiserne.”

name: Zum weißen Rauchfangkehrer
description: Zum Weißen Rauchfangkehrer, located at Weihburggasse 4, 1010 Vienna, Austria, is a traditional Viennese restaurant founded in 1848. The establishment is known for its classic Austrian dishes, such as Wiener schnitzel, beef tartare, and carpaccio variations of beef, lamb, and veal. The menu also includes fish, vegetarian and vegan options, as well as desserts like the original Sacher torte. The restaurant boasts a wine cellar with around 30,000 bottles, offering a wide selection of local wines. The interior comprises four traditionally decorated rooms, one of which features live piano music, creating a cozy and warm atmosphere.

name: Gasthof Alter Fuchs
description: Gasthof Alter Fuchs, located at Linzer Gasse 47–49, 5020 Graz, Austria, is a traditional Austrian restaurant known for its hearty dishes and cozy atmosphere. They serve Wiener schnitzel, dumplings, beef goulash, and a variety of sausages, along with a wide selection of local beers. The interior is designed in the style of an old Austrian tavern, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

name: Pauli Stubm
description: Pauli Stubm, located at Herrengasse 16, 5020 Graz, Austria, is a cozy Austrian café in the city center. They serve traditional dishes such as Wiener schnitzel, dumplings, and apple strudel, as well as a variety of beers. The interior is designed in the style of an old Austrian tavern, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. There is an outdoor terrace where you can dine while enjoying the view of the city.

name: Der Steirer
description: "Gemütlichkeit" is our watchword. Our aim is to make you feel completely at home, savouring the taste of traditional Styrian (or “steirisch”, as the locals say) cuisine and our almost limitless selection of wine. Relax in a laid-back atmosphere, grab a quick coffee at the bar or find a souvenir of that uniquely Styrian joie de vivre.

name: Omas Teekanne Cafe - Brunch - Frühstück - Kuchen
description: Omas Teekanne, located at Nikolaiplatz 1, 8020 Graz, Austria, is a cozy retro-style café, perfect for bikers looking for a place to rest and enjoy a delicious meal in the city center. They offer over 70 types of tea, freshly roasted coffee, homemade lemonades, and a variety of desserts, including vegan and gluten-free options. The breakfast menu features hearty dishes such as omelets, muesli, fresh fruits, and baked goods. The café's interior is decorated in a grandmother's living room style with vintage furniture and retro accessories, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. There is an outdoor terrace where you can dine while enjoying the view of the square.

name: Café Greenhouse
description: "We're all about the love of coffee and responsible enjoyment. We want our guests to enjoy their coffee and do something good for themselves. This includes not only healthy ingredients and gentle preparation, but also fair treatment of the environment and producers."

name: Zimt Restaurant & Shisha-Lounge
description:
You can order takeaway / delivery | Graz
Looking for a restaurant with Persian cuisine, but don't know where to go? When the weather is pleasant, you can take a seat in our relaxed outdoor seating area.

A restaurant in a great location with lunch
Enjoy yourself and take your tastebuds on a journey with our Persian cuisine. Our salads are well known for their fresh, unique flavours. Treat yourself to drinks with our soups or schnitzel dishes – it's a great combination. As a dessert or whenever you get a craving, you can enjoy our heavenly desserts as well as our variety of baked goods. We're always happy to serve you a delicious lunch or dinner in a relaxing atmosphere.

name: Boho Bowls
description: Boho Bowls offers a variety of bowls with rice, fish, vegetables, and sauces, as well as vegan and gluten-free options. You can choose from pre-designed combinations or build your own bowl to suit your taste. The interior features minimalist design with green plants, creating a cozy atmosphere. There is parking nearby, and takeaway options are available. The establishment is open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM, making it convenient for bikers planning a stop at any time of day.

description: Rent your motorbike from us and make your holiday complete by driving over the most beautiful mountain passes in Austria for a few days. name: Hertz Ride Motorradvermietung - Salzburg
description: Discover an authentic motorcycle adventure with Hertz Ride. Explore the freedom of motorcycle rental or discover breathtaking routes on our guided motorcycle tours. Choose your bike and start your adventure today.

name: Mex-Bikes

We rent KTM motorcycles for people who don't want or can't afford to buy a motorcycle but still want to have fun on two wheels a few times a year.
The cost advantage is compelling when you consider the purchase price and annual costs (depreciation, insurance, service, tires, etc.).

We also organize tours and motorcycle transport, thus offering the ideal conditions for a completely stress-free trip to the most beautiful places in Austria and Europe.

In addition to motorcycles, we also have 9-seater buses and trailers for rent.

...feel the freedom and have fun!!!

name: mo2drive GmbH
description: Scooter rental service in central Vienna offering Vespa-style vehicles with friendly customer support and competitive pricing.

name: Road Trip 78
description: Motorcycle rental and guided tours in Ötztal with BMW, Harley-Davidson, and Ducati models for Alpine road adventures.

name: Moto-Graf

Welcome to MOTO-GRAF
Discover Lake Wörthersee without traffic jams or the hassle of searching for parking! Our Vespas are the perfect way to explore the beautiful landscape around Lake Wörthersee. Whether you're traveling alone, with friends, or with family, our Vespa rental service offers you the opportunity to experience the region in a unique and unforgettable way.

name: Viewpoint of Old Town Salzburg
description: A historic fortress-side viewpoint offering sweeping panoramas of Salzburg's Baroque spires, the Salzach River, and the Alpine foothills — best visited at golden hour for magical lighting.

name: Südbahnhotel viewpoint Semmering-Kurort
description: A historic railway-era viewpoint offering dramatic Alpine panoramas where the Semmering Railway’s viaducts weave through forested peaks, best visited at sunset for golden light on the UNESCO-listed landscape.

name: Hallstatt Skywalk - Hallstättersee
description: A modern viewing platform perched 350m above Hallstatt, offering dizzying bird’s-eye views of the UNESCO World Heritage village, lake, and Dachstein Alps — best paired with a visit to the nearby Salt Mine.

name: View Point Perchtoldsdorf
description: A peaceful vineyard viewpoint overlooking Perchtoldsdorf’s medieval town center and distant Vienna skyline, perfect for sunset picnics with local wine

name: Hallstätter Wasserfall
description: Lake Hallstatt is a breathtakingly beautiful mountain lake in the Salzkammergut region. There are many great things to do around the lake. I know the area. Click here to read the description of my experiences and see if they might be of interest to you. Thousands of other readers have already found this very helpful.

name: View point Dellach
description: A serene alpine viewpoint nestled in the Gailtal Valley, offering sweeping panoramas of the Carnic Alps and Lienz Dolomites — perfect for sunrise photography and spotting paragliders launching from nearby slopes.

name: Jakobskogel
description: A forested summit viewpoint (1,052m) offering serene panoramas of the Ötscher Massif and Mariazell pilgrimage routes, accessible via a gentle 1-hour hike through pine trails — perfect for sunrise meditation or autumn foliage photography.

name: The PUB Bucharest
description: The PUB Bucharest is a well-known pub located in the heart of Bucharest, where patrons can pour their own beer directly from tabletop taps. The venue frequently hosts live music and unique events like first-aid courses tailored for motorcyclists. With its lively yet relaxed ambiance, great drinks, and live sports, it's a popular spot to hang out with friends.

name: Viewpoint Dég
description: A hidden hilltop perch overlooking Dég’s iconic Festetics Palace and the rolling farmlands of Transdanubia, best visited at golden hour when the Baroque architecture glows against the sunset.

name: Lookout on József-hegy
description: A serene hilltop escape in Buda Hills offering panoramic views of Budapest’s skyline and the Danube, accessible via a scenic hike

name: Gellért Hill Vista Point
description: Budapest’s most iconic viewpoint, offering breathtaking 360° panoramas of the Danube, Parliament, and Chain Bridge from atop a historic citadel — best visited at night for a glittering cityscape.

name: Elizabeth Tower
description: Built of limestone, the famous 1911 tower features a café and stairs to an observation deck offering panoramic views.

name: Old Shepherd
description: Old Shepherd Pub & Bar is a cozy, centrally located pub in Cluj-Napoca, designed with a classic Irish pub feel and decorated with scarves from beloved football teams. It offers a great selection of beers and cocktails, and boasts a welcoming, friendly atmosphere staffed by attentive and warm hosts. The pub is known for its quirky shot names and regularly broadcasts live sports events. It’s the perfect spot for a fun night out with friends.

name: Parliament Viewpoint
description: The classic postcard view of Hungary’s Parliament Building perfectly reflected in the Danube, best captured from Batthyány tér metro station’s riverbank at golden hour or after dark when the architecture is illuminated.

name: The Soviet
description: The Soviet Pub & Bar is a communist-themed cocktail bar in Cluj-Napoca, decorated with Soviet-era memorabilia, including propaganda posters and Lenin portraits. Cocktails are creatively served in jars, with names like "Ceaușescu" and "Europa Liberă" adding to the immersive experience. The bar offers a unique blend of nostalgia and modern flair, with affordable drinks, a sociable vibe, and friendly staff.

name: Musik Cafe
description: Musik Cafe is a cozy and atmospheric bar located in the heart of Brașov’s Old Town, celebrated for its eclectic decor and vibrant live music nights. The café’s design incorporates vintage and communist-era memorabilia, giving it a unique and nostalgic character. The menu features a wide selection of local craft beers, international brews, cocktails, and wines at affordable prices. With outdoor seating, friendly staff, free Wi-Fi, and a welcoming vibe, it’s perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends.

name: St. Andrew's Scottish Pub
description: St. Andrew’s Scottish Pub is a cozy, character-rich pub located in the heart of Sibiu's Old Town, just a minute’s walk from the Main Square and the Council Tower. As the first Scottish-style pub in the area, it offers an impressive selection of over 60 beers and whiskeys from Scotland, Germany, England, and the Czech Republic. The interior reflects traditional Scottish design, and the warm, welcoming atmosphere makes it a perfect place for relaxing evenings with specialty drinks and occasionally live music.

name: Music Pub
description: Music Pub is a cozy subterranean bar with a covered terrace, nestled in the heart of the Old Town. It features live music, well-crafted cocktails, and a wide selection of beers in a warmly decorated setting. The menu boasts generous servings of garlic pizza, burgers, and chicken parmigiana—favorites among patrons.

name: O'Peter's Irish Pub Brasov
description: O'Peter's Irish Pub & Grill is a charming Irish-style pub located on the vibrant pedestrian street of Strada Republicii in the heart of Brașov. It blends the cozy ambiance of traditional pubs with a wide-ranging menu, from a classic Irish breakfast to burgers, pizza, and an extensive selection of beers and cocktails. Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi and card payment options, combining convenience with comfort. It's a perfect spot for social gatherings, dinner, or a relaxed evening out.

name: Scârț, a Chill Place
description: Scârț, a Chill Place in Timișoara is a cultural oasis perfectly suited for touring motorcyclists looking to unwind. You can relax over a coffee or wine amid eclectic décor, enjoy board games, and wander through a mini museum dedicated to the communist era. Park your bike in the nearby free parking and step inside this cozy spot that offers affordable drinks and cultural activities — from live performances to art exhibitions. It’s an ideal stop to wind down after a ride, either with fellow riders or solo, in contemplative, creative calm.

name: LOKAL am Marktplatz 1
description: Lokal am Marktplatz 1 is a cozy, atmospheric pub situated on the central square of Faak am See, making it an ideal biker stop. The venue frequently hosts live music, including shows during the renowned European Bike Week, making it a favorite gathering place for motorcyclists. After a day on two wheels, you can relax with a great drink and good company in a warm, laid-back setting.

name: 1st Harley-Indian Twin Power Club Austria
description: 1st Harley-Indian Twin Power Club Austria is an iconic biker bar located in Nenzing, Austria. Decked with vintage motorcycles and biker memorabilia, it offers a warm and passionate atmosphere where kindred spirits gather to share road tales. The bar serves a range of beverages—local beers and classic cocktails—making it a perfect pit stop after a day riding through the Alps. The venue regularly hosts themed bike nights and shows, drawing both locals and touring riders, and often serves as a launch point for scenic motorcycle excursions.

name: Bockshorn Irish Pub
description: Bockshorn Irish Pub is a tiny but charming Irish pub tucked away in central Vienna. Known for its vast whiskey selection (over 100 varieties) and cozy, memorabilia-filled interior, it offers a nostalgic, character-rich atmosphere. Its small size creates an intimate, buzzing vibe — often referred to as a "hidden gem." It's a perfect spot to unwind with friends after a ride, enjoying quality drinks in warm ambiance.

name: Addicted to Rock
description: Addicted to Rock Bar & Burger is a dynamic bar-restaurant in central Vienna that blends rock culture aesthetics with vibrant design and great food. Expect juicy burgers made with alpine beef, quirky Gin & Tonics, and craft beers. The place exudes rock-club energy, featuring live performances and parties that keep the vibe electric. Amenities include Wi-Fi, card payments, and paid street parking for convenience.

name: Józsi kilátópont
description: A hidden gem viewpoint in the Buda Hills, offering serene forest-framed panoramas of Budapest’s skyline — perfect for sunrise solitude and autumn foliage photography.

name: Panoramic view Fátra
description: unexpected sweeping views of Budapest’s skyline, including Gellért Hill and the Danube — a local secret for sunset drinks without the crowds

name: Margaret Bridge Panoramic View
description: A dynamic urban viewpoint from Budapest’s second-oldest bridge, framing the Parliament Building, Buda Castle, and Margaret Island in a single sweeping panorama — best for twilight long exposures and tram silhouettes.

name: Trinity Pub Vienna
description: Trinity Pub Vienna is a cozy pub and cocktail bar located on Rilkeplatz square in Vienna. Its interior blends traditional Irish pub charm with contemporary flair, offering a rich selection of craft beers, whiskeys, and signature cocktails. The menu also includes hearty meals and steaks, making it an ideal spot for bikers seeking a comfortable stop after a ride.

name: Whiskey Lounge
description: The Salzburg Whiskey Museum is a cozy Irish-style pub located in the center of Salzburg - an ideal spot for motorcyclists. It boasts an extensive selection of over 200 whiskeys from around the world, including Guinness and craft beers. The bar often stays open late, features live music, and offers a friendly setting where bikers can relax after a long ride. Tastings and whiskey-related events add to the experience, making it more than just a pit stop.

name: Flann O'Brien Original Irish Pub
description: Flann O’Brien Original Irish Pub in Graz is an authentic Irish pub with a warm atmosphere and a wide selection of beers and whiskeys. Hearty snacks and traditional dishes make it a perfect stop to recharge after a long ride. Conveniently located in the city center, it’s a great meeting spot for bikers to relax, enjoy good food, and share the road spirit.

name: Stiegl Brewery Salzburg GmbH
description: Stiegl-Keller, the brewpub of Stiegl Brewery in Salzburg, is a perfect relaxation spot after a long motorcycle ride. You can enjoy freshly drafted beer and classic Austrian fare while lounging on a cozy terrace overlooking the historic town and fortress. The authentic ambiance, hearty food, and scenic view make it a rewarding pit stop among fellow riders. A top pick for those looking to refuel with great beer and a memorable vista.

name: North Point Lookout Hármashatárhegy
description: The highest natural viewpoint in Budapest (495m), offering 360° panoramas of the Danube Bend, city skyline, and Pilis Mountains — a prime spot for paragliding launches and astrophotography away from light pollution.

name: Predikálószék lookout
description: A dramatic cliffside perch towering 639m above the Danube Bend, offering eagle-eye views of the river’s sweeping curve, Börzsöny Mountains, and historic Visegrád Castle — reached via a steep 2-hour forest hike from Dömös village.

name: Gasthaus Sterna
description: Gasthaus Sterna—also known locally as Sterna z’ Muntlix - is a cozy village gasthaus and beer bar on Hauptstraße 12, part of the Sternbräu family in the Gemeinde Zwischenwasser. It feels like a community hangout: wood-and-stone interior, friendly service, and a little garden/terrace that fills up in fair weather. Expect straightforward regional comfort food and freshly poured Sternbräu beers rather than anything fussy. A relaxed stop for lunch or an unhurried evening round when you’re roaming the Rhine valley between Rankweil and Feldkirch.

Guests can enjoy local specialties brewed on-site, paired with food that complements the beer perfectly. It’s a great stop for those who want to combine the thrill of biking with fun, food, and drinks in a cool, themed environment.

Flexible rental conditions: You can choose from different rental structures, according to your needs.
Without kilometer restrictions:
With us, you don't have to calculate or worry about how many kilometers you can still drive that day.
Choose us and enjoy the freedom of motorcycling!

name: Harley-Davidson Budapest
description: A chain of motorcycle showrooms of a famous American brand. Some of them also sell clothing and accessories.

name: Liquid Rock
description: Liquid Rock in downtown Budapest is a rock bar with an authentic edge—perfect for bikers looking to cap off their ride with energy and flavor. With over 200 spirits (including rare whiskies) and 17 draft beers, it offers a thrilling pour for connoisseurs. Expect rock and metal playlists, live music, and edgy video decor that keep the vibe electric. A biker-friendly spot—open late, offering card payments, and equipped with urban rock ambiance that hits the right chord.

name: Hungarikum Bisztró
description:
We wanted to create a place… a good place where a Guest can truly feel like a guest would feel in our home, where the meals are prepared in a traditional, authentic way. So, we opened one. Our concept is a bit different than trend nowadays.

We do not reform the dishes or over-decorate them. We just simply prepare and serve food like our grandmother did. Perhaps our meals are a bit more salty or spicy than some are used to, but we do not want to change the original recipes. We would like to stick to the flavors that we grew accustomed to in our childhood.

We are a family, who together with some friends, would like to create an atmosphere where everybody can feel like a family member and feel the sense & the taste of the real Hungarian hospitality.

name: Parisi 6
description: A stylish cocktail bar hidden in a restored pre-war building, known for its art deco interior, creative drinks, and intimate atmosphere — a favorite for post-theater nightcaps.

name: Sheldon's
description: Sheldon's is a trendy pub located in the heart of Debrecen, perfect for bikers looking to unwind after a ride. It offers cozy seating, craft cocktails, local beverages, and tasty snacks like the much-loved nacho chips. On select evenings, live music enhances the vibe, and the friendly staff and attentive service make it a welcoming spot for camaraderie. The bar is open daily from 4 PM until midnight — ideal for a relaxed gathering after a long ride.

name: Hell's Kitchen – Hungarian Restaurant
description: Hungarian Hell’s Kitchen restaurant is like a loving, caring family member who always greets you with your favourite homemade dish. We source our ingredients from the best hungarian farmers, whether it’s meat, vegetables, or spices. Our owners, chefs, and staff all come from the Hungarian countryside, and our waiters' cheerful demeanour is sure to brighten your day. The ambience is enhanced by the music of gipsy musicians every evening.

name: Ruben Étterem
description: Ruben Restaurant is located in the heart of Budapest, near the Károlyi Garden, also known as the oasis of the city center, on the quiet Magyar Street. You can taste many classic and special dishes of Hungarian and international cuisine here.

name: Grumpy Food Bar Coffee
description:
On the We Love Budapest Toplist
Grumpy has breakfast, nutritious and light, home-cooked lunches in French, Hungarian or Moroccan style, and kind words and friendly service. Coming here is always like arriving at a guest house, whether it's your first or your many visits.

name: Szimpla Kert
description: Szimpla Kert is a legendary ruin bar in Budapest’s Jewish Quarter, a once-dilapidated building transformed into a lively and colorful venue. Its interior is a maze of eclectic decor: flea-market furniture, graffiti, vintage TVs, and even a Trabant car turned into seating. The bar frequently hosts live music, film screenings, art events, and even farmers' markets, making it a true hub of city culture and creativity. Szimpla isn’t just a bar — it’s a space where bikers can soak up artistic energy, meet people, and enjoy an unforgettable atmosphere after a ride.

name: Gyógygödör Borozó
description: Gyógygödör Borozó is an atmospheric wine bar tucked into a cellar space beneath a historic building on Sopron’s main square. Its maze-like vaulted rooms and cool underground setting make it the perfect retreat after a long ride. They serve hearty Hungarian and German dishes along with local wines, offering a soulful pit stop for bikers. Legend says weary travelers came here to be 'cured'—and perhaps this place still revitalizes spirits for the road ahead.

name: GLASGOW Pub & Café
description: GLASGOW Pub & Café is a cozy Irish-Scottish style pub in Pécs with a warm, welcoming vibe and a wide selection of beverages, including whisky and Guinness. The place is open every day of the year, making it a reliable stop on any ride whenever you need a break. The staff focuses on customer satisfaction—no pressure to buy expensive items, and thoughtful suggestions (often with student discounts).
