It’s a perfect spot to relax, swap biker stories, and recharge before continuing the journey.

name: Moto24
description: Moto24 serves as a convenient starting point for motorcycle adventures around Brașov, offering tours through the scenic Transylvanian countryside. Riders can access professional gear and accessories here, while preparing for their journey. Organized moto-tours depart directly from Moto24, exploring hidden passes, basalt columns, and the Kálnoky Castle. It’s not just a gear shop - it’s your gateway to a well-planned, two-wheeled adventure.

name: BikerMag
description: BikerMag is a modern showroom and motorcycle gear store in Bucharest, offering everything from protective jackets and helmets to consumables and accessories. The team behind BikerMag has been active motorcyclists since 2007, so they know exactly what works on the road. You can get expert advice here to choose gear that will endure your journey. It’s more than just a store—it’s a trusted partner for every biker adventure.

name: ASP Group East
description: ASP Group East is one of Romania’s leading powersports distributors, offering major brands like Royal Enfield, Polaris, Indian Motorcycle, and more. Riders can find a wide range of products here — from ATVs and motorcycles to gear, spare parts, helmets, and lubricants. The showroom and headquarters are located in Mogoșoaia, just west of Bucharest, making it a convenient launch point for scenic motorcycle routes in Romania. It’s the perfect spot to gear up, get expert advice, and set off fully prepared for your next adventure.

name: Showroom MotoMus - Bucuresti
description: The MotoMus showroom in Bucharest offers a modern venue to explore and equip yourself with motorcycle gear, accessories, and parts, while soaking up the rider culture. You’ll find a broad selection of popular brands, helmets, protective clothing, communication systems, and more. Conveniently situated on Ciobanului Street in Mogoșoaia, it serves as a perfect launchpad for scenic motorcycle routes around Romania. A great stop before hitting the road—ideal for gearing up and getting expert tips for the journey ahead.

name: Moto E Motion Bucuresti
description: Moto E Motion in Bucharest is a specialist shop for motorcycle gear, accessories, and parts, serving riders with passion and attention to quality. You can easily find everything from protective helmets and apparel to maintenance items and gear for enduro adventures. Conveniently located on Virtuții Avenue, the showroom makes an ideal starting point for biker trips across the region. A perfect stop for those who want to gear up like a pro and hit the road ready for Romania’s scenic routes.

name: Biker Fun Shop Giurgiu
description: Biker Fun Shop in Giurgiu is a cozy motorcycle store offering gear, accessories, and supplies for various riding styles and travels. Friendly experts are ready to help you find everything from protective essentials to everyday parts that keep your ride smooth. Conveniently located in the center of Giurgiu, it makes a great pit stop before setting off on your Romanian road adventures. A solid choice for riders who value comfort, quality, and gearing up for their next journey.

name: BBmoto Otopeni · Magazin Moto București ·
description: BBmoto Otopeni is a well-stocked motorcycle showroom on the outskirts of Bucharest, spanning over 600 m² with more than 4,000 items in stock. The shop covers a wide range of riding styles—street, enduro, motocross, and ATVs—and features premium brands like Shoei, Shark, Revit, Bering, Frey Daytona, and more. Its convenient location in Otopeni, just 20 km from central Bucharest, makes it an ideal last stop for gearing up before heading out on your ride. A solid choice for riders who value variety, quality gear, and ready-to-roll service before hitting the road.

name: Shox Motoros Áruház
description: Shox Motoros Áruház in Budapest is a large, dedicated motorcycle store spanning approximately 900 m², offering a wide selection of gear, parts, accessories, and technical products. You can find everything from helmets and protective clothing to consumables, touring equipment, and motorcycle upgrades. Conveniently located on Szentendrei út, the store provides rider-friendly services such as parking and easy access. A top destination for bikers who value quality, variety, and want to gear up before setting off on long road trips.

name: Shox Győr
description: Shox Győr is a large, well-equipped motorcycle store in Győr, offering a broad selection of gear, parts, and accessories for all types of riders. You’ll find helmets, protective clothing, technical supplies, and everything needed to get road-ready. Located conveniently at Szent Imre út 69B with parking and easy access, it makes a perfect stop before heading off on longer rides. An ideal spot for riders looking to fully gear up and get expert guidance before hitting the road.

name: Shox
description: Shox is a sizable motorcycle store located just outside Budapest, specializing in high-quality gear, spare parts, and accessories for long-distance rides and adventures. Riders can find everything they need here—from protective helmets and apparel to consumables and touring essentials. The store offers hassle-free access and parking, making it an ideal stop before hitting the open road. A great place to gear up and get expert tips before setting off on your journey.

name: Shox Kecskemét Motoros Áruház
description: Shox Kecskemét Motoros Áruház is one of the largest motorcycle stores in Hungary, offering an extensive range of gear, accessories, and technical supplies. Local riders praise its wide selection, excellent service, and friendly staff. Conveniently located in Kecskemét, it provides easy access for those preparing to hit the road. A great stop to gear up and get expert advice before setting off on your biking adventure.

name: Fokt Motor Kft.
description: Fokt Motor Kft. in Budapest is a well-established motorcycle showroom operating since 1991, representing top-tier European gear and accessory brands. Riders can discover everything from premium helmets, apparel, and boots to bags and communication devices—perfect for long-distance journeys. Customers praise the attentive and patient service, along with a rich inventory that makes road trip preparation seamless. Situated conveniently within the city, it’s an ideal spot for gearing up before hitting the open road.

name: Louis Wien-Nord - Motorradbekleidung und Motorradzubehör
description: Louis Wien-Nord is Europe’s largest retailer for motorcycle clothing and technology, featuring over 55,000 products from 500 brands across more than 85 stores. The store delivers a special shopping experience with comfortable seating areas, modern facilities, and expert advice. Located conveniently at Kagraner Platz in north Vienna, it offers parking and easy access. A prime spot to gear up and consult with seasoned riders before hitting the road.

name: POLO motorcycle Store Vienna
description: POLO Motorrad Store in Vienna is located at Triester Straße 275 and serves as a trusted hub for bikers looking for clothing, accessories, and technical gear. They offer a wide selection of products and have knowledgeable staff to assist with all your needs. The store is conveniently located with nearby metro access, parking, and quick routes to the highway. A great stop to gear up and get pro advice before hitting the road.

name: MKC Moto by Bike Expert
description: MKC Moto by Bike Expert is a spacious motorcycle showroom covering around 2000 m², offering a vast range of gear and clothing for all riding styles — from street riders to touring enthusiasts. Their experienced staff is available six days a week, ready to help match your kit to your journey level and riding needs. Conveniently located in Wiener Neustadt, the store offers easy access and parking — a great option before heading out on the road. Perfect for those who seek expert guidance and full prep for their biking adventure.

name: MKC Moto Graz Motorradbekleidung
description: MKC Moto Graz is a spacious motorcycle clothing outlet covering approximately 1,200 m², offering gear and accessories at attractive outlet prices with substantial discounts. Located in the Puntigam district of Graz, the store features a wide selection of men's and women's collections and is praised for its customer service. Friendly specialists are on hand to help match your kit to your riding style. With its convenient location, free parking, and complimentary coffee, it’s a perfect stop before heading off on a long-distance ride.

name: BIKE CORNER BADEN
description: Bike Corner Baden is a modern biker hub located within the Bierbaum Motorradhaus in Baden, offering a wide range of gear and accessories. You’ll find everything from helmets and apparel to communication systems and luggage options, suited for both on-road and off-road riding. Conveniently situated inside the motorcycle house and open daily, it’s a reliable stop before heading out on your ride. A great choice for riders who value quality, variety, and want to gear up with a professional edge.

name: Zweirad Ginzinger St. Pölten
description: Zweirad Ginzinger in Sankt Pölten is a trusted motorcycle hub offering retail, gear, parts, and workshop services at Niederösterreichring 22. The showroom features a broad selection of accessories and apparel from top motorcycle brands, alongside repair and maintenance services. Skilled staff are on hand to assist with product selection and technical inquiries. A solid pre-ride stop—perfect for gearing up and tapping into local rider knowledge before hitting the road.

name: Bike Factory Krems
description: Bike Factory Krems is a major motorcycle dealer and service center in Krems, located on Gewerbeparkstraße, offering both new and certified pre-owned bikes from a wide range of brands. You can also access comprehensive services including repairs, maintenance, safety inspections (Pickerl), and custom upgrades. The showroom features a broad selection of accessories, gear, and demo bikes—perfect for pre-ride preparation. With its convenient location, knowledgeable staff, and full-service offerings, it’s a go-to stop before motorcycle adventures across Austria.

name: La Terrazza
description: La Terrazza is a cozy seaside restaurant in the Herceg Novi area, well-regarded among travelers and motorcyclists. It serves fresh seafood, traditional Mediterranean dishes, and a fine selection of wines. The spacious terrace and peaceful sea view make it an ideal spot to relax after a long ride. A great stop for bikers to enjoy a good meal and recharge before hitting the road again.

name: G&S Motorcycles SRL
description: G&S Motorcycles SRL is a clean, modern workshop conveniently located in Bucharest near the Constanța bridge. Skilled motorcycle enthusiasts run the place, offering repairs, maintenance, and accident-related support. The service is top-notch — RAR certified and capable of handling all bike makes and models. A solid stop for riders looking to get their motorcycle road-ready before hitting the next leg of their ride.

name: BORA MOTO
description: BORA MOTO is a modern motorcycle service shop in Cluj-Napoca, specializing in professional care, bike detailing, and technical maintenance. They proudly style themselves as Romania’s only “SPA MOTO,” offering your ride the kind of pampering usually reserved for a spa. Located conveniently on Strada Someșului, it’s a great stop for riders looking to freshen up their bikes before hitting the road again. An ideal place to pause, show your machine some love, and roll out ready for your next leg.

name: MV Garage
description: MV Garage is a reliable motorcycle service located in the Lumina area of Romania, offering pre-owned bike inspections and professional diagnostics. Certified technicians are available to provide top-quality maintenance and technical support when needed. They emphasize careful attention to every detail of your ride. A great stop for riders aiming to get their bike road-ready or secure before continuing their journey.

name: John's Garage
description:
John's Garage is a concept born in 2015, but with 15 years of experience behind it, fueled by passion, ambition, and not least hard work, we decided to launch the brand well-known among all enthusiasts of extreme or less extreme sports, both in Brasov and throughout Romania, John’s Garage. Our team, made up of professionals, also driven by the same values and passion for motorcycles, scooters, jet skis, and ATVs, is ready to help you find the solution that suits you best.
We offer a full range of repair services for motorcycles, ATVs, jet skis, buggies, and snowmobiles.

name: DG Customs
description: DG Customs is a motorcycle service workshop in Brașov offering a full range of services — from repairs and scheduled maintenance to tire changes, inspections (ITP), and bodywork. They also provide painting, custom wraps, and bespoke bike tuning. The professional approach and attention to detail make DG Customs a reliable spot for riders looking to continue their journey without worrying about their machine. A great place to get your bike road-ready and ride on with confidence.

name: Profi motorszerviz
description: Profi motorszerviz is a professional motorcycle workshop in Budapest, specializing in servicing and repairing bikes of all makes. They offer comprehensive technical diagnostics, tuning, consumable replacements, and complex repair work with top-quality results. Experienced mechanics handle both routine maintenance and custom restoration or tuning projects. A reliable stop to get your bike ready before hitting the road again.

name: DunaMoto Szerviz
description: DunaMoto Szerviz is a welcoming, highly skilled workshop in Budafok where you can get comprehensive services — from quick oil changes and diagnostics to suspension care, wheel balancing, and thorough inspections. You'll be greeted with a cup of coffee, and the mechanics are happy to answer all your questions. Known for their meticulous attention, professionalism, and rider-first attitude, they earn glowing reviews for being precise, fast, and trustworthy. A great stop to refresh, ensure your bike is in top form, and carry on your ride with confidence.

name: Master Motor Motorkerékpár Szerviz
description: Master Motor Motorkerékpár Szerviz is a conveniently located workshop in Budapest's 22nd district, offering a friendly and relaxed atmosphere. They specialize in quick services - oil changes, minor repairs, tuning, and diagnostics done efficiently. The experienced mechanics are approachable and ready to understand the issue, helping riders get back on the road swiftly. A perfect stopover during your ride: quick bike care so you can continue your journey without unnecessary delays.

name: Triumph Budapest
description: Triumph Budapest is the official dealership and service centre located at Üllői út 143 in Budapest. Here you'll find a wide range of new and certified motorcycles, genuine accessories and riding gear, along with professional service support. Test rides and expert consultations are available to help you match the bike to your riding style and adventure needs. A perfect stop to update your ride between routes and continue your journey with confidence.

name: MFmotors engine service
description: MFmotors Engine Service is a well-regarded motorcycle workshop in Budapest, specializing in repairs and maintenance for a wide range of brands, including MV Agusta, Kawasaki, and Yamaha. They offer comprehensive services - from diagnostics and routine servicing to complex engine and chassis work. Riders consistently praise MFmotors for their precision, professionalism, and personalized approach, with reviews full of recommendations. An ideal stop for bikers looking to ensure their ride is tuned and ready before hitting the road.

name: Benisch Thomas Tom's Bike Service
description: Tom’s Bike Service is a family-run motorcycle workshop in Vienna, located on Staudiglgasse in the Favoriten district. They handle everything from routine maintenance, inspections (Pickerl), and repairs to custom tuning, accident recovery, and insurance paperwork with care and expertise. Riders especially value the shop's responsiveness, warmth, and willingness to help—even stepping in quickly when needed, such as draining excess oil just before closing time. A great spot to get your bike back in shape and continue your journey with confidence and peace of mind.

name: BMW Motorcycle Center Vienna
description: BMW Motorcycle Center Vienna is an official dealership and service center for BMW motorcycles, conveniently located in Vienna. You can explore new bikes, genuine accessories, gear, and components, along with accessing high-quality maintenance and service options. Test rides and expert consultations are available to help match your ride to your travel ambitions. A great stopover between routes—perfect for upgrading your machine or getting professional advice before heading onward.

name: PS Moto
description: PS Moto is a respected motorcycle workshop and dealership located at Marie-Louisen-Strasse 1b in Bad Ischl. They offer a comprehensive range of services, from diagnostics and maintenance to restoration of classic bikes, and they also sell new and pre-owned motorcycles, parts, and riding gear. Renowned for its attentive service, personalized care, and strategic location just off the B158 highway, it's a perfect pit stop to prepare for a ride through the scenic Salzkammergut region. The workshop is open Tuesday through Friday for service in the morning and afternoon, with sales and consultations also available on Saturday morning.

name: Mountain Motors
description: Mountain Motors is a leading dealership and motorcycle service workshop located in Bruck an der Mur, specializing in custom bikes and choppers. They offer repairs, maintenance, and full-cycle custom builds — from classic styles to exotic fighters. The team works with Harley-Davidson and various other brands, also providing parts and accessories. With expert craftsmanship and a welcoming vibe, it's an ideal stop for riders looking to entrust their machine to skilled professionals.

name: Moto Psycho Tichy KG
description: MotoPsycho Tichy is a welcoming, professional motorcycle workshop located in Vienna’s Ottakring district at Hubergasse 14, 1160 Wien. They are brand-independent and offer services like diagnostics, maintenance, tire changes, and official §57a inspections ("Pickerl"). Riders praise the shop for its honest pricing, excellent customer service, and personalized attention. A great pit stop to get your bike road-ready or freshened up whether you're setting out or rolling in after a long haul.

name: Ljubljana Castle
description: The Ljubljana Castle sits on a hilltop, overlooking the city for almost 900 years. Riders can reach the base through winding city streets and then hike or take the funicular up. Bikers will enjoy the medieval walls, towers, and panoramic views from the top. It’s a perfect stop for a break and some photos with the city skyline.

name: Bled Castle (Blejski grad)
description: Bled Castle is one of the most scenic castles in Europe, perched above Lake Bled. Getting there means riding through narrow roads surrounded by mountains and forests — a joy for bikers. Inside, there’s a museum and even a blacksmith’s forge, while the terrace offers breathtaking views. A perfect place for a break and inspiration on your ride.

name: Predjama Castle (Predjamski grad)
description: Predjama Castle is a unique fortress built directly into a cliff, looking like something from a knight’s tale. The road there winds through countryside routes and scenic valleys, making the ride memorable. The castle is famous for stories of knight Erazem and his secret tunnels. Riders will appreciate the rare blend of nature and medieval architecture.

name: Postojna Caves (Postojnska jama)
description: Postojna Cave is the largest karst cave system in Europe, stretching over 20 km. The ride there takes you through winding roads of the Karst region, a favorite for bikers. Inside, you board an underground train and see stalactites shaped like palaces. The mysterious atmosphere makes it an unforgettable stop.

name: Piranski svetilnik
description: Piranski svetilnik is a famous lighthouse in Piran, Slovenia, standing right on the Adriatic coast. It’s a symbol of the old seaside town and draws travelers with its unique atmosphere and panoramic views. Bikers can stop here to enjoy the sea breeze and stunning sunsets. It’s a perfect spot for a short break, great photos, and a moment of relaxation on the road.

name: Celjski grad
description: The Celje Castle is the largest medieval fortress in Slovenia, with towers and underground halls. The roads leading there pass through hills and small towns, adding to the sense of adventure. The castle is tied to legends of the powerful Counts of Celje. Riders will enjoy the open space and panoramic views from the towers.

name: Mariborski grad
description: Maribor Castle, built in the 15th century, stands in the city center and tells the history of Maribor. The ride there along the Drava Valley is both scenic and convenient for bikers. Inside, there’s a museum with weapons and historical artifacts. It’s a great spot for a short cultural break.

name: Seeker 2000
description:
NO RACE !! The SEEKER 2000 is Motorcycle Adventure Rallye for classic enduros and the format was deliberately designed to be minimalist and very simple. No compulsion and no big event program give our participants the feeling of freedom. We guarantee you maximum fun and the usual professional support in a familiar atmosphere. A fascinating Motorcycle Adventure Raid especially for Classic (young timer) Enduro motorcycles, leads us through the most beautiful sections of the Balkan. We want to celebrate these motorcycles again and we would love to see them in action.

This event is not for beginners! The motorcycle must withstand the rigors of off-road riding.

The “Seeker Vagabonds” follow the navigation with tracks and waypoints through breathtaking landscapes through Bosnia and Hercegovina and Montenegro. The route runs in a LOOP of approx.1000km. The start and finish of this Motorcycle Adventure Raid is Konjic (BIH) near Sarajevo. Part of the 6-day motorcycle trip is the overnight stay in various base camps, where each rider is responsible for board and lodging. As close as possible to nature! Participation is only possible with classic enduro motorcycles built up to year 2000! The participants must definitely have some off-road experience.

name: Viewing tower at Rašica
description: A 30m wooden tower offering 360° panoramas of the Kamnik-Savinja Alps, Ljubljana Marshes, and rolling green hills — perfect for sunrise hikes and spotting grazing Lipizzaner horses.

name: View point Piran
description: A stunning seaside viewpoint offering panoramic vistas of Piran’s red-tiled rooftops, the Adriatic Sea, and the Italian coast — best at sunset when the limestone buildings glow golden

name: Panorama view Rânca
description: A high-altitude viewpoint (1,650m) in the Parâng Mountains offering dramatic vistas of glacial lakes, rugged peaks, and the Lotru Valley — accessible via the Transalpina Road (DN67C) or hiking trails from Rânca resort.

name: Hunedoara View point
description: A historic viewpoint offering dramatic frontal views of Corvin Castle’s Gothic towers and bridges over the Zlaști River, best photographed at dusk when the fortress is illuminated.

name: Point View Șotrile
description: A mountain roadside viewpoint along DJ207 offering sweeping panoramas of the Prahova Valley, Bucegi Mountains, and traditional shepherd huts — perfect for quick photo stops during Transfăgărășan or Transalpina road trips.

name: View Point Sohodol
description: A hidden gem viewpoint in the Apuseni Geopark, offering lush green valleys, limestone cliffs, and traditional wooden villages — perfect for sunrise hikes and spotting karst formations.

name: Belvedere Glăvoaia
description: A dramatic karst plateau viewpoint in the Apuseni Geopark, offering panoramic vistas of the Glăvoaia Canyon, natural arches, and dense beech forests — accessible via a moderate hike from the Padiș tourist center.

name: Cheile Turzii Viewpoint
description: A breathtaking canyon overlook in the Turda Gorge Natural Reserve, offering vertical limestone cliffs, the Hășdate River winding below, and rock climbers scaling routes like "Viața de Vieci" — best visited at noon when sunlight illuminates the gorge depths.

name: Adriatic Moto Tours
description: A premium motorcycle rental and tour agency specializing in guided adventures along the Adriatic Coast, offering BMW and Ducati models for exploring Slovenian and Croatian coastal roads.

name: Moto rent Godič
description: Motorcycle rental service near Ljubljana offering adventure bikes (BMW R1250GS, KTM 1290) and sport-touring models (Yamaha Tracer 9) for exploring Triglav National Park and Julian Alps.

name: Mis moto, oddaja motornih koles, Jurij Zupančič s.p.
description: A personalized motorcycle rental service run by enthusiast Jurij Zupančič, offering well-maintained touring bikes (e.g., BMW R1200RT) for exploring Slovenia’s alpine roads and hidden gems.

name: Rent4Ride Motorcycle Rental
description: BMW Motorcycle Rental Romania - From 45€/day Rent premium BMW motorcycles in Romania with Rent4Ride. We offer the BMW G650GS starting at 45€/day - the lowest prices for BMW motorcycle rental in Europe! Perfect for exploring Transfagarasan and beyond. ✓ BMW R1300GS Available ✓ Lowest Prices in Romania ✓ Bucharest Airport Pickup Available 24/7 ✓ BMW F900GS Available ✓ Moto rentals

name: Romania Motorcycle Tours
description: Guided motorcycle adventures across Romania’s epic roads like Transfăgărășan and Transalpina, with BMW/Honda rentals and expert local guides

name: Romania Moto Adventure
description: Motorcycle rental and guided tour service based in Bucharest, specializing in off-road and adventure routes across the Carpathians, including Transylvania and the Danube Delta.

name: CatRider - Premium Motorcycle Rentals & Tours
description: Premium motorcycle rental and tour service in Bucharest offering high-end models (BMW R1250GS, Ducati Multistrada) for conquering Romania’s epic roads like Transfăgărășan and Transalpina.

name: Paprika Vendéglő
description: Paprika Vendéglő is a great spot when you want a real Hungarian meal on the road: rich soups, hearty goulash, and dishes with meat, poultry, and fish. There’s also a good selection of salads and desserts — from classic treats to those with cheese and fruit. The menu accommodates different tastes with vegetarian options, and servings are generous.

name: Hell's Kitchen – Hungarian Restaurant
description:
the best traditional hungarian dishes
Carefully selected ingredients
Live gypsy music every evening
Award-winning master chef

name: Kismező - Hungarian Cuisine
description: A cozy bistro celebrating traditional Hungarian flavors with modern twists, famous for its goulash soup, chicken paprikash, and homemade somlói galuska — all served in a rustic-chic setting with vintage posters.

name: Grand Hotel Tuzla
description:
The hotel building was built in 1985, it is one of the most beautiful hotel residences in the ex Yugoslavia, and over time it became one of the symbols of Tuzla.
In August 2022, the Hotel was taken over by a new owner, and the Grand prefix is added to the name, and a new management is hired with the task of restoring the Grand Hotel Tuzla to its old glory.

Currently, the hotel has 43 renovated single and double rooms, 8 small and large apartments.

name: Pansion Kipovi
description: In the strict city centre, our establishment is located near "Kipovi Bridge", after which the guesthouse is named. We offer quality service at an affordable price, with a wide selection of rooms to suit your taste. The restaurant is of a basic type and only offers breakfast in the form of a buffet.The Kipovi guesthouse has single, double, and triple rooms equipped with internet connection, TV connection with a wide selection of channels, as well as a sanitary unit, air conditioning, and breakfast included in the price. In any of our rooms, the following are available to you: Satellite TV/cable/ bathroom and toilet/ hot water/ air conditioning/ heating/ separate entrance/ parking/ restaurant. Visit us and see the quality of our offer.

name: The Chedi Luštica Bay
description:
At the nexus of gentle azure seas and majestic mountains, you'll find The Chedi Luštica Bay - a luxury 5-star Montenegro hotel. Located on the magnificent Montenegrin coast 16 km from Tivat, The Chedi Luštica Bay welcomes travelers to unwind amidst authentic, breathable luxury.

This luxurious retreat, a member of The Leading Hotels of The World, encompasses 111 exceptionally elegant rooms and suites, two restaurants, two bars, versatile meeting facilities, a private beach, an Asian-inspired Spa, an indoor pool, and an outdoor infinity pool. From our culinary artistry to our thoughtful guest amenities, The Chedi Luštica Bay offers everything you could expect from one of the most exclusive luxury Montenegro hotels, brought to life with genuine hospitality and flawless service that has anticipated your every need.

Visit us and create your memories on the Adriatic Coast.

name: Lustica Bay Vacation Homes
description:
With just the right blend of thoughtful service and a relaxed coastal pace, Luštica Bay vacation homes in Montenegro offer a refined way to experience coastal living.
Our studios to townhouse residences have been meticulously designed to reflect the essence of living by the sea. Each space invites comfort, where soft light, open layouts, and natural textures echo the calm of life by the Adriatic.
Whether for a short stay or an extended escape, each home offers open views and effortless access to the region’s treasures. Enjoy the blissful mix of comfort and unobstructed sea views – offering you an incomparable experience of the unspoilt beauty of the Luštica Peninsula, while being only a short drive away from the town centres of Tivat, Kotor, and Boka Bay hotspots.

name: Bran Castle (Brașov)
description:
A fortress guarding the Rucăr–Bran pass and one of Romania’s most photogenic castles. It later became Queen Marie’s residence and now houses a museum with sweeping mountain views. The approach offers curvy roads and scenic pull-offs—great for a quick stop and coffee. Park near the base and walk up to the gate for the full reveal.
Bran Castle has had many owners in its time. First it belonged to the ruler Mircea the Old, and then to the inhabitants of Brasov and the Habsburg Empire. According to legend, the famous ruler Vlad the Impaler-Dracula spent the night here during his campaigns, and the area surrounding Bran Castle was the ruler's favorite hunting ground. According to one version, he was tortured in the dungeons of the castle by the Turks, and therefore Bran Castle is also called Dracula's Castle.

name: Peles Castle
description: Commissioned by King Carol I and built between 1873–1914, this Neo-Renaissance palace dazzles with lavish rooms and a superb arms collection. Manicured terraces and forested slopes make the grounds perfect for a leg-stretch. The Prahova Valley ride is scenic but busy - early arrivals are best. Park near the lower alley and walk up through the gardens.

name: Corvin Castle
description: A 15th-century Gothic-Renaissance stronghold tied to John Hunyadi—arguably Transylvania’s most dramatic castle. The approach roads are fun, and the wooden bridge to the gate is made for photos. Inside you’ll find grand halls and bastions wrapped in legend. A rewarding stop when riding the western Carpathian corridors.

name: Sighisoara Citadel (UNESCO)
description: One of Europe’s best-preserved inhabited medieval citadels and a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1999. Cobblestones, the Clock Tower, and artisan streets make for an atmospheric wander. The ride along the Mureș Valley is gentle and scenic; parking is easier just outside the lower gates. A quiet, compact stop for coffee and photos.

name: Citadel of Alba Carolina
description: An 18th-century star-shaped stronghold in the Vauban tradition, complete with seven bastions and monumental gates. Vast grounds invite slow exploration on foot between ravelins and boulevards. Reaching it means relaxed riding through vineyards and Apuseni hills. Park outside the walls and stroll in for the full scale.

name: Sarmizegetusa Regia (Dacian Fortresses, UNESCO)
description: The spiritual and political heart of the Dacian kingdom within the UNESCO-listed Orăștie Mountains fortresses. Stone terraces and sacred circles sit deep in wooded hills with a hushed, timeless feel. Approaches are calm mountain roads; expect slower final kilometers. A contemplative off-highway stop steeped in ancient history.

name: Voronet Monastery (Painted Churches of Moldova, UNESCO)
description: Famous for its exterior frescoes and the intense “Voroneț blue,” a signature of Bukovina. Founded by Stephen the Great in 1488, it’s part of the UNESCO-listed Churches of Moldavia. Northern Bukovina’s rolling roads make a relaxed ride, especially in shoulder seasons. Expect a serene stop amid gardens and monastery walls.

name: Histria Citadel's Museum
description: Established in 1982, under the auspices of the Museum of National History and Archaeology in Constanţa, in a new building, the museum exhibits pieces of Greek, Roman and Byzantine archaeology, coming from research in Histria and the surrounding area: amphorae, inscriptions, ceramic vessels, glass, ornaments, Hellenistic bas-reliefs and others.

name: Palace of Parliament
description: Ceaușescu’s colossal legacy—among the world’s heaviest buildings and one of the largest administrative complexes. Tours reveal its staggering scale and ornate interiors. Riding into central Bucharest means traffic and some cobbles—aim for early hours. Parking is around the perimeter, with viewpoints on the surrounding boulevards.

name: Agape Farmstay & Campsite
description:
Agape Farmstay & Campsite is a small eco site tucked into the forested hills above Kotor Bay, with wide views over Tivat Bay and quick access to Lustica’s beaches.
Expect a laid-back, community vibe: a shared lounge hut, a fire pit with wood, and simple farm-to-table dinners/breakfasts on request.
Facilities are intentionally basic and eco-minded—compost toilets, showers, and power in the common area; the campground typically operates from May to November. Hiking paths, village churches, and scenic viewpoints are close by.

name: Hotel Boka
description: Boka Hotel is the ideal choice for a relaxing stay on the Montenegrin coast, midway between Budva, Tivat and Kotor. We are perfectly connected to attractions such as Luštica Bay, Porto Montenegro, the authentic fishing village of Bigovo, and Lovćen National Park.

name: Gusinjska Kula
description: Gusinjska Kula is a charming and historic family-run retreat, built around 300 years ago in the picturesque Gusinje Valley, at the foot of the majestic Prokletije Mountains. Originally a traditional stone tower, it has been carefully renovated to blend its rich history with modern comforts, offering guests a unique and welcoming stay. As one of the main symbols of Gusinje, the Kula holds deep cultural significance and adds to the area's unique charm. The rooms are spacious and thoughtfully designed, combining the original rustic character of the tower with all the conveniences of today. Whether you’re here to relax, enjoy the peaceful surroundings, or explore nearby hiking trails and local attractions, Gusinjska Kula provides the perfect base for your adventure. As a family business, we take pride in offering a personal and warm experience to all our guests. Whether you're drawn to the natural beauty of the area or the fascinating history of the Kula, your stay with us will be a memorable one.

name: Lazure Hotel & Marina
description:
Step in to a classical yet modernized hotel, whose 300-year-old walls stood through the major events in Montenegro’s history.
We give our guests the chance to go beyond and seek out all that Montenegro has to offer. You may choose to meander through trails or boat through the azure waters of Boka Bay or dive into new and exquisite flavours. We offer you new ways to pique your adventurous spirit.

name: Buda Castle / Budavári Palota
description: The Royal Palace crowns the Buda Hills with sweeping views over the Danube. Reaching it via the Castle District means cobblestones and gentle twists—plan a few extra minutes. Park down the hill or nearby and walk or ride the funicular up. It’s a prime stop for panoramas, a stretch of the legs, and a wander through historic lanes.

name: Church of Matthias / Mátyás-templom
description: This Gothic church with colorful Zsolnay tiles anchors the Castle District beside Fisherman’s Bastion. Narrow lanes and cobbles set the mood but call for careful riding. Aim for early morning or golden hour for softer light and fewer crowds. Park on the district’s edge and stroll into Trinity Square.

name: Basilica of Esztergom / Esztergomi Bazilika
description: Hungary’s largest church overlooks the Danube Bend, a classic ride with flowing riverside roads. Expect scenic pull-offs and easy navigation. Park at the base and walk up via paths and stairs to the basilica. The viewpoints take in the bridge and neighboring Slovakia

name: Vysehrad Citadel / Visegrádi Fellegvár
description: A medieval hilltop stronghold with postcard views over the Danube Bend. The final ascent is steep and twisty with some uneven patches. Park near the upper gate; below lies the royal palace ruins and riverside promenade. It’s a perfect climb-shoot-descend combo between Esztergom and Budapest.

name: Eger Castle / Egri vár
description: Famous for the 1552 siege, Eger Castle offers museums and ramparts over the red-roofed old town. Expect cobbles and traffic-calmed zones—ride in gently. Park on the edge of the center and walk up. Afterwards, roll over to the “Valley of the Beautiful Woman” for wine cellars and snacks.

name: Hollókő Castle
description: Its core was raised shortly after the Mongol invasion (1241–1242) by the Kacsics clan, then expanded with bastions, a zwinger-like passage, and rock-cut cisterns to sustain a hilltop defense. A distinctive feature is the pentagonal old keep around which inner and lower baileys were built—the multi-tier layout and odd-angled tower are easy to read from above and on site. What makes Hollókő special is the intact pairing of castle + authentic Palóc village below; the whole historic landscape (strip fields, orchards, vineyards) is UNESCO-protected. Local lore of a witch and ravens carrying stones away at night gives the “Raven-Rock” name its bite and adds to the site’s identity. Recent works under Hungary’s National Castle Programme improved paths, viewpoints, and small exhibits without over-restoring the ruin.

name: Pannonhalma Abbey (UNESCO) / Pannonhalma Archabbey
description: A Benedictine foundation since 996, with a famed library, basilica, and vineyards on gentle hills. Approaches are calm backroads with mild gradients. Park at the visitor center and explore the complex and vines on foot. A contemplative pause mid-ride.

name: Early Christian Necropolis of Pécs (UNESCO)
description: The Early Christian Necropolis of Pécs is a complex of 4th-century underground burial chambers and memorial chapels from the Roman city of Sopianae, inscribed on the UNESCO List in 2000. Walkways reveal wall paintings with early Christian iconography—the Good Shepherd, doves, vine scrolls, the Chi-Rho—capturing a community’s new faith. The site makes the late-Roman transition from pagan customs to Christian commemoration strikingly tangible. The Cella Septichora Visitor Centre links the excavated crypts with the seven-apsed chapel and clear exhibits on funerary practice and urban layout. A visit lets you explore the city’s “lower floor” and watch medieval Pécs emerge from its Roman foundations.

name: Sümeg Castle / Sümegi vár
description: A commanding hilltop citadel north of Lake Balaton, popular for knightly tournaments and re-enactments. The last stretch is steep with rough patches—keep it smooth and steady. Park at the base and hike to the gate. The reward is a 360° view over the Bakony Hills and nearby villages.

name: Szigliget Fortress / Szigligeti vár
description: Romantic ruins on a volcanic hill with sweeping views over Lake Balaton. The north-shore ride treats you to vineyards and lakeside panoramas. Park at the lower lot and walk up—the sunset light is superb. A perfect day-ender before a lakeside meal.

name: Schönbrunn Palace
description: The Habsburgs’ summer palace with vast gardens, fountains, and the Gloriette is a Vienna must-see. Approaching through city traffic and speed-limited streets is easier at dawn. Use the perimeter or nearby garages and walk in. It’s a fine place to decompress after urban riding and grab panoramic shots from the Gloriette.

name: St. Stephen's Cathedral
description: Vienna’s Gothic icon with its patterned roof anchors the old town. The core is pedestrianized - park along the Ringstrasse or in a nearby garage and walk in. Climb the tower for views over the Ring and rooftops. Early morning or golden hour keeps crowds down and light soft.

name: Hohensalzburg Fortress
description:
Hohensalzburg Fortress was begun in 1077 under Archbishop Gebhard during the Investiture Controversy and was reinforced and enlarged over the centuries. It epitomized the temporal-spiritual power of Salzburg’s prince-archbishops; in the late 15th–16th centuries, Leonhard von Keutschach added the showpiece residences—the Golden Hall and Golden Chamber. The fortress preserves a rare mechanical aerophone, the “Salzburg Bull” (c. 1502), once heard over the city on feast days. Counted among Europe’s largest and best-preserved medieval castles, it was never taken by force; in 1800 the garrison surrendered without a fight to Napoleonic troops.
 Ride the riverside roads, park in the cliff-side garages, then take the funicular up. Expect bastions, museums, and 360° mountain views. A perfect breather between Alpine twisties.

name: Melk Abbey
description: A baroque monastery with a famed library and terraces above the Danube - signature Wachau scenery. The B3/B33 riverside roads are gentle and scenic, lined with vines and castles. Park at the base and stroll up. It’s tailor-made for a slow lunch and Danube photo breaks.

name: Dürnstein Castle Ruins (Wachau)
description: Known for the legend of King Richard the Lionheart, these hilltop ruins overlook the blue Danube. Vineyard-lined lanes make for a dreamy, unhurried approach. Park in the village below and hike up. The payoff is a sweeping view over the Wachau gorge.

name: Hochosterwitz Castle (Carinthia)
description: A storybook stronghold on a limestone peak, famed for its series of fortified gates. The final approach is short but steep—keep it smooth. Park at the base and hike up through the gate sequence (seasonal lift may operate). Expect wide Carinthian views and compact exhibits.

name: Burg Hohenwerfen
description: A medieval stronghold above the Salzach valley with famed falconry and views toward the Watzmann. Access from the A10 is quick, but older valley loops are more fun. Park below and ride the funicular or walk up. A great tempo change between mountain passes.

name: Jadran
description:
Located on the stunning promenade of Budva at Slovenska Obala, Restaurant Jadran Kod Krsta has been a landmark of Montenegrin seaside dining since 1976.
With an expansive terrace right by the waves and an interior steeped in family hospitality, the restaurant invites you to explore a rich menu of fresh Adriatic seafood, expertly grilled meats, vegetarian options and Mediterranean classics.
Live music and a full-bar set the vibe for an evening by the sea.
Whether you’re wrapping up a bike ride or enjoying a coastal stop-over, Restaurant Jadran offers a scenic and satisfying break.

name: Route 66
description: Route 66 is a laid-back, rider-friendly bar in Risan, a short stroll from the waterfront and right off the coastal road. It’s drinks-forward - ice-cold beers and straightforward mixed drinks, no fuss. A rock-leaning playlist and a small outdoor area make it an easy meet-up before or after a loop around the bay. A handy pit stop en route to Perast/Kotor or before climbing inland via Grahovo toward Nikšić.

name: Riegersburg Castle
description: A massive fortress perched on a basalt cone, visible for miles. The final climb is steep; a lift exists, but the footpath is more scenic. Park near the visitor center below. Expect museums, ramparts, and 360° views over Styria’s “volcanic” hill country.

name: MEININGER Hotel Innsbruck Zentrum
description:
Hotel Innsbruck
An urban alpine experience
Backpackers, business professionals, families and tour groups drawn to the mountains will find an incredible place to stay at our hotel in Innsbruck. Comfortable facilities, modest prices and an agreeably central location: our guests love to return to us after a day exploring the city or hitting the slopes.

With our hybrid design, we are more than just a youth hostel. With a classic MEININGER range of room options- from single to multi-bedded rooms and dorms - and typical contemporary amenities, we are the perfect choice for accommodation in Innsbruck.

name: Montagu Bed & Beers
description: Welcome to Montagu Bed & Beers Hostel Innsbruck. In this colorful place we care about each other with love and respect. We invite you to be a part of our philosophy, create a caring and peaceful atmosphere amongst each other and fill our hostel with life. Come visit us and discover the best Hostel to get to know Innsbruck and its locals!

name: Mountain Blast Guesthouse
description: Mountain Blast is located in Kirchdorf in Tirol, 16 km from Casino Kitzbuhel and 18 km from Golf Club Kitzbuhel Schwarzsee. It offers accommodation with a terrace and free WiFi, as well as free private parking. The property is 24 km from Hahnenkamm, 50 km from Max Aicher Arena, and 15 km from Kitzbüheler Horn. The guest house features garden views and a barbecue. At the guest house, rooms are fitted with a wardrobe. Mountain Blast offers a buffet or continental breakfast. Golf Club Kitzbuhel Kaps is 17 km from the accommodation. Salzburg Airport (W. A. ​​Mozart) is 62 km away, and the property offers a paid shuttle service to and from the airport.

name: The SKILL® Mountain Lodge - Hostel, Camping & Stellplatz
description:
The SKILL Mountain Lodge
Right next to the ski lift and the ski slope. In the heart of the bike park.
The Ski & Bike Hostel offers various categories of very affordable rooms with shared bathrooms or rooms with private bathrooms, as well as apartments with cooking facilities.
In winter, a simple breakfast buffet is included in the breakfast room.

name: Pension Brixen im Thale
description: “Pension Brixen im Thale” is a comfortable B & B in the centre of the sunny Brixen im Thale. Just five minutes away is the gondola station which transports you directly into the SkiWelt Wilder Brixental. The beautiful garden provides views of the Tyrolean mountains. The bathing lake, swimming pool and the “Fischerstadl” restaurant are two minutes away. Various cycling tours and hiking routes can be started directly from the house. WiFi is available free-of-charge. FAHRRAD ABSTELL PLATZ IM VERSPERRTEN RAUM MÖGLICH

name: Hotel Kaiserhof
description:
Feeling fine! at the Kaiserhof
Fine! has always been the way of life at the Hotel Kaiserhof Kitzbühel. From the cozy rooms to the exquisite cuisine to the attentive staff. Everything is done with imperial style and sophistication – throughout the entire hotel: high-quality, refined, and sophisticated. And a wide range of services that make all the difference. This also includes the authentic Kitzbühel experiences and relaxed yet active excursions into the mountains right on the doorstep. Right on the legendary Streif!

name: Safestay Kitzbühel Centre
description:
Kitzbühel at heart
It’s a place with a great opportunity to connect with a collective bunch of feel-good people looking for a dose of happiness, inspiration, good vibes and good times. The Roomie Alps Hostel, a place where like minded new friends connect, go skiing or hike up the most beautiful mountains.

Community
Our hostel is in the heart of Kitzbuehel. Most bars, clubs and restaurants in the city can be reached within a 5 minute walk. The cable car station is 7 minutes away and an easy walk which also leads you to the train station. Ski rental shops are all around and of course there is aprés ski.

Information
Our hostel is the perfect location for young people! If you need any information about Kitzbühel, our friendly staff will provide you with all the tips and insider information you need, such as the best places to eat, sightseeing, transportation, nightlife and more.

Our Vision
As we are travelers like you, we know exactly what you want out of a hostel and will do our very best to make you feel comfortable and make your stay in one of the most famous ski areas in the world unforgettable.

name: Hotel Jakobwirt
description:
Welcome to Hotel Jakobwirt

Located in the picturesque village of Westendorf, the 400-year-old Hotel Jakobwirt has now been transformed into an exclusive and luxurious 4-star hotel!

After extensive renovations, we are pleased to announce that we have reopened our doors and you can now enjoy the exclusive adults-only atmosphere. Our hotel offers beautifully renovated rooms, an elegant reception, a stylish restaurant, and various other common areas, as well as extensive wellness offerings.

At Hotel Jakobwirt, you will experience the perfect blend of traditional Austrian charm and modern luxury. Whether you want to enjoy the breathtaking slopes of the Kitzbühel Alps or simply relax in the enchanting surroundings of the Austrian Alps, our hotel promises a unique stay.

We look forward to welcoming you so you can enjoy an unforgettable stay and experience the unique atmosphere of Hotel Jakobwirt!

We can't wait to welcome you back and share the magic of Hotel Jakobwirt!

name: Austria Parks Camping Am Arlberg
description: Austria Parks comprises two beautiful campsites in Tyrol: Camping Leutasch and Camping am Arlberg. These campsites offer campers the perfect opportunity to enjoy Tyrol's pristine nature and breathtaking mountain scenery. Whether you want to relax amidst the Alps or enjoy adventurous outdoor activities, Austria Parks has something for everyone.

name: Pension Vallüla
description:
Pension Vallüla is a cozy family-owned hotel located in the charming town of Galtür, Austria. The hotel offers comfortable accommodations with picturesque mountain views, featuring family rooms with carpeted floors and shared bathrooms. Each room is equipped with modern amenities such as a TV, electric kettle, wardrobe, and sofa bed to ensure a pleasant stay for guests.

Guests at Pension Vallüla can enjoy essential facilities including a sun terrace, outdoor seating area, and free WiFi throughout the property. The hotel also provides convenient services such as private check-in and check-out, options for special diets, daily housekeeping, and a children's playground for young travelers to enjoy.

Located just 65 miles from Innsbruck Airport, the hotel is ideally situated near popular local attractions such as Fluchthorn, Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse, and Dreiländerspitze. Guests can easily explore the surrounding area with activities like skiing and cycling, making Pension Vallüla a perfect base for outdoor enthusiasts.

In addition to its prime location and comfortable accommodations, Pension Vallüla boasts impressive cleanliness scores of 8.80, excellent location scores of 9.20, and outstanding value for money scores of 9.20. Guests can rest assured that they will receive top-quality service and amenities during their stay at this charming Austrian guest house.

Whether you're seeking a relaxing mountain retreat or an adventure-filled getaway, Pension Vallüla in Galtür offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and value. With its warm hospitality and well-equipped facilities, this hotel is a wonderful choice for travelers looking to experience the beauty of the Austrian Alps.

name: Hotel24Steps
description:
Be my guests.
My name is Andreas Steibl, and under the motto "service is our success," I welcome you to Hotel24Steps.

Motorcycling is my passion – which is why I'm all the more pleased to welcome bikers to our hotel.

name: TOP Hotel Hochgurgl
description:
Welcome to TOP Hotel Hochgurgl! Bright mountain sunshine, snow-covered slopes and a picturesque view of the valley - look forward to a skiing holiday in one of the highest luxury hotels in Europe. Our top-class hotel guarantees snow from November to April with the ski slope right outside your door. In addition, you’ll enjoy many unique experiences, an exclusive spa, fantastic cuisine, and warm, first-class service.

We can’t wait to welcome you here at 2,150 metres above sea level!

name: Hotel Gurglhof
description: Obergurgl boasts a luxurious gem, as the 4 Star Superior Hotel Gurglhof radiates a fresh splendour. The Hotel Gurglhof has been thoroughly renovated and offers you exquisite luxury in the alpine Tyrolean style and of course with the usual relaxed atmosphere. The hotel is located in Obergurgl in the Ötz Valley directly by the ski slopes and is only a few steps away from the ski lifts. Embedded in the picturesque backdrop of the Ötz Valley Alps and their mighty three thousand metre peaks, your hotel in Obergurgl awaits you, sparkling in all its glory among the snow crystals. Take a seat by the fireplace in the lobby and let your gaze wander over the many charming details. Get straight into the holiday spirit in the Ötz Valley while the parking service brings your car to one of the underground parking spaces.

name: Hotel Alpenland
description:
The most beautiful three thousand metre peaks
At the very end of the Ötztal, where the three-thousand-metre peaks of the main Alpine ridge with their glaciers rise into the sky, you will find Hotel Alpenland.
Obergurgl, close to the tree line, is considered the highest situated church village in Austria. For some time now there have been traffic-calmed zones and a ban on driving at night, which is very much in keeping with the need for peace and quiet of many guests. In winter the centre of the popular Obergurgl-Hochgurgl ski area, in summer the starting point for hikes and mountain tours.

name: all inclusive Hotel Lohmann
description:
Welcome to the Hotel Lohmann - Your All Inclusive Hotel in Obergurgl
A relaxing and fun holiday awaits you at an altitude of 1,930 metres here at our all inclusive hotel in Obergurgl. The Hotel Lohmann stands out among other hotels in Obergurgl not only because of its top location, but also because it is a real treat for families with children who will especially enjoy our all inclusive services.

name: Lifestylehotel dasMAX
description:
We are your hotel for your lifestyle
We are the home base for adventurers, peace seekers, and global citizens. We are your lifestyle hotel in Seefeld, Tyrol. Treat yourself to a smart vacation with maximum simplicity. At dasMAX, you can do a lot and nothing is necessary. Relax to the MAX or stay active until you drop? – You decide. Located in the center of Seefeld, dasMAX, with its extremely cool and casual look, is waiting to give you a break that suits your taste. What are you waiting for?

We look forward to seeing you

name: Restoran Babić
description: Restoran Babić is a straightforward, family-run roadside spot in the hills above Herceg Novi, on the inland route toward Trebinje. The kitchen leans classic Montenegrin: charcoal-grilled meats, hearty stews, fresh seasonal salads, and simple sides done right. Portions are generous, prices fair, and the vibe is unpretentious - perfect for cooling down after a twisty mountain run. It’s the kind of place where a quick espresso or a slow lunch both make sense before you roll back onto the road.

name: Kavkaz Restarant
description:
Kavkaz serves a Caucasus-driven menu in the Herceg Novi area, blending Georgian and Azerbaijani comfort food - khinkali, khachapuri, kebabs, pilaf, grilled meats.
Expect hearty portions and straightforward flavors; desserts and tea sit alongside a short list of Georgian/Caucasus wines.
Set on the coastal Bokeški put corridor, it works well as an easy lunch or dinner stop when riding between Herceg Novi, Kumbor, and Bijela; outdoor tables appear in season.
In short: unfussy, filling, and distinctly regional - good fuel for the next coastal stretch.

name: Hotel Olimpija plus - Garni Hotel Montenegro
description: Hotel Olimpija plus is a straightforward waterfront stay in Kumbor, looking across the Verige strait toward Tivat. The draw here is the location: you roll off the coastal road straight to the bay for swims and sunset views, with Portonovi’s promenade just a few minutes down the shore. Rooms are simple and functional - ask for a sea-view balcony if available. For riders, it’s an easy overnight on the Herceg Novi–Kotor line with quick access to the Kamenari–Lepetane ferry and loops out to the Luštica peninsula.

name: Portofino
description:
Portofino is a casual café-bar in the historic center of Herceg Novi, tucked among the stone lanes and stairways of the Old Town.
The menu sticks to Mediterranean comforts - pizzas and pastas, simple grilled seafood and salads - alongside espresso, spritzes, beers, and local wines.
The vibe is unhurried and social, with an outdoor terrace that works well for a post-walk pause among the fortifications.
An easy pick for a coffee stop, a quick bite, or relaxed drinks right in the heart of the old quarter.

name: 0 Sterne Hotel Weisses Rössl ZeroHotel
description:
In 2005 Roberto bought the long-standing
Weisses Roessl Hotel at Leutasch in Tyrol albeit in a ruinous state.
Nonetheless he rebuilt it by his own hands and with limited financial resources.
In such a way, the old Weisses Roessel awoke to a new life, like the Phoenix from cinders.
The awakening of
the Phoenix

name: Hotel Ambasador
description: Hotel Ambasador proudly represents Split's history and modern architecture. Since the original Hotel Ambasador opened its doors in 1937, it has been integral to Split's soul. Join us as we thread a brand new story into Hotel Ambasador, designed to help you slow down and enjoy the little things in life.

name: Central Square Heritage Hotel
description:
Seagull Accommodation Group offers Luxury Accommodation in Split.

Designed by an achieved architect, our luxury rooms are a vision of the historical Split´s core values with just a touch of modernity combined with an interior uniquely painted by artists—the perfect combination of traditional meeting contemporary.

All of our properties are located at the rural heart of Split, at the entrance of Diocletian´s palace protected under UNESCO Cultural Heritage. Fantastic location for visiting the Split city center and experiencing the local atmosphere and cuisine. There are many local cuisine restaurant options in the vicinity of our properties. If you opt for a stay with bed and breakfast, we offer the breakfast in one of the highest recommended restaurants Bokeria kitchen & wine bar.

name: AC Hotel Split
description:
Experience the city from our high-rise hotel in Split
When deciding where to stay in Split, there is a lot to consider. The AC Hotel Split is one of the prime hotels in the city center of Split. This newly built high-rise hotel is conveniently situated just a 10-minute walk away from the lively old town and historic Diocletian's Palace, ensuring easy access to everything Split has to offer. With a collection of 214 meticulously crafted guest rooms and five collaborative conference rooms, the AC Hotel in Split ensures a comfortable and productive stay for both business travellers and adventure-seekers. What's more, each guest room provides awe-inspiring vistas of the Adriatic Sea and the charming city of Split, offering a truly memorable experience. When it comes to modern hotels in Split, we've got you covered. Indulge in ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation at our spa, where you can unwind while being captivated by the breathtaking views. Alternatively, you can enjoy a workout at our 17th-floor fitness center with premium Matrix equipment

name: Beach Hotel Split
description: The hotel has several types of rooms and each one is special in its own way so each guest can find themselves what suits him best - from a sense of a ship deck to the sandy beach.

name: Hotel Neptun Dubrovnik
description:
An iconic property that has built its tradition of hospitality excellence for over 50 years is an ideal choice for travellers looking for a truly memorable vacation in the sun. Royal Neptun offers access to a stunning beach along the crystal clear Adriatic Sea as well as the proximity to the Old town of Dubrovnik.

Being the highest building in Dubrovnik area, Neptun boasts spectacular views overlooking Babin Kuk, Lapad Bay and the Elaphite Islands. Neptun is also a proud holder of a Blue Flag beach status.

Sea views are accessible from almost every corner of the building, while spacious balconies, bright decor, and a vast array of available amenities, such as indoor and outdoor pools, spas, and several à la carte restaurants and bars further accredit Neptun as a great vacation spot.

If arriving as a couple or a business guest, choose one of the Classic, Panoramic or Premium room types, while for the families or groups of friends, we recommend our fine selection of comfortable Junior Suite or Family Suites with separate bedrooms and sea view balconies as the best option for a comfortable and unique stay.

Other services in Royal Neptun include beauty salon services, excursions and day and night entertainment programs, fitness, sauna and complimentary deck chairs and sun shades.

name: Hotel Adria
description:
Hotel Adria, has modern decorated room and most of the rooms have a balcony. Hotel also has room adapted for persons with special needs. Each room has a direct phone line, satellite TV, WI-fi Internet connection, mini bar, safety deposit box, hair dryer... The hotel is fully air-conditioned.
Garage and parking are free of charge for all our guest.

name: Hotel Lero
description:
Nothing beats waking up to a delicious breakfast after a great night’s sleep in a comfortable bed, realising you are up for an exciting day in one of the world’s most glorious cities. This is especially true if you are only a 15-minute walk from the UNESCO-protected Old City of Dubrovnik and a 5-minute walk from the famous pebble Miramare Beach, with your car safely parked in our spacious garage.

Whether you are coming to Dubrovnik for business or pleasure, we are ready to help you get the most out of your stay in Dubrovnik, known as “The Pearl of the Adriatic”. Modern but unpretentious, stylish but affordable, with tip-top service, outstanding restaurants and dazzlingly indulgent relaxation areas, Hotel Lero has everything you need to make lifelong memories.

name: BTW Caffe
description:
BTW Caffe is a small, easygoing coffee bar on Jadranski put - the main coastal road running through Herceg Novi.
It’s a quick, no-fuss stop for a well-made espresso, soft drinks, and light bites when you’re rolling along the bay.
The vibe is relaxed and friendly, service is quick, and it’s a handy spot to cool down, check the map, and plan the next leg.
Works well as a short pit stop whether you’re looping the bay or heading inland for the twisties.

name: Hotel Central
description: Hotel Central is situated in a picturesque location with stunning views of the surroundings. Guests are offered comfortable rooms equipped with modern furniture and all amenities. Nearby cafes and restaurants provide an opportunity to enjoy local cuisine. The hotel also features a spacious lobby and conference room for business meetings. An excellent choice for those seeking relaxation away from city hustle and bustle.

name: Le Premier Boutique Hotel Zagreb
description: Le Premier Boutique Hotel Zagreb is perfectly located for motorcycle enthusiasts. Convenient access allows quick reach to main city attractions. Room facilities include modern interiors with necessary comforts after long travel days. A cozy restaurant offers Croatian dishes while friendly staff creates welcoming atmosphere. Individual approach and attention to details make every stay unforgettable even for experienced travelers.

name: Camp Zagreb
description: Camp Zagreb is ideally suited for motorcyclists due to its proximity to central Zagreb. Spacious camping areas offer comfortable accommodation options along with cooking stations and rest zones. After active day trips, visitors can relax amidst nature's beauty or socialize with fellow riders. Regular thematic events and excursions help explore nearby landmarks more deeply. This makes Camp Zagreb an ideal stopover point during two-wheeled journeys across Croatia.

name: Hotel Raca
description: Hotel Raca is a great place for bikers to stay. Located near natural landscapes, it invites guests to experience tranquility and scenic beauty. Modern rooms come fully equipped ensuring comfort after long rides on motorcycles. Friendly staff will attend to tourists' needs including organizing tours and activities. It’s perfect spot to recharge before continuing your adventure through Croatia.

name: Level 5 - Adults Only B&B
description: Level 5 is an excellent option for motorbike lovers who value comfort and peacefulness. Located in a quiet area surrounded by greenery, this boutique hotel provides ample opportunities to rejuvenate after long road trips. Comfortable rooms feature contemporary design and essential amenities. Service levels meet high standards offering pleasant and relaxing stays. It's the perfect spot to recharge ahead of new adventures on the road.

name: Rooms STUDIO DREAM
description: Located right at the heart of Rovinj, Studio Dream offers convenient accommodations perfect for motorcyclists exploring the town. Stylish studios come complete with necessary amenities ensuring comfort throughout your stay. Well-designed grounds create enjoyable resting spots following daily explorations. Proximity to key sights and urban infrastructure enables easy route planning and leisurely walks around the city. With close access to seashore, guests may combine their break with swimming and water-based activities.

name: Hotel Delfin
description: Situated in the very center of Rovinj, Hotel Delfin is well-positioned for motorcyclists looking to discover the region's charms via walking tours. Elegant interior designs combined with modern conveniences ensure an enjoyable evening after each adventurous day. Close proximity to beaches reveals breathtaking Adriatic Sea vistas. Vibrant old-town ambiance inspires exploration into regional traditions and cultural heritage. Here you’ll find the perfect balance between convenience and relaxation!

name: Valamar Parentino Hotel
description: Perfectly positioned for motorcycle enthusiasts, Valamar Parentino Hotel lies just steps away from Istria's coastal line. Its seaside setting ensures easy access to beautiful beaches and scenic paths suitable for sports activities. Clean and well-appointed guestrooms come fully equipped with everything needed for maximum comfort. Nightlife fans will appreciate the close proximity to dining establishments and entertainment venues creating unique nighttime vibes. Staying here promises memorable experiences that will leave lasting positive memories.

name: Hotel Mediteran Plava Laguna
description: Mediteran Hotel is an exceptional choice for motorcyclists seeking a peaceful retreat within the scenic landscapes of Opatija. Centrally located near the promenade and sea, allowing guests to admire the beauty of the local shoreline and take refreshing walks along the waterfront. The hotel courtyard serves as a favorite gathering spot among travelers after thrilling road trips. Professional service coupled with secure parking guarantees utmost comfort to every visitor. Everything needed for relaxation and revitalization post-long journey awaits here.

name: Camping Brioni
description: Camping Brioni is an excellent stop for motorcyclists, located on the scenic Brijuni Islands peninsula. Accommodation includes modern cottages, comfortable apartments and tent sites. The campground features tennis courts, swimming pools, children's playground and a sports complex making your stay varied and interesting. The site's location allows easy visits to neighboring villages and historical monuments of the peninsula. Camping Brioni is ideal for motorcycle tours providing comfort and amenities on the shores of the Adriatic Sea.

name: Arena Stoja Campsite
description: Arena Stoja Campsite is a convenient campsite for bikers, situated in the picturesque outskirts of Pula. Guests have access to clean and well-equipped tent sites, comfortable bungalows and apartments with modern amenities. Nearby sandy beaches are perfect for swimming and sunbathing. In addition to traditional entertainments, visitors can use sport fields and bike trails passing by ancient architectural monuments. The camp appeals to both active and relaxed lifestyle enthusiasts, offering unique opportunities for recreation and exploration of the surrounding area.

name: Boutique Suites Joyce
description: Boutique Hostel Joyce is a charming place for bikers, nestled in a picturesque neighborhood of Pula. Interior decoration is stylish and modern, creating a cozy atmosphere for rest after active road adventures. The hostel offers compact but functional rooms, perfect for solo travelers and small groups. Amenities include free parking, Wi-Fi and shared kitchen, facilitating meal preparation and socializing with other guests. Hospitable hosts are happy to share route tips and tell about the best places to visit in the vicinity.

name: Hotel Istra
description: Hotel Istra is an ideal stop for motorcyclists traveling through the Istria region. Located near the historic center of Rovinj, it offers modern comfort and excellent conditions for rest after a long ride. Interiors are done in light tones, creating a sense of space and freshness. Guests can use free Wi-Fi, private garage storage for bikes and a pleasant inner courtyard with garden. Windows overlook lovely surroundings adding romance to your stay.

name: Amadria Park Hotel Sveti Jakov
description: Amadria Park Hotel Sveti Jakov is an ideal stop for motorcyclists visiting the Istria region. This attractive and modern hotel is located close to famous beaches and popular routes for motorcycle riding. Inside you'll find spacious bright rooms with quality service and comfortable equipment. There is a pool, fitness center and spa complex where you can relieve fatigue after a long drive. Thanks to its accessibility and top-notch service, this hotel is an excellent option for any motorcyclist planning a trip to Croatia.

name: Hotel Paris
description: Hotel Paris in Opatija is a stylish and cozy hotel, located in a prestigious area of the resort town. The classic facade of the building harmoniously combines with the elegance of the interior, creating a unique atmosphere of luxury and tranquility. Among services for guests stand out panoramic pool, refined restaurant serving seafood and pleasant inner courtyard where one can relax after day trips. Free parking, fast Wi-Fi connectivity and attentive staff ensure comfort of your journey. For motorcyclists, the hotel represents an attractive point on the route opening up the way to explore the picturesque shores of Istria.

name: Falkensteiner Premium Camping Zadar
description: Falkensteiner Premium Camping Zadar is an ideal destination for motorcycling enthusiasts seeking to enjoy a holiday surrounded by Dalmatia's breathtaking nature. The well-organized car and motorcycle parking area is situated next to a picturesque sandy beach where you can swim and sunbathe. Guests have access to various amenities such as children's club, animators, sports fields and swimming pool. The ability to prepare meals on grills enhances your stay making it comfortable and memorable. This campsite is accessible for all types of transport including motorcycles thanks to excellent transportation links and safe guarded parking.

name: Falkensteiner Hotel Adriana
description: Falkensteiner Hotel Adriana is an excellent choice for motorcyclists enjoying active holidays along the Dalmatian Coast. Ideally situated near a clean beach, allowing guests to relish sunny weather and sea views. Rooms are designed in modern style, providing full comfort and functionality. On-site wellness complex offers large pools, saunas and SPA treatments. Additionally, free parking for motorcycles and secured car park are available.

name: Gasthof Batzenhausl Seefeld
description:
A traditional, comfortable atmosphere in the heart of Seefeld
The Gasthof Batzenhäusl was the first establishment in the Kaltschmid family. Since 1954, the Kaltschmid name has stood for a vibrant Tyrolean hotel tradition in Seefeld. This can be felt in every corner of the hotel. Enjoy the rustic, cozy atmosphere with its unmistakable Tyrolean charm. Look forward to an unforgettable holiday in the heart of beautiful Seefeld in Tyrol. With hearty local cuisine, Tyrolean morning drinks, and the mountains on your doorstep.

We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel in Seefeld soon!

name: Hotel Standlhof Zillertal
description:
Your mountain base in the Zillertal
Make it your adventure.
The Standlhof isn't a wellness palace,
but a place where you can unwind,
recharge, and experience the here and now.
We believe in genuine hospitality,
good food, and the feeling of
having arrived.
Sustainable travel made easy.
Just 100 meters from the train station, at the Standlhof, you can step almost directly from the train into the holiday feeling.
The Zillertal Railway and bus also offer easy, stress-free, and environmentally friendly travel.

name: Pension Maria
description:
Bruck, at the starting point of the Grossglockner Trail and just 5 minutes from the famous Zell am See, offers a pleasant atmosphere and good connections to the ski slopes. Excellent restaurants, cycling, running, and hiking trails, and an outdoor swimming pool make it an ideal place for relaxation in both summer and winter.
Haus Maria enjoys a quiet location in the center of Bruck an der Großlocknerstraße, at the northern entrance to the Alpine Road. The guesthouse offers rooms with free Wi-Fi and balconies overlooking the mountains and the Bruck Alpine Village.
The Schmittenhohe Areitbahn ski area is a 5-minute drive away, and the Kaprun ski area is a 10-minute drive away.
The ski bus stops right in front of the building. Haus Maria also features a sauna and a ski storage room with a ski boot dryer.
Guests at Haus Maria can sunbathe on the terrace and use the barbecue facilities. A buffet breakfast is served in the breakfast room to start the day.
Zell am See is 3 km away, while Kaprun and the Kitzsteinhorn Glacier Access Point are 4.7 km away. Kaprun is a 10-minute drive away.

name: Pension Dorfplatzl
description: Located in the center of Fusch, Pension Dorfplatzl offers rooms with free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV. It features a terrace and a garden where you can sunbathe.

name: Amadria Park Camping Apartments Šibenik
description:
Discover the charm of our two magical destinations. Šibenik – enjoy exclusive experiences and attractions at Amadria Park.
Trogir – soak in the essence of the Mediterranean with breathtaking views and crystal-clear sea.
Two cities, endless memories – your perfect escape awaits.

name: Medulić Palace Rooms & Apartments
description:
We are proud to be your hosts at Medulić Palace Rooms and Apartments guest house.
Our guests truly appreciate our heartfelt hospitality and that love for detail we all share. We are happy to assist you in everything you will need during your stay with us! From simple advise on where to dine to organizing your tour to amazing natural wonder Island of Kornati or world most beautiful water falls of National Park Krka river.
We are conveniently located in Šibenik city centre and our family-run guest house offers stylish air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and large beds. We are positioned near UNESCO-protected Šibenik's Cathedral and a 2-minute walking distance from Šibenik's harbour and marina.
Medulić Palace has spacious, air-conditioned rooms and apartments with wooden floors. Rooms are decorated in soft cream and lilac colours and are recently renovated with private bathrooms decorated with stylish Italian tiles and quality Grohe appliances!
As we believe in a clean and healthy environment our rooms are serviced daily with attention to details for your satisfaction!
Apartment guests can prepare meals in their own kitchenette. The property is located at the heart of the city on the main promenade street and is surrounded by many shops, restaurants, cafes and historical places of interest.
If you feel like spending your time on the beach cooling yourself in the water or simply wish to extend your beach time longer, you could enjoy refreshing sunset cocktail at the Šibenik's famous beach Banj. Beach with the heart and positive energy where you can unwind your soul and body. Just grab your towels and go! Beach Banj can be reached within 10 minutes walking distance.
The property also features storage space for luggage. Airport transfers are available at a surcharge and upon request.
Šibenik Bus Station is a 5-minute walk away and the beautiful Krka waterfalls can be reached within 10 minutes by car or public transport.
Medulić Palace is visitors favourite accommodation when staying in Šibenik according to independent reviews on leading booking channels.

name: Hotel Park Makarska
description:
HOTEL PARK MAKARSKA
Welcome to Hotel Park Makarska, where luxury and comfort meet unrivaled service in one of the most beautiful locations in Dalmatia. Located right on the pebble beach overlooking the clear Adriatic Sea, it is the ideal place to relax and enjoy all the charms of Makarska.

name: Hotel Biokovo
description:
Welcome to Hotel Biokovo in Makarska
Hotel Biokovo is a 3-minute walk away from the beach in the centre of Makarska. All en-suite rooms feature satellite TV and minibars.

name: Bluesun hotel Alga
description:
Quality family time
Experience a vacation in a spacious hotel by the beach where a rich entertainment program and a large pool await you. Full-board with drinks included in the price allows you to simply relax and enjoy.

Experience a vacation in a spacious hotel by the beach where a rich entertainment program and a large pool await you. Full-board with drinks included in the price allows you to simply relax and enjoy.
