description:
Book your stay
Easy and secure
Secure your place at Heritage Hotel Pašike with a quick and secure online reservation. Choose your ideal accommodation and enjoy the historic charm of the city of Trogir. Book now and start your Dalmatian story!

name: Heritage Hotel Vila Sikaa
description: Experience the allure of a bygone era while enjoying contemporary luxury at Heritage Hotel Vila Sikaa. Witness the beauty of Trogir’s historical nucleus from the comfort of our charming hotel. Unwind in elegance, immerse yourself in cultural experiences, and create cherished memories that will last a lifetime. Book your stay with us now and embark on an enchanting journey filled with warmth, heritage, and captivating views.

name: Apartmani Trogir
description:
Apartments in Trogir centre
‘Apartments Trogir’ is well situated in a quiet area just 250m from the centre of the old town of Trogir and only 4km from the international airport of Split.

The house is categorized with 4 stars and has 10 units of different types, which can meet all the needs. These are all situated on the ground, first and second floors whilst the ground floor comprises also of the reception, lobby, breakfast room, Wi-Fi and Internet cafe.

The exterior and interior of the property is decorated and maintained to a high standard. There is also a big, free private parking with easy access and video surveilance. You will find a comfortable family atmosphere and traditional Dalmatian hospitality.

name: Tami Residence
description: Tami Resort is a congress and hotel complex in the heart of Niš, which includes the Tami Residence with Annex and Constantinus Palace hotels. With 109 rooms, 3 luxury suites, 3 senior suites, 3 restaurants, 1 banquet hall, a congress center with 7 halls, a Spa center with a swimming pool and 3 secure parking spaces within the hotel complex, Tami Resort is the largest hotel complex in Niš and the south-eastern region of Serbia.

description:
Where seduction reaches excellence
The search for the unexplored, the magical and the hidden continues day after day at the Grand Hotel. The eternal inspiration – Kopaonik, surprises with new adventures, reminding every individual that the best things conquer time. name: Hotel & Restaurant SESTO SENSO
description:
Offering cars for rent, the 4-star Sesto Senso Hotel Trebinje lies within 5 minutes' walk of the orthodox church "Cathedral Temple of Holy Transfiguration of Our Lord". Featuring baggage storage and a restaurant, the modern hotel is within a 10-minute drive of Leotar.

This Trebinje property is about 95 km from Mostar airport and a short way from such cultural venues as Arslanagica Bridge. The nearby places of worship include Osman-pasa Resulbegovic mosque (300 metres) and Hercegovacka Gracanica (2.3 km). A public beach is merely an 11-minute walk from the hotel, while Tvrdos Monastery is situated around 10 minutes away by car. Guests will also be able to visit Herzegovina Museum, located only a short stroll from Sesto Senso Hotel. Autobuska stanica Trebinje bus station, allowing a good connection throughout the city, is merely a 10-minute walk from this Trebinje property.

Furnished with soundproof windows, all rooms are equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and cable programming along with a mini fridge bar. Guests can also make use of a walk-in shower and a separate toilet, as well as comforts such as hairdryers and bath sheets. You can enjoy views of the mountain.

Enjoy a sunbathing terrace, a shared lounge, and a garden available for your comfort on-site.

The Sesto Senso Trebinje offers breakfast in the restaurant. The Sesto Senso has Restoran Sesto Senso restaurant, serving a range of Mediterranean dishes and featuring a spacious terrace. There is also a pizzeria with different Italian dishes in the area.

name: PhilsPlace
description: Welcome to PhilsPlace — the perfect spot for bikers seeking comfort and coziness in the heart of Vienna! Here, you will find stylish apartments that are ideal for resting after a long day on the road. Its convenient location offers easy access to popular tourist attractions and thrilling routes for motorcyclists. Additionally, the premises provide all the necessary amenities for storing and servicing your bikes. Don’t miss the chance to enjoy the friendly atmosphere and camaraderie in this unique location!

name: Hilton Vienna Waterfront
description: Welcome to Hilton Vienna Waterfront — a wonderful spot for bikers looking to enjoy relaxation amid nature and the urban vibe of Vienna. This hotel is located by the banks of the Danube and offers stylish rooms with modern amenities, perfect for unwinding after a ride. Convenient bike routes are nearby, making it an ideal starting point for your adventures. The hotel features motorcycle parking and maintenance services so you can focus on your journey. Don't miss the chance to enjoy stunning river views and picturesque surroundings!

name: Hotel Exe Vienna
description: Welcome to Hotel Exe Vienna — the perfect refuge for bikers seeking comfort and convenience in the heart of Vienna. This hotel features modern rooms with a range of amenities suitable for both short visits and extended stays. With its strategically convenient location, you can easily access major attractions and scenic routes for motorcyclists. The hotel also offers motorcycle parking and maintenance services to provide you peace of mind during your travels. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and quality service!

name: ARCOTEL Wimberger Wien
description: Welcome to ARCOTEL Wimberger Wien — a great spot for bikers looking for comfort and style in Vienna. This hotel offers stylish rooms with modern amenities, including free Wi-Fi and spa services for full recovery after your rides. Its convenient location allows for easy exploration of the city and its scenic surroundings on a motorcycle, as well as the opportunity to enjoy local culture. The hotel provides motorcycle parking and maintenance services for your two-wheeled friends. Don’t miss the chance to relax and recharge in the cozy atmosphere of this hotel!

name: Bikergasthof Hotel Post
description: Welcome to Bikergasthof Hotel Post — the perfect spot for bikers looking to enjoy stunning views and comfort in the heart of Austria. This hotel offers cozy rooms, a traditional atmosphere, and delicious local cuisine, perfectly suited for recharging after long rides. You won't be disappointed with the fantastic motorcycle routes nearby, ideal for exploring the picturesque landscapes. The hotel also provides amenities for motorcyclists, including secure parking and maintenance services. Don’t miss out on the chance to have an unforgettable stay in this welcoming place!

name: Hotel Regina
description: Welcome to Hotel Regina — a great spot for bikers looking to enjoy the beauty of Austria. This hotel offers modern rooms and a high level of comfort, perfect for relaxing after long rides. With its convenient location, you'll have the chance to easily explore scenic roads and local attractions. The hotel also provides special services for motorcyclists, including secure parking and motorcycle monitoring options. Don't miss the opportunity to stay at this welcoming hotel and experience the unique atmosphere of the Alps!

name: Hotel Cappella
description: Welcome to Hotel Cappella - a fantastic spot for bikers looking to enjoy scenic routes and comfort. This hotel offers cozy rooms and a friendly atmosphere, creating perfect conditions for relaxation after long rides. Its convenient location makes it easy to access thrilling mountain roads and picturesque landscapes. The hotel also provides special amenities for motorcyclists, including secure parking and motorcycle maintenance services. Don’t miss the chance to stay at this welcoming place and experience the unique hospitality of the Alps!

name: a&o Hostel Salzburg Hauptbahnhof
description: Welcome to a&o Salzburg Hauptbahnhof — a great spot for bikers looking to explore the beauty of Austria. This hostel offers modern and comfortable rooms at affordable prices, making it perfect for motorcycle travelers. Its convenient location near the central train station allows easy access to scenic routes and local attractions. Additionally, the hotel provides secure parking for motorcycles, ensuring peace of mind during your stay. Enjoy the incredible atmosphere and friendly service while staying here!

name: Das Grüne Hotel zur Post - 100% BIO
description: Welcome to Das Grüne Hotel zur Post - 100% BIO - the perfect spot for bikers who care about their health and the environment. This eco-friendly hotel offers comfortable rooms and top-notch services, making it an excellent choice for relaxation after long rides. Its convenient location in the heart of Salzburg allows for easy access to scenic routes and city attractions. The hotel also features dedicated parking for motorcycles, ensuring the safety of your vehicles. Enjoy a cozy atmosphere and attentive service while staying here!

name: Romantik Hotel - Die Gersberg Alm
description: Nestled in the picturesque Austrian Alps, Romantik Hotel provides an ideal resting spot after a day of thrilling motorcycle adventures. The hotel boasts comfortable rooms with breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains, ensuring a memorable stay. Motorcyclists will appreciate the dedicated parking area equipped with surveillance cameras for peace of mind. Guests can indulge in authentic Austrian cuisine at the on-site restaurant. Its convenient location near popular tourist routes makes this stopover particularly appealing for two-wheeled travelers.

name: Hotel Grüner Baum - Zell am See
description: Hotel Grüner Baum is perfectly located in picturesque Zell am See, surrounded by majestic Alps. Motorcyclists will appreciate the convenient parking area equipped with video surveillance and special lighting. Guests can admire stunning views of the lake and mountains right from their rooms. The hotel features a cozy restaurant serving traditional Austrian cuisine and a bar with an extensive drink selection. After a long ride, bikers will appreciate the comfortable rooms and first-class service provided by the staff.

name: Hotel zum Toni Klaus Pichler
description: Nestled in a picturesque corner of Austria, this cozy hotel offers an ideal resting place for motorcyclists after a long journey. The spacious rooms feature modern design and provide a homely comfort atmosphere. The property boasts dedicated parking space for motorcycles, ensuring their complete safety. The friendly staff is always ready to assist with recommendations on local routes and attractions. The hotel’s restaurant serves traditional Austrian cuisine made from fresh local ingredients, providing a delightful culinary experience.

name: Hotel Alpina
description: Hotel Alpina is a cozy accommodation nestled at the foot of the Alps, offering a perfect base for motorcycle enthusiasts. The hotel features a dedicated parking area for motorcycles and spacious rooms with contemporary design. The friendly staff is always ready to assist with planning motorcycle routes through the surrounding areas. Guests can enjoy traditional Austrian cuisine at the on-site restaurant after an exciting day of riding. Its proximity to major tourist routes makes this location an ideal choice for bikers.

name: Hotel Vitaler Landauerhof | Familie Graf
description: The family-run Vitaler Landauerhof hotel is nestled in a picturesque location in Bavaria, perfect for motorcycle travelers. The property features a spacious parking area for motorcycles and a convenient garage for vehicle storage. Hospitable hosts provide comfortable rooms with modern design and all necessary amenities. After an eventful day of riding, guests can relax and enjoy traditional Bavarian cuisine in the hotel’s restaurant. Scenic motorcycle routes start right from the hotel’s doorstep.

name: Grand Hotel Bregenz - MGallery Collection
description:
Grand Hotel Bregenz. Culture, comfort and a view of Lake Constance. Central 4 star hotel near the Festspielhaus and the lake stage. Modern rooms, regional cuisine and ideal for cultural, business or weekend trips to Bregenz. Grand Hotel Bregenz. Culture meets comfort on Lake Constance. Located in Bregenz center, directly by the Festspielhaus and only a few steps away from the lake. Elegant rooms, fine regional cuisine and an ideal location for cultural and business guests.

Discover the lake, culture, and views of the Alps in Bregenz. The Grand Hotel Bregenz is perfect for walks along Lake Constance, visits to the Bregenz Festival, or excursions to the Pfänder. Art, nature, and relaxation are all in the immediate vicinity.

name: JUFA Hotel Bregenz
description: Experience your vacation on Lake Constance! In Bregenz, active vacationers and culture enthusiasts, as well as those seeking a taste for life and exploration, enjoy a wide range of leisure activities and numerous excursions into the surrounding area. The Vorarlberg state capital itself boasts a vibrant arts and culture scene with the relaxed pace of a small town.

name: Hotel Johann Lauterach
description: We completed our training in the hospitality industry many years ago. Then we met – now we're working together. Working with guests gives sommelier and restaurant specialist Natalie incredible satisfaction. Award-winning chef Neven creates innovative dishes from high-quality ingredients.

name: Studio 17 Bregenz
description:
Welcome to Studio 17, a place for everyone who enjoys beautiful things. And for everyone who wants to unwind on our stunning Lake Constance – or even dive right in.

Forget boring hotel rooms – Studio 17 is different from your average Bregenz hotel. You'll stay in a studio with personality, surrounded by beautiful surroundings, and enjoy inspiring illustrations – right in the center of Bregenz, 100 meters from the lake and a short walk from the Bregenz Lake Stage and Bregenz Old Town.

name: Moto Revolution Shop
description: Moto Revolution Shop is a rider-focused moto store in Lajkovac, handy when you’re crossing central–western Serbia. Expect on-the-road essentials and quick fixes: tires and tubes, chain & sprocket sets, brake pads, oils, bulbs, basic diagnostics and puncture repair. They usually carry core gear - helmets, gloves, rain layers, bungees/straps - so you can sort both the bike and the rider in one stop. If you’re transiting between Belgrade and the mountain routes toward Valjevo/Užice, it’s a practical pit-stop.

name: Hotel Integra
description:
Relax and enjoy the high level of comfort and our top-notch service.

Whether you are traveling for business, pleasure or private reasons, the combination of a unique atmosphere and high-quality technical equipment will help you be efficient, relaxed and satisfied.

name: Brunner Hotel - Restaurant - Camping
description: Hotel Bronner is perfectly situated in the picturesque, offering every biker a cozy and comfortable stay after a long ride. The spacious rooms feature modern design, providing ideal conditions for relaxation. The hotel boasts a dedicated parking area for motorcycles, ensuring the safety of your beloved ride. The on-site restaurant serves traditional local dishes that will delight even the most discerning palates. Its proximity to major tourist routes makes this location an excellent choice for a stopover during your motorcycle journey.

name: Pension Bergfried
description: Cozy guesthouse with its own parking lot is located at the foot of the Salzberg and is only 150 m from the lake. It is a 5-minute walk along the lake promenade to the center. Diving or swimming in Lake Hallstatt, experience wonderful hikes through untouched landscapes. Climbing tours, cycling or romantic boat trips on the lake offer you relaxation and variety during your holiday.

name: Hotel Lindwurm
description: Hotel Lindwurm is a charming property nestled in the picturesque Salzkammergut region, surrounded by majestic mountains and crystal-clear lakes. The hotel’s cozy rooms are decorated in traditional Alpine style, blending modern comfort with the authentic atmosphere of an old Austrian inn. Guests can enjoy breathtaking mountain views directly from their rooms and take advantage of the spa facilities featuring a sauna and steam bath. The on-site restaurant serves exquisite local cuisine made from fresh regional ingredients. The hotel’s convenient location provides easy access to both natural attractions and cultural sites of the region.

name: Rosenberger Ansfelden
description: Rosenberger Motor Hotel is a modern property conveniently located near the motorway in Ansfelden, perfect for travelers by car. The hotel offers comfortable rooms featuring contemporary design and all necessary amenities for a pleasant stay. Special attention is paid to guests with vehicles - there is ample parking space and convenient access roads. The hotel provides excellent facilities for both business travelers and tourists. The friendly staff ensures a high level of service and helps make your stay as comfortable as possible.

name: Hotel Karnerhof
description: Nestled in the picturesque landscapes of Austria, the luxurious Karnerhof hotel offers a perfect blend of modern wellness facilities and traditional Austrian hospitality. Guests can enjoy elegant rooms with breathtaking views of the Alpine scenery and indulge in a top-notch spa centre featuring an extensive range of wellness treatments. The hotel’s restaurant specialises in exquisite regional cuisine, providing a true gastronomic experience. This idyllic retreat is perfect for those seeking tranquillity amidst majestic mountains and wishing to rejuvenate in an atmosphere of luxury and comfort. The hotel provides various relaxation and wellness programmes designed to help guests achieve harmony of mind and body.

name: Hotel Kanz
description: Hotel Kanz is a cozy modern establishment located in a picturesque area of Austria, perfect for both leisure and business travelers.Guests are welcomed by comfortable rooms with contemporary design, equipped with everything necessary for a pleasant stay.The hotel features friendly staff available 24/7 to assist with any inquiries and provide information about local attractions.The hotel’s convenient location makes it easy to reach major tourist sites and entertainment centers.

name: Strandhotel Faak
description: Strandhotel Faak is a cozy hotel located in a picturesque spot by Lake Faak in Austria, making it an ideal stopover for motorcycle travelers. The hotel offers comfortable rooms with stunning views of the lake and surrounding mountains, making it particularly appealing to bikers seeking relaxation after a long ride. The property features dedicated parking for motorcycles and offers secure storage options for your bike. Guests can enjoy traditional Austrian cuisine at the on-site restaurant, along with modern amenities like Wi-Fi. The hotel’s convenient location provides easy access to popular tourist routes and scenic spots in Carinthia.

name: Camping Arneitz
description: We're located in the heart of the nature park, right by the lake. Experience a unique blend of tranquility and nature, culinary delights, and captivating music.

name: Strandcamping Gruber
description: The natural wonder of Lake Faak, with its turquoise-blue water of up to 28°C, offers the best conditions for swimming and gentle mountain and water sports.

name: Guesthouse - Pension Kärntnerhof
description: This cozy hotel is a real gem for traveling bikers. The spacious rooms with modern design are perfect for relaxing after a long ride. The property features a convenient parking area for motorcycles, ensuring your iron horse stays safe and secure. The hotel staff is biker-friendly and always ready to assist with any inquiries. Its prime location makes it easy to reach the city’s main attractions and popular motorcycle routes.

name: Panoramapension Lerchner
description: The cozy Panorama Pension Lerchner is situated in a picturesque location in Austria, offering breathtaking views of the mountains and valleys. Bikers will appreciate the dedicated parking area with video surveillance, ensuring complete safety for their motorcycles. After a long ride, guests can relax in comfortable rooms featuring modern design and all necessary amenities. The pension boasts a welcoming restaurant serving traditional Austrian cuisine, as well as a bar with an extensive drink selection. Its convenient location makes it easy to access popular motorcycle routes and scenic spots for rides.

name: Hotel Dermuth
description: This cozy hotel and restaurant is a perfect stopover for motorcycle travelers, thanks to its excellent location near major tourist routes. Spacious rooms with modern design ensure comfortable rest after a long day on the road. The hotel’s restaurant serves excellent Austrian cuisine, helping to replenish energy before the next leg of your journey. The friendly staff is always ready to assist with motorcycle parking and provide information about local attractions. The convenient location makes it easy to access both city entertainment and scenic countryside routes.

name: Seecamping Appesbach
description: Our campsite is just 1 km from St. Wolfgang, and the town center is easily accessible on foot (approx. 15 minutes) or by bike along the cycle path. The direct lakeside location is especially popular with water lovers of all ages. It's the perfect place for those who enjoy swimming, sailing, SUPing, etc. A total of three beaches offer something for every taste (grass, playground, and shallow water for children, a swimming area where dogs are allowed, and an activity area at the SUP center with boat rentals).

name: Berau am Wolfgangsee
description: Landhotel Berau is a perfect choice for motorcyclists traveling along the scenic roads of Austria, offering ample parking space for two-wheeled vehicles. The hotel provides cozy rooms with modern design, where you can truly relax and rejuvenate after a long day on the road. The hotel’s convenient location makes it easy to access the main tourist routes and attractions of the region. The hotel’s restaurant serves traditional Austrian dishes to help replenish your energy after an eventful day of riding.

name: Plaza 357
description:
Plaza 357 is a casual waterfront café-bar in Zelenika, set right by the Bay of Kotor promenade.
It’s a simple, drinks-forward stop - good espresso by day and cold beers or easy mixed drinks toward sunset, with light bites to match.
The vibe is relaxed and social, with outdoor tables by the water and music at a talk-friendly volume.
For riders, it’s an easy in/out from Jadranski put - an effortless pit stop between Herceg Novi and Bijela or before heading inland.

name: Volga-Volga
description: Volga-Volga is a casual waterfront café-bar in Baošići, set right on the seaside promenade just off Jadranski put. It’s a drinks-forward stop - espresso by day, ice-cold beers and simple mixed drinks toward sunset, with light bites. Outdoor tables sit by the water with music at a talk-friendly volume and wide bay views. For riders, it’s an easy roll-in/roll-out on the coastal road-handy between Kumbor/Đenovići and Bijela or before heading inland.

name: Stari Mlini
description:
Stari Mlini is Restaurant is family-owned and operated for almost 50 years. We grow our produce in our garden. We source what we don’t grow—ingredients, fish, and meat—daily from our next-door neighbors and other local families.
Our mission is to help preserve our culinary history while giving customers a taste of our tradition.

name: Hotel Bokeljski Dvori
description:
Hotel Bokeljski Dvori is located in the small town of Prčanj near Kotor, at the foot of the green belt of Vrmac, right on the shore of one of the most beautiful bays in the world, the Bay of Kotor. Because of this fact, the Hotel is surrounded by a dense pine forest, promenades with natural beaches, and crystal clear sea.
Comfortable 3-star accommodation in modern apartments, a beach close to the Hotel, a coastal ambiance, and always caring hosts guarantee a peaceful and pleasant stay at Hotel Bokeljski Dvori. You will find us only 3 minutes away from a 200m long natural beach and a 5-minute drive from the Old Town of Kotor and its sights and restaurants. Our desire is to offer you all the warmth and comfort of home, as well as a relaxed yet professional atmosphere.

name: Restaurant Bokeljski Dvori
description: Restaurant Bokeljski Dvori is a long-running, family-style spot in Prčanj, a short stroll from the waterfront. The kitchen leans Adriatic and Montenegrin: grilled local fish and octopus, calamari, mussels, alongside charcoal-grilled meats and simple, fresh sides. Seating spreads between a stone dining room and a leafy terrace with glimpses of the bay, making it easy to linger over lunch or a sunset dinner. Unfussy, hearty, and good value - an easy choice when you’re exploring the Kotor side of the bay.

name: Bike Fest Panonika 2025
description:
Organized by the Moto Club "TUZLA" and JP Panonika Tuzla, the traditional large event "BIKE FEST PANONIKA TUZLA 2025" features an exceptional program consisting of all the elements that make up the old spirit of motorcycle gatherings, as well as professional audio & light production, great Rock & Roll, the beautiful ambiance of the Panonian Lakes complex, and valuable hosts.
The event dates are September 12, 13, and 14, 2025.
The location is the center of the City of Tuzla at the Panonian Lakes complex.

name: Hotel Marko
description:
Rooms
Spacious rooms with sea or park views are comfortable and furnished with stylish furniture. All rooms on three floors are connected by an elevator and a staircase. The rooms have a desk, sofa or armchair, balcony, bathroom (with shower or bathtub), bidet, hairdryer, LCD TV, telephone, mini bar and room safe. The rooms are air-conditioned and have free wireless internet access. The rooms are suitable for allergy sufferers.

Guests of Hotel Marko have access to two beaches in the immediate vicinity of the hotel. Meduza Beach is located just 50 meters from the hotel and is one of the most beautiful in Portorož, and the main Portorož beach, which is 250 meters away. Both beaches offer many opportunities for sports and recreational activities, entertainment for children, as well as relaxation corners. The beaches are holders of the Blue Flag of Quality. This award is the most prestigious European symbol for water quality and respect for the environment, as well as for a clean, safe and friendly beach.

name: City Hotel Ljubljana
description: This hotel in the center of Ljubljana offers a convenient location for bikers wanting to explore the city. City Hotel Ljubljana has secure parking for motorcycles, which is a big plus. After a long ride, you can relax in comfortable rooms and enjoy a delicious breakfast. The hotel is within walking distance of major attractions and restaurants. The hotel staff is always ready to help you with information about the best routes and places to visit in Slovenia.

name: Urban Hotel
description: Urban Hotel attracts bikers with its modern style and excellent central location in Ljubljana. Secure motorcycle parking is available upon request, allowing you to leave your iron horse with peace of mind. After a day in the saddle, you can relax in stylish rooms or on the outdoor terrace. The hotel is surrounded by bars and restaurants where you can enjoy local cuisine and beer. The hotel staff is always ready to share tips on the best motorcycle routes around the city.

name: Hostel Celica
description: Hostel Celica - a unique hostel in Ljubljana that a biker will definitely remember! Located in a former military prison, it offers not just accommodation, but a whole adventure. Each cell has been converted into an original room with a unique design. The nearest parking lot allows you to safely leave your motorcycle during your stay. The hostel has an incredible atmosphere of creativity and freedom, and in the bar you can always meet interesting fellow travelers. This is the perfect place for those looking for something more than just a hotel!

name: Exe Lev
description: Exe Lev Hotel is an excellent choice for bikers looking to stay in the center of Ljubljana. The hotel's location makes it easy to explore both the city and the surrounding roads. Convenient parking nearby is a plus for motorcyclists. After a day in the saddle, you can relax in comfortable rooms and take advantage of free Wi-Fi. The hotel's restaurant offers local and international cuisine, where you can enjoy a delicious dinner.

name: Hotel Heritage
description: Hotel Heritage is a stylish and cozy hotel in the heart of old Ljubljana, a great choice for a biker who appreciates the atmosphere. Although the hotel is located in a pedestrian zone, the staff will help arrange motorcycle parking nearby. Here you can enjoy comfort and tranquility after a busy day on the road. Be sure to try the breakfast with local delicacies. Near the hotel are many cafes and restaurants where you can relax in the evening.

name: Penzion Berc
description: Penzion Berc is an excellent choice for bikers exploring the scenic surroundings of Lake Bled. This guest house offers cozy rooms with stunning mountain views. Free on-site parking is available for bikers, which is very convenient. After a day full of adventures, you can relax in the sauna or order a delicious dinner in the restaurant. The hosts are always happy to help you with information about the best motorcycle routes in the Gorenjska region.

name: Hotel Triglav l.l.c. Bled
description: Hotel Triglav Bled is the perfect place for bikers looking to enjoy luxury and scenic views of Lake Bled. The hotel offers comfortable rooms with balconies boasting breathtaking views. Secure parking is available for bikers to safely leave their motorcycles. After a long ride, you can relax in the spa or swim in the pool overlooking the lake. The hotel restaurant offers exquisite local cuisine.

name: Aire de camping car
description: Aire de camping car is a great option for budget-conscious bikers traveling through Slovenia and exploring Lake Bled. This is a specially equipped area for motorhomes, but motorcyclists can also stay here. It has all the necessary amenities: electricity, water, and waste disposal. Conveniently located near Lake Bled and the main attractions. It is a great opportunity to relax in nature and enjoy the beauty of the surrounding area.

name: Camping Bled
description: Camping Bled is a great place for bikers who want to enjoy nature and proximity to Lake Bled. The campsite offers equipped tent pitches as well as cabins for rent. Motorcyclists are provided with on-site parking. The site has all the necessary amenities: toilets, showers, electricity and Wi-Fi. Lake Bled can be quickly reached by motorcycle. It is convenient to explore the surroundings and mountain trails from here.

name: HOP HOUSE
description: HOP HOUSE is a great option for bikers looking for cozy and affordable accommodation near the picturesque Slovenian Karst. This guest house offers simple yet comfortable rooms. Free on-site parking is available for motorcyclists. The restaurant serves delicious local cuisine and a wide selection of beers. It's the perfect place to relax after a long day in the saddle and exploring the surrounding attractions.

name: Hotel Jama
description: Hotel Jama is an excellent choice for bikers traveling through Slovenia and wanting to explore Postojna Cave. The hotel offers comfortable rooms and a convenient location right at the entrance to the cave. Free parking is available for motorcyclists. After a day spent in the saddle, you can relax in the hotel restaurant and try Slovenian cuisine. The hotel's convenient location makes it easy to explore nearby attractions.

name: Hostel Proteus
description: Hostel Proteus is a great and budget-friendly option for bikers. The hostel offers both dormitories and private rooms, which is convenient for different budgets. Free motorcycle parking is available for bikers. Here you can relax and socialize with other travelers. The hostel's location makes it easy to reach the cave and other interesting places.

name: HOSTEL SONCE
description: HOSTEL SONCE in Ptuj is a great choice for bikers looking to explore the oldest city in Slovenia. This hostel offers affordable and comfortable accommodation in the city center. Free parking is available nearby for motorcyclists. In the hostel you can relax after the trip and chat with other travelers. It is easy to get to Ptuj Castle and other attractions from here to explore the history and culture of the region.

name: muzikafe B&B
description: muzikafe B&B is a cozy place for bikers in Ptuj, offering an atmosphere of music and comfort. Here you will find rooms of various categories - from budget to more comfortable. Parking is available for motorcyclists. In the evening, you can relax in the cafe and enjoy live music or other events. This is a great place to relax and immerse yourself in the local culture.

name: Hotel Roškar
description: Located in the quiet village of Hajdina, Hotel Roškar is a wonderful choice for bikers exploring the Slovenian countryside. This hotel offers tranquility and convenience, being only a few kilometers from Ptuj. Free parking is available on site for bikers, which is especially convenient. Enjoy traditional Slovenian cuisine in the hotel's restaurant after a long day in the saddle. The hotel is an excellent starting point for scenic rides through the surrounding hills and vineyards.

name: Grand Hotel Sava Rogaška
description: Grand Hotel Sava in Rogaška Slatina is a luxurious choice for bikers wishing to relax and rejuvenate. This historic hotel offers elegant rooms and high-class service. Secure parking is available for motorcyclists. After exciting roads, you can relax in the spa center with mineral waters or enjoy fine cuisine in the restaurant. Grand Hotel Sava is the perfect place for bikers who appreciate comfort and luxury.

name: Villa Angelina
description: Villa Angelina in Rogaška Slatina is a wonderful choice for bikers looking for a peaceful getaway away from the noise. This cozy villa offers comfortable rooms and well-kept grounds. Free parking for motorcycles is provided. Guests can relax in the garden or on the terrace overlooking the surroundings. Villa Angelina is an ideal place for bikers who appreciate peace, comfort and closeness to natur

name: Hotel Helikon
description: Hotel Helikon is a cozy haven for motorcyclists located in a picturesque area, offering comfortable rooms and excellent service. Its convenient location allows quick access to the region’s main attractions. The hotel provides special parking spaces for motorcycles, ensuring maximum comfort for guests. All necessary amenities are available for relaxation after a long ride, from comfortable rooms to delicious local cuisine in the restaurant. The friendly staff is always ready to assist with recommendations on local routes and interesting places to visit.

name: Hotel Yacht Wellness & Business Siófok
description: Hotel Yacht Wellness & Business in Siofok is a perfect destination for bikers seeking comfortable accommodation by Lake Balaton. The spacious rooms feature modern design and panoramic windows creating a cozy and relaxing atmosphere. The hotel offers an indoor pool, spa center, and business area for corporate travelers. Motorcyclists will appreciate the secure parking, while the proximity to the promenade allows quick access to the city’s main attractions. The on-site restaurant serves exquisite Hungarian cuisine with breathtaking views of the water.

name: Hunguest BÁL Resort
description: Hunguest BÁL Resort is a luxurious resort complex located in a picturesque area of Hungary, offering perfect conditions for motorcyclists’ relaxation. The hotel features a spacious parking area for motorcycles with 24-hour video surveillance and security. Guests can enjoy magnificent views of the surrounding hills and forests, perfect for motorcycle rides. The resort provides everything needed for a comfortable stay, including a spa center, restaurants serving traditional Hungarian cuisine, and a modern fitness center. The convenient location of the complex makes it easy to reach the main tourist attractions of the region.

name: Sports Academy Hotel
description: Akademia Hotel in Balatonfüred is an excellent choice for bikers exploring Hungary’s scenic routes. The hotel offers convenient free parking for motorcycles and is just a 15-minute walk from the beautiful lake promenade. Guests can enjoy the indoor pool and jacuzzi facilities to relax after a long ride. The hotel staff can assist with airport transfers and provide recommendations for the best motorcycle routes in the area. After an adventurous day, guests can unwind at the on-site restaurant and bar.

name: Villa Bellevue Portorož - Portorose
description:
Your New Favorite Place by the Sea
At Villa Bellevue Portorož, it’s not just a stay — it’s a feeling.
Perched above the Adriatic with unforgettable views, warm hospitality, and Mediterranean charm, we’re here to make you feel one thing above all:

“Welcome home.”

name: Europa Hostel Portorož
description:
Europa Hostel Portorož is located in the very center of Portorož, right next to the main bus station, where you can reach Europa Hostel Portorož in just two steps, or take a stroll along the beautiful Portorož promenade, which stretches from Lucija to Bernardin and hugs the most beautiful beach on the Slovenian coast.

In our hostel in Portorož, you will have everything at hand, just a stone's throw from the beach, where you will also find a varied catering offer, and the beautiful Path of Health and Friendship - PARENCANA also runs. The mentioned path connects Trieste and Poreč, just as the narrow-gauge railway once connected the aforementioned cities, but today it is intended for pedestrians and cyclists.

A few parking spaces in front of the Europa Hostel Portorož allow you to park during your stay. Our summer garden, surrounded by century-old trees, offers shelter from the sun on hot summer days, where you can enjoy a refreshing drink of your choice, have a picnic with friends, or simply relax while reading your favorite book. Can you imagine? A picnic in Portorož!

name: Guesthouse Resje
description: Hiša resje is a B&B with a long tradition. It is located in the village of Nemški Rovt, which is surrounded by beautiful nature and full of friendly villagers. We have 14 rooms that can accommodate 40 people. In the past, this place was a top-notch restaurant with an excellent chef, Jože Godc, at the helm, who now serves you at the SunRose 7 hotel. Find out more about us here

name: Vila Preseren
description:
from the 19th century
Vila Prešeren lies under the castle cliff right on the shore of Lake Bled. Visitors eager for pleasure are delighted with a rich selection of fragrant coffees, tempting pastries, top wines, the best champagnes, sophisticated cigars, fashionable cocktails and selected dishes, which are served to you on the sunny terrace overlooking the lake in good weather. Villa Prešeren, which is one of the traditional 19th century Bled villas, also has two boutique suites and six fashionable rooms.

name: Hotel Miklic
description:
The Miklič inn is located at the foot of Vitranc, right next to the ski slope and is just the right distance from the village center to spend a nice and peaceful holiday. Regardless of whether you come to Kranjska Gora to ski, ride your bike to Vršič or visit the peaks of the Julian Alps, our hotel offers everything you need to make your stay pleasant and unforgettable. The Miklič family, together with their professional staff, will pamper you in the pleasant atmosphere of the Miklič inn and take care of even the most hidden wishes.

You are cordially invited!

name: Hajdu Castle Hotel
description: Hajdu Castle Hotel is a true gem for motorcycle travelers, located in the picturesque Hungarian town of Hajdúszoboszló. The majestic medieval-style building is surrounded by a well-maintained park with convenient parking spaces for motorcycles. The hotel offers everything needed for a comfortable stay, from spacious rooms to a restaurant serving traditional Hungarian cuisine. Bikers will especially appreciate the convenient access roads and the option to leave their vehicles under staff supervision. After a long ride, you can relax in the thermal springs that this region is famous for.

name: Pri Martinu
description: Welcome to Gostilna pri Martinu, a true Slovenian inn with excellent food and friendly service in a pleasant homely atmosphere. We are located in the very center of Kranjska Gora, 400m from the ski slope and 100m from Casino Korona.

name: Hotel Boka
description: HOTEL BOKA is located close to the River Soca and Boka Waterfall, overlooking the Julian Alps and close to the Triglav National Park. Inside the hotel you'll find Boka Wine & Snack Bar where you can try local culinary. Outdoor activities can be booked in sport agency Boka Outdoor Sport. You are welcome to join us!

name: Laci Betyár Fogadó
description: Laci Betyár Fogadó is a charming guesthouse located in the picturesque Hajdúsoboszló area, making it an ideal stopover for your motorcycle journey. The cozy rooms and welcoming atmosphere provide perfect conditions to relax after a long day on the road. The surrounding area offers numerous interesting routes for motorcyclists, passing through beautiful Hungarian landscapes. The owners of the guesthouse are happy to share recommendations about local attractions and the best routes. Here you can not only rest but also immerse yourself in the local culture and cuisine.

name: Hotel Habakuk
description:
Be our guest and visit this landmark building, reminiscing in its tales
Situated at the foot of the picturesque Pohorje Hills in Maribor, Slovenia, Habakuk Hotel offers an ideal location for exploring the natural beauty and cultural treasures of the region. Just steps away, guests can enjoy the renowned Mariborsko Pohorje ski slopes in winter or lush hiking and cycling trails during warmer months. The city of Maribor, with its historic Old Town, the famous Lent district along the Drava River, and the world’s oldest vine at the Old Vine House, is only a short distance away.

Come and experience the perfect blend of relaxation, adventure, and luxury in this stunning Slovenian destination.

name: Exe Carlton Hotel Budapest
description:
The Ritz-Carlton, Budapest offers a fitness centre, a spa and wellness centre in the heart of the city centre, just a few minutes' walk from St. Stephen's Basilica and the Danube River. There is also an on-site restaurant and bar.
Overlooking the boutique-lined pedestrian street or the beautiful Erzsébet Park, the spacious, elegant and comfortable air-conditioned rooms and suites feature wired and wireless internet, an LCD satellite TV and a minibar. Some rooms also have a balcony with panoramic views. The luxurious marble bathrooms feature a separate bathtub and rain shower. Free toiletries, bathrobes, slippers and a hairdryer are provided in all rooms.
The Kupola Lounge, located under the iconic stained glass dome, is the ideal place to enjoy a rich breakfast, a light lunch or afternoon tea. IPANEMA, a Brazilian grill and barbecue restaurant, offers original yet modern dishes, craft cocktails and a South American atmosphere. Kaffee Wien offers homemade cakes and pastries.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa offers an impressive range of wellness and spa treatments, a hot tub, a steam room and a naturally lit swimming pool. The state-of-the-art fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.
Parking is available nearby for a surcharge. The hotel is just a few minutes' walk from the city's beautiful shopping and lively business district, the Castle District, the Opera House and the Dohány Street Synagogue, the largest synagogue in Europe.

name: Continental Hotel Budapest
description:
Continental Hotel Budapest****Superior
Welcome to Continental Hotel Budapest****Superior, a distinguished 4-star superior hotel that seamlessly blends historic elegance with modern sophistication. Located in the heart of Budapest, our hotel offers an unparalleled experience for both leisure and business travelers. Whether you're visiting to explore the vibrant cultural landmarks or attending professional events, Continental Hotel Budapest****Superior provides the ideal setting for a memorable stay.

name: Park Plaza Budapest
description: With famed baths, bars, and blue waters of the Danube, Budapest invites you to soak, sip, and stroll your way through its vibrant history and culture. And Park Plaza Budapest is the gorgeous hotel at the heart of it all. Take in stunning views of the river, Chain Bridge, Parliament, and Buda Castle from a contemporary space with a unique architectural twist. Sleep, meet, dine, do business, and make the most of your Budapest experience—the Park Plaza way.

name: Boutique Hotel Annuska
description:
The unique Annuska boutique hotel, located in the heart of Balatonfüred, offers perfect conditions for a relaxing holiday just a few minutes from Lake Balaton, yet in a quiet, peaceful environment.
According to guest reviews, this is one of the best-located accommodations in Balatonfüred! Our guests really love the atmosphere of Boutique Hotel Annuska, the brand new and chemical-free, slightly saltwater outdoor pool and the huge and beautiful garden, the pleasant and intimate environment, our rooms with a unique atmosphere and the kind staff, who really do everything to make you feel good with us.
The closest hotel to the brand new Balatonfüred conference center is Boutique Hotel Annuska, so if you arrive for an event, you can reach the Balaton Leisure and Conference Center building with a leisurely walk.

name: Babi Guest House
description:
Dear Traveler!
Our guesthouse welcomes its guests all year round.

Our 2-3-4 bed rooms with private bathroom, TV, refrigerator, WiFi are an ideal choice for couples, families, and groups of friends.

Parking is provided within a closed garden.

A well-equipped kitchen serves the comfort of our guests, as well as a large cozy terrace, where you can grill if desired.

Our guesthouse's services also include breakfast, air conditioning, bicycle rental, sailing, and laundry.

We also welcome guests with pets.

Balatonfüred has great natural features. Lake Balaton, as Europe's largest freshwater lake, ensures the city's pleasant climate all year round. This, and the slopes of the mountains bordering the lake from the north, are particularly suitable for growing grapes, which are essential for producing high-quality wines.

In addition to its museums and regularly organized cultural events, Balatonfüred also offers its visitors restaurants and wineries that can satisfy high gastronomic demands.

The surrounding nature reserves, including the Tihany Peninsula, are suitable for hiking, walking and relaxing all year round.

In winter, the silence of the city, mulled wine and occasional ice skating, from late spring to early autumn, beaching and fröccs, and from early spring to late autumn, boating, sailing and surfing provide relaxation opportunities for visitors here.

Discover our city, Balatonfüred!
We look forward to welcoming you!

name: Hotel Kalma
description: Our hotel is located in the heart of Hévíz, yet in a quiet environment, just a two-minute walk from the Lake Baths. You can spend relaxing days in our comfortable, spacious apartments that meet all your needs. Our restaurant awaits its guests with its versatile gastronomic experiences, the city's award-winning wine and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Crown Restaurant and Guesthouse
description: Our hotel is located in the heart of Hévíz, yet in a quiet environment, just a two-minute walk from the Lake Baths. You can spend relaxing days in our comfortable, spacious apartments that meet all your needs. Our restaurant awaits its guests with its versatile gastronomic experiences, the city's award-winning wine and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Unicorn Hotel
description:
With every booking* we give you free bath tickets to the Demjén Thermal Bath!
Our hotel does not have its own wellness department, but you can still enjoy the experience of bathing!

*The free, free Demjén bath tickets are included with a minimum 2-night booking for every guest, once only.

Our hotel awaits its guests with 50 rooms, from those looking for a romantic couple's relaxation to family hikers!

name: Hotel Estella
description:
I warmly welcome you to the website of the Hotel E*Stella **Superior teaching hotel and I hope that you will stay with us during your visit to Eger. “You have to go to Eger” - the poet said two centuries ago. Could we say anything different today when it comes to this city?
Eger is a city where everyone can find the right relaxation for them. Those who are interested in cultural values ​​and relics of the past can find a wide range in our city, as can those who seek relief, healing and relaxation in our hot water spas. The area around Eger is a world-famous wine-producing region, and the juicy grape clusters that provide the raw material for the world-famous Egri Bikavér and Egri Csillag ripen on the sunny slopes surrounding the city. If you would like to get to know the excellent wines of the Eger Wine Region better and participate in various wine-related events, visit Eger and take advantage of the Hotel E*Stella **Superior teaching hotel.

name: Danubius Hotel Rába
description: Győr is a city of encounters: in the town situated at the confluence of four rivers, cultural programs meet and different historical eras meet. Among the many attractions, the beautifully reconstructed Baroque city center stands out. Here stands the centuries-old building of the Danubius Hotel Rába, which, due to its central location, is a great starting point for exploring the city's monuments and sights.

name: Wesselényi Hotel Győr
description:
Our hotel is located in an extremely quiet and peaceful environment, just a 3-minute walk from the noise of the city center, on the edge of the green belt. Thanks to our family management, my wife and I do everything we can to fully meet the personal needs of each of our guests. We can assure you that our colleagues also work to make you feel as comfortable as possible, as if you were at home.

You can choose from six room types that best suit your needs and budget. Our cozy Zen Restaurant, closed parking, high-speed Wi-Fi, TV, shower, mini fridge, laundry service and much more ensure your comfort. We provide a transfer from Pér, Budapest, Bratislava and Vienna for a fee. The elegant and exciting spa of Győr is just a 15-minute walk from our hotel, through the baroque city center.

If you are coming with a pet, do not hesitate to bring it with you!

name: Gyirmót Sport & Wellness Hotel
description:
In one of the greenest areas of the Baroque city of Győr, one of the Lesser Plains, our main goal is to create a path to physical and spiritual harmony for our guests. We provide all this for those who come to us in a calm, quiet environment, on the shore of our own lake. We await you with spacious, comfortable rooms, delicious dishes from our chef, and the hospitality of our colleagues. Get to know our hotel's services, enjoy a coffee while admiring the rays of the rising sun on the shore of our lake, explore the 750-year-old city and its surroundings, the wildlife of the Holt-Rába nature trail, or one of the oldest operating monasteries of the Benedictine order in the country.

Relax with your team, brainstorm in a pleasant environment, chat informally, and get to know each other better in our hotel! If you are looking for a venue for team building, you have found it! Our restaurant offers the opportunity for wine and pálinka tastings with dinner, and outdoor pig roasts. The hotel surroundings can be an excellent location for indoor and outdoor training. If you would like to rent a football pitch from us, this is also possible. Contact us and we will be happy to organize the programs!

name: Mirage Hotel Sárvár
description: The aim of the staff at Mirage Hotel and Restaurant is to strike your fancy in discovering the town, to flash experiences and offer programs, possibilities and to transfer feelings. We encourage you to start your journey here. Sárvár is more than a town of spas! Know the different faces of Sárvár and discover it historical sights. Visit the Nádasdy Castle, the old buildings and relax under the shade of the trees in the Arboretum. Energize yourself with the power of the thermal waters, enjoy the services of Mirage Hotel. Let yourself be seduced by the different festivals, feel the special atmosphere of the town that is created by the wellness services, the history of the town, the traditions, the culture and the different leisure activities. There are no illusions, Sárvár will be love at first sight.

name: Holdvirág Hotel
description:
The Holdvirág Hotel Sárvár*** is ideal for families, groups of friends and couples, just 15 minutes from the spa and 5 minutes from Nádasdy Castle.

Our accommodation offers studio apartments, 2 and 3-room suites, as well as a restaurant & bar, terrace, free parking, games room, playground, Elf Village, billiards and fitness room.

name: Wild Garden Major
description:
Vadkert Major – where business success is born in an inspiring environment
Professional environment, natural inspiration – corporate events at Vadkert Major
Conferences, training, executive retreats or team building? With us, a peaceful environment and a high-quality technical background go hand in hand.
Discover our event offer and download our introductory material!

name: Tiszavirág Szeged
description: "Tiszavirág" in Szeged is not just a restaurant, it's a legendary place with excellent cuisine and atmosphere. Here you can taste traditional Hungarian dishes while enjoying the view of the Tisza River. The cozy interior and live music create a unique atmosphere for bikers looking to relax after a long ride. We recommend trying their goulash and paprikash - you'll lick your fingers! And don't forget about the local beer!

name: Novotel Szeged
description: Novotel Szeged is an excellent choice for bikers looking for a comfortable stay. The hotel is located in the city center, close to the main attractions and the Tisza River. It offers secure parking for motorcycles, which is essential when traveling. After a long ride, you can relax in the pool or enjoy local cuisine in the hotel restaurant. The convenient location and all the necessary amenities make Novotel the perfect place for a biker stop in Szeged.

name: Szivárvány Panzió Szeged
description: Szivárvány Panzió in Szeged is a cozy place for bikers seeking a peaceful rest. Located a bit away from the center, this guesthouse offers peace and comfort after a busy day on the road. They have secure, fenced parking for motorcycles, ensuring the safety of your ride. The owners are experienced motorcyclists themselves, so they understand all your needs. Enjoy the homely atmosphere and warm welcome at Szivárvány Panzió!

name: Rent Apartments Bucharest Downtown - CM111
description:
Located in the heart of the city, in the central area, just 900 m from the University Square, 10 minutes' walk, CM111 Aparthotel offers the alternative of luxury accommodation in the center of the Romanian capital.
Our accommodation unit offers you standard, premium, superior double rooms as well as simple suites/kitchenette.
The building was thought out and designed as smartly as possible, offering the possibility of self check-in, based on the codes issued by the property, without the need for the physical presence of someone at the reception to hand you your card or key.
Each room offers the guest wi-fi, smart TV, mini-fridge, private bathroom with shower, bathroom items (shower gel and shampoo), hairdryer, hangers, towels, slippers, Bosch Tassimo coffee machine and capsules, sugar, desk, closet. In addition to these standard equipment, the studios with kitchenettes are equipped with an induction stove, sink and cooking utensils. 90% of the rooms have balconies or terraces (the rooms located on the upper floors 4, 5, 6 offer an exceptional view of the city).
At the location you will also find underground parking, for a fee.

name: Hotel Laterum Pécs
description: Hotel Laterum in Pécs is the perfect place for bikers who appreciate comfort and style. Its convenient location allows you to enjoy the beauty of the city and its surroundings. Secured parking will ensure the safety of your iron horse. Relax in cozy rooms after a long ride and enjoy local cuisine in the hotel restaurant. Laterum is your reliable haven on the road to new adventures!

name: Vogue Boutique Residence
description: A favorite of local families as well as hotel guests, the Hugo Restaurant serves a range of delicious authentic Italian dishes, all freshly made with seasonal ingredients. The freshness and creativity of Hugo’s Chefs are matched by our stylish and elegant design. Hugo Restaurant is open daily from 11 am to 11 pm.

name: Hotel Arkadia
description:
Hotel Arkadia in Pécs is your biker oasis, combining comfort and a convenient location. Its proximity to major roads and attractions makes it the perfect starting point. Free motorcycle parking and Wi-Fi will help you relax and prepare for new adventures. Enjoy a delicious breakfast and recharge before the next leg of your journey.
Arkadia – a place where bikers feel at home!

name: Liad Hotel
description: Liad Bucharest City Center staff is pleased to welcome and help you for a wonderful staying in Bucharest. Working with us is having the best price-quality ratio and we are sure that you will come back next time to us like all the custormers that we had before

name: JN Boutique Hotel
description: JN Boutique Hotel is a distinctively impressive 4 star hotel close to Parliament Palace, JW Marriott Hotel and 5 minutes away from one of the biggest Cathedral in Europe. Like a fine diamond, this designed hotel rests on a quiet neighborhood. In the heart of the vibrant life of Bucharest, the JN BOUTIQUE HOTEL dazzles from the moment you enter, with eclectic, colorful design and a focus on art. The space is a riot of rich, tactile fabrics, elaborately printed wallpapers & modern art paintings. Bedrooms are all individually designed, using more than 30 different fabrics, meaning each feels unique. This lavish design hotel makes an excellent base for exploring Bucharest. Our hotel boasts that home-away-from-home atmosphere, with art-deco modern furnishings and a vibe that’s decidedly European.

name: Centrum Hotel
description: Centrum Hotel is the perfect choice for bikers seeking convenience and accessibility in the heart of the city.Its central location provides easy access to key attractions and major roads. Enjoy comfortable accommodations, free Wi-Fi, and a friendly, multilingual staff. Park your motorcycle safely and relax after a long ride in a cozy room. Centrum Hotel is your reliable haven in the heart of the action!

name: Euró Panzió
description:
Europanzio is a cozy guesthouse designed for a comfortable stay for bikers in a peaceful setting. Located away from the city bustle, Europanzio offers tranquility and proximity to nature. Free, secure parking for motorcycles will ensure the safety of your ride. Enjoy the home-like atmosphere, delicious breakfast, and the hospitality of the owners.
Europanzio - your quiet rest stop on the road to new discoveries!

name: Arc de Triomphe by CityBookings
description:
Well located in the Sector 1 district of Bucharest, Arc de Triomphe by CityBookings is situated 1.1 km from Museum of Romanian Peasant, 1.2 km from National Museum of Natural History Grigore Antipa" and 1.6 km from Dimitrie Gusti National Village Museum. It is located less than 1 km from Bucharest Arch of Triumph and provides a concierge service. The apartment features family rooms.

All units feature air conditioning and a satellite flat-screen TV. With a private bathroom equipped with a bath and slippers, units at the apartment complex also offer free WiFi, while selected rooms come with a balcony. At the apartment complex, all units are equipped with bed linen and towels.

A car rental service is available at the apartment.

Gara de Nord Metro Station is 2 km from Arc de Triomphe by CityBookings, while Ceausescu Mansion is 1.9 km away. The nearest airport is Băneasa Airport, 5 km from the accommodation.

name: Zenith Conference and Spa
description:
Spiritul Zenith nu înseamnă doar relaxare, servicii de calitate și personal prietenos, ci și transparență până la cele mai mici detalii. Pe lângă facilitățile incluse în pachetele de vacanță, la noi găsiți soluții și ingredientele unei experiențe reușite.

Cât timp vei sta la noi, ne dorim să-ți anticipăm nevoile, să te detașăm de rutina cotidiană, să te desfătăm cu atenția noastră, să te convingem să masori timpul numai în dimineți relaxate, zile însorite și seri elegante, să ai amintiri memorabile și să-ti doresti să revii.

name: Malom Hotel
description:
Malom Hotel is a stylish hotel by a former mill, offering a unique experience for bikers. Located in a picturesque setting, the hotel combines modern comfort with a historical atmosphere. Free motorcycle parking, Wi-Fi, and a restaurant with excellent cuisine – everything for your convenience. Relax in spacious rooms and enjoy beautiful views after an exciting ride.
Malom Hotel – your charming stopover with character and hospitality!

name: Le Premier
description: Experience timeless comfort at Le Premier Hotel where each moment is crafted for your pleasure. Immerse yourself in a symphony of classic elegance and modern sophistication. Choose from 2 types of rooms for your perfect stay.

name: Hotel Club Scandinavia
description:
Hotel Scandinavia, located on the shores of Lake Siutghiol, offers a rare combination of luxury, privacy and spectacular views. Every detail is designed for the comfort of our guests, from the elegant rooms with lake views, to the refined restaurant and terrace where sunsets become memorable experiences.

The central location in Mamaia allows you quick access to the vibrant life of the resort, while maintaining a quiet and select atmosphere. At Hotel Scandinavia, every stay becomes an unforgettable experience.

name: Friskó Panzió
description:
Frisko Panzió in Zalakaros is an excellent choice for bikers looking to combine relaxation with thermal springs. The guesthouse is located near the famous Zalakaros spa, ideal for relaxing after a long ride. Enjoy cozy accommodations, free parking, and the opportunity to recharge in a peaceful setting. Savor local cuisine and the hospitality of the hosts, who are ready to help you with any questions.
Frisko Panzió – your oasis of relaxation and comfort on your biker route!

name: Hotel Sinaia
description:
Hotel Sinaia is a mountain resort centrally located on the main street in the picturesque town of Sinaia, Romania.

We warmly welcome you to enjoy the Hotel Sinaia complete experience - enjoy our fine dining from a contemporary cocktail to traditional Romanian food, pamper yourself in our newly opened Silena Mountain Spa, and have a good night sleep in our newly refurbished rooms.

name: Hotel Forrás Zalakaros
description:
Hotel Forrás in Zalakaros is the perfect place for bikers, combining comfort, entertainment, and thermal springs. Enjoy the proximity to healing waters and the modern amenities of the hotel, specially created for your relaxation. Secure motorcycle parking, Wi-Fi, and a wide selection of SPA treatments will allow you to fully unwind. Recharge after a long ride in comfortable rooms and treat yourself to delicious dishes in the restaurant.
Hotel Forrás - your best choice for a recharge and new biker adventures!

name: Hotel Casa Iris
description:
With a great location and excellent facilities, Casa Iris Hotel & Restaurant is perfect for a peaceful vacation or a corporate event. Just 125 km from Bucharest, in the heart of Prahova Valley, we are close to top attractions: 1 km from Peleș Castle and 700 m from Sinaia Monastery and the Gondola. Famous hiking trails like the Royal Path, Royal Sheepfold Meadow, St. Ana Rock, and Franz Joseph Rocks are nearby.
Built in a charming chalet style, the hotel offers breathtaking views of the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains. We provide 14 double rooms, 4 junior suites, and 2 senior suites, all with balconies, LED TV, minibar, free Wi-Fi, hairdryer, phone, and a kettle for tea and coffee. Guests can enjoy delicious local and international dishes in our elegant restaurant or on the terrace.
For corporate meetings, our conference room accommodates up to 40 people, while The Club features a billiard table, gym, and two saunas (dry and hammam).
Outdoors, the barbecue area is perfect for events of up to 100 guests, complete with a campfire. Free parking is available for 18 cars.
Our high-quality services are reflected in over 1,500 positive online reviews.

name: Hotel Cumpătu
description: Cumpătu Sinaia Hotel offers you all the comfort possible with four-star amenities, in its 27 Twin, Executive, Deluxe or Junior Suite rooms. In addition to the breathtaking view, the rooms are equipped with LCD TV, telephone, individual safe, mini-bar, internet access, individual ambient thermostat, bathrooms with bathtub, hairdryer, emergency alarm, etc.

name: Hotel Ceramica
description:
Located in a very important area of ​​Iași, a few meters from the large Iulius Mall Shopping Center, 7 minutes from the largest Mall in Moldova – Palas Iași, just 10 minutes from the city's civic center and other points of interest, in an area with the highest density of restaurants, terraces, pizzerias, bars and cafes, clubs, pubs in Iași.

Hotel Ceramica is aimed at all those who visit the "beautiful fair" for both business and tourist purposes.

name: Pleiada Boutique Hotel & Spa
description: Pleiada Boutique Hotel is the only five-star hotel in the Moldavian region. The hotel is located in a quiet and secluded area of ​​Iași. Just a seven-minute drive from the city center, the place is an oasis of peace, filled with the sounds of nature and where sunrises and sunsets are a real spectacle. “Inspired by nature” is the idea behind the construction of the five-star wing of the hotel. Guests can book exclusive rooms and suites, which recreate a comfortable, intimate atmosphere and are suitable for business, leisure or family trips.

name: Denisa Boutique Hotel
description: Denisa Boutique Hotel is the perfect base for bikers exploring Transylvania. Situated in Brasov, the hotel offers easy access to mountain roads and local attractions. After a long day in the saddle, relax in comfortable rooms with modern amenities. Secure parking is available for motorcycles. Enjoy a delicious breakfast before heading out on new adventures through Romania.

name: Ana Hotels Bradul Poiana Brașov
description: Located in the scenic Poiana Brasov, Bradul Hotel is an excellent choice for bikers looking to explore Transylvania. The hotel offers comfortable accommodation and easy access to the legendary Transfăgărășan and Transalpina roads. Recover after a ride with a visit to the spa or enjoying fine dining in the restaurant. Free motorcycle parking and proximity to points of interest make it an ideal base for a biker stopover. Get ready for an unforgettable motorcycle trip!

name: Rizzo Boutique Hotel
description: Rizzo Boutique Hotel in Brasov is an excellent choice for bikers looking to explore Transylvania. The hotel is located in a quiet area, yet close to the city center and main tourist attractions. Comfortable rooms, modern design, and attentive staff will ensure you have a pleasant stay. Free parking makes the hotel convenient for motorcyclists. From here, it's easy to reach the Transfăgărășan and other scenic routes.

name: Golden Tulip Ana Tower
description: Golden Tulip Ana Tower in Sibiu is an excellent choice for bikers touring Transylvania. Its convenient location in the city makes it a great starting point for exploring the surroundings and scenic roads. The hotel offers modern rooms, comfort, and quality service after a long day on the road. Secure parking is available for motorcyclists. Enjoy panoramic views of Sibiu from the rooftop terrace and recharge before the next leg of your journey.

name: Hotel Casa Luxemburg
description: "Domul Luxemburg" in Sibiu is a cozy hotel perfectly suited for bikers exploring Transylvania. Located in the heart of the old town, within walking distance of major attractions and restaurants. The hotel offers comfortable rooms in a historic building with modern amenities. The hotel owners are happy to help you plan your route and share tips on the best roads for motorcyclists. Free parking (on request) adds convenience for those traveling by motorcycle.

name: Best Western Silva
description: Best Western Silva in Sibiu is a modern and comfortable hotel, ideal for a biker stopover in Transylvania. The hotel's location is convenient for exploring the historic center of Sibiu and the surrounding roads. Guests are offered comfortable rooms, a restaurant, and a bar where they can relax after a long day in the saddle. Free parking is available on site, which is essential for motorcyclists. A friendly staff is always ready to assist with route planning and provide the necessary information.

name: Lol et Lola Hotel
description: Lol et Lola Hotel in Cluj-Napoca is a stylish and modern hotel, a great choice for bikers traveling through Transylvania. The hotel is located near the city center, providing easy access to attractions and restaurants. After a day spent in the saddle, relax in comfortable rooms with modern design. Free parking allows you to safely store your motorcycle. Enjoy an excellent breakfast and set off on new adventures along Romanian roads.

name: Hotel Belvedere
description: Hotel Belvedere in Cluj-Napoca offers practical accommodation for bikers looking to explore Transylvania. The hotel is located near the historical center, providing easy access to city attractions and restaurants. Guests are offered comfortable rooms and basic amenities necessary for a relaxing stay. Free parking is available on site, which is especially convenient for motorcyclists. Use this hotel as a great starting point for exploring Romanian roads and mountains.

name: Savoy Hotel
description: Savoy Hotel in Timisoara is a convenient choice for bikers traveling through western Romania. Located in the city center, the hotel offers easy access to attractions and restaurants. Guests are offered comfortable rooms and basic amenities for a pleasant stay. Free, secure parking is an important plus for those traveling by motorcycle. Use the Savoy Hotel as a starting point for exploring Banat and the surrounding areas.

name: Pensiunea Ana Maria
description: Pensiunea Ana Maria in Oradea is a cozy guesthouse providing a peaceful retreat for bikers traveling through Romania. Located not far from the center of Oradea, it offers easy access to local attractions. Guests are offered clean and comfortable rooms, as well as a warm welcome from the owners. Secure parking for motorcycles is available on site. Enjoy the homely atmosphere and use Pensiunea Ana Maria as a convenient base for exploring the Crisana region.

name: VILA TOPAZ
description: VILA TOPAZ offers comfortable and affordable accommodation for bikers traveling through Romania. It provides a peaceful rest after a long day on the road. Guests are offered cozy rooms with basic amenities. Free parking on site makes the hotel convenient for motorcyclists. VILA TOPAZ is a great choice for those who want to explore Oradea and its surroundings without overpaying for accommodation.

name: Hotel Central Park Sighisoara
description: This hotel is an excellent choice for bikers looking to explore Transylvania. Central Park Hotel offers convenient access to historical landmarks and thrilling mountain roads. Here you will find secure parking for motorcycles and comfortable rooms to relax after a long ride. The hotel restaurant serves delicious local cuisine and refreshing drinks. It's a great place to stop and recharge before new motorcycle adventures.

name: La Teo Guesthouse and Cellar
description: Head to Pensiune Pivnita Lui Teo in medieval Sighisoara to experience the spirit of history. This guesthouse, located within the citadel walls, offers cozy rooms and the atmosphere of an old wine cellar. After the thrilling winding roads of Transylvania, you can relax and enjoy the tranquility of this ancient city. Secure parking for motorcycles is available. The guesthouse restaurant offers traditional Romanian dishes and local wines that tell the stories of the area. It's the perfect place to spend the night and immerse yourself in the past before hitting the road again.

name: Korona Hotel
description:
Situated at the foot of the medieval citadel, Hotel Korona offers an exceptional blend of modern comfort and historical ambiance in the heart of Sighișoara, one of Romania’s most treasured UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

Whether you’re visiting for leisure or business, Hotel Korona provides a welcoming retreat with top-tier amenities and easy access to the rich cultural heritage of the city.

name: Delta
description:
Hotel Delta keeps its doors open all year round, both for tourists coming for business purposes and for those who want to get to know the natural beauties of the Danube Delta, the traditions and lifestyle of the locals in the surrounding villages.

At Hotel Delta, you will enjoy impeccable service and comfortable accommodation. The view of the Tulcea port, located in the immediate vicinity, invites you to take the trip you dream of in the Danube Delta!

name: Hotel City
description: Hotel City has 24 modern double rooms, which offer clients all the necessary comfort, both for a relaxing vacation and for business meetings. The hotel provides its guests with ultra-modern accommodation services: air conditioning, minibar, cable television, international telephone line, high-speed internet connection in all rooms and public spaces.

name: Hotel Continental Suceava
description: MyContinental Suceava is a hotel in Suceava that offers accommodation services in the city centre. The 3 stars hotel is close to the main touristic and business attractions. In 1970, the building of the hotel has received the prize of the Union of Architects and was given as an example in the architecture literature.

Visit us and enjoy your break at the mk | hotel tirana.

Stay connected, while you are in business Trip, watch your preferred material, and take advantage of modern conveniences that are incorporated into our luxurious accommodation.

We are 500 metres from the closest taxi and bus station, so getting around is a breeze. Tour the city and admire its eclectic clash of architectural styles or journey further afield and explore the beautiful beaches that line the Adriatic coast.

Take a refreshing dip in our outdoor swimming pool Or head down to our ground-floor Summer Café and enjoy a range of hot drinks and snacks. Top out door swimming pool Mercure Tirana Hotel offer a confortable stay in a strategic location, near historic centre Tirana and Tirana International Airport. Equipped with leissure facilities as Roof-top, pool and garden restaurant it is the best choice for your trips.

Welcome to Mercure Tirana Hotel. We will be delighted to have you as our guest. Our team is dedicated to ensuring a memorable stay filled with comfort, exceptional service, and authentic experiences. Enjoy your time in Tirana.

This property is 18 minutes walk from the beach. Set in Vlorë, a few steps from Vlore Beach, Marina Premium Hotel offers accommodation with a bar, free private parking and a private beach area. Located around less than 1 km from Ri Beach, the hotel with free WiFi is also a 17-minute walk away from Vjetër Beach. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk, room service and currency exchange for guests.

At the hotel, rooms include a desk. Complete with a private bathroom fitted with a shower and slippers, all guest rooms at Marina Premium Hotel have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and some rooms also feature a seating area. At the accommodation the rooms are equipped with bed linen and towels.

Guests at Marina Premium Hotel can enjoy a à la carte breakfast.

Activities such as snorkelling, cycling, fishing can be enjoyed in the surroundings, and guests can relax along the beachfront.

Plazhi i Vjeter Beach is 2.4 km from the hotel, while Kuzum Baba is 3 km from the property.

name: Central Hotel
description: Hotel Central Vlorë is a new hotel located in the heart of Vlora, which offers an exceptional accommodation experience. In the center of the city of Vlora, this hotel structure is the perfect destination for those who wish to enjoy the beauty and attractions of this coastal city.

name: Hotel Aliko
description:
Boasting an on-site restaurant and bar with a terrace and sea views, Hotel Aliko is set in Vlorë, 7 km from Kuzum Baba. Free WiFi is available and free private parking is provided.

The air conditioned rooms are equipped with a seating area, fridge and a flat-screen cable TV. Private bathroom come with a shower and a bidet. Free toiletries and a hairdryer are provided.

Every room features a balcony with sea or mountain views. Banquet and meeting facilities are available at the hotel. Guests will find a children’s playground at the property and the area is popular for hiking.

description: Offering an outdoor pool, Karos Hotel Llaman is located in Himare. Free WiFi access is available. This hotel is a 3-minute walk from the nearest beach. All of the accommodations at Karos Hotel Llaman offer a balcony with pool views or sea views. They all have a private bathroom fitted with a bath or shower and toilet.
