Whether you’re here for a short escape or a longer retreat, we invite you to slow down and feel truly taken care of.

name: Hotel Enkelana
description:
Hotel Enkelana is located in the center of Pogradec City. One of the unique aspects of our hotel is our location. Accommodation in one of our rooms and suites is another unique experience. All of the rooms offer a magnificent view over Lake Ohrid. Our newly-renovated rooms and suites feature modern decor, cable TV, mini-refrigerator, air conditioning, and a private balcony with a lake view. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi. The hotel is a well-equipped and adaptable venue for conferences, banquets and meetings, welcoming large capacities of guests. The Bar Restaurant serves traditional Albanian, as well as international specialties. Breakfast is served on the same Restaurant, whose veranda gives to our guests the unique chance to enjoy it.

Hotel Enkelana in Pogradec City offers a unique experience with its central location and stunning views of Lake Ohrid from all rooms. Newly-renovated rooms and suites feature modern amenities, including free Wi-Fi. The hotel is an adaptable venue for conferences, banquets, and meetings. The Bar Restaurant serves traditional Albanian and international specialties.

name: Hotel Dior Krujë
description: Set in Krujë, 32 km from Skanderbeg Square, Hotel Dior offers accommodation with a terrace, free private parking, a restaurant and a bar. Among the facilities at this property are room service and a 24-hour front desk, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The property is non-smoking and is situated 36 km from Dajti Ekspres Cable Car.

name: Hotel Belvedere
description:
Placed in the pine forest of St. Stefan, 4 km from Ohrid and 100 m from the lake coast,

Hotel Belvedere is a brand that offers wide range of services and comforts enjoying a splendid views on the oldest lake in Europe. With its perfect balance between classical elegance and modern comforts, the four star hotel Belvedere offers 88 newly decorated rooms, two seminar halls, one modern hotel restaurant and two traditional restaurants in the center of the town Ohrid, piano lobby bar, antique shop, own parking.

As soon as you arrive, you will immediately be immersed in a warm atmosphere and unique ambience. From the elegant lobby with classical instruments and antiques to the comfortable furnished rooms with breathtaking views, you will find a true beauty here. The effect of this combination between essential style and focus on details provoke on every guest a desire to return.

name: Villa Niko
description:
Vila Niko & Ohrid, the Balkan Pearl
Located in Ohrid, 700 m from Lake Ohrid, Vila Niko has accommodations with a bar, free private parking, a garden and a terrace. The property is around 1 km from Center, 2 km from Port Ohrid and 2.4 km from Church of St. John at Kaneo. The property provides a 24-hour front desk and free WiFi is available.

we hope our service and quality can meet your needs

description:
Welcome to Struga Riverview Hotel
Located in the heart of Struga, Riverview Hotel offers modern comfort and stunning views. Enjoy cozy accommodations, excellent dining, and facilities for events, workshops, and outdoor adventures. Your perfect stay by the river awaits!

name: Hotel Drim & SPA

description: Hotel Drim is located on the shores of Lake Ohrid and the Black Drim River, in the heart of the city of Struga. Whether you are on vacation, a seminar, a celebration, we are here to satisfy all your senses. Come and join us for a unique experience!

name: Robevski Luxury Rooms
description:
Robevski luxury rooms is located 33 km from Florina and 10 km from National Park Pelister. The building lies at the core of Bitola, which is the famous street Shirok Sokak, next to the Old Catolic Church. The rooms in this historic building, which exists almost 200 years, are completely reconstructed in a luxurious time travel to the past of Bitola city.

Robevski luxury rooms provides 6 luxurious rooms in a different style. They are called after the former names of the most famous street in Bitola Shirok Sokak, such as Hamidie, King Petar, Marshall Tito. There is also a room called after the father of modern Turkey, Mustafa Kemal Ataturk, who finished his military studies in this city. Provided that the city is known as the City of Consuls, one of the rooms carries this names. Every room has its avtentic story related to the history of Bitola. The rooms which the building provides represent Bitola as a Consul and urban city whit a luxurious atmosphere. All rooms a equipped whit baths, air conditioners, a fridge, safe deposit boxes, hair dryers, hipoalergenic and antibacterial mattresses, cable TV, WI-FI. In some of the rooms there is a balcony with a fantastic view of the famous street Shirok Sokak. Guests can treat themselves with coffee, tea and fruit. There is a casino and restaurant.

name: Mercure Tetovo
description:
Mercure Tetovo is an international branded 5-star hotel located in the heart of the city overlooking the Sar Mountain range. We have 101 non-smoking rooms and suites, local inspired design combined with state-of-the-art facilities. Our hotel offers the best hospitality and services in the region with a fine restaurant, bar, terrace, conference and ballrooms, wellness center all this combined with the traditionally Mercure welcome and hospitality. Simply a great place to work and to relax.

name: Hotel Vola
description: Hotel Vola is a great place for bikers looking to relax after a long day in the saddle, offering comfortable rooms and a welcoming atmosphere. The convenient location of Hotel Vola makes it easy to explore the scenic roads of southern Albania and enjoy the breathtaking views along the way. Hotel Vola features motorcycle parking, where your trusty steed will be safe while you enjoy local cuisine in the hotel restaurant. The staff at Hotel Vola is always happy to help bikers with information on the best routes, local attractions, and nearby motorcycle repair shops. After an adventurous day, return to Hotel Vola to relax by the pool, share stories with fellow travelers, and prepare for new exploits.

name: The Queen's Lion Premium Hotel
description: The Queen's Lion - Premium Hotel is a luxurious retreat for bikers to relax and recharge after conquering the winding roads of Albania. Enjoy top-notch service and comfort.This hotel offers secure and convenient motorcycle parking, so you can rest assured that your bike is safe while you enjoy your stay.Located near key routes, The Queen's Lion - Premium Hotel is an ideal starting point for exploring the scenic corners of southern Albania on two wheels. At the hotel, you can find information about local biker clubs and events, allowing you to experience the spirit of the motorcycle community. After a day full of adventures, treat yourself to a delicious dinner at The Queen's Lion - Premium Hotel restaurant and share your experiences with other moto-travelers.

name: Hotel Meta
description: Hotel Meta in Ksamil is a great place for bikers looking to enjoy the beauty of the Albanian coast, with a convenient location near some of the country's best beaches. The hotel offers secure motorbike parking, allowing you to relax knowing your bike is safe. From Hotel Meta, it's easy to reach Butrint National Park, making it an ideal base for exploring historical and natural attractions. After a full day in the saddle, enjoy fresh seafood at one of the many restaurants near the hotel, while enjoying views of the Ionian Sea. The staff at Hotel Meta will be happy to share information about the best motorcycle routes in the region, including scenic mountain roads and coastal serpentines.

name: Sondor Hotel
description: Sondor Hotel in Saranda is an excellent choice for bikers, offering comfortable accommodation with sea views and easy access to the region's main roads. The hotel has a motorcycle parking area where you can safely leave your bike and enjoy the surroundings. Sondor Hotel's location makes it easy to reach scenic spots such as Ksamil and Butrint National Park, offering plenty of options for day trips on your motorcycle. After a day full of adventures, relax at the Sondor Hotel rooftop bar, enjoying local drinks and stunning sunset views. The staff at Sondor Hotel will be happy to help you with tips on the best routes, local attractions, and nearby motorcycle repair shops.

name: Sunlight Hotel
description: Sunlight Hotel in Ksamil is a wonderful choice for bikers looking to enjoy the beauty of the Albanian Riviera, located just minutes from the famous beaches. The hotel offers convenient and free motorcycle parking, allowing you to explore the surroundings knowing your bike is safe. From Sunlight Hotel, it's easy to reach Butrint National Park, a historical city-museum that is a must-see during your motorcycle trip. After a busy day on your motorcycle, relax on the terrace of Sunlight Hotel, enjoying views of the crystal-clear Ionian Sea. The staff at Sunlight Hotel is always ready to share information about secret spots and scenic routes for motorcyclists around Ksamil.

name: Hotel Kaceli
description: Hotel Kaceli in Berat is an excellent choice for bikers looking to discover the historic "city of a thousand windows," a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The hotel provides secure parking for motorcycles, allowing you to peacefully explore the narrow streets and picturesque surroundings of Berat. From Hotel Kaceli, it's easy to reach Berat Castle, ancient mosques and churches, as well as the nearby Osumi Canyon. After an exciting day in the saddle, enjoy a traditional Albanian dinner in the hotel restaurant, admiring the view of the city. The staff at Hotel Kaceli is always ready to help bikers with information on the best motorcycle routes in the region, including scenic mountain roads and nearby wineries.

name: Hotel Rezidenca Desaret
description: Hotel Rezidenca Desaret in Berat is an excellent choice for bikers looking to explore this historic city, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with its unique architecture. The hotel offers secure parking for your motorcycle, allowing you to calmly stroll through the narrow streets and explore local attractions. The convenient location of Hotel Rezidenca Desaret makes it easy to reach Berat Fortress, medieval churches and mosques, offering many opportunities for interesting rides. After a day spent in the saddle, enjoy traditional Albanian dishes in the hotel restaurant, admiring the beautiful view of the city. The staff at Hotel Rezidenca Desaret will be happy to provide you with information on the best motorcycle routes in the area, including scenic mountain roads and nearby wineries.

name: Hotel Villa Edis
description: Guest House Villa Edis in Berat is a great option for bikers looking for a cozy and homely atmosphere in the heart of the historic city. You'll feel right at home here! The guest house's small courtyard offers a safe place to park your motorcycle, which is especially valuable in the narrow streets of Berat. Villa Edis is within walking distance of Berat Fortress and other historical sites, allowing you to easily explore the city and its surroundings on your motorcycle. After a busy day, enjoy home-cooked Albanian cuisine, which the guest house owners will be happy to prepare, and discuss your travel experiences with other travelers. The owners of Villa Edis will be happy to share with you secret routes for motorcyclists in the surroundings of Berat and give you tips on the best places to visit.

name: Palorto Inn
description: Palorto Inn is a great choice for bikers looking for comfortable and stylish accommodation. This hotel in Albania offers modern rooms and a warm, friendly atmosphere. Start your day with a hearty breakfast and unwind in the cozy bar in the evening. The hotel's location is ideal for exploring local attractions and scenic routes. It has everything you need for a great stop during your trip.

name: DAM Stone Boutique Hotel
description: Dam Stone Boutique Hotel is a stylish haven for bikers, located in the heart of Albania. The hotel offers modern rooms with unique design and all the amenities for a comfortable stay. Enjoy delicious meals in the hotel restaurant, relax in the bar, and appreciate the welcoming atmosphere. The convenient location provides easy access to key attractions and scenic routes. Here you will find the perfect combination of style, comfort, and convenience for your biker adventure.

name: Qeli's House
description: Villa Qeli is a quiet and cozy hotel, perfect for bikers looking to relax from the road. Located in a picturesque area of Albania, this hotel offers comfortable rooms and a welcoming atmosphere. Enjoy traditional Albanian cuisine in the restaurant and relax in the garden with stunning views. The convenient location allows you to explore the surrounding area and scenic routes. Villa Qeli is a great choice for those seeking a peaceful and relaxing experience.

name: Labiatan Zogaj
description: Labiatan Hotel is a modern hotel offering comfortable accommodations for bikers in Albania. Appreciate the stylish rooms with amenities necessary to relax after a long ride. The hotel restaurant serves local and international cuisine. Take advantage of the hotel's convenient location to explore local attractions and scenic roads. Labiatan Hotel is a great choice for those who value comfort and quality at an affordable price.

name: Duomo Resort
description: Duomo Resort is an elegant hotel in the city center, perfect for bikers who want to combine road adventures with comfort. Enjoy stylish and modern rooms, offering all the necessary amenities. After a busy day on the motorcycle, relax in the hotel restaurant, which offers delicious dishes. Thanks to its convenient location, you can easily reach the main attractions and starting points for exciting routes. Duomo Resort is a great choice for those who appreciate style and convenience.

name: Hotel Rozafa
description: Rozafa Hotel Shkoder is a great choice for bikers visiting the historic city of Shkoder. This hotel offers comfortable rooms and a convenient location to explore local attractions, including the famous Rozafa Fortress. Enjoy Albanian hospitality and delicious cuisine in the hotel restaurant. Free parking is a convenient amenity for motorcyclists. Rozafa Hotel will be a starting point for new adventures on the roads of Albania.

name: Hotel Kocibelli POOL & SPA
description: Hotel Kocibelli is an excellent choice for bikers traveling through Albania and looking for a comfortable and welcoming place to rest. The hotel offers comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, and private parking for motorcycles. Start your day with a delicious breakfast and enjoy traditional Albanian dishes in the hotel restaurant. The hotel's convenient location provides easy access to the region's main attractions. Hotel Kocibelli – your reliable haven on the road!

name: Vecchia Boutique Hotel
description: Vecchia Boutique Hotel is a stylish and welcoming hotel, perfect for bikers looking to experience the atmosphere of the old town. Located in the heart of the historic district, the hotel offers unique rooms with modern amenities. After an exciting ride, relax in the cozy bar and enjoy local delicacies. The convenient location provides easy access to key attractions and interesting routes. Vecchia Boutique Hotel is your ideal choice for a stylish and memorable stay.

name: Tree hotel
description: Hotel Tree is a cozy and modern hotel, perfect for bikers traveling through Albania. The hotel offers comfortable rooms with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. Guests can relax in the hotel's bar or enjoy local cuisine in nearby restaurants. Free parking on the hotel grounds provides a safe place for your motorcycles. Thanks to its convenient location, you can easily explore the surrounding area and scenic roads.

name: Hotel „Garden Spa“
description: Bikers, forget about fatigue and road dust at the Garden Spa Hotel! Comfortable rooms await you here, where you can relax after a long day in the saddle. Relax your muscles in the spa with a swimming pool and sauna. In the hotel restaurant, you can enjoy hearty local cuisine to restore your energy. Convenient motorcycle parking will allow you not to worry about the safety of your iron horse. Garden Spa Hotel is the perfect place to reboot on your biker trip through Macedonia!

name: Hotel „Osten Art“
description: For bikers seeking style and comfort in Skopje, Osten Art Hotel is an excellent choice! This hotel offers modern rooms with unique designs, where you can relax after long rides. The restaurant serves delicious local and international cuisine to fuel you up. The hotel's convenient location allows you to easily reach the city's main attractions. And after a day on your motorcycle, relax in the cozy bar with a refreshing drink. Secure motorcycle parking will ensure peace of mind for your iron horse.

name: Hotel Premium
description: Bikers, if you're seeking elegance and comfort in Skopje, Hotel Premium is your choice! Enjoy stylish rooms offering the perfect blend of modern design and amenities for relaxing after long kilometers. The hotel restaurant serves exquisite European cuisine, and you can unwind with your favorite drink at the bar. The convenient location allows you to easily explore the city and its surroundings by motorcycle. The hotel offers secure parking for bikes, so you can peacefully enjoy your stay. Feel premium on your biker adventure!

name: Paint It Black Hotel
description: Hey bikers! Paint It Black Hotel is a stylish spot for true rock 'n' roll aficionados in Gevgelija, Macedonia. The hotel offers uniquely decorated rooms reminiscent of music legends. Here you can relax after exciting rides along the roads of North Macedonia. Enjoy the atmosphere of freedom and ease in the hotel bar, where you can spend the evening sharing biker stories. The security of your motorcycle is guaranteed thanks to secure parking. Paint It Black is the place where the biker spirit meets the rock 'n' roll soul!

name: Casino Motel Senator
description: Bikers, looking for a place to rest near the border? Casino Motel Senator is a convenient option for those crossing the North Macedonian border. Here you will find simple and comfortable rooms to rest before the next stage of your journey. There is a restaurant on site where you can grab a bite and have coffee to perk up. Convenient parking right in front of the motel will allow you to keep your iron horse in sight. And for those who like gambling, there is a casino on site. Casino Motel Senator is a practical choice for bikers on the road!

name: Apartments „Dan-Dar“
description: Bikers, planning a trip to North Macedonia? Check out "Dan-Dar" Apartments! These cozy apartments offer comfortable accommodation at an affordable price. After a long day in the saddle, you can relax and recharge in a quiet and peaceful setting. The convenient location makes it easy to reach local attractions and scenic routes. There is a place to park your motorcycle in the yard so you don't have to worry about its safety. "Dan-Dar" Apartments are a great choice for budget-conscious travelers!

name: Romantique Dojran Hotel
description: Bikers, heading to Dojran? Hotel Romantique Dojran offers a wonderful stay on the lake shore! This hotel is a great place to relax after long rides. Enjoy beautiful views and fresh air, as well as delicious food in the hotel restaurant. The convenient location allows you to easily explore the surroundings and enjoy nature. Secure parking is provided for bikers to keep their iron horse safe. Hotel Romantique Dojran is your romantic getaway on your biker journey!

name: Hotel Eterno
description: Bikers, traveling around Strumica? Hotel Eterno is a great option for an overnight stay! This modern hotel offers comfortable and stylish rooms for relaxing after a long ride. In the hotel restaurant, you can enjoy delicious local cuisine. The convenient location allows easy access to interesting places in the region. Safe and free parking is provided for motorcyclists. Hotel Eterno is modern comfort on your biker trip through North Macedonia!

name: Hotel Angro Palace
description: Bikers, looking for a convenient place to stay near Kavadarci? Angro Palace Hotel offers comfortable accommodation with modern amenities. After a busy ride, you can relax in stylish rooms and enjoy excellent service. The hotel restaurant offers a wide selection of local and international dishes. Secure parking is provided for motorcyclists, so you can rest assured knowing your bike is safe. Angro Palace is a great choice for bikers who appreciate comfort and convenience.

name: Wine cellar Popovi Apartments
description: Wine Cellar Popovi Apartments is the perfect combination of comfort and authentic experience! The apartments are located in an attractive area where you can relax after a long journey and enjoy the local flair. After a long ride, enjoy the tranquility of the surroundings and scenic views. There's secure parking on site for motorcycles. Wine Cellar Popovi Apartments will leave you with not only pleasant memories but also great photos!

name: Loven dom Berovo
description: Loven Dom Berovo is the perfect place to relax in the heart of the Maleshevo Mountains! This cozy hotel is surrounded by picturesque nature and Lake Berovo. After exciting roads, enjoy the peace and fresh air. In the restaurant, try traditional Macedonian dishes. Safe parking is provided for motorcyclists, so you can relax and enjoy your stay. Loven Dom Berovo is a combination of comfort and nature for true bikers!

name: Hotel Manastir Berovo
address: PV25+JX3 Kozara 8, 6 Kiril i Metodij Str
description: Hotel Manastir Berovo offers a unique combination of comfort and spirituality! Located near the Monastery of St. Archangel Michael, this hotel is ideal for relaxing after long rides. Enjoy the tranquility and beauty of the surrounding nature. The hotel has a restaurant with traditional Macedonian cuisine, as well as a spa center where you can unwind. Secure parking for bikes guarantees your peace of mind. Hotel Manastir Berovo is a place where not only your bike recharges, but also your soul!

name: Rajska rijeka
description: Rajska Rijeka is a riverside rafting camp in Bastasi, set on a green bend of the Drina/Tara with timber bungalows, tents, and a central lodge. It’s geared for riders and paddlers alike—easy roll-in from the main road, a safe courtyard to park the bikes, hot showers, and a big fire-pit zone right by the water. The kitchen leans mountain-Bosnian: grilled meats, stews, fresh bread, and “under the sač” specials, with early breakfasts before rafting. Come for a Tara Canyon run or simply to switch off by the river; in season, evenings tend to stretch into music, stories, and stars.

name: Zaborje Motel & Restaurant
description:
Zaborje Motel & Restaurant is a straightforward roadside stop in the highlands between Nikšić and Plužine, close to the Piva canyon.
The kitchen does homestyle Montenegrin mountain fare—charcoal-grilled meats, slow stews and beans, pies, fresh salads, and strong coffee.
It’s an easy roll-in from the main road with space to park the bikes; the terrace looks over pastures and pine ridges, making it a calm breather mid-ride.
A practical overnight if you’re linking the Piva–Durmitor loop or heading for the Šćepan Polje border and Tara rafting base.

name: Central Pub
description:
Central Pub is a modern neighborhood bar in New Belgrade, set on Bulevar Zorana Đinđića 106a.
By day it’s an easy coffee stop; by night expect draught beers, classic cocktails, and simple pub bites in a relaxed, social vibe.
Music and the occasional sports on TV stay at a talk-friendly volume, and a small terrace works well in warm months.
Handy as a meet-up point before dropping into the center or rolling along the river toward Zemun.

name: Vožnja kvadovima Svrljig - ATV Svrljiške planine
address: start point at ATV Svrljiške planine club (exact meeting point provided by organizers)
description:
The ATV Svrljiške planine club invites all off-road enthusiasts to a group ride across the scenic trails of the Svrljig Mountains. Riders can expect a full day of adventure: forest tracks, mountain passes, scenic viewpoints, and a welcoming biker spirit. A short safety briefing will be held before the start, with experienced riders leading and closing the convoy. It’s a perfect opportunity to test your machine, share stories, and enjoy the beauty of Serbia’s mountains together with fellow adventurers.

Additional contact: +381 64 9200 606

name: Hotel Adrović
description:
Welcome to Hotel Adrovic, your hidden gem overlooking Sveti Stefan and the Adriatic Sea. Located near the beach, our cozy rooms offer comfort and charm for every traveler.
Relax in our spacious rooms, perfect for families, couples, or solo travelers. Enjoy the indoor and outdoor seating on Mediterranean balconies with garden or sea views.
Savor the flavors of the Mediterranean while taking in the breathtaking views of Sveti Stefan and the Budva Riviera. Taste our fresh fish, meat or vegetarian specialties, but don’t forget the homemade Tiramisu.

name: Tramontana
description:
Tramontana Beach Bar is a seaside lounge located right on the waterfront in Morinj, Montenegro - ideal for riding in with sandy toes and salty air.
The vibe is completely laid-back: sunbeds, beach umbrellas, simple bites and snacks, cold drinks and cocktails to sip while watching the boats or the horizon.
Music is easygoing - Beach/Chill/World - and the layout is open, letting the Adriatic breezes do their work.
Great option for a midday stop, sunset view, or winding down after a coastal ride.

name: Fischer´s American Restaurant
description: Set your GPS for Fischer’s American Restaurant in Vienna - a biker’s haven nestled on Triester Str. beside a Harley-Davidson shop. With roaring motorcycles outside and classic American fare inside, this spot delivers juicy burgers, smoky ribs, steaks, and a laid-back bar vibe for the road-worn rider. It’s ideal for breaking up your ride or regrouping over hearty comfort food. Friendly service, a Harley-inspired interior, and a menu built for big appetites make it a must-stop on your Viennese route.

name: Bulgakov Museum
description:
The Museum of the Writer Mikhail Afanasyevich Bulgakov is rightfully considered one of the best museums in Montenegro. It is located in the center of the old town of Herceg Novi, near the Clock Tower, at the address: King Tvrtko Steps, House No. 10, Apartment No. 50 (the “unlucky apartment”).

The museum space has its own fascinating history, dating back to 1929.
The museum houses a large collection of exhibits related to the work of the outstanding writer. Visitors can explore a unique display of items, documents, awards, and jewelry from private collections; see costumes, stage props, photographs, posters, and personal belongings of theater and film actors who participated in performances based on Mikhail Bulgakov’s plays.

An engaging tour will transport you to events of long-past years. You will get a glimpse into the personal life of the unmatched Master, hear stories of his acquaintance with the writer Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, and walk through the historical labyrinths of a forgotten past.

Mikhail Bulgakov and Georgy Yakulov, Kachalov and Mariengof, Vladimir Mayakovsky and Lilya Brik, Sergei Yesenin and Isadora Duncan, Veresaev and Voloshin, Blok and Pasternak, Anna Akhmatova and Alexander Tairov, Konstantin Stanislavsky and Vladimir Topleninov, Vsevolod Meyerhold and Zinaida Raikh—you will discover what connected these very different people.

name: HOTEL ĐOKOVIĆ
description:
Hotel Đoković is located on the main road Risan - Žabljak, at the city of Šavnik, only 20km from the National Park Durmitor. Surrounded by fascinating beauties which are reflected due to natural phenomenon and its location on the three water, two dawns and two sunrise and sunset. Fitting in with the natural environment, the hotel with the appearance of a bird in flight captures with unusual appearance and stunning views from the terrace, which leaves you breathless.
Hotel offers furnished restaurant, domestic and international cuisine and friendly staff. Restaurant menu offers a wide range of traditional Montenegrin specialties.
To make your stay even better our professional team is at your disposal at any time and can assist you in terms of organizing any trips, transportation, bookings, celebrations, etc.
Enjoy the north part of our county and have an unforgettable vacation at Hotel Đoković.

name: InterContinental Sofia by IHG
description: InterContinental Sofia by IHG is a polished international chain hotel near Parliament, favored by bikers who value consistency and executive perks. 10 km from the airport, with E79 access for Black Sea or Vitosha loops. On-site the hotel features a multi-level garage with dedicated motorcycle bays. After your ride, work off dust in the gym or relax in spacious rooms with work desks, and in the evening attend a networking event or enjoy steak at the lobby bar.

name: Grand Hotel Sofia
description: Grand Hotel Sofia is a grand, historic 5-star property facing City Garden, a luxurious base for bikers treating themselves after long Balkan hauls. 10 km from the airport, with A1 on-ramp for Stara Planina or Danube runs. On-site the hotel offers a guarded underground garage tailored for motorcycles. After your ride, indulge in opulent rooms with chandeliers and marble, and in the evening dine in the gourmet restaurant or people-watch from the garden terrace.

name: Sense Hotel Sofia
description: Sense Hotel Sofia is a sleek, design-driven boutique hotel on Tsar Osvoboditel Boulevard, perfect for bikers who appreciate modern aesthetics and rooftop views. 10 km from the airport, steps from E79 for Pirin or Rhodope escapes. On-site the hotel provides valet-style parking for motorcycles. After your ride, recharge in minimalist rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows, and in the evening sip craft cocktails on the rooftop bar overlooking Alexander Nevsky Cathedral.

name: Hotel Sofia Palace
description: Hotel Sofia Palace is a classic, mid-range hotel tucked on a side street off Vitosha Boulevard, ideal for bikers who want central location without the premium price tag. Just 12 km from the airport, with easy A1 access for Balkan or Rila Monastery loops. On-site the hotel has limited but secure parking suitable for bikes. After your ride, unwind in traditional rooms with wooden accents, and in the evening stroll Vitosha’s shops or hit a cozy mehana for banitsa and rakia.

name: B1 City Hotel Sofia
description: B1 City Hotel Sofia is a practical, business-oriented hotel in the Mladost district, making it a solid overnight stop for bikers transiting through Sofia. It’s 7 km from the airport and 3 km from the center, with direct E79 access for Vitosha or Rila runs. On-site the hotel offers secure underground parking perfect for motorcycles. After your ride, crash in no-frills modern rooms, and in the evening grab a quick bite at a nearby mall or relax in the quiet residential streets.

name: Adella Boutique Hotel
description: Adella Boutique Hotel is a cozy boutique hotel located at 15G Tintyava Street, in a calm yet accessible part of Sofia. The hotel combines stylish design, cleanliness and personalized service. An important advantage is the secured parking on site, making it an excellent choice for motorcyclists needing a safe place for their bike. Rooms are modest in size but tastefully furnished with all essential amenities. It works well both for short stopovers and for stays in the city without excess noise.

name: Vipmotors
description: Vipmotors is a professional motorcycle workshop in Sofia, specializing in maintenance and repairs of various brands, including touring and enduro bikes. The team understands the needs of travelers — they offer urgent repairs, chain and tire replacement, and general servicing. The mechanics handle bikes with care and are always ready to assist riders on the road. Conveniently located in the Reduta area, just a short ride from the city center. A great option for those on a motorcycle trip looking for reliable support in Bulgaria.

name: TG Service
address: Sofia Center, ulitsa "Sv. Sveti Kiril I Metodiy" 119
description: TG Service is a modern motorcycle workshop located in the heart of Sofia, specializing in sport and street bike maintenance. The experienced team provides diagnostics, oil changes, brake and chain replacement, and general servicing. Their careful attention to detail makes this place ideal for riders traveling through Bulgaria. Conveniently located near the city center, it’s easy to reach for a quick stop or urgent repair. They work with multiple brands and are known for fast, reliable service.

name: Café Hubraum
description: A classic biker beer-garden on the Wupper with a huge terrace and plenty of bike parking - weekend crowds are the norm. You’ll see everything from cruisers to café racers, and conversations start easily over the bikes. Food is hearty, coffee stops are spot-on, and late breakfasts work well. Access and layout are tailored to heavy two-wheel traffic, so rolling in is easy. The vibe is welcoming for first-timers and non-riders alike.

name: Thunderbike Roadhouse
description: An American-style roadhouse attached to the famed Thunderbike custom HQ—burgers, ribs, and biker socials done right. Inside you’ll find H-D memorabilia and showcase builds; next door are the dealership and displays. Regular events, buffets, and meets pull a big community. There’s tons of space and loads of parking. A perfect start/finish hub for Lower Rhine loops.

name: AVUS-Treff Spinner-Brücke
description: Berlin’s iconic roadside restaurant & beer garden off the A115 has been the city’s biker magnet since the 1920s. Weekends turn the forecourt into a rolling bike show—from tourers to customs. Expect German-Austrian staples (schnitzel, strudel, currywurst) and quick counter service. It’s a perfect jump-off for short loops to Wannsee and the Grunewald. Group-friendly layout with plenty of outdoor tables. On-site parking for bikes and cars is explicitly mentioned by reviewers.

name: Biker Ranch Eifel
description: Big terrace, quick bites, and easy parking—this is a tried-and-true stop after the Eifel’s twisties. In season, riders report hundreds of bikes rolling in; it’s ideal for group meets. Food quality varies, but service and vibe are consistently friendly. Pairs well with routes around the Rursee and toward the Nürburgring. Frequently recommended in rider feeds as a dependable anchor.

name: Zündstoff Edersee
description: Part roadhouse, part western-style motel, and a major biker meet right by Lake Edersee. Expect American comfort food, lots of outdoor seating, and an event-friendly setup - good for a quick pit stop or an overnight. Clubs and tour groups drop in often; their IG calls out “All bikers welcome.” A perfect hub for scenic loops around the dam and Kellerwald-Edersee.

name: Kathi Bräu Heckenhof
description: A legendary beer garden and micro-brewery in Franconian Switzerland - this place has been a biker institution for decades. Homemade food, cakes, and ultra-fresh beer; in season the lot overflows with bikes. The vibe is family-friendly yet full of petrol talk. A great launchpad for twisty valleys and crags nearby. Frequently praised in guides and rider chatter.

name: Bavaria Alm Torfhaus
description: A big plateau meet at ~800 m with snack bars and Brocken views—weekends get absolutely packed. There’s ample space for group parking, and the surrounding passes are superb. “Bavaria Alm” is a solid end-of-ride spot for hot meals and sweets. The site shows up in most Harz ride guides. Parking was reduced—arrive early.

name: Fährimbiss am Anleger in Zollenspieker
description:
During the season (from March to the end of November), our ferry snack bar at the dock in Zollenspieker is open from 10:00 a.m. Here you can enjoy coffee and cake, bratwurst, sandwiches, ice cream, and much more.

Tables with benches and bar tables are available, inviting you to linger by the Elbe. The ferry snack bar is a popular meeting place among cyclists and especially motorcyclists. Ample parking for motorcycles is available.

name: Bigge Grill
description: A classic Sauerland stop on Lake Bigge’s west shore: big parking, quick snacks, fair prices. It’s heaving in season - extra seating was added. Beloved by riders working the L512 twisties. Frequently covered in local news and rider chats, including traffic-safety notes.

name: Road Stop Dortmund
description: A US-style bar & grill with motel rooms - good for an evening meet or an overnight on tour. Think diner classics, sports on TV, and ample parking. Popular for groups before/after Ruhr and Sauerland rides. The chain also runs spots in Münsterland and Wuppertal.

name: motorbike service
description: Motorbike Service in Bansko — a dedicated motorcycle workshop located in the very heart of the mountain resort. It caters both to enduro bikes and street models, offering oil changes, tire replacements, tune-ups and full servicing. They carry parts suitable for the demanding mountain routes of Bulgaria and are adept at quickly prepping bikes for alpine conditions. Its convenient location in Bansko makes it a perfect stop for riders touring the Rhodope or Pirin mountain passes looking for a reliable “roadside” service. A solid choice for motorcyclists who value speed and quality.

name: Malinov Moto Service
description:
Malinov Moto Service is a trusted motorcycle workshop in Plovdiv with years of experience in repairing and maintaining mopeds, motorcycles, and ATVs.
They provide diagnostics, engine and chassis repairs, tuning, and seasonal maintenance.
The service also offers transport of your bike to and from any location — very convenient for travelers on the road.
Skilled mechanics use reliable spare parts and modern equipment, ensuring safety and quality.
With its location on Rogoshko shose and customer-oriented approach, Malinov Moto Service is a solid choice for both local riders and moto-tourists.

name: Moto Factor
description: Moto Factor in the city of Pazardzhik is a reliable stop for traveling motorcyclists in need of high-quality and fast maintenance for their bikes. The service's team of young and responsive specialists has excellent knowledge and approaches every job with great care and precision. The owner and head mechanic have earned customers' trust through their competent and correct attitude towards their work. This service is popular among motorcycle enthusiasts who appreciate the high quality of work and the speed of repairs. The workshop is open from Monday to Saturday, which is very convenient for those on the road. Its location at 5 "Akad. Stoyan Argirov" Street makes it easily accessible.

name: RBT Custom motors
description: RBT Custom motors is a true gem for motorcyclists, especially for those who appreciate the BMW brand. Here, your motorcycle is handled by true enthusiasts for whom repair is not just a job, but a passion. The service specializes not only in maintenance and repair but also in deep work with electronics, including motorcycle software, which is a rare expertise. Customers particularly appreciate that the mechanics thoroughly explain all the work done and provide useful tips for operation. Thanks to the use of original parts and consumables, you can be confident in the quality and longevity of the services performed. This workshop has earned the trust of bikers from all over Bulgaria due to its professionalism, correctness, and genuine love for motorcycles.

name: A & V Moto
description: A & V Moto offers a full range of services for motorcycles. Experienced mechanics handle diagnostics, engine and chassis repair. They use quality parts and modern equipment. The service is focused on the reliability and safety of your bike. It's a trusted spot for maintenance while on the road.

name: Remap Power Service and roadside assistance
description: Remap Power Service is a comprehensive solution for motorcyclists, combining a stationary workshop with roadside assistance. For travelers, it's an ideal partner that can help with both scheduled maintenance and unexpected breakdowns on the road. The mobile assistance service means you won't have to wait long for a tow truck if your bike breaks down on the highway—a specialist will come to your location for diagnosis and minor repairs. The workshop itself offers chip-tuning to improve your motorcycle's performance, which is especially valuable for those who frequently ride in mountainous areas. Its reliability and quick response make this service a dependable pillar of support on any motorcycle journey.

name: Motomafia Service Vratsa
description: Motomafia Service is a modern motorcycle workshop located in the industrial zone of Vratsa, Bulgaria. The team specializes in maintenance and repair of all motorcycle brands, offering fast and professional service for travelers on the road. It’s an ideal stop for riders needing diagnostics, oil change, or tour preparation. The staff are skilled and attentive, ensuring your bike is ready for any journey. A trusted choice for motorcyclists exploring Northwestern Bulgaria.

name: G Moto
description: G Moto is a professional workshop specializing in the repair of motorcycles and scooters. They offer a full range of services, from diagnostics and regular maintenance to engine and chassis repair. For travelers, it's important that the service uses quality parts and modern equipment, ensuring your motorcycle's reliability after repair. Its convenient location in the Northern Industrial Zone of Pleven makes it easily accessible. It is a reliable partner for keeping your bike in excellent condition while traveling through Bulgaria.

name: Danailov Auto Service
description: Danailov Auto Service is a mobile tire service in Stara Zagora, operating 24/7. They offer quick on-site tire changes in 20 minutes, balancing, seasonal swaps, and rim repairs. Serving the Stara Zagora region and Trakia motorway, it's a reliable choice for motorcycle travelers needing roadside assistance.

name: Auto Moto Center
description: Auto Moto Center is a motorcycle service in Burgas offering a full range of services for both motorcyclists and car owners. Their offerings include repairs, diagnostics, seasonal maintenance, and even a motorcycle hotel. The service operates daily, including Sundays, and provides the option to book an appointment in advance. It's perfect for motorcycle travelers in need of quality roadside assistance.

name: Trafficker Group
description:
Trafficker Group is a motorcycle service in Burgas specializing in repairs and maintenance.
They offer services for suspension, engine repairs, welding, bodywork, and diagnostics.
The service operates daily except Sundays and provides the option to book an appointment in advance.
It's perfect for motorcycle travelers in need of reliable roadside assistance.

name: В-МОТО
description: V-MOTO in Varna is a professional motorcycle service designed for two-wheeled travelers. They handle repairs and maintenance of motorcycles of all types, including diagnostics, suspension tuning, and adjustments. Equipped with modern tools and staffed by skilled mechanics, the workshop can assist even in urgent roadside situations. Its convenient location and customer-focused approach make V-MOTO a great choice for motorcycle travelers exploring Bulgaria.

name: Fährhaus am Diemelsee
description:
Our biker café is located directly on the shores of Lake Diemelsee, amidst the beautiful forest landscape of the nature park, and offers all motorcyclists the opportunity to meet, chat, and have fun.

Lake Diemelsee is centrally located between Hesse and North Rhine-Westphalia, and with its winding mountain roads, it offers a wide variety of route options for extended tours.

Our biker café is open year-round, whatever the weather, and is therefore ideal for hardcore bikers even during the colder months.

- Generous breakfast
- Homemade cakes
- Beer garden
- Sun terrace
- Restaurant with hot meals served all day
- Large parking lot

name: Bikerscheune Kremmen "UMS LUCH"
description: The restaurant 'UMS LUCH' looks forward to welcoming you. The Ums Luch restaurant is located in Kremmen's historic Scheunenviertel (barn district). With its rustic decor, it offers a very special ambiance that can be both cozy and festive, depending on the occasion. We serve hearty, home-style cuisine with a weekly changing menu based on the season and the region. Our premises accommodate approximately 80 guests, and in addition to our own events (e.g., live music and theme nights), we are also happy to host your celebrations. Or simply drop by after a day trip in the surrounding area—the Luch offers a unique landscape that is well worth exploring. We look forward to welcoming you as our guest soon.

name: Biker's Lodge (BMW World)
description: In-city meetup is easiest at the Biker’s Lodge inside BMW Welt—espresso breaks with bikes in view. Locals use it as a “meet-and-roll” point for city rides. In season, MOTORWORLD München hosts open biker meets and community nights. From here, it’s a short hop to Isar loops and southbound routes to the Alps. The vibe is welcoming and there’s ample moto parking.

name: Road Stop Mettmann
description: An American-style roadhouse bar: burgers, deck seating, and plenty of space for bike groups. Convenient between Cologne and Düsseldorf, it’s a popular staging point for Bergisches Land loops. The themed interiors (and rooms) add that road-trip mood even if you’re not staying overnight. Parking is vast; there’s even e-bike charging and breakfast service. Local rider groups frequently recommend Road Stop as a neutral meetup hub.

name: Harley garage73
description: A live-music “garage” bar in the Rhein-Main area - beloved by H-D riders and classic-bike fans. Regular gigs and DJ nights keep the scene buzzing, and rolling in as a group is easy. Big interior, proper stage, and on-site parking; tickets are usually online. It’s a great springboard for Taunus loops. Social feeds highlight frequent biker nights and club meetups.

name: Glemseck
description:
Historic building located on the old Solitude racecourse route in Leonberg, Baden-Württemberg.
During the heyday of the track, Glemseck served as a staging base: garages and outbuildings were used as workshops, while the hotel hosted racers and spectators alike.
Built in 1906, it has long been associated with motorcycle culture - today it's being reborn as Motorsporthotel Glemseck with a preserved façade and renewed purpose.
Currently the hotel and main restaurant are under renovation; however, the biergarten (beer garden) remains open, serving as a relaxed gathering spot for bikers and guests.
For motorcycle enthusiasts, Glemseck is more than a place to stay - it’s a piece of racing heritage where the spirit of Solitude’s past lingers along the stretch now used for Glemseck 101 events.

name: Bikers Bar Hannover
description: A classic weekend rock bar in the Steintor quarter - open late Friday and Saturday. Inside you’ll get old-school rock and a proper biker bar feel. Many use it after the Friday “Georgsplatz” in-city biker meet. Street parking for bikes works fine if you arrive early evening. Local Ducati/Hannover groups list “Georg” as a key meetup.

name: MOTORWORLD Inn München
description: A themed restaurant inside MOTORWORLD Munich - full of memorabilia and displays, delivering peak petrol-head vibes. The menu blends Italian, US, and German comfort staples; good for lunch or a post-ride dinner. Car and bike enthusiasts regularly meet here - rolling in on two wheels feels natural. City location with quick access to northern Bavarian routes. Staff are used to groups, with flexible seating options. Parking is available on the MOTORWORLD grounds, per venue listings.

name: XXL Restaurant Waldgeist Hofheim
description: This suburban Frankfurt icon is famed for XXL schnitzels and steaks—a classic end-of-ride stop after Taunus loops. The dining room is large; reservations are smart on weekends. It’s easy to roll in via A66/A671 with minimal city traffic. You’ll often see bike groups and car clubs here, as forum threads and videos attest. The site lists menu and directions in detail. On-site parking is the norm at the venue.

name: Baba Vida Fortress
description: Baba Vida Fortress is the only fully preserved medieval fortress in Bulgaria, located on the bank of the Danube River. Built between the 10th and 14th centuries, it served as a defensive stronghold against invasions. The fortress has two walls and several towers, creating an impressive silhouette. Inside, visitors can explore old prison cells, weapons exhibitions, and historical reconstructions. Today, it is a cultural monument and one of the most visited tourist attractions in northwestern Bulgaria.

name: Chiprovtsi Monastery
description: The Chiprovtsi Monastery was founded in the 10th century and has played a key role in Bulgaria’s religious and revolutionary history. It was destroyed and rebuilt several times, especially after the Chiprovtsi Uprising of 1688. The monastery complex includes a church, residential buildings, and a small museum. It is also famous for its connection with the tradition of Chiprovtsi carpets, included in UNESCO’s cultural heritage. Surrounded by the Balkan Mountains, it is a peaceful place for visitors.

name: Magura Cave
description: Magura Cave is one of the largest caves in Bulgaria, famous for its prehistoric cave paintings. The drawings, dating back 8,000–10,000 years, depict hunting scenes, rituals, and animals. The cave is also known for its natural formations such as stalactites and stalagmites. A section of the cave is used for aging sparkling wine due to its unique microclimate. It is a unique combination of nature, history, and archaeology.

name: Tsarevets Fortress
description: Tsarevets Fortress was the main stronghold of the Second Bulgarian Empire between the 12th and 14th centuries. Located on a hill above the Yantra River, it offers breathtaking views of Veliko Tarnovo. Inside, visitors can see the remains of royal palaces, churches, and defense towers. The Patriarchal Cathedral, rebuilt in the 20th century, stands at the top of the hill. In the evenings, a spectacular “Sound and Light” show illuminates the fortress with music and lights.

name: Museum "Konstantsaliev house" (Arbanasi Village)
description: Arbanasi is a historical village near Veliko Tarnovo, known for its well-preserved Renaissance houses and churches. Wealthy merchants and nobles built richly decorated stone houses here during the 16th–17th centuries. Many of the churches are adorned with remarkable frescoes and icons. The village has been declared an architectural reserve and is a popular stop for cultural tourism. Its quiet streets and old atmosphere make it a favorite spot for bikers and travelers.

name: Motoroads
description: Motorbike rental in Sofia is available 24/7. You can book your BMW, Triumph or Harley Davidson motorbike online instantly. If you would like we will deliver the motorcycle rental to your hotel in Sofia or at the closest airport if you arrive by airplane. Rent a motorbike and explore Sofia. We will provide you with road map and itinerary orientation for Sofia and Bulgaria.

name: Cherven Fortress (Ruse region)
description: Cherven Fortress was one of the most important medieval strongholds of the Second Bulgarian Empire. Built on a rocky plateau, it controlled key trade and military routes along the Rusenski Lom River. Excavations have revealed a citadel, residential buildings, and over 30 churches. The fortress was destroyed by the Ottomans in the 14th century but remains impressive to this day. It is part of the Rusenski Lom Nature Park, combining history with scenic views.

name: Madara Horseman
description: The Madara Rider is a unique rock relief carved in the 8th century during the First Bulgarian Empire. It depicts a horseman spearing a lion, symbolizing power and victory. The carving is 23 meters above ground on a sheer cliff, making it especially impressive. It is the only monument of its kind in Europe and is included in the UNESCO World Heritage list. The site is surrounded by a peaceful natural area, popular among bikers for a short scenic stop.

name: Pliska Museum of National History and Archaeology
description: Pliska was the first capital of the Bulgarian state after its establishment in 681 AD. The city was spread over a vast territory with massive fortress walls, palaces, and administrative buildings. The Great Basilica of Pliska is one of the largest Christian temples of the Middle Ages in Europe. Today, visitors can explore the restored sections and a museum with artifacts. The site reflects the origins of Bulgarian statehood and culture.

name: Aladzha Monastery
description: Aladzha Monastery is a medieval rock-hewn monastery complex near Varna, dating back to the 12th–13th centuries. Monks lived in cells carved into the limestone cliffs, which also contained chapels, a church, and a crypt. The walls were once richly decorated with colorful frescoes, some fragments of which survive today. The monastery is located in a beautiful forest within the Golden Sands Nature Park. It is one of the most visited historical and spiritual sites on the Black Sea coast.

name: Bikers PUB Levice
description: A popular bikers' pub located in Levice, Slovakia, known for its lively atmosphere and rock music. It's a well-known gathering spot for motorcycle enthusiasts and travelers.

name: Black Dog
description: A cozy pub called Black Dog (Čierny Pes) located in a historic vaulted cellar in Bratislava's Old Town, known for its authentic atmosphere and selection of beers, including gluten-free options

name: Rider's Pub
description: The first and unique biker-style bar in Košice since 2011 for bikers and the general public. You can enjoy Italian coffee with us. VERO. At the tap we have prepared for you draft beer Pilsen 12, Radegast 10, Ratar, Birell pomelo grep, Brewers' Choice. We offer the possibility of watching various sports broadcasts and events (football, hockey, auto-moto sports). You can have fun with us as follows: live concerts of rock bands, jukebox, billiards, table football, box machine, darts. Possibility of organizing corporate events and various parties. We have a summer terrace. Live rock music.

name: Biker’s Garage
description: A biker-themed restaurant in Jaklovce known for its stylish decor and a varied menu that includes popular items like burgers, pizza, and coffee

name: FABRIKA the beer pub
description:
Where the magnificent beer FABRIKA is brewed and the excellent beer of the trademark the beer Pilsner Urquell is draught. You can read more about all these beers in the part Our beer and We draw beer. Of course each beer lover knows that it is very important how the beer is draught and this is very important for us, this means that if you get wrongly draught beer you can get it replaced.

Not everyone is a beer lover and if you don´t prefer beer, we have in our offer more than 200 sorts of carefully selected wines from the whole world with a strong presence of the best-known Slovak wine producers.

After opening our web-site, probably we don´t have to specify what our BEST SELL is. There is no doubt; it is our famous FABRIKA burger. Of course in our menu you will find also many other tasty dishes prepared from the finest raw materials from which everyone can choose.

name: Šport Pub U Belasých
description:
We serve Tankový Staropramen 11, Nefilter, Nealko pivo, Stella Artois, Hoegaarden White, Cool grep non-alcoholic, Kofola. The pub is divided into a non-smoking area, a smoking area, a lounge and a summer terrace.

The capacity of the Sport pub is 225 people indoors and 70 people outdoors.

name: Jumbo Pub
description: Jumbo Pub is a bar located in the pedestrian zone of Liptovský Mikuláš's historic center, known for its great atmosphere and a selection of Slovak and Czech beers.

name: Mešuge Craft Beer Pub
description: Mešuge Craft Beer Pub in Bratislava is a popular spot known for its rustic, cozy atmosphere and a wide selection of craft beers, which it sometimes brews itself. The pub combines this great beer with delicious Slovakian cuisine, including both traditional dishes and fusion options

name: 17’s BAR
description: A stylish cocktail bar on Bratislava’s most elegant square, known for creative drinks, a relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere, and prime people-watching from its terrace. Located in the heart of the Slovakia's capital city Bratislava, 17's BAR has a lot to offer. Below are some details of what makes our bar worth visiting.

name: Michalska Cocktail Room
description: Michalska Cocktail Room is a hidden speakeasy-style bar in Bratislava's Old Town, famous for its secret entrance through a wardrobe in Urban Bistro and its expertly crafted cocktails.

name: Veliki Preslav Archaeological Museum
description: Preslav was the second capital of Bulgaria (893–972 AD) and a major cultural and spiritual center. It became famous for its white stone palaces, golden-domed churches, and exquisite ceramic decoration. The Round (Golden) Church of Preslav is one of the masterpieces of medieval Bulgarian architecture. Many archaeological finds, including inscriptions and ceramics, are preserved in the local museum. Preslav played a key role in the development of the Old Bulgarian script and literature.

name: Sozopol Archaeological Museum
description: Sozopol is one of the oldest towns on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast, originally founded as the Greek colony Apollonia in the 7th century BC. It preserves ancient fortifications, traditional wooden houses, and charming narrow streets. The Archaeological Museum displays treasures such as the famous Apollonia anchor and relics. The town combines cultural heritage with a relaxed seaside vibe. Riders often enjoy a stop here for history and sea views together.

name: Cape Kaliakra
description: Cape Kaliakra is a dramatic headland stretching into the Black Sea, with steep 70-meter cliffs. The medieval fortress located here guarded trade and military routes along the coast. Legends tell of maidens who jumped into the sea to escape Ottoman capture. The cape offers panoramic views and is also a nature reserve, home to dolphins and rare birds. For bikers, the road to Kaliakra is one of the most scenic rides on the Bulgarian coast.

name: Monument of Freedom, Saint Nicholas peak
description: The Shipka Pass is a historic mountain pass in the Balkan Mountains, known for the heroic battles of 1877–1878 during the Russo-Turkish War. The Monument of Liberty at the top commemorates Bulgarian and Russian soldiers who defended the pass. The panoramic views of the surrounding peaks make it a favorite destination for travelers. The winding mountain road to Shipka is a legendary ride for motorcyclists. It combines history, nature, and adrenaline.

name: Buzludzha Monument
description: The Buzludzha Monument is one of Bulgaria’s most iconic and unusual sites, built in 1981 as a Communist Party house. Its futuristic UFO-like shape stands abandoned on a peak of the Balkan Mountains. Despite being closed and decaying, it attracts adventurers, photographers, and bikers from all over the world. The site is a powerful reminder of Bulgaria’s recent past. The road to Buzludzha offers breathtaking mountain views and thrilling curves.

name: Ethno village Etar
description: The Etar complex is an open-air ethnographic museum near Gabrovo, recreating the atmosphere of a 19th-century Bulgarian town. It features restored houses, workshops, and water-powered mills. Visitors can watch traditional crafts such as pottery, weaving, and metalwork. The complex shows the Bulgarian National Revival spirit and daily life. It is a peaceful and cultural stop for bikers exploring the Balkan region.

name: Troyan Monastery
description: The Troyan Monastery, founded in the 17th century, is one of Bulgaria’s largest and most important monasteries. It is famous for its richly decorated church frescoes by Zahari Zograf, a master of the Bulgarian National Revival. The monastery is dedicated to the Holy Virgin and houses a miraculous icon of the Virgin Mary. Surrounded by forests and mountains, it is both a spiritual and scenic destination. Many bikers stop here on their way through the Balkan passes.

name: Asen’s Fortress
description: Asen’s Fortress is a medieval stronghold located on a high rocky ridge near Asenovgrad. It dates back to the Thracian period but became especially important during the Second Bulgarian Empire. The preserved Church of the Holy Mother of God is the highlight of the site. From the fortress, there are breathtaking panoramic views of the Rhodope Mountains. The winding road to the fortress makes it a favorite biker route.

name: Bachkovo Monastery “Dormition of the Theotokos”
description: The Bachkovo Monastery, founded in 1083, is the second largest monastery in Bulgaria and one of the oldest in the Orthodox world. It combines Byzantine, Georgian, and Bulgarian traditions. The monastery is famous for its 14th-century frescoes and the miraculous icon of the Virgin Eleusa. It has long been a spiritual and cultural center in the Rhodopes. For bikers, it is a great stop combining history, faith, and mountain landscapes.

name: Ancient sanctuary city Perperikon
description: Perperikon is an ancient Thracian rock city and sanctuary, often called the "Machu Picchu of the Balkans." It was a sacred site where priests worshiped the god Dionysus and later became a fortress. The vast complex includes palaces, temples, and residential quarters carved into rock. Archaeologists believe Perperikon played a major role in Thracian and Balkan history. Its location in the Rhodopes makes it a fascinating destination for adventurous bikers.

name: Thracian Rock-Hewn Sanctuary (Tatul)
description: Tatul is an ancient Thracian sanctuary near Kardzhali, believed to be connected with the legendary musician Orpheus. The site consists of a rock pyramid, tombs, and ritual altars carved into stone. Archaeologists date it back to the 2nd millennium BC. It was a sacred place for sun and hero cults. The mysterious atmosphere and remote location make Tatul a hidden gem for bikers exploring the Rhodopes.

name: Rila Monastery
description: The Rila Monastery, founded in the 10th century, is the largest and most famous monastery in Bulgaria. It is dedicated to St. Ivan of Rila, the country’s patron saint. The monastery is renowned for its colorful frescoes, richly decorated church, and arcaded residential buildings. It is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a symbol of Bulgarian culture and faith. Nestled in the Rila Mountains, it is a must-visit for bikers who enjoy mountain rides.

name: Kordopulov House
description: Melnik is the smallest town in Bulgaria, famous for its unique sandstone pyramids and wine traditions. Its history dates back to antiquity, with ruins of medieval fortresses and churches scattered around. Traditional houses from the Bulgarian Revival period give the town a distinctive charm. Melnik is also known for its strong red wines, especially the local grape variety “Shiroka Melnishka.” Bikers often stop here for both cultural and gastronomic experiences.

name: Ancient town Heraclea Sintica
description: Rupite is a mystical place near Petrich, known both for its ancient ruins and its spiritual energy. The site contains the remains of the ancient city Heraclea Sintica. It is also closely connected with the Bulgarian prophetess Baba Vanga, who lived here. Today, her house and a modern church attract thousands of visitors. The area lies near the extinct Kozhuh volcano, giving the landscape a unique look. Bikers find it a powerful and unusual stop.

name: Samouil's fortress
description: Samuil’s Fortress is a medieval stronghold built by Tsar Samuil in the 10th century to resist Byzantine attacks. It was the site of important battles, including the defeat that led to the tragic “Battle of Kleidion.” Today, visitors can see reconstructed fortress walls, towers, and a museum. A large monument of Tsar Samuil overlooks the site. The fortress is located in the scenic Struma Valley, making it a beautiful biker destination.

name: Koliba Kamzík Zelená
description: Slovakia. A country with rich tradition, customs and history. A country full of warm and hospitable people. We have combined all these elements and created a unique place for you in the middle of Bratislava - Koliba Kamzík. A place specific for its unmistakable atmosphere of the Slovak countryside, enhanced by the aromas and tastes of traditional dishes and specialties of our home cuisine. This atmosphere is complemented by a warm and professional service, which will welcome you with its warmth and hospitality right at the entrance and will take care of you.

name: Bistro Zepen House
description: A charming bistro in Bratislava's Old Town offering modern Slovak cuisine with seasonal ingredients, known for its bryndza dumplings and craft lemonades in a minimalist, plant-filled space.

name: Road Stop Wuppertal
description: An American-style roadhouse on Wuppertal’s northern heights with a big lot and full “Easy Rider” vibe - think burgers, ribs, and a long bar counter. In season it’s a reliable magnet for rider groups and a handy start/finish hub for loops across the Bergisches Land and toward Hohensyburg. The calendar fills with specials - grill nights, tastings, live events—and there’s in-house SIM racing plus recent summer extras like axe throwing. The menu sticks to US comfort (burgers, steaks, smash options) and comes out fast, which helps when feeding a pack.

name: Le Papillon Slovak Fusion Restaurant
description: Le Papillon Slovak Fusion Restaurant is charmingly located in Bratislava’s historic center and offers guests an original blend of Slovak and modern cuisine. The menu is rich and varied — from traditional soups and local specialties to steaks, burgers, and fusion dishes. The interior is stylish yet understated, creating a light and welcoming ambiance. The service is often praised as friendly and attentive, while prices are moderate for a downtown location. It is especially popular with both tourists and locals thanks to its balance of quality, flavor, and local character.

name: Slovak Pub
description:
It's not just a pub, it's an institution
Slovak Pub is not only one of the oldest and largest pubs
in Bratislava, but also one of the most popular.

name: Gatto Matto Ventúrska
description: A unique space just off St. Michael's Gate, perfect for a dynamic lunch or a true Italian evening with friends. The signature product is original pizza with fluffy edges and quality ingredients, as well as other oven-baked dishes.

name: Modrá Hviezda / Blue Star
description:
Traditional Slovak restaurant with honest Slovak cuisine
Cozy atmosphere, traditional dishes, friendly service

name: Liptovská izba
description: Down-home eatery with a seasonal terrace preparing meat dishes, fish, dumplings & pizza, plus beer.

name: Houdini Restaurant
description: Present your company, train your employees, close a successful deal. Celebrate graduations and anniversaries, say your I Do, or just meet up with friends in the unforgettable atmosphere of our Library Saloon and Green Saloon.

name: BERG restaurant
description:
The BERG guesthouse has its own restaurant with a capacity of 95 seats, a bar and during the summer season a terrace for 40 guests. An ideal place for company lunches, family celebrations and other meetings. The corners of the restaurant offer enough space for an intimate conversation. However, BERG has a special, romantic charm in the evening. The atmosphere together with the dimmed lights gently gets under the skin of the visitor.

It is already a familiar concept for experienced Bratislava connoisseurs. Hidden from prying eyes, amidst greenery with its own parking lot, it has become a haven for many hedonists and hurried businessmen.

name: MOTOSHOP ŽUBOR, Ltd.
description: Motoshop Žubor is a guarantee of comprehensive services and maximum care. We have been engaged in the sale and service of motorcycles since 1995. We live by our work and we believe that it is felt in the approach of our employees to customers. In sales and service, we try to provide qualified advice, to come up with the best solution and the most appropriate procedure. That is why our customers return to us and rely on our services. We have a wide range of motorcycles, accessories and additional products.

name: Moped - Slovakia, S.r.o.
description: Our biggest priority is to continue strengthening our position on the Slovak market through wholesale and retail sales of motorcycle accessories, spare and tuning parts for scooters, spare parts for Babetta and Pionier

name: Louis Hamburg-Hammerbrook
description: This is Louis’ flagship-scale store in Hammerbrook, right off the A1/A255. Expect a massive selection of gear, helmets and hard parts, plus a wind-tunnel style display. There’s customer parking, free coffee and waiting areas. Staff are used to long-distance riders and ADV sizing questions. The outlet/warehouse sale is nearby for bargains. Weekday mornings are the quietest time.

name: Louis Bremen
description: A large Louis branch with long opening hours and easy parking. Stock covers commuters through tourers. Dedicated helmet, glove and tuning sections help you compare. Friendly vibe encourages slow, proper fitting. Great staging point before riding to the North Sea. Quick food options are nearby.

name: Börjes Bikers Outfit Oldenburg GmbH & Co. KG
description: Börjes Bikers Outfit Oldenburg is a must-stop for any motorcyclist seeking top-quality gear and accessories. The shop offers an extensive selection of jackets, helmets, protective gear and textile from leading brands. You’ll find both practical touring equipment and stylish pieces for city cruising. With over 40 years of experience, they deliver reliable products and expert service. Its convenient location in Oldenburg and welcoming atmosphere make a visit easy and inspiring. If you're on a ride, don’t miss the opportunity to stock up on essentials for your bike.

name: Börje Bikers outfit Augustfehn GmbH & Co KG
description:
Börjes Bikers Outfit Augustfehn is a major motorcycle gear shop with over 40 years of experience, located at Stahlwerkstraße 17a, 26689 Augustfehn, Germany.
You can find helmets, jackets, pants, protective gear, and a wide array of accessories from top brands. Alongside the brick-and-mortar store, they operate an online shop offering the full range of motorcycle apparel and equipment. The staff are knowledgeable and ready to assist you in choosing gear suited to your riding style and local weather.

name: POLO Motorrad Store
description: POLO Motorrad Store Jüchen is a well-known destination for bikers traveling through North Rhine-Westphalia. The store offers a wide selection of motorcycle gear, parts, and accessories from leading brands like POLO, Dainese, and Alpinestars. You can find everything here - from helmets and gloves to touring suits and custom parts for your bike. The spacious showroom and friendly staff make it a welcoming place to explore and gear up.

name: Modeka International GmbH
description:
The Modeka Flagshipstore in Beckum is the beating heart of motorcycle fashion in North Rhine-Westphalia and a must-visit spot for bikers in central-western Germany. It offers the full range of Modeka gear - from durable jackets and pants to gloves, boots, and touring suits.
The store features a spacious showroom where riders can try on gear and get expert advice from fellow motorcyclists.
Special focus is placed on safety and comfort - every Modeka product is designed for long rides and Europe’s unpredictable weather.

name: TOURATECH GmbH
description: TOURATECH GmbH in Niedereschach is a legendary destination for everyone who lives and breathes two-wheeled adventure. The company is world-renowned for its premium accessories for touring and expedition motorcycles. In the spacious store and showroom, you’ll find everything from panniers, bags, and crash bars to navigation systems, apparel, and camping gear. TOURATECH is more than a brand - it’s a philosophy of boundless travel, tested on the toughest routes across the globe. The site also features a cozy café where riders can share stories and plan their next journey. If you love long rides and true adventure, a visit to TOURATECH GmbH is a must-stop on your biker route through Germany.

name: Held Flagship-Store
description: Here you’ll find the complete Held range - from leather jackets and pants to touring suits, gloves, and accessories. The showroom offers a modern design and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for choosing your ideal gear at ease. Every item is crafted with German precision and attention to detail - something long-distance riders and mountain travelers truly appreciate. Located near scenic routes through the Allgäu Alps, it’s a perfect stop for touring motorcyclists. The Held Flagship-Store isn’t just a shop - it’s a source of inspiration for those who live for the road.

name: Dainese Berlin
description: Dainese Berlin is a specialized boutique in Germany’s capital, hosting the finest collection of gear from the iconic Italian brand. Here you’ll find jackets, pants, armor, gloves and boots from Dainese, including exclusive editions not found in regular shops. The staff are passionate riders themselves and offer tailored advice on fit and protection. The boutique hosts product launches, rider visits and workshops, making it a hub of Berlin’s moto culture. Located in Charlottenburg, the store is easily reachable from any area of the city.

name: Motorrad-Ecke Heilbronn
description: Motorrad-Ecke Heilbronn is one of the best gear stores in Baden-Württemberg, known for its focus on comfort, quality, and safety. The shop offers a wide selection of jackets, pants, helmets, and gloves, including special sizes and premium Stadler touring gear. It’s especially popular with long-distance riders and tourers looking for reliable apparel for all weather conditions. Experienced staff are always ready to help you find the perfect setup for your bike and riding style. Located conveniently on popular routes between Stuttgart and Nuremberg, it’s an ideal stop to rest and refresh your gear.

name: MON Accommodation free parking
description:
Nestled just a few blocks from the heart of Niš, MON Accommodation Free Parking offers the perfect pit stop for road-weary riders - complete with free private parking for your machine. The guest house is quiet but centrally located, putting you within walking distance of the Niš Fortress, King Milan Square, and local cafés.
Rooms are clean and comfortable, with air conditioning, free WiFi, and tea/coffee facilities - perfect for winding down after a long ride. Friendly staff often help with local tips for dining and exploring, making this a favored stop among travelers.

name: Louis Kiel - Motorradbekleidung und Motorradzubehör
description: Louis Kiel is one of the largest motorcycle gear and accessory stores in northern Germany, located at Schwedendamm 22, 24143 Kiel. The shop offers a vast selection of jackets, pants, helmets, gloves, touring bags, and parts for all types of bikes. Its range includes top international brands like Dainese and Shoei, as well as Louis’s own trusted product lines. A spacious showroom, easy parking, and helpful staff make it a comfortable stop even on long journeys. Close to both major highways and the port, it’s the perfect place to visit for riders touring northern Germany or catching a ferry. Louis Kiel isn’t just a store - it’s a true hub of biker culture where the spirit of the open road comes alive.

name: Börjes American Bikes GmbH
description: Börjes American Bikes GmbH is an iconic destination for fans of American motorcycles, located at Hauptstraße 55, 28816 Stuhr, Germany. Here you can see and test-ride legendary bikes like Harley-Davidson, Indian, and more in an authentic American biker atmosphere. The store offers motorcycles, spare parts, tuning components, branded clothing, and accessories inspired by Route 66. An in-house workshop provides professional service, customization, and setup tailored to each rider’s style. The team consists of true enthusiasts eager to offer advice, find the right parts, and share their riding stories. Börjes American Bikes in Stuhr isn’t just a dealership - it’s a place where the spirit of freedom and the roar of engines come alive.

name: Köterberg
description: Köterberg is a cult hilltop with a full 360° panorama and a summit café. The approach roads are rolling and twisty, perfect for bikes. There’s ample parking and it’s a popular meet-up spot. It can be windy and cool at the top—pack an extra layer. Sunsets here are especially striking.

name: Restaurant & Café Köterberg Inh. Fam. Brand
description: The Restaurant & Café Köterberg (Inh. Fam. Brand) sits atop the Köterberg hill, offering one of the region’s most spectacular panoramic views. It’s a favorite stop for bikers who conquer the winding roads just to reach this elevated spot. The menu features hearty, down-to-earth fare like currywurst, bratwurst, and regional German classics. The ambiance is warm and familial, with friendly service delivered by the Brand family and their team. On weekends, up to 1,500 motorcyclists flock here, creating a true biker’s gathering with conversations about the road and machines. However, it’s wise to check opening hours in advance — some visitors report that the restaurant is sometimes unexpectedly closed in the morning.

name: Harzturm Torfhaus
description: The Harzturm at Torfhaus rises 65 metres and offers breathtaking panoramic views over the Harz Mountains and the Brocken peak. For bikers, it’s a perfect stop to rest, catch the breeze, and enjoy the altitude after a challenging climb. The admission for the climb to the viewing platforms (including the Skywalk) is €12 for adults and €7 for children aged 6 to 15. The ambiance combines modern architectural elements with natural materials - wood, glass, and steel - blending the tower into its forest surroundings.The best time to visit is on a clear day when the views open fully; in the morning or bad weather, the tower may be partly closed.

name: Kyffhäuser Mittelburg
description:
The massive castle, once 600 meters long, was completed during the reign of Frederick I Barbarossa (1152-1190). His stay in the castle is not documented, but likely. Partially built over and pushed into the background by the monumental size of the Kyffhäuser Monument, impressive medieval architecture can still be admired today.

The Barbarossa Tower of the Upper Castle, a square keep ruin now 17 meters high with 3 meters thick walls, allows every visitor to sense the defensive strength of this castle. A glimpse into the 176-meter-deep castle well, the deepest in the world, is also unforgettable. After decades of work, it secured the water supply for the castle's residents. The Lower Castle, the best-preserved part of the once tripartite castle, boasts an impressive, life-size circular wall. The Middle Castle was destroyed by a millstone quarry. A romantic rocky gorge was created, which connects the lower castle with the memorial grounds.

name: BiggeBlick Skywalk
