description: The BiggeBlick glass skywalk juts over Lake Bigge. Approaches weave through Sauerland’s rolling hills. A nearby car park and a short trail lead to the platform. Expect strong winds on the deck. Clear mornings or golden hour work best.

name: Motor City Sofia
description:
Motor City Sofia is located in Sofia’s city centre, offering a rock music & biker friendly vibe. It is explicitly advertised as a Rock’n’Roll & Biker Friendly bar.
It has a large selection of beers and spirits, and often hosts live shows.
The bar is just ~50 meters from Vitosha Boulevard, very accessible from main city routes.

name: Bar Point
description: Bar Point in Sofia is mentioned in connection with biker gatherings (e.g., Moto Balkans events). It is a small dive bar with a relaxed atmosphere, moderate prices, often evening-events. There is “ample parking” according to the listing.

name: Rock Bar "SPIRIT OF ROCK"
description: “Spirit of Rock” is a rock music bar in Varna known for live performances and a musical atmosphere. The interior feels intimate yet energetic — favored by those who enjoy guitars, rock bands, jam nights. The crowd seems to be people who appreciate good sound and genuine music over glitzy clubbing.

name: Amsterdam Rock
description: Amsterdam Rock is a café-bar / rock bar in central Varna (Bratya Bakston St. 30). Frequently praised for its pleasant atmosphere and good rock music, it's more chill than a full nightclub. Visitors say the service is friendly, drinks reasonably priced, and it's good for a relaxed evening. Likely not ultra late-night hotspot, but very usable for a biker stop.

name: Kafe Bezisten
description: Bizisten / Rock Bar “Bezisten” in Plovdiv (Nayden Gerov St. 5) is described in reviews as a pleasant place to have drinks, listen to rock music, socialize. Not a high-energy club, more “bar style”, good for winding down. Open into evening hours. Feels authentic, friendly crowd.

name: Bikers lounge 2020
description: Bikers Lounge 2020 in Plovdiv is a true biker hub. Decorated with motorcycle memorabilia, it plays classic rock and welcomes travelers. They often host charity and moto events, with easy access and parking for bikes. A friendly stop for riders crossing southern Bulgaria.

name: Kaiser Willhelm Turm
description: Hohe Acht is the Eifel’s high point with a tower and Nürburg in view. Approach roads are scenic and undulating. Park near the trailhead and walk a few minutes to the tower. Fog can limit visibility. After rain, roots on the path get slick—wear suitable shoes.

name: Gipfelkreuz
description: The Gipfelkreuz viewpoint is an impressive spot standing above the surroundings, reached via winding roads through forests and passes. For bikers, it’s a perfect stop - stretch your legs and enjoy the high-altitude views. From the top you get panoramic views of valleys, forests, and neighboring peaks. The route up is often full of curves and hairpin turns - a delight for motorcycle riders. The best time to come is in clear weather, when visibility is excellent, as fog or haze can obscure the views.

name: Geierlay Hängebrücke
description: Geierlay – Germany's most beautiful suspension bridge. 360 meters long, 100 meters high, in the heart of the Hunsrück. Between Mörsdorf and Sosberg, you'll experience nature, panoramic views, and true adventure. Perfect for hikes, family outings, and stunning photos.

name: Bastei Bridge
description: The Bastei Bridge is one of the most dramatic viewpoints in Saxon Switzerland, linking sandstone formations over the Elbe valley. It’s a perfect waypoint on a biker’s itinerary - challenging ascents, forest switchbacks, and then the reward of views hovering above the cliffs. Visiting the bridge is free of charge, as it is part of the natural landscape and accessible without an entrance fee. Parking is available nearby on official lots: motorcycles cost about €2 per day, cars around €7 for 4 hours or €12 for a full day. From the parking area you’ll walk 5 to 15 minutes along trails to reach the bridge - the path is scenic and shaded. The best timing is early morning or late evening, so you can enjoy the panorama undisturbed and with fewer crowds.

name: Aussicht Faller-Klamm-Brücke
description: The Faller-Klamm Bridge viewpoint overlooks Lake Sylvenstein, offering one of the most stunning panoramas in the Bavarian Alps. The road leading there winds through mountain curves a perfect ride for bikers who enjoy twists, turns, and breathtaking scenery. Visiting the viewpoint is free of charge, and there’s a small parking area nearby suitable for motorcycles. The best time to visit is early morning or sunset, when the lake and cliffs glow in warm golden light.

name: Ludwigsturm auf dem Donnersberg
description: Ludwigsturm atop the Donnersberg is a historic observation tower, standing 27 metres tall with sweeping views over the Palatinate and surrounding landscapes. Visitors and bikers can park at a large lot located close by and then walk a short distance to the tower. The tower is generally open on weekends and holidays, and on weekdays the key can be obtained from the tourist office in Dannenfels. Climbing 142 steps brings you to the lookout platform, with panoramic views of the Palatinate Forest, Hunsrück, and distant ranges. For motorcyclists, the ride to the parking lot offers engaging terrain and vistas, and from the tower the final ascent is a pleasant walk.

name: Karlsplatz
description: Karlsplatz is one of Munich’s most famous squares, where history, city life, and the rhythm of bikers all intersect. For motorcyclists, it’s a convenient rest and meeting point, surrounded by cafés, shops, and outdoor terraces. Parking is available nearby - the Stachus underground garage and several open lots that allow motorcycle parking. The best time to visit is in the evening, when the square lights up and the city buzzes with energy and motion.

name: Handwerkerhof Nürnberg
description: Handwerkerhof Nürnberg is a charming medieval-style artisan courtyard right in the heart of Nuremberg. Visitors can watch craftsmen at work - blacksmiths, potters, glassblowers - and purchase handmade goods and local specialties. There is no dedicated parking at the Handwerkerhof itself; the nearest parking garages are near the main train station and in the city center, a short walk away. For biker tours it’s a convenient stop between historic districts, especially in the evening when the crowds thin out.

name: Potsdamer Platz
description: Potsdamer Platz is one of Berlin’s most vibrant spots, blending modern skyscrapers, history, and the pulse of urban life. Once divided by the Berlin Wall, this square now stands as a symbol of unity and the city’s rebirth. For bikers, it’s a perfect stop in the city center - surrounded by cafés, museums, and plenty of places to relax. Parking is available at the Potsdamer Platz Arkaden underground garage, which includes motorcycle spaces. The best time to visit is in the evening, when the square glows with neon lights and glass reflections - a perfect photo stop in the heart of Berlin.

name: Domplatz
description: Domplatz in Erfurt is the historic heart of the city, dominated by the majestic St. Mary’s Cathedral and charming medieval façades. For bikers, it’s a must-visit spot - you can feel the city’s history and relax in cozy cafés after a long ride. Parking is available nearby at the Domplatzgarage Erfurt, where motorcycles can be left just a short walk from the square. The best time to visit is early morning or sunset, when the soft light enhances the cathedral and gives the square a magical glow.

name: Burschenschaftsdenkmal
description: The Burschenschaftsdenkmal is an impressive monument overlooking Eisenach, dedicated to 19th-century student fraternities and their fight for German unity. For bikers, it’s a great stop filled with history and offering stunning views over the town and rolling hills. There’s a parking area at the base of the monument - spacious enough to leave your motorcycle before a short walk uphill. Admission is free, and the best time to visit is at sunset, when the monument glows in warm light and the valley spreads out below.

name: Schwabentor
description: Schwabentor is one of Freiburg’s two remaining medieval city gates, decorated with murals and a tower that recalls the city’s old trading past. For bikers, it’s a perfect stop in the heart of the old town, surrounded by cozy cafés and narrow cobblestone streets full of southern German charm. Motorcycle parking is available nearby at the Schwabentor Parkplatz, located at the base of Schlossberg hill, just a few minutes’ walk away. The best time to visit is early morning or late afternoon, when the old gate glows in the sunlight and the streets are calmer.

name: Reeperbahn  Street
description: Reeperbahn is Hamburg’s legendary street - the heart of St. Pauli and one of Europe’s most famous entertainment districts. For bikers, it’s where nightlife, rock ’n’ roll, and the city’s port heritage merge into a vivid mix of sound and lights. The street is packed with bars, clubs, live music venues, and cafés - a perfect stop after a long ride through northern Germany. Motorcycle parking is available on nearby streets and in underground garages such as Parkhaus Millerntorplatz and Reeperbahn Garage. The best time to visit is after dark, when the street glows with neon lights and captures the true spirit of freedom and biker culture.

name: Externsteine
description: Externsteine is an ancient rock formation with pagan and medieval traces. Approaches run along fun, curvy roads through the Teutoburg Forest. Pavement is mostly good, with shaded damp patches. It gets busy in season—arrive early. Short walking paths lead to the viewpoints. Parking nearby: yes, several paid lots at the entrance.

name: Kaiser-Wilhelm-Denkmal
description: The Kaiser Wilhelm Monument overlooks the “Gate of Westphalia.” Access comes via scenic switchbacks with Weser views. It’s windy on the terrace, so bring an extra layer. A small museum and café make for a good stop. The final walk to the viewpoint is short. Parking nearby: yes, main terrace parking plus overflow below.

name: Wartburg
description: Wartburg Castle was built around 1067 and first mentioned in records around 1080. This legendary fortress is where Martin Luther translated the New Testament while in hiding, and it preserves centuries of architectural history. Parking is available at the base of the castle - a paid lot costing about €5, from which visitors walk up or take a shuttle. The path from the parking area to the gate is about 500 metres long, and a shuttle is available for visitors with limited mobility. For bikers, the ride up to the parking area offers scenic forest roads and curving mountain routes leading to the historic site.

name: World Heritage Rammelsberg ore mines
description: The Rammelsberg ore mines near Goslar are one of Europe’s oldest industrial heritage sites, where mining continued for over a thousand years. The first shafts were opened around AD 968, making it a rare example of early engineering and mining craftsmanship. Today, Rammelsberg is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and operates as a mining museum offering underground tours. For bikers, it’s a rewarding stop - the route through the Harz hills is scenic, and there’s convenient parking near the entrance. The cool air, echoing tunnels, and smell of stone create a thrilling contrast to the open road outside.

name: Marksburg
description: Marksburg Castle stands above the town of Braubach and is one of the best-preserved medieval fortresses on the Rhine. Historical records indicate that the first stone keep was built around 1100, and the castle was expanded around 1117. A spacious parking lot sits below the castle. From the parking area, visitors walk uphill for about five minutes via a winding path or stairs to reach the castle gate. The castle is part of a UNESCO World Heritage site and offers guided tours through its halls, kitchen, and armory museum. The ride along the Rhine leading to Marksburg is a biker’s pleasure - full of curves, scenic views, and a medieval atmosphere.

name: Reichsburg Cochem
description: Reichsburg Cochem Castle rises above the Moselle Valley and stands as a symbol of the town, blending medieval romance with views of surrounding vineyards. The first mention of the castle dates back to 1130, when it served as a fortress protecting trade routes along the Moselle River. After being destroyed by the French in the 17th century, it was rebuilt in 1868 in a neo-Gothic style by Berlin merchant Louis Ravené. For bikers, it’s a perfect stop - the winding road up to the castle offers curves, climbs, and breathtaking views over the river and town. A paid parking area is located at the base of the hill, costing about €3–4, with a footpath or shuttle leading up to the castle.

name: UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe Völklinger Hütte
description: The Völklingen Ironworks is the world's only completely preserved ironworks from the heyday of industrialisation and at the same time the first industrial monument of this era to be included in the UNESCO World Heritage List. It presents itself to your visitors as a highly exciting and fascinating place where past, present and future meet in a variety of ways.

name: Kaiserburg Nürnberg
description: The Imperial Castle (Kaiserburg Nürnberg) rises above Nuremberg’s old town and once served as the residence of the emperors of the Holy Roman Empire. Archaeological evidence indicates that the first fortifications were built around 1000 AD, with major expansions in the 12th century. There is no dedicated visitor parking at the castle itself - riders can use public garages in the city center and walk to the site. Inside, visitors can climb the Sinwell Tower, explore the Deep Well, and wander through halls filled with imperial history. The winding approach roads and scenic views make this stop especially memorable and rewarding for motorcyclists.

name: Heidelberg Castle
description: Heidelberg Castle (Schloss Heidelberg) was first mentioned in the early 13th century, with its main structures evolving over the following centuries. During the Renaissance, the castle was rebuilt and expanded into a splendid residence of the Electors of the Palatinate. Parking is available nearby - about 0.5 km from the castle, with more than a hundred paid spaces and several garages in the old town. Direct access to the castle hill is limited, so most visitors park below and either walk up or take the funicular. For bikers, the winding road leading from the old town to the castle adds to the thrill of the journey.

name: Kloster Maulbronn
description: Maulbronn Monastery (Kloster Maulbronn) is a former Cistercian abbey founded in 1147, and has been a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1993. It is regarded as one of the best-preserved medieval monastic complexes north of the Alps. There is parking nearby - about 230 free spaces for cars, as well as designated areas for buses and motorhomes. On weekends, vehicle access to the inner courtyard is often restricted, so visitors usually park outside and walk in. For bikers, the ride through the Stromberg hills to Maulbronn offers scenic views and a sense of traveling back in time. Inside, visitors can explore the church, cloisters, monks’ quarters, and the original water systems once used by the monastery’s residents.

name: Sanssouci & Parks of Potsdam
description: The Sanssouci Palace and Parks of Potsdam were created in the mid-18th century, when Frederick the Great began planting vineyards and designing terraces - the palace itself was built between 1745 and 1747. The ensemble is part of the Palaces and Parks of Potsdam and Berlin, recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1990. For motorcyclists, the ride to the palace along leafy avenues and park roads is a perfect blend of architecture, landscape, and serenity. Parking is available near the palace - P1 by the historic mill and P3 near the New Palace, plus several smaller lots around the park. Entry to the park itself is free, and strolling through its gardens, fountains, and terraces is a perfect way to unwind after the ride.

name: Frauenkirche Dresden
description: The Frauenkirche Dresden is a magnificent Baroque church built between 1726 and 1743, designed by architect Georg Bähr. Destroyed during World War II and rebuilt in its original form by 2005, it now stands as a powerful symbol of reconciliation and Dresden’s rebirth. Parking is available in the underground garages An der Frauenkirche and Q-Park Frauenkirche / Neumarkt, located just below the Neumarkt square. The church lies within a pedestrian zone, so vehicles must be left nearby and visitors walk a few minutes to reach it. Opening hours: Monday to Friday from 10:00 to 11:30 and 13:00 to 17:30, weekends vary depending on services - advance registration for visits or tours is recommended. Riding through Dresden’s historic streets to the sight of the dome rising above the old town makes this a must-see stop for every biker exploring Saxony.

name: Schloss Neuschwanstein
description: Neuschwanstein Castle (Schloss Neuschwanstein) is one of Germany’s most iconic landmarks, built by King Ludwig II between 1869 and 1886. Inspired by Wagner’s operas and medieval legends, Ludwig envisioned it as his “fairy-tale kingdom,” blending Neo-Gothic, Romantic, and theatrical styles. For bikers, the ride to the castle is pure pleasure - winding Bavarian Alpine roads, views of Lake Alpsee, and charming villages make it a dream route. Parking is available in the village of Hohenschwangau below the castle; from there, visitors can walk, take a shuttle bus, or ride a horse-drawn carriage - motorcycles are allowed in the main lot. Tickets should be booked in advance online, as visitor numbers are very high, especially during the summer months. Neuschwanstein is more than just a castle - it’s a monument to imagination and a must-see destination for every motorcyclist exploring southern Germany.

name: Burg Hohenzollern
description: Hohenzollern Castle (Burg Hohenzollern) is the ancestral seat of the Hohenzollern dynasty, built in its current form between 1846 and 1867 by order of King Frederick William IV of Prussia. The original fortress on this site dates back to the 11th century, but the present castle showcases Neo-Gothic architecture with romantic touches. For motorcyclists, the road leading to the castle is one of the most scenic in Baden-Württemberg - full of curves, forests, and breathtaking mountain views. Parking is available at the base of the hill on a designated lot; from there, visitors can either walk up (about 20 minutes) or take the shuttle bus to the gate. The castle’s towers and panoramic views of the Swabian Alps make it a must-see stop for riders who appreciate history, scenery, and the thrill of the road.

name: Schloss Lichtenstein
description:
Lichtenstein Castle (Schloss Lichtenstein), often called the “Fairy Tale of Württemberg,” was built between 1840 and 1842 by architect Carl von Leins. Perched dramatically on a cliff above the Echaz Valley, the castle was inspired by Wilhelm Hauff’s novel Lichtenstein and blends medieval spirit with 19th-century romanticism.
For bikers, the ride to the castle is a thrill - winding mountain roads, dense forests of the Swabian Jura, and breathtaking panoramic views. Parking is available at the base of the hill - spacious and biker-friendly, just a five-minute walk from the gate. Entry is only possible with a guided tour, so it’s best to check the visiting schedule in advance. Lichtenstein is perfect for riders who enjoy medieval legends, scenic routes, and the magic of Germany’s most romantic castles.

name: Burg Eltz
description: Eltz Castle (Burg Eltz) is one of Germany’s best-preserved medieval castles, built in the 12th century and owned by the same Eltz family for over 850 years. Nestled deep in the Eltzbach Valley and surrounded by forest, it exudes a timeless, fairy-tale charm. For bikers, the road to the castle is pure joy - twisting curves, lush greenery, and the thrill of riding through a hidden valley. Parking is available about one kilometer from the castle; from there, you can walk along a scenic path or take a shuttle bus. The admission ticket grants access to the furnished rooms, armory, and panoramic views over the valley - all well worth the visit. Eltz Castle is perfect for riders seeking a mix of history, nature, and the pleasure of winding roads in the Rhineland-Palatinate region.

name: Rent-a-Boxer
description: BMW-focused rental with fully equipped motorcycles. The location is inside BMW Motorrad Zentrum Hamburg. It’s a perfect launch for North Sea/Baltic loops. A broad adventure-touring fleet is available. Book and configure options online. Dealer parking is provided.

name: Motorradvermietung Hamburg / München
description: Independent rental offering BMW/KTM with touring luggage and nav. Great for long routes toward the Elbe and the coasts. Reputation is backed by traveler reviews. Flexible pickup/return windows. Good choice for multi-day tours. On-site parking at the office.

name: Rent-a-Boxer
description: Rent-a-Boxer is a specialized BMW motorcycle rental center located near Frankfurt am Main, established in 2013. The company offers perfectly maintained BMW R and GS series bikes - ideal for anyone wishing to explore Germany on a legendary boxer engine. For riders, it’s a perfect starting point: from Frankfurt you can easily head toward the Rhine or the winding roads of the Taunus and Black Forest. Parking is available right at the rental office, with secure spaces for storing your own vehicle while you’re on the road. Gear, panniers, and GPS routes are provided, making it simple to plan scenic rides through Germany’s most beautiful regions. Rent-a-Boxer is the go-to choice for bikers who want to experience authentic German roads on a true BMW, backed by expert service and local knowledge.

name: Triumph World Leipzig
description: Triumph World Leipzig is a Triumph motorcycle dealership in Leipzig offering sales, servicing, and test rides. Its exact founding date is not publicly documented, but the centre has become an important hub for Triumph enthusiasts in recent years. For bikers, it’s a convenient launching point: you can pick up or refuel your ride and hit the road across Saxony. Parking is available right at the premises - customers can park their bikes in designated areas adjacent to the building. They stock the latest Triumph models along with accessories and gear ideal for long-distance rides.

name: Rock club Rock'nRolla
description: Rock’nRolla is an iconic rock club & bar located in the heart of Sofia. It hosts live rock performances and also houses a separate karaoke room, offering a blend of concert and club vibes. The décor features exposed brick and darker tones, creating a chill but energetic ambiance, attracting music lovers and bikers alike.

name: City Pub
description:
City Pub is an atmospheric pub-bar in the heart of Veliko Tarnovo.
The interior includes rock-inspired decor: guitars, posters, occasional live music, with volume and vibe that appeals to people who enjoy guitar riffs and a bit of grit.
They offer a solid menu — burgers, pizza, snacks, plus their own beer and a good selection of drinks.
It's well located, easy to reach, and both locals and tourists go there — good spot for an evening stop after walking around the old town.

name: You Rock
description:
“You Rock” in Nessebar is a bar praised for live rock music and a very good vibe.
Customers note good service, friendly hosts, diverse crowd. Atmosphere is lively without being overly crowded.
It opens late on weekends, which suits bikers arriving after a ride along the coast.

name: Rockhouse Cafe
description: Rock House is a cozy bar-café in Blagoevgrad, popular among students and youth, especially on weekends. They play a mix of live music and retro tunes, with a good cocktail list and relaxed atmosphere. The interior is decorated with works by local artists, giving the place character and a “local artsy” feel. A good stop for an evening drink after riding down from mountain routes or before a night-ride. Not strictly a rock club, but the vibe fits: decent sound, friendly crowd, good energy.

name: Flavor Bar & Restaurant
description: Flavor Bar & Restaurant is a cozy venue in Elenovo, Bulgaria, offering a delightful blend of authentic Bulgarian cuisine and international culinary accents. Guests can enjoy a variety of dishes, including fresh salads, juicy meat delicacies, and traditional desserts made from local ingredients. The bar menu features an extensive selection of cocktails, including the famous Bulgarian rakia, as well as refreshing drinks for evening relaxation. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with a cozy terrace perfect for warm days. It’s an ideal spot for family dinners or gatherings with friends, where everyone can find something to their taste.

name: Rodopchanka
description: Rodopchanka is one of Smolyan’s top restaurants, per reviews. A steakhouse / BBQ joint with a wine selection. Cozy atmosphere, friendly staff. Great for dinner after riding through the Rhodope Mountains — food is solid, portions generous. If you’re craving grilled meat or a premium steak, Rodopchanka is a clear choice.

name: Bulgarche Restaurant & Folklore Shop
description: Bulgarche Restaurant & Folklore Shop in Smolyan is a traditional Bulgarian style eatery with local folk music and often dance in the evenings. The interior is decorated in a folkloric style, giving it a strong local character. Great if you want not just food, but an experience with culture. Prices are moderate, portions decent. A very good stop for those traveling through Smolyan region.

name: Atlas Restaurant
description: Atlas Restaurant in Plovdiv is one of the upscale restaurants in the city, located on Knyaz Alexander I Street. It offers refined atmosphere and an elevated menu: meat, seafood, good wine selection. Great if you want a nicer meal after a day of riding. Prices are above average, but according to reviews, the food and service justify it.

name: Restaurant "Ethno"
description: Ethno Restaurant in Veliko Tarnovo is a stylish eatery with a nice interior and outdoor seating. The menu is diverse: meats, fish, pasta, salads with modern twists. Views of the old city are beautiful, especially in the evening with ambient lighting. It operates until late evening, making it a good stop after a day of riding. Good price-to-quality ratio.

name: Moma Bulgarian Food & Wine
description: Moma Bulgarian Food & Wine is a well-liked Sofia restaurant offering modern Bulgarian cuisine with a regional twist. The interior blends national heritage with a clean, stylish look. Their menu is diverse and the ambiance suits both tourists and locals wanting a quality dining experience.

name: Hadjidraganov’s Cellars
description: Hadjidraganov’s Cellars (Hadjidraganovite Izbi) is a wine cellar style restaurant focused on Bulgarian cuisine, with cozy wooden interiors and traditional ambiance. Ideal for experiencing Bulgarian food with character and style.

name: Happy Bar & Grill
description:
Happy Bar & Grill is a major casual dining chain in Bulgaria, known for its broad menu and comfortable ambiance.
They serve everything from burgers, steaks and sushi to traditional Bulgarian dishes and seasonal themed menus.
The interior is modern and stylish, often with bright design and relaxed music — fitting for families and travelers alike.
The chain maintains high quality standards, using fresh ingredients and avoiding pre-processed foods.
For bikers: it’s a convenient waypoint along routes, menu for varied tastes, and a comfortable spot for lunch or dinner.

name: DOMO Restaurant
description: DOMO Restaurant is a refined eatery in central Kardzhali that combines traditional Bulgarian cuisine with Mediterranean flavors. The dishes are prepared with attention to detail and presented elegantly. A great spot if you want a proper dinner stop in the city, good food and atmosphere. It leans more upscale than casual, so expect slightly higher prices, but you get quality.

name: MOTO Slovakia, s. r. o.
description: Motorcycle dealership and rental service offering new/used bikes, official KTM and Yamaha sales, and adventure gear for exploring the Malé Karpaty region.

name: MOTO-SHOP s.r.o.
description: Motorcycle sales, service, and rental shop in central Slovakia, offering new and used bikes, maintenance, and touring gear for exploring the Strážovské vrchy mountains.

name: DUCATI Slovakia
description: Official Ducati dealership and service center in a historic mining town, offering new models, genuine parts, and test rides through the Štiavnica mountain routes.

name: Yamaha Centrum Bratislava
description: As an exclusive YAMAHA store in Bratislava, we bring our customers a completely new approach and care for your Yamaha motorcycle, quad bike or scooter. In our store, in addition to Yamaha products, you will also find under one roof a branded service, a towing service for motorcycles, a washing center and, of course, the sale of clothing and accessories from brands such as Alpinestars, Spidi, Oxford, ... Sale of HJC, Cassida, Nox and Airoh helmets. We believe that this diverse range of services will please you and that you will find your way to our store at Račianska Street 184/A.

name: Sherco Slovakia
description: Official Sherco enduro and trial motorcycle dealer for Slovakia, offering sales, service, parts, and demo rides in the nearby Slovak Paradise mountains.

name: KTM Motosport racing
description:
KTM Púchov is an authorized dealer of KTM motorcycles and spare parts. To the complete satisfaction of our regular and new customers, we have prepared an e-shop where you can easily and clearly order original spare parts, Powerparts, Powerwear and other accessories for your KTM motorcycle from the comfort of your home. The e-shop contains the complete offer of the KTM manufacturer.

We ship parts that we have in stock within 24 hours, otherwise the goods will be delivered to you within 5-7 business days.

We believe that you will be satisfied with our services. If you have any questions, concerns or other inquiries, please do not hesitate to contact us. We wish you a pleasant shopping experience.

name: MOTOSVET
description:
We are a multi-brand brick-and-mortar store in Košice with an online store. We offer services for all beginners and advanced bikers.

We are an official dealer of Kawasaki motorcycles, AGV helmets, Dainese clothing, and SIDI shoes.
We sell brands that have a name in the world.
We offer professional advice based on the personal experience of the employees who work for us.
Our main goals are the satisfaction of our customers, providing adequate clothing, accessories, and possibly even a motorcycle according to the customer's needs.

name: KTM OKR
description:
Hello. My name is Richard Kuba. Many people know me and maybe we have had the honor of meeting in person. And maybe you also know that I have been riding motorcycles since I was 6 years old, and that is why I want to share with you our 44 years of experience in top motorsport!

As a baby, I slept in a basket on motocross tracks and experienced and saw legends like Jaroslav Falta, Németh Kornél st, Zdenek Velký, Stefan Everts... My life and dreams revolve only around engines, motorbikes and racing - I'm not interested in anything else. I've tried a lot of competitions and experienced everything possible in this motorsports world. I've raced quads, ridden motocross, supermoto, enduro, long-distance rally competitions, driven buggies and even flew airplanes.

I simply love everything that has an engine and roars... Since 2002 I have been doing the only thing that still interests me = selling and testing motorcycles! Every year I try all the available motorcycles, the newest and best ones for the given season. In 2001 on a Yamaha and in 2004 on a KTM motorcycle I won the Slovak motocross championship .

Since 2006, we have been supporting motocross and enduro racers together with KTM. Our KTM OKR team has featured the best racers in Eastern Europe - Legends, such as Gábor Grillmayer, Németh Kornél, Szvoboda Bence, Gábor Firtosvári and many others. We have been cooperating with Štev Svitko, but also with Jaro Katriňák, for a long time.

name: Moto-car service
description: We offer our clients a comprehensive service for motorcycles and cars. We also focus on their construction and conversion. Our guarantee is our many years of experience in servicing motorcycles and cars of various brands.

name: SERVICE 13 s.r.o.
description:
SERVICE 13's priority is customer satisfaction. We strive to provide all services, starting from inspection - diagnostics, price quotation, supply of spare parts and motorcycle service. We treat each customer individually and give them our utmost.

We always have a friendly atmosphere and you don't have to yell at us.

Do not hesitate to contact us.

name: Motoservice.sk
description:
We offer complete service and tire repair for motorcycles, scooters and ATVs, from basic service tasks to complete general repairs of engines, gearboxes, chassis parts, electrical systems, etc.We use only the highest quality parts while adhering to service procedures! Either original manufacturer parts, or parts from renowned manufacturers such as Athena, Wossner, Prox, Pivot Works, Motul...

We will transport your motorcycle anywhere! For service work, we offer discounted transportation to and from the service. We also offer transportation upon purchase (Slovakia and abroad) or after an accident. We also offer transportation in a closed van!

name: MotoArt - Service
description:
The MotoArt service operates on a garage-service system,
which is very popular among bikers. This method makes it easier to apply the individual approach to each repair, which is what MotoArt is based on. The workshop offers year-round maintenance and repairs of motorcycles of most European, American and Japanese brands.

name: Motoservis Virtuos Motorcycle
description: A trusted motorcycle service and repair workshop specializing in European and Japanese brands, known for expert diagnostics, engine rebuilding, and pre-trip inspections for touring riders.

name: MOTOFIX - Servis Motocyklov Zvolen
description:
Welcome to Motofix Zvolen , where your passion for motorcycles meets our expertise. From early childhood, when I first held the keys to a motorcycle, I knew that my life would be inextricably linked to these amazing machines. This love and passion for motorcycles is the foundation of our service.

With over 15 years of experience, I decided to found Motofix – a place where every biker can find what they need. From a simple oil change to a comprehensive overhaul, our workshop is equipped with the latest technology and our mechanics are true experts in their field.

At Motofix , we pride ourselves on a personal approach. We understand that every motorcycle is unique and every biker has their own specific requirements and stories. That's why we always try to listen to our customers and provide services tailored to their needs.

At Motofix , every biker feels at home. Come and experience the highest level of expertise and care that your motorcycle deserves. We look forward to working with you and writing the next chapter in your motorcycle journey together.

name: moto.garáž.73
description: A community-focused motorcycle garage and workshop offering repairs, custom builds, and rider meetups in the Pezinok wine region, with a passion for vintage and modern bikes alike.

name: MotoGlobal
description: We are a company focused on providing complete services in the field of motorcycles and ATVs.

name: Motoservis RK
description: We specialize in servicing, repairing and diagnosing faults on motorcycles, scooters and ATVs, regardless of make or model. We carry out all work directly in GALANTE in western Slovakia – quickly, reliably and with an emphasis on quality.

name: PKS Servis Motocyklov s.r.o.
description:
Motorcycle service with many years of experience
We perform all types of repairs from pre-season preparation to general repairs.

name: TamaMoto
description: Motorcycle sales, service, and customization workshop specializing in Japanese and European brands, known for performance upgrades and touring preparations near the Austrian border.

name: AddVision rental
description:
Rental of scooters up to 125cc for a standard B driver's license
We also cooperate with couriers Wolt, Bolt Food, Foodpanda
Also advantageous for foreigners who are getting to know Bratislava
We also cooperate with food delivery fleets, contact us

name: SCOOTERRENTAL
description: If you need to get from one part of town to another quickly, this stylish and affordable scooter is perfect for you. It doesn't fight traffic, it cuts through it like a knife through butter. The relaxed riding position brings comfort and offers a great view of what's happening around you. The flat floor is practical. The all-new Vision 110 is more fuel-efficient and offers a range of premium features that you'll enjoy every ride.

name: Moto Skill s.r.o.
description: Discover the beauty of Orava, Liptov and the Tatras in the saddle of the Yamaha Tenere 700 World Raid - an adventure motorcycle with high performance, a large tank and comfort for every journey. Reliable, comfortable and ready to conquer even the most demanding routes.

name: Marek Lesák - požičovňa motocyklov
description:
How does the motorcycle pick-up process work?
At Motoshop Žubor, a prepared motorcycle (full tank, clean, 100% technical condition) and a rental agreement will be waiting for you. All you need to prepare is your driver's license, ID card and deposit (cash/payment card - pay attention to the limit on the card).

How is the motorcycle returned?
The motorcycle must be returned in the same condition as when it was picked up (full tank, clean, 100% technical condition). Dirt is charged according to the contract, as is damage, which is described in more detail in the contract.

name: Spiš Castle
description: Hilltop ruins of an expansive, fortified, stone-built castle, dating from the 12th century.

name: Múzeum mesta Bratislavy – Hrad Devín
description: Partially reconstructed medieval castle offering panoramic vistas over the Danube & Morava rivers.

name: Bratislava Castle
description: Reconstructed Baroque castle dating back to 907 A.D. & national museum located on a hilltop.

name: Bojnice Castle
description: Daily & night tours of a hilltop, neo-gothic castle with a museum, landscaped gardens & cave.

name: Trenčín Castle
description: This ancient hilltop castle houses a history museum with exhibits on the area & the castle.

name: Červený Kameň Castle
description: Guided tours of a preserved 13th-century castle museum housing furniture & historic weapon exhibits.

name: Vlkolínec (UNESCO)
description: The most valuable thing that belongs to Ružomberok is the foothill settlement of Vlkolínec. In Vlkolínec, the original architecture and structure of a mountain settlement of želiars, shepherds and lumberjacks have been preserved. Wooden log houses, which grew up along a stream, rise in the sloping terrain of the Veľká Fatra below the Sidorovo hill. The surroundings of Vlkolínec consist of orchards, terraced fields, meadows dotted with wooden haystacks and forests. The log houses are built in the classic Liptov style, from hewn trunks of coniferous trees placed on a stone foundation. The roofs of the houses are covered with wooden shingles, as wood was once the most available material for roofing. The log cabins consist of three rooms, an entrance hall, which served as a kitchen, a pantry for storing food and tools, and a room that served as a living space for all activities and also for the entire family to sleep. The uniqueness of Vlkolínec is that these log cabins are treated with colored lime paint. Already in the post-war period, people realized the uniqueness of preserving the original architecture and Vlkolínec was declared a monument reserve of folk architecture. A little later, it was realized that such a unique thing is not only unique in Slovakia, but also in the entire world. Therefore, Vlkolínec was included in the UNESCO World Cultural and Natural Heritage List in 1993, thereby gaining global prestige.

name: Michael's Gate
description: The only preserved medieval gate in Bratislava, offering a historic viewpoint from its tower over the Old Town rooftops and a museum of fortification history.

name: The Ľubovňa Castle
description: Castle built in the 13th c. & reconstructed in the 17th c., with guided tours & museum exhibits.

name: Old Town Hall
description: This museum in the Old Town Hall complex features exhibits on the history of Bratislava.

name: Tomášovský view
description: Clifftop outlook with a cave underneath, offering views of Hornád Gorge & the High Tatras mountains.

name: Sunset viewpoint Staré Mesto
description: A popular riverside spot near the Old Town offering stunning sunset views over the Danube, Apollo Bridge, and Bratislava Castle, with benches perfect for evening relaxation.

name: Slovak Paradise National Park
description: Massive park with a lake & hiking trails through scenic canyons, waterfalls & peaceful forests.

name: Bridge SNP
description: Flying saucer–shaped tower offering an observation deck & a restaurant with panoramic vistas.

name: Bratislava Viewpoint
description: A modern observation deck in Petržalka offering spectacular panoramic views of Bratislava Castle, Old Town bridges, and the Danube — especially magical at night when the city lights illuminate the skyline.

name: Výhľad pri Srdiečku
description: A hidden viewpoint in the Devínska Kobyla nature reserve offering sweeping panoramas of the Morava River confluence, Austrian borderlands, and distant Alps — perfect for sunrise hikes and birdwatching.

name: Kamzík Television Tower
description: Tall transmission tower with a public observation deck & a Mediterranean restaurant.

name: Rozhľadňa Ostredok, Bencúrova veža
description: A 25-meter wooden observation tower at 1,596m altitude, offering 360° panoramas of the Low Tatras peaks, Demänovská Valley, and distant High Tatras — accessible via a moderate 2-hour hike from the resort.

name: Observation deck
description: A modern elevated platform in Bratislava's main square offering panoramic views of the Old Town, UFO Bridge, and Bratislava Castle — perfect for quick photos and people-watching.

name: Motocenter OHG
description: Motocenter OHG is a motorcycle service and dealership in Hanover, specializing in maintenance, repairs, and sales since 1997. The workshop offers a full range of services - from seasonal maintenance and tire service to travel prep and custom tuning. For touring motorcyclists, it’s a reliable stop to fix issues quickly before continuing the journey. Parking is available right in front of the service building, with covered waiting areas and a small rest zone for customers. The mechanics are experienced with BMW, Honda, Yamaha, and other major brands, ensuring top-quality service.

name: Börjes American Bikes GmbH
description: Established in the 1990s, the company specializes in the sale of new and pre-owned Harley-Davidson motorcycles, as well as tuning and maintenance. Riders can rent Harley-Davidson bikes here, get expert customization, or have premium Öhlins suspension components installed. The service center is staffed by certified Harley-Davidson mechanics offering seasonal maintenance, diagnostics, tire service, and suspension setup. Parking is available directly in front of the building, with designated motorcycle spaces and a comfortable customer lounge. Börjes American Bikes isn’t just a dealership - it’s a true hub for American motorcycle enthusiasts to buy, rent, repair, and connect with fellow riders.

name: Recycle-Motorradvermietung
description: Founded in the early 2000s, it has built a strong reputation for reliable bikes and friendly, rider-focused service. Available models include BMW, Honda, Suzuki, and Yamaha - from touring enduros to sporty roadsters. The company provides not only bike rentals but also storage, trip preparation, and optional gear and GPS rental. Parking is available on-site, with covered spaces and easy access for trailers and support vehicles. Recycle-Motorradvermietung is the perfect starting point for bikers eager to explore Germany’s scenic routes without owning a motorcycle.

name: Allround car and motorbike rental GmbH
description: The company offers a wide selection of motorcycles - from city bikes to touring models by BMW, Ducati, and Harley-Davidson. In addition to rentals, they provide storage, insurance, airport transfer, and a short briefing before each trip. Customers appreciate the convenient online booking system and flexible rental terms, ranging from a single day to several weeks. Parking is available directly on-site, with designated spaces for both motorcycles and cars. Allround GmbH is a perfect starting point for a Bavarian or Alpine motorcycle journey, combining technical reliability with friendly service.

name: Rent-a-Boxer
description: Rent-a-Boxer is a BMW motorcycle rental service in Berlin, operating since 2004 and well known among touring riders across Europe. The company offers a wide range of BMW models - from the classic R nineT to the adventure-ready R 1250 GS, perfect for long-distance touring. Services include motorcycle rentals, guided and self-guided tours across Germany and neighboring countries, storage, and route planning assistance. Riders can also rent riding gear, luggage systems, and Garmin navigation devices for added comfort.

name: Rent a Legend
description: The company offers a wide range of motorcycles for touring, weekend rides, and test drives. Services include motorcycle rentals, guided tours across Germany and the Alps, and sales of riding gear and accessories. Customers can choose from flexible rental options - daily, weekend, or weekly - with insurance and technical support included. Parking is available on-site with easy access for motorcycles and support vehicles. Rent a Legend is the perfect destination for riders who want to live their dream and ride a true legend of American or European engineering.

name: Stefan Knopf Tours
description: The company specializes in BMW motorcycle rentals, European tours, and motorcycle shipping between the USA, Canada, and Germany. Services include motorcycle storage, maintenance, delivery, and full travel preparation with paperwork and insurance. Riders can also book group or self-guided tours across Germany, the Alps, and Southern Europe. Parking is available on-site, including secure indoor spaces for customers bringing their own bikes. Stefan Knopf Tours is more than just a service - it’s a true hub for international riders, designed for long-distance touring and carefree adventures on the open road.

name: Moto-K
description: The company specializes in repairs, maintenance, diagnostics, and spare parts sales, as well as seasonal motorcycle storage. Riders can have their bikes fully prepared for the season, including tire changes, oil service, and accessory installation. Moto-K also offers customization and performance upgrades, helping riders make their machines truly one of a kind. Advance booking is required, especially during the busy riding season. Moto-K is where your bike gets expert care - and you find genuine camaraderie among true two-wheeled enthusiasts.

name: Moto-Clinic Dipl.-Ing. (FH) Harald Borkowsky
description: Services include regular maintenance, TÜV inspection preparation, accessory installation, and full pre-trip checks. Customers can also arrange seasonal storage and get advice on tuning and performance upgrades. Advance booking is required, especially during spring and early riding season. Parking is available near the workshop, and the atmosphere is warm and rider-friendly - a place where your motorcycle is treated with real care and respect.

name: Mobiler Motorradservice Ingolstadt
description: The company focuses on mobile maintenance and minor repairs for motorcycles, scooters, and ATVs, eliminating the need for transport to a workshop. Services include oil changes, electronic diagnostics, part installation, TÜV preparation, and roadside breakdown support. They also offer seasonal storage and scheduled maintenance for riders who prefer service at their own location. Mobiler Motorradservice Ingolstadt is the perfect choice for riders who value convenience, speed, and dependable on-the-go motorcycle care.

name: MotoTech Andreas Wöhrle
description: MotoTech Andreas Wöhrle is a modern motorcycle workshop in Karlsruhe, specializing in maintenance and repair for all major brands. Services include diagnostics, seasonal maintenance, engine and suspension repair, TÜV preparation, and accessory installation. The workshop also provides tire service, replacement of consumables, and professional motorcycle cleaning. Advance booking is required, especially during the start of the riding season. Parking is available directly in front of the building, and the atmosphere is friendly and biker-oriented, with a focus on quality and honesty.

name: Rasch Moto - Free motorcycle workshop
description: Rasch Moto – Free Motorcycle Workshop is an open motorcycle garage in Berlin where riders can maintain and repair their bikes using professional tools and equipment. The workshop offers fully equipped workstations with lifts, compressors, and mechanic support when needed. Riders can rent a workspace by the hour, bring their own parts, or purchase what they need directly on-site. The vibe is friendly and communal - a meeting place for enthusiasts who love to work on their machines together. Advance booking is recommended, especially on weekends and during the busy season.

name: MOTO-Frankfurt GmbH
description: MOTO-Frankfurt GmbH is a large motorcycle dealership and service center in Frankfurt, specializing in sales, rentals, and maintenance of various motorcycle brands. The shop offers both new and pre-owned bikes, along with a full range of riding gear and accessories. Services include maintenance, repairs, seasonal storage, and TÜV preparation. The dealership also provides motorcycle rentals, perfect for travelers or riders looking to test different models. Advance booking is recommended for service appointments or test rides. There is a spacious parking area in front of the building, and the overall vibe is friendly and biker-focused, emphasizing quality and expertise.

name: Bar & Dinner Friends
description: Bar & Dinner Friends is a nice restaurant-bar in Kardzhali. The menu is varied — breakfast, lunch, dinner — good for a light meal on the road. Parking is available, the location is convenient, especially if passing through town center. Friendly vibe, comfortable place for a relaxed dinner.

name: V-Moto
description: V-Moto in Varna is a premier motorcycle parts and service shop since the 2000s, specializing in spares, accessories, and maintenance for riders, perfect for adventure journeys across the Balkans and Europe. Centrally located in Varna, it equips long-haul travelers with premium Dunlop, Bridgestone, and Michelin tires, plus Motul and Silkolene oils for reliability on twisty roads and highways. You'll find NGK spark plugs, K&N and Hiflofiltro filters, RK, CZ, and DID chains, along with TRW and Brembo brake pads to keep your bike safe from the Black Sea to the Rhodopes. The selection includes Yuasa and Landport batteries, Brembo radial pumps, and tuning parts like Malossi, Airsal, and TopRacing for customizing long-distance setups. A must-visit for moto adventurers, V-Moto offers pro servicing, MT helmets, and OEM parts, ensuring confident and unforgettable rides through Bulgaria and beyond.

name: Ducati Bulgaria
description: Ducati Bulgaria in Sofia is the official Ducati dealer since the 2000s, offering premium motorcycles like Panigale, Multistrada, DesertX, and Scrambler, perfect for adventure rides across the Balkans and Europe. Located on Trakia Highway, Km 1 (Red Moto), it equips long-haul riders with Alpinestars gear, Arai helmets, and Termignoni accessories for ultimate protection and performance on twisty roads and highways. You'll find OEM parts, Givi luggage systems, and GPS mounts to keep your bike reliable from the Rhodopes to the Black Sea. The range includes long-distance models, enhanced with rain protection and comfy options for easy roadside stops. A must-visit for moto travelers, Ducati Bulgaria provides test rides, personalized service, and warranties, ensuring confident and unforgettable journeys through Bulgaria and beyond.

name: Moto House / Moto Universe (dealer)
description: Moto House / Moto Universe in Plovdiv is a top motorcycle dealership since the 2000s, offering premium bikes like KTM, Kawasaki, Husqvarna, Aprilia, Moto Guzzi, Vespa, and Piaggio, perfect for adventure rides across the Balkans and Europe. Located on Nestor Abadzhiev №59, it equips long-haul riders with Alpinestars gear and Shoei helmets for ultimate protection on twisty roads and highways. You'll find touring accessories and parts such as luggage systems, GPS mounts, and chain kits to keep your bike reliable from the Rhodopes to the Black Sea. The range includes long-distance models, enhanced with rain protection and comfy seats for easy roadside stops. A must-visit for moto travelers, Moto House provides personalized service, no-down-payment financing, and warranties, ensuring confident and unforgettable journeys through Bulgaria and beyond.

name: ML Racing
description: ML Racing in Veliko Tarnovo is a premier motorcycle shop with service since 2004, offering everything riders need: from KTM, Honda, Yamaha, Kawasaki, Suzuki, and BMW bikes to quality gear and parts tailored for adventure journeys. Located on Dalga Laka 15, it equips long-distance travelers with waterproof LS2 textile jackets, protective boots, gloves, and helmets perfect for Balkan mountain twists. You'll find OEM and aftermarket maintenance parts like WP shock springs, seal kits, and chain sliders to keep your bike reliable from the Danube to the Black Sea. The selection features touring accessories, including grippy seat covers for KTM and Kawasaki, plus full rain protection sets for comfy routes. A must-visit for moto adventurers, ML Racing provides expert consultations from seasoned owners and a 2-year warranty, ensuring confident and unforgettable rides across Bulgaria and Europe.

name: Fusione / Moto Universal Ltd
description: Fusione Moto Universal Ltd in Ruse is a go-to spot for bikers, offering CFMOTO and FUSIONE motorcycles alongside premium SCHUBERTH and SHOEI gear for safe European adventures. Located on Bulevard Tsar Osvoboditel, it stocks SENA Bluetooth headsets, K&N filters, and EBC brakes for reliability on tough terrains. The shop equips riders with YUASA batteries and ROCKOIL lubricants, ensuring bikes run smoothly from the Balkans to the Black Sea. Its range includes lightweight VOLTA and LIFAN touring bikes, complemented by CHAMPION accessories and ZEUS protection for comfy journeys. A must-visit for moto travelers, Fusione provides tires, chains, and SENA GPS headsets for confident, unforgettable rides across Bulgaria and beyond.

name: Eagle's Eye
description: Eagle’s Eye (Orlovo Oko) is a dramatic viewpoint perched at approximately 1,563 m above sea level, located in the Western Rhodope Mountains near the village of Yagodina. The steel‑platform juts out above the Buynovo Gorge, offering sweeping views over forested slopes, a winding river and distant mountain ridges — it really gives the feeling of floating above the landscape. The access route, whether via scenic mountain road or a short hike, is especially appealing to motorcyclists looking to make a memorable stop. Once there, it’s worth spending time to take photos, breathe in the mountain air and absorb the view before continuing your ride. Stopping here adds a standout moment to your journey — combining forests, cliffs, fresh air and a wide open panorama.

name: Lisa Gora Viewing Tower
description: Lisa Gora Viewing Tower is a popular lookout point near Plovdiv, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding hills and the city skyline. The tower is easily reachable via scenic trails, making it a favorite stop for motorcyclists who enjoy short hikes from nearby parking spots. From the top, visitors can admire rolling hills, forested areas, and the distant Rhodope Mountains. The location is peaceful and perfect for photography, stretching legs, and enjoying a short nature break. Its elevated position provides an impressive perspective, especially during sunrise or sunset.

name: Kamen Del Peak
description: Kamen Del Peak is a scenic summit on Mount Vitosha near Sofia, known for its wide panoramic views of the city and surrounding mountains. The terrain is rocky and open, making it a favorite spot for easy hikes and short trekking routes. From the top, you can see the Sofia Valley, the Balkan Mountains, and even Rila on clear days. The trail is relatively simple and suitable for beginners when the weather is good. It’s a perfect place for photos, relaxing in nature, and escaping the city for a peaceful mountain atmosphere.

name: Snezhanka Tower — Pamporovo
description: Snezhanka Tower is a 156-meter telecommunications tower located at the peak of Mount Snezhanka in the Pamporovo ski resort. The tower features an observation deck and a panoramic café, offering stunning 360° views of the Rhodope Mountains and, on clear days, even distant mountain ranges. It’s one of the most iconic landmarks in the region and a popular stop both in winter and summer. The area around the tower is easily accessible by ski lifts or by car during the warm season. With its high-altitude scenery and calm mountain air, the tower is an ideal spot for photos, relaxation, and taking in the beauty of the Rhodopes.

name: Eagle's Nest
description: Eagle’s Nest is one of the most atmospheric and dramatic viewpoints in central Bulgaria, located on the slopes of the Balkan Mountains. The platform offers wide panoramic views over the valley around Sopot and Karlovo, with dense forests and mountain ridges stretching into the distance. It’s a popular stop for motorcyclists: the road leading up is scenic, and the viewpoint itself is perfect for a short break and photos. Parking space is limited, and there are sections along the road where stopping is prohibited, so it’s important to keep this in mind when planning your visit. The spot is quiet, breezy, and ideal for taking in the vast landscape and peaceful mountain atmosphere.

name: Old Nessebar Viewpoint
description: Old Nessebar is one of the oldest towns in Europe, situated on a narrow peninsula on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast with a history spanning over 3,000 years. Originally a Thracian settlement called Menebria, it later became a Greek colony, followed by Roman and Byzantine rule, and today exists as an open-air museum protected by UNESCO. Its cobbled streets, wooden houses from the 18th-19th centuries and dozens of medieval churches create a unique atmosphere where riders can pause, stretch their legs and soak up the heritage. For motorcyclists, it's a perfect stop: easy access from the coastal road, a stroll through the historic core, sea views and a restful break before continuing your journey. Plan roughly 30 – 60 minutes for the stop.

name: Park-Monument of the Bulgarian-Soviet Friendship
description: The Park–Monument of the Bulgarian–Soviet Friendship is located on a hill near Varna and stands as one of the most impressive monumental structures from the socialist era. Its massive concrete architecture rises above the city, offering panoramic views of Varna and the sea. Visitors can climb the long staircase or ride up via the road, experiencing both the historic atmosphere and striking design. Although partially abandoned today, the site remains open to the public, giving it a unique urban-exploration vibe. It’s a great spot for photos, viewpoints, and a quick stop for motorcyclists riding through the Varna region.

name: The Meanders of Arda River near Madzharovo
description: The Arda River forms some of the most spectacular natural meanders in Bulgaria, creating dramatic curves surrounded by steep volcanic cliffs. Near Madzharovo, the landscape opens into wide panoramic views that feel untouched and wild, making the spot especially popular among photographers and road-trippers. The area is also famous for its rich biodiversity, including one of the largest populations of vultures in the Balkans. The viewpoint is easily reachable by car or motorcycle, but parking is limited and roadside stopping is restricted in some places, so it’s important to plan your stop carefully. This is a peaceful, atmospheric location where you can enjoy quiet nature, impressive rock formations, and the vast winding river below.

name: KHL Moto Travel
description: KHL Moto Travel Ltd. is one of the prominent motorcycle rental and tour service companies in Sofia. They provide motorcycle rentals, guided tours, logistical support, transfers, accommodation booking, and on-route assistance. They’re a good choice when you seek not just a bike, but a full travel partner for riding around Bulgaria and the Balkans.

name: KFZ Meisterbetrieb Uwe Günther
description: KFZ Meisterbetrieb Uwe Günther is a certified workshop in Erfurt offering maintenance and repair services for both cars and motorcycles. The shop is equipped with modern diagnostic and repair tools for engines, brakes, and suspension systems. Services include oil and filter changes, TÜV preparation, seasonal maintenance, and minor body repairs. The staff is friendly and professional, ensuring top-quality service that meets German automotive standards. Advance booking is recommended, especially during the busy maintenance season.

name: Casa di Moto GmbH
description: Casa di Moto GmbH is a professional motorcycle service center in Bielefeld, specializing in maintenance, repairs, and customization of various bike brands. The workshop offers full diagnostics, oil and tire changes, and installation of additional accessories. Riders can also order tuning and custom modifications to make their bikes truly unique. A wide selection of spare parts, gear, and motorcycle accessories from top brands is available on-site. Advance booking is recommended, especially during the spring and summer riding season.

name: AS Racing Performance GmbH
description: AS Racing Performance GmbH is a modern motorcycle workshop in Munich, focused on sport and street bikes. The company specializes in tuning, suspension setup, engine optimization, and track bike preparation. They also provide full maintenance, diagnostics, tire service, and all types of mechanical repairs. A wide range of parts, oils, and accessories from leading brands is available for purchase. Advance booking is recommended for maintenance or custom work to ensure personalized service.

name: Craft Beer & Meat
description: CRAFT Beer & Meat is a beer restaurant and bar located at the Sea Port in Varna, Bulgaria. It offers a beautiful view of the port and the sea, especially impressive at sunset. The menu features a wide selection of craft beers and meat dishes such as burgers, ribs, barbecue, and snacks. The spacious hall can accommodate over 350 guests and includes large LED screens, perfect for watching sports events. The venue is open daily from morning until late evening, suitable for both lunch and evening relaxation.

name: Caffe Pizzeria "Saturnus"
description: Caffe Pizzeria “Saturnus” is situated in a charming spot of Herceg Novi and is known for its warm, friendly ambiance. They serve a variety of pizzas, fresh salads, and signature coffee drinks. The interior blends the coziness of a café with the casual feel of a pizzeria, perfect for a relaxed dinner. The service is often praised as attentive and welcoming, and the prices are quite reasonable. It’s a popular spot among locals and tourists alike who appreciate good food in an informal setting.

name: Falkensteiner Hotel Bratislava
description:
Small streets with nice pubs, the beautiful historic old town and the fortress perched high above Bratislava are among the top reasons for a visit to the Slovakian capital. Take a leisurely stroll, enjoy culinary highlights and soak up the wonderful flair of the coexistence of history and modernity - here you can discover something at every turn.

Our hotel offers you the perfect starting point for this: centrally located in the city, you can start your very own tour on foot after a delicious breakfast or embark on a successful business trip. When you return happy and exhausted after a long day on your feet, you can make yourself comfortable to your heart's content in our Acquapura SPA with a breathtaking view of the castle. Once again refreshed, an aperitif awaits you at the bar - does that sound like a tempting scenario for your city break?

name: CHORS like a hotel | Capsule & NFT Boutique Hostel Bratislava
description:
HORS is the first art boutique hostel in Europe that offers accommodation in exclusive Capsules. Capsule accommodation is a modern and minimalist trend that combines the social experience of living in a hostel while offering perfect privacy. Capsules are separate cells or boxes for guests to stay in for a great price. CHORS hostel in Bratislava, Slovakia strives for perfection to maximize the accommodation experience. You'll be pleasantly surprised to find Capsules providing all the equipment you need in such a minimalist space.

CHORS interior is in industrial design, it focuses on bringing a guest standard of a hotel of the highest category. An unforgettable atmosphere is made by unique and original paintings provided exclusively for CHORS by Marek Ormandík, an important academic Slovak painter of the middle generation known all over Europe.

name: Patio Hostel
description: Patio Hostel is a unique place on the map of Bratislava. Our facility has an excellent location - only a few minutes walk separates us from the main attractions of Bratislava, as well as many popular and widely recognized restaurants, clubs and pubs. We are also proud of our exceptional staff - multilingual, working 24/7, always willing to help and able to recommend interesting events and places. Our offer also includes many amenities, incl. parking (10 euros per day), free luggage room or laundry, bicycle rental, communal kitchen with free coffee and tea, elevator, fast wireless wi-fi network and many more. However, the greatest value of our hostel are the guests visiting us - coming from different countries, curious about the world, willing to meet new places and new people. They make Patio Hostel a unique place where you can not only spend the night during your stay in Bratislava, but also have fun and find new friends.

name: Hotel ANTARES
description:
Hotel ANTARES is one of the popular four-star hotels in Bratislava. It is located in a residential area of the city, near Bratislava Castle. It offers peace and relaxation, just a few steps from the historic center. Hotel ANTARES offers accommodation in four categories of rooms, Standard Single rooms, Standard Double rooms, Suite and Deluxe apartment. All rooms are tastefully and comfortably furnished, air-conditioned, equipped with a SMART TV, telephone, safe, WiFi, minibar, and a coffee and tea making set. In the hotel’s wellness center, our guests have access to a sauna, whirlpool, and fitness center. Parking in the hotel garages is a matter of course for us. The hotel has 27 rooms, 2 suites, 4 single rooms, 20 double rooms and one Deluxe apartment. Our hotel offers you an attractive location under Bratislava Castle, 10 minutes to the historic center, with comfortable and secure garage parking, a quiet environment, relaxation, modern equipment and design, complete services, and a wellness center.
Behind the scenes Hotel ANTARES was built in a luxurious part of our capital city Bratislava. The first 4 years were filled with positive reactions from guests, making our hotel a sought-after place for business travelers and vacationers. This soon led to insufficient capacity, so we built an additional part, giving our hotel its current form. The hotel is characterized mainly by its uniquely pleasant atmosphere, which guarantees a comfortable and quiet stay.

name: Boutique Apartments Possonium
description:
Stylish serviced apartments in a historic building, blending original features with modern design, offering fully equipped kitchens and comfortable stays for short or long visits.

We have a popular SELF CHECK-IN SYSTEM in use for all of our apartments / studios.
All of them are air conditioned, pet friendly and are equipped with TV, fridge, hair dryer, towels and bed linens.

You may find more exact details and informations about your desired apartment / studio in our booking system. Do not hesitate and press “BOOK NOW”!

name: Hotel Yasmin Kosice
description:
Hotel Yasmin Košice – where elegance meets functionality in modern lifestyle.
Are you looking for a comfortable business hotel in the city center or a romantic escape for a weekend getaway? Hotel Yasmin Košice is the perfect choice!

You'll be captivated by its harmonious interior design, modern amenities, and exceptional quality of service. Inspired by nature, the Yasmin style flows throughout the hotel, which opened its doors on March 23, 2009.

From the moment you arrive, you'll be welcomed by a shimmering mosaic exterior, a moss-covered wall, and the refreshing ambiance of a fountain surrounded by colorful stone paving.

Our comfortable rooms and suites combine refined taste with functionality, offering elegant and efficient use of space. Equally impressive are our fully equipped conference facilities for up to 300 guests, and a gourmet restaurant with a sunny summer terrace.

Hotel Yasmin** Košice will undoubtedly leave a lasting impression – right in the heart of a modern city.

name: Hotel & Restaurant Resort Barca
description: A modern hotel and restaurant complex on the outskirts of Košice, offering comfortable rooms, a traditional Slovak restaurant, and easy access to both the city center and nearby cycling trails along the Hornád. The perfect combination of gourmet cuisine , luxurious accommodation and unforgettable spaces designed to meet all your expectations. We invite you to discover a place that combines comfort, elegance and unique experiences, ideal for families, friends and business meetings.

name: Hotel Polo
description: Hotel Polo is a modern hotel inspired by baroque style and is located only 3 km from the center of Presov, near the Shopping Center MAX. Hotel Polo provides to its guests luxurious comfort to relax, overnight accommodation, business meetings and other social events. Because of its attractive design, hotel is very popular for businessmen from Slovakia, but also for businessmen from the other countries. In Hotel Polo, there are 15 hotel rooms decorated in a various color combinations with quality furniture accessories. Hotel Polo can simultaneously accommodate more than 32 guests in luxury and comfortable hotel rooms.

name: Holiday Inn Žilina
description:
A modern four-star hotel, located near the city center of Žilina.

The hotel is easily accessible from the main roads into, and out of Žilina. Try the comfort of stylishly furnished rooms and enjoy the beautiful panoramic views of the Small Fatra mountains surrounding the hotel. Our professional approach and varied selection of menu options create an ideal setting during your stay.

Whether you are traveling for business or spending quality time with the family, we wish you all a very relaxing and refreshing stay with us.

name: Penzión Sentami
description: A peaceful guesthouse in Žilina offering comfortable rooms with mountain views, a garden, and easy access to the Malá Fatra National Park — perfect for nature lovers and motorcyclists.

name: GRAN Hostel
description: Hi there! We would like to warmly welcome you to our website and later hopefully in our cute and tiny hostel in the center of Banská Bystrica. A modern hostel in Banská Bystrica’s historic center, offering budget-friendly rooms, a social atmosphere, and easy walking access to cafes, museums, and mountain trailheads.

name: Al Corso Pension
description: A cozy pension in Banská Bystrica offering comfortable accommodation with easy access to the Low Tatras and Veľká Fatra mountains, ideal for motorcyclists exploring central Slovak routes. Alcorso Pension is a guest house of modern family type located only a 5-minute walk for the city center. Free WiFi and parking is available.

name: Motorhotel Landgasthof Grevenstein
description: The heart of the Sauerland beats here — at Landgasthof Grevenstein, a cozy biker-friendly inn perfect for riders exploring Germany’s winding roads. Nestled among rolling hills, it offers scenic curves and panoramic views right from the doorstep. Guests enjoy secure bike parking, drying facilities for gear, and a welcoming, rider-oriented atmosphere. After a day in the saddle, relax with a cold German beer and hearty home-cooked meals. Rooms are simple yet comfortable, exuding rustic charm.

name: Hotel Restaurant Schützen
description: In the heart of the Black Forest, Hotel Restaurant Schützen welcomes bikers with the scent of pine and the sound of roaring engines. The roads around are a rider’s dream — sweeping bends, steep descents, and misty valleys. The hotel offers covered parking, gear-drying facilities, and a warm biker-friendly vibe. The restaurant serves classic Baden specialties and freshly brewed beer. After a long day on the road, relax on the terrace overlooking the mountains.

name: Pension Oesterle
description: Set deep in the forests and hills of the Northern Black Forest, Pension Oesterle is a serene biker’s haven where winding country roads meet tranquil nature. Walking through the door, you embark on a journey of curves, pines and fresh air. It offers biker-friendly parking, a relaxed base to prep and unwind before and after the ride. After a day on the saddle you can savour breakfast in a homely, family-run atmosphere, lulled by the nearby stream. The rooms are uncomplicated but comfortable enough for a restful overnight stay on the move.

name: Panorama Sky Bar
description: Cocktails, DJ sets and city views in a glamorous designer lounge with a long black and red bar.

name: Dom Whisky Cocktail Bar
description: Since 2009, the House of Whisky has combined the four pillars of our brand: a B2B and B2C e-commerce platform, exclusive stationary shops with spirits from around the world and professional service, cocktail bars serving classic and proprietary drinks and selected whisky, and Poland's largest whisky festival.

name: WarSaw Pub
description: A lively pub in Warsaw's historic Old Town, known for its wide selection of Polish craft beers, hearty snacks, and vibrant atmosphere in a rustic brick cellar setting.

name: Kraken Rum Bar
description: Cozy bar: serving world cuisine, including seafood and buffet dishes, as well as cocktails, rum and beer.

name: British Bulldog Pub
description: A lively bar with English beers, all-day breakfasts, classic home-cooked food and eight TVs.

name: Zapiecek
description: A warmly decorated restaurant serving traditional Polish pierogi and pancakes.

name: Soul Kitchen
description: A luxury restaurant with a terrace. A regularly updated menu features local meat and fish dishes, pasta, and wine.

name: Restauracja Słoik
description: A casual restaurant serving local cuisine with dumplings, grilled meat, pasta, burgers, and cocktails.

name: Fiorentina
description: A trendy brick-built restaurant with a terrace, the menu features local dishes with a modern twist, desserts, and wine.

name: NOAH
description: NOAH – (Hebrew) rest, peace, delight. Celebrating meals together, sharing what's on one table, is our idea for creating new culinary memories that we want to be a part of. We connect distant culinary cultures – our own and Israel's – and create a place open to all.

name: Pierogarnia Stary Młyn Łódź
description:
Piotrkowska Street is teeming with Łódź's remarkable history – and no one needs convincing. However, the tenement house where our Pierogarnia is located stands out even against such a unique backdrop! Built in the early 20th century in the then-fashionable Art Nouveau style, it stands five stories tall, boasting an impressive façade, heralding the arrival of modernism. It was here that the city's first children's and youth book lending library opened in 1945.

Today, we invite entire families, friends, loved ones, and acquaintances to Pierogarnia to celebrate together, celebrate important moments, laugh, and create memories. At a table laden with ovens and lepiocha, sweet and savory, in a cozy atmosphere or with a large, vibrant group.

So let the magic of Łódź captivate you and the enchanting taste of our pierogi – made according to traditional recipes and always with fresh, local ingredients.

name: Sklep Motocyklowy Motopasja.pl Części i Akcesoria do MOTOCYKLI.
address: Sklep znajduje się w budynku za domem, aleja Jana Pawła II 48
description: Our mission is to provide motorcyclists with a comprehensive range of parts and accessories. Since 2006, we have been constantly expanding our product range to meet the needs of motorcyclists. As the largest motorcycle shop in our area, we ensure high availability of our parts. Our advantage is a personalized approach to each customer. We have always been motorcycle riders ourselves, which translates into a better understanding of your needs.

name: Motoszklarnia - Sklep motocyklowy & quady | Części i akcesoria | Serwis | Wypożyczalnia motocykli
description:
WELCOME TO THE MOTOR GREENHOUSE
Before we go any further, we want to welcome you to the Motoszklarnia multi-salon, although nothing can replace the on-site experience.
Thank you for taking the time to visit our website. Our goal is to provide you with an interactive experience exploring our new and used inventory, as well as a convenient way to request a quote, schedule a service appointment, or apply for financing.

name: Liberty MotoStore Warszawa - Odzież i akcesoria motocyklowe
description: Liberty MotoStore is a network of brick-and-mortar motorcycle stores in Poland, as well as a thriving online store. Our priority is to create an attractive space for motorcyclists, where everyone can find something for themselves – regardless of riding style or budget.

name: Bikestar.pl - Shop Motorcycle Warsaw
description:
Bikestar is a place created for professionals, enthusiasts, and those just starting their motorcycle adventure. We offer reliable parts from the best manufacturers at the most attractive prices. Here you'll find everything you need for safe and enjoyable riding – helmets, motorcycle clothing, tires, and numerous accessories that will make your ride unique. We're constantly expanding our selection of motorcycle parts and accessories to provide you with a wide and diverse selection.

The Bikestar store was created by a group of enthusiasts who, drawing on their own experience, offer essential products for every two-wheeler enthusiast. We know how important it is that the equipment we buy is of the highest quality and at an affordable price. Explore our selection today. Tires, helmets, parts, and other products are sure to satisfy even the most demanding customers.

name: ARIMOT
