description: Arimot, a motorcycle and scooter parts store with over 66 years of experience in selling vintage motorcycle parts, is one of the most renowned in Warsaw. We sell motorcycle and moped parts, specializing in vintage motorcycles, mopeds, and scooters . We also offer services essential for restoring classic vehicles to their former glory. You'll find us in the same location for years – in Warsaw's Praga Północ district.

name: Gartenhotel Fettehenne
description: Gartenhotel Fettehenne lies near Düsseldorf and makes a perfect stop for motorcycle travelers, offering quick access to scenic local routes. After a long day on the road, unwind in the indoor pool, sauna, or relax in the hotel’s peaceful garden. The on-site restaurant Das Blaue Schaf serves modern German dishes and signature cocktails. Surrounded by greenery and with easy motorway access, it’s a great base for exploring the Neanderland and Bergisches Land regions. Riders will appreciate the free parking, EV charging for electric bikes, Wi-Fi, and air-conditioned rooms. The garden-inspired design and calm atmosphere set the mood for rest and recharge before the next ride.

name: BFG racing Poland
description: A motorcycle service and performance workshop specializing in track preparation, ECU tuning, and suspension setup for sport bikes and adventure touring models.

name: Land-Hotel Neuhof, Bayern (Bayerischer Wald)
description: Landhotel Neuhof sits on the edge of the forest in the scenic Southern Bavarian Forest — a true gem for motorcycle travelers. Winding forest roads start right outside the door, offering perfect curves and sweeping views for a day’s ride. The family-run hotel welcomes bikers with covered parking, a friendly atmosphere, and insider route tips from the hosts. After a long day, unwind in the indoor pool or infrared sauna with views over the forested hills. The restaurant serves hearty Bavarian dishes made from fresh, local ingredients — the perfect way to end the evening. An ideal base for exploring Germany, Austria, and the Czech Republic, combining comfort, charm, and biker spirit.

name: Moto Muppet - Serwis, naprawa, zimowanie motocykli i transport Warszawa
address: teren klubu sportowego Spójnia, Wybrzeże Gdyńskie 2
description: Motorcycles are our everyday life and passion. For over 10 years, we've been ensuring that Warsaw motorcyclists can ride safely and buy reliable machines.

name: ISM Serwis - Aprilia|BSA|Royal Enfield|Peugeot|MV Agusta|Moto Guzzi|Kymco.Sklep online, importer części OEM
description: Professional workshop, accepting motorcycles and scooters, Italian and Japanese.

name: PWM Pomeranian Rental Motorcycles
description: Motorcycle rental service in the Pomeranian region offering touring and adventure bikes for exploring the Baltic coast, Kashubian lakes, and historic sites like Malbork Castle.

name: Rental bikes and scooters www.rent-a-motor.pl
description: A convenient motorcycle and scooter rental service in Warsaw, offering a range of models from city scooters to touring bikes, with flexible rental periods and delivery options.

name: Hotel Hanauerhof
description: Hotel Hanauerhof lies at the edge of forests and vineyards in the Ortenau region - a perfect base for riders seeking winding roads and scenic landscapes. The hotel offers a secure garage for motorcycles, making it especially biker-friendly. After a long ride, relax in the cozy restaurant or enjoy a crafted cocktail in the stylish wine cellar bar. Rooms are bright, modern, and designed for rest after an active day - with Wi-Fi, comfortable beds, and a clean, airy feel. Its location is excellent: close to the motorway, train station, and the French border - ideal for tours through the Black Forest and Alsace. And for food lovers, the kitchen serves authentic Baden dishes paired with local wines.

name: Wynajmij125.pl | Wypożyczalnia motocykli 125cm3
description: A specialized 125cc motorcycle rental service in Warsaw, perfect for riders with standard car licenses exploring the city and surrounding Mazovian countryside.

name: Konieczny Seriws Motocyklowy
description:
Motoexpert is a professional motorcycle service , providing services in the field of motorcycle repair, periodic inspection, optical and mechanical tuning, as well as advice and assistance in purchasing a motorcycle .

We provide comprehensive motorcycle servicing for all brands, including accident repairs. In our workshop, motorcycle repairs are performed using specialized tools. You can count on expert advice, suggestions, and feedback from a motorcycle mechanic. We offer transportation of the motorcycle to the service center and back to the customer after the repair.

Our motorcycle workshop also provides a 24-hour Motopomoc service , which guarantees professional service, safe transport of the motorcycle, and the possibility of providing a replacement motorcycle.

Motoexpert also offers motorcycle rentals . Our rental equipment is roadworthy, insured, and road-ready. You can winterize and store your motorcycle with us , and you can also have it repaired and prepared for the season. We also provide professional training and riding technique improvement services.

We strive to thoroughly analyze all of our clients' needs to meet their expectations. We approach each client honestly and diligently . We strive to build strong, long-lasting relationships because we know that trust and satisfaction are built over time.

name: Rentmoto.pl Wypozyczalnia Motocykli
description: A professional motorcycle rental service in central Warsaw offering a diverse fleet of touring, sport, and cruiser models for exploring Poland's scenic routes.

name: St. Florian's Gate
description: Medieval Gothic gate tower dating from the 14th century & adjoining the city's fortified walls.

name: Grunwald Monument
description: Statue of King Władysław Jagiełło on a granite plinth, commemorating the Battle of Grunwald in 1410.

name: Muzeum Ziemi Tarnowskiej (dawniej Muzeum Okręgowe w Tarnowie)
description: Museum tracing Tarnów's heritage with fine art exhibits, ethnographic displays & ancient artifacts.

name: Seehotel am Stausee
description: The Seehotel am Stausee, located at Am Stausee 2, 54568 Gerolstein, Germany, lies in the picturesque Eifel region. It’s a perfect base for bikers looking to explore the winding roads and volcanic hills of the area. The hotel offers secure motorcycle parking, route tips, and a cozy place to relax after a long ride. The surroundings are filled with scenic serpentine roads passing through forests and along lakes, ideal for two-wheel adventures. After a thrilling day, guests can unwind in the spa area with sauna and pool while enjoying the tranquil view of the reservoir.

name: Naturhotel Gasthof Bärenfels
description: The hotel features comfortable rooms, a restaurant serving regional cuisine, and a tranquil atmosphere, ideal for relaxing after a day on the bike. For bikers, it offers the advantage of suitable parking and easy access to scenic mountain routes that meander through valleys and forested hills. In the surrounding area, you’ll find winding roads with stunning views and traditional cafés where you can stop and enjoy the local charm. Staying here gives you the best of both worlds: the thrill of the ride and the comfort of a well-equipped base to rest and prepare for the next stage.

name: Best Western Hotel Am Straßberger Tor
description: Best Western Hotel Am Strassberger Tor is located in the heart of Plauen in the Vogtland region of Saxony and makes an excellent base for biker routes through the surrounding scenic countryside. This modern 4-star hotel features comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, a sauna, and a Mediterranean-style restaurant - a great place to unwind after a long ride. Motorcyclists will appreciate the convenient parking and easy access to winding roads popular among riders in the Vogtland area. After a day on the saddle, you can relax in the sauna or book a massage - perfect for recharging before the next leg of your journey. With its central location in Plauen and proximity to the A72 motorway, the hotel is ideal as a one- or two-night stopover during a biker tour.

name: Hotel Schloss Montabaur
description: Hotel Schloss Montabaur sits atop a hill in the Westerwald region and serves as an excellent base for a biker’s trip, surrounded by scenic forests and winding roads. The hotel offers biker-friendly amenities such as mountain and e-bike rental, route information, and the freedom to explore the area on two wheels. After a ride, guests can unwind in the spa complex with a sauna, indoor pool, and massage treatments — a great way to recover. Modern rooms, spacious parking, and easy motorway access make it a convenient stop for long-distance touring. After breakfast, you can set out on one of the many Westerwald routes, enjoying the thrill of the ride and the beauty of nature.

name: Victor's Residenz-Hotel Gummersbach
description: Victor’s Residenz-Hotel Gummersbach is located in the heart of the Bergisches Land region, in the town of Gummersbach, making it an ideal starting point for biker routes through forests, lakes, and scenic valleys. The hotel offers comfortable rooms, free high-speed WiFi, and spacious parking - all the essentials for a rider after a long day on the road. Motorcyclists will enjoy the hotel’s proximity to the region’s winding roads, perfect for rides surrounded by nature and charming villages. After your journey, you can unwind in the hotel’s restaurant or bar, taste regional cuisine, and relax for the evening. With its great location and reliable infrastructure, the hotel serves perfectly as a one- or two-night base for a motorcycle tour through North Rhine-Westphalia.

name: Hotel Derichsweiler Hof
description: This family-run hotel is located in the Oberbergisches Land region in Nümbrecht, surrounded by forests and scenic roads - perfect for a motorbike journey. At the hotel you’ll find comfortable rooms, free parking and high-speed WiFi - all essentials after a long day in the saddle. The area is ideal for riding winding roads amidst nature, with chances to stop in charming villages. After a ride you can unwind in the sauna or on the terrace overlooking the park and pond - a great way to finish your tour. Thanks to its convenient location and welcoming atmosphere, the hotel makes an excellent base for one or two nights during a biker’s trip.

name: Weinhotel des Riesling "Zum grünen Kranz"
description: This charming wine hotel is located in the historic centre of Rüdesheim am Rhein, just steps from the Rhine riverfront and the famous Drosselgasse lane - a perfect stop for a motorbike tour through the Rhine wine region. The hotel offers comfortable rooms with free Wi-Fi, a buffet breakfast and its own wine garden where you can sample wines from the family vineyard - a pleasant bonus after a day on two wheels. For bikers key features include parking and storage for gear, plus easy access to winding scenic roads of the wine region that offer stunning valley and river views. After your ride you can unwind in the hotel’s wine bar-restaurant, enjoy regional cuisine and a glass of Riesling — the ideal way to relax before your next leg. Thanks to its location, atmosphere and amenities, the hotel makes an excellent base for a one- or two-night stay during a motorbike journey through Hesse and the Rhine wine region.

name: Restaurant Bar Premier
description:
Welcome to Premier Bar – A Haven for Travelers and Bikers!
Located right by the sea, Premier Bar is where the aroma of fresh food meets the sound of the waves. Every guest is welcomed with heart, and bikers are especially invited to take a break, refresh, and enjoy a warm, friendly atmosphere.

Our kitchen blends the finest local specialties with creative modern flavors, all prepared with passion and care. Whether you’re craving a light bite or a hearty meal after a ride, you’ll find it here.

With a warm welcome, smiles, and a place where stories are shared like on the open road, Premier Bar is a destination where journeys turn into experiences, and meals into true joy.

For bikers. For sea lovers. For the soul.

name: Hotel Restaurant Seebode
description: Hotel Restaurant Seebode is located in the scenic Frauenberg area of Ebsdorfergrund, Hesse, surrounded by rolling hills and peaceful countryside - an ideal stop for motorcycle tours. The hotel provides free parking and secure storage for bikes, making it especially convenient for riders. A hearty breakfast buffet, a cozy restaurant serving local dishes, and a welcoming atmosphere help guests relax after a day on the road. From the hotel, you can head out onto winding forest roads across Hesse, offering both excitement and beautiful views. After a long ride, the spacious rooms and tranquil surroundings make it a perfect base for one or two nights on your motorbike journey.

name: Hotel Goldflair am Rathaus
description: Hotel Goldflair am Rathaus is located in the heart of Korbach, Hesse, right across from the town hall — a convenient stop for motorbike travelers. The hotel offers free parking and a special biker area, making it particularly suitable for riders exploring the region. The interior design follows a “gold” theme, reflecting the town’s gold mining history and adding a unique touch to the rooms and restaurant. After a day in the saddle, guests can unwind in the hotel sauna or enjoy a meal of traditional regional dishes. It’s an ideal base for a one- or two-night stop during a motorbike tour through the Waldeck region, combining comfort, atmosphere, and a prime location.

name: Hotel Restaurant Sauerländer Hof Willingen
description: Hotel Restaurant Sauerländer Hof is located in the town of Willingen-Upland, in the heart of the Sauerland region - a perfect base for motorcycle tours along winding roads through hills and forests. The hotel provides a full biker service: covered parking, washing area, drying room for gear, a small workshop corner, and pre-planned routes. In the morning you can ride through the scenic roads of the region, and in the evening relax on the hotel terrace or enjoy traditional regional cuisine. The hotel is close to the town centre, making it easy to combine your ride with a pleasant evening walk. Altogether, it’s an ideal one- or two-night stop during a motorbike tour through Sauerland - convenient, comfortable, and designed with riders in mind.

name: Leonardo Hotel Hamburg Elbbrücken
description: Leonardo Hotel Hamburg Elbbrücken is located in Hamburg’s Veddel district and serves as a convenient base for bikers, being close to both the A255 motorway and the city centre. Motorcyclists will appreciate the secure parking and safe facilities for their bikes. After a ride, guests can relax in the sauna, enjoy a meal or a drink at the restaurant and bar, and rest in spacious, modern rooms. The hotel’s location makes it easy to explore Hamburg or take a short city walk. It’s an excellent choice for a one- or two-night stopover - comfortable, modern, and designed with bikers in mind.

name: Hotel Motel One Hamburg Am Michel
description: Motel One Hamburg Am Michel is located in the heart of Hamburg, close to the Schanzenviertel district and the Landungsbrücken piers - a perfect stop for bikers on an urban ride. A major advantage for motorcyclists is the underground garage with secure paid parking, offering a safe place to leave your bike. After a long day, you can relax in a modern air-conditioned room, enjoy free Wi-Fi, and unwind in the stylish hotel lounge bar. The location is ideal for a short overnight stay between routes, combining a city walk with your motorcycle journey. It’s a great choice for one- or two-night stays, offering comfort, convenience, and biker-friendly facilities right in the city center.

name: Mercure Hannover Oldenburger Allee
description: Our 4-star Mercure Hannover Oldenburger Allee hotel is located near the Hannover-Buchholz motorway and Hannover Airport. Relax over dinner in the LeJardin restaurant or the FAIRLight bar. We offer 8 conference rooms for up to 450 people, as well as a complimentary gym. A private car park with 119 spaces (including 40 garage spaces) is located adjacent to the hotel.

name: Mercure Hotel Am Entenfang Hannover
description: Mercure Hotel Am Entenfang Hannover is located in the quiet, green Stöcken district northwest of Hanover, making it a convenient stopover for bikers traveling through Lower Saxony. Guests can use free outdoor parking or a paid underground garage with charging stations — ideal for motorcycles and extra gear. The rooms feature air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and flat-screen TVs, providing a comfortable rest after a long day on the road. The hotel’s proximity to the A2 motorway allows easy access for continuing your ride without detours. With its blend of modern facilities and peaceful surroundings, it’s an excellent base for a one- or two-night stay during a motorcycle tour.

name: Hotel AMANO Grand Central
description: Hotel AMANO Grand Central is located at Heidestraße 62, 10557 Berlin, right next to the main train station - a convenient stop for bikers traveling across Germany. With its central location, it’s perfect for a short stay in the capital during a motorcycle trip. A key advantage for riders is the underground parking garage, providing a safe place to park your bike overnight. After a long day on the road, you can relax in the modern lounge, on the rooftop terrace with city views, or at the hotel’s stylish bar. Comfortable rooms and an excellent location make it a great choice for a one- or two-night stay in the heart of Berlin.

name: Scandic Berlin Potsdamer Platz
description: Scandic Berlin Potsdamer Platz is located at Gabriele-Tergit-Promenade 19, 10963 Berlin - right in the heart of the city, near Potsdamer Platz and major attractions. It’s a great stop for bikers looking to combine a city visit with a comfortable rest along their journey. The hotel offers secure underground parking, providing a safe spot to leave your motorcycle overnight. After a day on the road, guests can unwind in the restaurant, bar, or fitness area. With modern rooms and a prime central location, this hotel is an excellent base for a one- or two-night stay in Berlin.

name: Hollywood Media Hotel Berlin
description: Hollywood Media Hotel Berlin is located at Kurfürstendamm 202, 10719 Berlin - right on one of the city’s most famous streets, in the heart of West Berlin. This cinema-themed hotel is perfect for bikers who want to combine an active road trip with the vibrant atmosphere of the capital. The hotel offers its own underground parking, providing a secure spot to park your motorcycle overnight. After a long day on the road, guests can unwind in the sauna, fitness area, or hotel bar. With its great location, comfort, and secure parking, it’s an ideal stop for a one- or two-night stay during a motorcycle tour through Berlin.

name: MK Familija — Zimska Žurka
description: Join the winter party of MK Familija on 6 December 2025 in Podgorica at Gradski Pub - a biker-friendly night full of engines, laughter and good vibes. Expect fellow riders, cold drinks, music and the electric atmosphere only a two-wheel community can bring. Whether you roll in solo or with your crew, grab the chance to connect with local bikers and share stories around the bike. Petrol in the tank - and enthusiasm in your heart.

name: Hotel Alt-Connewitz
description: Hotel Alt-Connewitz, located at Meusdorfer Str. 47a, 04277 Leipzig, makes a smart choice for a biker stop, thanks to its convenient parking and relaxed surroundings. The hotel provides free on-site parking and facilities for securely storing your bike overnight - a key feature for motorcyclists. After a full day of riding you can unwind in the sauna or relax in the hotel’s garden before your next route. Its location in the southern district of Leipzig gives you easy access to scenic roads in Saxony while avoiding heavy city traffic. With modern rooms, a friendly atmosphere and biker-friendly amenities, the hotel serves as an excellent one- or two-night stopover during your motorcycle tour.

name: Capri by Fraser Leipzig
description: The Capri by Fraser Leipzig is centrally located in Leipzig, making it a smart stopover for bikers looking to combine urban exploration with their motorcycle journey. The hotel offers secure underground and gated parking, albeit limited in availability and priced around €22 per day - a key feature for riders. After a long day on the road you can unwind in a comfortable room and enjoy hotel amenities such as free Wi-Fi and contemporary design. Its proximity to the train station and major city attractions means you can easily mix your ride with a short walk around Leipzig. Overall, it’s an excellent one- or two-night base for a motorcycle tour: combining comfort, convenience and biker-friendly parking.

name: Gradski Pab
description: Located in the heart of Podgorica, Gradski Pab offers a relaxed and welcoming setting ideal for a drink after the road. With a wide selection of beers on tap and a simple, comfortable pub interior, it’s a spot where motor-tourers can unwind, park nearby and enjoy local atmosphere. Friendly staff and central location near the city centre make it a convenient meeting point before or after a ride. Whether you’re topping up with a cold pint or catching up with friends, Gradski Pab gives you a genuine Montenegrin pub experience.

name: Suite Hotel Leipzig
description: Suite Hotel Leipzig is located at Permoserstraße 50, 04328 Leipzig, Germany, in a peaceful green district east of the city centre. The hotel is ideal for bikers touring Saxony, offering free on-site parking and a safe place to park your motorcycle. Spacious rooms with a kitchenette and balcony provide a comfortable retreat after a long day on the road. Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast in the morning and easily reach scenic routes leading out of the city. With its quiet location, convenient parking, and homely atmosphere, this hotel is a perfect one- or two-night stop during a motorcycle trip.

name: Hotel NH Collection Dresden Altmarkt
description: The NH Collection Dresden Altmarkt is located on Altmarkt Square in the historic centre of Dresden, making it a convenient stop-over for bikers looking to blend their tour with city exploration. The hotel offers underground on-site parking, priced at around €28 per day, providing a secure place to park your motorcycle. After a day on the road you can relax in the sauna or rain-shower, and take a stroll through the old town to enjoy the city atmosphere. With modern rooms offering city views and a prime location, it’s a fantastic spot to unwind before the next leg of your journey.

name: Victor's Residenz-Hotel Erfurt
description: Victor’s Residenz-Hotel Erfurt, located at Häßlerstraße 17, 99096 Erfurt, Germany, is a great stopover for motorcycle tours, thanks to its convenient location. The hotel offers underground garage parking with around 56 to 58 spaces, providing a secure place to park your bike or vehicle overnight. Situated in the southern part of the city and close to the A4 motorway, it seamlessly fits into your route across Thuringia. After a day in the saddle, guests can unwind in spacious rooms and enjoy free Wi-Fi and the hotel bar. It’s an excellent choice for a one- or two-night stay during a motorcycle tour: comfortable lodging, handy parking, and smart location.

name: Dorint Hotel am Dom Erfurt
description: Dorint Hotel am Dom Erfurt is located in the heart of Erfurt at Theaterplatz 2, right next to the cathedral - a convenient stop for bikers traveling through Thuringia. The hotel features an underground garage providing secure parking for motorcycles. After a long ride, guests can relax in modern rooms, enjoy free Wi-Fi, and unwind in the hotel’s bar or restaurant. Thanks to its central location, it’s easy to take a walk through the old town and experience the city’s charm.

name: Grand Hotel Plovdiv
description: Grand Hotel Plovdiv is an elegant riverside hotel in Plovdiv’s Kapana district, a cultural hub for bikers exploring Thracian ruins or Rhodope trails. 15 km from the airport, with E80 access for coastal or mountain routes. On-site the hotel has a secure courtyard parking ideal for motorcycles. After your ride, soak in rooms with Maritsa River views, and in the evening wander Kapana’s street art and craft beer bars.

name: Best Western Premier Plovdiv Hills
description: Best Western Premier Plovdiv Hills is a contemporary hilltop hotel overlooking Plovdiv, a relaxed choice for bikers needing elevation and easy E80 access to Stara Planina. 15 km from the airport, with panoramic city views. On-site the hotel offers open-air parking with CCTV for motorcycles. After your ride, unwind in bright rooms with balcony access, and in the evening fire up the BBQ terrace or drive down to the old town.

name: Hotel Royal Bath
description: Royal Bath Hotel is a cozy spa retreat in Hisarya’s thermal spring area, a healing stop for bikers riding E80 between Plovdiv and Rhodope. 40 km from Plovdiv airport, surrounded by Roman ruins. On-site the hotel has a small guarded lot for motorcycles. After your ride, soak in mineral-rich rooms, and in the evening stroll to ancient amphitheater ruins or sip herbal tea by the springs.

name: Empire Balneo & Spa Hotel
description: Hotel Empire Balneo & SPA is a wellness-focused resort in Hisarya’s park zone, a recovery base for bikers tackling E80 to Roman tombs or Balkan loops. 40 km from Plovdiv airport, with indoor thermal pools. On-site the hotel provides covered parking for motorcycles. After your ride, recover in spa suites with private balconies, and in the evening enjoy a sauna session or light dinner by the pool.

name: Camping Verila Bungalows
description: Camping Verila Bungalows is a rustic mountain camp in Rila’s foothills near Sapareva Banya, a raw base for bikers staging I-6 rides to Seven Rila Lakes. 100 km from Sofia airport, surrounded by pine forests. On-site the campground has open gravel parking for motorcycles. After your ride, bunk in wooden bungalows with fireplaces, and in the evening gather around the campfire or hike to Goritsa Waterfall.

name: Nomado Hostel
description: Nomado Hostel is a restored 19th-century house turned creative hub in Varna, a laid-back spot for bikers mapping E87 coastal dunes. 10 km from the airport, in the historic quarter. On-site the hostel offers street-side parking with chains for motorcycles. After your ride, chill in artsy dorms with hammocks, and in the evening sketch in the garden or hit local street food.

name: Camping Laguna & Villas Resort
description: Camping Laguna is a campground in Laguna Mountains, 100 km from San Diego (USA), but in Bulgarian context — a wild spot by the lake. In the forest, convenient for I-8 rides to San Diego. They’ll suggest mountain trails — from meadows to Pacific Crest Trail. Staff friendly. Combo with Laguna Meadow Trail (~0.5 km walk) or Big Laguna Lake (~1 km route).

name: Cosmos Campsite / Campsite Durankulak
description: Campsite Durankulak is a wild beachfront site near the Romanian border, a rugged outpost for bikers chasing E87’s northern Black Sea dunes. 100 km from Varna, by a lagoon. On-site the campsite has sandy parking for motorcycles. After your ride, pitch a tent with sea sounds, and in the evening watch sunset over the reeds or share stories by the fire.

name: Hotel Bulgaria Burgas
description: Hotel Bulgaria Burgas is a no-nonsense 4-star tower in Burgas center, a reliable hub for bikers prepping E87 to Sunny Beach or Nessebar. 5 km from the airport, by Sea Garden. On-site the hotel has a multi-level garage with motorcycle section. After your ride, settle in functional rooms with sea glimpses, and in the evening walk the promenade or try fresh fish at a harbor tavern.

name: Primoretz Grand Hotel & Spa
description: Grand Hotel & SPA Primoretz is a beachfront 5-star resort in Burgas, a pampering reward for bikers finishing E87 coastal marathons. 10 km from the airport, inside Sea Garden. On-site the hotel offers valet parking with covered motorcycle spots. After your ride, indulge in sea-view suites and spa treatments, and in the evening dine al fresco by the waves or sip wine on the terrace.

name: DAS Marina Burgas Hotel
description: DAS Marina Burgas Hotel is a compact boutique on Burgas promenade, a nautical pit stop for bikers cruising E87 to Sunny Beach. 10 km from the airport, by the port. On-site the hotel has street-level parking with motorcycle covers. After your ride, chill in harbor-view rooms with yacht vibes, and in the evening watch boats or grab seafood on the pier.

name: Grand Hotel Riga
description: Grand Hotel Riga is a Soviet-era riverside giant in Ruse, a nostalgic base for bikers crossing E85 to Bucharest. 200 km from Sofia airport, on the Danube. On-site the hotel has a vast open lot for motorcycles. After your ride, check into retro rooms with river views, and in the evening walk the Danube embankment or try shopska salad at a communist-style diner.

name: Best Western Bistra & Galina
description: Best Western Bistra & Galina is a family-run hotel in Ruse’s pedestrian old town, a homely stop for bikers exploring E85 Danube forts. 200 km from Sofia airport, near craft shops. On-site the hotel offers a small locked garage for motorcycles. After your ride, relax in warm rooms with local art, and in the evening browse handmade souvenirs or sip coffee on the square.

name: Hotel Sentido Bellevue Beach
description: Hotel Sentido Bellevue Beach is an all-inclusive beachfront resort in Sunny Beach, a party recovery zone for bikers finishing E87 coastal sprints. 30 km from Burgas airport, on the sand. On-site the hotel has guarded parking with motorcycle shade. After your ride, crash in seafront rooms with buffet access, and in the evening join beach parties or foam events under the stars.

name: Dunav Plaza Hotel
description: Dunav Plaza Hotel is a central high-rise on Ruse’s Svoboda Square, a convenient hub for bikers plotting E85 to Belgrade or the delta. 200 km from Sofia airport, in the market buzz. On-site the hotel has underground parking with motorcycle lift access. After your ride, settle in square-view rooms, and in the evening watch street performers or try local banitsa from vendors.

name: MotoCamp Bulgaria
description: MotoCamp Bulgaria is a biker-only camp in the Balkan Mountains near Idilevo, a hardcore base for riders tackling off-road loops to Veliko Tarnovo. 200 km from Sofia airport, in the wilderness. On-site the camp has gravel parking and chain posts for motorcycles. After your ride, bunk in shared cabins with fire pits, and in the evening swap stories over grilled meats and rakia by the bonfire.

name: Yantra Grand Hotel
description: The Yantra Grand Hotel is a 4-star landmark on Veliko Tarnovo’s cliff, a dramatic perch for bikers conquering E85 Balkan passes. 200 km from Sofia airport, above Yantra River. On-site the hotel has terraced parking with motorcycle covers. After your ride, indulge in panoramic rooms, and in the evening dine with fortress views or explore Trapezitsa by night.

name: Prague Castle
description: Prague Castle, the largest medieval castle in the world, founded in the 9th century, is the heart of Czech history. Its hilltop location above the Vltava River offers stunning views, perfect for motorbike travelers. The roads around Prague provide smooth access and parking options for bikers. The castle is surrounded by cobbled streets and gardens, adding charm to the ride. It’s an ideal starting point for motorbike tours across Bohemia.

name: Charles Bridge
description: Charles Bridge, a 14th-century Gothic masterpiece, spans the Vltava River in Prague. Its 30 statues and panoramic views make it a must-stop for motorbike travelers. The roads along the embankment offer easy access, with parking nearby. The bridge is surrounded by Prague’s historic center, perfect for a break to soak in the atmosphere. It’s an ideal spot for short urban motorbike rides.

name: Karlštejn Castle
description: Karlštejn Castle, built in the 14th century, is a Gothic gem located 30 km from Prague. The road to the castle through the Berounka Valley features winding stretches beloved by bikers. Surrounded by forests, the castle offers scenic views and parking facilities. It’s a popular destination for day trips from Prague by motorbike. The historical ambiance makes the stop unforgettable.

name: Hotel Monopol
description: Hotel Monopol is a charming boutique hotel right in the heart of Frankfurt, just a one-minute walk from the central train station. It occupies a historic building and makes a superb base for travelers on bikes — there’s easy access and good visibility from the street. The hotel offers an on-site parking garage located just next door at Mannheimer Str. 9. You can securely park your bike or motorcycle and then set out to explore the riverside views along the Main or the city’s streets. The staff are very helpful with local route tips and sightseeing guidance — ideal for solo riders or biking couples.

name: b'mine Frankfurt Airport
description: The b'mine Frankfurt Airport is a stylish 4-star hotel located directly at Frankfurt Airport (Terminal 2), making it an excellent option for motorbike travellers. The hotel features an underground garage with parking rates around €3.50 per hour or approximately €25 for a full day. With its easy access from the A3 and A5 highways and direct proximity to airport transit, you can park your bike quickly and get on the road with minimal hassle. The rooms are equipped to accommodate luggage and riding gear, and the location makes an early morning departure effortless. The multilingual front-desk staff are ready to assist with route recommendations or logistical support.

name: Maritim Hotel Stuttgart
description: Maritim Hotel Stuttgart is an elegant 4-star hotel conveniently located in the city center of Stuttgart, next to the Liederhalle concert hall and beautiful park grounds. It’s a great choice for bikers exploring the Swabian region, with easy access from the city’s main roads. The hotel offers a spacious underground parking garage where motorcycles can be safely stored; the daily rate is around €25. Guests can unwind in the wellness area with a pool and sauna or take a short walk to nearby cafés and attractions. The friendly staff are always ready to provide route tips and make every rider’s stay smooth and enjoyable.

name: Park Inn by Radisson Stuttgart
description: Park Inn by Radisson Stuttgart is a modern 4-star hotel located near the city center in the charming Marienplatz district. With easy access from the main roads and highways, it’s a perfect stop for bikers exploring southern Germany. The hotel offers a secure underground parking garage where motorcycles can be safely stored. After a long ride, guests can unwind in the sauna, fitness area, or enjoy the panoramic terrace overlooking the city. The friendly staff are always happy to provide route suggestions and tips for great local sights and dining spots.

name: Český Krumlov
description: Český Krumlov, a medieval town on a bend of the Vltava River, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its narrow streets and castle create a unique atmosphere for motorbike travelers. The roads of South Bohemia leading to the town are filled with smooth curves and hilltop views. Parking is available near the center, convenient for bikers. It’s a perfect stop for motorbike tours in southern Czechia.

name: Kutná Hora
description: Kutná Hora, a historic town known for its silver mines and Sedlec Ossuary, is a UNESCO site. The road from Prague passes through scenic fields, ideal for relaxed riding. The Gothic St. Barbara’s Cathedral and narrow streets attract bikers seeking history. Parking areas are convenient for stops and exploration. It’s a great point for a motorbike route through Central Bohemia.

name: Lednice Castle
description: Lednice Castle, a neo-Gothic palace in the Moravian park complex, is a UNESCO site. The roads of Moravia, lined with vineyards and hills, are perfect for long motorbike rides. The castle is surrounded by gardens where bikers can relax after riding. Spacious parking areas are convenient for motorcycles. It attracts those who love history and scenic routes.

name: Zacharias of Hradec Square
description: Telč, a Renaissance town with colorful houses and a castle, is a UNESCO site. Its location in South Bohemia makes it part of scenic motorbike routes with winding roads. The roads around the town offer views of ponds and forests, perfect for bikers. Parking is available near the historic center. It’s a spot for those who appreciate beauty and relaxed rides.

name: Vyšehrad
description: Vyšehrad, an ancient fortress in Prague, offers stunning views of the Vltava River and city skyline. The roads along the river provide easy access for bikers who enjoy urban routes. The fortress is surrounded by a park, perfect for a stop to take in the views. Its historic walls and basilica add charm to the site. It’s an ideal spot for short motorbike rides in Prague.

name: Kostel sv. Mořice
description: Olomouc, a Baroque city in Moravia, is home to the Holy Trinity Column, a UNESCO site. The roads to the city wind through hills, offering bikers exciting routes. The historic center with cathedrals and squares is perfect for stops. Parking is convenient for motorcycles, and local cafés add a cozy touch. It’s a great destination for motorbike tours in eastern Czechia.

name: Hotel Central
description: The Hotel Central is a small boutique in Veliko Tarnovo’s craft quarter, a charming base for bikers wandering E85 to Arbanasi. 200 km from Sofia airport, near Samovodska Charshiya. On-site the hotel has a nearby locked lot for motorcycles. After your ride, relax in rustic rooms with handmade textiles, and in the evening browse pottery workshops or sip coffee in the market.

name: Hostel Mostel
description: Hostel Mostel is a legendary backpacker lodge in Veliko Tarnovo’s old town, a social hub for bikers climbing E85 to Tsarevets Fortress. 200 km from Sofia airport, in medieval streets. On-site the hostel has a courtyard with bike racks for motorcycles. After your ride, crash in stone-walled dorms, and in the evening join free walking tours or rakia tastings.

name: Park Hotel Stara Zagora
description: Park Hotel Stara Zagora is a green oasis by Zagorka Lake, a tranquil stop for bikers on E80 to Rhodope or Thracian tombs. 150 km from Plovdiv airport, in a park setting. On-site the hotel has open parking under trees for motorcycles. After your ride, relax in lake-view rooms, and in the evening jog the park paths or dine al fresco by the water.

name: Best Boutique Hotel
description: BEST BOUTIQUE HOTEL is a chic urban retreat in Stara Zagora center, a stylish pause for bikers cruising E80 to wine valleys. 150 km from Plovdiv airport, near galleries. On-site the hotel has a small valet garage for motorcycles. After your ride, unwind in designer rooms with local wine minibars, and in the evening visit art exhibitions or taste rose valley vintages.

name: Hotel Trayana
description: Hotel Trayana is a modest family hotel near Stara Zagora’s art gallery, a budget-friendly base for bikers exploring E80 to Rhodope. 150 km from Plovdiv airport, in a quiet quarter. On-site the hotel has street parking with security for motorcycles. After your ride, rest in simple rooms with home-cooked breakfast, and in the evening walk to the gallery or local mehana.

name: Dorm BG
description: Dorm.bg Art Hotel is a creative hybrid of hostel and gallery in Stara Zagora, an inspiring stop for bikers on E80 seeking Thracian culture. 150 km from Plovdiv airport, by Mall Galleria. On-site the hotel has nearby paid parking with motorcycle slots. After your ride, sleep in mural-painted dorms, and in the evening join art workshops or street murals tour.

name: Holiday Inn Munich - City Centre, an IHG Hotel
description: Holiday Inn Munich – City Centre is an excellent choice for bikers traveling through Bavaria. The hotel is located in the Haidhausen district, close to Rosenheimer Platz station, offering easy access both by motorcycle and public transport. Guests can use the underground parking garage directly at the hotel to safely store their bikes. The rooms offer everything needed for a comfortable rest after a long ride, with cafés, shops, and the scenic Isar riverside nearby. The friendly staff are always ready to provide route tips and make every biker’s stay enjoyable and relaxed.

name: Maritim Hotel München
description: The Maritim Hotel München is a superb stopover for bikers touring Bavaria: centrally located in Munich, just a short walk from the main train station. Guests have access to a public underground garage with 255 parking spaces, providing secure parking for motorcycles. The hotel offers convenient access from the major city roads, making it an ideal base for motorbike travellers. After a ride, you can unwind in the wellness area or stroll through the nearby cafés and shops in the vibrant city centre. The hotel staff are ready to assist with route tips and logistics, ensuring a smooth and comfortable stay for riders.

name: Hotel Spiegel
description: Hotel Spiegel is a cozy hotel located at Hermann-Löns-Straße 122, 51147 Cologne, close to Cologne/Bonn Airport. The hotel offers on-site parking, providing a safe place to leave your motorcycle. Guests can enjoy comfortable rooms, a beautiful garden, and a restaurant with a terrace. The friendly staff are always ready to offer route suggestions and tips for exploring the Cologne area.

name: V8 Hotel Köln at MOTORWORLD
description: V8 Hotel Köln @ MOTORWORLD is a perfect choice for biker-enthusiasts: the hotel is located right within the MOTORWORLD Köln | Rheinland complex on the site of the former Butzweilerhof airport. Easy access from the A1 and A57 highways makes it a convenient base for motorcycle tours in the region. On-site you’ll find a secure parking lot where you can safely leave your bike. After your ride you can unwind in the themed rooms that pay homage to automotive culture and take a stroll through the exhibition of classic and modern cars on the premises. The friendly staff are ready to assist you with route suggestions or tips for top spots in the area.

name: Nicetostay Aparthotel
description: The nicetostay aparthotel is a comfortable option in Germany, well-suited for riders travelling by motorcycle and looking for a calm base. With convenient access and a location in a quiet neighbourhood, it fits well for both day stops and overnight stays before an early morning ride. There is on-site parking available, so you can safely leave your bike. Inside, you’ll find spacious rooms with kitchenettes, giving extra convenience after a long ride. The staff are happy to assist with route tips, sightseeing suggestions and practical logistics -making it a great choice for biker travellers.

name: ATLANTIC Grand Hotel Bremen
description: The ATLANTIC Grand Hotel Bremen is a superb hotel situated in the heart of Bremen, making it an excellent stop for bikers touring northern Germany. The location provides quick access from major roads and ensures that you’re ready to relax after a long ride. On-site there is a secure underground parking garage with a limited number of spaces, where you can safely park your motorcycle or vehicle. Being so close to the historic town centre, you can easily stroll along the Weser riverside and explore the charming old streets in the evening. The staff are always ready to assist with route planning, gear storage and any other needs - especially convenient for motorbike travellers.

name: Hotel FIVE
description: Hotel FIVE is a stylish boutique hotel located right in the heart of Nuremberg, making it a great base for bikers looking to stay in the city during a tour. Its proximity to historic squares and major roads means easy access by motorcycle and a convenient exit route. The hotel offers a secure garage parking facility where you can safely park your bike or car. After your ride you can unwind in one of the modern, comfortable rooms or enjoy time in the inviting hotel bar. The friendly staff are ready to provide route tips and recommend top local spots for sightseeing and relaxation.

name: Sorat Hotel Saxx Nürnberg
description: SORAT Hotel Saxx Nürnberg is situated right on the main square of Nuremberg - an excellent choice for bikers touring Germany. The hotel’s location in the historic old town means you can easily arrive by motorcycle and take an evening stroll through cobbled streets. There is a secure underground parking garage with size limitations, perfect for leaving your bike behind. After your ride you can relax in comfortable rooms and soak up the city atmosphere. The friendly staff are ready to assist with route suggestions and highlight must-see spots in the area.

name: Novotel Freiburg am Konzerthaus
description: The Novotel Freiburg am Konzerthaus is a modern hotel located right in the centre of Freiburg, making it a smart choice for bikers touring Baden-Württemberg. Arriving on a motorcycle, you’ll appreciate the easy vehicle access and its proximity to the main station and historic old town district. The hotel features its own underground parking, with dedicated spaces for guests, so you can safely park your bike or car. The rooms are equipped for a comfortable rest after a road ride, and in the evening you can explore lively streets or relax with a coffee near the hotel. The friendly staff are ready with route suggestions, sightseeing tips and support tailored for motorbike travellers.

name: Park Hotel Post Freiburg
description: The Park Hotel Post Freiburg is a stylish hotel situated right in the heart of Freiburg, making it an excellent stop for bikers wanting to explore the region. It is just a short walk from the old town and central train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the hotel offers an underground parking garage where you can securely park your bike or car. After your ride you can relax in comfortable, literary-themed rooms, and in the evening enjoy a stroll through the charming streets of Freiburg or visit a nearby café.

name: Ostrog Monastery
description: The monastery is carved straight into a cliff. It is one of the region’s foremost Orthodox shrines. Pilgrims arrive on foot or by bus. White façades contrast with grey limestone. Inside rest the relics of St Basil of Ostrog. Silence and valley panoramas leave a deep impression.

name: Doclea (also known as Duklja)
description: Doclea (also known as Duklja) is an ancient Roman city located near Podgorica, the capital of Montenegro. It was founded in the 1st century AD and served as an important administrative and trade center of the Roman province of Dalmatia. The city was well-planned, featuring a forum, baths, temples, and an aqueduct. After barbarian invasions in the 5th–6th centuries, Doclea declined and was eventually abandoned. Today, the site features impressive archaeological remains that offer insight into life during the Roman era. It is one of Montenegro’s most important historical and cultural landmarks.

name: Budva Old Town
description:
The Old Town of Budva is an ancient fortress on the Adriatic coast and the historic heart of the modern resort of Budva, Montenegro. Its history spans more than 2,500 years, making it one of the oldest settlements on the Adriatic Sea. Narrow cobblestone streets, stone houses, and medieval walls create an atmosphere of antiquity and romance. The Old Town is home to the churches of St. John, the Holy Trinity, and St. Mary in Punta, as well as numerous museums and galleries.

This paid parking lot is located at the coordinates 42.279440, 18.835794 near the Budva Old Town. The paid spot offers a convenient place to park and then walk into the historic district without worrying about finding free parking.

name: Baščaršija
description: The Ottoman bazaar quarter is the historic heart of Sarajevo. Narrow lanes lead to artisan shops and coffee houses. The famous wooden Sebilj fountain anchors the main square. Nearby stand the Gazi Husrev‑bey Mosque and the clock tower. Cultures intersect here—Ottoman, Austro‑Hungarian, and Balkan. The ambiance is cozy yet vibrant.

name: Latin Bridge
description: This is where Archduke Franz Ferdinand was assassinated in 1914. The event ignited World War I. The bridge itself is a graceful Ottoman stone structure. Austro‑Hungarian buildings line the Miljacka River banks. A nearby museum explores the “Sarajevo shot.” The site invites reflection on chance and history.

name: Jajce Fortress
description: The medieval fortress rises over the confluence of the Pliva and Vrbas rivers. Jajce served as a residence of Bosnian kings. The town is famous for its waterfall right in the center. Key decisions of World War II were made here. Stone walls and gates retain their silhouette. Panoramas reveal mountains and terracotta roofs.

name: Travnik Old Town
description: The fortress overlooks Bosnia’s former vizier capital. Its walls reveal minarets and colorful houses below. The famed “Colored Mosque” sits at the foot. A small museum presents regional life. The mood blends military austerity with everyday scenes. It’s compact yet detail‑rich.

name: Petrovaradin Fortress
description: Petrovaradin Fortress rises above the Danube as one of the largest and best‑preserved artillery fortifications in Europe. The Habsburgs began building it in 1692 to control the frontier with the Ottoman Empire. Its intricate network of underground tunnels and casemates once housed thousands of soldiers and supplies. The iconic Clock Tower, with a large minute hand and small hour hand, helped boatmen tell time from afar.

name: Studenica Monastery
description: Studenica is a royal monastery founded by Stefan Nemanja in 1186. Its white marble Church of the Virgin showcases the Raška architectural school. Remarkable frescoes, including the Crucifixion (1209), rank among Serbia’s finest medieval art. Studenica played a central role in the spiritual and political life of early Serbia. The monastic complex remained active through turbulent centuries. It is inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its universal value.

name: Stari Ras & Church of St. Peter (Petrova crkva)
description: Stari Ras was the early medieval capital of Serbia, with nearby Petrova crkva as one of its oldest churches. The site illustrates the emergence of a Slavic Christian state on the Balkans. Archaeological remains include fortifications and ecclesiastical structures. The small rotunda church preserves layers of frescoes from different periods. Together with Sopoćani, it is recognized by UNESCO for outstanding universal value. The landscape conveys the frontier character of the medieval kingdom.

name: Golubac Fortress(Đerdap Gorge)
description: Golubac Fortress stands at the entrance to the scenic Đerdap Gorge on the right bank of the Danube and is considered one of Serbia’s most impressive medieval fortresses.The first written records of the fortress date back to 1335, and its construction is believed to have begun in the early 14th century. It consists of nine massive towers connected by defensive walls up to three meters thick, emphasizing its strategic importance. Throughout history, the fortress changed hands many times — among Hungarians, Serbs, Ottomans, and Austrians.

name: Lot Chmiela
description: A craft beer pub in Poznań's historic center, known for its rotating selection of Polish and international microbrews, industrial-chic interior, and lively atmosphere

name: Wściekły Chmiel
description: A vibrant craft beer bar in Poznań's Old Town, known for its extensive tap list of Polish and international craft beers, industrial decor, and lively, social atmosphere.

name: Pub u Szewca
description: A cozy, traditional Polish pub in Lublin's Old Town, known for its rustic atmosphere, local beers, and hearty Polish bar snacks at affordable prices.

name: Padbar
description:
We're so glad you stopped by! Let us tell you a few words about Padbar – a place a little different from all the others.
Our motto is joy. The genuine, youthful kind that warms you inside :) Joy is what we want to give you through everything we do. But you know what – we also really like our Padbar
You probably want to know what we mean by all this joy. And various things:
Consoles – nothing is as relaxing as a good thrashing in Mortal Combat or Tekken. You sit in front of a 65-inch screen, controller in hand, and with a gleeful expression, you're giving your friend a kick.
From time to time, we organize some cool FIFA tournaments. It's as exciting as the Champions League final!
Good alcohol – behind the bar, you'll find dozens of different craft beers, there's always something cool on tap, and our bartenders sometimes like to mix up something interesting with vodka, rum, or tequila

name: Nocny Portier - Cocktail Bar
description: An elegant, intimate cocktail bar in Lublin with a 1920s speakeasy vibe, known for creative drinks, premium spirits, and live jazz evenings in a sophisticated setting.

name: Manekin Lublin
description: A popular Polish restaurant chain famous for its huge, creative crêpes (naleśniki) and pancakes, served in a modern, industrial-style space with generous portions and affordable prices.

name: Bistro u Mili
description:
Welcome to our place, where we serve authentic, home-cooked Polish meals every day – just the way you like them!

We prepare our dishes with passion and attention to every detail, bringing back the flavors of traditional cuisine you remember from your childhood. Whether you crave fragrant soups, pierogi, or pork chops – you'll feel right at home here!

Our cuisine is based on fresh ingredients and authentic recipes, because your satisfaction is our top priority. We invite you to enjoy a Polish home!

You can order for delivery to your home or work!

name: Koper Włoski u Braci Mazur
description: Easygoing Italian restaurant featuring a terrace, plus shared plates & cocktails.

name: Chata Swojsko Strawa
description: Classic restaurant with quaint interiors & a terrace, offering local eats & live music nights.

name: Lublin Center Motorcycle SOKOL
description: A full-service motorcycle workshop and parts supplier in Lublin, specializing in European and Japanese brands, known for reliable repairs, vintage bike restoration, and tire services.

name: MOTOKASIA Lublin - Detailing Shop
description: A professional motorcycle detailing and cosmetic care studio in Lublin, offering paint correction, ceramic coating, and full aesthetic restoration for bikes of all types.

name: Different Motorcycle Repair
description: A specialized motorcycle repair shop focusing on custom builds, performance upgrades, and complex electrical work for both modern and classic bikes.

description:

Currently, we offer a wide range of combustion and electric vehicles.

description: A versatile vehicle service center in Szczecin specializing in scooters, motorcycles, quads, e-scooters, and e-bikes — offering repairs, maintenance, and parts for all types of two-wheeled transport.

description: A trusted motorcycle service and repair workshop in Wrocław, offering comprehensive maintenance, engine rebuilding, and diagnostics for both classic and modern bikes.

name: WypozyczMotoGolus
description: A motorcycle rental service in Wrocław offering a range of bikes for exploring Lower Silesia, from nimble city models to comfortable tourers, with flexible rental terms and optional insurance.

name: MotoExpress - Wypożyczalnia skuterów Poznań
description: A scooter rental service in central Poznań offering modern 50-125cc scooters for convenient city exploration, with hourly and daily rates including helmets and insurance.

name: V-Bikes Wypożyczalnia Motocykli
description: A professional motorcycle rental service in Poznań offering touring, sport, and cruiser models for exploring Greater Poland and beyond, with full insurance and roadside assistance included.

name: Fencer Fountain
description: A striking modernist fountain from 1904 depicting a nude fencer, symbolizing the connection between physical and intellectual strength — one of Wrocław's most recognizable landmarks.

name: Muzeum Sztuki Mieszczańskiej
description: Old town hall built from the 13th to 16th centuries, now housing the Museum of Bourgeois Art.

name: The City Museum of Wroclaw
description: Tours of an 18th-century royal palace with a Wroclaw history museum & reconstructed baroque garden.

name: Roman Catholic church St. Wojciech
description: A historic neo-Gothic church (1906–1909) with a distinctive 67-meter tower, serving as both a place of worship and a city landmark, known for its stained glass and peaceful interior.

name: Wały Chrobrego
description: Landmark elevated promenade dating to 1902, offering water views & paths past iconic buildings.

name: Museum of Technology and Transportation - Art Depot in Szczecin
description: Museum of technology & transport with old Polish motor cars, bikes & wartime vehicles since 1919.

name: Pomeranian Dukes' Castle in Szczecin
description: Renovated castle hosting art & history exhibitions plus classical concerts, some outdoors in summer.

name: Szczecin Boulevards
description: Pedestrian walkway along the West Oder, with cafes & restaurants, plus fishing & panoramic views.

name: Observation deck on the archicatedral basillica's tower
description: A breathtaking panoramic viewpoint from the reconstructed tower of St. James Cathedral, offering 360° views of Szczecin’s red-roofed Old Town, the Oder River, and modern port cranes.

name: Bell Tower of the Castle
description: A historic 52-meter clock tower offering panoramic views of Szczecin’s Old Town, Oder River, and the modern city skyline from the Ducal Castle’s highest point.

name: The Benjamins' Pavilion on Kozak Hill
description: A charming 19th-century wooden pavilion offering panoramic views of Gorzów Wielkopolski, the Warta River, and surrounding forests — a romantic spot for sunset and photography.

name: Wieża Katedry św. Jana Chrzciciela
description: A historic 91-meter Gothic tower offering breathtaking 360° views of Wrocław’s skyline, including the Old Town, Oder River bridges, and surrounding islands — reached by climbing 247 steps.

name: Bridge of Penitents
description: Views from a bridge between 15th-century church towers, destroyed in WWII & rebuilt in 2001.

name: Punkt widokowy Żeglarska

name: Tarasy widokowe CSK
