name: Punkt widokowy - na dachu Dworca Lublin
description: An urban viewpoint on the roof of Lublin's renovated railway station, offering a unique perspective of the city's skyline, train movements, and sunsets over the railway district.

name: Punkt widokowy św. Mikołaja na Czwartku w Lublinie
description: A historic hilltop viewpoint near St. Nicholas Church, offering one of Lublin’s oldest panoramic views of the Old Town, Lublin Castle, and the surrounding districts.

name: Ibis Warszawa Stare Miasto
description:
Hotel ibis Warszawa Stare Miasto is located in the northern part of the center, close to Warsaw's picturesque Old Town. This is a great choice for a business stay, family trip or weekend with friends.

Hotel is located 3km from Warszawa Centralna station, 11km from Chopin Airport and 36km from Modlin Airport. Transport via Muranowska (tram, bus) and Dworzec Gdański (metro, railway) stops close to hotel. Next to hotel there are North Gate, Intraco Prime and Gdański Business Center complex, as well as Polonia Warszawa stadium. Warsaw's largest shopping centre, Westfield Arkadia, is just 1 km away.

The Royal Castle, fountain park and Polin Museum are just a few minutes' walk away. The nearby Vistula Boulevards are ideal for walking, running or resting with a cup of coffee overlooking the river.

name: ibis Warszawa Centrum
description:
Ibis Warszawa Centrum is an economical, sustainable, city hotel located in a perfectly connected point of the city. Its proximity to many fashionable places makes it an ideal choice for a business trip or an outing with friends or family.
We offer 3 types of modern and comfortable rooms equipped with tea and coffee making facilities, TV with Canal+ and en-suite bathroom with shower. Experience our varied breakfast buffet, stocked with local and sustainable food and drinks.

ibis Warszawa Centrum is active in the field of sustainable development. We adapt to current needs and expectations. Together with Accor, we are making many changes to protect our planet and support local organisations and suppliers. Try our seasonal menu at Ibis Kitchen. Relax or get energised by sports in our hotel bar. Meet our Team and be part of our sustainable actions. Capture the local atmosphere and explore indigenous places nearby.

name: Lofthotel Sen Pszczoły
description: LoftHotel Sen Pszczoły is located in a quiet area of ​​central Warsaw, in the picturesque Śródmieście Południowe district. It offers self-catering accommodations in designer rooms and apartments. Free WiFi is available. Each room is uniquely decorated. All are bright and spacious and include a private bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and free toiletries. Each room has a flat-screen TV, and some have a balcony. Guests have access to a reception and a shared kitchen with free tea and coffee. A tour desk and laundry facilities are available on site.

name: Moxy Warsaw City
description: Moxy Warsaw City is where style meets fun in the heart of Warsaw's vibrant Wola district. Our playful hotel redefines the travel experience, offering cozy, tech-savvy rooms with fast Wi-Fi, 55-inch HDTVs, and comfy bedding, perfect for work or relaxation. Moxy’s lively lobby is the social heart of the hotel—grab a craft cocktail at the 24/7 bar, challenge friends to a game, or unwind in stylish lounges designed for both work and play. With a 24-hour gym and convenient grab-and-go dining options, Moxy makes it easy to stay active and fueled on the go. Located near business hubs, trendy cafes, and iconic sites, Moxy Warsaw City puts you steps away from the best of Warsaw. Ideal for modern travelers looking for affordable luxury, Moxy combines Marriott’s reliability with a fresh, youthful vibe, making it the ultimate base for exploring the city. Embrace the unconventional and make Moxy Warsaw City your launchpad for an unforgettable stay!

name: Krakow B&B - Bed&Breakfast
description:
Kraków B&B offers comfortable apartments in a prime location in the heart of Kazimierz, Krakow's historic district. Just a 20-minute walk from the Main Market Square.
We guarantee a comfortable stay in one of our two-, three-, or five-person apartments. All of our apartments are functionally furnished and include a kitchenette and an elegant bathroom.
Surroundings:
- The Vistula Boulevards (Kurlandzki Boulevard) are 450 meters away, with recreational walking and cycling paths.
- "Lajkonik" Bakery and Cafe - serving delicious breakfasts - open from 7:00 a.m. (on the ground floor of our building).

name: Sky Hotel Kraków
description:
We kindly invite you to the modern and elegant 4-star Sky Hotel Krakow located in the very center of the city. If you are looking for a hotel in Srodmieście that will provide you with top-of-the-line rest and comfort while being close to the most interesting monuments in the capital of Lesser Poland, than you are more than welcome to visit us. Other Hotels are able to fulfill your expectations – we will do nothing else but exceed them.
Here, superior quality materials are combined with history and the idea of relaxation. We offer to our Guests 60 comfortable, fully equipped rooms. We focused primarily on large, comfortable beds. We chose the brand Hilding - a Swedish specialist in hypoallergenic mattresses, because we believe that they provide great sleep.

name: PURO Hotel Łódź Centrum
description:
Discover Łódź
and Manufaktura
Renowned architecture, street art, dozens of museums and galleries, and a film school. It's no wonder Łódź tops the list of Polish cities recommended by international travel portals.

One of a kind

The PURO Hotel in Łódź is like a Hitchcock film – it starts well, and then gets even better. From the moment you enter, you experience the finest design and architecture. Its excellent location in the city center means yo

name: Aiden by Best Western Lodz
description: We invite you to discover our 61 exceptional rooms, where elegance harmoniously combines with functionality. Each space has been carefully designed to provide guests with both the utmost comfort and an aesthetically pleasing experience. The room interiors captivate with their modern design and carefully selected details, creating an atmosphere conducive to relaxation and rest.

name: Radisson Blu Hotel, Wroclaw
description:
Rich in culture and picturesque charm, Wroclaw draws countless visitors every year. By basing yourself at the Radisson Blu Hotel, Wroclaw, you'll be just a few minutes' walk from major attractions, shops, restaurants and other businesses, helping you make the most of your stay in this beautiful Polish city.

Convenient accommodation near the Market Square

Our Wroclaw hotel is located near the historic Market Square, at the heart of the city, as well as popular sites such as the Panorama of Raclawice and the National Museum. If you're visiting Wroclaw on business, you'll also appreciate our proximity to Dominikanski Square - plus the local airport is just 11 kilometers away.

Savor freshly prepared Polish cuisine at our restaurant, The Kapist. Take advantage of convenient services such as underground car parking, a business center and a 24-hour fitness center. Numerous parks and river walks surround the hotel and provide optimal routes for walking or jogging.

name: Park Hotel Diament Wrocław
description: Wrocław, also known as the "Meeting City," is home to countless hotels, but Park Hotel Diament stands out among them. We offer this unique place, offering not only comfortable accommodations but also exceptional experiences. Find out why this hotel is worth choosing for your stay in the heart of Wrocław. Park Hotel Diament in Wrocław combines modernity and comfort, providing guests with an unforgettable experience. Its location is ideal for both tourists and business travelers, allowing easy access to the city's most important attractions, business centers, and the train station. Additionally, the hotel offers a wide range of services, including an excellent restaurant and a modern conference center, making it an excellent choice for anyone seeking comfort and convenience during their stay in Wrocław.

name: Gold
description: This modest hotel is located on a tree-lined street, 4 km from the Poznań International Fair and 3 km from Poznań-Ławica Airport and the tranquil Rusałka Lake.

name: Hotel Moderno
description: Hotel Moderno in Poznań was created with a passion for hospitality and combines modern design, comfort, and the highest standard of service. It is an ideal choice for both business guests and tourists seeking comfortable accommodations in the center of Poznań.

name: Petřín Lookout Tower
description: Petřín Lookout Tower, a petite replica of the Eiffel Tower, crowns a hill above Prague, promising a breathtaking view of the golden city. From its 60-meter height, you’ll see Prague Castle, the winding Vltava River, and the tiled roofs of Old Town. The funicular ride through lush gardens adds a touch of romance, while sunset shots here are pure magic. Perfect as a starting point for a bike trip, with easy parking nearby. Bring your camera — the 360° panorama is the ultimate keepsake!

name: Pravčická brána
description: Pravčická brána, Europe’s largest sandstone arch, towers over Bohemian Switzerland National Park. Its lookout offers an epic view of canyons, pine forests, and the Elbe River, straight out of a fantasy film. Reach it via a scenic trail from Mezní Loučka, with the D8 bike route adding adventure through Bohemian fields. The platform is perfect for crowd-free photos, especially at dawn. A spot where nature and history merge into one unforgettable scene!

name: Viewpoint Máj
description: Vyhlídka Máj lookout near Slapy Dam unveils a stunning view of the Vltava’s curve, framed by green hills and forests. From the cliff, the water’s surface, yachts, and distant villages create an idyllic Czech scene. Just 40 km from Prague via the smooth D4, it’s a perfect biker route with scenic roads. A short 15–20-minute hike from the Štěchovice parking leads to a postcard-worthy panorama. Visit at sunset for golden light and serene tranquility!

name: Diana Observation Tower
description: Diana Lookout Tower in Karlovy Vary unveils a panorama of the spa town’s colonnades, tiled roofs, and green hills. The funicular to Friendship Hill is an adventure itself, and the 40-meter tower’s view takes your breath away. The E48 bike route offers a scenic ride through western Bohemia. Mornings are quiet, perfect for tourist-free photos. After descending, grab a local wafer dessert at a cafe by the springs!

name: Český Krumlov Castle Tower
description: The baroque tower of Český Krumlov Castle offers a ticket to a UNESCO town’s panorama, framed by Vltava’s curves. From the top, medieval streets, red roofs, and distant Alps unfold. The 162-step climb is worth it, especially at sunset. Bikers will love the route through South Bohemia (170 km from Prague), with stops at local breweries. Castle parking is convenient, and the town feels like a time machine!

name: Poledník Mountain Lookout
description: Poledník Mountain’s lookout tower in Šumava opens a window to Czechia’s wild heart. The panorama of glacial lakes, peat bogs, and forests along the German border mesmerizes. A 1–2-hour hike from Modrava winds through pine trails, while the Šumava bike route offers freedom on two wheels. Mornings are crowd-free, with silence you can almost touch. A spot for those craving solitude and vastness!

name: Šumava National Park
description: Šumava National Park, Czechia’s wild heart, unveils panoramas of forests, glacial lakes, and mountains stretching to the Alps and Austrian border. Lookouts like Plechý peak or Plešné Lake offer stunning views of boulder seas, peat bogs, and endless pines. A 180–200 km bike route from Prague via E50 winds through twisty roads to Nová Pec, the gateway to hiking trails. Morning vistas, free of crowds, and silent forests are perfect for photos and relaxation. A place where nature and freedom merge into an epic adventure!

name: Bohemian Paradise Golden Path
description: The Golden Path in Bohemian Paradise links viewpoints at Hrubá Skála, showcasing cliffs, castles, and canyons. Panoramas of sandstone formations and forests feel otherworldly. The 10–15 km trail is perfect for hiking, while the 100-km bike route from Prague winds through Bohemian villages. Quiet mornings or evenings yield postcard-worthy photos. An adventure for the soul and camera!

name: Milešovka
description: Milešovka, queen of the Ore Mountains, offers a panorama of volcanic peaks, plains, and ancient castle ruins. The 360° view captures Lovoš, Radobýl, and endless fields. A simple 1-hour hike from the parking lot, with a 70-km bike ride from Prague that’s pure joy. Steeped in history, it’s perfect for unfiltered photos. Come at dawn for a mystical vibe!

name: Petrov Hill Lookout
description: Petrov Hill in Brno, crowned by the Gothic St. Peter and Paul Church, beckons with a panorama of the "wine capital" — red rooftops, Svratava River, and Palava hills glowing in autumn gold. The tower lookout sweeps 360° over the city and vineyards, where the "Towers and Jewels Exhibition" adds sparkle to historic walls. A 200-km bike route from Prague via D1 is pure joy through Moravian fields, with base parking and an easy 10-minute climb. Mornings are serene and crowd-free, perfect for misty valley shots and exhibit installations. A blend of medieval charm, wine vibes, and vistas — a must for Moravian bikers!

name: New City Hall Observation Tower
description: Ostrava’s New City Hall Tower, a 73-meter icon of industrial Moravia, sweeps over the basin, Beskydy Mountains to the south, and Jeseníky to the west. From the top, rusty Dolní Vítkovice furnaces, Ostravice River, and Silesian plateaus unfold — a clash of Czechia’s past and future. An epic 350-km bike route from Prague via D1/E462 (3–4 hours) passes Olomouc, with parking at the city hall. The quick elevator ride costs ~50 Kč, perfect for crowd-free sunsets and shots with factory smoke. Where steel meets sky, for urban explorers and two-wheeled freedom seekers!

name: e-motionrent
description: e-Motion Rentals in Plovdiv is an eco-oasis for bikers, where the SUPER SOCO CUmini's 40 km range and 45 km/h speed turns city streets into silent adventures without exhaust or noise. Rent for a day (35 lv.) for spontaneous tours through Old Town hills or 15+ days (20 lv./day) for daily commutes — its compact 57 kg weight is perfect for narrow alleys and easy parking. Online booking is straightforward: pick dates from the calendar, fill the form, and get email confirmation with support at 089 999 4179. It's more than a rental — a leap to sustainable thrills on urban rides!

name: Scooter and car rental MOTO CENTER FOR RENT
description: MOTO CENTER FOR RENT in Burgas is your gateway to Black Sea adventures, where scooter rentals (from 20–30 lv./day) and motorbikes (~€114/day) let you cruise golden Nessebar beaches and Strandja hills. Pick a compact scooter for city alleys or a powerful motorbike for routes to Sozopol — all with airport delivery and full insurance for peace of mind. Booking online or by phone is straightforward: select dates, model, and get a pristine bike, as praised in Riderly partner reviews. More than a rental — freedom on wheels along the Balkan coast, from beaches to ancient ruins!

name: ZÁHY MOTO
description: ZÁHY MOTO in Western Bohemia is a cozy hub for bikers, where renting a Honda CB500X or KTM Adventure (from 1500 Kč/day) unlocks Šumava trails with lakes and forests, just 150 km from Prague. Choose a bike for a day route through Pilsen or a week-long trip to the Austrian border — complete with helmet, insurance, and optional GPS for newcomers. Booking by phone or email is straightforward: specify dates, model, and experience, and they'll arrange pickup in Záhy or delivery to your hotel. In October 2025 (golden autumn!), it's a must for misty mornings in the national park and beer stops in Plzeň, minus the crowds. More than a rental — a gateway to Bohemian adventures, freedom on two wheels along medieval roads!

name: MeRa Moto
description: MeRa Moto in Plzeň is a biker’s hub in Czechia’s beer capital, where renting adventure bikes like BMW GS unlocks routes to Šumava forests and the German border. Cruise D5 highways to castles or swing by Pilsner Urquell breweries, with full gear and insurance for road freedom. Booking online or via email is effortless: select your model, set dates, and get a pristine motorcycle, praised for reliability in reviews. Morning rides tempt with misty Bohemian hill vistas, perfect for unfiltered photos. More than a rental — a launchpad for epic Western Czech tours, from beer bars to medieval trails!

name: Motorbike rental - Europe
description: Motorbike Rental - Europe in Prague is a biker’s launchpad for Czech tours, where renting powerful motorcycles like BMW GS unlocks routes to Karlštejn Castle and Vltava panoramas. Cruise the D1 highway to Brno or twisty roads to the German border, with full gear and insurance for road freedom. Online booking on their site is simple: select your model, set dates, and get a GPS-equipped bike, praised for quality in reviews. Morning rides tempt with misty Bohemian hills and medieval villages, perfect for unfiltered photos. More than a rental — a pass to European adventures, from Prague Castle to Alpine horizons!

name: ORANGE RENT
description: ORANGE RENT in Prague is an eco-friendly hub for urban adventures, where renting high-quality Honda scooters unlocks narrow Old Town alleys and Vltava panoramas without noise or traffic jams. Glide along routes to Charles Bridge or Petřín Hill, with full gear and insurance for effortless city maneuvering. Online booking on their site is straightforward: select your model, set dates, and get a spotless scooter, praised for cleanliness and service in reviews. Morning rides offer golden rooftops and green hills, perfect for hassle-free photos. More than a rental — a way to feel Prague’s pulse, from medieval streets to trendy cafés!

name: Motopůjčovna Olomouc
description: Motopůjčovna Olomouc is a motorcycle rental service in Olomouc, perfect for rides through baroque squares and Beskydy hills with their green views. Grab a bike and roll along E462 to Brno or forest roads to the mountains, with gear and insurance for comfort. Booking on their site is easy: choose your model, set dates, and get a pristine motorcycle, praised for service in reviews. Morning rides reveal panoramas of historic cathedrals and Moravian fields, great for photos. A rental for exploring Moravia on two wheels — from city to mountains!

name: CFMOTO brand motorcycle rental
description: CFMOTO in Brno is a motorcycle rental service specializing in CFMOTO bikes, perfect for rides through Moravian hills and vineyards with their scenic views. Grab a bike and roll along D1 to Olomouc or forest roads to castles, with gear and insurance for comfort. Booking on their site is easy: choose your model, set dates, and get a pristine motorcycle, praised for service in reviews. Morning rides reveal Moravian field panoramas and historic towns, great for photos. A rental for exploring Eastern Czechia on two wheels — from city to mountains!

name: AMGmoto s.r.o.
description: AMGmoto s.r.o. in Ostrava is a motorcycle store where Italian brands like Ducati, Aprilia, and Moto Guzzi await riders with Beskydy mountain panoramas in the background. Here, you can buy a new model, gear, or take a test ride to feel the power on D1 roads to the hills. The service center handles full maintenance — from repairs to tuning, praised for quality in reviews. Morning visits reveal steelworks views and hills, perfect for photos with your new bike. A spot for style and reliability — from track Ducati to urban Vespa!

name: Free-moto s.r.o
description: FREE-MOTO s.r.o. in Držovice-Prostějov is a motorcycle store specializing in new and used Yamaha, Kawasaki, and other brands, with a full range for riders. Here, you can buy a bike, gear, or take a test ride to test it on D1 roads to Beskydy. The service center offers full maintenance — from repairs to tuning, praised for quality in local reviews. Morning visits reveal Moravian fields and castles, perfect for photos with your new motorcycle. A spot for reliable bikes — from adventure for tours to urban models!

name: MTT Brno
description: MTT Brno is a motorcycle and quad store in Brno, where you can buy new CFMOTO, KTM, GASGAS models, gear, and clothing for riders. Full service is available — from repairs to tuning, praised for quality in local reviews. Morning visits offer views of city hills and Moravian vineyards, perfect for photos with your new bike. A spot for reliable motorcycles — from adventure for Beskydy tours to urban scooters. MTT Brno is a convenient base for exploring South Moravia, with parking and friendly staff!

name: Moto-man
description: Moto-man in Brno is a motorcycle store offering new and used Yamaha, Suzuki models, plus gear and parts for riders. Full service is provided — from repairs to customization, praised for quality in local rider reviews. Morning visits reveal vibrant Brno streets and Špilberk Castle, perfect for photos with your new bike. A spot for motorcycles suited for city rides or D1 tours to Beskydy. Moto-man is a convenient central Brno base for starting moto adventures, with parking and friendly staff!

name: Motoman s.r.o Praha
description: Motoman s.r.o. Praha in Prague is a motorcycle store offering new and used models, gear, and accessories for riders. Full service is provided — from repairs to customization, praised for quality in local rider reviews. Morning visits reveal city streets and Vltava views, perfect for photos with your new bike. A spot for motorcycles suited for urban rides or Bohemian tours, with a convenient south Prague location. Motoman is a great base for gearing up for adventures, with parking and friendly staff!

name: LevneMOTO Centrum
description: LevneMOTO Centrum in Prague is a biker’s shop selling new SYM, BENELLI, KEEWAY, GOES motorcycles and scooters, plus gear and parts. The service center repairs and tunes any brand, praised for speed and quality in reviews. Located in the northeast, it’s perfect for hitting D8 toward Bohemian hills. They’ll help you pick a bike — from urban models to tourers for long rides. Parking’s nearby, and the staff knows their stuff, ready to answer any question!

name: CITY MOTO
description: CITY MOTO in Plzeň is a biker’s shop selling new and used motorcycles, quads, and gear from BMW, Yamaha, and other brands. The service center handles repairs and tuning, praised for quality in local reviews. Located near the D5 highway, it’s perfect for test rides toward Bohemian forests. They’ll help you pick a bike — from urban models to tourers for long hauls. Parking’s on-site, and the staff knows how to guide riders to the right machine!

description: Motocykly Yamaha - KAVAL in Karlovy Vary is a biker’s shop selling new Yamaha motorcycles and scooters, plus gear and parts. The service center repairs and tunes any brand, praised in reviews for quality and care. Located near the R6 highway, it’s perfect for test rides to the Krušné Mountains. They’ll pick a bike for you — from urban models to tourers for long hauls. Parking’s on-site, and the staff knows how to set up your machine just right!

They’ll pick a bike for you — from urban models to tourers for long hauls. Parking’s on-site, and the staff knows how to set up your machine to fit your needs!

name: Smederevo Fortress
description: Smederevo Fortress is located on the right bank of the Danube River, at the confluence with the Jezava River, and is an outstanding example of medieval Serbian fortification architecture.The fortress was built by order of Despot Đurađ Branković between 1428 and 1430 and served as the residence and capital of the Serbian Despotate.It has a triangular shape, thick defensive walls several meters wide, and numerous towers emphasizing its military purpose. After being captured by the Ottomans in 1459, the fortress witnessed many historical events, including an ammunition explosion during World War II. Today, Smederevo Fortress is a popular tourist attraction where visitors can experience the spirit of medieval Serbia and enjoy beautiful views of the Danube River.

name: Chillon Castle
description: Chillon Castle is located on a rocky islet on the shores of Lake Geneva near Montreux and is one of the most impressive medieval fortresses in Switzerland. The first written mention of the castle dates back to 1150, although its construction likely began in the 11th century. During the 13th and 14th centuries, it belonged to the Counts of Savoy and served as an administrative and military center before being captured by Bern in 1536. Chillon Castle inspired many poets and artists of the Romantic era and today remains one of Switzerland’s most visited landmarks. A visit to the castle offers the chance to experience the atmosphere of the Middle Ages, explore its halls and dungeons, and enjoy breathtaking views of Lake Geneva.

name: Zytglogge
description: The Zytglogge is an ancient clock tower in the historic center of Bern, Switzerland, and one of the city’s most famous landmarks. It was built in the early 13th century as part of the city’s fortifications and originally served as a gate and watchtower. In the 15th–16th centuries, it was equipped with an astronomical clock and a mechanical figurine display that activates every hour. Today, the Zytglogge is open to visitors and offers guided tours that include access to the viewing platform overlooking Bern’s Old Town. The tower’s architecture combines medieval, Renaiss

name: Fortifications of Bellinzona
description: The Fortifications of Bellinzona are an outstanding ensemble of medieval castles and defensive walls located in the Swiss town of Bellinzona. The complex includes three main castles — Castelgrande, Montebello, and Sasso Corbaro — connected by powerful walls and towers. These fortresses were built to protect the strategically important Ticino Valley and served as a key defensive barrier between the northern and southern Alps. Their architecture reflects the evolution of fortification design from the 13th to the 15th century. Today, the Bellinzona Castles are listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. They are open to visitors and represent one of the most picturesque historical landmarks in Switzerland.

name: Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke)
description: Europe’s oldest covered wooden bridge. Built in the 14th century as a defensive link. Interior panels from the 17th century depict local history. Rebuilt after the 1993 fire. It links Old Town to the modern city. Sunrise shots by the Water Tower are classic.

name: Lausanne Cathedral
description: Switzerland’s foremost Gothic cathedral. Begun in the 12th–13th centuries and consecrated in 1275. Climbing the tower rewards you with city-and-lake views. Inside are fine stained glass and stonework. The Cité quarter is great for a coffee stop. Summer often brings music events.

name: Geneva Cathedral (Cathédrale Saint-Pierre Genève)
description: St. Peter’s Cathedral is located in the historic center of Geneva and is one of the most famous architectural and religious landmarks in Switzerland. The first Christian buildings on this site date back to the 4th century, while the present structure was built between the 12th and 13th centuries. In the 16th century, the cathedral became a key center of the Reformation — John Calvin preached here, and it was transformed into a Protestant church. Today, visitors can climb the towers to enjoy panoramic views of Geneva and the lake, and explore the archaeological remains of early churches beneath the cathedral. Its architecture combines Romanesque, Gothic, and Neoclassical elements, reflecting the long and layered history of Geneva.

name: Reformation Wall (Mur des Réformateurs)
description: The Reformation Wall is located in Bastions Park in the center of Geneva and serves as a monument dedicated to the events of the 16th-century Reformation. It was built between 1909 and 1917 in honor of four key reformers — John Calvin, William Farel, Théodore de Bèze, and John Knox. The monument is integrated into the city’s old fortifications and features a long stone wall with statues and reliefs bearing the motto “Post Tenebras Lux,” meaning “After darkness, light.” Today, the Reformation Wall is a popular spot for walks, meetings, and reflection on Europe’s religious and cultural heritage.

name: Promenade de la Treille
description: The Promenade de la Treille is one of the oldest walkways in Geneva’s Old Town, located above Bastions Park and next to the City Hall. It is famous for its wooden bench, about 120 meters long, considered one of the longest benches in the world. The promenade is home to Geneva’s official chestnut tree, whose first bud each year marks the arrival of spring in the city. From this spot, visitors can enjoy beautiful views of the lower town, the old city walls, and the distant Alps, making it a favorite place for walks and photos.

name: The Dying Lion (Löwendenkmal)
description: The Lion Monument, also known as the Dying Lion of Lucerne, is located in Lucerne, Switzerland, and depicts a lion carved into a rock face. It was created between 1820 and 1821, designed by Danish sculptor Bertel Thorvaldsen and carved by Lukas Ahorn. The monument honors the Swiss Guards who died defending the Tuileries Palace in Paris on August 10, 1792. The Latin inscription “Helvetiorum Fidei ac Virtuti” translates as “To the loyalty and bravery of the Swiss.” The sculpture is considered one of the most moving stone memorials in the world, symbolizing courage, loyalty, and sacrifice.

name: Oberhofen Castle (Schloss Oberhofen am Thunersee)
description: Oberhofen Castle is located on the shores of Lake Thun in the canton of Bern and is considered one of the most picturesque castles in Switzerland. Its main tower was built in the early 13th century, while the castle’s current appearance was shaped in the mid-19th century in a Neo-Gothic style. Since 1954, the castle has housed a museum featuring restored period interiors and the history of its noble owners. The surrounding park, with its stunning views of the lake and mountains, is regarded as one of the most beautiful gardens in the Alpine region. Oberhofen Castle combines elements of a medieval fortress, a romantic palace, and a modern museum, offering visitors a truly enchanting experience.

name: Château de Gruyères
description: Gruyères Castle is located in the commune of Gruyères in the canton of Fribourg, Switzerland, standing proudly on a hill amid the picturesque pre-Alpine scenery. The first written record dates back to 1244, and the castle was built in the 13th century following the typical Savoyard square design of medieval fortresses. During the Middle Ages, it served as the residence of the Counts of Gruyères, but after the last count’s bankruptcy in 1554, it came under the control of the cantons of Fribourg and Bern. Today, the castle functions as a museum showcasing eight centuries of history, art, and local legends — from medieval stained glass to 19th-century paintings.

name: Lindenhof Zurich (Lindenhof Zürich)
description: This viewpoint is located in Lindenhof Park, one of Zurich’s most famous and historic green spaces. From the hill, visitors can enjoy stunning views of the Old Town, the Limmat River, Lake Zurich, and the distant Alps. The atmosphere here is calm and open — just reach the terrace and take a moment to absorb the sweeping panorama. The spot is particularly beautiful at sunrise or sunset, when the soft light bathes the city in warm golden tones.

name: Aussichtspunkt Waid
description: Aussichtspunkt Waid is a viewpoint on the Käferberg hill above Zurich’s Höngg district, offering spectacular views over the city, Lake Zurich, and the Alps. The spot is best visited at sunrise or sunset, when the soft light enhances the beauty of the surrounding landscape. You can reach it on foot through the Wipkingen and Höngg neighborhoods or by bus, and at the top there are benches and peaceful areas to relax and enjoy the panorama.

name: Höllgrotten Baar
description: Höllgrotten Baar is a karst cave complex located in the scenic Lorze Gorge in the canton of Zug, Switzerland. Formed over thousands of years by mineral-rich springs, the caves feature impressive stalactites, stalagmites, and underground lakes. The illuminated walking paths take about 45 minutes to explore and are suitable for families and visitors of all ages. The cave maintains a steady temperature of around 10 °C throughout the year, so bringing a light jacket is recommended. The caves are open daily from April 1 to October 31, after which they close for the winter season.

name: Aussichtspunkt Guggi
description: Aussichtspunkt Guggi is a charming viewpoint in the city of Zug, offering breathtaking views over Lake Zug and the surrounding Rigi and Pilatus mountains. Located close to the Old Town, it’s an ideal spot for a short walk or a relaxing break with a panoramic view. The area is especially beautiful at sunset, when the sunlight reflects on the water and paints the landscape in golden and pink hues.

name: Red Factory (Rote Fabrik)
description: The Rote Fabrik (Red Factory) is a cultural center located on the shores of Lake Zurich, housed in a former 19th-century textile factory. Today it hosts concerts, exhibitions, theater performances, and film screenings, making it a key part of the city’s cultural life. The area is adorned with graffiti and street art, creating an atmosphere of freedom and creativity. From the factory’s waterfront, visitors can enjoy a beautiful view of the lake and mountains, especially at sunset.

name: Bernina Express
description: The Bernina Express is a unique panoramic train that connects Switzerland and Italy, passing through the magnificent scenery of the Alps. It operates on the Bernina Railway line, part of the Rhaetian Railway network and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. During the journey, passengers pass through 55 tunnels and cross 196 bridges, admiring glaciers, lakes, and mountain valleys. The train climbs to more than 2,200 meters above sea level, offering stunning views of alpine passes and peaks. It is not a high-speed train — its purpose is to let travelers enjoy nature and the impressive feats of engineering. The carriages feature panoramic windows and multilingual audio guides for a comfortable and immersive experience.

name: YZY FLOW CHOPPERS SRL
description: YZY FLOW CHOPPERS SRL is a Bucharest-based motorcycle workshop that works exclusively with Harley-Davidson bikes, offering everything from routine maintenance to full custom builds and performance upgrades. Focused on craftsmanship and authenticity, the team brings together deep technical skill and a true passion for the Harley brand. Each project is tailored to the rider’s personality and style, making the garage a go-to place for Harley owners across Romania. It’s not just a workshop - it’s a hub for the Harley-Davidson community and lifestyle.

name: Château de Tourbillon
description: Château de Tourbillon stands atop a rocky hill in the town of Sion, in the canton of Valais, Switzerland. It was built in the late 13th century by Bishop Boniface de Challant as a residence for the bishops of Sion and a symbol of ecclesiastical power. In 1788, the castle was destroyed by fire, but its majestic ruins still dominate the Rhône Valley skyline. A scenic path with winding turns leads up to the castle, offering breathtaking views of Sion, the vineyards, and the surrounding Alps. Facing it across the valley is Valère Castle, together forming one of Switzerland’s most iconic historical ensembles. Today, Tourbillon Castle is a beloved destination for walks, photography, and exploring the medieval heritage of Valais.

name: Mattequartier
description: Mattequartier is a historic district in Bern’s Old Town, situated along the Aare River on the city’s peninsula. In the Middle Ages, it was home to workshops, mills, and trading houses that thrived thanks to the power of the river and its strategic location. Today, the quarter combines medieval architecture and narrow streets with modern cafés, galleries, and a creative atmosphere. Walking through the area, visitors can admire the views of the river, tiled rooftops, and historic buildings while feeling the vibrant spirit of Bern.

name: Ace Cafe Luzern
description: Ace Café Luzern is a legendary biker and car enthusiast hub. The air smells of fuel, grilled meat, and freedom. Thursdays bring hundreds of bikes, from choppers to sport models. Inside it’s all rock’n’roll, chrome, and friendly faces. The kitchen serves hearty burgers and ribs with great service. If you want to feel Swiss motorcycle culture - this is the place to be.

name: Bar Route 66
description: Bar Route 66 in Glarus is a cult biker bar where time feels frozen on Highway 66. Neon lights and Harley posters set the tone of the road spirit. Locals and travelers swap stories about mountain passes at the counter. The bar is famous for its burgers, beers, and friendly mood. From the terrace, you can watch bikes rolling in from all over the canton.

name: Housi’s Bikerbar
description: Housi’s Bikerbar is a true biker haven in an old smithy near Bern. It’s warm, cozy, and scented with wood smoke. On weekends, rock bands play while Housi himself greets guests. The vibe is family-like but full of road spirit. License plates, helmets, and travel photos fill the walls.

name: Tacho Cafe Bar
description: Tacho Bar is where riders cool off after tearing through the Bernese Oberland. The interior is honest and simple, with wooden tables and vintage race posters. MotoGP and Superbike run on the TVs. It’s not about glamour — it’s about the road, friends, and cold beer. The terrace opens wide in summer, while the fireplace keeps it cozy in winter. A perfect base to plan your next lake or mountain loop.

name: Biker Bar
description: Small but soulful, the Biker Bar in Plaffeien is a local riders’ gem. There’s always friendly warmth and a whiff of coffee mixed with engine oil. It’s not about show - it’s about genuine company. After riding the Schwarzsee routes, it’s perfect for a beer and a chat. The walls are covered with biker patches and stickers from around the world. The bartender knows everyone by name - and that says it all.

name: RESTAURANT CHEMI-HÜTTA
description: Restaurant Chemi-Hütta is located in the village of St. Silvester in the canton of Fribourg and offers a cozy traditional chalet ambiance. Its warm wooden interior and decorative murals evoke the charm of an authentic Swiss countryside inn. The menu features regional Swiss dishes such as steak, tartare, fondue, along with pizza and vegetarian options. The restaurant is open Wednesday to Sunday from 08:30 AM to midnight, and closed on Monday and Tuesday. It is recommended to reserve a table in advance, especially on weekends and holidays, as the restaurant is very popular.

name: Isebähnli
description: Isebähnli is a well-known chalet-style restaurant located at the foot of the Hauenstein Pass in Trimbach, canton Solothurn, Switzerland. For decades it has hosted weekly large gatherings of motorcycle enthusiasts, giving the place a lively and dynamic character. The menu features Swiss and alpine cuisine classics, including cordon-bleu, hearty meat dishes, and vegetarian options. The interior blends cozy chalet charm with a welcoming atmosphere: wooden beams, warm lighting, a spacious terrace and covered veranda. It’s highly recommended to reserve a table in advance.

name: Chevy's Road Stop
description: Chevy’s Road Stop is an American-style restaurant located in Remigen (canton Aargau), featuring a large Route 66-themed parking area and a biker-friendly vibe. The menu includes homemade burgers made from regional ingredients, hot sandwiches, steaks, milkshakes and a fine selection of beers. The décor is filled with classic American car motifs and road-trip charm, attracting both families and motorcycle enthusiasts. It is recommended to reserve a table in advance. Chevy’s Road Stop is ideal for a relaxed lunch after a drive, a friendly meet-up, or a fun family dinner in a lively atmosphere.

name: Easy Rider Lounge
description: Easy Rider Lounge is a meet-and-go lounge on the Harley dealership grounds. It’s perfect for coffee, a quick bite, and last-minute route tweaks. Bike parking sits right by the door and in full view. Inside it’s clean, functional, and dotted with custom-culture details. A great base to sync your GPS, check tire pressure, and roll out toward Lavaux and the Jura passes. The vibe is friendly, efficient, and purpose-built for riders.

name: Harley-Davidson Lausanne
description: Harley-Davidson Lausanne is the official dealership of the legendary American brand, located in Lausanne, Switzerland. It offers a full range of new and pre-owned Harley-Davidson motorcycles, along with genuine accessories, parts, and branded gear. The shop features a cozy Easy Rider Lounge, where visitors can enjoy coffee, meet fellow bikers, and soak up the spirit of freedom. The dealership regularly hosts test rides, seasonal events, road trips, and meetings of the regional Harley Club. Its professional team assists riders in choosing motorcycles and accessories that match their personal style and riding experience.

name: Vida Loca Café
description: Vida Loca Café is located at Route des Courtraits 30, 1880 Bex, in the canton of Vaud, Switzerland. It is a lively café-restaurant with a bar area and terrace, popular with locals and visitors alike. The menu features burgers, pizzas, vegetarian options and even gluten-free choices. The interior is styled in a modern fashion with a bar-café ambiance complemented by a sunlit terrace. The venue is suitable for lunch, dinner or a meet-up with friends, and ideal after a walk in the surroundings. It is strongly recommended to reserve a table in advance, especially during evenings and weekends.

name: Pinte Pub&Club
description: Pinte Pub&Club is a pub-club located in the heart of Andermatt, canton Uri, Switzerland, and offers the vibe for both relaxed meet-ups and lively night outs. The menu features popular burgers, wings, nachos and vegetarian options, while live sports and foosball add to the friendly, active atmosphere. The interior blends traditional pub charm with a club energy: wooden tables, a well-stocked bar, a dance floor downstairs and a lounge area upstairs. The venue is especially lively in the evenings and on weekends — ideal for an après-ski drink, an evening program with a DJ, or simply good company. It’s recommended to reserve a table ahead of time or arrive early to secure your spot, especially if you plan to stay late.

name: The Devil’s Bridge (Teufelsbrücke)
description: The Devil’s Bridge (Teufelsbrücke) is a famous stone bridge located in the Schöllenen Gorge near Andermatt, in the canton of Uri, Switzerland. The first bridge was built in the 13th century to connect the vital trade route over the Gotthard Pass. According to legend, it was constructed with the help of the Devil, who demanded the soul of the first to cross - but the villagers tricked him by sending a goat instead. The current bridge, built in the 19th century, preserves its monumental appearance and stands as a symbol of Swiss engineering mastery. Nearby, a scenic walking trail with viewing platforms offers stunning vistas over the gorge and the roaring Reuss River. Today, the Devil’s Bridge is both a historical landmark and one of the most photographed sites in the Swiss Alps.

name: Reuss Waterfall
description: The Reuss Waterfall is located in the Schöllenen Gorge in the canton of Uri and is formed by the Reuss River cascading down a narrow alpine valley. This impressive natural site features roaring streams, steep rock walls, and powerful water energy — a perfect spot for walking and photography. The Reuss River is one of the main rivers of Central Switzerland, flowing through the Alps and valleys down to Lake Lucerne. In earlier centuries, the gorge and waterfall were part of a strategically important trade route over the St. Gotthard Pass. Today, it is a popular destination where visitors can enjoy the sound of the rushing water and the beauty of untouched nature. Comfortable shoes are recommended, as the rocks near the waterfall can be slippery and the environment changes quickly.

name: HSmoto s.r.o.
description: HSmoto s.r.o. is a specialized motorcycle dealership and repair shop in Tábor, making it an essential stop for bikers on Bohemian routes needing parts or quick fixes. It is just a short ride from the D3 highway and local train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a full workshop where you can drop off your bike for repairs or upgrades. After your ride you can browse the showroom for accessories, and in the evening head to nearby Tábor Castle for a historical walk or a beer at a local pub.

name: Moto assistance s.r.o.
description: MOTOBOOM s.r.o. is a motorcycle repair and sales shop in České Budějovice, making it an essential stop for bikers facing mechanical issues or upgrades on South Bohemian routes. It is just a short ride from the D3 highway and local train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a full workshop where you can drop off your bike for diagnostics, repairs, or custom upgrades. After your ride you can browse the showroom for parts, and in the evening head to nearby Hluboká Castle for a historical walk or a beer at a local pub.

name: MOTODÍLNA | Údržba motocyklů a skútrů
description: The MOTODÍLNA | Údržba motocyklů a skútrů is a specialized motorcycle and scooter maintenance workshop in Prague's southern outskirts, making it an essential stop for bikers needing quick diagnostics or repairs on urban or highway routes. It is just a short ride from the D1 highway and metro station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the workshop offers a dedicated bay where you can drop off your bike for tune-ups, oil changes, or brake checks. After your ride you can wait in the waiting area with mechanic updates, and in the evening head to nearby Prague Castle for a historical walk or a beer at a traditional pub.

name: LTR moto s.r.o.
description: The LTR moto s.r.o. is a motorcycle repair and maintenance shop in Prague's southern outskirts, making it an essential stop for bikers facing mechanical issues on urban or highway routes. It is just a short ride from the D1 highway and metro station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a dedicated workshop where you can drop off your bike for diagnostics, repairs, or tire changes. After your ride you can wait in the lounge with mechanic updates, and in the evening head to nearby Vyšehrad Fortress for a historical walk or a beer at a local pub.

name: Auto moto servis David
description: The Auto moto servis David is a versatile car and motorcycle repair shop in Plzeň, making it an essential stop for bikers needing quick fixes or diagnostics on West Bohemian routes. It is just a short ride from the D5 highway and local train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a multi-bay workshop where you can drop off your bike for oil changes, brake repairs, or tire services. After your ride you can wait in the customer area with coffee and updates, and in the evening head to nearby Pilsner Urquell Brewery for a tour and a fresh beer.

name: JS Moto Brno
description: The JS Moto Brno is a professional motorcycle repair and tuning workshop in Brno’s city center, making it an essential stop for bikers prepping for Moravian circuits or Masaryk Circuit track days. It is just a short ride from the D1 highway and main train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a high-tech bay where you can drop off your bike for performance upgrades, suspension tuning, or race prep. After your ride you can discuss mods with the crew in the lounge, and in the evening head to nearby Špilberk Castle for a panoramic walk or a beer at a local microbrewery.

name: Schrott
description: The Schrott Bar is a cozy, motorcycle-themed pub tucked in Brno’s old town, making it a welcoming stop for bikers to relax after rides through Moravia. It’s just a short ride from the D1 highway and main train station, with convenient motorcycle parking right outside. Inside, you’ll find vintage bike posters on the walls, a relaxed vibe with wooden tables, and a solid selection of local Czech beers on tap. After your ride, settle in with a cold pint, chat with fellow riders, or enjoy the evening live music. It’s the perfect spot to unwind before heading to nearby Špilberk Castle for a quiet walk.

name: Moto Matěj
description: The Moto Matěj is a no-frills motorcycle repair and accessory shop in Ostrava’s suburban area, making it an essential stop for bikers tackling Silesian industrial routes or Beskydy mountain runs. It is just a short ride from the D1 highway and local train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a straightforward workshop where you can drop off your bike for chain service, brake checks, or seasonal prep. After your ride you can pick up basic gear like oils or filters, and in the evening head to nearby Ostrava Zoo for a quick detour or a beer at a local pub.

name: Joe Bar Team
description: Joe Bar Team is a biker-style bar-restaurant located in Vernayaz, Valais, Switzerland. The interior features a motorcycle theme throughout: bike memorabilia, rock music elements and a laid-back, energetic ambiance. The menu offers snacks, burgers and drinks, making it a favorite among travelers, locals and motorcycle enthusiasts alike. It’s an ideal spot for an evening out: music, chats with friends and a chilled yet lively atmosphere. You’ll often find groups of motorcyclists and road-trip fans gathering here after a ride to unwind and socialize.

name: Le Bonanza Pub
description: Le Bonanza Pub is located in Villars-le-Terroir in canton Vaud and welcomes guests into a biker-style bar-club with a Wild West vibe. The interior features motorcycle- and rock-themed décor, creating a high-energy, informal atmosphere. The bar offers a selection of craft beers and premium whiskies, while the menu includes snacks and light meals ideal for an evening out. Live concerts, karaoke nights and themed events take place regularly, making it a hub for social nightlife. Outdoor terrace seating and dedicated motorcycle parking add comfort for bikers and road-trip visitors.

name: HR Giger - Bar & Museum
description: The HR Giger Bar & Museum is located in Château St-Germain in the medieval town of Gruyères, canton Fribourg. The bar was created by Swiss artist Hans Ruedi Giger and is entirely designed in a biomechanical style — the walls, ceiling, furniture and lighting resemble the skeletal structures of alien beings. Stepping inside feels like entering the body of a fantastical creature, where art and architecture merge into one surreal environment. The bar serves drinks and light snacks; although the menu is limited, the atmosphere makes it an unforgettable experience. Adjacent to the Giger Museum, visitors can also explore original artworks and film concepts from “Alien.” This extraordinary place is perfect for those who wish to experience the fusion of art, science fiction and cinematic history in one setting.

name: Moto Suchý
description: The Moto Suchý is a reliable motorcycle repair and parts shop in Hradec Králové’s quiet outskirts, making it an essential stop for bikers prepping for Krkonoše mountain runs or Elbe valley cruises. It is just a short ride from the D11 highway and local train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a well-equipped workshop where you can drop off your bike for suspension tuning, exhaust repairs, or winter storage. After your ride you can stock up on oils and accessories, and in the evening head to nearby White Tower for a panoramic view or a beer at a riverside pub.

name: Moto Hlaváček s.r.o.
description: The Moto Hlaváček s.r.o. is a full-service motorcycle dealership and repair center in Olomouc’s industrial zone, making it an essential stop for bikers gearing up for Jeseníky mountain passes or Haná plain cruises. It is just a short ride from the D35 highway and main train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the shop offers a modern workshop where you can drop off your bike for warranty service, ECU tuning, or crash repairs. After your ride you can test-ride new models in the showroom, and in the evening head to nearby Holy Trinity Column for a UNESCO walk or a beer at a traditional Moravian pub.

name: Hostinec u Rotundy
description: The Hostinec u Rotundy is a traditional Czech pub nestled in Prague's Vinohrady district, making it an excellent stop for bikers winding down after city loops or Vltava rides. It is just a short ride from the D1 highway and metro station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the pub offers a small courtyard where you can park your bike securely. After your ride you can relax in wood-paneled rooms with hearty portions, and in the evening enjoy a pint of Pilsner Urquell while listening to local folk tunes or chatting with regulars.

name: The Dubliner Irish Bar
description: The Dubliner Irish Bar is a lively Irish pub in Prague’s city center, making it an excellent stop for bikers craving a Guinness after urban rides or Vltava loops. It is just a short ride from the D1 highway and metro station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the pub offers nearby paid parking where you can leave your bike safely. After your ride you can relax in cozy wooden interiors with live sports on big screens, and in the evening enjoy Irish folk music sessions or a proper pint with fish & chips.

name: The Dutch Pub - Steak & Burger
description: The The Dutch Pub - Steak & Burger is a hearty Dutch-inspired pub in Prague’s bustling Karlín district, making it an excellent stop for bikers craving a steak after Vltava river runs or D8 highway dashes. It is just a short ride from the D1 highway and metro station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the pub offers a small side street where you can park your bike securely. After your ride you can relax in lively interiors with craft beers, and in the evening enjoy a juicy burger with fries while catching a game on the TV or chatting with fellow travelers.

name: Ventura pub - Evropák
description: The Ventura pub - Evropák is a welcoming local pub in Karlovy Vary’s spa district, making it an excellent stop for bikers soaking up thermal vibes after Krušné hory mountain loops. It is just a short ride from the D6 highway and main bus station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the pub offers a small lot where you can park your bike securely. After your ride you can relax in casual interiors with Czech lagers, and in the evening enjoy grilled sausages while watching the colonnade lights or chatting with spa-goers.

name: Comix Kitchen & Bar
description: The Comix Kitchen & Bar is a quirky comic-book themed restaurant in Plzeň's historic center, making it an excellent stop for bikers to refuel after brewery tours or D5 highway dashes. It is just a short ride from the D5 highway and main train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the restaurant offers a small courtyard where you can park your bike securely. After your ride you can relax in vibrant interiors with superhero murals, and in the evening enjoy burgers and craft beers while flipping through comic books or watching a match on TV.

name: The Mist České Budějovice
description: The Mist České Budějovice is a modern craft-beer bar in the heart of České Budějovice, making it an excellent stop for bikers sampling Budvar after South Bohemian lake loops. It is just a short ride from the D3 highway and main train station, with easy vehicle access suitable for motorcycles. On-site the bar offers nearby paid parking where you can leave your bike securely. After your ride you can relax in sleek interiors with 20+ taps, and in the evening enjoy a flight of local IPAs while watching the sunset over the Vltava or joining a pub quiz.

name: Chaos Lounge
description: Chaos Lounge is a stylish lounge bar located in the heart of Tábor, offering a perfect spot for motor-travelers to unwind after a long ride. The bar features premium hookahs, aromatic tea blends, and signature cocktails. Its cozy interior and welcoming atmosphere make it an ideal place to relax in the evening. During the warmer months, guests can enjoy a pleasant outdoor terrace. Chaos Lounge is a great stop for riders who appreciate comfort and high-quality leisure on their journey.

name: AUX Café
description: AUX Bar is a chic bar located in the heart of Tábor at Žižkova 249. The interior blends original décor with modern art-deco furnishings, creating a refined but relaxed ambiance. The drink menu features an extensive selection of premium rums from around the world, fine spirits, and both classic and signature cocktails. The bar also hosts themed events – DJ nights, cultural shows, and live performances – perfect for a memorable stop during your ride. Ideal for bikers looking for a stylish rest stop on the road.

name: Výčep Na Stojáka
description: Výčep Na Stojáka is a legendary stand-only beer bar located in the center of Brno at Běhounská 16. It offers draught beers from small Czech breweries, including its own signature brew “Stojácké Poupě”. The no-seating concept creates a lively, social atmosphere where guests enjoy their drinks while standing. The bar is well-known among locals for its authenticity and energetic vibe. A great stop for motor-travelers looking for a quick refreshment and a taste of true Brno culture.

name: The Erin's Flag Irish Pub
description: THE ERIN’S FLAG Irish Pub is a stylish Irish-style pub located on Biskupská street in the centre of Brno. It offers a wide selection of imported beers and ciders, an extensive menu of whiskies, rums and gins, plus homemade cuisine including burgers, shepherd’s pie and daily-baked sourdough bread. The interior features classic Irish pub elements—wood-panelled bar, cosy seating zones and large screens for sports—making it a relaxed place to unwind after riding. The opening hours extend late on Fridays and Saturdays, which is perfect for motor-travelers looking for a lively evening stop.

name: Drapal Restaurant
description: Restaurace Drápal is a spacious restaurant located in Olomouc at Havlíčkova 1. It offers Czech and traditional Bohemian cuisine, including steaks, pastas, vegetarian dishes, and classic mains. The venue features a summer terrace and a banquet hall, and accepts card payments. With a warm, traditional ambiance and solid drink selection, it makes a comfortable stop for motor-travelers looking to refresh during their journey.

name: Bernard Bar Olomouc
description: Bernard Bar Olomouc is located at Horní náměstí 18, right in the heart of Olomouc. The bar is known for its own beer brand, including unfiltered lagers and dark 12° varieties. With a menu that features burgers, ribs and wings, it offers a satisfying mix of good food and great beer — perfect for a rider’s stop. On weekends it stays open late (until 2 AM on Fridays and Saturdays), making it a convenient evening stop on your journey.

name: Bernard Bar Brno
description: Bernard Bar Brno is located at Svatopetrská 35/7 in the Komárov district of Brno. The bar focuses on Bernard brand beers — light, unfiltered and dark varieties — and pairs them with a high‑quality food menu featuring burgers, steaks and more. It is open daily from 11:00 until 23:00 (until 22:00 on Sundays), making it a convenient evening stop for motor‑travelers. With its relaxed lounge atmosphere, friendly service and focus on good beer and food, it’s a great place to unwind during your ride.

name: Panská restaurace a pivovar Telč
description: Panský dvůr Telč is a restaurant set in the charming courtyard of the historic manor complex in Telč. It offers classic Czech cuisine with a modern twist, prepared from fresh, locally sourced seasonal ingredients. The restaurant features its own brewery on site, presenting signature beers including lager and IPA specialties. It frequently hosts gastronomic events and festivals, adding a festive vibe on special days. A wonderful stop for travelers seeking culture, ambiance, and good food along their route.

name: Beer bar Pioneer
description: Pivní bar Pionýr is a cozy beer bar located at Skupova 4 in Plzeň. It offers a varied selection of draft beers, along with other drinks and light snacks. The venue features amenities such as accessibility for guests with disabilities, a terrace, and pet‑friendly areas. A great choice for motor‑travelers looking for a good beer and a relaxed vibe.

name: Dublin Pub
description: Bastila Pub is a lively Irish pub located on Stodolní Street in Ostrava, operating late into the night. They serve local Czech beers (notably Plzeň) and draught Guinness in a stylish wood‑accented interior. Evenings bring R&B and club music, making it a hub for nightlife and socializing. It functions both as a bar and a club and regularly hosts events. A solid stop for riders looking for good drinks and urban nightlife vibes.

name: Grandezza restaurant
description: Grandezza Restaurant is located in the heart of Brno at Zelný trh 2 (or 314/2) and serves light Mediterranean cuisine focusing on high‑quality ingredients. The stylish and relaxed ambiance makes it a great stop for riders seeking a comfortable meal in the city. Perfect for those who want a pleasant break with quality food during their journey.

name: U Kroka
description: U Kroka restaurant nestles in Prague's vibrant Praha 2 district, just a stone's throw from the scenic Havlíčkovy Sady park, making it a perfect pit stop for motorcyclists tackling the twisting urban routes of the Czech capital. It's a go-to spot for bikers, thanks to nearby ample parking and a laid-back vibe where riders swap tales of the road over frothy pints of fresh Pilsner beer. The menu shines with preservative-free Czech classics like juicy pork knuckle, hearty goulash with dumplings, and crispy duck, all served in generous portions at wallet-friendly prices. The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, with English-speaking staff delivering friendly, attentive service in a pub-style setting ideal for casual biker meetups. Book ahead, especially on weekends when it buzzes with crowds, and double-check opening hours to ensure your crew doesn't get turned away.

name: Výtopna
description: Výtopna restaurant sits right on the platform of Prague’s main train station (Hlavní nádraží), turning a quick layover into a fun biker stop with model trains delivering beer straight to your table. Riders love the easy street access, secure parking nearby, and the chance to refuel without lingering far from the bike. The menu sticks to hearty Czech staples — pork knuckle, roasted knee, house sausages, and fresh salads — all in generous, budget-friendly portions. The vibe is lively and buzzing, with friendly staff and the playful train service delighting both kids and road-weary motorcyclists. Expect crowds during rush hours and note that it closes at night — best visited midday or early evening.

name: Caffe Vescovi
description: Vescovi coffee shop sits in Prague’s historic heart, just steps from Charles Bridge, offering motorcyclists a perfect pause while navigating the cobblestone maze of the Old Town. Bikers park right at the door on the quiet side street with room for a handful of machines and dive into the scent of freshly roasted beans served table-side. The menu revolves around in-house roasted premium blends — from bold espresso to velvety cappuccino — paired with homemade pastries and light sandwiches. The vibe is cozy and passionate, with baristas eager to share the story behind each roast while riders unwind from twisty roads. Open from early morning to late evening, but arrive early on weekends — seats fill fast with tourists and local moto enthusiasts.

name: Hell's Mine (Bikers' Cave)
description: Hell's Mine Viewpoint perches on a cliff in the core of Český ráj, 80 km from Prague, rewarding riders with a sweeping vista of snaking valleys, pine forests, and sandstone crags after a final gravel climb. Motorcyclists park right at the cave entrance, framing their bikes against wild scenery — perfect for high-altitude shots and a breather post-thrill trails. The lookout inside the cave features wooden benches overlooking the ride-in loop and fire pit, with clear-day views stretching to Jičín’s silhouette. The vibe is raw: wind, pine scent, engine echoes off rock — a spot to linger, recharge, and plot the next twist. Free access in warm months (May–September), but bring water and check weather — post-rain the path slicks up, and clouds can steal the panorama.

name: Harley's
description: Harley's Bar is a genuine American-style biker club in central Prague (Pankrác), where riders roll in after urban twisties and park their machines right at the door on the bustling street. Rock blasts through the space, walls plastered with Harley plates and tattoo art, while the bar slings craft beer and stiff cocktails for road tales. The menu keeps it hearty and straightforward: juicy burgers, BBQ ribs, grilled steaks — all ~250–400 Kč, in portions that fuel a full day’s ride. The vibe is loud and fraternal, with live bands on weekends and staff who speak motorcycle fluently. Open late, but expect a crush on Friday–Saturday — arrive early or reserve a spot.

name: Restaurace Akvárko
description: Restaurace Akvárko nestles in the village of Stupava, 50 km from Brno, offering motorcyclists a perfect pause while tackling the twisty trails of South Moravia. Bikers park right at the door on the spacious lot with room for a dozen machines and enjoy the sight of the open kitchen crafting fresh meals. The menu revolves around daily Czech classics — from hot soups and pork knuckle to goulash with dumplings — paired with draft Budvar 33 or Pilsner Urquell. The vibe is modern and familial, with baristas eager to share hill route tips while riders unwind on the terrace after wine roads. Open from 9:30 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., but arrive early on weekends — terrace seats fill fast with tourists and local moto enthusiasts.

name: SKØG
description: SKØG Urban Hub sits in the very heart of Brno on Dominikánské Square, offering motorcyclists a convenient pause while navigating the bustling streets of the historic center. Bikers park right nearby on the square with room for a handful of machines and dive into the scent of specialty coffee or cocktails served table-side. The menu revolves around vegetarian and vegan options — from brunch sandwiches to snacks and desserts — paired with craft beer and wines. The vibe is stylish and Scandinavian, with baristas eager to share route tips while riders unwind in the cozy interior after urban twists. Open from early morning to late night (till 1:00 a.m. on Fridays-Saturdays), but arrive early on weekends — seats fill fast with tourists and local hipsters.

name: Mama's Hot Dogs, Burgers & Fries
description: Mama's Bistro sits in central Ostrava on Na Hradbách street, offering motorcyclists a handy stop after tackling the winding roads of the Silesian region with self-parking right at the door. It's a biker favorite thanks to the laid-back vibe where you can stash your ride and dive into authentic American cuisine without rush. The menu boasts hearty eats like burgers, steaks, and BBQ, all in generous portions at wallet-friendly prices — perfect for refueling after a long saddle day. The ambiance is warm and welcoming, with friendly staff, free Wi-Fi for route checks, and takeout options on the go. Open Wednesday to Saturday till 9:00 p.m. (kitchen till 7:45 p.m.), but closed Mondays, Tuesdays, and Sundays — best to verify hours ahead, especially if bringing a pet, as they're welcome here.

name: Gasthaus Passhöhe
description: Located at the foot of Mount Säntis, this is one of Eastern Switzerland’s most scenic biker cafés. The terrace offers views of the cable car and alpine meadows. The large parking area makes it ideal for group rides. The menu features simple, home-style food served quickly. On sunny days, the place turns into a real biker gathering. It’s open all year, though the atmosphere peaks in summer.

name: Restaurant Schwägalp
description: Restaurant Schwägalp is located at the foot of the Säntis mountain in the canton of Appenzell Ausserrhoden, Switzerland, at an altitude of around 1,278 m. The menu features traditional Swiss and Appenzell dishes prepared using fresh regional ingredients. The restaurant’s windows and terrace offer stunning views of the Säntis massif and surrounding alpine slopes, making it an ideal rest stop during a mountain excursion. The interior blends modern touches with a cozy alpine atmosphere: a spacious dining room, warm natural materials and generous windows letting in daylight. Open year-round, the venue is a popular choice among nature seekers and travelers traversing Swiss passes.

name: Restaurant Klausenpass
description: Located on the legendary Klausen Pass, this café has been a biker stop for decades. The view is pure postcard—alpine meadows and winding roads. The food is simple and hearty, ideal for a quick break. Riders from Uri and Glarus often meet here. The pass is open only in summer, so hours are seasonal. Nearby you’ll find the well-known biker hangout “Klause-Ranch.”

name: Restaurant Sustenpass
description: Restaurant Sustenpass is located at Sustenpass, 3863 Gadmen, Switzerland, sitting at over 2 000 meters above sea level. It’s a cozy mountain restaurant offering breathtaking views of glaciers, alpine peaks and valleys. The menu features traditional Swiss cuisine - cheese fondue, alpine macaroni and locally sourced meat dishes cooked with a homemade touch. The interior combines classic alpine design with wood, stone and wide panoramic windows that let in the surrounding beauty. It’s the perfect stop for a relaxing meal after a scenic drive or a mountain hike across the Susten Pass.

name: Restaurant Gabelspitz Schallenberg
description: Restaurant Gabelspitz is located at the Schallenberg pass (approximately 1 167 m above sea level) in the canton of Bern, Switzerland. Situated along a popular scenic route for motorcyclists and road-trip travellers, it serves as an excellent rest stop on the journey. The terrace offers stunning panoramic views over the Emmental valley and the Bernese Oberland mountains, regardless of season. The menu highlights home-style Swiss cuisine with a focus on regional ingredients: soups, “Berner Platte”, desserts and signature dishes. The interior is warm and welcoming: a spacious dining hall, wooden beams and a large terrace where you can unwind after a ride or walk.

name: Restaurant Raten
description: Restaurant Raten is situated at approximately 1,077 metres above sea level, between Oberägeri and Biberbrugg in the canton of Zug, Switzerland. From its panoramic terrace and large windows, guests can enjoy stunning views over Lake Ägeri and the surrounding alpine landscape. The menu features fresh, regional cuisine: seasonal dishes, a children’s menu and a fine selection of drinks and desserts. The interior combines a stylish dining hall, a cosy bar area and a large outdoor playground, making it ideal for family visits. Due to the restaurant’s popularity, it is recommended to reserve a table in advance, especially on weekends and holidays. Restaurant Raten is a perfect stop whether you’re on a mountain hike, meeting friends or enjoying a family meal surrounded by nature.

name: Bikers Bar
description: Bikers Bar Plzeň is an atmospheric biker-friendly spot in the center of Plzeň, featuring an authentic interior, rock music, and a welcoming crowd. Riders from all over the Czech Republic like to stop here for a beer, a snack, and some good company. The bar is located in the city center, so parking nearby is limited and some areas have no-parking signs. Motorcyclists are advised to plan ahead and use the nearest legal parking areas. Despite the parking restrictions, this bar remains an excellent stop for riders looking to rest, socialize, and meet the local biker community.

name: The Eight Rooftop Cocktail Bar
description:
Welcome to the Eight Rooftop. The Eight Rooftop is a cocktail bar located in the heart of Brussels. In this bar in the capital of Europe, you can enjoy a 180° panoramic view of the city of Brussels from our magnificent terrace. A wide selection of cocktails and snacks will be offered by our specialized waiters.

We offer of course a large terrace where you can sit and enjoy your cocktail but we also offer a big place at the inside of the bar. You can enjoy the rooftop and its view while being inside of the bar.

The Eight Rooftop is the bar to not miss when you are visiting Brussels. You can access the bar from the 8th floor of the Bedford hotel.

name: Le Petit Lion
description: A charming Belgian brasserie in the historic Marolles neighborhood, known for its classic moules-frites, seasonal Belgian beers, and cozy, traditional atmosphere.

name: Downtown Brussels
description: A vibrant cocktail bar and restaurant in the heart of Brussels, known for its creative drinks, lively atmosphere, and international menu—just steps from the Grand Place

name: Beer Capital Brussels
description: A modern beer bar in the heart of Brussels offering an extensive selection of Belgian craft beers and traditional classics, with knowledgeable staff to guide your tasting journey.

name: The Dubliner Irish Pub Brussels
description:
Dive into the authentic Irish experience right in the heart of Brussels. Nestled in the city’s central hub, The Dubliner Brussels stands out as a top destination for both locals and visitors.
Celebrate genuine Irish hospitality with a pint of our finest Irish beer, a testament to the age-old brewing traditions of the Emerald Isle.
But it’s not just about the drinks; this renowned establishment offers a full entertainment package.
Challenge your friends to a game of pool or darts, or simply revel in the vibrant atmosphere that’s always abuzz with energy.
Widely acclaimed for its welcoming ambiance and unmatched service, The Dubliner Brussels is not just a bar—it’s an institution.
Join the multitude of happy patrons and make memories to last a lifetime. Cheers!

name: Chez Juliette
description: A beloved family-run brasserie nestled in Namur’s historic center, Chez Juliette welcomes guests with its rustic wooden interiors, vintage decor, and the comforting aroma of traditional Walloon cuisine. Known for its generous portions and heartfelt service, this spot captures the soul of Belgian regional cooking. From the rich, beer-braised carbonnade namuroise to the delicate tarte al djote, each dish tells a story of local heritage. The beer list highlights artisanal brews from Wallonia, making it an ideal place to unwind after exploring the nearby Citadel or strolling along the Sambre River.

name: O'Flaherty's Irish Pub
description: A lively and welcoming Irish pub located right opposite the Namur train station, O'Flaherty's is a hub for both locals and travelers. With its dark wood interiors, classic pub decor, and friendly English-speaking staff, it offers an authentic Irish atmosphere in the heart of Wallonia. It's the perfect spot to enjoy a pint of Guinness, watch live sports on large screens, or join in the regular live music sessions. The menu features pub favorites like fish and chips, Irish stew, and hearty burgers.

name: Ravage Beer Bar
description:
The "RAVAGE Beer Bar": It's a new beer experience in Namur.

There's something for every taste: from comforting classics to discovery and adventure, thanks to a wide range of quality products chosen just for you. Everything is advised and presented by professionals!

In an atmosphere conducive to both celebration and tasting, you can exchange ideas, meet, and share with other enthusiasts.

It's a human-scale project, made for beer lovers by beer lovers!

For those curious souls who might be less drawn to hoppy beverages, don't panic! A range of soft drinks, wines, spirits and cocktails will also be available!

But that's not all! We will organize tastings, blind tests, themed evenings... and more depending on your wishes.

Here you are here to enjoy yourself and feel right at home!

name: La Bodeguita del Medio
description: A vibrant Cuban-themed restaurant and cocktail bar inspired by the original Havana establishment, La Bodeguita del Medio brings a slice of Cuba to the heart of Kortrijk. Famous for its mojitos, lively atmosphere, and walls covered in signatures and messages from visitors, it’s a place where music, rum, and good times flow freely. The menu features Cuban and Latin American classics like ceviche, empanadas, and ropa vieja, all enjoyed in a setting filled with tropical vibes and salsa rhythms.

name: Gainsbar
description: A stylish and sophisticated cocktail bar in the heart of Kortrijk, Gainsbar is known for its expertly crafted drinks, elegant Art Deco-inspired interior, and intimate, moody ambiance. Named as a playful nod to the legendary Serge Gainsbourg, the bar exudes a sense of timeless cool. The skilled bartenders create both classic and innovative cocktails using premium spirits and house-made infusions. It’s the perfect spot for a pre-dinner aperitif or a late-night drink in a refined yet relaxed setting.

name: Motorcycle Rental Zürich
description: Motorcycle Rental Zürich is a motorcycle and scooter rental company located in Zurich, Switzerland. It offers a wide range of models - from touring enduros to sporty road bikes - making it a popular choice among travellers. The rental price includes helmets, roadside insurance, and advice on scenic routes such as the Swiss alpine passes. The bikes are in excellent condition, and the staff help select the model that best fits the rider’s experience and preferences. It’s a perfect option for those who wish to explore mountain roads, enjoy the freedom of riding, and discover new routes across Switzerland.

name: RIBE Moto AG
description: RIBE Moto AG is a modern motorcycle rental platform based in Switzerland, designed for two-wheel enthusiasts. The company offers a wide range of bikes - from touring enduros to sporty road models - available for daily or long-term rentals. The service includes bike selection based on rider experience, rental assistance and technical support. RIBE Moto AG is the perfect choice for anyone wishing to explore Switzerland’s scenic routes on two wheels without owning a motorcycle.

name: Mister Spaghetti
description: A modern and vibrant pasta bar in the heart of Amsterdam, Mister Spaghetti specializes in fresh, customizable pasta dishes. With a focus on quality ingredients and a lively, casual atmosphere, it's the perfect spot for a quick yet delicious meal. Choose your pasta type, sauce, and toppings to create your perfect bowl. The open kitchen and contemporary design make it a popular choice for both locals and tourists looking for a satisfying and affordable dining experience.

name: De Garage Kortrijk
description:
