Expect simplicity with soul. Established classics and desirable suggestions for your goût du jour. Simple yet sublime meat, the freshest fish, pasta alla mamma. Homegrown vegetables. Bread, beer, wine, and countless drinks that speak your language. And they tell you a whole story.

We choose every dish and drink we'll serve you: local or locally sourced, powerful quality, infused with flavor, honest food that hits the spot.

name: Fritzguard
description: A stylish and contemporary brasserie in the heart of Brussels, Fritzguard combines Belgian culinary tradition with a modern, cosmopolitan twist. Known for its elegant Art Nouveau-inspired interior, relaxed yet sophisticated ambiance, and a menu that celebrates both classic and innovative dishes, it's a favorite among locals and in-the-know visitors. The bar serves an excellent selection of Belgian beers, curated wines, and creative cocktails, making it ideal for everything from a business lunch to a romantic dinner or late-night drinks.

name: La Brouette
description: Traditional brasserie with views of the Grand Place, terrace seating, wooden booths & crown lamps.

name: Fin de Siècle
description: A legendary and wildly popular brasserie in central Brussels, Fin de Siècle captures the free-spirited, artistic vibe of the "end of the century" Belle Époque era. Known for its no-reservations policy, communal seating, and daily-changing menu scrawled on chalkboards, it offers a uniquely authentic and bustling Belgian experience. The food is hearty, traditional, and generously portioned, focusing on classic dishes like rabbit in prune beer sauce, stoemp, and vol-au-vent, all best enjoyed with a sturdy Belgian beer. The atmosphere is loud, lively, and unpretentious—a true local institution.

name: MOLFAR
description: MOLFAR is a modern and innovative restaurant in Brussels that takes its name from Carpathian folk sorcerers, weaving a concept of "culinary magic" into its dining experience. It offers a creative and refined take on Eastern European cuisine, reimagining traditional dishes with contemporary techniques and high-quality local ingredients. The intimate and stylish setting, combined with a carefully curated wine list and cocktail menu, makes it a unique and memorable spot for food enthusiasts looking to explore beyond classic Belgian fare.

name: Hispania Brussels
description:
Our restaurant offers a variety of spaces: The Brasserie, El Impasse del Sablon, and the VIP Room, each with its own unique atmosphere. Whether for a casual visit or a special gathering, we have the perfect setting to welcome you.
Symphony of flavors that honor the rich tapestry of Spanish culinary heritage. From inspired tapas to exquisite signature creations, each plate is a masterpiece, inviting you to savor the essence of Spain.

name: The Jane
description: Chic eatery in an ex-chapel with soaring ceilings, a glassed-in kitchen & high-concept plates.

name: Pazzo
description: Pazzo is a vibrant and trendy Italian restaurant in the heart of Antwerp, known for its authentic pizzas, homemade pasta, and lively atmosphere. The name "Pazzo," which means "crazy" in Italian, reflects the restaurant's energetic and welcoming vibe. With an open kitchen, rustic decor, and a menu focused on fresh, high-quality ingredients, it’s a popular spot for both locals and visitors looking for a taste of Italy in a cozy yet bustling setting.

name: Le Shanghai
address: Galerie Cathédrale, Pl. de la Cathédrale 104/1er étage
description: An elegant and authentic Chinese restaurant situated in the heart of Liège, Le Shanghai offers a refined dining experience with panoramic views of the Cathedral of Saint Paul. Specializing in traditional and contemporary Chinese cuisine, the restaurant is known for its delicate dim sum, flavorful Peking duck, and a wide variety of seafood and wok dishes. The interior combines modern Asian aesthetics with classic touches, creating a serene and upscale atmosphere perfect for special occasions or business dinners.

name: Motos Center sprl
description: A trusted motorcycle service, repair, and sales center in Liège, offering comprehensive maintenance, mechanical repairs, and a selection of new and used bikes for both casual riders and touring enthusiasts.

name: Bikers Design
description: A unique motorcycle customization, apparel, and lifestyle shop in Liège, specializing in custom bike builds, branded biker gear, and a curated selection of accessories for riders who value style and individuality.

name: Motorkit
description: A well-stocked motorcycle parts and accessories store near Liège, offering a wide range of components, tools, and gear for maintenance, repair, and customization of various motorcycle brands.

name: American Fever sprl
description: A specialized workshop and dealership focused on American motorcycles, particularly Harley-Davidson. The company offers sales of new and used bikes, custom builds, maintenance, repairs, and a wide range of authentic parts and accessories. It's a go-to spot for fans of the American motorcycle culture in the Liège region.

name: Moto Store - Liège
description: A modern motorcycle dealership and service center near Liège, offering a diverse range of new and used motorcycles, from sport and adventure bikes to scooters and urban models. The store provides sales, maintenance, repairs, and a selection of gear and accessories, making it a one-stop shop for riders in the region.

name: American Fever sprl
description: A specialized Harley-Davidson and American motorcycle hub in Liège, offering sales of new and used bikes, custom builds, genuine parts, servicing, and repairs for riders dedicated to the classic American cruiser lifestyle.

name: Moto tech Atelier
description: A professional motorcycle service and customization workshop in the Brussels region, specializing in maintenance, mechanical repairs, and custom projects for a wide range of motorcycle brands and styles.

name: Moto Rent Bern
description: Moto Rent Bern is a motorcycle rental service in Bern, Switzerland, offering an excellent way to explore the region on two wheels. The fleet includes a wide variety of bikes - from light city motorcycles to powerful touring enduros suitable for alpine roads. Rental services include protective gear and technical assistance, making your ride safer and more convenient. The staff also assists with route recommendations and gives advice on scenic motorcycle roads around Bern. To ensure availability of your preferred model and convenient pick-up, it’s advisable to book your motorcycle in advance.

name: MKC Moto Antwerpen
description: : A full-service motorcycle center near Antwerp offering sales of new and used bikes, professional repairs, maintenance, and a wide range of accessories and gear for touring, sport, and urban riding.

name: Moteo Nv
description: A major motorcycle distribution and logistics center in Flanders, specializing in wholesale parts, accessories, and apparel for dealerships and repair shops across Belgium and Europe.

name: Star mobility
description: A scooter and motorcycle dealership in Antwerp specializing in urban mobility solutions, offering sales of new and used scooters (50cc–125cc), light motorcycles, and electric models, along with maintenance and repairs.

name: MTY Motors
description: A motorcycle and scooter dealership in the Brussels region, offering sales of new and used two-wheelers, along with maintenance, repairs, and spare parts, with a focus on urban and commuter models.

name: Moto-Center Bern
description: Moto-Center Bern is located in Bern, Switzerland, at Freiburgstrasse 384. It is a large motorcycle hub offering bikes, gear, accessories and maintenance under one roof. The showroom features top-brand models and seasonal collections, with staff ready to help riders find the perfect motorcycle. A professional service area provides maintenance and accessory installation on site.

name: MVZ Motorradvermietung Zentralschweiz
description: MVZ Motorradvermietung Zentralschweiz is a motorcycle rental service located in the heart of Switzerland. The company offers a wide range of models - from light city bikes to powerful enduros and sport motorcycles. The rental price includes maintenance, insurance and a set mileage allowance. The service suits both beginners and experienced riders, allowing everyone to find the right bike for their needs. Due to seasonal demand and limited stock, it’s recommended to book in advance, especially during peak riding months.

name: BikerShop.BXL
description: A comprehensive motorcycle gear and accessories store in Brussels, offering a wide range of riding apparel, helmets, protection, and custom parts for urban commuters and touring enthusiasts.

name: Kiels Scooter center - Kymco en GTS scooters
description: An authorized Kymco and GTS scooter dealership in Antwerp, offering new and used scooters, genuine parts, professional repairs, and maintenance services for urban commuters and delivery riders.

name: Rent-n-Ride Lausanne
description: Rent-n-Ride Lausanne is a motorcycle and gear rental service located at Avenue Juste-Olivier 23, 1006 Lausanne, Switzerland. The company offers a wide range of motorcycles - from 125 cc bikes to more powerful models - catering to different skill levels. The rental price typically includes a helmet, basic protective gear, technical inspection and route advice for the Lausanne and Lake Geneva area. Advance booking of motorcycles and gear is recommended, especially during the high season.

name: Antwerp Bike Store
description:
A modern bicycle and e-bike store in Antwerp offering sales, repairs, and maintenance for city, trekking, and electric bicycles, with a focus on sustainable urban mobility.
Multi-brand store, scooters, mopeds, and motorcycles, modern or vintage...
Can't find what you're looking for? Send us an email or visit our store, where we're happy to help!

name: Twins2wielers Antwerpen
description: A motorcycle and scooter dealership in Antwerp offering new and used bikes, professional maintenance, repairs, and genuine parts, with a focus on Japanese and European brands for city and touring riding.

name: Roli's Motostyling GmbH
description: Roli’s Motostyling GmbH is a custom motorcycle workshop and showroom located near Zurich. They offer a full range of services: from routine maintenance to bespoke tuning and styling projects for bikes. The showroom and workshop are filled with unique custom bikes, accessories and modifications that reflect the rider’s personality. Their team assists clients in selecting style elements, components and accessories tailored to their preferences and the machine’s potential. It’s advisable to book ahead for a consultation or to schedule a custom project, especially if you’re planning a unique rebuild.

name: Motorshop Gent
description: A full-service motorcycle and scooter dealership offering new and used bikes, professional repairs, maintenance, and genuine parts for urban commuting and touring.

name: Mono 500 Events
description: An event space and motorcycle culture hub in Brussels, specializing in motorcycle-themed events, workshops, and community gatherings, with a focus on café racer and custom bike culture.

name: Eddy Sport
description:
For over 60 years, Eddy Sport has been your trusted choice for urban mobility in Brussels.
Come visit us today and discover why our expertise and commitment to quality make us your urban mobility partner of choice.Founded in 1989, CF MOTO is a globally recognized brand known for its engineering expertise and innovation. Present in over 100 countries, it has established itself as a benchmark in quality, design, and performance.

name: HARLEY-DAVIDSON LIÈGE
description: An official Harley-Davidson dealership in Liège offering new and used motorcycles, genuine parts, branded merchandise, and certified service for the iconic American brand.

name: Vespa Tours Brugge
description: A guided scooter tour service in Bruges offering Vespa rentals and themed routes through the city's medieval streets, picturesque canals, and surrounding Flemish countryside.

name: Rent & Go
description:
A vehicle and equipment rental service offering scooters, motorcycles, cargo bikes, and light transport solutions for both leisure and practical needs in the Flanders region. Rent & Go brings Italian charm to our Leie region with Vespa rentals. Our central location in Machelen aan den Leie makes us an excellent base for exploring the region's beauty in a relaxed and comfortable way by Vespa.

Starting from Machelen aan den Leie, you can enjoy a fun tour of the Leie region with friends, family, or colleagues. For those who want to venture beyond the Leie region, our central location also makes it easy to explore the hilly Flemish Ardennes by Vespa.

The charming villages and towns in the region, along with our routes and packages, offer you the opportunity to have a wonderful day.

For singles, team-building activities, or simply to put someone in the spotlight, we also have a "Pink Vespa."

name: Vespa2rent.be / Vespabar Bossuit Vlaamse Ardennen
description: A Vespa rental service and scooter-themed bar in the scenic Flemish Ardennes, offering scooter rentals for exploring the hilly countryside and a cozy spot for drinks afterwards.

name: Scootevents
description:
Welcome to Scootevents
With our electric scooters you can discover Gaasbeek Castle and the Pajottenland in a unique and sustainable way.

Scootevents has 10 scooters available and the departure point is always in the village of Gaasbeek.

name: ScootMoment
description: A scooter rental and tour service in the Flemish countryside, offering modern scooters for exploring the peaceful polder landscapes, historic villages, and coastal paths of northern Belgium.

name: Ooike Vespa's
description:
Welcome to Ooike Vespa's.
"Scooting and enjoying bliss" in the heart of the Flemish Ardennes with our charming Vespas.
From Ooike (Wortegem-Petegem) you can discover Flanders with its Flemish cultural heritage, the many hilly small roads and numerous culinary establishments.

name: Eddy Sport
description:
Welcome
For over 60 years, Eddy Sport has been your trusted choice for urban mobility in Brussels.
Come visit us today and discover why our expertise and commitment to quality make us your urban mobility partner of choice.
This means you can now find the entire CF MOTO range directly from us: innovative, high-performance and accessible motorcycles, designed to offer a unique riding experience.

name: Mont des Arts
description: Small downtown area on a hill, with a landscaped garden, museums, and notable architecture. A breathtaking panoramic viewpoint and cultural square in central Brussels, offering one of the city's most iconic vistas – a symmetrical garden staircase framing the historic guildhouses of the Grand Place clock tower in the distance.

name: Cauchie House
description: Architect Paul Cauchie's art nouveau mansion, built in 1905, with an ornate facade & guided tours.

name: Napoléon, l'Épopée Immersive • Bruxelles
description: A cutting-edge immersive exhibition in Brussels that brings Napoleon Bonaparte's epic story to life through 360° projections, soundscapes, and interactive displays, set within the monumental Cinquantenaire architecture.

name: Het Coudenbergpaleis
description: Museum & archaeological site on medieval palace foundations with excavations on display.

name: Autoworld
description: From vintage carriages to iconic racing cars, via presidential limousines in a spacious car museum.

name: Royal Palace of Brussels
description: Palace of the constitutional monarchy, with throne & other state rooms open for tours each summer.

name: Maison Saint-Cyr
description: An architectural masterpiece of Brussels' Art Nouveau movement, designed by architect Gustave Strauven in 1903, celebrated for its extraordinary narrow facade (just 4 meters wide), intricate ironwork, and vibrant polychrome brick patterns.

name: Het Steen
description: Landmark city center medieval fortress & Antwerp's oldest building set along the riverfront.

name: The oldest house of Antwerp
description: A meticulously preserved 13th-century Gothic townhouse, considered Antwerp's oldest surviving residential building, featuring distinctive stepped gables, historical timber framing, and a rare glimpse into medieval urban life.

name: Waterpoort
description: A historic water gate and bridge spanning the former city moat, built in 1937 as part of Antwerp's urban development, blending medieval-inspired architecture with early 20th-century engineering.

name: Zuivelbrugstraat
description: A charming stone arch bridge spanning the Graslei canal, known for its picturesque views of Ghent's medieval guildhouses and bustling waterfront, originally built for dairy traders accessing the old market.

name: Gentse Winterfeesten
description: Ghent's magical festival transforming the historic city center into a seasonal wonderland with ice rinks, festive markets, light installations, and traditional Belgian holiday treats from late November through January.

name: Terril du Bois du Cazier
description: A striking conical slag heap near the historic Bois du Cazier mining site, now reforested and accessible via trails, offering panoramic views of Charleroi's industrial landscape and serving as a symbol of the region's mining heritage and ecological transformation.

name: Zaha Hadidplein
description: A striking public square and architectural landmark named after visionary architect Zaha Hadid, featuring her signature fluid concrete forms and dynamic urban design that redefines Antwerp's modern waterfront identity.

name: Pagodepoort
description: A vibrant ceremonial gate marking the entrance to Antwerp's Chinatown, gifted by the Chinese community in 2019, blending traditional Asian architectural elements with the city's urban fabric as a symbol of cultural friendship.

name: Michiel Coignet Observatorium
description: A private observatory built in 1933-34 for astronomer Michiel Coignet, hidden within an Art Nouveau residential block, representing a unique fusion of scientific pursuit and architectural elegance in early 20th-century Antwerp.

name: Les Enfants Noyés
description: A poignant natural rock formation and historic site in the Bois de la Cambre forest, named "The Drowned Children" after a local 19th-century tragedy, where eroded sandstone creates haunting shapes that spark both geological interest and somber reflection.

name: Uitzicht Brussel-Congres
description: A hidden rooftop viewpoint offering a surprising panoramic perspective of Brussels' Congress district, showcasing the contrast between historic 19th-century architecture and modern urban development, with the iconic Congress Column as the centerpiece.

name: International Rose Garden Courtrai
description: A magnificent 3.5-hectare rose garden surrounding a historic castle, featuring over 10,000 rose bushes representing 300 varieties from around the world, creating a breathtaking floral spectacle from May through October.

name: Budabeach
description: A vibrant urban beach and summer pop-up venue on the banks of the Lys River, featuring sandy shores, palm trees, beach bars, and recreational activities that bring a Mediterranean vibe to the heart of Flanders from May to September.

name: P-plads, Knudmosebjerget
description: A scenic viewpoint and parking area atop Knudmosebjerget hill, offering panoramic views of Herning's distinctive heathland landscape and modern architecture, including the iconic Herning Museum of Contemporary Art.

name: LEGO House
description: Attraction showcasing the brand's colorful building sets & toys, plus interactive play areas.

name: LEGO Miniland
description: The original and most iconic section of LEGOLAND Billund, featuring incredibly detailed miniature landscapes of global landmarks, cities, and airports built from over 20 million LEGO bricks at 1:20 scale.

name: Runkenbjerg
description: A prominent 97-meter hill in East Jutland, known as one of the highest points in the region, offering panoramic views over Vejle Valley and surrounding forests, with cultural significance in local folklore.

name: Vejle Windmill
description: A beautifully preserved 19th-century Dutch-style windmill perched atop a hill, offering panoramic views of Vejle Fjord and the city, serving as both a historical landmark and popular viewpoint.

name: Vejle Havn Mole
description: A modern harbor pier and public space in Vejle's revitalized port area, featuring industrial-chic design, maritime atmosphere, and views of the fjord, with access to boats, restaurants, and cultural events.

name: Kongestolen
description: A dramatic 90-meter-high cliff formation in the Silkeborg Lakes region, known as "The King's Throne," offering breathtaking panoramic views over Denmark's Lake District and accessible via scenic hiking trails.

name: Arnakke Spring
description: A historic natural spring and picturesque forest clearing in the Silkeborg woodlands, known for its crystal-clear water, tranquil atmosphere, and traditional Danish spring house, popular for walks and nature contemplation.

name: Viewpoint - Birkehøj Silkeborg
description: A serene hilltop viewpoint in the Silkeborg forests, offering peaceful panoramas over mixed woodlands and rolling hills, known for its birch groves and tranquil atmosphere away from crowded tourist spots.

name: Lyshøj
description: A scenic hill and viewpoint near Viborg, offering panoramic views over Lake Flesø and the surrounding countryside, popular for walks, picnics, and sunset watching in Central Jutland.

name: Inderøen
description: A peaceful peninsula and nature area extending into Lake Flesø, featuring walking trails, birdwatching opportunities, and serene water views, creating an ideal escape into Viborg's natural landscapes.

name: Amalienborg Palace
description: 18th-century rococo complex of palaces, with a museum & marches/displays by royal guards.

name: Rosenborg Castle
description: Dutch Renaissance palace & gardens, including a museum housing the crown jewels, with guided tours.

name: Kronborg Castle
description: 16th-century castle with banqueting hall & royal chambers, the model for Elsinore in Hamlet.

name: Frederiksborg Castle
description: Elegant lakeside palace donated to the country & now housing a museum of Danish & royal history.

name: Dronningholm Castle Ruin
description: The atmospheric ruins of a 16th-century Renaissance castle nestled in a forest near Arresø Lake, offering a glimpse into Danish noble life and architectural history amid tranquil natural surroundings.

name: The Hermitage Palace
description: Guided tours of an 18th-century Baroque royal hunting lodge, originally used for lavish banquets.

name: Frederiksberg Slot
description: Early 18th-century palace in an Itlaian Baroque style with guided tours of former royal apartments.

name: Museum of Danish Resistance
description: Contemporary structure with subterranean exhibitions on the Danish resistance movement during WWII.

name: The Little Mermaid
description: Iconic bronze mermaid sculpture, by Edvard Eriksen, of a character from H.C. Andersen's fairytale.

name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
description: Fine art museum with antique Mediterranean sculptures, plus 19th-century French & Danish works.

name: Bike Station v / Anders Nielsen
description:
Do you also dream of experiencing the freedom of riding a motorcycle, but aren't quite ready to invest before you've tried it? Your friends want you to go on a motorcycle vacation, but you don't have the right motorcycle for the trip - or maybe you don't have a motorcycle at all?
Do you have a few days off, the weather is nice, and you just need to try something new and exciting?
Let the adventure on two wheels begin. Contact us today to book your next experience.

name: Dispensary, Whisk(e)y And Beer
description: A specialized beverage shop in Copenhagen's vibrant Nørrebro district, offering an extensive selection of craft beers, premium whiskies, and spirits in a cozy, knowledgeable environment perfect for connoisseurs and curious explorers alike.

name: Taphouse
description: Snacks, spirits & numerous beer taps are offered at this vibrant bar that has happy hour specials.

name: Dexter's
description:
Dexter’s is built on a lifetime behind the bar — 35 years of mixing drinks, meeting people, and bringing good vibes from the Caribbean to Copenhagen.
Originally from Jamaica, Dexter brings more than just experience — he brings culture, soul, and a deep love for the craft. The drinks here reflect that. You’ll taste tropical roots in every cocktail, balanced with the kind of know-how that only comes from years of doing what you love.
But it’s not just about what’s in the glass. It’s about the atmosphere — warm, welcoming, and full of life. We’ve created a space where people from all over feel at home. Whether you're here for a quick drink or a long night, you’ll feel the energy.
The music? It’s part of the story too. Expect Afrobeat, dancehall, reggae — sounds that move with the rhythm of the bar and tie into our motto: “Out of many, one people.”
This place is more than a bar. It’s a celebration of culture, community, and connection — all coming together under one roof.

name: MOTOWERK
description: MOTOWERK – Motorrad Service is a multifunctional motorcycle centre located in the Bern-Zurich region, combining workshop services, trade, tuning and rental options.The facility offers maintenance, repair, accessory installation and tire services - everything needed to get your motorcycle road-ready. They also present ready-to-ride motorcycles and individual build projects: from used inventory to fully customised machines with a distinct character. The showroom and workshop are equipped with modern tools, and the staff assist in selecting the right bike or service plan according to your needs. Because the workshop is in demand, it’s advisable to book ahead and confirm timelines when scheduling your service or tuning project.

name: Moto-Tech Switzerland AG - Kawasaki Center
description: Moto-Tech Switzerland AG – Kawasaki Center is located in Switzerland and specializes in Kawasaki motorcycles, accessories, parts and service. The showroom features a wide range of Kawasaki models - from urban bikes to high-performance sport motorcycles - allowing riders to find their perfect match. In addition to sales, the centre offers full service: maintenance, repair work, accessories installation and tuning. Their team of professionals assists clients in selecting motorcycles, accessories and custom solutions based on experience and preferences. It’s advisable to book an appointment or consultation in advance, especially if you’re interested in a test ride or a rare model.

name: Sam's Workshop - Garage moto & Atelier mécanique
description: Sam’s Workshop – Garage moto & Atelier mécanique is an independent motorcycle workshop in Switzerland specialising in repair, maintenance and customisation of bikes. They work with both modern motorcycles and classic carbureted models, emphasizing precision, flexibility and versatility in their services. The workshop is equipped with milling and turning machines, enabling the fabrication of bespoke parts and prototypes tailored to the client’s needs. Their service range covers maintenance parts replacement, engine overhaul, electrical systems, tuning and accessory installation - a full cycle for your bike. It is advisable to book a consultation or order work in advance, as demand is high, particularly during the riding season. Sam’s Workshop is an excellent choice for riders who seek quality service or want to transform their motorcycle into a customised work of art.

name: 3D MOTOS sàrl
description: 3D MOTOS Sàrl is a motorcycle dealership and workshop located at Route de Bottens 1, 1053 Brétigny-sur-Morrens, canton Vaud, Switzerland. They offer a broad selection of new and used motorcycles from various brands, along with sales and service options. Experienced mechanics on-site handle everything from road bikes to more specialized models with individual requirements. Besides sales, customers can access repair, maintenance and accessory installation services - all in one location. It is advisable to contact the company in advance to schedule an appointment or consultation, especially if you’re interested in a specific model or service. A great choice for both newcomers selecting their first motorcycle and seasoned riders seeking high-quality service and a reliable partner.

name: Moto Doc Häusler Cross
description: Moto Doc Häusler Cross & Supermotorama is a motorcycle workshop and dealer centre located in Grossaffoltern, canton Bern, Switzerland. The facility specializes in repair, maintenance and modification of motorcycles, including motocross and supermoto models. Its technicians offer a full range of services - from standard diagnostics to the installation of tuning components. Customers benefit from a personalised approach: selecting parts, receiving consultation on riding style and bike preparation. Due to high demand, it’s advisable to book a consultation or service in advance to secure a convenient time slot and required components.

name: Foti Motos Vespa Nest
description: Foti Motos Vespa Nest is located at Stauffacherstrasse 209 in Zurich, Switzerland. The shop specializes in selling scooters, motorcycles and e-bikes from brands such as Vespa, Piaggio, Aprilia and more. Inside you’ll find a modern showroom presenting current models and accessories. The team provides not only sales but also service and maintenance, which is convenient for motorcycle owners. The store is situated in a convenient part of Zurich, with good transit links and the possibility of a test ride. If you’re looking for quality scooters or Vespa-style motorbikes in Zurich, this is a great place to visit.

name: Cahenzli Motos
description: Cahenzli Motos is located at Feldstrasse 147 in the 8004 Zurich district, Switzerland. The shop specializes in repair, maintenance, and trading of Japanese motorcycles. Inside you’ll find a modern showroom featuring various motorcycle models and accessories. For repairs, it is recommended to make an appointment in advance to avoid waiting times. If you’re looking for reliable service and a selection of Japanese bikes, this is a great place to visit.

name: Moto Mader AG
description: Moto Mader AG is located at Ausserfeldstrasse 20, 5036 Oberentfelden, Switzerland. The store offers everything: new motorcycles, riding gear, accessories, and repair services. Their range includes brands like BMW, KTM, and Yamaha, along with a wide selection of accessories and equipment. The shop also hosts events, tours, and training courses, creating a friendly atmosphere for motorcycle enthusiasts. If you’re looking for high-quality service and a great selection of motorcycle products in Switzerland, Moto Mader AG is an excellent choice.

name: Moto Center Schwyz
description: Moto Center Schwyz AG is located at Riedmattli 1, 6423 Seewen, Canton of Schwyz, Switzerland. The store is an official dealer for brands such as BMW, Triumph, KTM, GASGAS, Piaggio, and Vespa, offering a wide selection of motorcycles and scooters. The showroom features both new and used models, along with accessories and riding gear. The shop has a service department that provides maintenance and repair options, convenient for motorcycle owners. If you’re looking for a reliable motorcycle center in Central Switzerland with quality service and a large selection, Moto Center Schwyz AG is an excellent choice.

name: Louis Zürich
description: Louis Zürich is a large motorcycle gear and accessories store located at Im Schwanen 5, 8304 Wallisellen, Switzerland. It offers a wide range of helmets, jackets, gloves, boots, and protective equipment. The shop caters to all motorcycle enthusiasts - from beginners to experienced riders. Products from leading global brands and seasonal new arrivals are available. The staff provides expert advice to help customers find the right gear for their riding style and needs.

name: Moto Boutique
description: Moto Boutique is a motorcycle gear and accessories shop, operating since 1972 and located in Lausanne, Switzerland. The store offers a vast selection of helmets, jackets, boots, protective gear and accessories for both urban riding and enduro adventures. Staff members assist customers in selecting the right gear based on riding style, comfort and safety. Tools and consumables for DIY motorcycle maintenance are also available. The shop features a convenient showroom where you can view products in person and try on gear before purchasing.

name: VERDI
description:
Caffe Pizzeria Verdi is a cozy café and pizzeria located at Sunčana Obala bb, 85346 Zelenika, Montenegro, just a short walk from the Adriatic coast. The restaurant is famous for its traditional Italian wood-fired pizzas and Mediterranean-inspired dishes. The interior combines modern design with the warmth of a seaside café - wooden furniture, soft lighting, and an open terrace overlooking the sea. Verdi offers a relaxed atmosphere, perfect for friendly gatherings or family dinners by the water. Guests praise the attentive service, generous portions, and excellent value for money.

It’s the perfect place to enjoy a fragrant pizza and a glass of wine while watching the sunset over the Adriatic.

name: Nostalgija Vintage cafe & Live music bar
description: Nostalgija Vintage cafe & Live music bar in Ljubljana is steeped in old-school American and Route 66 vibes — bikers park right at the entrance on a spacious lot and dig into burgers with cold beer while live rock music plays in the evenings. Easy access from the main road, with a gas station and mechanic just 500 meters away for quick fixes. Riders gather here for casual meetups, swapping Slovenian routes and snapping pics under the glowing neon sign. The perfect stop to unwind after a ride and launch group trips along scenic roads and Alpine twisties.

name: Garaž Bar
description: Garaž Bar in Poreč offers a laid-back coastal vibe with views over the sea and the old town. It’s a comfortable stop for motorcyclists: a cold drink, a moment to relax and connect after the ride. The bar’s menu features cocktails, drinks and light snacks; while the interior isn’t explicitly biker-themed, the location is still biker-friendly. Parking is limited due to the central location, so it’s wise to plan your motorcycle stop in advance. A solid choice for a short break during your coastal route.

name: Old Time
description: Old Time is a bar in Poreč with a relaxed vibe that suits motorcycle travellers. The menu includes drinks and light snacks, making it a good stop after a ride. Its central location offers easy access, but motorcycle parking may be limited - so plan ahead. The interior isn’t overtly biker-themed, but the welcoming atmosphere makes it a nice rest point. A solid choice for an evening drink or a quick break on your coastal route.

name: Pizzeria & Grill Smile Motovun
description: Pizzeria & Grill Smile in Motovun is set in the picturesque medieval hilltop town overlooking the Mirna River valley. The restaurant offers pizza, tasty grill dishes and cold drinks — a perfect stop for a light lunch or dinner on your route. For motorcyclists it’s a convenient waypoint: the roads leading to the town are scenic and relatively calm. There is parking available nearby (commonly by the entrance or just under the fortress walls) — important to leave your bike in view. After your meal you can take a walk through the historic streets, snap some photos and soak in the Istrian atmosphere before hitting the road again.

name: Colosseum Lounge & Beach Bar
description: Colosseum Lounge & Beach Bar in Opatija is a stylish seaside venue offering sweeping views of the Adriatic Sea and a relaxed yet upscale beach-lounge atmosphere. Located on Ulica Maršala Tita 129, it features a terrace by the water, comfortable couch seating, and a menu of cocktails, light grill dishes and chilled-out music. The venue shifts from a laid-back daytime lounge into a lively open-air night-club with DJs and late-night shows. For motorcyclists, it’s an excellent reward stop after a scenic ride: park near the promenade, grab a refreshing drink, unwind and take in the view. The prime sea-front location combined with good vibes makes it a memorable stop on a coastal route.

name: Lička kuća Restaurant - Plitvice Lakes
description: Lička kuća Restaurant, near Plitvice Lakes National Park, serves traditional Lika-region cuisine: fire-grilled meats, home-style sides and local drinks. The restaurant is well placed for motorcyclists travelling through the area — close to the roads leading to the park and easy to continue your route afterwards. The setting is cosy, styled like a guesthouse, creating a relaxed stop amidst nature. Plan about an hour to ninety minutes for a meal before setting off towards the lakes or continuing your journey. There is parking nearby, but as the place is popular, it’s wise to park your bike early and then enjoy your meal unhurried.

name: Rock caffe D8
description: Rock Caffe D8 is a trendy bar in Zadar located on the coastal D8 highway, well known among drivers and motorcyclists alike. The interior blends a light rock-music vibe with a relaxed seaside setting: live or recorded music, cocktails and outdoor seating. It enjoys a strong review score (around 4.7 out of 5) and is a convenient stop for riders traveling the coast. For bikers: the bar is right on the D8 route — offering an easy pit-stop, though parking is limited, so plan where to park your bike. A great choice for an evening break, drink in hand, and sea view.

name: Fabrique Pub
description: Fabrique Pub is a vibrant bar located in the heart of Split, near the waterfront and old town. The menu features steaks, burgers, pizzas and a wide selection of craft beers — a great setting to unwind after a long motorcycle ride. The bar stays open late with live music and a lively vibe. For motorcyclists: while on-site parking may be limited due to its central location, you’ll find nearby public parking spots or dedicated bike zones — it’s wise to plan ahead. This makes it a convenient stop for a night in the city before hitting the road again.

name: Club Bounty est. MK Fjaka
description: Club Bounty (est. MK Fjaka) is located in Split, near the old town and waterfront — a cozy spot where bikers and rock-atmosphere lovers gather. The interior features biker memorabilia, themed décor and a spacious bar zone, creating a perfect place to unwind after a ride. Their menu includes drinks, cocktails and snacks suited for evening relaxation and meeting fellow travellers. For motorcyclists: motorcycle parking is possible near the venue, but given the central location you’re advised to arrive a bit earlier and secure a visible spot for your bike. This is an excellent stop for an evening break, soaking in biker vibes and preparing for your next day’s ride.

name: Croatia Moto Adventure
description: Croatia Moto Adventure is a motorcycle rental and tour company based in Split, specializing in bike hire and organized riding routes across Croatia. They offer equipment rental as well as guided route support — ideal for travelling motorcyclists. After a day on the road you can park your bike there, get route advice and rest. If you're planning a multi-day ride, this contact is especially useful: you can receive support on road conditions, weather and interesting stops. If you’re on the go and need a “motorcycle-point” for a break and assistance — this is a great option.

name: Wild West Trogir
description: Wild West Trogir is a burger and steak house located in the historic heart of Trogir, styled like a cowboy saloon with a sizzling grill and hearty portions. It’s an ideal stop for a substantial meal after a coastal motorcycle ride: generous servings, strong grilled meats and a laid‑back bar atmosphere. For bikers it’s convenient because it’s close to the waterfront and main roads, yet motorcycle parking might be limited due to the central location — so plan your bike stop ahead. The food quality and friendly service are frequently praised, though prices are somewhat above average. If you’re looking for an evening pit stop in the city, this place is definitely worth adding.

name: Lungo Mare
description: Lungo Mare is located about 10 minutes walking distance from Hvar town centre, offering Dalmatian cuisine: fresh fish, seafood and meat dishes. The atmosphere is relaxed and cosy, with a terrace and nice view — a great stop for a motorcycle break on the island. For riders: the route to the restaurant includes winding island roads, making the stop part of the journey. As it’s a popular spot with many guests, it’s wise to park your bike ahead of time and plan the stop. It’s an ideal point for a meal, rest and recharge before continuing your ride.

name: Konoba i Apartmani Gaj Prozor-Rama
description: Konoba i Apartmani Gaj is located near Lake Rama, close to Prozor and offers a cozy stop in the midst of natural surroundings. The menu features regional specialties: lamb cooked under the metal bell “sač”, trout and homemade rakija — perfect for a recharge after a motorcycle ride. For motorcyclists: there is parking available at the restaurant/apartments, and the access road along mountain passes makes the arrival part of the experience. Parking space can be limited, so arriving early and choosing a visible spot for your bike is advisable. It’s an ideal mid-route pause: good food, nature, views and a breath of calm before continuing your journey.

name: Restoran Ramsko Jezero
description: Restoran Ramsko Jezero is located on the shore of the scenic Rama Lake near Prozor-Rama, and makes a perfect stop for motorcycle travellers. The menu features fresh lake trout, grilled meat dishes and local drinks — an excellent way to refuel after a ride. The approach road takes you along winding passes and the lake’s edge, making arrival part of the experience. Parking is available nearby, but as the spot is popular you’re advised to find a visible motorbike parking spot in advance. It’s a calm and cozy place to enjoy lake views, fresh air and good food before continuing your ride.

name: The House Pub
description: The House Pub is located along the “Route 66” highway near the town of Čapljina/Mostar region in Herzegovina, making it a convenient stop for motorcyclists riding through the area. The pub offers a relaxed vibe, atmospheric décor, a wide drinks menu and snacks — a place to take a breather and mingle with fellow travellers. For bikers it’s convenient: the pub is just off the main road and has parking (or space nearby) where you can park your bike visibly. Stopping here is a good way to break up the ride, stretch your legs, grab a cold drink and gear up for the next stretch.

name: The Rebels PUB
description: The Rebels Pub is a stylish bar in the heart of Mostar, offering a friendly vibe, rock music and a strong selection of beers and cocktails. For motorcyclists, it’s a good stop: easily reachable from the main route, with space to park your bike nearby and unwind. The interior features themed décor, the atmosphere is laid-back but lively — a great evening pause. Note: parking may be limited due to its central location, so plan ahead for your motorcycle spot. This pub serves as an excellent end-of-day stop on the road — drink, music and conversation before you ride on.

name: Restoran Vrelo
description: Restoran Vrelo is located in Blagaj at the mouth of a mountain river, in a scenic natural setting near the historic spring Vrelo. It’s an excellent stop for a motorcycle route through Herzegovina: enjoy a good meal, the view of cliffs and the river, and recharge for the next stage of your ride. The access road features winding hills that enhance the sense of adventure during your ride. Motorcycle parking is available nearby, though it’s wise to pick a spot early as the place is popular. After the meal you can take a short stroll to the Vrelo spring and cave, adding a nice pause to your journey.

name: Profi-moto
description: Profi-Moto Děčín is a motorcycle shop located in northern Czechia, not far from the German border. It offers spare parts, tires, oils, batteries, and riding gear for different types of bikes. You can also find basic tools and supplies for on-the-road maintenance. A small service area is available for tire changes and minor repairs. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable about motorcycles. The selection is practical and focused on real riders’ needs. The shop has convenient parking right in front of the entrance. A great stop to prepare your bike before heading into the Czech mountains or crossing into Germany.

name: DCXmoto s.r.o.
description: DCXmoto s.r.o. in Děčín, Czechia, specializes in motorcycle and ATV sales as well as gear and accessories for travelling riders. Here you can also find a service area for minor repairs and maintenance during your journey. The location is biker-friendly, near major routes, making it a convenient stop on your road trip. Their selection covers various types of motorcycles and includes riding equipment, oils and travel accessories. Plus, there is parking nearby and a chance to check your bike’s condition before continuing the ride.

name: Děčín Castle
description: Děčín Castle towers above the confluence of the Elbe and Ploučnice rivers on a rocky promontory, offering spectacular views of the valley and town below. Its origins date back to a wooden fort from the 10th-11th century, later rebuilt into a stone castle in the 13th century. Over the centuries, the castle has served as a noble residence, fortress and administrative centre, reflecting architectural layers from Gothic to Baroque. The approach road is scenic and winding — making it an appealing stop for motorcyclists in search of a ride with a view and a slice of history. The castle grounds and adjacent park provide a relaxed setting to stretch your legs. Allocate about 30–45 minutes for a walk through the castle and viewpoints before moving on.

name: Fabrika Děčín
description: Restaurace Fabrika Děčín is a modern restaurant-bar located in Děčín, Czechia, offering a mix of Czech and modern grilled cuisine and a broad drink menu. The restaurant’s menu features grilled dishes, snacks and a solid selection of beverages — a great stop after a ride. The venue is conveniently positioned near main routes, making it a handy point for motorcyclists. Parking is available nearby, but due to the place’s popularity it’s wise to secure your bike spot early. A fine choice for an evening break, relaxation and recharging before you continue your journey.

name: The caravan park lake
description: The Caravan Park Lake is a peaceful lakeside parking-and-rest spot in Hlučín, northern Czechia — perfect for motorcyclists seeking a quiet stop. You can park your bike, take in views of the lake and nature, stretch your legs after the ride and unwind in the shade. The access road is relatively straightforward, making it a good choice even after a long stretch of riding. The park offers essential infrastructure: parking, possibly a café or rest area — a nice opportunity for a pause and recharge. It’s a great spot if you’re looking for more than just a stopover — you’ll get some nature with your route.

name: Autokemp Dolní Morava
description: Autokemp Dolní Morava is a campsite & autokemp located in the Králický Sněžník region of Czechia. Open all year round, it offers pitches for tents, caravans, and motorcycles with connections for electricity, water and amenities. The approach road features a scenic climb and winding routes, making the ride an experience itself for bikers. The large parking and pitch area allow you to securely park your bike and relax. After the ride you can immerse yourself in nature, take in mountain views, walk a bit, and then continue your journey refreshed.

name: Camping Country
description: Camping Country is a campsite/autocamp in Czechia (Vysočina Region, near Jemnice) that works very well for motorcycle travellers. It provides spacious pitches where you can park your bike and set up a tent or stay in a caravan, with basic amenities. The access route features pleasant hills and some twisty sections, making the arrival part of the ride. After a day in the saddle you’ll find a place to unwind outdoors, stay in nature and recharge for the next leg. It’s a convenient overnight solution if you want to stay away from cities — calm, stars and your bike right next to your tent.

name: Camping Olšina
description: Camping Olšina is a cosy lakeside campsite on Lake Lipno in South Bohemia, Czechia, near the village of Černá v Pošumaví. It offers about 180 green pitches, many situated right by the water or in the forest, making it appealing for travelling motorcyclists. The access road runs through scenic sections of South Bohemia — perfect for a bike route. Facilities include electricity, showers, boat and bike rentals — all set in nature so you can unwind after the ride. A great overnight stop if you want to rest before your next leg.

name: Camping Fox Český Krumlov
description: Camping Fox Český Krumlov is located just outside the historic centre of Český Krumlov, set within a scenic forested environment. It offers pitches for tents, campers and motorcyclists, with infrastructure such as electricity hook‑ups, showers, a café‑bar and a relaxation area. Arriving by motorcycle is especially enjoyable as the surrounding roads are winding and fun to ride. For bikers: there is parking and bike‐friendly areas where you can leave your machine securely. After a day in the saddle you can unwind here, take a stroll through town and enjoy the evening view of the castle.

name: MOSAIC HOUSE Design Hotel
description: MOSAIC HOUSE Design Hotel in Prague is a stylish, design‑driven hotel with an eco‑friendly ethos — a great city stop on a motorcycle trip. Rooms are modernly decorated, and the hotel features amenities like a fitness zone, wellness area and lounge bar, making it a comfortable choice after a long ride. For motorcyclists it’s well‑placed: close to the city centre, allowing you to pull in, relax and refuel before your next leg. Bear in mind: parking in Prague centre may be limited or paid — check motorcycle‑friendly options ahead of time. Altogether, a solid choice for a city stay and onward journey.

name: Akát Pension
description: Akát Pension is located in Prague 5 (Smíchov district) and is convenient for motorcyclists looking for a city stop on their route. The pension offers rooms and apartments, breakfast and free Wi‑Fi — a good choice for travellers on two wheels. The parking is approximately 100 m from the building and costs around 200 CZK per night; it's advisable to inform the reception ahead of arrival. Even within the city, the location allows quick access to the historic centre and public transport, making it a practical base for a short stop. For motorcyclists this is valuable: its location and bike‑parking opportunity reduce stress on your journey.

name: Plus Prague Hostel
description: Plus Prague Hostel is located in Prague 7 (Holesovice) — a convenient stop for motorcyclists on route. The property offers private rooms and dorms. After your ride you can park your motorcycle (paid parking available) and relax in the lounge or bar before the next leg of your route. The interior and service cater to travellers, and it’s conveniently located relative to major roads and sights. Being in a city centre, it’s wise to check bike‑parking and local restrictions ahead of time.

name: Internesto Apartments
description: Internesto Apartments are a comfy apartment‑style lodging in the centre of Brno, convenient for travelling motorcyclists. You can book private apartment rooms, giving more comfort after a ride. The location near key routes makes entry and departure easy. Motorcycle parking may be paid or on‑site — check ahead when booking. A solid choice for a city stop: comfort, amenities and a base for your next leg.

name: Penzion Janka
description: Penzion Janka is located in Brno, Czechia, offering a comfortable stopover option for motorcyclists during a city leg of their route. They provide cosy rooms and apartments, including options with sauna or jacuzzi — great for unwinding after a ride. Parking is available directly in front of the building or nearby — it’s wise to check the motorcycle parking conditions in advance. The location enables easy entry and exit through the city as well as a smooth onward ride. A solid choice for an urban overnight stay when you’re looking for comfort and calm before your next journey.

name: Hotel Passage
description: Hotel Passage is located in Brno, Czechia in a convenient section of the city with quick access to major roads — making it a smart stop for motorcyclists on a route. The hotel offers modern rooms, a good breakfast and amenities to help you recover after a ride. Despite being in the city, access to exits and routes is straightforward, which makes it a logical choice for overnight stay. If you are parking the motorcycle, it’s wise to check in advance for availability of motorcycle‑friendly parking in or around the hotel. An excellent option for comfortable city rest before your next leg of the journey.

name: AVANTI Hotel
description: AVANTI Hotel in Brno is conveniently located near major routes, making it a smart stop for motorcyclists. The hotel features modern rooms and free on‑site parking — a crucial advantage for bike travellers. There is a monitored garage parking, which is very good for longer rides. After a day in the saddle you can unwind in the wellness area with sauna, hot tub and gym before continuing your journey. The location, slightly outside city bustle, allows for a comfortable stay and an easy morning start.

name: Pension Minor Czech Budejovice
description: Pension Minor is a cozy guesthouse in České Budějovice, Czechia — a good choice for travelling motorcyclists. Rooms include en‑suite bathrooms, a mini‑bar and fridge — convenient after a long ride. The property offers paid, secured parking where you can park your motorcycle with more confidence. It’s located within reasonable distance from the city centre and provides easy access to the region’s main roads.

name: Hotel U Nádraží
description: Hotel U Nádraží is located in České Budějovice, just minutes from the main train and bus station — ideal for motorcyclists needing a convenient stop with easy onward access. The hotel offers comfortable rooms and a paid, secure on‑site parking lot where you can safely leave your motorcycle. Its central city location also means you can get back on the road quickly the next morning. As it is urban accommodation, riders should check parking conditions and any motorcycle restrictions ahead of arrival. A solid urban overnight choice before continuing your journey through Czechia or into neighbouring countries.

name: Hotel Metropol CB
description: Hotel Metropol CB is located in the heart of České Budějovice, just minutes from the main square and bus station. The hotel features modern rooms in a recently refurbished building, offering comfort after a long ride. On‑site parking is available but paid — it’s wise to check in advance for motorcycle‑friendly options. The location is convenient for motorcyclists: easy access to major roads and a short ride into the city centre, making it a smart urban overnight stop.

name: Chebský dvůr
description: Chebský dvůr ‑ Egerlander Hof is located in the heart of Karlovy Vary, just steps from the famous colonnade and hot spring. The guest house offers private parking where you can safely leave your motorcycle — a key consideration for bike travellers. Rooms are equipped with a fridge and kettle, making for a comfortable stop after riding. Its central location enables a quick morning departure and access to highways or scenic routes in the region. If you’re stopping in a spa town but still want to keep riding momentum — this is a great choice.

name: Hotel Lions Plzeň
description: Hotel Lions Plzeň is located in Plzeň and offers modern, comfortable accommodation ideal for motorcyclists. The rooms are stylishly designed, and the friendly staff are always ready to assist. The hotel is conveniently situated near the city center and main routes, making it a great stopover point. After a long ride, guests can relax at the on-site restaurant or take a walk around the area. It’s a perfect blend of comfort and location for a short or extended stay.

name: Apartmány U Gigantu
description: Apartmány U Gigantu are located in a quiet area of Plzeň, Czechia, just a short ride from the city centre and in a convenient position for motorcycle travellers. They offer apartment-style accommodation with kitchens and separate bedrooms — a great option for relaxing after a long ride. Free parking is available on neighbouring streets or on-site — a major plus for bikers. The access roads are straightforward, letting you easily hit the road again the next morning. It’s a comfortable overnight stop if you’re looking to recharge before your next leg of the journey.

name: Hotel Plzeň
description: Hotel Plzeň is located in Plzeň, Czechia, and offers convenient accommodation for motorcycle travellers on route. The hotel is situated in a favourable part of the city with quick access to major roads and routes. The rooms are comfortable, and you can make use of hotel amenities to unwind after a ride. Motorcycle parking is available — it’s important to check parking conditions at the reception upon arrival. A solid choice for an urban stopover before your next leg.

name: Chateau Zábřeh
description: Chateau Zábřeh is a unique hotel set in a 15th-century castle in Ostrava. Its interiors blend historic charm with modern comfort, creating a truly special atmosphere. The hotel features its own brewery and a restaurant serving traditional Czech cuisine. For motorcycle travelers, secure parking is available in the inner courtyard. A perfect stay for those who appreciate comfort, good food, and the spirit of old Europe.

name: Hotel Garni VŠB-TUO
description: Hotel Garni VŠB-TUO is located in Ostrava, Czechia, and offers a practical overnight stop for motorcyclists on the northern Czech leg of their route. The hotel provides clean, functional rooms — important after a long ride — and free parking so you can leave your bike securely. Its convenient location near city exits makes it a smart choice before your next leg. For bikers, it’s a cost-effective option with all the essentials, and without excessive city bustle. A strong choice for a route-stop overnight.

name: Long Story Short Hostel
description: Long Story Short Hostel is housed in a historic building in the center of Olomouc, offering motorcyclists convenient accommodation with free private parking on-site for secure bike storage. Cozy rooms with comfortable beds and personal lockers provide solid rest after a long ride, while shared spaces with a terrace and garden are perfect for connecting with fellow travelers. Nearby gas stations and motorcycle service centers make maintenance easy, and the old town location allows seamless exploration on foot or by bike. The design-forward interior and laid-back vibe create memorable stays, with the option to enjoy an organic breakfast made from local produce. Easy access from main highways ensures a smooth arrival for those on the road.

name: Miss Sophie's Olomouc - Boutique Hotel
description: Miss Sophie's Olomouc is a boutique hotel in a 14th-century historic building right in the heart of Olomouc, just 400 meters from the main square, making it a prime spot for motorcyclists with easy highway access and central drop-in convenience. Elegant rooms with air conditioning, minibars, and a blend of antique charm and modern touches provide a cozy recovery after miles on Czech roads, while the inner garden and bar offer perfect chill-out zones overlooking the city. Parking is public and paid—around 300–500 CZK per day depending on the zone—but nearby secure lots work well for bikes with straightforward entry. Gas stations, motorcycle shops, and walking paths through the old town are steps away, letting you refuel and hit the Moravian routes swiftly. The welcoming vibe, fresh continental breakfast with local specialties, and attentive staff turn your pit stop into something special, complete with bike rental options for side trips.

name: Vinařství U Kapličky
description: Vinařství U Kapličky is a charming winery with guesthouse in Zaječí village at the foot of Pálava, just a 15-minute ride from Mikulov, a perfect pit stop for motorcyclists craving downtime amid Moravian vineyards with sweeping views over lakes and hills. Cozy 2–3 person rooms and suites with AC, balconies, and garden vistas deliver top-notch recovery after twisting South Moravian roads, backed by free ample parking with outlets to stash your bike securely right by the door. On-site pool, spa, and gym recharge your batteries, paired with a restaurant serving local fare and tastings of their own wines to toast a solid day's ride. Nearby gas stations and bike paths that double as moto routes make it easy to top up and roll on through the wine trails, with smooth access off E461 for riders coming from Brno or Vienna. The family-run vibe, breakfast with organic local bites, and kids' play area turn your stay into a full-on adventure, soaked in Moravian charm and fireside yarns.

name: Boutique Hotel The River House
description: This cozy boutique hotel is located in the heart of the picturesque alpine village of Andermatt. It is designed as a small “sanctuary” with a warm and comfortable atmosphere. With only eight rooms, the hotel provides an intimate and peaceful setting. It is situated close to the train station and the cable cars leading to popular ski slopes. Guests can enjoy breakfast, a bar, and free Wi-Fi in public areas. The interior combines modern design with traditional alpine elements, creating a charming mountain-home feel.

name: KLAUSE RANCH
description: This ranch-style hotel-restaurant is located in the Urnerboden valley on the Klausen Pass in Switzerland, offering the feel of a country ranch nestled in the mountains. Welcoming staff and homestyle cuisine create a cozy lodge atmosphere, as if you’re in a rustic home with a fireplace. The terrace offers breathtaking panoramic views of surrounding peaks and the valley. The menu features grilled dishes, chicken wings, and country-style fare, and the interior is decorated with western-themed elements. In winter, it becomes a perfect stop for skiers and snowboarders; in summer, for hikers and motorcyclists. Overall, it’s a relaxed and unconventional spot away from the city buzz, where nature and wild-west ambiance meet in the Swiss Alps.

name: Berggasthaus Susten Passhöhe
description: This cozy mountain guesthouse is located at 2,265 meters above sea level on the Susten Pass. It offers a peaceful atmosphere and a large sunny terrace with stunning views of glaciers and alpine slopes. The restaurant serves traditional Swiss mountain dishes, including alpine macaroni, raclette, and signature steaks. Accommodation options include small comfortable rooms as well as a shared dormitory for groups. Breakfast is included, Wi-Fi is available, and the windows offer beautiful panoramic views. Due to its location, the guesthouse is ideal for summer hikes and alpine routes and operates only during the season when the pass is open.

name: Hotel “Bononia”
description: Hotel Bononia (Bononia Estate Winery & Resort) is a boutique wine-resort located right on the Danube’s bank in Vidin, Bulgaria. The place blends vineyard charm and relaxed elegance: historic interiors, wine tastings, and cozy rooms. For motorcyclists it’s convenient: the hotel offers parking and a calm setting where you can safely leave your bike. In the evening, you can unwind in the restaurant with regional cuisine and a glass of wine. It’s a perfect stop to rest, recharge and enjoy some wine before continuing your journey along the river.

name: Hotel Dunav
description: Hotel Dunav is located in the centre of Vidin, Bulgaria, right on the Danube riverbank — making it a convenient stop for motorcyclists riding along the river. The hotel offers a variety of rooms: single, double, triple, family rooms, and studio types — suitable for both solo riders and groups. Parking is free and secure, so your bike can be parked safely on site. There’s a lobby bar, offering a relaxing atmosphere after a ride. It’s a solid choice for a restful overnight stay before continuing your journey or as a calm stop on your Danube route.

name: Hotel Crown
description: Hotel Korona is a quiet family-run hotel in the heart of Blagoevgrad, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and the secured parking ensures your motorcycle stays safe. After a ride, you can unwind on the terrace with views of the town and surrounding mountains. Its central location provides quick access to the historic streets of Blagoevgrad. This makes it an ideal overnight stop between riding routes.

name: Hotel Primavera
description: Hotel Primavera 2 is located in the heart of Pazardzhik, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers passing through the city. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and parking next to the building ensures the safety of your motorcycle. After a ride, you can relax in cozy rooms and take a walk along the central streets of the city. Being close to the historic center, guests can easily reach cafés, restaurants, and local attractions. The hotel’s calm and comfortable atmosphere makes it an ideal choice for an overnight stop between riding routes.

name: Hotel Complex LUXOR
description: Hotel Complex Luxor is located in the heart of Smolin, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers exploring the region. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and the secured parking on-site ensures your motorcycle stays safe. After a long ride, you can relax in comfortable rooms and take a walk along the city’s main street. Nearby cafés and shops make it easy to grab a bite or enjoy a short break. Thanks to its convenient location, the hotel is ideal for an overnight stop between riding routes.

name: Hotel My House Kardzhali
description: Hotel My House (Kardzhali) is located in the heart of Kardzhali, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers passing through the city. The hotel offers easy bike access and free on-site parking to safely store your motorcycle. After a long ride, you can relax in clean, cozy rooms and take a walk through the town to soak in the local vibe. Its central location also gives you access to nearby natural attractions, making it a good base for day rides around the region. The peaceful and welcoming atmosphere makes it a solid choice for an overnight stop between routes.

name: Hotel OPERA
description: Hotel Opera in Burgas is a stylish boutique business hotel located on a quiet street in the heart of the city, making it a great stop for motorcycle travelers. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and there is an underground garage for up to 10 cars, offering a secure place for your ride. After a long journey, you can relax in cozy, retro-style rooms and then take a stroll through the city center, filled with cafés and historic corners. The retro atmosphere and calm environment make it a comfortable and relaxing place to spend the night between routes. Thanks to its central location, you can easily continue your trip either to the coast or inland.

name: Ranč Telč
description: Ranč Telč is a picturesque countryside ranch located just a few minutes ride from the center of Telč, making it a perfect stopover for motorcycle travelers who want to combine road riding with a nature retreat. The site is easily accessible by bike, and there is free parking to securely leave your motorcycle. After a ride, you can unwind in a variety of accommodation options — from apartments to tents, teepees, and even small wooden barns filled with hay. In the evenings, take a walk among the meadows and orchards surrounding the ranch — the quiet and seclusion offer a peaceful escape. This ranch is a great overnight point, especially for riders passing through rural routes and scenic landscapes.

name: Pytloun Wellness Travel Hotel
description: The Pytloun Wellness Travel Hotel is located in a quiet part of Liberec, nestled among historic timber buildings from the 17th century — ideal for motorbike travelers who want a calm city stop blended with wellness. It’s easily reachable on a bike and provides parking space to securely leave your motorcycle. After a long ride, you can unwind in the “Luxury Island Spa,” which includes saunas, whirlpools, and relaxation zones to help you recharge. Thanks to its proximity to public transport and central areas, you can easily continue your route or enjoy an evening walk. The hotel’s peaceful vibe makes it a perfect place to rest and refuel for the next leg of your journey.

name: Inspiration Fénix Design Hotel
description: The Inspiration Fénix Design Hotel in Liberec, Czech Republic, is a very good stopover for motorbike travelers who want a mix of city riding and rest. Located at Ještědská 279, the hotel is easily accessible by bike, with parking available for securely leaving your motorcycle. After a long ride, you can unwind in stylish, design-focused rooms, and in the evening take a walk in the hotel’s garden or the surrounding area. The calm setting and modern elegance create a comfortable and relaxing atmosphere before you continue your journey. It’s a smart choice for an overnight stay when riding through the Czech Republic or Central Europe.

name: The Golden Lion / Zlatý Lev - Clarion Grandhotel
description: The Golden Lion / Clarion Grandhotel Zlatý Lev is located in the very heart of Liberec, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers passing through the city. The Art Nouveau building draws attention with its architecture and history, and the hotel is easily accessible by bike, with parking available for your motorcycle. After a long ride, you can unwind in spacious and elegant rooms, then stroll through the scenic park just across from the hotel in the evening. Thanks to its central location, it's easy to continue your journey toward the picturesque roads of the Jizera Mountains or take the cable car up to Ještěd. The cozy atmosphere and high-quality service make this hotel a top choice for an overnight stay during a motorcycle trip.

name: Clarion Congress Hotel Usti nad Labem
description: The Clarion Congress Hotel Ústí nad Labem is a great stopover for motorcycle travelers passing through Ústí nad Labem. Located right in the city center, it offers easy access to the region’s roads. The hotel is bike-friendly, and parking is available close by (included for some business offers). After a long ride, you can relax in spacious, modern rooms and unwind at the on-site restaurant or bar before continuing your journey. Its central location also makes it easy to head out toward scenic highways for the next leg of your trip. The hotel’s professional, comfortable, and urban vibe makes it a perfect overnight spot on a riding route.

name: BIRDIE Pension & Wellness
description: BIRDIE Pension & Wellness is located in Pardubice, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers riding between cities. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and there is free on-site parking for secure motorcycle storage. After a long ride, you can unwind in the wellness area, with a sauna and relaxation zones. The rooms are designed in a rustic, cozy style with spacious bathrooms, helping you recharge before the next leg of your journey. Thanks to its location — close to the city but still in a quiet area — it’s a peaceful and comfortable choice for an overnight stay.

name: Penzion Šenk
description: Penzion Šenk is located in a quiet neighborhood of Pardubice, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers riding through the city. It’s easily reachable on a bike, and there is free on-site parking — a real advantage for riders. After your ride, you can relax in cozy, well-kept rooms and enjoy the welcoming, family-run atmosphere of the guesthouse. The on-site restaurant serves Czech and international cuisine, offering a comfortable place to dine and recharge before your next leg. With its proximity to the city center, it's easy to continue your journey the next morning along scenic regional roads.

name: EA Theresian Court Hotel
description: EA Theresian Court Hotel is located in a peaceful part of Hradec Králové, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers passing through. The hotel is bike-friendly, and there is a secure indoor garage for safely parking your motorcycle. After a ride, you can unwind in stylish, elegantly decorated rooms, and enjoy the on-site spa and wellness facilities. Staying here offers a chance to recharge in a calm and cozy atmosphere before hitting the road again. The location also provides easy access to the historic city center — perfect for an evening stroll among charming streets.

name: Penzion Amátka
description: Penzion Amátka is located in the historic heart of Hradec Králové, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers riding through the city. The pension is easily accessible by bike, and there is nearby parking for a small fee where you can securely leave your motorcycle. After your ride, you can unwind in simple but clean and cosy rooms, and in the evening stroll through the charming cobbled streets around the small square. Its location right on Malé náměstí gives you quick access to historic landmarks and local cafés. The atmosphere is calm and homely — a great place to relax before continuing your journey.

name: Hotel Tanzberg
description: Hotel Tanzberg is situated on the outskirts of Mikulov, just minutes from scenic riding roads in South Moravia — a perfect overnight stop for motorcycle travellers. The access is bike-friendly and straightforward, and on-site parking allows you to safely leave your motorcycle. After a day on the road, relax in cozy rooms and enjoy a walk through the vines around the hotel — a pleasant way to unwind before your next ride. Its location, close to wine routes and a major highway, allows you to launch the next leg of your journey with ease. The calm setting, away from the bustle of larger cities, makes this a particularly good choice for a stopover between routes.

name: Městský penzion Mikulov
description: Městský Penzion Mikulov is located right in the historic heart of Mikulov, making it a convenient and cozy stop for motorcycle travelers. The access by bike is easy, and there are parking options nearby — very helpful when you're traveling on a motorbike. After a long ride, you can unwind in simple and tidy rooms, then take a stroll through the town’s charming narrow streets. An evening or morning walk in the center offers a chance to soak in the atmosphere of wine cellars and historic architecture. Thanks to its central location, this guesthouse is a great overnight spot between riding routes, especially for riders who want to combine the journey with exploring the city.

name: Endemit Boutique Hotel a Spa
description: ENDEMIT Boutique Hotel & Spa is nestled in the scenic Beskid Mountains in Horní Bečva, offering a peaceful and refined stop for motorcycle travelers who want to balance road adventure with relaxation. The hotel is bike‑accessible, with free on-site parking to keep your motorcycle safe. After a long ride, you can unwind in the wellness area, featuring an indoor pool, whirlpool, and a variety of saunas. In the evening, take a stroll around the surroundings — the mountain vistas and forested hills give a serene and rejuvenating atmosphere. With its stylish, warm design and thoughtful amenities, this hotel is a perfect overnight stay for bikers on a scenic route.

name: Penzion Sokolská
description: Penzion Sokolská is a cosy guesthouse located in the heart of Zlín, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers riding through the region. It is easily accessible by bike, and free parking on Sokolská street ensures a safe spot for your motorcycle. After a long ride, you can unwind on the terrace or by the pool, or take an evening stroll around the charming town. Thanks to its proximity to local roads, this guesthouse is a great choice for an overnight stop between stages of your route. The atmosphere is calm, friendly, and family‑oriented — a perfect place to recharge during your motorcycle trip.

name: HOTEL ČERNÝ KŮŇ HUMPOLEC
description: The Černý kůň Hotel is located right on the historic square in Humpolec, making it a practical stop for motorcycle travelers crossing the Vysočina region. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and there is free parking nearby, perfect for leaving your motorcycle safely. After a long ride, you can unwind in clean, modest but cozy rooms, and enjoy a coffee on the summer terrace overlooking the square and the local church. In the evening, take a walk along the charming old streets of the town — a good opportunity to soak in the peaceful, historical Czech atmosphere. Thanks to its central location, this hotel is an excellent overnight point between scenic bike routes across Vysočina.

name: Penzion Hurikán
description: Penzion Hurikán is a cozy, family-run guesthouse located in Havlíčkův Brod in the Vysočina region, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers on regional routes. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and there is free on-site parking. After a long ride, you can unwind in comfortable rooms — from single to triple occupancy — equipped with a fridge and TV. In the evening, the on-site restaurant or the summer terrace offers a relaxing spot to soak in the local vibe. With its peaceful atmosphere and strategic location, this pension is a great overnight point between the highways of Vysočina.

name: hotel GRAND Tábor
description: The GRAND Tábor Hotel is a great stop for motorcycle travelers thanks to its historic location in the center of Tábor. It’s bike‑friendly with its own parking, making it easy to leave your motorcycle safely. After a ride, you can unwind in well-appointed rooms — from economy to deluxe — and enjoy a breakfast that’s included in the rate. Its location on one of the town’s main squares makes evening walks through the old town a real pleasure. This hotel is ideal for overnight stays between scenic riding routes, offering both convenience and a sense of history.

name: Penzion u Pivovaru
description: Penzion U Pivovaru is located in a quiet part of Děčín, just a few minutes’ ride from the old town and castle — a great stop for motorcycle travelers looking to rest mid‑route. The guesthouse is easily bike‑accessible, and there’s parking on-site for safely leaving your motorcycle. Accommodation options range from apartments with kitchens to cozy double rooms, all with free Wi‑Fi to help you recharge. In the evenings, you can unwind in the courtyard or on the terrace, soaking in the small, family‑run hotel’s atmosphere. Thanks to its location, this pension is a strong base for exploring nearby areas — be it the rock formations of Czech‑Saxon Switzerland or scenic routes along the Elbe.

name: Aqua Hotel
description: Aqua Hotel in Děčín is a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers riding through northern Czechia, especially along routes near the Elbe. The hotel is easily accessible by bike, and on-site parking ensures your motorcycle stays safe. After a long ride, you can relax in comfortable rooms or visit the hotel’s aquapark and pools.
