In the evening, enjoy a stroll to Děčín’s town center or head up to nearby viewpoints for scenic views. The hotel’s lively and relaxed atmosphere makes it an excellent overnight stop between riding routes.

name: Wellness Hotel Kocanda
description: Wellness Hotel Kocanda is located in Děčín by the Elbe riverside and right on a cycling route — a perfect stop for motorcycle travelers looking to mix riding with relaxation. The hotel is bike‑accessible, and on‑site parking makes it easy to store your motorcycle securely. After a long ride, you can unwind in the private wellness area, which includes a hydromassage tub with ambient lighting, a glass‑walled Finnish sauna, and a relaxing lounge. In the evening, enjoy dinner on the terrace overlooking the river, paired with traditional Czech cuisine and beer from the tank. The hotel’s calm and stylish vibe makes it an ideal overnight point between riding segments.

name: Hotel Formule
description: Hotel Formule is located just outside Děčín, making it a practical stop for motorcycle travelers riding through northern Czechia. The hotel is bike‑accessible, and there’s free on‑site parking to securely leave your motorcycle. After a long ride, you can unwind by the seasonal outdoor pool or stroll through the garden and terrace, and later enjoy dinner at the hotel’s restaurant. For more active breaks, the site offers mini‑golf, table tennis, and bike rental, so you can mix rest with movement. The overall vibe of the place is friendly and relaxed — a solid overnight spot between riding routes.

name: Kristin Hrádek
description: Kristin Hrádek is a charming historic hunting castle located near Děčín, right on the Czech‑German border — a fantastic stop for motorcycle travelers who appreciate both road riding and architectural heritage. The castle is bike‑accessible, and its secluded location gives you a peaceful retreat. You can relax in elegant rooms and apartments, while the restaurant serves traditional Czech cuisine, reinforcing the castle’s authentic atmosphere. The surrounding forest trails and scenic overlooks make it a perfect spot for an evening walk to unwind after a ride. The overall mood is calm, romantic, and inspiring, making it an ideal overnight point between riding routes.

name: Chata Tokáň
description: Chata Tokáň is located right in the heart of the Czech‑Swiss National Park (České Švýcarsko), making it an ideal stop for motorbike travellers seeking nature and tranquility. You can reach it on a bike via an asphalt road, with parking available on‑site for ease. After a day riding, unwind in neat, simple rooms or on the terrace overlooking the forest — a great way to recharge. Surrounded by woodland trails and rock formations, it offers an easy walk before your next leg of the journey. The calming, grassroots vibe makes it a perfect overnight point between adventures.

name: Hotel KORTUS
description: Hotel Kortus is located in the picturesque village of Vysoká Lípa, right in the heart of Bohemian Switzerland, making it a perfect stop for motorcycle travelers who want to combine riding with nature. The hotel is easily bike‑accessible, and there is free on‑site parking to leave your motorcycle overnight. After a day on the road, you can unwind in stylish air-conditioned rooms with a minibar, and enjoy dinner at the on‑site restaurant — the terrace is especially pleasant in the evening. The hotel is close to key route highlights like the Small Pravčická Gate, the Kamenice Gorge, and other natural attractions. With its cozy atmosphere, historic building beautifully renovated, and friendly staff, this hotel is a great overnight option between riding segments.

name: Forester Park Resort
description: Resort U Fořta is a secluded complex located in the heart of Bohemian Switzerland, making it an ideal stop for motorcycle travelers seeking peace and immersion in nature. The resort offers unique haylofts — luxurious, historically inspired cabins where you can watch the stars at night and wake up to the gentle rustle of grass. For those who prefer more conventional comfort, there is a modern hotel building with rooms equipped with kitchenettes, minibars, and secure storage (plus nearby parking). In the 200-year-old forester’s lodge, you’ll find a romantic, historic atmosphere, and the resort’s restaurant serves dishes made from seasonal local ingredients — perfect for recharging after a long ride. Given its proximity to scenic routes like the Pravčická Gate and forest trails, this resort is a great overnight base on your motorcycle journey.

name: Falkenštejn Brewery
description: Brewery Falkenštejn in Krásná Lípa is not just a brewery but also a cozy guesthouse, with several rooms and apartments located within the brewery building. For motorcycle travelers, it's very practical: you can ride right up to the brewery and park nearby. After a ride, unwind with craft beer straight from the tank, then head up to comfortable rooms, some of which feature a kitchenette. In the evening, enjoy a meal in the brewery’s restaurant — the menu is inspired by brewery tradition and pairs perfectly with the beer. With its location in the scenic region of Bohemian–Saxon Switzerland, this spot makes for a great overnight stop for bikers looking to combine riding with a relaxed, flavorful break.

name: Area 51
description: Area 51 is a cozy chalet-style bar and restaurant located along the scenic road between Cortina d’Ampezzo and San Vito di Cadore, making it a convenient stop for motorcycle travelers. It’s a great place to take a break after winding mountain roads, enjoy a meal, and soak in the Dolomite views from the wide sunny terrace. The menu features hearty dishes and a well-known club sandwich, perfect after a long ride. The spot is welcoming both for groups and for travelers with children, thanks to a small playground in the back. There is also on-site parking, which is particularly practical for bikers looking to keep their motorcycles easily accessible and safe.

name: Autofficina Pneus Cortina Snc Di Alberti Elvio E Italo
description: The Pneus Cortina (Alberti Elvio & Italo) workshop is located in Cortina d’Ampezzo at Pian da Lago, 61. It offers reliable maintenance services, including tire fitting, vehicle repair, and also motorcycle inspections. The workshop is part of the PuntoPro network, guaranteeing qualified staff and modern diagnostic equipment. Their opening hours are convenient — weekdays and Saturday mornings — so you can plan your stop during a biking trip. This spot is particularly useful for bikers who need to check tire condition or perform a revision before tackling the mountain passes.

name: Parcheggio Passo Giau
description: The parking area at Passo Giau is a perfect stopover for motorcyclists tackling one of the most scenic mountain passes in the Dolomites. Located right at the summit, at an elevation of about 2,236 m, it offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Tofane, Croda da Lago, and other peaks. The parking lot is open 24 hours, making it ideal for early starts or evening stops. While there are no extensive services directly on the spot, it's a fantastic base for photo breaks, rest, and a quick mechanical check after winding climbs. For two-wheel travelers, this isn’t just a point on a map — it's a moment to breathe, reflect, and take in the Alpine spirit.

name: Museo Postazioni Italiane Grande Guerra alle Cinque Torri
description: The open-air Great War Museum at the Cinque Torri is a deeply evocative historical site where visitors can walk through preserved trenches, dugouts, and artillery positions from World War I. This was once the location of the Italian mountain artillery command, and original military installations—such as observation posts, barracks, and gun emplacements—have been faithfully reconstructed. The paths are well-maintained and marked, making them accessible even for families, and informative panels in Italian, English, and German explain the history. All this is set against the dramatic backdrop of the Cinque Torri rock towers, offering both a powerful experience of history and stunning alpine views. For bikers, it’s a meaningful stop: a place to reflect, stretch your legs, and capture unforgettable mountain scenery.

name: M.C.M Moto Centro Moena
description: M.C.M Moto Centro in Moena is a trustworthy garage for motorcyclists, offering maintenance, repairs, and tire services. The workshop is well-equipped and staffed by experienced mechanics who understand the specific needs of touring riders. It's conveniently located in the heart of the Trentino valleys, making it an ideal stop before tackling mountain passes. Riders can not only get their bike in top shape but also receive professional advice on road conditions, route options, and bike care after winding climbs. For bikers riding through the Dolomites, M.C.M Moto Centro is a reliable waypoint to ensure your machine is ready for the next leg of the journey.

name: Parking Passo Pordoi
description: The Passo Pordoi parking lies right at the summit of the pass, making it a key stop for motorcyclists cruising the Dolomites. The pass itself sits at around 2,239 meters in altitude, offering spectacular mountain vistas. According to user feedback, the parking is free and provides about 30 spaces, though relatively few are level. There are no services on site — it’s essentially a resting point for breaks, photos, or as a base to start hikes or take the cable car. For bikers riding the Pordoi switchbacks, this is a prime spot to pause, regroup, and soak in the panoramic surroundings before continuing.

name: Bobo Moto
description: Bobo Moto is a motorcycle service center right in the heart of Bormio on Via Milano, 53, where riders can rely on professional repair and maintenance. This workshop specializes in motorcycles — covering tuning, suspension work, tire fitting, and diagnosing issues that often arise during intense Alpine riding. Thanks to experienced mechanics, it’s an especially valuable stop for travelers tackling iconic passes such as Stelvio or Gavia. After long mountain roads, you can drop in, refresh your machine, and get advice for the next legs of your journey. For bikers on tour, Bobo Moto is a key point of safety and reassurance along the route.

name: Ristorante Vecchia Combo
description: The Vecchia Combo restaurant is a cozy, traditional spot right in the heart of Bormio (Piazza Santuario), making it a perfect break for bikers after tackling the mountain switchbacks. The menu features classic Valtellina cuisine — think pizzoccheri, taroz, and other regional specialties made with fresh, local ingredients. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with a charming alpine feel and friendly, family-run service. There are outdoor seating options that make it especially pleasant on sunny, clear days. For motorcyclists, it’s not just a place to grab a bite — it’s a chance to connect with the culinary and cultural heart of the region.

name: Sunrise Ristorante con Pizzeria
description: The Sunrise Restaurant & Pizzeria in Bormio is a cozy spot offering a relaxed, welcoming break for bikers after tackling Alpine switchbacks. Their pizzas are baked in a wood-fired oven with dough made from Italian flour and a minimum 24-hour fermentation. The menu features not only pizza but also traditional regional dishes, and there’s a fixed tourist menu that offers great value. A standout is their wine cellar — with over 100 wine labels, including local specialties — perfect for pairing with your meal. The atmosphere is warm and calm, making it an ideal place to refuel, relax, and recharge for the next leg of your ride.

name: Clem Pub Birreria
description: Clem Pub Birreria is a popular pub located in the heart of Bormio at Via Fiera 4, offering bikers a relaxed stop after winding mountain roads. The menu includes a wide selection of craft and classic beers, along with burgers, pizza, and snacks. The pub has a cozy atmosphere and friendly staff, capturing the charm of a true Alpine tavern. There’s also a game area with pool, darts, and table tennis, adding a fun, social element. For motorcyclists, Clem Pub is an ideal place to meet fellow riders, unwind, and recharge before continuing their journey.

name: Hotel Nufenen
description: This three-star hotel is located in the picturesque village of Ulrichen in the Swiss canton of Valais. Situated on Furkastrasse 19, it is a convenient stop for travellers exploring nearby mountain passes. The rooms are modern, featuring balconies, cozy seating areas and complimentary Wi-Fi. The restaurant offers a generous breakfast each morning and a three-course dinner in the evening. The hotel is ideal for active holidays, providing access to hiking trails, cycling routes and winter sports. Mountain views, peaceful surroundings and friendly staff create a welcoming and relaxing stay.

name: Hotel Hof und Post GmbH
description: This traditional hotel is located in the picturesque village of Innertkirchen in the canton of Bern, Switzerland. It lies at the junction of roads leading to mountain passes, making it a convenient base for hiking and motorcycle tours. The rooms are simple yet comfortable, with complimentary Wi-Fi and a cozy ambiance. The hotel features a restaurant serving regional cuisine in a pleasant setting. Guests also enjoy free parking and a garden terrace for relaxation after an active day. The staff are friendly and create a homely atmosphere amidst Alpine scenery.

name: Hotel Astoria
description: This family-run hotel-restaurant is located in the alpine village of Ulrichen in the canton of Valais, Switzerland. It features panoramic mountain and valley views, comfortable guest rooms and a restaurant focused on regional cuisine. The hotel’s prime location between the Nufenen, Furka and Grimsel mountain passes makes it an excellent base for travellers. Guests can enjoy a sauna, a garage for motorcycles and free parking - especially convenient for active tourists. Breakfast is served as a rich buffet, and evening menus showcase local specialties. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming: many guests highlight the comfortable stay and attentive staff.

name: Hotel Restaurant Urweider
description: This family-run hotel-restaurant is located in the picturesque village of Innertkirchen in the Haslital region of the canton of Bern. The cosy rooms are modern in design and offer a comfortable stay amidst the mountains. The on-site restaurant is known for regional cuisine and a friendly atmosphere. The hotel is conveniently situated for hiking, cycling and scenic drives through mountain passes.

name: Berghotel Steingletscher
description: This mountain hotel is located right beneath the Steingletscher glacier on the Susten Pass in the canton of Bern, Switzerland. It offers breathtaking panoramic views of the glacier, lake and alpine rock formations. The rooms are simply furnished and cosy, in a traditional alpine style, with amenities such as Wi-Fi and en-suite bathrooms. The hotel serves as an excellent base for hiking, skiing and mountaineering trails.

name: Hotel Restaurant Grimsel
description: This cozy hotel‐restaurant is located in the picturesque Ober Goms valley (canton of Valais, Switzerland) surrounded by alpine scenery. The rooms are decorated in a classic mountain style, offering comfort after active hikes and routes. In the restaurant guests are served dishes made from local products—such as fondue and raclette—and in summer you can dine on the sunny terrace. The hotel is conveniently situated for nature lovers, scenic mountain roads and a peaceful retreat away from the hustle.

name: Hotel Aurora
description: This hotel is located in the alpine village of Andermatt in the canton of Uri and provides convenient access to ski slopes and lifts. Guests can enjoy a generous breakfast buffet, as well as an on-site café and small shop.The hotel serves as a great base for mountain hikes in summer and skiing in winter. The overall atmosphere is warm and relaxed, making it suitable for both families and active travellers.

name: Museum Ferrari Maranello
description: The Ferrari Museum in Maranello is an iconic stop for motorcycle travelers who appreciate speed, engineering, and the legendary world of motorsport. Visitors can explore famous Formula 1 cars, rare road models, and interactive exhibits showcasing the evolution of Italian automotive design. The museum sits right next to the Ferrari factory, adding an authentic touch of historical heritage. Parking is convenient and suitable for motorcycles, making it an easy and valuable stop along a ride through Emilia-Romagna. After the visit you can stroll through Maranello and experience the unique atmosphere that Ferrari brings to the town.

name: Ducati Museum
description: The Ducati Museum in Bologna is a must-stop for motorcycle travelers passionate about performance, engineering, and motorsport heritage. The museum showcases iconic Ducati bikes — from vintage classics to modern prototypes — alongside the brand’s rich history. There are interactive areas where you can dive into the racing legacy, view trophies, and learn about the company’s technical evolution. There’s convenient parking for motorcycles, making it an ideal stop when touring through Northern Italy. After your visit, you can explore Bologna — a city steeped in medieval charm, delicious cuisine, and a strong motorcycling spirit.

name: Moto Guzzi Museum
description: The Moto Guzzi Museum in Mandello del Lario is housed in the historic factory building where the legendary “Eagle” brand was born in 1921. The collection features over 150 exhibits, including iconic production bikes, racing prototypes, engines, and experimental models — among them Carlo Guzzi’s very first motorcycle from 1919. There is a dedicated racing section with bikes that made Moto Guzzi famous on the track, and a special “The Sound of Passion” area showing videos on the brand’s legacy. For motorcycle travelers, this is a shrine to heritage, passion, and engineering — a meaningful stop when touring through Northern Italy. Admission is free, but visits are by guided tour and require prior reservation.

name: Museo Nicolis
description: The Nicolis Museum in Villafranca di Verona is a remarkable venue where motorcycles, vintage cars, bicycles, cameras, and musical instruments come together to tell the story of 20th-century technology and design. The collection includes over 200 classic cars, around 100 motorcycles, and a wide array of mechanical marvels, making it a fascinating stop for motorcycle travelers. The museum building itself is a sleek, modern aluminium-and-glass pavilion that complements the timeless nature of its exhibits. Located near Verona, it provides convenient parking — suitable for bikes — and makes a compelling break on a motorcycling journey. More than just a museum, Nicolis is a cultural space where engineering heritage and creative spirit meet, perfect for a pause to reflect and recharge.

name: Museo Piaggio
description: The Piaggio Museum in Pontedera is a must-see for motorcyclists and lovers of automotive heritage. It features a vast collection of Vespa scooters, motorcycles, three- and four-wheelers from Piaggio — from vintage classics to rare prototypes. The exhibition spans about 5,000 m² and includes dedicated halls for motorcycles, Ape, Porter, and a rich historical archive. Visits must be booked in advance online, as this is a strict requirement. The museum is open Tuesday through Saturday, and on the second and fourth Sunday of each month. Entry is free, though a voluntary contribution is appreciated.

name: National Motorcycle Museum
description: The National Motorcycle Museum (Museo Nazionale del Motociclo) in Rimini is a major destination with over 250 motorcycles from different periods and brands. The exhibition includes pioneer bikes from the late 1800s and early 1900s, interwar models, sidecars, racing motorcycles, and utilitarian post-war bikes. The museum is organized into thematic areas that guide visitors through the evolution of two-wheeled transport and technical design. For motorcyclists, it’s a highly inspiring stop — a place to dive deep into the roots of bike culture and see historic machines up close.

name: Cinque Torri
description: Cinque Torri (Five Towers) is a striking rock formation in the Dolomites, near Cortina d’Ampezzo, reaching up to 2,361 m in height with five distinctive “tower” peaks. This site carries deep historical significance — during World War I, it was part of the frontline, and visitors can now walk through restored trenches, bunkers, and artillery positions. Today, it's an open‑air war museum where walking among the towers becomes a powerful journey into the past. For adventure seekers, Cinque Torri is also a renowned climbing area, offering routes of varying difficulty on its rugged dolomite walls. For motorcyclists, it’s a perfect scenic stopping point: a place to pause, take photos, and reflect on the history and beauty of the Alpine landscape.

name: Karer See
description: Karer See (also known as Lago di Carezza) is a magical high‑mountain lake in the Dolomites, situated at around 1,520 m above sea level. Its water dazzles in emerald green and mirrors the towering peaks of the Latemar massif — especially striking at sunrise and sunset. According to legend, a water nymph lived in the lake, and a wizard crafted a rainbow of jewels, only to shatter it, the fragments of which now give the lake its shimmering colors. The lake is fed by underground springs, so the water level varies significantly with the seasons. A walking trail and viewing platform offer stunning vantage points — making Karer See a scenic and thoughtful stop for bikers riding through the Dolomites.

name: Gavia Pass
description: Gavia Pass (Passo Gavia) is one of the highest paved passes in the Alps, located at approximately 2,621 m on the border between Sondrio and Brescia provinces. The SS 300 road that crosses the pass is narrow, winding, and incredibly scenic, featuring steep hairpins and stunning views of glaciers and alpine meadows. Gavia has a legendary place in cycling history — during the Giro d’Italia, especially in 1988 when a fierce snowstorm struck, the pass became a symbol of endurance. Historically, this pass was strategically significant: its modern road was substantially expanded during World War I, transforming it into a crucial alpine route. For motorcyclists, Gavia Pass is a thrilling and rewarding stop — riding its switchbacks at high altitude with panoramic mountain views and alpine lakes offers an unforgettable experience.

name: Harley Davidson Bozen
description: Harley-Davidson Bozen is the official Harley-Davidson dealership in Bolzano. Here, motorcyclists can browse new and pre-owned bikes, buy gear and accessories, and grab official merchandise — a great place for inspiration on the road. The shop also offers maintenance and repair services, making it a reliable stop if you need to check or fix your bike. They provide Harley rentals and demo rides as well. The location is Via Antonio Pacinotti 4, Bolzano / Bozen. Opening hours are Monday–Friday from 09:30 to 12:30 and 14:00 to 18:30, and Saturday mornings from 09:30 to 12:30.

name: V Motors
description:
V Motors is a small motorcycle workshop and parts shop located near Bolzano, convenient for riders exploring the mountain routes of South Tyrol. It’s a good stop for quick technical assistance: replacing consumables, finding essential spare parts, or doing a simple check-up before hitting the road again.
It’s a compact, low-key place focused on helping traveling motorcyclists who need efficient, no-fuss service without long delays.

name: Movetronix
description: Movetronix — это специализированный мотомагазин в Валь-Гардене, где мотоциклисты могут найти широкий ассортимент деталей и аксессуаров: от масла и тормозных колодок до CNC-элементов, тормозных систем и кастомных компонентов. Также здесь делают шиномонтаж и базовое обслуживание техники — удобно сделать остановку перед альпийским маршрутом или после серпатинов. Магазин ориентирован на качество “Made in Val Gardena” и предлагает как брендовые, так и фирменные запчасти, разработанные локально. Атмосфера спокойная и фокусируется на ремесленном подходе, для мотоциклистов это место, где можно не просто купить часть, но и получить совет от настоящих энтузиастов.

name: Biker bar
description: Biker Bar is a legendary pub in Bolzano located on Via Antonio Pacinotti, beloved by motorcyclists and the biker community. The bar is open from early morning to late at night, making it a perfect stop whether you’re riding during the day or winding down after a long journey. The menu features burgers, sandwiches, beer, and snacks in a relaxed, rocker-style atmosphere — patrons often mention live music and friendly staff. It’s a place where bikers can unwind, meet fellow riders, and swap stories about the road. For two‑wheel travellers, Biker Bar isn’t just a bar — it’s a biker hub, full of passion and camaraderie.

name: Bikers' Bos
description: Bikers' Bos is a warm and welcoming pub in Masarié (Veneto), conveniently located along the SP347 road — a great stop for motorcyclists on a ride. The atmosphere is retro-style, with pool tables, foosball, and vintage games offering a laid-back place to unwind after winding roads. The menu features grilled dishes alongside a wide drink selection — beer, wine, cocktails — delivering classic biker fare. Outdoor seating and on‑site parking make it especially biker-friendly; you can safely park your motorcycle and relax for a while. It’s a spot where riders gathering, unwind, and recharge their spirit before hitting the road again.

name: In Sella
description: In Sella is a charming bar-restaurant located in a scenic spot beneath the mountain passes in South Tyrol, making it an ideal stop for motorcyclists on the road. It’s a cozy place to rest, grab a coffee or beer, and enjoy both Italian and Tyrolean cuisine. The terrace offers panoramic views of the mountain passes, creating a relaxing and refreshing atmosphere for a break. The staff are friendly and welcoming to travelers, and it's common to meet fellow bikers sharing route stories. For those looking to recharge, refuel, and soak in the alpine spirit before tackling more switchbacks, In Sella is a perfect choice.

name: Chiosco Bar da Silver
description: Chiosco Bar da Silver is a cozy kiosk-bar nestled in Colle Santa Lucia, offering stunning mountain views. It’s a perfect pit stop for bikers: the menu features tasty panini, salsiccia, fries, and beer — simple but satisfying. The vibe is relaxed and welcoming, with friendly staff who genuinely enjoy hosting travelers looking to unwind and soak up the alpine atmosphere. This spot is beloved by road trippers for its genuine mountain charm and makes a great place to pause, refuel, and take in the high-altitude surroundings.

name: Bar Buffet Stazione
description: Bar Buffet Stazione is a bar-buffet located right by the train station in Cortina d’Ampezzo. It’s a perfect stop for motorcyclists needing a quick break between mountain passes — ideal for grabbing a coffee, a snack, or a light bite. The bar has a simple yet welcoming style, with a practical atmosphere and friendly staff. It’s a no-fuss, convenient place to re-energize without veering off your route. Its location by the station makes it a clever stop, especially if you’re combining your ride with train travel or just want to rest in the heart of Cortina.

name: Villa Franca
description: Villa Franca is a cozy 3-star hotel located just 200 meters from the shores of Lake Garda, making it a perfect base for bikers looking to explore the scenic roads around the lake. The hotel offers secure parking and is close to cycling routes — so you can park your bike safely and head out for rides. After a day on your bike, you can unwind in the garden, take a dip in the pool, or enjoy the spa area with a sauna and Turkish bath. In the evening, relax at the bar or terrace, savoring Italian cuisine with views over the mountains or the lake. During spring, summer and autumn, the hotel organizes free guided mountain bike tours, and there is a secure bike service area for two-wheelers.

name: Hotel Al Sorriso
description: Hotel Al Sorriso Greenpark & Wellness sits on the shores of Lake Levico, surrounded by a private 20,000 m² park — a perfect retreat for motorcyclists who appreciate nature and tranquility. For bikers, there’s dedicated infrastructure: a covered garage or parking, plus a workshop area and equipment service for motorcycles. After a ride, you can unwind in the spa area featuring an indoor pool, saunas, a Turkish bath, Kneipp therapies, and peaceful relaxation zones. The hotel’s restaurant emphasizes local and seasonal produce, much of which comes from its own organic garden, offering a true taste of Trentino. The staff is very biker-friendly: they can provide touring maps, route advice, contacts for repair shops and recommended scenic roads around Valsugana.

name: Cristallo Sport & Wellness Hotel
description: Hotel Cristallo Sport & Wellness is located in the quiet upper area of Levico Terme, close to the town center and the lake, making it a convenient stop for motorcyclists. The hotel offers a secure garage and a dedicated motorcycle service area, including a washing spot and basic tools. After a long ride, guests can unwind in the wellness area featuring a pool, several saunas, and relaxing zones. Rooms are designed in a warm Alpine style, creating a cosy atmosphere after an active day. The staff is familiar with the region’s routes and can recommend scenic roads around Valsugana and Lagorai.

name: Hotel Reipertingerhof
description: Hotel Reipertingerhof is a family-run, cozy hotel located in Reischach (near Brunico), ideally situated for motorcyclists exploring the winding passes of the Dolomites. It offers a secure, lockable garage where motorcycles can be parked free of charge. There is a drying room for riding gear, a workshop area with a lift, tools, and repair facilities to service your bike. After a ride, guests can relax in the wellness area with a sauna, steam bath, infrared cabin, and relaxation zones. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with home-style cuisine and friendly hosts, making you feel right at home in the heart of the mountains. The owner is a passionate biker himself, often leading guided motorcycle tours through the scenic roads of South Tyrol.

name: Ristorante Pizzeria Gilda
description: Ristorante Pizzeria Gilda is a cozy restaurant-pizzeria in Levico Terme, conveniently located along motorbike routes through Valsugana. It’s a perfect spot for bikers to stop, refuel with freshly made pizzas and classic Italian dishes. The restaurant offers parking, making it easy to safely leave your bike while you dine. The laid-back, welcoming atmosphere is ideal for a relaxed dinner after a day of riding. Staff speak English and are happy to share tips on scenic local roads and touring routes.

name: DAS Mondschein Aktiv&Wohlfühlhotel
description: DAS Mondschein Aktiv & Well-Being Hotel is a true biker retreat, perfectly located for exploring the twisty passes of the Dolomites. The hotel offers secure parking for motorcycles, a washing area, a small workshop, and a drying room — everything your bike might need. After a ride, you can unwind in the wellness center with an indoor pool, Finnish sauna, steam grotto, and relaxing lounge zones. The hotel team supports motorbike tours by providing a roadbook full of curated routes through the Alpine passes. In the evenings, enjoy local cuisine and friendly company in the relaxed hotel restaurant.

name: Hotel Condor
description: Hotel Condor is a family-run, upscale hotel located in St. Vigil at the foot of Kronplatz, making it a perfect base for motorcyclists exploring the winding passes of the Dolomites. The hotel offers covered parking, a wash area for bikes, tools, an air compressor, and a drying room — everything a biker needs to take care of their machine. The owner, Konrad, is a passionate rider himself and helps guests plan their trips with road maps, printouts, and GPS-downloadable roadbooks. After an adventurous day on the road, you can unwind in the wellness centre featuring a large indoor pool, sauna, steam room, infrared cabin and relaxation zones. The hotel cuisine combines traditional Dolomite and Mediterranean flavors in a warm, family-style atmosphere.

name: Rider Hotel Obereggen
description: Rider Hotel Obereggen is located in the scenic Obereggen area at about 1,400 m altitude — an excellent base for bikers who love the winding passes of the Dolomites. The hotel offers covered parking for motorcycles, a washing area, and a drying room for rider gear. After a day on the road, you can unwind in the outdoor wooden sauna or on the terrace with mountain views. In the on-site steakhouse & pub, you can enjoy burgers, steaks, and meals cooked on hot volcanic stone — a perfect way to round off a day of riding. Guests also receive GPS roadbooks with 30 popular guided tour routes through the Dolomites, including passes and lake rides.

name: Hotel Gran Paradis
description: Hotel Gran Paradis is nestled in the heart of Val di Fassa, offering breathtaking views of the Catinaccio, Sella, and Marmolada peaks — making it a superb base for motorcyclists tackling the Dolomite passes. The hotel provides covered motorcycle parking, a deposit, and garage facilities to keep your bike safe. There is a washing area, a workshop, and a drying room for your riding gear — everything a biker needs. After a long ride, you can unwind in the spa center featuring an indoor pool, sauna, and relaxing wellness zones. The hotel also offers biker-friendly packages with guided tours, roadbooks, and recommendations for the most scenic mountain routes.

name: Residence hotel Da Remo
description: Residence Hotel Da Remo is perched on the hill of Tenna, between Lake Caldonazzo and Lake Levico — a peaceful and scenic retreat, perfect for motorcyclists seeking a quiet mountain base. This is a true biker-friendly hotel: there is a garage or parking for bikes, a small workshop, and a drying area for gear. Bikers receive GPS files and maps with curated mountain pass routes through the Dolomites. After a day on the road, you can unwind on the terrace overlooking the lake or enjoy a beer garden-style evening as the sun sets over the mountains. The hotel’s restaurant serves local specialties and light Italian fare, all in a warm, relaxed, homey atmosphere.

name: Hotel Villa Colico
description: Hotel Villa Colico is set in a quiet area of Colico, just a short walk from the lakeside — a convenient stop for riders exploring both the Alpine roads and scenic lake routes. The hotel offers private parking, providing a safe place to leave your motorcycle at the end of the day. The rooms are spacious and well-kept, offering a relaxing environment to rest and recharge. In the evening, guests can unwind in the cosy bar or sit outside on the terrace, enjoying the atmosphere of the lakeside town. For those wanting to explore further, bicycle rentals are available to discover the surrounding valleys and panoramic paths.

name: Parc Hotel Posta
description: Parc Hotel Posta is located in the heart of San Vigilio di Marebbe, making it a great base for bikers who want to explore the Dolomite passes and winding roads around Kronplatz. The hotel offers parking so motorcyclists can safely park their bikes after a day on the road. Guests can unwind in the indoor pool and garden — a perfect recovery spot after a long ride. The hotel’s interiors are styled in a traditional Alpine way with warm, cozy decor. The staff are happy to recommend scenic motorcycle routes, viewpoints, and touring roads in the surrounding area.

name: Hotel Almhof Call
description: Hotel Almhof Call is a stylish 4-star wellness hotel located in San Vigilio (St. Vigil), at the foot of the Kronplatz pass — a superb base for motorbike tours through the Dolomites. The hotel provides free motorcycle parking, a washing area, tool corner, and a drying room for your gear. The hosts organise self-guided and group bike tours, offering roadbooks and maps with scenic Dolomite routes. After a full day of riding, you can unwind in their wellness centre with a swimming pool, multiple saunas, a steam bath, and relaxing areas. In the evening, guests can enjoy a refined yet cozy cuisine that blends Alpine elegance with home-style hospitality.

name: Hotel Ludwigshof & Luvina
description: Hotel Ludwigshof & Luvina is nestled in the Trudner Horn Nature Park in South Tyrol — a perfect base for motorcyclists wanting to explore Dolomite passes and the winding roads of the region. As one of the first MoHo motorcycle-friendly hotels in the area, it offers covered motorcycle parking, a wash station, a small workshop, and a drying room for your riding gear. The host is a passionate rider himself and can share curated roadbooks and route recommendations for mountain passes. After riding, you can relax on the terrace overlooking vineyards and alpine hills or enjoy a meal in the cozy, homey restaurant. The hotel also offers special biker packages, including curve-training courses to improve your riding skills.

name: Hotel Obereggen
description: Hotel Obereggen is located on a sunny plateau at the foot of the Latemar mountain group — a perfect spot for motorcyclists aiming to ride the twisting passes of the Dolomites. The hotel provides covered parking, a dedicated motorcycle garage, a washing station, a repair corner, and a drying room for your riding gear. Biker guests can use the “Bike-Info-Corner” with maps, GPS tracks, and recommended tour suggestions. After a day on the road, you can unwind in the jacuzzi or on the terrace while enjoying panoramic mountain views. The hotel offers special biker packages including a welcome beer, route advice, and other thoughtful touches tailored to riders.

name: Hotel Castel Latemar
description: Hotel Castel Latemar is nestled in the mountains between the Latemar and Catinaccio ranges, making it a superb base for motorcyclists who want to explore the Karer Pass and other scenic Alpine bends. The hotel offers a free motorcycle garage, a repair corner, tour maps (including digital versions for your navigator), and a drying room for riding gear. After a day on the road, you can unwind on the terrace with panoramic mountain views, or in the wellness area with a sauna and steam bath. The restaurant serves regional cuisine and a good selection of drinks — offering local charm and warmth. Thanks to its biker‑friendly atmosphere and dedicated infrastructure, it’s an ideal place for both short curve‑filled rides and longer touring adventures.

name: Hotel Diana Bike & Ski
description: Bike & Ski Hotel Diana is located in Nova Levante at the foot of the Latemar massif, making it a perfect base for motorcyclists who love riding Alpine passes and curvy mountain roads. The hotel offers covered parking and a garage for motorcycles, a workshop corner, washing facilities, and a drying room for your riding gear — ideal for keeping your bike in shape. Bikers can receive route maps and download GPS tracks for scenic passes and mountain roads. After a day on the road, you can unwind in the wellness area with a Finnish sauna, a whirlpool, and a rock-integrated shower. The restaurant features seasonal and local cuisine, creating a warm, Alpine-style dining experience.

name: Biohotel & Bikehotel Steineggerhof
description: Bio & Bikehotel Steineggerhof is quietly nestled in Steinegg, among forested hills and far from main roads — a peaceful retreat for motorcyclists who appreciate a calm, nature-rich base. The hotel offers a motorcycle garage, a repair workshop, a washing area, and a dedicated drying room for your riding gear. Biker guests receive GPS‑data and route maps, including roadbooks tailored to scenic tour routes. After a long ride, you can unwind in the wellness area, which features an indoor pool, a Finnish sauna, a whirlpool, and a panoramic terrace. The restaurant serves organic cuisine, focusing on seasonal and plant-based dishes made with locally grown ingredients — many harvested from the hotel’s own garden.

name: Hotel Santoni
description: Hotel Santoni Freelosophy is located in Torbole, on the northern shore of Lake Garda — making it a perfect base for motorcyclists combining lake rides and mountain passes. The hotel offers secure bike and motorcycle storage with video surveillance and alarm system. Bikers can use the laundry facilities for their gear and a maintenance corner, making it easy to care for your equipment. Guests receive route maps and cycling or motorbike touring advice, and the staff are happy to recommend the best roads around Garda Trentino. In the evening, unwind in the lounge bar with a “post-ride” atmosphere and connect with other travelers.

name: Hotel Garni Toresela
description: Hotel Garni Toresela is a biker‑friendly inn in Nago‑Torbole, perfectly positioned near the northern shore of Lake Garda and close to scenic mountain roads — ideal for motorcyclists. The hotel offers a secure motorcycle garage, a small workshop for light repairs, a bike wash area, and a compressor — everything you need on the road. There is also a laundry room for your riding gear and a drying space for clothes after long rides. At the reception you can pick up maps, route guides, and GPS tracks with curated motorcycle tours around Garda and the Trentino hills. In the evening, unwind in the cosy bar or on the terrace, soaking in the relaxed lakeside atmosphere.

name: Hotel Continental - Tonelli Hotels
description: Hotel Continental – Tonelli Hotels is located in Nago, just a short ride from the shores of Lake Garda — a perfect base for bikers looking to explore both winding mountain roads and lakeside routes. The hotel features a video-monitored garage to safely store motorcycles, a high-pressure wash area, a compressor, and a small workshop for minor repairs. There is also a drying room, a laundry service for rider gear, and a self-service area to care for your kit. After a ride, guests can unwind in the wellness area, which includes indoor and outdoor pools, a whirlpool, sauna, and relaxation lounge. The hotel’s terrace and bar “La Cort,” with live music, create a friendly space to share ride stories, get route advice, and plan your next day on the road.

name: Hotel Villa Clara
description: Hotel Villa Clara is located in the heart of Torbole, just 200 m from the shores of Lake Garda — an ideal base for motorcyclists looking to combine lake rides with nearby mountain routes. The hotel provides a secure motorcycle garage, a workshop with an air compressor, a bike wash area and a drying room for your riding gear — perfect for bike maintenance after a long ride. Rooms are simple but neat, offering a comfortable place to rest after a day on the road. From Torbole you can easily head out to the lake or into the mountains, and after returning you can relax in the hotel’s bar or garden. The family-run atmosphere and biker-friendly amenities make it a good choice for solo riders or couples.

name: Hotel Jonathan
description: Hotel Jonathan is located on a sunny apple-plateau in Natz-Schabs — a great base for motorbike tours across South Tyrol and the Dolomites. The hotel is officially bike/motorcycle-friendly: it provides a secure garage for bikes, a workshop with tools, a wash station, drying room for gear, and rental options for additional equipment. Guests get ready-made roadbooks, route advice, and help planning tours — perfect when you want to hit the road right away. After a ride you can relax in the wellness area with indoor/outdoor pool, saunas and relaxation zones, and enjoy healthy local cuisine made from seasonal produce. Comfortable rooms with wooden interiors offer a cozy atmosphere to rest and recharge for the next day on the road.

name: Gasthof Brugghof
description: Gasthof Brugghof is a traditional mountain guesthouse in Campo Tures, nestled among the Dolomites — a convenient base for bikers looking for a quiet stop before mountain passes. The hotel offers covered parking/garage with the possibility to store motorcycles, which is especially useful for overnight stays. After a ride you can refresh in the outdoor pool or unwind in the pub with live music — a great vibe for relaxing. Rooms are simple but clean and cozy; the newer apartments in the rear building get good feedback for comfort. For nature lovers and active travellers, there are hiking routes nearby and lovely mountain scenery.

name: Hotel Am Reschensee
description: Hotel Am Reschensee is situated right by Lake Resia on the high-plateau near the Reschen Pass — a perfect starting point for motorcyclists planning alpine routes through Italy, Austria and Switzerland. The hotel — a certified “MoHo / Motorrad Hotel” — provides a covered garage, a bike-wash and maintenance area, drying room for gear and tool corner. Guests have access to route maps, GPS roadbooks and optional guided tours — ideal for hitting the road right after arrival. After a long ride you can relax in the wellness area (sauna, steam bath, relaxing lounge) with stunning views over the lake and mountains. The hotel’s restaurant serves local cuisine in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere — a great way to end a day of riding.

name: Hotel Cavallino Bianco
description: Hotel Cavallino Bianco is located in Nova Levante (Welschnofen), at the foot of the Dolomites — an ideal base for motorcyclists planning to explore mountain passes and scenic Alpine routes. The hotel is part of a complex offering a garage and covered parking for motorcycles, with options for storage and basic maintenance if needed. After a ride you can relax in the spa/wellness area, a perfect place to recover before your next journey. In the evening guests enjoy a cosy atmosphere, good cuisine and warm hospitality — exactly what’s needed after a long ride. Thanks to its location, the hotel is conveniently placed for departures toward mountains, lakes or winding Dolomite roads.

name: Hotel & Restaurant Forni
description: Hotel Forni is a cozy family-run hotel in the Swiss Alps, located in the mountain village of Airolo at the foot of the St. Gotthard Pass. The rooms, renovated in 2018, feature a modern minimalist design and include all essential amenities for a comfortable stay. The hotel has a restaurant offering fresh and creative dishes in a warm, homelike atmosphere. Guests can unwind in the spa area, sauna, and Turkish bath after an active day in the mountains. Hotel Forni is ideal both for nature enthusiasts and for those passing through on their journey.

name: Hotel Restaurant Pazzola
description: Hotel Restaurant Pazzola is located on the quiet edge of a village surrounded by lush Alpine meadows, making it an ideal place for a peaceful getaway. The hotel offers 12 standard rooms and 2 family suites, many with balconies providing beautiful glacier views. Its restaurant serves refined dishes prepared from fresh Swiss ingredients in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Guests can enjoy the serene mountain environment while relaxing on the sunny terrace. The convenient location makes the hotel a great starting point for hiking and winter sports. Hotel Restaurant Pazzola is well suited for both outdoor enthusiasts and those seeking calm and comfort.

name: Hotel Bellavista
description: Hotel Bellavista is located in the village of Ravascletto in the Carnic Alps — a convenient base for bikers who want to ride the scenic mountain passes of Northern Italy. The hotel is a certified motorbike-friendly hotel: it offers covered parking for motorcycles, washing and drying facilities for gear, and a maintenance corner for light repairs. After a ride you can relax in the wellness area, and enjoy home-style Carnic meals in the evening, crafted with care for local tradition. A friendly, family atmosphere makes it a good choice both for solo riders and for group tours.

name: Lodenwirt Hotel
description: Hotel Lodenwirt is located in the Puster Valley (Val Pusteria), in a good spot for riders — easy access to main roads and a convenient base to reach the Dolomites and South Tyrol mountain passes. This 4-star hotel offers spacious rooms and has a large parking area + garage; many motorcycle-tourists mention that there is a covered parking/garage where you can safely store your bike overnight. After the ride you can unwind in the wellness/spa area — sauna, Turkish bath, hot tub and relaxation rooms — great for recovery after a day on the road. The hotel also features a restaurant and pizzeria, offering hearty regional and Italian dishes — perfect after a long ride. Thanks to its strategic location, Hotel Lodenwirt works as a convenient base for summer tours through mountain passes — and in winter nearby ski-resorts add flexibility, if you plan a mixed trip.

name: Taubers Unterwirt Aktiv & Vitalhotel
description: Aktiv & Vitalhotel Taubers Unterwirt is located in the village Velturno (Feldthurns), at about 850 m altitude — a convenient base for motorbike trips across South Tyrol and alpine passes. The hotel is part of “BikeHotels Südtirol,” designed to welcome cyclists and bikers: there is a covered garage/parking and facilities for storing and maintaining your bike. After a ride you can unwind in a spacious wellness area — with pools, saunas and spa treatments — perfect for recovery after long roads. Rooms are cozy, furnished with local wood, offering comfortable rest before another day on the road. The hotel also offers outdoor-active options — hiking, cycling, mountain trekking — useful if you want to combine motorbike travel with hiking or nature.

name: Hotel Krone
description: Hotel Krone lies right in the historic centre of Bressanone — perfect if you want to combine city vibes, culture and quick access to alpine routes. It’s a certified “Bike-Hotel”: there’s a covered garage for two-wheelers, bike-storage, washing / maintenance area, and bike rental possibilities. After a ride you can relax in the hotel’s wellness/spa area — ideal for recovering after long mountain roads or active days. On-site restaurant and bar let you eat or have a drink without leaving the hotel — convenient after a trip. Great location — mixing city centre comfort, valley base, and quick access to mountains — makes it a good hub for multi-day tours or as a stopover.

name: Alpenhof Mountain Residence (company Hotel Alpenhof KG Inh. Gasser Renate)
description: Mountain Residence Alpenhof is located in the village of Afers (Eores) above the Eisack valley near Bressanone — a peaceful and scenic base in the Dolomites, ideal for bikers planning mountain routes. The residence offers covered parking for motorcycles and a storage area for gear, which makes it biker-friendly for guests arriving on two wheels. The cozy apartments come with kitchens and mountain views — perfect for those who prefer flexibility and self-catering. The property also features a sauna, relaxation area and a panoramic terrace overlooking the peaks — a great way to unwind after a ride. For active travelers, there are plenty of trails around, and this location is a good starting point for exploring South Tyrol’s mountains.

name: Ca' Nova
description: Ca' Nova is a cosy agritourism estate in Bogogno, Piedmont — ideal for travellers looking for a peaceful stay in a scenic countryside setting. Accommodation is offered in apartments with kitchen facilities — convenient if you're travelling by bike or car and prefer to self-cater. There is parking available, so you can safely leave your motorcycle or car. Surrounded by vineyards and nature, it's a great place to unwind after a ride, enjoy some quiet, view the landscape, and perhaps taste local wine from the estate. It’s a good pick if you want to step a bit off the main roads and spend the evening in a relaxed, rustic atmosphere.

name: Hotel Lory
description: Hotel Lory is located in Molveno, close to the lake and the mountains — a convenient spot for motorcyclists who want to combine mountain rides with lakeside relaxation. For bikers, there is covered parking / garage, a secure place to store motorcycles, and facilities for washing and drying riding gear — convenient for maintaining your bike after the road. After a day in the saddle, you can unwind on the terrace or in cozy rooms with views of the lake and mountains — the panorama from here is often considered one of the best in the valley. The hotel’s location is practical: the village center and the lake are within walking distance — easy access to both nature and amenities. In the evening you can enjoy dinner in the hotel restaurant — a nice finish after a day of riding, with lake views and relaxed atmosphere.

name: B&B Hotel Kyrr
description: B&B Hotel Kyrr is located in Moena (Val di Fassa), in a quiet and panoramic area on the outskirts of town — yet just a few minutes walk from the village center, which makes it convenient for a motorbike traveler. The hotel offers free parking — a useful convenience if arriving on a motorcycle. Rooms are designed in a cozy Alpine style with mountain views, giving a comfortable place to rest after a ride. Breakfast is included — a good way to prepare for the next day’s ride. After a route you can easily reach the center of Moena to relax, get dinner or plan the next leg — the location works well for touring or staying a few nights.

name: Albergo Tuenno
description: Albergo Tuenno is located in the heart of the village of Tuenno (Ville d’Anaunia) in Val di Non — a convenient base for bikers travelling across Trentino and surrounding areas. The hotel provides free parking for cars and motorcycles — useful for safely leaving your bike overnight. Rooms are simple but comfortable, with wooden finishes, private bathrooms and all needed amenities — a nice place to rest after a long ride. Guests can enjoy a sweet breakfast each morning with homemade pastries and fresh local juice — a good preparation before a new motor-day. The hotel is located near natural spots and a lake, allowing a mix of road routes and scenic nature detours — a great option if you like combining riding and nature. In the evening you can dine in the hotel restaurant, which serves traditional Trentino dishes in a warm, homey atmosphere.

name: Hotel Molino del Ponte - Motorradhotel Tuscany
description: Hotel Il Molino del Ponte is a biker-friendly hotel set on the Chianti hills near the old Via Volterrana — a great base for motorcyclists wanting to explore Tuscany. The hotel offers a covered parking space specifically for motorcycles — a secure place to store your bike overnight. After a ride you can unwind at the outdoor pool or in the garden, surrounded by vineyards and olive groves — perfect for relaxation after a day on the road. Rooms and apartments come with private bathrooms, air conditioning and other comforts — offering a cozy place to rest after touring. The hotel’s location makes it ideal for discovering scenic roads and small Tuscan villages, and in the evening you can enjoy local cuisine and unwind at the bar.

name: Hotel L'Ulivo
description: Hotel L'Ulivo is located in the village of Girasole, Ogliastra region of Sardinia — just about 2 km from the sea, which makes it a convenient base for riders planning both coastal and inland routes. The hotel offers clean and comfy rooms, plus an outdoor pool and garden — perfect to relax after a long ride. The on-site restaurant/pizzeria serves Mediterranean and Sardinian dishes — a good meal before or after a day on the road. Girasole’s location is handy: within 5–10 min ride you can reach the coast or the town center — giving flexibility if you travel along the coast or plan to explore nearby areas. The hotel’s vibe is peaceful and relaxed — a decent option for those who appreciate simple comfort and rest after riding.

name: Hotel Pop
description: Hotel Pop is located right by the sea in Cala Gonone, next to the tourist port — a convenient spot for bikers who also want to enjoy coastal surroundings. The hotel offers parking — useful for travellers arriving on a motorcycle. Rooms feature balconies and in many cases sea or port views — a pleasant treat after a day riding. Just a few minutes’ walk from the hotel you can reach the beach or the sea — ideal if you want to mix mountain rides with seaside relaxation. Nearby restaurants and cafés make it easy to have dinner without going far — a good way to unwind after a ride, surrounded by sea and harbour vibe.

name: Antica Torre
description: Agriturismo Antica Torre is a historic rural estate located on the green hills near Salsomaggiore Terme — an ideal base for bikers looking for a peaceful countryside stay. There’s parking where you can safely leave your motorcycle overnight, and a warm, home-like atmosphere maintained by the hosts. After a ride you can unwind by the pool, stroll in the garden or relax on the porch — a great recovery spot after a day on the road. The restaurant serves homemade regional food, with local cheeses and traditional specialities; breakfasts with home-made jams and pastries give a good start before the next ride. Also, the location is convenient: within ~40–50 minutes by road you can reach alpine passes, scenic routes and historical sites of the region.

name: Hotel SA Contonera
description: Hotel Sa Contonera is located in Tortolì / Arbatax on Sardinia’s east coast — a convenient stop for bikers who want to mix road travel with seaside relaxation. The hotel offers an internal parking/garage where you can safely leave your motorcycle overnight. After a ride, you can unwind by the hotel’s outdoor pool, and nearby beaches and coastal scenery allow you to balance riding with sea-side rest. Rooms are simple and comfortable — enough for a relaxed night before continuing your journey. The hotel offers car/bike rental and transfer services, which is handy if you plan parts of your route without a motorcycle. Given its position — near sea, beaches, and main roads — Sa Contonera works well as a base for exploring eastern Sardinia by motorcycle.

name: Bio-Landhotel Anna
description: Bio-Landhotel Anna is located in the scenic Val Venosta valley, right in the centre of Silandro — close to shops and local eateries, but situated in a calm and quiet area.There is free on-site parking for guests — a real plus if you arrive on a motorcycle or by car. Rooms are cosy and many have balconies offering mountain views — ideal to unwind and enjoy the landscape after a long ride. The hotel serves organic meals made from local produce — after a day on the road, you can enjoy wholesome, fresh food. The location makes it a great base for travellers — perfect for hiking, cycling, motorcycling or exploring the surrounding mountains and valleys directly from the hotel.

name: Residence Garnì Hotel Vineus
description: Residence Garni Hotel Vineus sits on a hill above the village of Termeno, surrounded by vineyards — offering peaceful panoramic views and a calm spot to rest after a ride. It features comfortable rooms, apartments and suites, many with balconies overlooking the valley, plus amenities like a garden, terrace, outdoor pool and facilities for storing and caring for your bike and gear — handy for travelers on two wheels. There is free private parking (garage / covered spot) and a dedicated area for bike maintenance or storage. After a long day on the road, you can relax by the pool or terrace, while the hotel serves as a great starting point for motorcycle tours, bike or hiking trips through the mountains and wine country. The location gives a taste of alpine-wine-region charm: peaceful, scenic and full of character, yet within walking distance to Termeno’s center with cafes, local wineries and village atmosphere.

name: Hotel & Südtiroler Gasthaus Restaurant Gassenwirt
description: Hotel & Südtiroler Gasthaus Restaurant Gassenwirt lies in the small village of Chienes in South Tyrol — a peaceful, atmospheric spot perfect for resting after a ride. The rooms are simple yet cozy; arriving by motorcycle, you’ll likely appreciate parking availability and a quiet evening with no fuss — great for an overnight stop. The in-house traditional restaurant offers hearty meals and local cuisine — a solid dinner to fuel up before your next route. The location is convenient for motorcyclists: from Chienes it’s easy to head out to mountain roads and scenic valleys of South Tyrol. Authenticity, calm surroundings, and good food make Gassenwirt a good base for travel by bike.

name: Hotel Ristorante Teutschhaus
description: Hotel Ristorante Teutschhaus is located in the scenic village of Cortina sulla Strada del Vino — a calm, cozy spot that’s perfect for a rest after a ride. The rooms are simple but comfortable, making it a good overnight stop for motorcyclists. The hotel offers an in-house restaurant where you can enjoy a hearty homemade dinner — a real plus after a long day on the road. The location is conveniently close to the main roads of the region, so it’s easy to continue your ride: mountain passes, wine-country valleys and scenic routes are within reach. For travellers the hotel offers just what’s needed: peace, nature and a decent rest before the next leg of the journey.

name: Hotel Florian
description: Hotel Florian is located in the scenic mountain area of Selva di Val Gardena — a great spot to stop after a long motorcycle ride. The rooms are simple but cozy; as a biker, you’ll appreciate the ease of parking and a peaceful evening rest. The hotel offers tasty dinner and a homely atmosphere — perfect after a day on the road. The location is convenient for setting off on new routes through mountain roads, valleys and passes — Selva di Val Gardena gives direct access to beautiful alpine rides. Peace, nature and comfort — everything you need to recharge before the next leg of your journey.

name: Moar's Hotel
description: Moar's Hotel is located in the village of Valdaora — a convenient and practical spot for an overnight stop after a ride. Rooms are simple but comfortable; as a biker you’ll appreciate being able to park and rest peacefully after the road. The hotel offers a hearty dinner — good food to recharge before your next journey. The location provides easy access to scenic mountain roads and valleys — a solid base for continuing your travels. Calmness, basic comfort and traveler-friendly amenities make Moar’s Hotel a good choice for a night’s stay.

name: Hotel Traube Post am Reschensee
description: Hotel Traube Post am Reschensee is located by Lake Reschensee — a picturesque and unique spot with mountain and lake views, perfect for relaxing in nature after a ride. The hotel offers a peaceful, restful atmosphere — ideal after a long journey, with opportunities to stroll by the lake or simply enjoy the scenery. For bikers, it’s likely there is parking given the remote and scenic location — convenient for parking and staying with a bike. Its proximity to the lake and mountains means you can start your next route directly from the hotel: scenic roads, nature, and adventure are right at your doorstep. The combination of atmosphere, nature and beautiful views makes Hotel Traube Post a great choice for a restful stop and recharge on a journey.

name: Monte Giner Hotel & Residence
description: Monte Giner Hotel & Residence is located in the village of Mezzana — a quiet, cozy place from which it’s convenient to set off on motorcycle routes around Trentino or towards nearby mountain roads. The hotel and residence offer rooms and apartments designed for comfort; arriving with gear and bike, you’ll have a relaxed place to stay without hassle. For travelers it’s beneficial that the area is calm, offering peace and rest in the evening after a long ride. The location gives flexibility: you can stay for just one night or more, if you plan to explore the nature and routes around Mezzana. Overall, the vibe is simplicity, practicality and comfort — a good fit if you value functionality after the road.

name: Energy Hotel
