After a night here you can easily head out on new roads through valleys and wine regions — a lovely contrast to highway travel. Hotel Garni La Vigna is a smart “stop on the map” for rest, recharge and setting the mood for the next leg of your journey.

name: Oasis Beach Restaurant & Bar
address: HN 436, beach road, Junaswada, Mandrem, Goa
description:
Nestled along Beach Road at Junaswada in Mandrem, this spot places you just moments from one of North Goa’s most serene and scenic beaches. Mandrem Beach is known for its soft white sands, crystal-clear waters and laid-back vibe - a favourite for sunrise strolls, yoga on the shore, and unwinding away from the crowds.
Here you’re surrounded by boutique stays, beach shacks and cafés that capture the relaxed Goan spirit while keeping you close to coastal beauty. Whether you’re riding the Konkan coast, planning a seaside stopover, or chasing ocean sunsets, this address offers a peaceful beachfront base just steps from the Arabian Sea.

name: The Woodpecker By The Beach
description: The Woodpecker By The Beach is a charming beachfront resort in Mandrem, Goa, perfectly positioned right on the soft sands of Mandrem Beach - one of North Goa’s most peaceful and scenic stretches of shoreline. Guests can wake up to the sound of the Arabian Sea, relax with ocean views from many rooms, and enjoy the barefoot beach life just steps from the property. With a laid-back coastal vibe, on-site restaurant and bar, plus free parking and Wi-Fi, it’s an ideal stop for travellers seeking sun, sea and serenity. Whether you’re here for a soothing getaway, sunset walks or a slice of Goan beach culture, this place brings seaside hospitality front and centre.

name: Nanu Resort Arambol
description:
Experience Authentic Goan Hospitality with Nanu Hotels, Resorts & Spas
For over 30 years, Nanu Hotels, Resorts & Spas has been the heart of Goan hospitality—delighting guests with warm service, scenic escapes, and unforgettable experiences across its iconic properties in North and South Goa.

name: Royal Enfield Garage Cafe Goa
address: House #560, Villa Rodrigues,Baga Creek Road, Arpora,Bardez, Goa-40516
description: Garage Café, Goa is motorcycling inspired café and bar by Royal Enfield. It is home to Royal Enfield’s vintage motorcycles, art by motorcyclists, signature dishes curated by speciality chefs. Here you find 120 years of motorcycling legacy seamlessly integrating with Goan heritage.

name: Artjuna Cafe - Anjuna
address: 972, Market Rd, Monteiro Vaddo, Anjuna, Goa 403509
description: Established in an old portuguese house surrounded by a beautiful garden, this location has developed into a popular and trendy place. With a large outdoor restaurant, lifestyle shop, event area. The garden restaurant is a lively and vibrant place with a welcoming atmosphere. Filled with mango trees and frangipani flowers, the garden grows colourful and lush. There is plenty of space to enjoy delicious and healthy food, meet up with friends, chill out and enjoy the excellent library. Artjuna is open for all day breakfast, lunch and dinner. The food is fresh and contemporary, with a great choice of salads, sandwiches and popular dishes from the Mediterranean cuisine.

name: Anuskura Ghat
description: Anuskura Ghat is a biker’s paradise tucked away in the Western Ghats, offering a thrilling mix of technical hairpin bends and smooth, sweeping curves. Rising nearly 1,000 meters, this pass connects Kolhapur to the Konkan coast with minimal traffic, making it the ultimate "long way home" for riders traveling between Pune and Goa. Whether you're chasing the monsoon mist or leaning into the corners with views of the Arjuna Dam below, it’s a pure, raw riding experience

name: Amboli Valley
description: Amboli Ghat is a premier, winding mountain pass in Maharashtra’s Sahyadri range (near Goa) known for its thrilling, misty, and lush green roads—perfect for monsoon riding. Offering steep curves, numerous waterfalls, and a 690-meter elevation, it provides a scenic, cool escape with fantastic viewpoints

name: RIDE INN CAFE, BAR & Resort
address: Burwa Rd, across Nehrukund bridge, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175103
description: Just outside the vibrant town of Manali, this one-of-a-kind boutique hotel offers a stay designed with bikers in mind. Built from a passion for the riding culture, the place features an offbeat motorcycle-themed cafe, a haircut spot, and a relaxed vibe perfect for riders looking to unwind after a long ride through the mountains. It’s a stop where good food, good company, and the spirit of the road come together

name: Meduza
description: Hotel Meduza is a comfortable seaside stay in Biograd na Moru, offering travelers a relaxed base just moments from the coast. Its location makes it especially convenient for guests exploring the Adriatic and nearby islands, while the on-site restaurant and bar add to the ease of the experience. The atmosphere is simple, welcoming, and well-suited for road travelers who want to unwind after a full day on the move. For motorcycle and touring guests, it works well as a practical and pleasant stop on a Croatian coastal route.

name: Restaurant Marina Kornati
description: Restaurant Marina Kornati offers a scenic dining experience in one of Biograd na Moru’s most attractive waterfront settings. Set within the marina, it combines a relaxed Adriatic atmosphere with the charm of boats, sea views, and an easygoing Mediterranean feel. It is a great stop for travelers who want a pleasant meal in a location that feels both vibrant and comfortable. For touring guests, it stands out as a convenient and memorable place to take a break and enjoy the coastal side of the journey.

name: Hotel IZVOR
description: Hotel Izvor is one of the most refined stays in Aranđelovac, offering a comfortable base in a town known for relaxation, nature, and easy scenic riding routes. It combines a polished atmosphere with the convenience travelers appreciate after a full day on the road. For motorcycle guests, it works especially well as a more premium stop with space to unwind and recharge. It is a strong choice for riders who want comfort without losing the sense of travel.

name: Crown
description: Hotel Kruna Elegant Garni offers a calm and practical stay in Aranđelovac, well suited for travelers passing through central Serbia. Its atmosphere is simple, comfortable, and easygoing, making it a convenient stop for road trips and motorcycle tours. For riders, it stands out as a straightforward place to rest, reset, and continue the journey without unnecessary hassle. It fits especially well for guests who value convenience and a relaxed overnight stay.

name: Restoran GRB
description: Restoran GRB is a well-known dining stop in the Aranđelovac area, appreciated for its welcoming atmosphere and convenient setting outside the busiest part of town. Its location near the Bukulja area makes it a natural break point for travelers exploring the region by road. For motorcycle guests, it works well as a relaxed place to stop for a meal, take a pause, and enjoy the surroundings. It is a strong choice for riders looking for a comfortable and easy stop along the route.

name: Moto Servis D&V City Bikes
description:
Moto Servis D&V City Bikes is a practical local service point in Aranđelovac for riders who need support on the road. It offers the kind of straightforward assistance that can be especially valuable during a motorcycle trip, from routine service needs to essential parts and rider-related basics. For touring guests, it stands out as a useful stop to handle issues quickly and continue the journey with more confidence. It is a strong local option for everyday motorcycle support in the area.

ps:
- service for scooters and motorcycles, including models from 50cc up to 850cc
- please call for reservation

name: Taverna Tradicionale KARDHASHI
description: Taverna Tradicionale KARDHASHI is a popular traditional restaurant in Gjirokastër, known for its authentic Albanian cuisine and warm, family-style hospitality. It offers a relaxed local dining experience that feels welcoming rather than touristy, making it a great stop for travelers exploring southern Albania. The combination of homemade food, generous portions, and convenient parking adds to its appeal for guests arriving by road. It is a strong choice for riders and road travelers looking for a memorable local meal in Gjirokastër.

name: Thethi Paradise Restaurant & Hotel
description: Thethi Paradise Restaurant & Hotel is a scenic mountain retreat in Theth, offering travelers a peaceful stay surrounded by the dramatic landscapes of the Albanian Alps. Its setting makes it especially appealing for guests exploring northern Albania by road and looking for a place that feels both relaxing and authentic. The combination of traditional hospitality, local food, and convenient on-site parking makes it a practical and memorable stop for motorcycle travelers. It is a strong choice for riders who want a comfortable stay with a true mountain atmosphere.

name: GURRA FAMILY RESTAURANT
description: GURRA FAMILY Restaurant & Guesthouse is a welcoming mountain stay in Theth that combines accommodation, dining, and a relaxed village atmosphere in one place. It works especially well for travelers who want a convenient base for exploring the Albanian Alps without giving up the comfort of on-site meals and easy parking. The property presents itself as more than just a guesthouse, offering rooms, restaurant service, and even camping support, which makes it particularly practical for road travelers and riders. It is a strong choice for guests looking for a simple, authentic, and traveler-friendly stop in Theth.

name: Winterfell The Stay
address: Bahanu village, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175143, India
description:
Winterfell The Stay is a boutique riverfront resort and hospitality chain in northern India, with properties in Delhi, Manali, Kaza, Leh, and Sarchu. The flagship location in Bahanu Village near Manali, Himachal Pradesh, offers scenic views of the Beas River and the Himalayas, blending mountain-lodge comfort with contemporary design.

The Manali property provides 20 soundproofed rooms and chalets, each individually decorated with Egyptian cotton linens, memory-foam bedding, and private balconies overlooking mountain or river landscapes. Units are equipped with LED TVs, rainfall showers, and designer toiletries.

name: The Hosteller Manali, Old Manali
address: Log Huts Area Rd, Old Manali, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India
description:
The Hosteller Manali, Old Manali is a popular backpacker hostel located on Log Huts Area Road, Old Manali, Himachal Pradesh, India. Part of The Hosteller chain known across India for youth-oriented accommodations, it caters primarily to solo travelers and small groups exploring the Himalayas. The property combines rustic mountain charm with modern comfort, making it a favored stop for backpackers visiting Manali.

Nestled amid the pine forests of Old Manali, the hostel offers panoramic views of snowcapped peaks and easy access to key attractions such as Hidimba Devi Temple and Mall Road. Its relaxed, social environment encourages interaction among travelers, with bonfire nights, hammocks, and outdoor lounges enhancing the communal vibe.

name: Zostel Old Manali (Goshal Road)
address: New Manu Temple Road, via, Clubhouse Rd, side, Old Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India
description: Zostel’s newest addition in the heart of Old Manali is the perfect crash pad for your mountain adventures. Set aside the curtains and let the sun rays make way for a glimpse at gorgeous peaks and lofty trees. Fill your bellies with drool-worthy food, sip fusion cocktails, and gaze at jaw-dropping views from our in-house café+ bar. Equipped with a pool table and a number of board games, our common room is all yours to challenge your friends and collect a bunch of new stories and laughter. For those who can’t skip those important work calls, there’s a dedicated workspace with a stunning background. With the option of spacious deluxe rooms and happening dorm rooms to choose from as your den, you're in for an uber-cool holiday. As dusk approaches, find yourself under a sea of twinkling stars and a crackling bonfire to enjoy a guitar session. Here at Zostel Old Manali (Goshal Road), you’re just a walk away from Manali’s bustling bazaars & trails.

name: The Lazy Dog
address: Manu Temple Rd, Old Manali, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India
description: A popular riverside café and biker hangout in Old Manali with a relaxed vibe, live music, and late operating hours—perfect for unwinding after a long ride. The venue is easily accessible and features visible bike parking right at the entrance, making it convenient for riders. Known for its social atmosphere, it’s a great spot to meet fellow bikers, plan routes, and enjoy food and drinks in a laid-back setting.

name: Johnson Lodge & Spa
address: Mall Rd, Siyal, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India
description: A cozy mountain lodge in central Manali combining traditional Himalayan charm with modern comfort, featuring spacious rooms, a garden setting, on-site restaurant/bar, and a full-service spa. Conveniently located near the main road and close to key attractions, it offers easy access for riders. With dedicated parking, travel assistance, and a relaxed social atmosphere (live music, bonfire, lounge areas), it works well as a comfortable base for bikers to rest, recover, and plan the next leg of their journey.

name: Johnson Lodge & Spa
address: Mall Rd, Siyal, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India
description: A cozy mountain lodge in central Manali combining traditional Himalayan charm with modern comfort, featuring spacious rooms, a garden setting, on-site restaurant/bar, and a full-service spa. Conveniently located near the main road and close to key attractions, it offers easy access for riders. With dedicated parking, travel assistance, and a relaxed social atmosphere (live music, bonfire, lounge areas), it works well as a comfortable base for bikers to rest, recover, and plan the next leg of their journey.

name: Johnson Bar & Restaurant
address: Mall Rd, Siyal, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India
description: Johnson Bar & Restaurant is a signature feature, offering Italian, Indian, Southeast Asian, and Mexican cuisines crafted by resident chefs. The venue hosts live music on weekends and provides both indoor and outdoor seating. Its vibrant setting and diverse menu make it a social hub for locals and visitors alike.

name: Drifters Inn & Cafe By The Hidden Tribe
address: Manu Temple Rd, Old Manali, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India
description: A cozy, social guesthouse and café in Old Manali known for its relaxed backpacker vibe, mountain-view sun decks, and all-day café/bar. With comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, travel assistance, and on-site parking, it serves as a convenient and welcoming stop for bikers. Its easy road access, rider-friendly atmosphere, and communal spaces make it a great place to rest, meet other travelers, and plan the next leg of a Himalayan journey

name: Vila Zana
description: Hotel Vila Zana is a stylish boutique stay near Gostivar, offering travelers a calm and comfortable base in western North Macedonia. The property combines a more polished atmosphere with practical features that matter on the road, including on-site parking, dining, and wellness facilities. For motorcycle and road travelers, it works especially well as a convenient stop where comfort and ease come together after a full day of travel. It is a strong choice for guests looking for a relaxed stay with a more refined feel.

name: Pella Restaurant
description: Pella Restaurant is a stylish and welcoming dining spot in Gostivar, offering travelers a comfortable place to relax and enjoy a quality meal in the city. Its atmosphere feels modern yet approachable, making it suitable for both casual stops and more relaxed evening visits. For road travelers, it works well as a convenient restaurant option with a polished feel and easy city access. It is a strong choice for guests looking for a pleasant and reliable dining experience in Gostivar.

name: Garage bar Pula
description: A small garage-style bar with the right kind of soul - no pretence, just pure vibe. It’s all about simplicity: cold drinks, relaxed atmosphere, and friendly staff. Perfect pit stop to unwind after a long ride through Istria. Easy street parking makes it biker-friendly for a quick break.

name: Bullet Basecamp - Raju Bullet surgery
address: Lakeside Road, Ward No. 6 Baidam, Pokhara 33700 Kaski District, Nepal
description: Pokhara's premier motorcycle workshop. Royal Enfield repair, Himalayan tours, and bike rentals in Lakeside Pokhara Nepal. Expert mechanics with over 30 years of experience. Fleet of 10+ well-maintained Royal Enfield motorcycles ready for any Himalayan adventure. Each bike comes with full documentation and amazing free amedities.

name: SJ MOTO X Himalayan Java
description:
Nepal’s first motorbike gallery, SJ MOTO is also a museum for historic and premium superbikes, with which one can enjoy the majestic view and take pictures. We also have a retail outlet where customers can buy brand new and reconditioned super bikes along with official merchandise and clothes from various brands, including Marvel and DC. Motorbike enthusiasts can visit us to see the collection of superbikes, drink Nepalese coffee, and savor Nepali delicacies in the café.
We celebrate bikes, culture, and superheroes

name: Ride Ultimate Adventure Motorcycle
address: Ride Ultimate Adventure Motorcycle, Lakeside Rd, Pokhara 33700
description: Ride Ultimate Adventure offers top-quality motorbike rental in Pokhara Lakeside, including Royal Enfield, Himalayan 452, and more. Affordable rates, trusted service, perfect for Mustang and Himalayan tours.

name: Adventure Pokhara (Ride & Dare)
description: A legendary community-driven motorcycle club and rental hub established in 2010. It’s known for its "bikerhood" atmosphere, where adventure meets social responsibility (part of the profits goes to local NGO projects).

name: GC Brothers Motorcycle workshop & Recondition House
description:
Specialization: One of Pokhara’s most reliable and "no-nonsense" independent garages. They are experts in heavy-duty bikes, particularly Royal Enfield (Classic, Himalayan, Bullet) and modern performance bikes like KTM and Bajaj Pulsar.

Reliability: Known among the local biking community for handling complex mechanical repairs, engine overhauls, and pre-expedition prep for long-haul trips to Mustang or Manang.

Availability: They are famous for their extended hours, often listed as open 24/7 (except Saturdays), making them the go-to spot for emergency repairs or late-night tuning.

Service: While the shop looks like a typical local garage, the mechanics are highly skilled in troubleshooting issues that standard rental shops might miss. They also deal in "reconditioned" (refurbished) bikes if you are looking to buy or trade.

name: Hearts & Tears Motorcycle Club
description:
Vibe: Established in 2005, this is one of Nepal's most respected adventure motorcycle hubs. It combines a professional expedition agency with a high-end garage and a tight-knit community feel.

The Fleet: They maintain a premium fleet of Royal Enfield Himalayan 450, Scram 411, and Classic 350/500. They are known for having some of the best-maintained bikes in the country, specifically tuned for high-altitude Himalayan terrain.

Specialization: Their core business is high-end, guided tours to Upper Mustang, Manang, and even international routes (Tibet, Bhutan). They are famous for their "Adventure on Steroids" philosophy—focusing on grit, scenery, and solid mechanical support.

Community & Shop: They run a full-service workshop ("The Garage") that meets Western standards. It's a key meeting point for international riders to grab a coffee, check maps, and get reliable advice on road conditions.

Ethos: A socially responsible club that actively supports local NGOs, making it a favorite for travelers who want their trip to have a positive local impact.

name: Auto-Moto Servis IRVAS
description: Auto-Moto Servis IRVAS is a practical service point in Sarajevo that works with both cars and motorcycles, making it especially useful for travelers who need flexible technical support in the city. Public business and social profiles indicate that the workshop handles vehicle and motorcycle repairs, and it is also active in the installation and servicing of LPG systems. Its profile suggests a hands-on local service rather than a large dealership, which can be valuable for riders looking for direct and practical help. It is a solid option for road travelers who want a multi-purpose technical stop in Sarajevo.

name: Busy Bee Cafe
description:
Vibe: Established in 1998, this is the undisputed heart of Pokhara’s nightlife. It’s a high-energy, open-air venue known for its "Rock & Roll" spirit, featuring live bands every single night and a massive, social atmosphere.

The Biker Connection: The wide sidewalk and parking area эdirectly in front of the entrance act as the unofficial "showroom" of Lakeside. You'll always find rows of Royal Enfields, custom builds, and touring bikes parked here as riders gather for a post-trip beer or to plan the next day's route.

Food & Drink: Offers a large menu of wood-fired pizzas, steaks, and local Himalayan snacks, alongside an extensive bar. It's the go-to spot for a celebratory "last meal" after returning from the mountains.

Atmosphere: While it gets loud and crowded with tourists and locals alike, it remains a "biker-friendly" institution where you can easily meet fellow travelers and exchange tips on road conditionхs in Mustang or Manang.

name: Tirana International Hotel & Conference Center
description: Tirana International Hotel & Conference Centre is one of the city’s landmark stays, offering travelers a central and well-connected base right on Skanderbeg Square. Its location makes it especially convenient for guests who want easy access to Tirana’s main attractions, business areas, and city life. With a strong official presence and direct contact options, it is also a practical choice for travel planning and reservations. It is a solid fit for travelers looking for a recognizable and reliable hotel in the heart of Tirana.

name: Motoservis Musclemoto-mne
description: Muscle Moto Crna Gora is a practical motorcycle-focused workshop in the Kotor area, offering riders a useful local point for repairs, parts orders, and technical support. Its public profiles clearly show that the business works with motorcycles rather than being only a general auto service, which makes it more relevant for road travelers and bikers. The workshop appears to operate in a hands-on, flexible format, helping with both repair needs and sourcing components when needed. It is a solid option for riders looking for direct motorcycle support while traveling through Kotor and the Bay of Kotor.

name: Mas Trade doo Jaz
description: Mas Trade Moto Showroom Budva is one of the stronger motorcycle retail points on the Montenegrin coast, offering riders a dedicated place for bikes, gear, and parts in the Budva area. Public profiles show that the showroom focuses on motorcycle equipment and accessories, while also presenting itself as an importer and seller of motorcycles, parts, and riding gear in one place. Its Budva/Jaz showroom format makes it especially practical for travelers who need a quick stop for essentials, replacement gear, or bike-related shopping while moving along the coast. It is a strong option for riders looking for a specialized and easy-to-access moto shop near Budva.

name: Camp Oaza Lipa
description: Camp Oaza Lipa is a relaxed nature-based stay near Cetinje, combining camping, simple accommodation, and a restaurant setting in a peaceful mountain environment. Its location near Lipa Cave and with views toward the Skadar Lake valley makes it especially appealing for travelers who want a quieter stop surrounded by scenery rather than a standard city hotel. Public listings and tourism sources position it as a traveler-friendly place for hikers, bikers, couples, and families, which fits well with road trips and outdoor travel. It is a strong choice for guests looking for an authentic, low-key stop with local food and a natural atmosphere near Cetinje.

name: Kole Restaurant
description: Kole Restaurant is a well-established dining spot in Cetinje, located just a short distance from Dvorski trg and the city’s main cultural landmarks. The restaurant presents itself as a place with a warm atmosphere, polished interior, and a comfortable setting for both everyday dining and longer, more relaxed meals. Reviews consistently highlight generous portions, local Montenegrin dishes, friendly service, and good value, which makes it especially appealing for travelers. It is a strong choice for visitors looking for a reliable and welcoming restaurant in Cetinje.

name: Rolling Stones Rock Bar
description:
Vibe: A high-energy, authentic rock-and-roll venue and a cornerstone of Pokhara’s live music scene. It’s widely regarded as the "rebel brother" to the more mainstream spots on Lakeside, offering a raw, underground atmosphere.

The Biker Connection: This is a primary gathering point for the local and international riding community. Its location and "no-nonsense" attitude make it the preferred evening hangout for those who prefer heavy riffs and cold beer after a long day in the saddle.

Music & Entertainment: Famous for its talented local house bands that cover classic rock, heavy metal, and blues. It has a great acoustics setup and a spacious floor that gets very lively after 9:00 PM.

Food & Drink: Known for its wide selection of cocktails, spirits, and hearty "pub grub" (burgers, wings, and snacks) that caters well to hungry travelers.

Social Scene: It’s an excellent place to network with seasoned riders who have just returned from the Upper Mustang or the Annapurna Circuit.

name: Krazy Gecko
description:
Vibe: A bohemian, laid-back lakeside retreat tucked away in a quiet corner of North Lakeside. It offers a "hidden gem" atmosphere with rustic wooden decks right over the water, making it the perfect escape from the busier main street.

The Biker Connection: Highly popular among the expat biker community and long-term travelers. Its slightly off-the-beaten-path location and spacious parking area make it a favorite destination for a short afternoon ride or a "chill-out" session after returning from the mountains.

Scenery & Setting: Famous for its incredible sunset views over Phewa Lake. The seating is mostly outdoors under trees, with hammocks and floor cushions, creating a very relaxed, "island-style" vibe.

Food & Drink: Known for its fresh, home-style menu, including great salads, grilled fish, and refreshing cocktails. It’s less of a "party" spot and more of a place for deep conversations about future routes and travel stories.

Social Scene: It’s the best place to meet seasoned riders who live in Pokhara and can give you insider tips on the most scenic backroads around the valley.

name: Bikemandu Kathmandu
description:
Vibe: Widely recognized as Nepal's most professional "premium-only" motorcycle rental and tour operator. It functions more like a high-end logistics hub than a standard rental shop, focusing on international standards of safety and mechanical reliability.

The Fleet: They boast a specialized fleet of fuel-injected, late-model bikes. Unlike many local shops, they offer the Honda CRF 250L/300L and Honda XR 190L for technical off-roading, alongside the latest Royal Enfield Himalayan 450 and Scram 411.

Specialization: They are the experts in "Fly-and-Ride" logistics. They specialize in cross-country expeditions and offer unique one-way rentals (e.g., pick up in Kathmandu, drop off in Pokhara).

Technical Standards: Every bike undergoes a rigorous multi-point inspection before release. They provide professional-grade riding gear (helmets, armor, and waterproof panniers) which is often hard to find in standard rental outlets.

Location: Situated in the Jhamsikhel/Lalitpur area (the "expat hub" of Kathmandu), away from the chaotic tourist center of Thamel. This allows for a much smoother and safer exit from the city when starting a tour.

name: Bikemandu Kathmandu
description:
