address: Harley Days Dresden, Ostragehege Rinne Dresden, Messering 6 / Flutrinne P7, 01067 Dresden
description:
Harley Days Dresden 2026 brings official Harley-Davidson spirit to the Rinne Dresden festival grounds in the Ostragehege for a weekend of motorcycles, live music and city-riding atmosphere. The event welcomes Harley riders as well as anyone interested in motorcycles, with the Milwaukee Circle, shopping area, demo rides, official Harley dealers, bike show and the Sunday parade through Dresden.

For motorcycle travelers, Dresden adds a strong destination feeling with historic city scenery, the Elbe and practical routes from eastern Germany, Czechia and Poland. The venue gives the weekend a proper open-air festival mood while still keeping the city close. It is a strong German Harley weekend for riders who want brand culture, music, custom bikes and a real city ride in one trip.

name: British Superbike Championship — Snetterton 2026
address: Snetterton Circuit, Norwich, Norfolk NR16 2JU, England
description:
British Superbike Championship at Snetterton 2026 brings a full summer race weekend to the fast Snetterton 300 circuit in Norfolk. The event features three headline BSB races plus a strong support programme, giving sportbike fans plenty of track action across Friday, Saturday and Sunday. For motorcycle travelers, Snetterton is a practical East Anglia destination with camping, free general parking, trade stands and a paddock-style race atmosphere that feels accessible and rider-focused.

The circuit’s long straights and technical sections make it a strong live superbike experience, especially for fans who enjoy high-speed national championship racing. It suits superbike fans, UK touring riders and travellers who want a full race weekend with real British motorcycle culture.

name: British Superbike Championship — Oulton Park 2026
address: Oulton Park Circuit, Little Budworth, Tarporley, Cheshire CW6 9BW, England
description: British Superbike Championship at Oulton Park 2026 brings a high-summer race weekend to one of the UK’s most characterful motorcycle racing venues. The International circuit’s parkland setting, elevation changes and fast, flowing layout make it a favourite for fans who like to move around the venue and watch from different corners. The weekend includes three BSB races, support classes, camping, trade stands, evening entertainment and a proper British race-paddock atmosphere. For motorcycle travellers, Cheshire and nearby North Wales routes can turn the event into a wider riding weekend. It suits superbike fans, UK touring riders and travellers who want a full national championship weekend with serious racing and strong spectator access.

name: British Superbike Championship — Cadwell Park 2026
address: Cadwell Park Circuit, Louth, Lincolnshire LN11 9SE, England
description:
British Superbike Championship at Cadwell Park 2026 is a signature UK motorcycle weekend at one of the country’s most atmospheric bike-racing circuits. The event returns over the August Bank Holiday with three headline BSB races, support classes, trade stands, camping and evening entertainment. Cadwell Park’s narrow, flowing layout and legendary Mountain section make it feel closer to a road-racing amphitheatre than a wide modern circuit.

For motorcycle travelers, the Lincolnshire Wolds setting turns the weekend into a classic ride destination with strong spectator views and proper British racing culture. It suits superbike fans, UK touring riders and travellers who want a full national championship weekend with a special circuit atmosphere.

name: WorldSBK Estoril Round 2026
address: Circuito Estoril, Av. Alfredo César Torres, Apt 49, 2646-901 Alcabideche, Portugal
description:
WorldSBK Estoril Round 2026 gives riders an autumn superbike racing destination near Lisbon, with the Atlantic coast and Portuguese touring routes close by. The Estoril circuit has a long international motorsport history, and the WorldSBK weekend brings a loud, fast and rider-focused atmosphere to one of Portugal’s best-known tracks.

For motorcycle travelers, this round works well as a southern European escape when much of northern Europe is already cooling down. The location makes it easy to combine race days with coastal roads, Cascais, Sintra and a wider Portugal route. It suits superbike fans, sportbike riders, touring bikers and travelers planning a major race weekend around a Portuguese ride.

name: Moto Fest Inđija 2026
address: Keltsko selo, Milorada Stojića Gorčila bb, 22320 Inđija
description:
Moto Fest Inđija 2026 brings four days of motorcycles, music and Serbian biker energy to Keltsko selo in Inđija. The festival is a free-entry regional moto gathering with concerts, biker games, guest welcomes and a ride-friendly atmosphere built around the local MK Inđija scene. For motorcycle travelers, Inđija is an easy stop between Belgrade, Novi Sad and the Srem region, making the event a useful weekend anchor on a Serbia road trip.

The Celtic Village setting gives the rally a more unusual backdrop than a standard town-square festival, with open-air space, local food and drinks, and a compact community feel. It is a good pick for riders who prefer authentic Balkan moto-club culture, live music and relaxed social riding over a polished commercial show.

name: 17. Moto susret MK Gospodari Vjetra Otok
address: Gradski hipodrom Čistine, Rudine čistine 1, Mali Otok, Croatia
description:
17. Moto susret MK Gospodari Vjetra Otok is a free-entry Croatian biker meeting at Gradski hipodrom Čistine, bringing riders together for a long weekend of music, club hospitality and Slavonian moto-susret atmosphere. The event is built around the local MK Gospodari Vjetra scene, with a rally-style programme that fits touring riders looking for a real regional gathering rather than a commercial show.

The hipodrome location gives the meeting an open-air, camp-friendly feel, with space for bikes, music and social time across the weekend. For motorcycle travelers crossing eastern Croatia, Otok can work as a relaxed stop between Vinkovci, Županja and the wider Slavonia region. It should suit riders who enjoy local clubs, live bands, biker games, food and a friendly grassroots rally vibe.

name: Moto Fest Bratijanje 2026
description:
Moto Fest Bratijanje 2026 brings riders to Loznica for four days of motorcycle culture, music and local club energy around the Lagator Stadium area. The event is promoted with good music, cold beer and a proper moto spirit, making it a relaxed regional gathering rather than a large commercial show.

For motorcycle travelers, Loznica is a useful western Serbia stop near the Drina region and the Bosnia border, so it can fit naturally into a Balkan touring route. The plateau by Lagator Stadium gives the meeting a town-based, easy-to-reach setting for riders arriving solo or with a club. It should suit touring bikers, regional rally fans and anyone looking for a friendly Serbian moto weekend with a strong community feel.

name: 12. Moto skup MK Argentum Srebrenica 2026
address: Moto kamp MK Argentum, Srebrenica bb
description:
12. Moto skup MK Argentum Srebrenica 2026 brings riders to a compact Balkan club rally at Moto kamp MK Argentum, with a simple camp atmosphere, live rock music and a strong local biker identity. The programme opens on Friday with camp arrival and an evening concert, then continues on Saturday with lunch for bikers, a ride-through parade and more live bands.

For motorcycle travelers, Srebrenica makes this a more unusual stop away from the main festival routes, combining regional riding, club hospitality and a close-knit moto skup feel. This event is best suited to riders who enjoy smaller gatherings where the road, the people and the campfire-style atmosphere matter as much as the stage.

name: VI Letnji moto susret MK Torda 2026
description:
VI Letnji moto susret MK Torda 2026 is a small Serbian summer biker meeting built around the local club scene in Torda. The poster promotes free entry, free food for bikers, a Pop Rock Jones concert and a playful party atmosphere with motorcycle washing as part of the fun. For motorcycle travelers, this is the kind of grassroots village moto susret that can turn a Vojvodina or Banat ride into a memorable social stop.

It should appeal to riders who enjoy simple hospitality, local club energy and one-night gatherings where the people and the road matter more than big-festival production.

name: 28. Moto susret MK Okit Vodice 2026
description:
28. Moto susret MK Okit Vodice 2026 brings riders to the Croatian coast for a classic club-run moto gathering at the MK Okit clubhouse in Vodice. The published programme promises live music, a parade, camping and biker games, giving the weekend the feel of a relaxed Adriatic rally rather than a commercial festival.

For motorcycle travelers, Vodice is an easy and attractive stop on a coastal route, with the sea, local roads and an evening biker atmosphere all close together. The official GPS on the poster makes arrival straightforward for riders navigating directly to the clubhouse area. This event should suit touring bikers, regional moto susret fans and riders looking for a simple Croatian seaside stop with rock’n’roll energy.

name: Moto skup MK Noćni vitezovi Žabari 2026
address: FK Borac, Aleksandra Mišića bb, 12374 Žabari
description:
Moto skup MK Noćni vitezovi Žabari 2026 is a Serbian biker gathering at FK Borac with a proper local-club rally atmosphere across the first weekend of June. The official announcement promotes free entry, rock concerts, biker games, Saturday lunch for riders and a Sunday coffee-and-breakfast send-off.

For motorcycle travelers, Žabari offers the kind of informal Balkan stop where the road, the camp, live music and club hospitality are the main reasons to ride in. The event should suit riders who enjoy smaller regional moto skup weekends rather than polished commercial festivals. With free entry and a community-style programme, it looks like an easy social stop for touring bikers crossing eastern or central Serbia.

name: 17. Međunarodni moto susret Senj 2026
description:
17. Međunarodni moto susret Senj 2026 brings riders to Sveti Juraj’s waterfront for a classic Croatian coastal moto weekend organized by Moto Racing Klub Senj. The event combines Adriatic scenery with a familiar moto-susret atmosphere: music, biker games, camping, a welcome drink and a Sunday bean meal are promoted on the poster. For motorcycle travelers, this is a strong stop on a Senj and Velebit riding route, with sea views, coastal roads and club hospitality all in one place.

The free-entry format makes it easy to include in a touring plan, especially for riders moving along the northern Croatian coast. It should suit touring bikers, regional rally fans and anyone who prefers relaxed seaside gatherings with local club character.

name: 7. Internacionalni moto susret MK Kraljevi Raje Tolisa 2026
description:
7. Internacionalni moto susret MK Kraljevi Raga Tolisa 2026 brings riders to Stadion Sloga in Tolisa for a grassroots motorcycle gathering with a strong local-club atmosphere. The poster promotes lunch for bikers, biker games, a defile, go-go dance, free camping and live music from Iluzija, Wanted 5 and Deminutiv.

For motorcycle travelers, this is a good Posavina stop for riders crossing northern Bosnia and Herzegovina and looking for a friendly regional biker crowd rather than a commercial festival. The stadium setting and camping option make it easy to treat the event as a relaxed overnight stop on a Balkan route. It should suit touring bikers, regional rally fans and riders who enjoy simple hospitality, live music and local moto-club culture.

name: The Great Malle Rally 2026
address: Lizard Point, The Lizard, near Helston, Cornwall TR12 7NT, England
description:
The Great Malle Rally 2026 is a premium long-distance motorcycle expedition built for riders who want a serious road adventure rather than a static festival. The 10th-anniversary edition starts at Lizard Point in Cornwall and finishes at The Castle of Mey in Scotland, with Wales and Ireland included in the route. Riders follow daily checkpoints through some of the wildest landscapes in Great Britain and Ireland, supported by rally marshals, engineers, medics, photographers and the Malle crew.

Rally camps, meals, ferry crossings and rider kit are part of the experience, making it especially appealing for touring bikers, adventure-minded custom riders and riders who want a curated endurance journey. The 2026 rally is ticketed, with packages listed from £2399, and the official page currently shows the edition as sold out with a waiting-list option.

name: MotoGP Dutch TT Assen 2026
address: TT Circuit Assen, De Haar 9, 9405 TE Assen
description:
MotoGP Dutch TT Assen 2026 brings riders and race fans to one of the most historic motorcycle racing weekends in Europe, held at the legendary TT Circuit Assen. Known as “The Cathedral” of motorcycle racing, Assen delivers fast corners, packed grandstands and a festival-like atmosphere that has made the Dutch TT a pilgrimage point for generations of bikers.

For motorcycle travelers coming through the Netherlands or northern Germany, it is an easy and rewarding stop with strong racing heritage and excellent road access. The weekend is especially attractive for MotoGP followers, sport-bike riders and touring bikers who want a classic Grand Prix experience rather than a generic motorsport stop.

name: 44ª Concentração do Moto Clube Faro 2026
description:
44ª Concentração do Moto Clube Faro 2026 brings one of Portugal’s landmark biker gatherings back to Vale das Almas for a long summer rally weekend in the Algarve. For motorcycle travelers, Faro is a classic southern destination, with warm coastal riding, a strong club identity and an international road-trip atmosphere.

The event is built for riders who want more than a short local meet, combining the feeling of a major rally with the appeal of a ride through Portugal or southern Spain. It is especially suitable for touring bikers, cruiser riders, club groups and anyone planning a warm-weather motorcycle escape. Official online pre-registration is listed from €70, so riders should check the official sales link before travel.

name: MXGP of Italy 2026
address: Crossodromo Miravalle, Via di Rendola 301, 52025 Montevarchi (AR)
description:
MXGP of Italy 2026 brings world championship motocross back to the historic Miravalle track in Montevarchi for a raw and intense race weekend in Tuscany. For motorcycle travelers, it is a strong off-road stop between Florence, Arezzo and the classic riding roads of central Italy. The compact motocross setting offers a very different experience from road racing, with close views of the dirt, jumps, paddock energy and fan atmosphere around the hillside circuit.

It is especially suited to motocross fans, adventure riders and touring bikers who want a louder, dustier and more physical motorsport weekend.

name: MXGP of Portugal 2026
address: Crossódromo Internacional de Águeda, Avenida das 2 Rodas, Parque Empresarial do Casarão, 3750-860 Borralha
description:
MXGP of Portugal 2026 brings world championship motocross back to the Crossódromo Internacional de Águeda, one of Portugal’s most established off-road racing venues. For motorcycle travelers, Águeda is a strong stop between Porto, Aveiro and central Portugal’s riding routes, with a race weekend that feels raw, loud and close to the dirt.

The event offers the classic motocross mix of jumps, roost, paddock energy and hillside spectator atmosphere rather than the polished feel of a road-racing circuit. It is especially relevant for motocross fans, enduro riders, adventure-bike travelers and bikers who enjoy rougher, more physical motorsport weekends.

name: MXGP of Czech Republic 2026
description:
MXGP of Czech Republic 2026 takes the world motocross championship to Loketské serpentiny in Loket, one of the classic regional stops on the MXGP calendar. The setting near Karlovy Vary gives motorcycle travelers a strong reason to ride into western Bohemia, with historic towns, forest roads and spa-country routes around the race weekend.

The track atmosphere is compact, gritty and close to the action, with hard-pack motocross racing, hillside viewing and a passionate local crowd. It is a strong fit for motocross fans, enduro riders, adventure-bike travelers and touring bikers who want something more raw than a large road-racing circuit. Tickets are listed from 1350 CZK, making it a focused weekend stop for riders crossing the Czech Republic or nearby Germany.

name: MXGP of the Netherlands 2026
address: Motorsportpark Gelderland Midden, Koningsweg 51, 6816 TJ Arnhem
description:
MXGP of The Netherlands 2026 brings the world motocross championship back to Arnhem for a late-summer weekend on the deep sand of Motorsportpark Gelderland Midden. For motorcycle travelers, the event is easy to combine with routes through Gelderland, the Veluwe and the German border region, making it a strong stop in north-western Europe.

The Arnhem track is around 1.7 km long and known for technical sandy sections, close spectator energy and the raw feel that makes motocross very different from road racing. It is especially relevant for motocross fans, enduro riders, adventure-bike travelers and touring bikers who want a loud, physical race weekend with a strong Dutch crowd. Weekend tickets are listed from €90, with the official site noting that one ticket gives access on both Saturday and Sunday.

name: EnduroGP of Portugal 2026 — Fafe I
description:
EnduroGP of Portugal 2026 — Fafe I brings the world enduro championship back to northern Portugal for the first weekend of a rare Fafe double-header. The event is based around Fafe and the Argande mountain area, giving motorcycle travelers a raw off-road racing stop surrounded by granite hills, villages and classic northern Portuguese riding country. This is not a polished show-bike festival; it is a chance to watch world-level riders attack natural terrain, technical tests and demanding conditions.

The atmosphere should suit enduro fans, adventure riders and touring bikers who want real competition, local energy and a closer connection to the terrain than a normal circuit event. Fafe’s strong motorsport identity and the scale of the 2026 double round make it a distinctive stop for riders crossing Portugal in June.

name: EnduroGP of France 2026
address: Chiniac / La Voute, Equiblues grounds, 07320 Saint-Agrève
description:
EnduroGP of France 2026 brings world enduro racing to Saint-Agrève in the Ardèche highlands for a weekend built around technical terrain, special tests and local motorsport energy. For motorcycle travelers, the area is part of the attraction, with mountain roads, rural French scenery and a strong off-road atmosphere around the town.

The Friday Super Test at the Chiniac / La Voute site sets up a high-energy start, while Saturday and Sunday move deeper into real enduro racing across the Saint-Agrève plateau. This is a strong stop for enduro fans, adventure riders and touring bikers who want a rawer championship experience than a closed-circuit race. Access is officially listed as free, making it especially appealing for riders planning a July route through Ardèche.

name: EnduroGP of Wales 2026
address: Cwmythig Hill MX, Rhayader, Powys LD6 5BU, Wales
description:
EnduroGP of Wales 2026 brings the FIM EnduroGP World Championship season finale to Rhayader in Mid Wales for a rugged four-day event based around Cwmythig Hill MX and Saintswell Enduro Centre. For motorcycle travelers, the location is a strong reason to ride into Wales, with open hills, reservoirs, narrow rural roads and a real off-road motorsport atmosphere around the event. The weekend combines world-class racing, the Akrapovič SuperTest, paddock energy and a festival-style send-off for the championship finale.

It is especially suited to enduro fans, adventure riders and touring bikers who want a rawer terrain-based experience than a conventional spectator circuit. Tickets are officially on sale from £25, making it an accessible stop for riders planning an August road trip through Wales.

name: EnduroGP of Portugal 2026 — Fafe II
description:
EnduroGP of Portugal 2026 — Fafe II gives off-road fans a second consecutive world championship weekend in northern Portugal, turning the Fafe area into a real June enduro destination. For motorcycle travelers, it can work as part of a longer off-road-focused trip, with granite hills, forest roads and northern Portuguese scenery adding real riding value around the event.

This second Fafe round is linked to a different course and special-test area from the first weekend, so it is not just a simple repeat of the previous GP. The atmosphere should be raw, technical and close to the terrain, with world-class riders attacking demanding tests rather than a closed-circuit show. It is especially relevant for enduro fans, adventure riders and touring bikers who prefer real dirt racing and local motorsport energy over polished exhibition events.

name: Baja TT Dehesa Extremadura 2026
address: Rally HQ — Centro Joven Puente Real, P.º Fluvial 7, 06011 Badajoz
description: Baja TT Dehesa Extremadura 2026 brings rally-raid style motorcycle and quad racing to western Spain for a compact but demanding FIM Bajas World Cup weekend. Based around Badajoz, with a prologue in Elvas and long timed sections through the Extremadura dehesa landscapes, it offers a very different motorsport experience from circuit racing. For motorcycle travelers, the event can fit naturally into a Spain–Portugal route, especially for riders interested in endurance, navigation and rugged terrain. The atmosphere is built around real off-road competition, service parks, road books and long-distance racing culture rather than a polished festival setup. It is best suited to rally-raid fans, off-road travelers, adventure riders and bikers who want to see serious terrain-based racing in a cross-border setting.

name: Baja Aragón 2026
address: Rally HQ — Palacio de Exposiciones y Congresos de Teruel, Ctra. Sagunto–Burgos, s/n, 44002 Teruel
description:
Baja Aragón 2026 is one of Spain’s classic rally-raid events and a strong summer target for fans of bikes, quads and long-distance off-road racing. Based around Teruel, it offers a dry, dramatic Aragón setting where the ride to the event can feel like part of the adventure.

The experience is more about endurance, dust, road books, service-park energy and timed off-road sections than grandstand-style circuit viewing. It suits adventure riders, rally-raid fans, trail riders and touring bikers looking for a motorsport stop away from the usual road-racing calendar.

name: FIM MotoJunior World Championship — Estoril 2026
address: Circuito do Estoril, Av. Alfredo César Torres, Apartado 49, 2646-901 Alcabideche
description:
FIM MotoJunior World Championship — Estoril 2026 is a strong Portuguese stop for riders who enjoy watching the next generation of Grand Prix talent before they reach the world stage. Circuito do Estoril gives the weekend a classic racing setting close to Lisbon, Cascais and the Atlantic coast, so it can fit naturally into a Portugal motorcycle trip.

The programme includes Moto3 Junior, Moto2 European Championship, Stock European Championship and Moto4 action, giving sport-racing fans a full development-series weekend rather than a single headline race. For motorcycle travelers, it is especially appealing as a compact circuit event that can be combined with coastal roads around Cascais, Sintra and the Lisbon region.

name: FIM MotoJunior World Championship — Jerez 2026
address: Circuito de Jerez - Ángel Nieto, Carretera Jerez-Arcos, km 10, 11405 Jerez de la Frontera
description:
FIM MotoJunior World Championship — Jerez 2026 brings junior Grand Prix-level racing to one of Spain’s most motorcycle-obsessed circuits. Circuito de Jerez-Ángel Nieto gives the weekend a classic Andalusian racing setting, with strong motorsport culture and a venue deeply linked to the Road to MotoGP ladder. For motorcycle travelers, Jerez can fit naturally into a southern Spain route, with Cadiz, the white villages and Atlantic-side riding all within reach.

The event is smaller than MotoGP, but it still offers a serious race-weekend atmosphere and a chance to watch young riders before they step up to bigger championships. It is a good fit for sport-racing fans and touring bikers who want a circuit stop without the full Grand Prix crowd size.

name: Campionato Italiano Velocità — Imola 2026
address: Autodromo Internazionale Enzo e Dino Ferrari, Piazza Ayrton Senna da Silva 1, 40026 Imola BO
description:
Campionato Italiano Velocità — Imola 2026 brings Italy’s top national motorcycle road-racing series to the legendary Autodromo Internazionale Enzo e Dino Ferrari. For motorcycle travelers, Imola is a strong northern Italy stop, with serious racing heritage, Emilia-Romagna roads nearby and a circuit setting that feels much bigger than a local club weekend. The event features classes such as Superbike, Supersport 600, Sport Bike, Moto3 and PreMoto3, mixing experienced riders with young talent on the way up.

It is especially suitable for sport-racing fans, touring riders and bikers who enjoy discovering serious race events beyond the biggest international championships. Tickets are listed from €20 for the Saturday/Sunday race weekend, making it an accessible motorsport stop for riders crossing northern Italy in June.

name: Campionato Italiano Velocità — Misano Racing Night 2026
address: Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli, Via Daijiro Kato 10, 47843 Misano Adriatico RN
description:
Campionato Italiano Velocità — Misano Racing Night 2026 brings Italy’s top national motorcycle road-racing series back to Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli for a special summer night-racing weekend. For motorcycle travelers, Misano Adriatico is an easy Adriatic coast stop that can be combined with Rimini, San Marino, Tavullia and the wider Motor Valley atmosphere.

The Racing Night format gives the CIV round a more distinctive feel than a standard daytime race weekend, with floodlit competition and a stronger evening atmosphere around the circuit. It is especially suitable for sport-bike riders, Italian racing fans and touring bikers who want real paddock energy without the scale and crowds of MotoGP.

name: French Superbike Championship — Pau-Arnos 2026
address: Circuit Européen Pau Arnos, 1 camin deu circuit, 64370 Arnos
description:
French Superbike Championship — Pau-Arnos 2026 brings national-level superbike racing and the FIM Sidecar World Championship to a compact circuit in southwest France. Circuit Européen Pau Arnos sits in a green valley near the Pyrenees, making the ride to the event part of the weekend for motorcycle travelers.

The event offers a more approachable atmosphere than major world championship rounds, with paddock access, grandstand viewing, terrace areas and close racing across several motorcycle classes. It is especially relevant for sport-bike fans, touring bikers and riders who enjoy discovering strong local championships away from the biggest international crowds. Tickets are listed from €20, making it a practical race stop for a June route through Béarn, the Pyrenees approaches or western France.

name: El Bar de Las Motos
address: Av. del Tivoli, 29631 Arroyo de La Miel
description: El Bar de Las Motos is a атмосферic biker bar in southern Spain, popular among local riders and traveling bikers. The interior is decorated with motorcycles, engine parts, and rock-and-roll memorabilia, creating a true road spirit. Motorcycle club meetups, casual parties, and live music events are often held here. The bar is known for its friendly atmosphere where it’s easy to connect with like-minded people.

name: Hollister Rockabilly & Biker
description: Hollister Rockabilly & Biker is a vibrant themed bar combining rockabilly style and biker culture on the Catalonian coast. The interior features vintage American décor with motorcycles, neon signs, and retro elements. Rock’n’roll and rockabilly music are regularly played, along with live performances.

name: Ruta 69 Rock Bar
address: Carrer Llevant, 18, 46715 L'Alqueria de la Comtessa
description: Route 69 is a vibrant bar with an American theme. It’s popular among tourists and local bikers. Visitors can see a collection of motorcycle memorabilia. Parties and live shows are frequent. It’s a great place for a fun night out.

name: Motard Bar Biker Friendly
address: Plaza Alcalde Mayin, s/n, 33777 Villanueva de Oscos
description: Motard Bar Biker Friendly is a cozy biker bar designed for motorcycle enthusiasts and lovers of the open road. It offers a welcoming atmosphere where every guest feels like part of a big biker community. The interior features classic motorcycle-themed decor that gives the place a unique character.

name: Restaurante Racers Madrid
description: Restaurante Racers Madrid is a stylish biker restaurant inspired by the culture of speed and motorcycles. It combines a dynamic atmosphere with a friendly vibe that attracts both bikers and casual visitors. The interior features racing-themed decor with bold details that create a sense of motion and adrenaline. The menu offers hearty dishes and drinks perfect for relaxing after a ride. It’s a great spot to meet up, enjoy good food, and experience a spirit of freedom.

name: Moto albergue Farango
description:
Moto Albergue Farango is a motorcycle hostel located at the foot of the Spanish Pyrenees, built by and for motorcycle lovers. Here you will find the perfect combination of impressive routes, moments of relaxation, and a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
Located just 120 km from the French border, at the foot of the Spanish Pyrenees, Moto Albergue Farango is the ideal starting point for motorcyclists. Enjoy spectacular roads, stunning nature, and the freedom to ride in one of Spain's most beautiful regions.

name: La Cantera Biker Bar
description: La Cantera Biker Bar is a vibrant biker bar with a true spirit of freedom and the open road. It attracts motorcycle enthusiasts who come to relax and socialize in a laid-back setting. The interior is styled with classic biker-themed decor and cozy details that create a welcoming vibe. Guests can enjoy drinks and simple yet tasty food, perfect for casual gatherings. It’s a great place to experience biker culture and spend time with like-minded people.

name: Hotel Moto-Rural VEGALION
description:
Hotel Moto-Rural VEGALION is a unique destination created especially for motorcycle travelers from around the world.
Located in the breathtaking Picos de Europa region of northwestern Spain, directly on the famous N-621 route, the hotel offers the perfect base for riders exploring the area.
One of VEGALION’s main highlights is its secure motorcycle facilities, including private parking and a covered garage with automatic gates and 24/7 video surveillance for complete peace of mind. Guests also have access to a dedicated service area equipped with essential tools for maintenance and minor repairs.
After a long day on the road, riders can relax in the cozy private "La Hornera" bar with a wood-burning fireplace, enjoy a selection of drinks and dinner options, and share stories with fellow travelers.

name: 2 Wheels Granada
description: 2 Wheels Granada is a true motorcycle-friendly escape at the foot of the Sierra Nevada mountains, created by riders for riders. It is the perfect base to explore some of Spain’s most exciting motorcycle roads - from breathtaking mountain passes to the scenic routes of Andalusia. After a day of riding, guests can relax in a welcoming biker atmosphere, share stories with fellow travellers and enjoy the charm of Granada. With secure motorcycle parking and a passion for two-wheel adventures, it’s more than just accommodation - it’s part of the journey.

name: Hotel Infantado
description: Hotel Infantado is an ideal starting point for motorcycle adventures in the heart of the Picos de Europa mountains. Located near Potes, it gives riders easy access to some of Northern Spain’s most spectacular roads, including mountain passes, deep valleys and unforgettable viewpoints. After exploring the winding routes of Cantabria, guests can enjoy traditional hospitality, local cuisine and a relaxing mountain atmosphere. With motorcycle-friendly facilities and parking, Hotel Infantado is a perfect stop for riders discovering the beauty of northern Spain.

name: Hotel del Oso
description: Hotel del Oso offers a unique motorcycle getaway surrounded by the breathtaking landscapes of the Picos de Europa National Park. Located in the Liébana Valley near some of Northern Spain’s most scenic riding routes, it is a perfect base for exploring mountain passes, charming villages and unforgettable viewpoints. After a day on the road, riders can relax in a peaceful atmosphere, enjoy traditional Cantabrian cuisine and experience authentic Spanish hospitality. With convenient parking and a great location for touring adventures, Hotel del Oso is an excellent stop for motorcycle travellers exploring northern Spain.

name: Hotel Dos Rios
description: Hotel Dos Rios is a perfect base for motorcycle travellers exploring the legendary roads of the Spanish Pyrenees. Located in the historic town of Aínsa, it offers easy access to spectacular routes, mountain passes and breathtaking landscapes between Spain and France. After a day of riding, guests can enjoy the charm of a medieval village, local cuisine and a comfortable place to relax. With motorcycle-friendly facilities and convenient parking, Hotel Dos Rios is an excellent stop for riders looking for unforgettable Pyrenean adventures.

name: ☀️ SUNGIRO Moto-Hotel 🏍️
description:
Thirsting for adventure and relaxation?☀️ At Moto-Hotel SUNGIRO in Spain we have everything you need!

Eight motorbikes, ten comfortable beds and more than three hundred twenty-five sunny days a year. Imagine riding in the warm autumn or winter, taking thousands of perfect turns on scenic roads we recommend. And after your exciting day? Relax by the fire in the garden with breathtaking mountain views. Kitchen, terrace, barbecue, dedicated chill out areas, airport transfer - we have everything you need.
It's not just a hotel- it's your next great story!

For decades we have been a group of friends brought together by a passion for motorbikes, adventure and fun. We invite everyone who shares our vision of spending free time. Boasting about the number of kilometres covered is long overdue; a mature motorbike rider can enjoy nature, a well-taken turn and interesting conversations by the fire. Start a day Start your day with a peaceful breakfast with a majestic view, choose one of the many prepared routes and attractions, enjoy the Spanish atmosphere and culture, recharge your batteries and find your peace.

name: Hotel Los Cerezos De Yanguas
description: Hotel Los Cerezos De Yanguas is a peaceful mountain retreat surrounded by the scenic roads and natural landscapes of northern Spain. Located in the historic village of Yanguas, it is a great stop for motorcycle travellers exploring the quiet curves, valleys and hidden routes of the Soria region. After a day of riding, guests can relax in a welcoming rural atmosphere, discover traditional Spanish charm and enjoy the beauty of an authentic countryside destination. With convenient parking and access to incredible touring roads, Hotel Los Cerezos De Yanguas is a perfect choice for riders looking for a calm and memorable journey.

name: Hotel Can Boix de Peramola
description: Hotel Can Boix de Peramola is a hidden gem for motorcycle travellers exploring the stunning landscapes of the Catalan Pyrenees. Located near some of the region’s most beautiful mountain roads, it offers an excellent starting point for rides through winding routes, dramatic cliffs and scenic valleys. After an unforgettable day on two wheels, guests can relax in a peaceful natural setting, enjoy high-quality Catalan cuisine and experience warm local hospitality. With convenient parking and a perfect location for Pyrenees adventures, Hotel Can Boix de Peramola is an ideal stop for riders seeking comfort, nature and incredible roads.

name: Hotel Rebeco
description: Hotel Rebeco is an excellent mountain escape for motorcycle travellers exploring the breathtaking roads of the Picos de Europa. Located in Fuente Dé, surrounded by dramatic peaks and valleys, it offers direct access to some of Northern Spain’s most spectacular riding routes. After a day of discovering mountain passes, scenic viewpoints and traditional villages, riders can relax in a peaceful alpine atmosphere and enjoy authentic Cantabrian hospitality. With convenient parking and an unbeatable location for touring adventures, Hotel Rebeco is a perfect stop for those who want to experience the wild beauty of Spain on two wheels.

name: Motocard
description: Motocard Barcelona is one of Europe’s leading destinations for motorcycle enthusiasts, offering everything riders need for their next adventure. With a huge selection of helmets, riding gear, accessories and motorcycle equipment from top brands, it is a must-visit stop for both local riders and travellers passing through Barcelona. Whether preparing for a long-distance tour, upgrading equipment or finding essential accessories on the road, riders can count on expert advice and a wide range of products. For motorcycle travellers exploring Spain, Motocard Barcelona is more than a store — it is a trusted partner for every journey on two wheels.

name: Martimotos Madrid 2
description: Martimotos Madrid is a well-known destination for motorcycle riders looking for premium gear, equipment and expert support before their next adventure. Offering a wide selection of helmets, riding apparel, accessories and motorcycle essentials from leading brands, it serves both local enthusiasts and touring riders crossing Spain. Conveniently located in Madrid, it is an ideal stop to upgrade equipment, replace worn gear or prepare for long-distance routes. With a strong reputation among the motorcycle community and a focus on quality and rider experience, Martimotos Madrid is a trusted point for every journey on two wheels.

name: MOTORRAIZ
description: MOTORRAIZ Valencia is a trusted destination for motorcycle travellers and adventure riders looking for quality gear, accessories and equipment. With a strong focus on touring and adventure motorcycling, it offers a wide range of helmets, riding apparel, luggage systems and essential products from leading motorcycle brands. Located in Valencia, it is a great stop for riders preparing for long-distance journeys or exploring the scenic roads of eastern Spain. With expert knowledge, quality products and a passion for two-wheel adventures, MOTORRAIZ is a reliable partner for every rider on the road.

name: Outlet Moto
description: Outlet Moto is a popular motorcycle store for riders looking for quality gear, accessories and equipment at great value. With a wide selection of helmets, protective clothing, gloves, boots and motorcycle essentials from well-known brands, it is a convenient stop for both everyday riders and motorcycle travellers. Located in Barcelona, it helps riders prepare for city rides, long-distance tours and adventures across Spain and beyond. With its rider-focused approach and extensive product range, Outlet Moto is a trusted place for every motorcyclist on the road.

name: Motocard - Ropa, accesorios y cascos de moto en Málaga
address: Av. de Velázquez, 4, Carretera de Cádiz, 29003
description: Motocard Málaga is a perfect stop for motorcycle travellers exploring the sunny roads of Andalusia and the Costa del Sol. Offering a wide range of helmets, riding gear, accessories and motorcycle equipment from top international brands, it helps riders prepare for every kind of journey. Located close to some of Spain’s most exciting routes, including mountain roads around Ronda and Sierra Nevada, it is a convenient point for touring and adventure riders. With expert support, quality products and a passion for motorcycling, Motocard Málaga is a reliable partner for every adventure on two wheels.

name: DIRTBIKE Garage
address: Carrer Ponent s/n Polígon Industrial Can Mascaró Nau 17B, 08756 La Palma de Cervelló
description: DIRTBIKE Garage Barcelona is a specialized motorcycle workshop for riders who demand reliability, performance and adventure-ready machines. Focused on off-road, enduro and adventure motorcycles, it provides expert maintenance, repairs and preparation for those who love exploring beyond ordinary roads. Located in Barcelona, it is a valuable stop for riders preparing for mountain trails, long-distance trips or challenging routes across Spain. With technical expertise and a true passion for motorcycles, DIRTBIKE Garage helps riders keep their bikes ready for every adventure.

name: Taller Motos Madrid | B.R.M. Reparaciones
description: Taller Motos Madrid | B.R.M. Reparaciones is a trusted motorcycle workshop in Madrid, providing professional maintenance and repair services for riders and their machines. With experience in servicing different types of motorcycles, it is a convenient stop for both local bikers and travellers passing through Spain’s capital. Whether riders need regular maintenance, diagnostics or repairs during a long journey, the workshop helps keep motorcycles safe and road-ready. With a practical location and rider-focused service, B.R.M. Reparaciones is a reliable partner for continuing every adventure on two wheels.

name: "MotoFix" -Taller de Motos Multimarca
description: MotoFix - Taller de Motos Multimarca Málaga is a reliable motorcycle workshop for riders exploring Andalusia and the Costa del Sol. Specializing in multi-brand motorcycle maintenance and repairs, it provides support for different types of bikes, from everyday motorcycles to touring machines. Located in one of Spain’s most popular riding regions, it is a useful stop for travellers who need service, repairs or technical assistance during their journey. With professional care and a passion for keeping motorcycles road-ready, MotoFix helps riders continue their adventures with confidence.

name: CH MOTORRAD
address: Carrer Cadí, 25, 08272 Sant Fruitós de Bages
description: CH MOTORRAD is a specialized motorcycle workshop created for riders who value reliability, performance and adventure-ready machines. Located near Barcelona and close to the routes leading towards the Pyrenees, it is a great stop for touring and adventure travellers preparing for long-distance journeys. With experience in motorcycle maintenance, repairs and preparation, the workshop helps riders keep their bikes ready for mountain roads and challenging adventures. Combining technical expertise with a passion for motorcycles, CH MOTORRAD is a trusted partner for exploring Spain and beyond on two wheels.

name: BMW Boxer Motorrad - Sevilla
address: Pol. Ind. Carretera Amarilla, C. del Motor, 3, 41007
description: BMW Boxer Motorrad Sevilla is a premium motorcycle service center dedicated to riders who expect reliability, quality and professional support on every journey. Located in Seville, it is an important stop for motorcycle travellers exploring Andalusia, southern Spain or continuing their adventure towards Portugal and Morocco. With specialized BMW Motorrad service, maintenance and support for touring and adventure motorcycles, it helps riders keep their machines ready for long-distance routes. For BMW GS enthusiasts and adventure travellers, Boxer Motorrad Sevilla is a trusted partner on the road.

name: Basílica de la Sagrada Família
description: Sagrada Família is a famous basilica in Barcelona designed by architect Antoni Gaudí and one of the city’s most iconic landmarks. Construction began in 1882 and has continued for over 140 years, making it one of the longest-running architectural projects in the world. In 2026, the central Tower of Jesus Christ was completed, marking a major milestone and reaching the basilica’s full planned height. However, some elements, including the Glory façade, are still under construction. For parking, visitors can use nearby underground garages such as Saba Bamsa Sagrada Familia or Parking NN Valencia III, both within a short walking distance.

name: Balcón del Mediterráneo
description: Balcón del Mediterráneo is one of the most famous viewpoints in Tarragona, Spain, offering stunning views of the sea. It is located at the end of Rambla Nova on a high cliff and is a popular spot for walks and photography. From here, visitors can admire the coastline, the port, and the ancient city walls, creating a unique atmosphere. It is an ideal place to enjoy the sunset and experience the spirit of the Mediterranean. Nearby, there are parking areas and city garages in central Tarragona, just a short walk from the viewpoint.

name: Casa Batlló
description: Casa Batlló is one of Barcelona’s most famous houses, designed by architect Antoni Gaudí and considered a masterpiece of Modernism. Located on Passeig de Gràcia, the building stands out with its unique façade resembling waves and bones. The interior is equally impressive, featuring curved lines, colorful stained glass, and carefully crafted details that create a magical atmosphere. Casa Batlló is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a must-see attraction in the city. For parking, visitors can use nearby underground garages such as Parking Saba Passeig de Gràcia or Parking NN Valencia II.

name: Motoservice
description: Moto Service Verona is a professional motorcycle workshop in Verona, a real lifesaver for riders traveling through Northern Italy. They focus exclusively on bikes, offering everything from tire changes and diagnostics to serious engine work, with many parts in stock for quick turnaround. The location is perfect for a pit stop en route to Lake Garda or before tackling the Alpine passes. The mechanics speak basic English and understand that time matters to a biker, so they genuinely try to fix urgent issues without delay. It’s a clean, modern shop where your machine is treated with real care. Bookmark this one: they won’t just repair your ride, they’ll do it with passion.

name: Tbike Moto Honda Dealership Tottene Silvio
description: Tbike Moto Honda is an official Honda dealership in Vicenza, conveniently located on Viale della Scienza. For motorcycle travelers, it's a reliable stop for maintenance, genuine parts, and accessories. The showroom features a range of Honda bikes and riding gear, with helpful staff ready to assist even if you're just passing through. There's ample parking where you can safely leave your fully loaded touring bike. A great spot to refresh your kit, stock up on consumables, and get expert advice before continuing your ride through the Veneto region.

name: Japan Moto Di Stano Michele
description: Japan Moto Di Stano Michele is a specialized workshop in Milan dedicated to Japanese motorcycles. Located on Via Monte Velino in the south-eastern part of the city, it's easily accessible from the ring road without having to navigate the narrow historic center. They handle diagnostics, engine repairs, suspension work, and electrics for any Japanese bike, from vintage classics to modern sport machines. For a traveler, this is the kind of place where you can get a quick fix and get back on the road through Lombardy without losing a day. The mechanics work neatly and understand a biker's tight schedule, and there's a small parking area where you can safely leave your loaded motorcycle. A solid backup for unexpected maintenance or sourcing specific parts while in Milan.

name: Motocenter
description: Motocenter in Vipiteno (Sterzing) is a well-stocked motorcycle shop situated right beneath the Brenner Pass, one of Europe’s major transalpine routes. You’ll find gear, helmets, consumables, oils, and handy road essentials — perfect for a stop before or after crossing the Alps. Thanks to the bilingual region, staff speak German and Italian, and often English, so communication is smooth. There’s parking nearby where you can safely leave your fully loaded bike while you browse and try things on. A great checkpoint to refresh your kit and do some light shopping surrounded by stunning mountain scenery.

name: Guesthouse Vissinokipos - Biker Friendly Hotel
description: Guesthouse Vissinokipos (“Cherry Orchard”) is set in the quiet village of Aposkepos, just a short ride from Kastoria and the scenic Lake Orestiada. It’s a truly biker-friendly place: the owners welcome motorcyclists with secure parking and space to dry gear. The surrounding roads twist through the Grammos mountains and towards Prespa Lake, offering fantastic day rides. Rooms are cosy and spotless, breakfast is homemade with local ingredients, and the hospitality is warm and genuine. An ideal base to relax after a day of curves and enjoy the calm of Greece’s Macedonian countryside.

name: Gamila Rocks
description: Gamila Rocks is a cosy mountain hotel in the village of Aristi, deep in the Zagori region, with breathtaking views of the Gamila peaks and Vikos Gorge. For motorcycle travellers, it’s a perfect base: twisting roads wind through stone bridges and traditional villages straight from Aristi, and the famous Oxia viewpoint over Vikos Canyon is just a short ride away. The hotel offers secure parking for your fully loaded bike and a homemade breakfast with local ingredients to fuel your day in the saddle. Rooms are finished in stone and wood, with balconies facing the mountains — an unbeatable spot to unwind after tackling Epirus’ switchbacks. The owners are genuinely biker-friendly and happy to share the best riding routes in the region.

name: Hotel Orestion
description: Hotel Orestion sits right on the main square of Kastoria, steps from Lake Orestiada, and is officially listed as bike & motorcycle friendly. For a motorcyclist, it offers that rare mix — a bed in the historic centre with safe parking for your bike (the hotel helps arrange a spot on the adjacent lot or nearby). It’s equally convenient for launching into the switchbacks of Mt Vitsi and Grammos or for a relaxed day ride around the lake. Rooms are spacious and warm, overlooking the square or the mountains, with the best meze bars and tavernas of Kastoria buzzing just downstairs. The staff are used to bikers, always ready with route tips and local knowledge — it’s a true rider’s living room in the heart of Western Macedonia.

name: ANASTASSIOU HOTEL
description: ANASTASSIOU HOTEL is located right on the Grevena–Kastoria national road, in the Petra area, just a couple of minutes’ ride from the city and the lake. For bikers, it’s a “ride in, park, sleep” kind of place: leave your motorcycle right at the entrance, near your room window. A perfect overnight stop before tackling the switchbacks of Northern Pindos in the morning, or while transiting through Western Macedonia. Rooms are simple, spotless and family-cosy, and the owners welcome you with genuine Greek hospitality. A gas station and a taverna are steps away — grab a bite in the evening, fill up in the morning, and you’re back on the road.

name: Hotel Doupiani House
description: Doupiani House is a family-run guesthouse in the village of Kastraki, right at the base of the Meteora rocks. You can securely park your motorcycle on the private lot, with the main monasteries, viewpoints, and winding cliff roads just minutes of riding away. Rooms feature wooden ceilings, balconies, and views of the stone towers — a soul-soothing break after a day of switchbacks. Breakfast is served on a terrace filled with birdsong, and the owners are true enthusiasts who will happily share the best routes and photo spots. An excellent base for a relaxed Meteora exploration before heading into the Pindus range or towards the coast.

name: The Alex, Monte Kastella
description: The Alex is a boutique hotel perched on the Kastella hill in Piraeus, just minutes from the main passenger port. It’s a great choice for a biker catching or arriving on a ferry: you can park your motorcycle on the hotel’s grounds (by prior arrangement), sparing yourself the stress of the port's tight streets. The terrace and rooms offer superb views over the sea and the Athens coastline, and the hotel itself is a cosy, individually styled mansion. A hearty breakfast is served in the morning, and the famous coastal ride to Cape Sounion starts almost around the corner. An ideal spot for a civilized overnight before the islands or after a long day in the saddle.

name: Monastiri Guesthouse
description: Monastiri Guesthouse is set on a quiet street in Kalambaka, at the very foot of the Meteora rocks. For motorcycle travellers, it's one of the most convenient overnights in town: the famous monasteries and the panoramic cliffside road are just a short ride away, and your bike can be securely parked right outside. Inside, the rooms are spacious, with stone walls and wooden floors — immaculately clean and offering a mountain cosiness after a long day in the saddle. A generous homemade breakfast is served in the common room, with views of the towering peaks. Tavernas and shops are just steps away, and the owners always accommodate bikers with a smile and top route tips for the area.

name: Boufidis Greek Tavern
description: Boufidis Greek Tavern is an authentic Greek tavern in the village of Kastraki, directly beneath the towering rocks of Meteora. For bikers, it's a perfect pit stop for a tasty, quick lunch or dinner after a day spent carving through monasteries and switchbacks. There's a spacious area in front of the tavern where you can safely park your motorcycle without removing the panniers. The food is home-style: giant beans, moussaka, fresh fish, village salads, and, naturally, ice-cold local beer. The staff are friendly, fast, and genuinely motorcycle-friendly — they respect your time and will happily recommend the best dishes. A brilliant spot to refuel before an evening walk to the rocks or a morning launch into the Pindus mountains.

name: Tenuta Le Cave
description: Immersa nella Valpolicella e ai piedi della Lessinia, Tenuta Le Cave è la sosta ideale per i motociclisti in cerca di relax, buona cucina e panorami unici. Da qui si diramano numerosi itinerari, sia on-road che off-road, tra colline, vigneti e montagne. La struttura oltre gli alloggi dispone di un ristorante che propone una cucina del territorio reinterpretata in chiave contemporanea, accompagnata da vini biologici di produzione propria, il tutto in una location suggestiva ricavata da un'antica cava.

name: Taverna bakaliarakia
description: Taverna Bakaliarakia in Kastraki is a legendary spot for authentic Greek fried cod (bakaliaros) served with the creamiest garlic mash (skordalia). The tavern sits right at the foot of the Meteora rocks, with enough space out front to park your motorcycle without removing the panniers. The interior is simple and homey, like an old village house, and the food arrives fast — perfect for a biker who wants a hearty, delicious meal without wasting time. Alongside the cod, the menu features excellent village salads, fresh seafood, and ice-cold beer. The service comes with a smile, and the staff are used to motorcycle travellers — they’ll happily recommend dishes and won’t keep you waiting. A brilliant lunch or dinner stop before continuing your Meteora ride.

name: Bikers House
description: Bikers House in Athens is a dedicated motorcycle workshop and shop, built by riders for riders. Inside there's a full workshop with professional tools and a lift: they can handle maintenance, tyre changes, diagnostics and any technical issue quickly before you hit the Greek roads. The attached shop stocks consumables, oils, accessories and handy bits — you can grab everything you need in one stop. The owners are experienced motorcycle travellers who understand exactly what a rider needs on the road and are always ready to help with route advice or urgent repairs. You can safely leave your bike out front while sorting things out. A true biker's pit stop in the capital — ride in, fix up, gear up, and back in the saddle.

name: The Bikers
description: The Bikers in Chalandri is a dedicated motorcycle shop and service centre in the northern suburbs of Athens, worth a stop before heading out or after a long haul. The showroom stocks gear, helmets, oils and consumables from top brands, while the workshop handles tyre changes, diagnostics, repairs and scheduled maintenance quickly. The location is away from tourist traffic — easy to ride in, sort everything out, and get back on the road without delay. The team speaks English and truly understands bikers’ needs, ready to help with both parts selection and urgent fixes. Parking is right out front, so your motorcycle stays in sight. A perfect pit stop to refuel with spares and tech support before heading to the Peloponnese or the northern twisties.

name: Biker's Store Σισμάνης-Σεραφειμίδης
description: Biker's Store Σισμάνης-Σεραφειμίδης is a dedicated motorcycle shop right in the centre of Thessaloniki, on Agiou Nestoros Street. Motorcycle travellers will find everything here: helmets, gloves, locks, consumables, oils and handy road accessories. The location is perfect — close to the seafront and main roads, so you can pop in quickly without wasting time in city traffic. The staff are knowledgeable and speak Greek, and most likely English, and are always ready to help with your choice. Motorcycle parking is available right in front of the store, no hassle. A great pit stop to refuel your gear before heading to Halkidiki, Kavala or further into the Balkans.

name: Classic Moto Restore
description: Classic Moto Restore in Agii Anargiri is a workshop with real soul, where classic motorcycles are brought back to life and modern machines are treated with equal care. For a motorcycle traveller, it’s a reliable address in the north-west of Athens, easily accessible from the main avenue without diving into the city centre. They handle everything from carburettors and electrics on old Japanese bikes to routine maintenance and diagnostics of touring enduros. The workshop is clean, the tools professional, and the mechanics work with restorers’ attention to detail — your ride won’t just be fixed, it’ll be revived. Motorcycle parking is available right at the entrance, and urgent repairs can be arranged if needed. A great spot to get back on the road or simply admire some living classics before the next leg of your journey.

name: Biker Station Hellas Στου Καζεπου
description: Biker Station Hellas in Kerdillia is a genuine roadside biker station on the main route between Thessaloniki and Kavala, surrounded by the green hills of Serres. Stop here for hot coffee, cold drinks, hearty snacks and, most importantly, a full understanding of biker needs: there's a spacious parking area right out front where you can safely leave your fully loaded motorcycle. The place serves as a gathering spot for riders from all over Northern Greece — a chance to rest, swap stories, and get route tips from locals. The owners are welcoming, speak Greek and basic English, and the atmosphere is laid-back and friendly. A perfect checkpoint to stretch your legs and grab a bite before heading towards the Falakro mountains or onwards to Halkidiki.

name: HARLEY DAVIDSON CLUB HELLAS
description: HARLEY DAVIDSON CLUB HELLAS in Thessaloniki is the official chapter of the legendary American brand and a magnet for Harley owners and enthusiasts across Greece. For a motorcycle traveller, it’s more than just a clubhouse — it’s a gateway into the local biker community: they’ll welcome you like family, share the best routes, hook you up with service contacts, and have a coffee with you. Inside you can pick up official merchandise, accessories and parts, or join upcoming rides. You can park your motorcycle right out front on a spacious area — plenty of room even for a group. The atmosphere is classic Harley: rugged, friendly and soaked in road spirit. A brilliant stop to connect with Northern Greece on two wheels, especially if you’re transiting through Thessaloniki towards the Balkans or south.

name: Rider's Stories Coffee and Drinks
description: Rider's Stories Coffee and Drinks is a motorcycle-themed café in central Athens, where every corner breathes road spirit. Park your bike right out front in the spacious area, panniers on, and enjoy a quality coffee or a cold drink in peace. Inside, vintage motorcycle décor, photos and a cozy atmosphere set the tone, and you're likely to meet fellow travellers at the next table. The staff and owners are part of the biker community, speak Greek and English, and are always happy to share route tips and local advice. A brilliant spot to catch your breath, swap stories and plan the next leg of your ride.

name: Silver Spurs
description: Silver Spurs is an atmospheric biker bar in a quiet Athens neighbourhood, welcoming you with a wood-panelled interior, dim lighting and true brotherhood. You can park your motorcycle right by the entrance on the pavement, clearly visible from inside, so no worries about your ride. They serve excellent draught beer, spirits and burgers, with live rock and blues music in the evenings. The crowd is a mix of local riders and passing travellers, always ready to swap stories. The staff are friendly, speak English, and are happy to suggest what to see in Athens or where to head next. A perfect spot to unwind after a day carving through city traffic or to celebrate the end of a journey.

name: MOTO THEOCHARIS
description: MOTO THEOCHARIS is a multi-functional motorcycle centre in Thessaloniki, housing both a shop and a service area under one roof. Its location on Karaoli and Dimitriou ton Kiprion Street is easy to reach from the city's main roads, so you can swing by without getting stuck in traffic. The shop stocks helmets, riding gear, consumables, oils and spare parts, while the workshop handles tyre changes, maintenance, diagnostics and repairs. The staff speak Greek and usually English, and are always ready to help with both purchases and urgent fixes. There is parking right outside, so you can safely leave your loaded bike — a perfect pit stop to refuel with tech and gear before heading to Halkidiki or deeper into the Balkans.

name: Motosp
description: Motosp in Likovrisi is a dedicated motorcycle shop and service centre, conveniently located in the northern suburbs of Athens, just minutes from the Attiki Odos motorway. For a traveller, it's a perfect checkpoint before heading north or after returning to the capital: you can safely park your bike in the spacious area right outside. Inside you'll find gear, oils, consumables, spare parts and accessories, while the workshop handles diagnostics, tyre changes and maintenance. The staff speak Greek and English, are always accommodating and ready to help with urgent fixes. A great spot to check your bike, restock and continue your journey with peace of mind.

name: Moto Pursang
description: Moto Pursang in Pefki is a motorcycle workshop and shop in the northern suburbs of Athens, easily accessible from the Attiki Odos ring road without diving into city traffic. For a motorcycle traveller, it's a convenient spot to quickly handle maintenance, diagnostics, tyre changes and pick up consumables. The workshop is clean, well-equipped, and the staff speak Greek and English, always happy to help with urgent fixes. You can park your bike right out front, within sight. A great checkpoint to prep your machine before heading north or into the Parnitha mountain twisties.

name: Moto Manolis
description: Moto Manolis in Kastoria is a trusted local motorcycle workshop worth visiting if your bike needs attention while riding through Western Macedonia. The shop is conveniently located on Grammou Street, with easy access and parking right by the entrance, so you can safely leave your loaded motorcycle. They handle repairs of any complexity, routine maintenance, diagnostics, tyre changes and electrical work, and they do it neatly without unnecessary delays. The mechanic is a local expert who speaks Greek and most likely basic English, and always tries to help a traveller quickly. The lake and the city centre are just a short walk away — you can grab a bite or relax while your bike is being sorted. A solid backup spot on any route around the Pindus range or while transiting towards Albania.

name: Moto Market SA. Athens
description: Moto Market SA is one of the largest motorcycle shops in Athens, situated on the busy Venizelos Avenue in the Kallithea district. For a traveller, it's a treasure trove: a huge range of gear, helmets, oils, accessories and spare parts, all under one roof, saving you time and hassle. There's an attached service area where they can quickly handle an oil change, tyre swap or diagnostics. You can park your motorcycle right out front in the spacious lot without worrying about your bike. The staff speak Greek and English, and are always ready to help with both purchases and urgent fixes — a perfect stop to gear up and check your machine before heading out on any journey.

name: Papastavrou Shops (Petrou Ralli)
description: Papastavrou Shops on Petrou Ralli Avenue in Tavros is a large motorcycle store with an excellent range of gear, helmets, consumables and spare parts from leading global brands. The location is very convenient: right on a wide main road, minutes from central Athens, with spacious parking out front where you can easily leave your fully loaded bike. For a motorcycle traveller, it's a perfect spot to quickly stock up on oil, grab a missing part, or refresh your riding kit before heading off. Staff speak Greek and English, are always happy to help with selection, and understand the realities of life on the road. The store also serves as a pick-up point for online orders — handy if you need to reserve something in advance.

name: Papastavrou Shops (Thessaloniki)
description: Papastavrou Shops in Kalamaria is a well-stocked motorcycle store in the eastern part of Thessaloniki, right on the busy Ethnikis Antistaseos Street. For a biker travelling through Northern Greece, it's a convenient stop to quickly refuel with gear, oils, consumables and genuine spare parts. There is enough space in front of the shop to park your motorcycle and calmly pick up everything you need. The staff speak Greek and English, and are always ready to help with selection and urgent purchases. A great option to stock up before heading to Halkidiki, Kavala or the Balkan passes.

name: Agnantio Hotel Spa
description: Agnantio Hotel Spa is set on the quiet road between Sidirokastro and Ano Vrontou, in rolling countryside just a few kilometres from the Bulgarian border. For motorcycle travellers, it's an ideal overnight when transiting through the Balkans: park your bike securely and unwind in the spa after a long day in the saddle. The hotel offers spacious rooms with panoramic valley views, an outdoor pool, and a proper Greek breakfast in the morning. Gentle winding roads lead to Lake Kerkini and the Belasica mountain range — perfect for relaxed day rides. The staff are welcoming and always accommodating to bikers. A great base to recharge before heading deeper into Greece or back into the Balkans.

name: Athens Hawks Urban
description: Athens Hawks Urban is a modern budget hostel in central Athens, located in a neighbourhood with easy access to main roads and city exits. You can park your motorcycle on the quiet residential streets nearby, or arrange a spot in a secure underground car park just around the corner. Inside you'll find clean dorms and private rooms with air conditioning and comfortable beds, plus a shared lounge where it's easy to meet fellow travellers. The metro, supermarkets and bars are steps away, and the Acropolis is just a short ride. The staff speak English, are genuinely bike-friendly, and will happily advise on safe parking and local highlights. A solid, affordable overnight before launching into your Greek adventure.

name: Athens Hawks Hostel
description: Athens Hawks Hostel is set right in the heart of Athens, on Menandrou Street, just a stone's throw from lively Psirri and Monastiraki Square. For bikers, it's a brilliant budget option: sleep in the centre and hit the road in the morning without traffic, with the ring road and ferry ports nearby. You can leave your motorcycle on the quiet side streets or arrange a spot in a secure car park close by — the staff are happy to suggest the safest options. Inside you'll find clean dorms and private rooms, a cosy lounge and a rooftop bar with Acropolis views, where it's easy to connect with fellow travellers. Breakfast is included, coffee flows 24/7, and the reception team speak great English and are used to motorcyclists. A perfect spot for an affordable overnight, some story-swapping, and route planning before tackling Greece.

name: Amfiteatre romà de Tarragona
description: The Roman Amphitheatre of Tarragona is an ancient monument from the 2nd century AD, located right by the Mediterranean coast. It was built during the Roman Empire and used for gladiator fights and public spectacles. Today, visitors can explore well-preserved ruins as well as remains of later structures inside the arena. The amphitheatre is part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is one of Tarragona’s main attractions. For parking, visitors can use nearby city garages such as Aparcament Saavedra or Parking Rambla Nova, within walking distance of the site.

name: Museo Motocicletas
address: Carretera Callosa - Guadalest km 7, CV-755, 03517 El Castell de Guadalest
description: Museo Motocicletas is a motorcycle museum in Spain featuring an impressive collection of classic and rare models. The exhibition showcases bikes from different eras, allowing visitors to explore the evolution of motorcycle engineering. Guests can admire carefully restored machines and learn about their history and unique features. The museum is especially appealing to enthusiasts of technology and vintage vehicles.

name: Puente Nuevo de Ronda viewpoint
description: A viewpoint overlooking a picturesque gorge spanned by an 18th-century arched bridge.

name: Plaza de Toros de Las Ventas
description: Las Ventas Arena is the largest bullring in Madrid and one of the most famous in Spain. It was opened in 1931 and built in a Neo-Mudéjar style, featuring an impressive brick façade and decorative ceramics. Today, the venue hosts not only bullfights but also concerts, cultural events, and guided tours. Inside, there is also a museum dedicated to the history of bullfighting and Spanish traditions. For parking, visitors can use nearby underground garages and street parking in the Salamanca district, within walking distance of the arena.

name: Bécane - Bar Restaurant, Villeneuve d'Ascq
description: Bécane - Bar Restaurant is a stylish bar and restaurant located in Villeneuve-d’Ascq, France, known for its cozy atmosphere and modern cuisine. The venue combines gourmet dishes with a wide selection of drinks, including cocktails and wines. Its interior features an original design with industrial elements, creating a comfortable and trendy setting. It is a popular spot for both social gatherings and relaxed dinners. Nearby, visitors can find parking spaces and public parking areas, making it convenient to access by car.

name: Two Wheels Bar
description: Two Wheels Bar in Vila Nova de Famalicão is a cosy motorcycle-themed bar in northern Portugal, welcoming you with the smell of fresh coffee, cold beer and an authentic biker vibe. Park your bike right out front in the spacious area, panniers on, and relax with your drink in peace. Inside, road spirit takes over: vintage posters, motorcycle memorabilia and a friendly crowd that makes conversation easy. There's often live music in the evenings, and by day it's a perfect pit stop between rides. Staff speak Portuguese and English, are always happy to see bikers, and will gladly share the best routes around the region. A great spot to catch your breath and feel part of the local riding community.

name: Wing-Club
description: Wing-Club in Seroa is a motorcycle club and bar tucked away in a quiet industrial area, off the tourist trail but just minutes from Porto. Ample parking right at the entrance means you can safely leave your fully loaded bike and unwind among fellow riders. Inside, cold beer, soft drinks, simple hearty snacks and a genuine club vibe await — all fuelled by road talk and route tips. On weekends, riders from all around gather here, often with live music and themed nights. The staff speak Portuguese and basic English, are always welcoming to travellers, and will happily suggest where to head next in northern Portugal. A perfect checkpoint to stretch your legs, connect with local bikers and feel part of the community.

name: HD Bar to Be Wild
description: HD Bar to Be Wild is a Harley-Davidson themed bar right in the heart of Porto, on the famous Galeria de Paris street, where the nightlife buzzes all year round. You can park your motorcycle on the side streets or at a nearby square — staff will point you to a safe spot. The interior is decked out in Harley memorabilia, rock music sets the mood, and conversations naturally turn to roads and upcoming rides. Cold beer, spirits and traditional Portuguese snacks are on the menu — a hearty bite without leaving the bar. Local riders and travellers alike drop by, so you're sure to find good company. A perfect spot to start or end your day in Porto surrounded by fellow road lovers.

name: Bar O Motard (Taberna o Motard)
description: Bar O Motard in Canelas is a true riders' bar south of Porto, where motorcycles and their owners feel right at home. Spacious parking at the entrance lets you safely leave your fully loaded bike, while inside, cold beer, Portuguese snacks and a full-on brotherhood vibe await. The walls are covered in motorcycle memorabilia, flags and posters, and the screens often show MotoGP and other racing broadcasts. On weekends, local riders and travellers gather here to swap stories and plan joint rides. Staff speak Portuguese and basic English, are always welcoming, and will happily point you to the best twisty roads in the region. A perfect spot to catch your breath after the switchbacks or before heading south.

name: Emblemático & Original
description: Emblemático & Original in Oliveira de Azeméis is an atmospheric bar and meeting spot whose name says it all: bold, distinctive, and full of character. For bikers, it's a perfect inland Portugal pit stop far from the tourist crowds, where you can park your motorcycle right out front on a quiet street. The interior mixes vintage and modern touches, and the menu features craft beer, hearty snacks, and signature drinks. The owners are genuine motorcycle enthusiasts who welcome travellers warmly and are happy to share the best routes in the region. A brilliant spot to pause, soak up the authentic vibe, and refuel between the twisty roads of the Aveiro district.

name: SKULL-The Misfits Safehouse
description: SKULL - The Misfits Safehouse in Viseu is a biker hideout with a rebel soul, where everything from the name to the decor screams freedom and the open road. Park your motorcycle right out front on a quiet street or inside the courtyard, which is reserved for the trusted few. Inside: dim lights, rock on vinyl, cold beer, and hearty snacks, with walls covered in patches, skulls, and trophies from around the globe. The owners are true misfits who know every twist of the region — from the switchbacks of Serra da Estrela to the winding roads of the Dão valley. Staff speak Portuguese and English, always welcome travellers, and can help with both a place to sleep and route tips. A perfect spot to rest after a long haul and feel part of the worldwide biker family.

name: 23 Bar (Bar Sambikers)
description: 23 Bar, also known as Bar Sambikers, in Oliveira do Bairro is the kind of place where motorcycles at the door are as much a part of the scenery as the drink taps. There's enough space out front to park up with a whole group and not worry about your bike while you're inside. They serve cold beer and simple drinks, with the soundtrack of lively talk about roads, routes, and everything that matters to riders. The vibe is laid-back and brotherly: you'll be welcomed like an old friend and quickly pointed to the best seat. A perfect stop to stretch your legs and connect with local bikers while crossing central Portugal.

name: Motoclube do Montijo
description: Motoclube do Montijo is a genuine biker clubhouse in the town of Montijo, on the south bank of the Tagus River, just a short ride from Lisbon. For a motorcycle traveller, it’s a perfect spot to connect with the local riding community, swap stories, and get trusted route tips for the region. Park your bike safely at the club, then step inside for cold drinks and warm company. The vibe is completely laid-back and friendly: local riders and passing travellers mingle here regularly. Stop by if you want to soak up real Portuguese biker spirit, find riding buddies, or simply enjoy a good evening.

name: RW Motorcycles - Rusty Wrench
address: R. de Nossa Sra. da Piedade 126
description: RW Motorcycles, known as Rusty Wrench, is a soulful motorcycle workshop in Loulé, right in the heart of the Algarve. For a traveller, it's a reliable address for diagnostics, engine work, suspension, electrics, and tyre changes. The shop blends experience, honest advice, and a true love for machines: your bike isn't just fixed, it's cared for like their own. You can park your motorcycle nearby and wait comfortably while the mechanic works. Staff speak Portuguese and English, are easy to reach, and are happy to work around your travel schedule. A great stop for repairs before heading to the beaches or up into the Monchique mountains.

name: Motobel
description: Motobel is a motorcycle shop and service centre in Lisbon, conveniently located on Avenida Cidade de Luanda, close to the airport and the main roads out of the city. For a traveller, it's a perfect spot to quickly stock up on oils, consumables, or grab essential gear before a long haul. The workshop can handle oil changes, diagnostics, and minor repairs — just what you need when time on the road is precious. There's enough space to park your motorcycle right out front, and the staff speak Portuguese and English, always happy to help. A great checkpoint to check your bike and gear up before heading south or deeper into the continent.

name: Officina Moto
description: Officina Moto is an independent motorcycle workshop in Lisbon, where machines are looked after with true enthusiast dedication. For a motorcycle traveller, it’s a reliable address if your bike needs attention in the Portuguese capital: they handle diagnostics, consumables, tyre changes, and most common technical issues. Park your bike right at the entrance, and while the work is being done, grab a bite at one of the nearby cafés. The mechanics speak Portuguese and basic English, and they always try to help quickly, knowing that downtime is a rider’s worst enemy. A solid choice for repairs before heading south or before the journey home.

name: Norboxe Concessionário Motorcycles
description: Norboxe is an official motorcycle dealership in Porto, located on busy Rua de Camões, just minutes from the historic centre. For a traveller, it's a complete support point: you can buy a new motorcycle, gear, genuine parts and accessories here, or get scheduled maintenance and urgent repairs at the certified workshop.
