Parking your bike nearby is easy, and while it's being serviced, you can take a stroll through the city. Staff speak Portuguese and English, and are always ready to advise and help with any technical issues. A great option for those wanting to upgrade their ride or get it back in shape before continuing through northern Portugal.

name: Food Bikes and Cars
description: Food Bikes and Cars is a unique restaurant in France, combining a passion for food, motorcycles, and cars. The venue offers a diverse menu featuring burgers, snacks, and American-style dishes. Its interior is designed with a biker and vintage car theme, creating a distinctive atmosphere for enthusiasts. It is a popular spot for social gatherings and casual dining.

name: Route 66
address: 15 RUE GAMAY, Lot. la Clementide, 34980 Saint-Clément-de-Rivière
description: Route 66 is a themed bar and restaurant in Montpellier inspired by the legendary American highway. The venue is decorated in a U.S. road culture style with biker and retro elements. The menu features burgers, snacks, and Tex-Mex dishes. It is a popular spot for social gatherings with a lively and relaxed atmosphere.

name: Rock Beer Temple by. Dr Feelgood
description: Rock Beer Temple by Dr Feelgood is a popular rock bar in Paris, located in a lively part of the city. The venue is known for its wide selection of craft beers and a strong rock music atmosphere. Classic and modern rock hits are frequently played, attracting fans of biker and alternative culture. The bar offers a friendly and informal setting, perfect for social gatherings.

name: Hôtel Beau Site
description: Hôtel Beau Site is a beautiful lakeside retreat near Annecy, perfectly placed for motorcycle travellers exploring the French Alps. From here, riders can access scenic alpine roads, mountain passes and unforgettable routes around Lake Annecy, Col de la Forclaz and the Aravis area. After a day of riding through some of France’s most impressive landscapes, guests can relax in a peaceful atmosphere with views of the lake and surrounding mountains. With convenient parking and a prime location for touring adventures, Hôtel Beau Site is an excellent stop for riders discovering the alpine beauty of France.

name: Hôtel le Panoramic - Gorges du Verdon
description: Hôtel Le Panoramic is an ideal destination for motorcycle travellers exploring the spectacular Verdon Gorge, one of Europe’s most famous riding regions. Located in the heart of Provence, it offers direct access to breathtaking mountain roads, dramatic canyon viewpoints and some of France’s most scenic motorcycle routes. After a day of unforgettable riding, guests can unwind in a peaceful setting and enjoy the natural beauty of the surrounding landscapes. With convenient parking and an unbeatable location for touring adventures, Hôtel Le Panoramic is a perfect stop for riders discovering southern France on two wheels.

name: Route 66 Hotel & Harrys Bar
description: Route 66 Hotel & Harry’s Bar is a motorcycle-themed destination inspired by the spirit of the legendary American highway. Welcoming riders from across Europe, it combines comfortable accommodation with a vibrant biker atmosphere, making it a popular stop for motorcycle travellers. Guests can enjoy secure parking, relax at the iconic Harry’s Bar and meet fellow riders while sharing stories from the road. Whether passing through or staying to explore the surrounding region, Route 66 Hotel & Harry’s Bar offers an unforgettable experience for everyone who loves life on two wheels.

name: Algarve Race Resort
description: Algarve Race Resort is a modern hotel in Portimão, located right next to the famous Algarve International Circuit, which hosts regular bike track days and racing series. For a rider, it's a unique chance to combine a holiday with a track session: park your motorcycle securely at the hotel, then roll onto the grid in the morning. After a hot day on the circuit or carving through the Monchique and Fóia switchbacks, unwind in the spa, pool, and restaurant overlooking the mountains. Rooms are spacious and well-equipped, and the staff are used to riders and their machines. An excellent base for those who want to hit the track and explore the winding roads of the Algarve highlands.

name: WOT New Lisbon Social
description: WOT New Lisbon Social is a modern hostel and guesthouse in the heart of Lisbon, in the colourful Bairro Alto district, and its main selling point for bikers is the private indoor garage. You can lock your motorcycle away from the sun and prying eyes — a priceless feature in the city centre — while you explore the winding streets, bars, and viewpoints. After a day on foot or carving corners, clean rooms (from dorms to private), a cosy patio, and a shared kitchen await. All of Lisbon’s key sights are nearby, and the exit towards Cascais and Sintra is just minutes away. The staff are welcoming, speak English, and are genuinely biker-friendly. An ideal base for a civilized overnight before hitting the road again in the morning.

name: Hostel Gaia Porto
description: Hostel Gaia Porto is located in Vila Nova de Gaia, just across the river from Porto's historic centre, yet away from its narrow, noisy streets. A garage is available for bikers — a rare and valuable feature that lets you lock up your fully loaded motorcycle and head out to explore the riverfront, port wine cellars and viewpoints on foot. Inside, you'll find clean rooms, a lounge with a fireplace, and a garden to unwind in after a day in the saddle. Breakfast is included, and the staff speak English and are welcoming to travellers. We recommend confirming garage space when booking — once that's sorted, it's one of the most convenient and affordable overnights in Porto.

name: Wake Up Famalicão
description: Wake Up Famalicão is a modern and cosy hostel located right on the town's main square, perfectly suited for a transit overnight on the route between Porto and Braga. You can park your motorcycle on the spacious square in front of the building or in a nearby side street — the area is quiet and your bike stays in sight. Inside you'll find clean rooms, comfortable beds, a full kitchen, and a lounge area where it's easy to meet fellow travellers. Restaurants, supermarkets and everything you need for a short break are just steps away. The staff are friendly, speak English, and the atmosphere is totally relaxing after a day in the saddle. An excellent budget-friendly stop to recharge before continuing to explore northern Portugal.

name: B&B HOTEL Famalicão
description: B&B HOTEL Famalicão is a modern chain hotel in northern Portugal, perfectly designed for the "ride in, sleep, ride out" style of travel. For bikers, everything is thought through: a spacious free car park right in front, where you can leave your motorcycle within sight of your room. The rooms are clean, soundproofed, and have excellent beds — exactly what you need to recover after a long day in the saddle. Breakfast is included and served early, so you can fuel up before hitting the road. The hotel is conveniently close to motorways, making it easy to head to Porto, Braga, or further into the continent. A top choice for a transit overnight when comfort and efficiency matter most.

name: Col de l'Iseran
description: Col de l'Iseran is one of the highest paved mountain passes in Europe at 2,770 meters, making it a must-ride destination for any biker. The road winds through breathtaking Alpine scenery with glaciers, sweeping curves, and wide-open views that turn every stop into a highlight. This place is less about speed and more about the feeling of freedom and the sheer scale of the landscape. In summer, the pass becomes a magnet for riders from across Europe, creating a vibrant and friendly atmosphere. It’s easy to meet fellow bikers, share routes, and enjoy the experience together. With its legendary status, fresh mountain air, and incredible roads, it’s a key stop on any motorcycle journey through France.

name: Brasserie Le Daf'
description: Brasserie Le Daf’ is a cozy stop in Aubière, popular among local riders thanks to its easy parking and relaxed vibe. It offers simple, hearty French food and good beer — perfect for a break on the road. In the evening, it turns into a friendly afterwork bar with sharing plates and a social atmosphere. A great place to rest, plan your next ride, and meet locals. Its location makes it a convenient stop when touring central France.

name: Ioannina Castle
description: The Kastro of Ioannina is a living fortress with a thousand years of history, perched on a peninsula in the middle of Lake Pamvotida. Life still buzzes inside its stone walls: narrow cobbled streets, Ottoman mosques, Byzantine towers, and the Ali Pasha Museum recounting Epirus's turbulent past. For a biker crossing the Pindus range, it's a perfect stop: park your motorcycle on the square at the fortress gate and wander the alleys for an hour or a whole evening. Sunset over the lake from the ramparts is one of the most atmospheric sights in northern Greece. Several tavernas and cafés inside the castle serve the famous Ioannina baklava and local frog legs. A must-stop for anyone riding through Epirus who wants to touch living history.

name: Meteora
description: Meteora is a colossal rock formation in central Greece, where ancient Orthodox monasteries perch impossibly atop sheer stone pillars. For a biker, this place is an absolute magnet: twisting roads wrap around the rocks, revealing dizzying views at every turn that demand a stop. Park your motorcycle at the designated viewpoints or at the base of the monasteries, then climb the steps to touch centuries of history and silence. Sunset here is legendary — the rocks ignite in orange, and road noise gives way to absolute stillness. A UNESCO World Heritage Site and a must-ride for any motorcyclist crossing Greece. Best tackled in the saddle early morning or before sunset, before the tour buses flood the switchbacks.

name: Delphi Archaeological Museum
description: The Delphi Archaeological Museum is the main treasury of one of the most significant ancient sanctuaries, nestled right at the foot of Mount Parnassus. Inside are finds excavated over centuries: the famous bronze Charioteer, the Naxian Sphinx, fragments of the Siphnian Treasury frieze, and other masterpieces over 2,500 years old. For a motorcycle traveller, it’s a perfect stop on the classic route through central Greece: park your bike in the spacious lot at the archaeological site entrance and wander the halls at your own pace. After the museum, don’t miss the Sanctuary of Apollo and the stadium further up the slope. A brilliant mix of history, culture, and a break from the saddle before continuing along the winding roads of Phocis and Aetolia.

name: Archaeological Site of Olympia
description: Ancient Olympia is sacred ground where the Olympic Games were born, and where the echo of ancient athletes still lingers among quiet olive groves. For a biker, it’s a must-stop on any western Peloponnese route: park your motorcycle in the secure lot at the entrance and step back into the age of Zeus, Phidias, and the first Olympians. You’ll walk through ruins of temples, the original stadium, and the workshop that once housed the legendary statue of the god. An excellent museum sits right next to the archaeological zone, and the town of Archaia Olympia itself offers dozens of tavernas and cafés. A perfect stop to combine history, good food, and a break between the mountain roads of Arcadia and the Ionian coast.

name: Archaeological site of Mycenae
description: Mycenae is the legendary fortress city sung by Homer, where the Lion Gate has stood for 3,500 years and beehive tombs full of secrets lie hidden underground. For a motorcyclist crossing the Peloponnese, this is a must-stop: park your bike in the spacious lot at the base of the hill and take half an hour to climb to the royal graves and cyclopean walls. The view from the acropolis over the Argolid plain and mountains is pure magic, especially in the morning before the crowds arrive. A museum and several tavernas in the village of Mykines are right nearby. A classic slice of Greek history that fits perfectly into any route between Corinth and Nafplion.

name: Palamidi Fortress
description: Palamidi Fortress is a Venetian citadel proudly crowning a 216-metre hill above Nafplion, with a breathtaking panorama of the Argolic Gulf and the Peloponnese mountains. For a biker, it's an ideal stop: a winding asphalt road snakes up to the top, letting you ride right to the entrance and park your motorcycle there, bypassing the famous 999-step staircase. Inside, explore eight bastions, labyrinthine archways, underground prisons, and the feeling of stepping into a medieval film. The best time to visit is early morning or the hour before sunset, when the light turns the stone to gold and the tourist crowds haven't arrived. Afterwards, descend into the cosy old town, packed with tavernas and fresh seafood. A brilliant addition to any route through the eastern Peloponnese.

name: Fortress Town of Monemvasia
description: Monemvasia is a unique Byzantine fortress-town clinging to a giant rock that rises straight out of the sea off the south-eastern Peloponnese coast. For a motorcyclist, it’s one of the most atmospheric stops in all of Greece: leave your bike in the large, free car park on the mainland, then walk across the narrow causeway and step straight into the Middle Ages. Inside the fortress walls, a labyrinth of cobbled lanes, stone archways, Byzantine churches, and tavernas serving local wine and Malvasia awaits. At the very top of the rock, the upper citadel still stands, offering a breathtaking view over the Aegean and the Laconian shore. A must-do detour for any rider exploring the Peloponnese — here, history, romance, and old-world spirit merge into one.

name: Oxya Viewpoint
description: Oxya Viewpoint is the iconic photo spot above Vikos Gorge, where your gaze plunges hundreds of metres down to the Voidomatis riverbed, with the peaks of Astraka and Gamila rising on the horizon. For a motorcyclist, the ride here is a treat in itself: a narrow asphalt road snakes through junipers and stone, ending in a small parking area that easily fits 5–6 bikes. From the parking to the viewpoint is exactly one minute on foot, so you don’t even need to take off your gear. The view is utterly wild and empty, especially at dawn or before sunset, when the canyon fills with every shade of ochre and green. A perfect checkpoint on a route linking Monodendri, Aristi, and the stone bridges of Zagorochoria.

name: Acrocorinth
description: Acrocorinth is a colossal fortress crowning a 575-metre rock above ancient Corinth, offering what may be the best panorama of the Corinthian Gulf, the Aegean Sea and the Peloponnese mountains. For a biker, it's a perfect escape from the coastal heat up to cooler air and history: a paved switchback road leads straight to the main gates, with ample parking for your motorcycle. Inside, a labyrinth of ruins spanning three millennia awaits — Greek towers, Roman cisterns, Byzantine churches, Frankish walls and Ottoman fortifications. The site is completely free and rarely crowded, so you can wander among the stones and soak up the spirit of the ages at your own pace. A brilliant checkpoint en route from Athens to the mountain passes of Arcadia or to Nafplion.

name: Temple of Poseidon
description: The Temple of Poseidon at Cape Sounion is a marble sentinel over the Aegean Sea, perched on a 60-metre cliff for two and a half thousand years. For a biker, the ride here along the coastal road from Athens is one of the most beautiful routes in Attica: the asphalt hugs the Saronic Gulf, and the final climb to the cape reveals a panorama of sunset and endless sea. Park your motorcycle in the spacious lot at the entrance, then walk to the colonnade where Lord Byron himself once prayed and carved his name into the marble. The best time to visit is an hour before sunset, when the temple is flooded with gold and the crowds have thinned. A must-stop for anyone riding south of Athens or heading back into the city.

name: Navagio Beach Viewpoint
description: The Navagio Beach Viewpoint is that iconic spot on Zakynthos where the turquoise cove with the rusty smuggler's ship lies spread out before you. Getting here by motorcycle is an adventure in itself: the asphalt twists through olive groves and cypress trees, with the final stretch leading to a car park right at the cliff's edge. There's always room for a bike, even in peak season, and the viewpoint is just a few steps from the parking area. The view is stunning at any time of day, but early morning is best, before the tour buses arrive. A must-do for any rider exploring the Ionian Islands.

name: Stelvio Pass
description: Stelvio Pass is a biker legend: 48 hairpins on the southern ramp and endless switchbacks that make every kilometre ridden to get here worth it. The climb from the Bormio side tops out at 2,757 metres and delivers some of the most breathtaking alpine panoramas in Europe — snowy peaks, glaciers, and a road that vanishes into the sky. Park your motorcycle at the summit and catch your breath before the descent; local sausage stalls and souvenir kiosks add to the character. The best time to ride is early morning in June or September, when traffic is light and the asphalt is dry. A bucket-list must-do that tests your machine, your skills, and your soul.

name: Strada della Forra
description: Strada della Forra is a breathtaking road carved into the cliffs above Lake Garda, famously called "the eighth wonder of the world" by Winston Churchill. For a biker, it's pure bliss: the narrow asphalt plunges into stone tunnels, squeezes between the sheer walls of the Brasa Gorge, and bursts out at viewpoints with dizzying lake panoramas. The road connects the lakeside Gardesana with the village of Tremosine, hovering high above the water. It's best ridden uphill on a weekday, before the crowds and bicycles appear, and a stop at the stone balconies is absolutely mandatory. One of those routes that makes the whole trip to Garda worth it — a perfect mix of adrenaline, beauty, and motorcycling joy.

name: Monte Grappa
description: Monte Grappa is a sacred mountain for Italian motorcyclists and a war memorial soaring to 1,775 metres above the Veneto plains. The climb up any of its three slopes is pure riding bliss: smooth asphalt, cascades of hairpins, and panoramas that explode at the summit with views of the Alps and the Adriatic. At the top, park your motorcycle by the enormous ossuary monument and wander among cannons, trenches, and the silence of the First World War. Best tackled on a weekday morning, when the road is free of cars and bicycles and the air still cool. A must-do for any rider travelling through northern Italy — here, history, spirit, and flawless asphalt merge into one.

name: Cafe Twin Royal Enfield Rome
description: Cafe Twin is an official Royal Enfield dealership in Rome, hitting two targets at once: a showroom with motorcycles and parts, right next to a café that serves excellent espresso. For a motorcycle traveller, it's a perfect excuse to stop by: book a test ride on a classic model, or simply enjoy a coffee surrounded by brand-new bikes and biker memorabilia. Spacious parking out front lets you leave your own ride safely, and the English-speaking staff are genuinely welcoming to riders. A great checkpoint in northern Rome to relax, swap route stories, and get a closer look at legendary Indian-built classics.

name: Labyrinth - Pub & Birreria
description: Labyrinth - Pub & Birreria in Pomigliano d'Arco is an atmospheric pub where cold drinks and giant burgers greet a tired rider after a day of carving through Campania's curves. You can park your motorcycle right out front on the spacious lot — it’s in plain sight, so no worries about the bike. Inside, a labyrinth of brick, wood and dim lighting sets the stage for long conversations about roads, routes and future adventures. The menu features an excellent selection of draft beers, hearty snacks, and the star attraction: huge sandwiches loaded with prosciutto and mozzarella. The staff are friendly, speak Italian and English, always welcome bikers, and will happily point you to the best twisty roads towards Vesuvius or the coast. A perfect evening anchor if your route takes you through the Naples area.

name: Off Road Lab
description: Off Road Lab is a welcoming pub in Bacoli, just west of Naples, and a great place to take a break during a motorcycle trip through Campania. Known for its tasty burgers, grilled dishes, and wide selection of beers, it's an ideal stop to recharge before continuing your ride. The relaxed atmosphere, friendly service, and spacious setting make it easy to unwind after a day on the road. Whether you're exploring the coastal roads around the Phlegraean Fields or heading toward the Amalfi Coast, Off Road Lab is a great spot to enjoy good food, cold drinks, and a well-deserved rest.

name: Bar del Sole
description: Bar del Sole is a relaxed café and bar in the heart of Praiano, offering beautiful views of the Amalfi Coast and the iconic Church of San Gennaro. Whether you're stopping for an espresso in the morning, a light lunch, or an aperitivo at sunset, it's an easy place to slow down and enjoy the scenery. The terrace is perfect for taking a break, watching the town come to life, and planning the next stretch of your ride. If you're exploring the Amalfi Coast by motorcycle, Bar del Sole is a scenic stop that's well worth adding to your route.

name: Bikers Bar
description: Bikers Bar is a popular lakeside stop on the shores of Lake Viverone, well known among motorcyclists exploring northern Italy. With plenty of motorcycle parking right in front, it's the perfect place to take a break, enjoy a burger, sandwich, or cold drink, and watch bikes come and go throughout the day. The relaxed atmosphere and beautiful lake views make it an easy place to spend an hour before getting back on the road. Whether you're riding through Piedmont or heading toward the Alps, Bikers Bar is a stop that's definitely worth adding to your route.

name: BIKER'S PUB
description: BIKER'S PUB is a welcoming stop for motorcyclists in the Aosta Valley, surrounded by some of Italy's most spectacular mountain roads. It's a great place to relax with a burger, local specialties, or a cold beer after tackling the nearby Alpine passes. The friendly atmosphere and biker-friendly vibe make it a popular stop for riders exploring the region. Whether you're heading toward Mont Blanc, the Little St. Bernard Pass, or continuing through the Alps, BIKER'S PUB is a perfect place to recharge before the next ride.

name: Bar Torino
description: Bar Torino is a charming seaside café in the historic town of Noli, making it a perfect stop while riding along the Ligurian coast. Whether you're in the mood for an Italian espresso, a fresh pastry, or a refreshing aperitivo, it's an ideal place to take a break and soak up the Mediterranean atmosphere. Located just a short walk from the beach and the old town, it's easy to combine a quick stop with a stroll through one of Liguria's most picturesque villages. If you're following the scenic coastal roads between Genoa and the French Riviera, Bar Torino is well worth adding to your itinerary.

name: Bar Tip TAP
description: Bar Tip TAP is a friendly local bar in Cuneo that's perfect for a quick stop during a ride through the Piedmont region. Whether you're after a fresh espresso, a light snack, or a cold drink, it's a comfortable place to take a break before getting back on the road. The relaxed atmosphere and welcoming service make it an easy choice for riders looking to recharge without leaving their route. Surrounded by scenic roads leading toward the Alps and the French border, Bar Tip TAP is a convenient stop on any motorcycle journey through northwestern Italy.

name: Jack Biker's
description: Jack Biker's is a motorcycle-themed restaurant in Vigevano, offering a relaxed atmosphere that's perfect for riders exploring Lombardy. The menu features hearty burgers, grilled dishes, and classic comfort food, making it an excellent place to recharge after a day on the road. With its biker-inspired style and welcoming vibe, it's a great stop to enjoy a satisfying meal before continuing your journey. Whether you're riding between Milan, Pavia, and the Alps or discovering the scenic backroads of northern Italy, Jack Biker's is a restaurant worth adding to your route.

name: Bar Levey
description: Bar Levey is a cozy café and bar in the mountain town of Sassello, a favorite stop for riders exploring the winding roads of Liguria. It's an ideal place to enjoy an authentic Italian coffee, a light meal, or an aperitivo while taking a break from the ride. The relaxed atmosphere and central location make it easy to unwind before continuing through the scenic hills and forests surrounding the town. Whether you're crossing the Ligurian Apennines or simply enjoying the region's beautiful backroads, Bar Levey is a pleasant stop along the way.

name: Kamurria Bistrò & Cocktail Bar
description: Kamurria Bistrò & Cocktail Bar is a stylish seaside spot in Giardini Naxos, perfect for taking a break while exploring Sicily's eastern coast. Whether you're stopping for lunch, dinner, or a refreshing cocktail, the menu combines Sicilian flavors with a modern twist. Its waterfront location offers beautiful views of the bay, creating the perfect setting to relax after a day on the road. If you're riding between Taormina, Mount Etna, and the Ionian coast, Kamurria is a great place to enjoy good food, drinks, and a memorable seaside atmosphere.

name: Palazzo dei Normanni
description: Palazzo dei Normanni, also known as the Norman Palace, is one of Sicily's most important historical landmarks and the oldest royal residence still in use in Europe. Built by the Norman kings in the 12th century, the palace is famous for its stunning Palatine Chapel, adorned with magnificent Byzantine mosaics. A visit offers a fascinating journey through centuries of Sicilian history, blending Norman, Arab, and Byzantine influences. If you're exploring Palermo by motorcycle, this iconic landmark is well worth a stop before continuing your ride across the island.

name: Cafè on the road
description: Cafè on the Road is a welcoming café in Bari that's well suited for a quick stop during a motorcycle trip through southern Italy. Whether you're starting your day with a strong Italian espresso or taking a break for coffee and a light snack, it's a comfortable place to recharge before hitting the road again. The relaxed atmosphere and friendly service make it an easy stop for riders passing through the city. If your route takes you along the Adriatic coast or deeper into Puglia, Cafè on the Road is a convenient place to pause and enjoy a taste of local hospitality.

name: Officina 921
description: Officina 921 is a biker-themed pub and restaurant in Molise, making it a great stop for riders exploring central and southern Italy. Set inside a converted industrial building, it combines a garage-inspired atmosphere with great burgers, grilled dishes, and an impressive selection of beers. Motorcycle memorabilia, rock-inspired décor, and a relaxed vibe make it a place where every rider will feel at home. Whether you're crossing the Apennines or riding toward the Adriatic coast, Officina 921 is well worth adding to your route.

name: DAFY MOTO
description: DAFY MOTO is a specialized motorcycle store located in Aubière, France. It offers a wide range of gear, accessories, and parts for various motorcycle brands. The shop is popular among bikers looking to prepare for a trip or upgrade their equipment. It is known for its professional service and welcoming atmosphere.

name: Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris
description: Notre-Dame de Paris is one of the most famous Gothic cathedrals in the world, located in the heart of Paris on Île de la Cité. Built between the 12th and 14th centuries, it has become a symbol of French history, architecture, and culture. After the 2019 fire, the cathedral underwent careful restoration and has reopened to visitors. Its magnificent stained glass windows, towers, and sculptures attract millions of tourists each year. The nearby Seine riverbanks offer scenic walking routes, although vehicle access in the area is limited.

name: Logis Hôtel de France
description: Logis Hôtel de France is a welcoming stop for motorcycle travellers exploring the scenic roads of the Jura Mountains and the French–Swiss border. Located in Villers-le-Lac, it offers easy access to winding mountain routes, forests and the spectacular Saut du Doubs, making it a great base for touring riders. After a day on the road, guests can unwind in a comfortable atmosphere, enjoy outstanding regional cuisine and relax in the wellness area. With secure motorcycle parking and an excellent location for discovering the Jura region, Logis Hôtel de France is an ideal destination for unforgettable rides through eastern France.

name: Hôtel Les Templiers
address: 21 Rue de la république, 1 Bd Intérieur N
description: Hôtel Les Templiers is a characterful stop for motorcycle travellers exploring the Mediterranean side of France and the roads leading towards the Pyrenees. Located in the beautiful coastal town of Collioure, it is a great base for riders following scenic routes along the Côte Vermeille, the French–Spanish border and the mountain roads towards Andorra. After a day of riding, guests can enjoy the artistic charm of Collioure, local Catalan-style cuisine and a relaxed seaside atmosphere. With convenient parking nearby and an excellent location for coastal and Pyrenean touring routes, Hôtel Les Templiers is a memorable stop for riders discovering southern France on two wheels.

name: Hôtel les Bartavelles & Spa
address: Le clos des pommiers, 785 route de Gap
description: Hôtel Les Bartavelles is a perfect retreat for motorcycle travellers exploring the legendary roads of the French Alps. Located in the village of Crots, near Lake Serre-Ponçon, it offers easy access to iconic mountain passes such as Col de Vars, Col d'Izoard and Route des Grandes Alpes. After an unforgettable day of riding through breathtaking alpine scenery, guests can relax in the hotel's peaceful park, enjoy regional cuisine or unwind in the spa. With private parking, a garage for motorcycles and an excellent location for alpine touring, Hôtel Les Bartavelles is an outstanding stop for riders discovering

name: Logis Hôtel le Belvédère
description: Hôtel Le Belvédère is a fantastic stop for motorcycle travellers exploring the scenic roads of southwestern France. Perched above the medieval village of Rocamadour, it offers breathtaking panoramic views and easy access to quiet countryside routes through the Lot and Dordogne regions. After a day of riding, guests can relax with regional cuisine, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and take in one of France’s most iconic landscapes. With private parking and an excellent location for touring adventures, Hôtel Le Belvédère is an ideal destination for riders seeking comfort, unforgettable scenery and authentic French charm.

name: Hôtel Les Oliviers
description: Hôtel Les Oliviers is a welcoming retreat for motorcycle travellers exploring the spectacular roads of Provence, the Verdon Gorge and the French Riviera. Ideally located near Draguignan, it offers easy access to scenic mountain routes, charming Provençal villages and the legendary Route Napoléon. After a day of riding, guests can relax in a peaceful garden setting, cool off in the outdoor pool and enjoy the warm hospitality of this family-run hotel. With secure parking and a location well suited for motorcycle groups, Hôtel Les Oliviers is an excellent base for discovering southern France on two wheels.

name: Hôtel Restaurant Le Viscos
description: Hôtel Le Viscos is a charming mountain retreat for motorcycle travellers exploring the legendary roads of the French Pyrenees. Nestled in the picturesque village of Saint-Savin, it provides easy access to iconic mountain passes such as Col du Tourmalet, Col d'Aubisque and Hautacam - some of the most celebrated riding routes in Europe. After an unforgettable day on winding alpine roads, guests can relax in elegant surroundings and enjoy exceptional regional cuisine prepared with local ingredients. With private parking, warm hospitality and an outstanding location for Pyrenean adventures, Hôtel Le Viscos is a perfect destination for riders seeking authentic mountain experiences on two wheels.

name: Moto-Hôtel Col de Bussang
description: Moto-Hôtel Col de Bussang is a motorcycle-focused hotel designed for riders exploring the breathtaking roads of the Vosges Mountains. Located at the foot of the famous Col de Bussang and close to the legendary Route des Crêtes, it offers direct access to some of eastern France’s most enjoyable riding routes. After a day of carving through mountain passes and scenic forests, guests can relax in a welcoming biker-friendly atmosphere and meet fellow motorcycle enthusiasts. With dedicated motorcycle facilities, convenient parking and an unbeatable location for touring adventures, Moto-Hôtel Col de Bussang is an ideal stop for discovering the beauty of the French Vosges on two wheels.

name: Sport Moto
description: Sport Moto is a motorcycle and quad repair shop in Barcelonnette, one of the key towns for motorcycle travel in the French Alps. The workshop works with multiple brands and is well placed for riders crossing Route des Grandes Alpes, Col de la Bonette, Col de Vars and the Ubaye Valley. A useful service point for urgent repairs, maintenance and technical help during alpine motorcycle trips.

name: FK Moto - Garage moto Atelier réparation
address: ZA de Planbois, 100 Imp. des Clos Bat B05
description: FK Moto is a rider-focused motorcycle garage near Thonon-les-Bains, well placed for bikers exploring Lake Geneva, Morzine, Les Gets and the French Alps. The workshop offers real hands-on mechanical support, including maintenance, repairs, diagnostics, tyres, brakes, chains and suspension work. For motorcycle travellers, FK Moto is especially valuable because they can also arrange breakdown pickup in the surrounding area. It is a practical stop for riders who need quick help on the road, pre-ride servicing or emergency repairs during an alpine trip. A reliable garage-style service point for bikers who care more about getting back on the road than visiting a showroom.

name: SM RACING
description: SM Racing is a specialist motorcycle workshop near Aix-les-Bains, ideally located for riders travelling through Savoie, Lake Bourget, Annecy, Chambéry and the surrounding Alpine routes. The garage works with road bikes, supermoto, track and off-road motorcycles, offering maintenance, repairs, diagnostics, tyre changes and chassis preparation. For motorcycle travellers, it is a useful stop for both routine servicing and unexpected technical issues during a mountain trip. Its performance-oriented background makes it especially attractive for riders who want a more enthusiast-driven workshop rather than a standard dealership. A strong service point for bikers exploring the French Alps and looking for proper mechanical support on the road.

name: Rock 'N' Ride
description: Rock’N’Ride is a motorcycle garage in Gap, a strategic stop for riders travelling through the Hautes-Alpes, Route Napoléon, Écrins and the southern Alpine roads. The workshop focuses on motorcycle maintenance, repairs, servicing and restoration, making it a practical place for bikers who need real mechanical help rather than a showroom experience. Its location is especially valuable for motorcycle travellers crossing mountain routes, where a reliable garage can make the difference between continuing the trip and getting stuck. Rock’N’Ride is a good choice for riders looking for hands-on support, technical assistance and a biker-friendly service point in one of France’s most popular riding regions.

name: Renart Garage Motorcycles
description: Renart Garage Motorcycles is a characterful motorcycle workshop near Toulouse, created for riders who value real garage culture, custom work and hands-on mechanical expertise. The garage offers motorcycle maintenance, diagnostics, repairs, tyre changes, chain kits, brake work, restoration and preparation after long periods off the road. For motorcycle travellers heading between Toulouse, the Pyrenees and the south-west of France, it can be a useful stop for both planned servicing and unexpected technical issues. Its custom and enthusiast-driven background gives it a stronger biker identity than a standard dealership. A solid service point for riders looking for practical support, mechanical know-how and a proper motorcycle garage atmosphere.

name: Harley-Davidson Paris Bastille
description: Harley-Davidson Paris Bastille is a flagship-style motorcycle destination in the heart of Paris, combining an official Harley-Davidson dealership, riding gear, parts, accessories and service support. For bikers and motorcycle travellers, it is more than just a shop: it is a recognizable brand stop with a strong rider identity and a natural appeal for the cruiser, touring and custom community. The location can be useful for travellers looking for Harley-Davidson gear, branded accessories, spare parts, service assistance or rental options while visiting Paris. Its connection with the Harley-Davidson lifestyle and rider community makes it a valuable point of interest for bikers who enjoy iconic motorcycle culture. A strong premium partner candidate for riders who want both practical support and a true motorcycle atmosphere in the French capital.

name: Horizon Ride BMW Motorrad Porte d'Asnières
description: Horizon Motos / BMW Motorrad Paris is a premium motorcycle dealership and service point for BMW riders in Paris, especially relevant for touring, adventure and long-distance motorcyclists. The dealership offers BMW Motorrad motorcycles, accessories, rider equipment and brand-focused support, making it a useful stop for travellers who need reliable assistance or high-quality gear while passing through the city. For adventure riders on GS-style bikes, it can be particularly valuable as a trusted place for parts, accessories and technical advice before continuing a European trip. Its strong BMW identity and focus on premium motorcycle travel make it more than a standard shop. A solid partner candidate for riders who value comfort, reliability and long-distance touring culture.

name: Magasin Motoblouz Lille-Seclin
description: Motoblouz Lille-Seclin is one of France’s strongest motorcycle gear and accessories destinations, offering a large selection of rider equipment, helmets, luggage, parts, accessories and travel essentials. For motorcycle travellers, it is a practical stop before or during a trip, especially for replacing damaged gear, upgrading comfort, buying rain protection, communication devices or extra luggage solutions. The store also has a strong rider-oriented feel, with click & collect, a workshop area and facilities designed around real motorcyclists rather than casual shoppers. Its location near Lille makes it useful for riders crossing northern France, Belgium, the UK ferry routes or heading south into Europe. A highly valuable partner candidate for bikers who need trusted products, fast access to equipment and a well-known motorcycle retail brand.

name: Maxxess Valence | MaxxMoto26
description: Maxxess Bourg-lès-Valence is a major motorcycle gear, accessories and equipment store in the Rhône Valley, a strategic riding corridor between northern France, Provence and the Alps. The store is especially valuable for motorcycle travellers looking for helmets, riding gear, luggage, tyres, maintenance products, parts, accessories and practical road essentials. With its large retail space and strong local biker presence, it works not only as a shop but also as a useful stop for riders preparing for longer routes or solving gear-related issues on the road. Its location near Valence makes it convenient for bikers heading toward the Vercors, Ardèche, Provence, Route Napoléon or Alpine passes. A strong partner candidate for riders who need reliable motorcycle products, practical support and a recognized biker-oriented retail point.

name: Hey Joe
description: Hey Joe is a welcoming biker café and bar in Banja Luka, created for good rides, good music and great company. Stop by for a strong coffee, a cold beer or a relaxing drink after a long day on the road. Its warm, laid-back atmosphere makes it easy to meet local riders, share travel stories and plan your next adventure. Tucked away from the busiest streets, it feels like a true home away from home for motorcycle travellers. Park your bike, take a break and enjoy the authentic biker spirit of Banja Luka.

description: Kafe Hej Džo is a relaxed local café in Leskovac, Serbia, offering a friendly stop for riders travelling through the south of the country. With outdoor seating, coffee, beer, drinks and a casual atmosphere, it is a good place to take a break, meet friends or rest between road sections. The café is also associated with live music and weekend gatherings, giving it more character than a simple roadside coffee stop. For motorcycle travellers, it can work well as an easy social waypoint - a place to park, refresh, enjoy local hospitality and continue the ride. A simple but valuable stop for bikers looking for an authentic local café experience in southern Serbia.

The café’s covered terrace is especially useful for bikers who want to rest comfortably even when the weather is not perfect. Its location on Reherweg makes it an easy waypoint for riders passing through Aerzen or connecting nearby scenic roads. A simple, friendly and practical stop for motorcycle travellers looking for local hospitality rather than a generic roadside chain.

The Ketom brand is associated with Thai massage, wellness services and related products, making it more suitable as a rest-and-recovery point than a typical motorcycle stop. Its location in northern Czechia can work well for riders passing through the Ústí nad Labem region, the Elbe valley or routes toward Germany. A quiet complementary stop for bikers who want to recharge, relax and continue the ride feeling better.

name: Complex Panoramic Rânca Transalpina
description: Transalpina Rânca - Complex Panoramic is a mountain accommodation stop in Rânca, directly connected with one of Romania’s most famous riding roads - the Transalpina. Its location makes it highly attractive for motorcycle travellers who want to stay close to the pass, enjoy mountain views and start or finish a scenic riding day without leaving the route. The complex offers comfortable accommodation in a central mountain setting, making it suitable for both short overnight stops and relaxed breaks during a longer Romanian road trip. For bikers, it is especially valuable as a practical base for exploring the Parâng Mountains, Rânca resort area and the dramatic curves of the Transalpina road. A strong stop for riders looking for mountain atmosphere, easy route access and a memorable stay on one of Eastern Europe’s most iconic motorcycle roads.

name: Tequila Drive Biker Motel
description: Tequila Drive Biker Motel is a true motorcycle meeting point in Reuden/Anhalt, Germany, welcoming riders since 1993. Located between Berlin, Leipzig and Magdeburg, it is a practical stop for motorcycle travellers crossing central Germany or exploring the forested roads of the Fläming region. The place combines biker-friendly accommodation, a café, beer garden, grill station, hot and cold drinks, homemade cakes and a strong garage-style riding atmosphere. With six rooms, thirteen beds and a clear focus on motorcyclists, it works well for overnight stays, relaxed breaks, group rides and biker gatherings. A valuable stop for riders looking for more than a bed - a real biker motel with character, community and road-trip spirit.

Its small local workshop character makes it a good choice for riders looking for real mechanical help rather than a showroom experience. A useful service point for bikers who need maintenance, repairs or quick support while riding through eastern Croatia.

For motorcycle travellers, it can work as a peaceful waypoint away from busy tourist routes, suitable for a short rest, scenic photos or a calm pause during a mountain ride. The area is especially interesting for riders exploring Montenegro’s inland roads, ethno villages and highland routes between Žabljak, Šavnik and the Durmitor region. Its remote character gives it a more authentic local feel than standard roadside stops. A simple but atmospheric point for bikers looking for nature, quiet roads and a true mountain-riding experience in Montenegro.

name: Alpensport Speckeller
description: Alpensport Speckeller is a relaxed food and drink stop in Vigo di Fassa, right in the heart of the Dolomites. For motorcycle travellers, it is a convenient place to take a break between mountain roads, enjoy a panino, piadina, bruschetta, coffee or a cold drink before continuing the ride. Its central location makes it useful for riders exploring Val di Fassa, the Dolomite passes and the scenic roads around Trentino. The casual bar atmosphere and simple Italian food make it a practical stop for bikers who want something quick, local and satisfying rather than a formal restaurant. A good waypoint for riders looking to refuel, rest and enjoy the mountain village vibe during a Dolomites trip.

name: Dragaljska Prica
description: Dragaljska Priča is a quiet rural stop in Dragalj, Montenegro, set among the mountain roads and traditional landscapes of the Krivošije area above the Bay of Kotor. For motorcycle travellers, it can work as an atmospheric waypoint away from the busy coastal routes, offering a sense of local character, nature and mountain-road exploration. The location is especially interesting for riders travelling between Risan, Grahovo, Nikšić and the inland roads of western Montenegro. Its remote setting makes it more suitable for bikers looking for an authentic pause, scenic surroundings and a slower local experience rather than a standard tourist stop. A distinctive place for riders who enjoy hidden mountain routes and unusual local points of interest.

name: HOTEL ORJEN sport&pleasure

Hotel ORJEN sport & pleasure is a modern 4-star hotel in Trebinje, set close to the river and within easy reach of the city’s historic centre. The hotel’s sport-and-leisure concept, with fitness facilities, garden space and shared lounge areas, makes it suitable for riders who want to rest properly after long hours on the road. name: Etno selo Čubura - restoran
description: Etno Selo Čubura is a traditional countryside complex in Čubura, Serbia, combining local food, accommodation and a relaxed rural atmosphere. For motorcycle travellers, it can be a comfortable stop away from busy city roads, with private parking, authentic wooden cabins, traditional cuisine and space to rest properly after a long ride. The complex also offers leisure facilities such as an outdoor pool, jacuzzi and sauna, making it suitable not only for a quick meal but also for an overnight recovery stop. Its location near Niš and the roads of southern Serbia makes it useful for riders travelling across the Balkans or exploring less touristy inland routes. A warm and practical biker-friendly stop for riders looking for local hospitality, homemade food and a peaceful place to recharge.

name: Etno selo Čubura - apartmani
description: Etno Selo Čubura Apartments is a traditional countryside accommodation option in Čubura, Serbia, offering riders a peaceful place to rest away from busy urban routes. For motorcycle travellers, it is well suited as an overnight stop, with private parking, rural surroundings and easy access to homemade food and local hospitality within the ethno village complex. The apartments provide a more relaxed and comfortable base than a simple roadside stop, making them useful after long riding days across southern Serbia. Its location can work well for bikers travelling near Niš or exploring inland Balkan routes. A practical biker-friendly accommodation choice for riders looking for quiet surroundings, authentic atmosphere and a proper place to recharge before continuing the journey.

name: The Oldest Grapevine in the World
description: https://najstarejsatrta.si/en/The Oldest Grapevine in the World is a unique cultural and wine landmark in Maribor, Slovenia, located in the historic Lent district by the Drava River. For motorcycle travellers, it is a memorable scenic stop where riders can take a break, explore local heritage and experience one of Slovenia’s most iconic wine stories. The over 400-year-old Žametovka vine is recognized by Guinness World Records as the oldest noble vine in the world still bearing grapes. The site also offers access to local wine culture, with a wine shop and tasting space featuring wines from the Štajerska Slovenia region. A distinctive stop for bikers looking to combine beautiful roads, city atmosphere, history and authentic Slovenian wine tradition.

name: Test Shop
description: testing — E2E Save

name: AutoTestObj
description: cool place for tests

name: Route 66
description: Coffee Bar Route 66 is a casual café-bar in Radoviš, North Macedonia, located on Boulevard Aleksandar Makedonski. For motorcycle travellers, it can work as an easy urban stop for coffee, cold drinks and a relaxed break while passing through the southeast of the country. The Route 66 name gives the place a road-trip feel, making it naturally appealing for riders looking for simple stops with travel-oriented character. Its location in Radoviš is useful for bikers riding between Štip, Strumica, Berovo and wider eastern North Macedonia routes. A practical coffee and social stop for riders who want to rest, refresh and continue the road.

name: Rock & Blues Café Die Twee
description: Rock & Blues Café Die Twee is a lively music bar in Bergen op Zoom, where rock and blues fill the evening and people gather for good sound and a drink in pleasant company. You can park your motorcycle on the quiet street right in front — there's enough space, and your bike stays in sight. Inside, the vibe is easygoing and friendly, with no pretence: cold beer, simple snacks, and a stage hosting both local and visiting musicians. Staff speak Dutch and English, are always welcoming to bikers, and happy to suggest what to see around town. A perfect spot for an evening wind-down after a day riding through the roads of Brabant.

name: American Motorcycle Museum
description: The American Motorcycle Museum in Raalte is a private collection where classic American motorcycles come to life amid steel, chrome, and history. Dozens of restored machines are on display, primarily Harley-Davidson and Indian, spanning nearly a century of US motorcycle culture. For a traveller, it’s a perfect stop to stretch your legs and get inspired before continuing through the eastern Netherlands. There’s ample parking in front, so you can leave your bike safely and take your time with the exhibits. Staff speak Dutch and English, are always welcoming to bikers, and are happy to share the story behind each machine. A great themed checkpoint that anyone who loves soulful machinery in the saddle will appreciate.

name: Klassieke Motoren museum. Adventon. Middelbeers
description: Adventon Klassieke Motorfietsen is a private museum and workshop run by Ad Vennix in the village of Westelbeers, where classic motorcycles aren't just displayed — they live and breathe. The collection features dozens of beautifully restored machines from across Europe, and the owner knows every single one down to the last bolt. For a motorcycle traveller, it's a rare chance to combine inspiration with practicality: park your bike in the spacious lot, soak up some history, and maybe get some solid technical advice along the way. Ad Vennix speaks Dutch, German, and a bit of English, always welcomes bikers, and is happy to open the doors with a quick call ahead. A true hidden gem of Brabant worth the detour.

name: National Moped Museum
description: The National Moped Museum in Waddinxveen is the largest collection in the Netherlands dedicated to light two-wheeled machines, spanning from post-war mopeds to iconic 90s scooters. For a motorcyclist, it's a fascinating dive into history: dozens of restored machines, rare models, parts, and posters capture an entire era of road culture. The museum operates by appointment only, so be sure to contact the owners before your visit — and you'll be welcomed with soul and nostalgia. There is ample parking where you can safely leave your bike. Staff speak Dutch and English. A perfect stop to stretch your legs, smile at familiar shapes from decades past, and continue your ride through South Holland with fresh memories.

name: Motormuseum Friesland
description: Motormuseum Friesland in Raerd is a private museum featuring a collection of historic motorcycles, cars and other classic vehicles. The motorcycle collection includes several notable vintage models, including historic Harley-Davidson and British motorcycles. The museum offers visitors an opportunity to explore classic motorcycle and automotive history in a personal collection setting. Visits are arranged in advance.

name: Tony Leenes Indian Motorcycle Museum
description: Tony Leenes Indian Motorcycle Museum in Lemmer is dedicated to the history of Indian motorcycles and features a collection of more than 40 Indian motorcycles. The museum displays motorcycles and memorabilia related to the historic American brand. The location also includes a motorcycle workshop, shop, campsite and facilities for events, making it suitable for riders travelling through the Netherlands. It is a destination combining motorcycle history with practical facilities for motorcyclists.

name: Wil Hartog Museum
description: The Wil Hartog Museum is dedicated to Dutch motorcycle racer Wil Hartog and his racing career. The collection documents his career in motorcycle racing and includes motorcycles and memorabilia connected with his time on the track. The museum offers motorcycle enthusiasts an opportunity to learn more about one of the Netherlands' notable figures in motorcycle racing.

name: Cafe Calluna
description: Café Calluna is a biker bar and rock ’n’ roll venue in Ommen, Netherlands, welcoming motorcycle enthusiasts and riders. The venue hosts rock, metal and tribute concerts and regularly brings together the local biker community. Camping facilities are available on site, making it possible for riders to stay overnight. It is a destination combining a motorcycle-friendly atmosphere, live music, camping and a bar.

name: Motor Hotel Meddo
description: MotorHotelMeddo is a motorcycle-friendly hotel in Meddo, near Winterswijk in the eastern Netherlands. The hotel is specifically intended as a base for motorcyclists exploring the Achterhoek region and offers accommodation, breakfast and dinner. Motorcycles can be stored in a large garage, while the hotel grounds are fenced and secured at night. The property also has a terrace and a bar with billiards, darts and table football.

name: Motorcamping De Motorschuur
description: De Motorschuur is a motorcycle campsite and group accommodation in Gasselternijveenschemond, in the north of Drenthe. The campsite is specifically designed for motorcyclists and offers a relaxed, informal place to stay after a day of riding. Guests can camp on the grounds or use indoor sleeping facilities, while the site also has a bar, a small kitchen and a stage for events. The location is a convenient base for motorcycle rides through Drenthe, Groningen and the surrounding countryside.

name: Motorcamping 't Witveen
description: Motorcamping ’t Witveen is a motorcycle campsite in Eastermar, Friesland, located about 6 kilometers from Drachten. The campsite was created specifically for motorcyclists and is a convenient base for exploring the northern Netherlands by motorcycle. Guests can stay in their own tent or in a wooden cabin, while the campsite also offers a barbecue area, campfire, small snack facilities and breakfast. Cars are not allowed on the campsite, creating a setting focused on motorcycle travellers.

name: Hotel Restaurant Café Boschzicht
description: Hotel Restaurant Café Boschzicht is a three-star hotel, restaurant and café in Echten, Drenthe. The property offers comfortable accommodation, a restaurant, a bar and a covered rooftop terrace overlooking the surrounding countryside. Motorcycle travellers can use the secured motorcycle and bicycle storage, making it a convenient overnight stop for riders exploring Drenthe. The hotel also serves breakfast and offers lunch and dinner.

name: De Stobbe hotel & suites en Brasserie Vrouwe Swedera
description: De Stobbe Hotel & Suites is a motorcycle-friendly hotel in Ruinen, Drenthe, offering a convenient base for exploring the region by motorcycle. The hotel has a secure, covered and lockable motorcycle storage area and staff can provide recommendations for motorcycle routes in the surrounding countryside. Guests can relax after a ride in the indoor swimming pool or sauna, or enjoy food and drinks at Brasserie Vrouwe Swedera and the hotel café. The hotel also welcomes groups of motorcyclists and offers dedicated motorcycle packages.

name: Supertramp Bar Belgrade
description: Supertramp Bar Belgrade is a motorcycle- and rock ’n’ roll-themed bar in the historic center of Belgrade. The venue combines a biker-garage atmosphere with American and Mexican-inspired food, burgers, beer and other drinks. Motorcycles and classic cars are an important part of the bar’s visual identity and concept, making it a distinctive stop for riders visiting Belgrade. The bar also features rock music, a pool table and indoor and outdoor seating.

name: Restoran Jezero donja Jablanica
description: Restoran Jezero is a popular restaurant in Jablanica, Bosnia and Herzegovina, located in a scenic natural setting near the Jablanica area. The restaurant is known for its traditional Bosnian and European cuisine, with a selection of meat dishes, grilled specialties and other local favorites. Its location makes it a pleasant stop for travelers exploring the surrounding mountains and countryside. The restaurant offers a relaxed atmosphere and views of the nearby natural landscape.

name: Motorhotel La Mouche
description: Motorhotel La Mouche is a motorcycle-focused hotel and campsite in the Vosges Mountains of France. The property offers comfortable rooms, a dormitory and camping facilities, as well as a biker bar, restaurant and covered motorcycle parking. Guests can use the on-site workshop and motorcycle wash area, while several motorcycle routes are available for exploring the surrounding mountains, forests and lakes. The relaxed atmosphere and facilities are designed specifically for motorcycle travellers.

name: MOTO-GARAZ
description: Moto-Garaż Lubraniec is a motorcycle workshop and dealer in Lubraniec, Poland. The business provides motorcycle servicing, repairs and maintenance, as well as motorcycle sales. It also works on custom motorcycle projects, including Café Racer-style builds and modifications. The garage can be a useful stop for riders who need mechanical assistance, servicing or motorcycle-related work while travelling through the region.

name: Excalibur Café
description: Excalibur Café is a legendary hard rock and heavy metal bar in the heart of Amsterdam. The venue is well known for its biker atmosphere, with classic motorcycles, motorcycle memorabilia and medieval-themed décor creating a unique setting. It has long been a popular meeting place for bikers, rock and metal fans, as well as visitors from around the world. Along with a wide selection of drinks, the bar features pool tables and a lively rock soundtrack throughout the day and evening.

name: Motor Saloon Harley-Davidson
description: Motor Saloon Harley-Davidson is an official Harley-Davidson dealership and service center in Amersfoort, Netherlands. The dealership offers new and pre-owned Harley-Davidson motorcycles, professional servicing and repairs, genuine parts, accessories and riding gear. Riders can also take advantage of motorcycle customization, demo rides and rental services. It is one of the leading Harley-Davidson destinations in the Netherlands for sales, maintenance and motorcycle enthusiasts.

name: Mont Saint-Michel
description: Mont-Saint-Michel Abbey is a unique architectural complex located on a rocky island off the coast of Normandy. Founded in the 8th century, it became an important religious and cultural center of France. The island is famous for its dramatic tides, which periodically turn it into a true fortress surrounded by water. Narrow medieval streets leading to the top create a feeling of traveling back in time. The destination is especially appealing for motorcycle travelers thanks to scenic roads and breathtaking views along the way.

name: Bike Shed Moto Co
description: Bike Shed Moto Co. is an iconic London venue that combines a restaurant, bar, and a hub for motorcycle enthusiasts. Visitors can admire custom bikes, connect with like-minded people, and immerse themselves in biker culture. The interior features an industrial, garage-inspired design that creates a unique sense of freedom and adventure. The menu offers a wide range of food and drinks, perfect for both a quick stop and a relaxed evening. It’s a popular meeting point for bikers and motorcycle fans from around the world.

name: Squires Cafe Bar.
description: Squires Cafe Bar is one of the most famous biker cafés in the UK. Founded in 1954, it has become a legendary meeting point for motorcyclists from across the country. The venue regularly hosts bike nights, events, and club gatherings, creating a strong sense of community. It offers food, drinks, and a large outdoor area where visitors can see hundreds of motorcycles. It’s a perfect stop for riders and anyone looking to experience authentic British biker culture.

name: Anchor Restaurang & Pub
description: Anchor Restaurang & Pub is Stockholm's oldest rock pub, serving the city's rock and metal community since 1992. The venue is well known for its live bands, rock karaoke, extensive beer selection and welcoming atmosphere. Over the years, it has become a popular meeting place for rock fans, bikers and motorcycle enthusiasts visiting Stockholm. Whether stopping by for live music, food or drinks, Anchor offers an authentic rock pub experience in the heart of the city.

name: Kafé Bredsjön Widelake Blues & Rock Route 72
description: Kafé Bredsjön – Widelake Blues & Rock Route 72 is a restaurant and live music venue in Järlåsa, Sweden. The venue combines a relaxed dining experience with a strong blues and rock atmosphere, regularly hosting live concerts and music events throughout the season. Guests can enjoy a selection of homemade dishes, grilled specialties, sandwiches and Swedish classics while overlooking the surrounding countryside. Its location along Route 72 has made it a popular stop for road trippers, motorcyclists and music lovers exploring the region.

name: MC Collection
description: MC Collection is one of Europe's leading motorcycle museums, located at the historic Tidö Castle near Västerås, Sweden. The museum showcases an extensive collection of classic and rare motorcycles from different manufacturers and eras, illustrating the development of motorcycle engineering and design. Visitors can explore beautifully restored machines, temporary exhibitions and unique motorcycles with historical significance. It is a must-visit destination for motorcycle enthusiasts and anyone interested in the history of two-wheeled transportation.

name: Husqvarna Museum
description: Husqvarna Museum is a fascinating museum in Huskvarna, Sweden, showcasing more than 300 years of the company's industrial history. The collection includes historic Husqvarna motorcycles alongside bicycles, mopeds, sewing machines, firearms, chainsaws and many other products that shaped the brand's legacy. Visitors can explore beautifully preserved motorcycles and learn how Husqvarna evolved into one of the world's most recognized motorcycle manufacturers. The museum is a must-visit destination for motorcycle enthusiasts and anyone interested in Swedish industrial heritage.

name: Eds MC och Motormuseum
description: Eds MC & Motormuseum is a motorcycle and motor museum in Ed, Sweden, featuring a diverse collection of classic motorcycles, mopeds and other historic motor vehicles. The museum showcases well-preserved machines from different decades, highlighting the evolution of motorcycle design and engineering. Visitors can explore a variety of rare and vintage models while learning about the history of motorized transportation in Sweden. It is a worthwhile stop for motorcycle enthusiasts and anyone interested in classic vehicles.

name: Motala Motor Museum
description: Motala Motor Museum is one of Sweden's most popular transport museums, located in the heart of Motala. The museum features an impressive collection of classic motorcycles, vintage cars and motoring memorabilia, showcasing the history of transportation from the early 20th century to the present day. Visitors can explore themed exhibitions with beautifully restored vehicles, historical artifacts and unique collectibles. It is a great destination for motorcycle enthusiasts, classic vehicle fans and anyone interested in automotive history.

name: MC Museet Gyllene Hjulet Surahammar
description: Motorcykelmuseet Gyllene Hjulet is a motorcycle museum in Surahammar, Sweden, dedicated to the history of Swedish motorcycle production and two-wheeled transportation. The museum features a large collection of historic motorcycles, mopeds and bicycles, including machines connected to the famous Swedish brand Monark. Visitors can discover the development of motorcycle technology and explore beautifully preserved vehicles from different eras. It is an interesting stop for motorcycle enthusiasts and anyone interested in Sweden’s industrial and motoring heritage.

name: The Custom Café
description: The Custom Café is a stylish seaside café in Bexhill-on-Sea, blending a passion for motorcycles with great food. It is a popular stop for bikers and travelers looking to relax by the coast. The interior features custom culture elements and motorcycle-inspired décor, creating a unique atmosphere. The menu includes breakfasts, coffee, and hearty meals, perfect for a road trip break. The café has become a favorite spot for custom bike enthusiasts and relaxed seaside gatherings.

name: Wemoto
address: 7, Grange Road Industrial Estate, Albion Street
description: Wemoto is a well-known motorcycle parts store in Brighton, popular among riders of all levels. It offers a wide range of parts, accessories, and gear for various motorcycle models. The shop is known for its competitive prices and extensive selection of both original and aftermarket components. Experienced staff are always ready to help customers find the right parts and provide useful advice. It’s an essential stop for riders looking to maintain or upgrade their bikes efficiently.

name: Da Renzo
description: Bar and restaurant much appreciated by bikers

name: Moto servis Dzanini
description: Moto Servis Dzanini is a local motorcycle repair workshop in Radoviš, North Macedonia, useful for riders travelling through the eastern part of the country. The service is positioned as a practical garage for motorcycle repairs and general mechanical support, making it more relevant for bikers than a standard auto shop or roadside stop. For motorcycle travellers, it can be a valuable point when riding between Štip, Strumica, Berovo and the wider eastern Macedonian routes, especially if the bike needs attention away from the main tourist areas. Its location on Marshal Tito in Radoviš makes it an accessible local service point during regional rides. A useful workshop candidate for riders who need quick repairs, maintenance or local mechanical help on the road.
