name: Revs Automobilia
description: Cafe with Motorcycles on display, plenty of parking and Petrol station next door

name: U Kohouta
description: U Kohouta is a traditional Czech pub and restaurant in the centre of Hradec Králové, offering local food, beer and a relaxed city atmosphere. For motorcycle travellers, it can work well as a convenient food stop while exploring eastern Bohemia or passing through the Hradec Králové region. The restaurant’s central location makes it useful for riders who want to take a proper break, enjoy Czech cuisine and experience a classic local hostinec rather than a generic roadside place. Its own Kohout unfiltered beer and traditional pub character give the stop a stronger local identity. A good urban waypoint for bikers looking for food, drinks and authentic Czech hospitality during a ride through northern Czechia.

name: Route 59 Cafe
description: Route 59 Cafe is a popular biker café located along the scenic A59 road near Skipton. It’s a favorite stop for motorcyclists exploring the Yorkshire countryside. The café is known for its friendly atmosphere and regular gatherings of riders. It serves hot meals, drinks, and classic snacks, perfect for a break on the road. Surrounded by beautiful landscapes, it’s an ideal place to relax and connect with fellow bikers.

name: Caten Pub
description: Caten Pub is a popular pub in Castelfranco Veneto, Italy. It is known for its friendly atmosphere, delicious burgers, club sandwiches, pulled pork, and a wide selection of beers. The pub is a great place to spend time with friends and family, thanks to its welcoming staff and comfortable environment. It also has a billiards room and screens for watching sports events. If you are looking for good food, quality drinks, and a relaxing evening, Caten Pub is an excellent choice.

name: Bolton Abbey
description: Bolton Abbey is one of Yorkshire’s most picturesque historic sites, set in the beautiful valley of the River Wharfe. It features the ruins of a 12th-century Augustinian priory surrounded by green meadows, woodlands, and rolling hills. The famous stepping stones across the river have become an iconic highlight of the area. Visitors can enjoy scenic walks, picnics, and stunning countryside views while experiencing a sense of English history. Bolton Abbey is a perfect destination for a peaceful outdoor escape and cultural exploration.

name: Hermanus Bruges
description: friendly service, nice pleasant terrace, biker interior and tasty simple food

name: Pension Garni Bihac
description: Lovey people who started 10 days ago with a great place to stay. With a parking garage (there is a fee for parking in the garage). Free parking on private property also available. The place is few minutes away from the city centre with a lot of cafes and restaurants in the area.

name: Camping le moulin
description: Camping/ bar/restaurant

name: Marmion Tower
description: Marmion Tower is a well-preserved 14th-century medieval tower. It is a rare example of a fortified manor house built to protect local nobility. Оverlooking the River Ure and surrounded by scenic countryside, the tower offers a strong sense of England’s medieval past. Inside, visitors can explore narrow staircases, stone walls, and historic interiors that reflect life in that era. Marmion Tower is a great destination for history enthusiasts and those seeking lesser-known yet atmospheric landmarks in England.

name: Stonehenge
description: Stonehenge is one of the world’s most famous and mysterious prehistoric monuments, located on Salisbury Plain. This ancient stone circle was built over 4,000 years ago and continues to raise questions about its purpose. It is believed to have served as an astronomical calendar, a religious site, or a place for ceremonial rituals. Stonehenge is especially striking during sunrise on the solstices, when the sun aligns with the stones. A UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is one of the most visited and iconic landmarks in the United Kingdom.

name: Rigg Viewpoint
description: Rigg Viewpoint is a stunning lookout point on the Isle of Skye, offering breathtaking views over the Atlantic Ocean and rugged coastline. It is a place where visitors can truly experience the wild and dramatic nature of Scotland. From the viewpoint, you can see steep cliffs, crashing waves, and an endless horizon. The spot is especially popular with photographers thanks to its dramatic scenery and beautiful sunsets. Rigg Viewpoint is a perfect stop for travelers exploring Skye and looking for unforgettable natural views.

name: Glen Garry Viewpoint West
description: Glen Garry Viewpoint West is one of the most scenic viewpoints in the Scottish Highlands, located along the A87 road. It offers the famous view over Loch Garry, whose shape is said to resemble a map of Scotland. Surrounded by mountains, dense forests, and calm waters, the landscape is truly breathtaking. It is a popular stop for travelers to take photos and enjoy a peaceful break while exploring the Highlands. Glen Garry Viewpoint West is a must-visit spot for anyone wanting to experience the classic beauty of Scotland.

name: Loomies Moto Café
description: Loomies Moto Café is a classic biker café in West Meon, Hampshire, known as a rider-focused meeting point on some of southern England’s best motorcycle roads. Run by bikers for bikers, it offers a relaxed place to stop for coffee, food and conversation before or after a ride through Hampshire, the South Downs and the A32/A272 routes. For motorcycle travellers, it is especially valuable as a genuine community stop rather than a generic roadside café. The atmosphere, rider traffic and motorcycle-friendly identity make it a natural waypoint for solo riders, groups and weekend ride-outs. A strong biker-friendly stop for riders looking for food, local road culture and a proper motorcycle café experience in the UK.

name: The Vennel Viewpoint Edinburgh Castle
description: The Vennel Viewpoint is one of Edinburgh’s most photogenic spots, offering a stunning view of the iconic Edinburgh Castle. Located along a narrow historic path with steps leading upward, it frames the castle perfectly. This viewpoint is especially popular with photographers for its classic postcard-like composition. The combination of old stone walls, traditional architecture, and the dramatic castle backdrop creates a unique atmosphere. The Vennel Viewpoint is a must-visit for anyone looking to capture one of the best views in Edinburgh.

name: Edinburgh Castle
description: Edinburgh Castle is Scotland’s most iconic historic landmark, perched atop an extinct volcanic rock in the heart of the city. With over a thousand years of history, it has served as a royal residence and a powerful military stronghold. Inside, visitors can explore the Scottish Crown Jewels, the Great Hall, and St Margaret’s Chapel — the oldest building in Edinburgh. The castle offers stunning panoramic views over the city and beyond. Today, it stands as one of the UK’s most visited attractions and a powerful symbol of Scotland’s heritage.

name: Bernish Viewpoint
description: Bernish Viewpoint is a great stop for travelers seeking tranquility and an authentic Irish atmosphere.

name: Krazy Horse Empire House
address: Business Park, 3 Lamdin Rd, Lark Valley Dr
description: Krazy Horse Empire House is a standout motorcycle destination in Bury St Edmunds, combining dealership, custom culture, service support, parts, clothing and a strong rider lifestyle atmosphere. For motorcycle travellers, it is more than a place to buy a bike — it is a useful stop for servicing, accessories, gear, technical advice and inspiration during a UK road trip. The venue is especially attractive for riders interested in custom motorcycles, Indian Motorcycle, premium machines and distinctive biker culture. With its showroom, workshop and rider-focused identity, Krazy Horse feels like a proper motorcycle hub rather than a standard dealership. A strong partner candidate for bikers looking for practical support, quality products and a memorable motorcycle experience in Suffolk.

name: Rusty Gold Motor Shop
description: Rusty Gold Motor Shop is a motorcycle lifestyle store in the Netherlands specializing in vintage and classic motorcycle culture. The shop offers a carefully selected range of motorcycle clothing, accessories, parts and lifestyle products with a strong focus on retro and custom-bike aesthetics. Its collection reflects the spirit of old-school motorcycling and is aimed at riders who appreciate classic machines and authentic motorcycle style. It is a great stop for motorcyclists looking for distinctive gear, parts or inspiration for their next build.

name: Chronos Motorcycle Garage
description: Chronos Motorcycle Garage is a specialized motorcycle workshop in the Netherlands dedicated to servicing and maintaining motorcycles. The garage provides professional mechanical work for riders who need their bikes checked, repaired or prepared for the road. Its focus on motorcycles makes it a practical stop for travelers looking for reliable technical assistance during a trip. The workshop is a good addition to a motorcycle travel guide for riders passing through the Netherlands. Open only with appointment.

name: Moto Dick
description: Moto Dick is a motorcycle specialist in Amsterdam offering professional maintenance and repair services for motorcycles. The workshop provides technical assistance for riders who need their motorcycles serviced, repaired or prepared for the road. Its location in Amsterdam makes it a practical stop for motorcyclists travelling through the Netherlands. It is a useful destination for riders looking for motorcycle expertise and workshop support during their journey.

name: FortaMoto
description: FortaMoto is a motorcycle shop in the Netherlands offering a range of products and equipment for motorcyclists. The shop is focused on motorcycle-related gear and accessories, making it a useful stop for riders looking to equip or prepare their bikes for a journey. Its selection is aimed at motorcycle enthusiasts and everyday riders as well as those travelling by motorcycle. FortaMoto is a practical destination for motorcyclists looking for equipment and accessories in the Netherlands.

name: Biker Outfit
description: Biker Outfit is a motorcycle clothing and equipment store in the Netherlands specializing in gear for riders. The shop offers motorcycle clothing, protective equipment and accessories designed for everyday riding and longer motorcycle trips. It is a practical stop for motorcyclists looking to replace or upgrade their riding gear while travelling through the Netherlands. The store is particularly useful for riders who want to find dedicated motorcycle equipment rather than general outdoor clothing.

name: Museum ’t Kromhout
description: Museum ’t Kromhout is a historic shipyard and industrial heritage museum in the heart of Amsterdam. Located on one of the city's last surviving historic shipyards, the museum preserves the story of Amsterdam's shipbuilding industry and the famous Kromhout engine factory. Visitors can see a collection of historic steam and diesel engines, many of which are still operational and demonstrated during special opening days. The authentic shipyard setting and working machinery make it an unusual stop for travelers interested in engineering, industrial history and historic motor technology.

name: Enniskillen Castle
description: Enniskillen Castle is a historic 16th-century fortress located in the town of Enniskillen. Originally built as a defensive stronghold, it played a significant role in the history of Northern Ireland. Today, the castle houses museums dedicated to military history and local heritage. Visitors can explore its towers, courtyards, and exhibitions that bring the past to life.

name: Stockholms MC-Varuhus
description: Stockholms MC-Varuhus is a motorcycle shop in Stockholm offering motorcycles, riding gear, parts and accessories for riders. The store has a broad selection of motorcycle equipment and products for both everyday riding and longer trips. It is a useful stop for motorcyclists travelling through Stockholm who need new gear, accessories or motorcycle-related products. With its dedicated focus on motorcycles, the shop is a practical addition to a motorcycle travel guide.

name: Lelles MC Center AB
description: Lelles MC Center AB is a well-established motorcycle shop in Uppsala, Sweden, serving riders with a wide range of motorcycle equipment and accessories. The store offers riding gear, motorcycle clothing, spare parts and other products for motorcyclists. With its broad selection and long-standing presence in the Swedish motorcycle scene, it is a useful stop for riders preparing for a trip or looking for replacement equipment. Lelles MC Center is a practical destination for motorcycle travellers passing through the Uppsala area.

name: Enniskillen Motorcycles
description: Enniskillen Motorcycles is a dedicated motorcycle shop and service center located in the town of Enniskillen. It offers a wide range of motorcycles, parts, accessories, and riding gear for all levels of riders. The shop is known for its quality service and professional approach to repairs and maintenance. It’s a convenient stop for travelers who need to prepare or service their bikes during a journey.

name: Bike & Repair
description: Bike & Repair Stockholm AB is a motorcycle workshop in Stockholm providing maintenance and repair services for motorcycles. The workshop is focused on keeping motorcycles in good technical condition, from routine servicing to repairs and troubleshooting. It can be a useful stop for riders who need professional mechanical assistance while travelling through the Stockholm area. Its motorcycle-focused services make it a practical addition to a motorcycle travel guide.

name: Stockholms MC servicecenter AB
description: Stockholms MC Servicecenter AB is a motorcycle workshop in Stockholm specializing in motorcycle maintenance and repairs. The service center provides technical support for riders who need their motorcycles inspected, serviced or repaired. Its motorcycle-focused expertise makes it a useful stop for travellers who encounter technical problems or need routine maintenance during a journey. It is a practical destination for motorcyclists looking for professional workshop services in Stockholm.

name: Bromley Motorcycle Services
description: Bromley Motorcycle Services is a dedicated motorcycle workshop and shop located in the Bromley area of South London. It is well known among local riders for its reliable service, professional approach, and extensive experience working with motorcycles and scooters of various brands. The business offers a full range of services, including maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs, as well as sales of motorcycles, parts, and riding gear. Its convenient location makes it a great stop for travelers exploring London and the surrounding areas on two wheels.

name: Motor Riders Ltd.
description: Motor Riders Ltd. is a motorcycle workshop and service center located in London, catering to riders of all experience levels. It is appreciated for its customer-focused approach, professional service, and reliable work on motorcycles of various brands. The shop offers a wide range of services, including diagnostics, maintenance, and repairs, as well as assistance with sourcing parts and accessories. Its convenient city location makes it suitable for both local riders and travelers who may need quick and dependable service on the road.

name: Handelsboden Leather & Motorcycle Clothing Stockholm
description: Handelsboden Leather & Motorcycle Clothing Stockholm is a specialized motorcycle clothing and equipment store in Kungens Kurva, just outside Stockholm. The shop offers a wide selection of motorcycle clothing, protective gear and accessories from well-known motorcycle brands. It is particularly useful for riders looking for riding gear, replacement equipment or something new for a long-distance trip. With its strong focus on motorcycle apparel and equipment, it is a practical stop for motorcyclists travelling through the Stockholm area.

name: Honda MC Center / Ahlqvist MC
description: Ahlqvist MC is a long-established motorcycle dealer and authorized workshop in Västra Frölunda, Gothenburg. The company has been selling motorcycles since 1945 and operates one of Sweden's largest Honda motorcycle centers, with a full range of Honda motorcycles, parts and accessories. Its workshop provides maintenance and repairs for Honda motorcycles as well as several other brands, from routine servicing to more advanced mechanical work. It is a useful stop for motorcycle travellers who need professional service or technical assistance while passing through the Gothenburg area.

name: BikeZone
description: BikeZone is a motorcycle dealership and workshop in Malmö offering a wide range of services for riders. Its workshop provides motorcycle servicing and repairs, as well as wheel service, customization, painting and motorcycle storage. The company works with different motorcycle models and can assist riders with both routine maintenance and more extensive work. It is a useful stop for motorcycle travellers who need technical assistance while passing through southern Sweden.

name: Triumph Stockholm Norr
description: Triumph Stockholm Norr is an official Triumph motorcycle dealership serving riders in the Stockholm area. The dealership offers new Triumph motorcycles, genuine parts, accessories and riding equipment, with an authorized workshop providing maintenance and repairs. It is a useful stop for Triumph owners as well as other motorcyclists looking for professional motorcycle services and equipment. Its location in Upplands Väsby makes it convenient for riders travelling north of Stockholm.

name: Johans Mc-Service
description: Johans MC-Service is a long-established motorcycle dealership and workshop in Hisings Kärra, near Gothenburg. The company has more than 40 years of experience and is an authorized dealer for several motorcycle brands, including Triumph, Kawasaki, Suzuki, Aprilia, Moto Guzzi and Sherco. Its facilities include a motorcycle workshop, a large showroom and a wide selection of parts, accessories and riding equipment. It is a useful stop for motorcycle travellers who need servicing, repairs, spare parts or equipment while travelling through the Gothenburg area.

name: Magicmotorexperience
description: MagicMotorExperience is a motorcycle adventure company based on Bolmsö in southern Sweden, specializing in guided motorcycle tours across Scandinavia. The company provides motorcycle rentals as part of its tours, including Yamaha and other adventure bikes, with options ranging from one-day off-road rides to multi-day Scandinavian adventures. Their tours combine scenic roads, gravel tracks, local food and carefully selected accommodation, making the experience especially appealing to travelling riders. It is an excellent option for motorcyclists who want to explore Sweden or Scandinavia without bringing their own motorcycle.

name: Nordic MC Rental AB
description: Nordic MC Rental AB, operating as Hyr1Hoj, is a motorcycle rental company based in Vallentuna, north of Stockholm. The company specializes in adventure motorcycles, offering models such as the CF Moto 450 MT and Yamaha Ténéré 700 for riders who want to explore Sweden on two wheels. Motorcycles can be rented for day trips, weekends or longer journeys, with luggage options available for touring. It is a convenient choice for travellers looking to experience Swedish roads and countryside without bringing their own motorcycle.

name: Finnish Motorcycle Museum (Suomen Moottoripyörämuseo)
description: Finnish Motorcycle Museum in Lahti is Finland’s only museum dedicated specifically to motorcycles. Its collection features more than 100 motorcycles from different eras, including rare and historically significant machines from Finland and around the world. The museum also hosts changing exhibitions and motorcycle-related events, making it more than just a traditional vehicle collection. It is a must-visit destination for motorcycle enthusiasts travelling through southern Finland.

name: Mobile Motorcycle Service
address: Tudor Gates, 1, Highfield Ave, Kingsbury Green
description: Mobile Motorcycle Service is a mobile repair and maintenance service based in London, offering a convenient alternative to traditional workshops. Its key advantage is that mechanics travel directly to the customer- whether at home, work, or even roadside. The service covers a wide range of tasks, including diagnostics, routine maintenance, minor and mid-level repairs, replacement of consumables, and emergency assistance. It is particularly useful for riders who cannot easily transport their bike or prefer saving time.

name: Bike Repair Centre
description: Bike Repair Centre is a dedicated motorcycle service workshop located in Muir of Ord, Scotland, close to the famous North Coast 500 route. The workshop offers a wide range of services, including maintenance, diagnostics, repairs, and preparation of motorcycles for long-distance journeys. It also stocks parts, tyres, and riding gear such as helmets and clothing. Known for its experience and practical approach, Bike Repair Centre is especially valued by touring riders who may need quick and reliable assistance on the road. It is a dependable stop for anyone traveling through northern Scotland.

name: Lyle Hill Viewpoint
description: Lyle Hill Viewpoint is one of the most scenic viewpoints in the town of Greenock on Scotland’s west coast. From the top of the hill, visitors can enjoy sweeping panoramic views over the Firth of Clyde, surrounding hills, and open waters, often dotted with passing ships.

name: Harleys Ayr
description: Harleys Ayr is a popular biker bar located in the town of Ayr on Scotland’s west coast. The venue is known for its friendly atmosphere, live music, and strong connection to motorcycle culture. It attracts riders, locals, and travelers looking for a relaxed place to unwind and socialize.The bar features classic biker-style décor, including motorcycle-themed elements and Harley-Davidson influences, creating an authentic road-inspired vibe. Live performances and themed events are often held here, making it a lively spot after a day of riding.

name: The Penny Gill
description: The Penny Gill is a traditional British pub located in the town of Spennymoor. It offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere typical of classic English pubs, combining simplicity, comfort, and friendliness.Visitors can relax with a drink, enjoy traditional pub food, and mingle with locals. The pub often serves as a social hub for the community, attracting both regulars and travelers looking to experience authentic British culture.

name: Superbike Rental
address: Stondon Hall Farm, Ongar Rd, Stondon Massey, Hook End, M7RG+P9
description: Superbike Rental is a motorcycle rental company based in Essex, offering a range of modern, high-performance bikes for riding across the UK. It’s an ideal option for those who want to experience superbikes without owning one. Their fleet includes a variety of models, from comfortable road bikes to powerful sport machines. The service caters to both experienced riders and travelers looking to explore England on two wheels.

name: Go Green Motorcycles
description: Go Green Motorcycles is a modern London-based company specializing in electric motorcycle and scooter rental and sales. It’s an ideal choice for those who want to explore the city in a quiet, eco-friendly, and emission-free way. The company offers a wide range of electric vehicles suitable for daily commuting as well as short urban trips. With easy handling and accessibility, these bikes are perfect for both beginners and experienced riders.

name: Melrose Abbey
description: Melrose Abbey is one of Scotland’s most famous medieval abbeys, founded in 1136 by King David I. It was the first Cistercian monastery in the country and an important religious center for centuries.The abbey suffered heavy damage during the Anglo-Scottish wars, yet even in ruins it remains one of the finest examples of Gothic architecture in the UK.

name: Racer Cafe
description: Racer Cafe is a relaxed roadside café in Barcaldine near Oban, Scotland, well placed for riders exploring the west coast, Loch Creran, Glencoe and the scenic roads of Argyll. For motorcycle travellers, it works as a practical food and coffee stop between coastal and Highland routes, offering a friendly place to rest before continuing the ride. The café has a casual road-trip feel, with outdoor seating and a welcoming atmosphere for travellers passing through the area. Its location makes it especially useful for bikers riding the Oban–Glencoe loop or heading toward the Highlands and islands. A good stop for riders looking for coffee, breakfast, simple food and a proper pause on Scotland’s west coast.

name: BikespeedUK
description: BikespeedUK is a motorcycle dealership and workshop in Livingston, West Lothian, offering new and used bikes, parts, accessories, clothing and practical service support. For motorcycle travellers in Scotland, it can be a useful stop for servicing, MOT needs, tyre fitting, repairs, gear upgrades or finding parts before continuing a longer ride. The shop works with a range of modern motorcycle brands, including electric and lightweight commuter/adventure options, making it relevant for different types of riders. Its location between Edinburgh and Glasgow gives it strong practical value for bikers crossing central Scotland or starting a trip toward the Highlands. A solid motorcycle shop and service point for riders who need bikes, gear, parts or workshop help on the road.

name: Mollie's Motel, Oxfordshire
description: Mollie’s Motel Oxfordshire is a modern roadside motel and diner on the A420 near Faringdon, well placed for riders travelling between Oxford, Swindon, the Cotswolds and wider southern England. For motorcycle travellers, it offers a practical overnight stop with free on-site parking, comfortable rooms, a diner and bar, and easy road access without needing to ride into a busy city centre. The American motel-diner concept gives it a road-trip feel, making it more memorable than a standard chain hotel. Its location is especially useful for bikers looking for a clean, convenient and relaxed base before continuing toward Oxfordshire, the Cotswolds or Wales. A strong accommodation and food stop for riders who want comfort, parking and a proper roadside travel atmosphere.

name: The Altnacealgach Motel
description: The Altnacealgach Motel is a remote Highland motel and inn near Ledmore Junction, perfectly placed for riders exploring the NC500, Lochinver, Ullapool and the wild roads of Scotland’s west coast. For motorcycle travellers, it offers exactly the kind of practical stop that matters on a long ride: accommodation, food, drinks and a quiet base in one of the UK’s most scenic riding areas. Its location on the A837 makes it especially valuable for bikers crossing the Highlands, with dramatic landscapes, single-track roads and coastal routes nearby. The place has a classic road-trip feel, more like a true traveller’s inn than a standard hotel. A strong biker-friendly stop for riders looking for rest, local atmosphere and easy access to some of Scotland’s best motorcycle roads.

name: Ace Cafe Lahti
description: Ace Cafe Lahti is a motorcycle-themed café and meeting place located next to the Finnish Motorcycle Museum in Lahti. The venue hosts motorcycle cruises, bike-related events, live music and gatherings for riders throughout the season. Its atmosphere combines the classic Ace Cafe rock'n'roll spirit with Finnish motorcycle culture, making it a natural meeting point for local and visiting motorcyclists. It is an excellent stop for riders looking for food, drinks, music and a genuine motorcycle atmosphere.

name: Bike World – Vantaa
description: Bike World Vantaa is a major motorcycle dealership and equipment store in Vantaa, Finland. The shop offers motorcycles from brands such as Honda, Indian and Zero, along with riding gear, accessories and motorcycle parts. It also provides maintenance and repair services, making it a useful stop for riders who need technical assistance or equipment during a journey. Its extensive motorcycle selection and comprehensive services make it a practical destination for motorcycle travellers around Helsinki.

name: Tuusmotor Oy
description: Tuusmotor Oy is a motorcycle dealership and service centre in Tuusula, Finland, serving local riders and motorcycle travellers in the Helsinki region. The company provides motorcycles, parts, accessories and riding equipment, along with workshop services and maintenance. Its combination of sales and technical support makes it a practical stop for riders who need equipment or assistance with their motorcycle. Tuusmotor is a useful destination for motorcyclists travelling through southern Finland.

name: PJP-Huolto
description: PJP-Huolto is a motorcycle service and repair workshop in Finland specializing in the maintenance of motorcycles. The workshop provides technical assistance for riders who need servicing, repairs or other mechanical work on their bikes. It can be a useful stop for motorcycle travellers who need professional help while riding through southern Finland. For riders on a long journey, a dedicated motorcycle workshop like PJP-Huolto can be especially valuable when unexpected technical problems arise.

name: Biketeam Vanda
description: Biketeam Vantaa is a full-service motorcycle centre in Vantaa, Finland, offering motorcycles, riding gear, accessories, spare parts and professional workshop services. The dealership represents several major motorcycle brands, including BMW, Triumph and Kawasaki, and also carries a wide selection of used motorcycles and scooters. Its service department provides maintenance and repairs, making the location useful not only for shopping but also for riders who need technical assistance on the road. With its comprehensive range of motorcycle services under one roof, Biketeam Vantaa is a particularly practical stop for motorcycle travellers around Helsinki.

name: Lång & Aronen Racing Oy
description: Lång & Aronen Racing Oy is a motorcycle workshop in Finland specializing in motorcycle maintenance, repairs and technical work. The company has a strong connection to motorcycle racing and performance-oriented motorcycle culture. Its expertise makes it a useful stop for riders who need professional mechanical assistance or technical work on their bikes. It is a practical addition to a motorcycle travel guide for riders travelling through Finland.

name: Hot Bike
description: Hot Bike is a motorcycle workshop in Helsinki, Finland, providing maintenance and repair services for motorcycles. The workshop offers technical assistance for riders who need their bikes serviced, repaired or checked before continuing their journey. Its location in Helsinki makes it a convenient option for motorcyclists travelling through the Finnish capital. It is a practical stop for riders looking for professional motorcycle service and technical support.

name: Artmotor
description: Artmotor is a motorcycle workshop in Lapinjärvi, Finland, providing maintenance and repair services for motorcycles. The workshop is a practical option for riders who need technical assistance, servicing or repairs while travelling through southern Finland. Its location outside the larger cities can make it particularly useful for motorcyclists travelling between different parts of the country. It is a suitable stop for riders looking for professional motorcycle workshop services along their route.

name: Mopo Sport
description: Mopo Sport is a motorcycle and motorsport shop in Vantaa, Finland, offering a wide range of parts, accessories and equipment for riders. The store caters to motorcycle and powersports enthusiasts and carries products for maintaining, equipping and customizing bikes. It can be a useful stop for travellers who need spare parts, riding equipment or other motorcycle-related supplies during a trip. Its location in the Helsinki metropolitan area makes it convenient for riders travelling through southern Finland.

name: Bikercamp Oijärvi
description: Bikercamp Oijärvi is a motorcycle-friendly camping and accommodation destination in northern Finland, surrounded by forests and wilderness. The camp is designed with travelling motorcyclists in mind and offers a place to stay while exploring the remote roads and natural landscapes of the region. Its location makes it particularly suitable for riders looking for a peaceful stop away from busy towns and main tourist centres. It is a good choice for motorcyclists who enjoy outdoor travel, scenic routes and a more adventurous style of accommodation.

name: Motorcamping The Big Oaks
description: Motorcamping The Big Oaks is a motorcycle-friendly campsite in Ruinerwold, in the northern Netherlands. The campsite is specifically aimed at motorcyclists and provides a convenient base for riders exploring the Dutch countryside and nearby motorcycle routes. Its location makes it a good stop for travellers looking for a relaxed place to stay while touring the Netherlands by motorcycle. The campsite is also included among motorcycle destinations promoted by the Dutch motorcycling community, making it a worthwhile addition to a motorcycle travel guide.

name: Heimser Hof
description: Heimser Hof is a relaxed countryside café and German food stop in Petershagen-Heimsen, set close to the Weser River. For motorcycle travellers, it can work well as a peaceful break during rides through North Rhine-Westphalia, Lower Saxony and the Weser region. The place offers a simple local experience with homemade grilled dishes, freshly baked cakes and a calm riverside atmosphere away from busy city traffic. Its location makes it suitable for riders looking to pause, refuel and enjoy a slower rural stop during a touring day. A pleasant waypoint for bikers who want local food, quiet surroundings and an easy break near the Weser.

name: Makedonac Burger Bar
description: Makedonac Burger Bar is a casual fast-food and burger spot in Belgrade’s Savski Venac district, located on Sarajevska Street. For motorcycle travellers, it can work as a quick and easy urban food stop while passing through the Serbian capital or taking a break from city traffic. The place is focused on burgers and fast meals, making it useful for riders who want something simple, filling and convenient rather than a long restaurant stop. Its central Belgrade location makes it easy to include during a city visit, fuel stop or short pause between routes. A practical food waypoint for bikers looking for a relaxed bite before continuing the ride.

name: Restaurante Museo Moto Moto Tapas
description: Restaurante Museo Moto Moto Tapas is a unique dining spot in Cullera that blends Spanish cuisine with motorcycle culture. Designed like a small museum, the restaurant features vintage bikes, mechanical parts, and biker-themed décor, creating a distinctive and immersive atmosphere. The menu focuses on classic Spanish tapas with a modern twist, offering a variety of small plates, meats, seafood, and regional wines. It’s especially popular among motorcyclists and travelers looking for something out of the ordinary.

name: Overdrive Rock Cafe
description: Overdrive Rock Cafe is a vibrant rock-themed venue on the Spanish coast, blending music, food, and biker culture. Styled like a classic rock bar, the interior features guitars, iconic band posters, and motorcycle-inspired décor, creating a lively and edgy atmosphere.

name: Motor & nostalgimuseet
description: Motor & Nostalgimuseet Grängesberg is a nostalgic museum in Dalarna housed in a former steam centre of the Grängesberg mine. Its collection covers everyday life and technology from the 1920s onwards, including cars, motorcycles, mopeds, boat engines, photography, radio and forestry equipment. The museum also features historic workshops, shops and construction machinery, creating an extensive look at Sweden’s industrial and everyday heritage. For motorcycle travellers, the motorcycle and moped collection makes it an interesting stop while exploring Dalarna.

name: Torsångs Motormuseum
description: Torsångs Motormuseum is a small local museum dedicated to historic vehicles and motor culture in the Torsång area near Borlänge. Its collection includes vintage vehicles and mechanical memorabilia, offering visitors a glimpse into Sweden’s motoring heritage. The museum is a suitable stop for enthusiasts who enjoy classic vehicles and smaller, local collections rather than large commercial museums. Its rural location also makes it a natural addition to a motorcycle route through the Dalarna region.

name: Hanksville Farm
description: Hanksville Farm is a rural B&B, camping site and restaurant in Torrlösa, near Svalöv in southern Sweden. The property offers rooms, cottages and camping accommodation in a peaceful countryside setting, with a restaurant and bar on site. It has a long connection with the motorcycle community and has hosted motorcycle gatherings and rallies, making it a particularly interesting stop for riders. Its location in Skåne also makes it a convenient base for exploring the scenic roads of southern Sweden.

name: Bike Fest Panonika 2026
description:
Welcome to Bike Fest Panonika, Tuzla’s premier motorcycle gathering hosted by MK Tuzla, where passion, adrenaline, and brotherhood meet. Every summer, riders from across the region and Europe roll into the heart of Bosnia to celebrate the spirit of motorcycling against the backdrop of the famous Panonika lakes.
 Expect the thunder of engines, dazzling custom bikes, and the camaraderie of thousands of bikers united by the road. With live rock concerts, stunt shows, camping zones, and endless entertainment, Bike Fest Panonika transforms Tuzla into a biker’s paradise.
Whether you ride a cruiser, chopper, sportbike, or classic, you’ll find your tribe here. The atmosphere is electric, the nights unforgettable, and the friendships forged on the asphalt last forever.

name: Louer Une Moto .fr
description: Louer Une Moto .fr is a scooter and motorcycle rental service in Paris. Its fleet includes city scooters, Vespa models and larger motorcycles from brands such as Yamaha, Kawasaki, KTM and BMW. The company offers online booking with a choice of vehicle, rental period and additional options, as well as delivery and collection services.

name: Norton Museum Best
description: Norton Museum Best is a motorcycle museum in Best, the Netherlands, dedicated to the legendary British Norton brand. The collection features around 40 Norton motorcycles, including rare models and racing machines connected to the history of the Dutch TT in Assen. The museum showcases the development of Norton motorcycles and their place in British and international motorcycle history. It is a great stop for riders interested in classic motorcycles, racing heritage and historic motorcycle engineering.

name: Ekerödsrasten
description: Ekerödsrasten is a roadside restaurant and rest stop in Hörby, Skåne, popular with travellers crossing southern Sweden. The restaurant offers traditional Swedish food, lighter meals and refreshments in a convenient setting along the road. Its location makes it a practical stop for motorcycle travellers exploring the scenic roads of Skåne. It is also included among recommended stops for motorcycle riders in the region.

name: Cafe Zakun Ranta
description: Café Zakun Ranta, также известное как Voimala Zaku, — мотоциклетное кафе и место встреч в Уусикаупунки, Финляндия. Здесь проходят вечера Motor Café, во время которых собираются владельцы классических автомобилей, мотоциклов, мопедов и другой техники. В кафе можно поесть и выпить, а спокойная атмосфера делает его естественной остановкой для райдеров, путешествующих по финскому побережью. Место особенно понравится тем, кто интересуется классической техникой и местной мотокультурой.

name: Keppana Kellari
description: Keppana Kellari is a popular family-run restaurant in Liesjärvi, Finland, surrounded by forests and peaceful countryside. Established in 1992, the restaurant serves hearty homemade-style meals and is a well-known stop for travellers exploring the scenic roads of southern Finland. Its location makes it particularly suitable for motorcycle trips, with plenty of beautiful countryside roads nearby. The restaurant also offers accommodation in cottages, making it a convenient place to stop for both a meal and an overnight stay.

name: Tjorven Café & Museum
description: Tjorven Café & Museum is a charming café and small automobile museum in Rockneby, near Kalmar in southern Sweden. The museum showcases the iconic Tjorven cars produced by Kalmar Verkstad in the late 1960s, while the café serves homemade food, coffee and baked goods. Visitors can also see ongoing restoration work and explore the nostalgic collection. Its combination of classic vehicles, food and a relaxed countryside atmosphere makes it a memorable stop for road and motorcycle travellers.

name: Rebel Burgers
description: Rebel Burgers is a casual burger restaurant in Hörby, Skåne, serving burgers, fries and other classic fast-food dishes. Its convenient location makes it a practical stop for riders travelling through the countryside of southern Sweden. The restaurant is included among recommended stops for motorcycle riders exploring the region, making it a useful addition to a motorcycle travel route. It is a good choice for a relaxed meal during a day of riding.

name: Hardys
description: Hardys Höör is a casual restaurant and roadside stop in Höör, Skåne, serving burgers, sandwiches, traditional Swedish dishes and other filling meals. Its convenient location makes it a practical place to stop for food while travelling through southern Sweden. The restaurant is included among recommended stops for motorcycle riders exploring Skåne, making it particularly relevant for our motorcycle travel guide. It is a good choice for a relaxed meal during a day on the road.

name: Önneköpsbageriet & Noy's Thaikök
description: Önneköpsbageriet & Noy's Thaikök is a unique local bakery and Thai restaurant in Önneköp, in the countryside of Skåne, southern Sweden. The venue combines freshly baked Swedish pastries and bread with Thai cuisine, offering riders a choice between a coffee and traditional fika or a more substantial meal. Its rural location makes it a convenient and unusual stop while riding the scenic roads of Skåne. It is also recommended as a stop for motorcycle travellers exploring the region.

name: Backagårdens Kurs & Konferenscenter AB
description: Backagården is a countryside hotel and conference centre in Höör, surrounded by the beautiful beech forests of Skåne. The property offers hotel rooms, cottages and hostel accommodation, as well as a restaurant and plenty of space for groups. Backagården has a strong connection with the motorcycle community and regularly welcomes motorcycle and car groups, with dedicated road-trip packages including accommodation, meals and group rides. Its central location in Skåne and the scenic roads surrounding the property make it an excellent base for motorcycle travellers.
